strings.text: 小娘がうっすらと目を開ける。

暫くぼんやりと天井を見つめたあと、少しずつ意識を
覚醒させていった。
strings.translated:
She stared blankly at the ceiling for a moment, then
slowly began to regain her senses.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、どこだと思う？」

人がいると思ってなかったのか、小娘が大慌てでベッ
ドから起き上がった。
strings.translated:
She must not have expected anyone to be there -- the girl
scrambled up off the bed in a panic.

strings.text:
オレの顔を見るなり後ずさりして、体を壁際へと寄せ
ていく。
strings.translated:
The moment she saw his face, she backed away, pressing
herself against the wall.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ハッ、分っかりやすい反応してくれるぜ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Ha -- you sure make it easy to read you."

strings.text:
だいぶ混乱してるらしく、オレを見たり部屋を見たり
自分を見たりと忙しい。
strings.translated:
She seemed thoroughly confused, her eyes darting between
him, the room, and herself.

strings.text:
だが、それで事態を理解できるはずもなく、唯一自分
が異常な状況にあることだけ分かったようだった。
strings.translated:
But there was no way she could make sense of the situation
from that -- all she seemed to grasp was that something was terribly wrong.

strings.text:
恐怖で声も出ないのか、小娘が真っ青な顔になって
ガタガタと震える。
strings.translated:
Too paralyzed with fear to make a sound, the girl's face
had gone dead white as she shook uncontrollably.

strings.text:
まぶたは眼球が零れそうなほどに見開かれ、額には
びっしりと汗の粒ができていた。
strings.translated:
Her eyelids were stretched so wide her eyes looked ready
to fall out, and beads of sweat covered her forehead.

strings.text:
煉悟
「いいぜぇ。大人しいのは面倒がなくていい」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Good. Quiet ones are less trouble."

strings.text:
煉悟
「あとは、苗床としてしっかり蟲どもを産むんだな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Now just make sure you do your job and birth those Bugs
as a proper Seedbed."

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、ヒッ、ヒヒヒャヒャヒャヒャヒャッ！！」
高笑いしながら、部屋を後にする。
strings.translated: He left the room, laughing his high-pitched laugh.

strings.text: 説明など一切しないし、する必要もない。
strings.translated:
He had no intention of explaining anything -- nor any
need to.

strings.text:
あの小娘は単なる苗床で、それ以上でもそれ以下でも
ないからだ。
strings.translated:
That girl was nothing more than a Seedbed -- no more,
no less.
She was -- nothing but a tool--------.

strings.text:
昼になるより少し前になって、街のほうへと足を運ん
だ。
strings.translated: A little before noon, I made my way into town.

strings.text:
本当は大人しく身を隠すべきなんだろうが、あいにく
食料がスッカラカンの状態だ。
strings.translated:
I probably should have stayed low and kept out of sight,
but unfortunately my food supply was bone dry.

strings.text:
蟲使い、裏社会の人間とはいえ、やはり食わなくては
生きていけない。
strings.translated:
Bug User, underworld dweller -- even so, a man still
needed to eat to survive.

strings.text:
普段は、一週間分の食料で済ますのだが、今回は念の
ため二週間分買い込む事にした。
strings.translated:
Normally I'd buy enough to last a week, but this time
I decided to stock up for two weeks just to be safe.

strings.text:
何しろこういった生活だ。
いつも買い物に出られるとは限らない。
strings.translated:
Living the way I did, there was no guarantee I could
always get out to go shopping.

strings.text: 正直、自分以外に動ける奴がいると楽なんだが……。
strings.translated:
Honestly, it'd make life easier to have someone besides me
who could run errands...

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、あの小娘でも調教するかァ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Khih -- maybe I'll train that little girl to do it?"

strings.text: どうせ、今は蟲を産む以外に使い道のない奴だ。
strings.translated:
Right now she was useless for anything other than
birthing Bugs anyway.

strings.text: 気分が乗れば、奴隷にするのもいいかもしれない。
strings.translated:
If he felt like it, making her a slave might not be
a bad idea.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ん……そういや、ここだったな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Hn... come to think of it, this was the place."

strings.text:
街を歩いている途中、昨日女と闘り合った場所へやっ
て来ていた。
strings.translated:
Walking through town, I had wandered back to the spot
where I'd fought the woman yesterday.

strings.text:
道路にはちょいとした人だかりができ、黒ずんだアス
ファルトに目を向けている。
strings.translated:
A small crowd had gathered on the road, all eyes fixed
on the blackened asphalt.

strings.text:
自動車は撤去されたようだが、辺りにはまだガラスの
破片などが散らばっているようだった。
strings.translated:
The car had apparently been removed, but shards of glass
and other debris were still scattered around.

strings.text:
朝のニュースでは、そんな風に報道されているのだろ
うか。
strings.translated: Was that how the morning news had reported it?

strings.text:
隠れ家にはテレビがないので分からないが、いちいち
確認してそれを知ろうとも思わない。
strings.translated:
There was no TV at the hideout, so I had no way of
knowing -- and I had no desire to bother finding out.

strings.text:
例え事実がどうであっても、あの家族、そしてあの
小娘が不運だった事に変わりはないのだ。
strings.translated:
Whatever the truth of the matter, the fact remained that
that family -- and that girl -- had been unlucky.

strings.text: それよりも、当面の問題はあの蟲使いの女だ。
strings.translated: More pressing than that, though, was the immediate problem of that Bug User woman.

strings.text:
オレ自身の力量も、蟲の強さも、今のままでは敵わな
い。
strings.translated: My own strength, the power of my Bugs -- neither was a match for her as things stood.

strings.text:
ましてや、敵があの女一人かどうかさえ分からない今、
オレにできる事は、少しでも強力な蟲を増やすことく
らいだった。
strings.translated: What's more, I didn't even know if she was the only enemy I was up against. About all I could do was build up as many powerful Bugs as possible.

strings.text:
煉悟
「さぁて、これからどうしたもんか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"So then... what's the plan from here?"

strings.text:
幸いにして倉庫には数匹の蟲を残していたが、言い換
えればそれが全ての戦力とも言える。
strings.translated: Fortunately, I had left a few Bugs back at the warehouse -- but in other words, those were my entire fighting force.

strings.text:
オレの体ひとつでどうにかなる相手ならともかく、
蟲使いが相手となればやはり蟲が必要だった。
strings.translated: If she were the kind of opponent I could handle with my body alone, that would be one thing -- but against a Bug User, I needed Bugs.

strings.text: 果たして、手持ちの蟲をどう使うべきか……。
strings.translated: The question was how to best use the Bugs I had on hand...

Rengo
"Should I try making a move?"

strings.text: 相手はオレを殺したと思っているかもしれない。
strings.translated: She might think she'd already killed me.

strings.text: そこを衝けば、勝機が見えてくるかもしれなかった。
strings.translated: If I could exploit that, a chance at victory might open up.

strings.text:
もっとも、あの女がどこにいるのか分からないのだか
ら、攻撃する事など不可能なのだが……。
strings.translated: Of course, since I had no idea where that woman was, actually launching an attack was out of the question...

strings.text:
煉悟
「餌の時間が同じなら、可能性はあるな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"If she feeds at the same time I do, there's a chance."

strings.text:
蟲を飼っている以上、どこかで餌を与えなければなら
ない。
strings.translated: As long as you keep Bugs, you have to feed them somewhere.

strings.text:
ドッグフードみたいなもんがあって屋内で食わせてる
ならアウトだが、もしもオレと同じで蟲を放す方法を
取っているのだとしたら……。
strings.translated: If she had some kind of dog food equivalent and was feeding them indoors, I was out of luck -- but if she used the same method I did and let them loose...

strings.text:
煉悟
「どうせこっちも餌は食わさなきゃならねぇしな。
　見つけた端から襲ってみるか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Either way, I've got to feed mine too.
 Might as well jump her the moment I spot her."

strings.text:
可能性としてはあまり高くないが、やってみる価値が
ないわけでもない。
strings.translated: The odds weren't particularly high, but that didn't mean it wasn't worth trying.

strings.text:
要するに餌を取ってる間に敵に出くわせば、片っ端か
らぶっ潰せと命令を下しておけばいいだけの話だ。
strings.translated: In short, all I had to do was give the order: if you run into an enemy Bug while you're out feeding, crush it on the spot.

strings.text:
煉悟
「よぅし、そうと決まれば早速試してみるか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Alright, now that that's settled, let's give it a shot."

strings.text:
煉悟
「面倒だ。ここで放してみるか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Too much trouble. Maybe I'll just let them loose here."

strings.text:
普通に考えれば、餌の多い森や川辺で放すほうが自然
だ。
strings.translated: Common sense said it was more natural to release them in a forest or riverbank where prey was plentiful.

strings.text:
だが、可能性がゼロではない以上、試してみるのも
悪くないだろう。
strings.translated: But as long as the possibility wasn't zero, trying it out couldn't hurt.

strings.text:
ゆっくりと街を歩きながら、一匹ずつ蟲を解き放って
いく。
strings.translated: Walking slowly through town, I released the Bugs one by one.

strings.text:
もちろん、そのへんをボーッと歩いてる連中に気付か
れるようなヘマはしない。
strings.translated: Of course, I wasn't careless enough to let the people wandering around notice.

strings.text:
オレの足元を注意して見てる奴がいれば話は別だが、
それなりに混雑している人ごみの中で、そんな奇妙な
ことをしてる暇人はいないだろう。
strings.translated: If someone happened to be watching my feet closely, that would be another matter -- but in a crowd this size, nobody would be idle enough to do something that odd.

strings.text: 適度に間隔を開けて、蟲を街中に放していく。
strings.translated: At measured intervals, I released the Bugs throughout the town.

strings.text:
果たして、この辺りに奴の蟲はいるのか、それとも
全く別の場所で悠々と餌を食っているのか。
strings.translated: Were any of her Bugs lurking around here, or were they off somewhere else, feeding at their leisure?

strings.text:
あまり期待はせずに、オレは蟲どもの帰りを待つこと
にした……。
strings.translated: Without expecting too much, I decided to wait for my Bugs to return...

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、予想通りってヤツか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, just about what I expected."

strings.text: 戻ってきた蟲どもを回収して、オレは短く嘆息した。
strings.translated: I collected the Bugs as they returned and let out a short sigh.

strings.text:
どうやら一匹として敵の蟲とは遇わなかったらしく、
都会に棲む昆虫なんかをせっせと喰らったようだ。
strings.translated: It seemed not a single one had encountered an enemy Bug -- they'd apparently been busily feeding on whatever insects happened to live in the city.

strings.text:
その間、オレはと言えばあの女が現れそうな場所を
歩いたりしてみたのだが成果はゼロ。
strings.translated: As for me, I'd spent the time walking around places where that woman seemed likely to appear, but came up with nothing.

strings.text: ま、蟲どもが安全に餌を食えただけ良しとするか。
strings.translated: Well, at least the Bugs got to feed safely. I'd call that good enough.

strings.text:
蟲どもに餌をやるため、オレはよく利用する森へと
やって来た。
strings.translated: To feed my Bugs, I had come to the forest I often used.

strings.text:
辺りの雰囲気はいつも通りで、これといって変わった
様子はない。
strings.translated: The atmosphere around me was the same as always -- nothing out of the ordinary.

strings.text:
あの女がここにいる可能性は低そうだと思いながら、
オレは蟲を放ってみることにした。
strings.translated: Thinking it unlikely that woman would be here, I decided to release the Bugs anyway.

strings.text: オレの命令を受けて、数匹の蟲が森の中に入っていく。
strings.translated: Following my order, several Bugs disappeared into the forest.

strings.text:
もっとも、敵の蟲に攻撃する許可を与えているだけで、
実際は命令というほどのものじゃないのだが……。
strings.translated: Though really, all I'd given them was permission to attack any enemy Bugs they found -- it wasn't much of an order in the true sense...

strings.text:
煉悟
「……ったく、面倒なことになってきやがったぜ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"...Damn, this is turning into a real pain in the ass."

strings.text:
近くの樹の幹に寝転んで、頭の上に広がる空を見つめ
る。
strings.translated: I lay back against a nearby tree trunk and stared up at the sky spreading above my head.

strings.text:
蟲使いの村から逃げ出して何年経ったかは忘れたが、
上手く隠れ続けてきたというのに、西の野郎が全て
台無しにしてくれた。
strings.translated: I'd lost count of how many years it had been since I fled the Bug User village -- I'd managed to stay hidden all that time, and then that bastard Nishi had gone and ruined everything.

strings.text:
あの閉鎖的な一族のことだ。
オレが生きている限り、次々と追っ手を送り込んでく
るだろう。
strings.translated: That insular clan was exactly the type. As long as I was alive, they'd keep sending hunters after me, one after another.

strings.text:
この戦いが終わったら、活動する町の拠点を変えたほ
うがいいかもしれない。
strings.translated: Once this fight was over, it might be better to move my base of operations to a different town.

strings.text:
だが、今の環境は気に入ってるし、何より西の仕事が
貴重な収入源になっているのは否定できない。
strings.translated: But I'd grown fond of my current setup, and I couldn't deny that Nishi's work was a valuable source of income.

strings.text:
必要以上に騒ぎを起こさず、気楽に暮らすためには、
今の状態は打って付けなのだった。
strings.translated: To live easy without stirring up more trouble than necessary, my current situation was perfectly suited.

strings.text:
煉悟
「時代遅れの連中め……」
毒づいてまぶたを閉じる。
strings.translated: I muttered a curse and closed my eyes.

strings.text:
かつては時代の闇に生き、裏の仕事を請負っていた
蟲使いも今では衰退の一途をたどっている。
strings.translated: Bug Users, who had once lived in the shadows of their era and taken on work from the underworld, were now on a steady path toward decline.

strings.text:
昔ならいざ知らず、現代において蟲を使った仕事など
そうそうあるはずもない。
strings.translated:
Maybe it was different in the old days, but in the modern era, there was hardly any work
to be had that involved Bugs.

strings.text:
結果、連中は森の中でひっそりと暮らし、今に至って
いるのだ。
strings.translated:
As a result, those people lived quietly in the forest,
right up to the present day.

strings.text:
オレは、そんな生活に嫌気が差し、一族の村を逃げ出
した……。
strings.translated:
I had grown sick of that kind of life, and so I fled
the clan's village...

strings.text:
思い出そうとすれば、今でもまぶたの裏に映すことが
できる……。
strings.translated:
If I try to remember, I can still see it
behind my eyelids even now...

strings.text: 薄暗く、冷たい、蟲の巣食う森。
strings.translated: A dim, cold forest, infested with Bugs.

strings.text: 古びた結界を張り、外の世界から隔絶された空間。
strings.translated:
A space sealed off from the outside world
behind ancient barrier wards.

strings.text:
普通の人間なら立ち入る事もできないその場所は、
逆に外に出るのも難しい。
strings.translated:
That place, which ordinary humans could not even enter,
was equally difficult to leave.

strings.text:
蟲使い達の中には、一度も森を出ることなく死んでい
く者もいるくらいだ。
strings.translated:
There were even Bug Users who died
without ever once leaving the forest.

strings.text: ――森と共に生き、蟲と共に生きる。
strings.translated: -- To live with the forest, to live with the Bugs.

strings.text:
外の世界がどれだけ広いのか、そんなことも知らずに、
蟲使い達は森の中で生き続けようとする。
strings.translated:
Not even knowing how vast the outside world was,
the Bug Users continued trying to live on within the forest.

strings.text:
自分達の生き方に疑問さえ抱かず、己の生を全うしよ
うとする。
strings.translated:
Never questioning their own way of life,
trying to live out their existence to the fullest.

strings.text:
煉悟
「そんなもんに縋るようにして生きて、何になるって
　んだか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"What's the point of living
 like you're clinging to something like that?"

strings.text: 昔の生活を思い出して、オレは小さく舌打ちした。
strings.translated: Remembering the life I'd left behind, I clicked my tongue softly.

strings.text:
頭の中を占めるのは、蟲を操る修練ばかりの記憶だけ
で、それ以外に覚えていることなどない。
strings.translated:
The only memories occupying my mind were of training to control Bugs --
there was nothing else I could recall.

strings.text:
たとえ裏切り者として命を狙われようとも、今の生活
のほうが何倍もマシだった。
strings.translated:
Even if it meant being hunted as a traitor,
my current life was a hundred times better.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、あの女にもそれを分からせてやるか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Khih -- maybe I'll make that woman understand the same thing."

strings.text:
あの蟲使いの女をとっ捕まえたときの事を想像して、
オレは軽く肩を揺らした。
strings.translated:
Imagining the moment I'd get my hands on that Bug User woman,
I gave a light shake of my shoulders.

strings.text: 耳の奥で、艶かしい嬌声が聞こえた気がした……。
strings.translated: Deep in my ears, I thought I could hear a seductive moan...

strings.text:
森の中に入って程なく、オレは道なき道を進み川辺へ
とやって来ていた。
strings.translated:
Not long after entering the forest, I had pushed through pathless terrain
and made my way to the riverbank.

strings.text:
辺りからは、鳥の鳴き声やら小動物の気配やらがして、
のどかと言えばのどかだ。
strings.translated:
From all around came birdsong and the presence of small animals --
peaceful, you might say.

strings.text:
念のため神経を集中させてみるが、蟲の気配も感じら
れない。
strings.translated:
I focused my senses as a precaution,
but I couldn't detect any trace of Bugs.

strings.text:
……もっとも、オレは感知が苦手だったから、あまり
アテにならないかもしれないが。
strings.translated:
Though, since detection was never my strong suit,
I might not be the most reliable judge of that.

strings.text:
煉悟
「オラ、行って来い。
　……んで、他の蟲がいたらぶっ殺しちまえ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Go on, get out there.
 ...And if you find any other Bugs, kill them."

strings.text: そんな命令を下しながら、蟲を周囲の森へと解き放つ。
strings.translated: Issuing that order, I released my Bugs into the surrounding forest.

strings.text:
結果にはあまり期待していないが、オレは木陰に座り
込んで暫く待つことにした。
strings.translated:
I wasn't expecting much from the results, but I settled down
in the shade of a tree and decided to wait a while.

strings.text: 俄かに辺りの気配が騒がしくなった。
strings.translated: All at once, the forest around me came alive with commotion.

strings.text:
遠くから鳥の羽ばたきが聞こえ、同時に鳴き声が響き
渡る。
strings.translated:
The sound of birds taking flight reached me from a distance,
their cries ringing out at the same time.

strings.text:
ガサガサと風ではない何かで木々が揺れ、黒い影が
矢のような速度で飛び回った。
strings.translated:
The trees rustled with something that was not the wind,
and black shadows darted about at arrow-like speed.

strings.text:
衝撃で枝から離れた木の葉が、ひらひらと地面に舞い
落ちる。
strings.translated:
Leaves shaken loose from branches by the impact
drifted fluttering down to the ground.

strings.text:
あまり期待はしてなかったが、この辺りでオレ以外に
蟲に食事をさせてた奴がいたらしい。
strings.translated:
I hadn't been expecting much, but it seemed someone other than me
had been letting their Bugs feed in this area.

strings.text:
まあ、昨日の今日である事を考えるなら、おそらく
あの女の蟲だろうが……。
strings.translated:
Well, since it was only the day after the fight,
it was probably that woman's Bugs...

strings.text:
蟲同士の戦いは暫く続いたようだが、食事のために
ここにいる蟲と、敵を見つけたら攻撃とまで命令さ
れた蟲とでは、根本的に行動が異なる。
strings.translated:
The battle between Bugs seemed to go on for a while, but there was a fundamental difference in behavior
between Bugs that were here to feed and Bugs that had been ordered
to attack any enemy they found.

strings.text:
その理由もあってか、数十分後には、オレの周りに
四匹の蟲の死骸が落ちる結果となっていた。
strings.translated:
Perhaps for that reason, within a few dozen minutes,
four Bug carcasses had fallen around me.

strings.text:
煉悟
「こっちの被害はゼロか」

多少傷付いた蟲はいるものの、致命的なダメージを
受けたものはいない。
strings.translated: A few of my Bugs had taken some damage, but none had suffered anything fatal.

strings.text: たった四匹、されど四匹――――。

この結果が後々影響してくるかどうかは分からないが、
ひとまず狙い通りの結果となったことに、オレは優越
感を覚えずにはいられなかった……。
strings.translated:
Whether this outcome would have repercussions down the line remained to be seen,
but for now, having achieved exactly the result I'd aimed for,
I couldn't help but feel a surge of satisfaction...

strings.text: 錆び付いた鉄の扉を開ける。
strings.translated: I opened the rusted iron door.

strings.text:
『苗床』の様子を見るため、気まぐれに寄ってみただ
けなのだが、小娘の反応はやはり露骨だった。
strings.translated:
I had only stopped by on a whim to check on the "Seedbed,"
but the little girl's reaction was as obvious as ever.

strings.text:
ベッドの上で膝を抱えていた小娘が、オレの姿を見る
なりビクッと体を震わせる。
strings.translated:
The little girl who had been sitting on the bed hugging her knees
shuddered violently the moment she saw me.

strings.text:
顔色は一瞬にして青褪め、蟲の体液にまみれた体を
壁へと押し付けた。
strings.translated:
Her complexion drained in an instant, and she pressed her body --
still drenched in Bug fluid -- against the wall.

strings.text:
煉悟
「いよぅ、まだ起きてやがったか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Hey there -- still awake, are you?"

strings.text: 今度は悲鳴にもならない声、というよりも息が漏れる。
strings.translated: This time it wasn't even a scream -- more like a breath escaping her.

strings.text: これでは、会話をするどころの話ではない。
strings.translated: There was no chance of having a conversation at this rate.

strings.text:
ガクガクと痙攣したように震える小娘は、明らかに
目の焦点が合っておらず、今にも呼吸困難で死んで
しまいそうな様子だった。
strings.translated:
The little girl was trembling in convulsive spasms, her eyes clearly unfocused,
looking as though she might die from hyperventilation at any moment.

strings.text:
まあ、オレとしては無事に蟲を産めばそれで構わない
んだが…………。
strings.translated: Well, as far as I'm concerned, as long as she can birth the Bugs safely, that's all that matters..........

strings.text: 今のところ、小娘の体に変化はない。
strings.translated: For now, there's no change in the girl's body.

strings.text:
昨日の今日だから仕方ないが、蟲が産まれるのには
暫く時間が掛かるだろう。
strings.translated: It only happened yesterday, so it can't be helped -- it'll take some time before the Bugs are born.

strings.text:
本当はすぐにでも欲しいんだが、こればっかりはどう
にもならない。
strings.translated: I'd like them as soon as possible, but there's nothing to be done about that.

strings.text: 来るべき日まで、気長に待つしかなかった。
strings.translated: All I could do was wait patiently until the day comes.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、しっかりと寝て体力だけはつけとくんだなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, make sure you sleep and keep your strength up, yeah."

strings.text: ゲラゲラと笑いながら、オレは部屋の扉を閉めた……。
strings.translated: Laughing my head off, I shut the door to the room......

strings.text:
オレが部屋に入るなり、小娘が抱きかかえた体を強張
らせた。
strings.translated: The moment I stepped into the room, the little girl's huddled body went rigid.

strings.text:
どうやら昨夜は一睡もせず、ずっと同じ格好のまま
過ごしたらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed she hadn't slept a wink all night, staying in the exact same position the whole time.

strings.text:
相変わらず顔色は悪いが、それでも昨日ほど青くはな
かった。
strings.translated: Her complexion was still poor, but even so, she wasn't quite as pale as yesterday.

strings.text: まあ、ずっと怯えっぱなしより良い傾向だ。
strings.translated: Well, that's a better sign than being terrified nonstop.

strings.text: たぶん、一晩中考えていたのだろう。
strings.translated: She had probably been thinking about it all night long.

strings.text:
目の下には隈が出来ているが、眠るどころか異様な
ギラ付きさえ感じられた。
strings.translated: There were dark circles under her eyes, but rather than looking sleepy, there was an unsettling, feverish gleam in them.

strings.text:
夢美
「ジュース、買ってって……言っ……それで……
　車……停めて、もらって……降りて…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I asked them... to buy me some juice... and then...
they stopped... the car for me... and I got out..."

strings.text:
なるほど、あそこに自動車があったのはそういうわけ
か。
strings.translated: Ah, so that's why there was a car back there.

strings.text:
小娘にとっちゃ、ジュースを買いに車外に出たはずな
のに、気付けばこんな場所で蟲の卵を植え付けられた
わけで……。
strings.translated:
From the girl's perspective, she had stepped outside the car to buy juice,
and the next thing she knew, she was in a place like this with Bug eggs planted inside her......

strings.text:
様子から察するに、炎上する自動車のことは覚えてい
ないらしい。
strings.translated: Judging by her demeanor, she didn't seem to remember anything about the car going up in flames.

strings.text:
煉悟
「オレは、テメーの所有者だ」

にぃっと口の端をつり上げて言ったが、小娘はあまり
理解していないようで、暫く不思議そうな表情を浮か
べただけだった。
strings.translated:
I said it with a grin curling the corner of my mouth, but the little girl didn't seem to quite understand,
and just stared back at me with a puzzled look for a while.

strings.text:
面白味はないが、まあこのへんは今後じっくりと教え
込んでやる。
strings.translated: Not very entertaining, but I'll drill it into her thoroughly soon enough.

strings.text:
夢美
「お父さんと、お母さんは…………？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"What about... my dad and mom...?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「お前の親か？　そうだなァ――――」

煉悟
「――派手に燃えてたからなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"-- they were burning pretty spectacularly."

strings.text:
今度はそれなりに意味が伝わったらしく、小娘の表情
がさっと変化する。
strings.translated: This time the meaning seemed to get through well enough, and the little girl's expression shifted in an instant.

strings.text: 強張っていた体も、この瞬間だけは緩んだようだった。
strings.translated: The tension in her body loosened, if only for that one moment.

strings.text:
煉悟
「火葬する手間が省けて良かったんじゃないか？
　クヒヒヒヒャヒャヒャッ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Saves the trouble of cremating them, doesn't it?
 Kuhihihihyahyahya!!"

strings.text: 小娘が、呆然とした表情でオレを見つめる。
strings.translated: The little girl stares at me with a blank, dazed expression.

strings.text:
まだ全てを理解するには至っていないが、自分の親が
どうなったのかは、何となく察したらしかった。
strings.translated: She hadn't yet grasped the full picture, but she seemed to have vaguely understood what had become of her parents.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、せっかく生き残ったんだ。
　オレのために元気な蟲を産んでくれよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, you managed to survive, so.
 Go ahead and birth some healthy Bugs for me."

strings.text:
オレの言葉に、小娘がびくっと体を震わせて自分の
腹を見つめる。
strings.translated: At my words, the little girl flinched and looked down at her own stomach.

strings.text:
植え付けられた卵でも感じるのか、顔色は真っ青だっ
た。
strings.translated: Perhaps she could feel the eggs that had been planted inside her -- her face had gone completely white.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、楽しみにしてるぜ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Kuhih, I'm looking forward to it."

strings.text:
小娘のいる部屋を出て、いつものように壊れかけた
ソファーに腰を下ろす。
strings.translated: I left the room where the little girl was and sank into the half-broken sofa as usual.

strings.text:
冗談のような言い方をしたが、実際のところあの小娘
には戦力になる蟲を産んでもらう必要がある。
strings.translated: I said it like it was a joke, but in truth, I need that girl to birth Bugs that can be actual fighting power.
After all, my enemy is a Bug User.

strings.text:
西が今まで用意してきた連中は、オレにとっては単な
る雑魚以外のなにものでもなかったが、さすがに同族
ともなると楽じゃない。
strings.translated:
The ones Nishi had lined up for me until now were nothing more than small fry as far as I was concerned,
but dealing with our own kind is a different story -- it won't be easy.

strings.text: 果たして、これからどうするべきか――――
strings.translated: So what should I do from here --

strings.text:
――あの女の情報でも集めに外へ出るか、それとも
ここで大人しく時を過ごすか。
strings.translated: -- should I head outside to gather information on that woman, or stay here and bide my time quietly.

strings.text: 考える時間は、そう多くはなかった……。
strings.translated: I didn't have much time to think...

strings.text:
煉悟
「もう一度、この辺からあたってみるか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Guess I'll try canvassing this area again."

strings.text:
蟲使いの女と戦ったビルの前までやって来て、オレは
数匹の蟲を街に放った。
strings.translated:
I made my way back to the building where I'd fought that Bug User woman, and released
a few Bugs into the city.

strings.text:
与えた命令は、他の蟲を見つけたら報せろという単純
なものだ。
strings.translated: The order I gave them was simple -- find any other Bugs and report back.

strings.text:
正直、見つかるとは思ってないが、何もしないよりは
マシだろう。
strings.translated: Honestly, I don't expect them to find anything, but it's better than doing nothing.

strings.text:
隠れ家でじっとしてるなんて過ごし方は、オレの好み
じゃない。
strings.translated: Sitting still in a hideout isn't exactly my style.

strings.text:
煉悟
「何か手掛かりでもありゃいいんだが……」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Would be nice if I could find some kind of lead..."

strings.text: 蟲に探させる一方で、オレも街をぶらつく。
strings.translated: While the Bugs searched, I wandered the streets myself.

strings.text:
あの女とバッタリ鉢合わせるような事はないだろうが、
注意しておくに越したことはない。
strings.translated: I doubted I'd run into that woman by chance, but it never hurt to stay cautious.

strings.text:
認めるのは癪だが、まともに戦えばオレの劣勢は免れ
ないからな。
strings.translated: It galled me to admit it, but in a straight fight, I'd be at a disadvantage.

strings.text:
理想的なのは、相手が気付いてないうちに襲っちまう
ことなんだが……。
strings.translated: Ideally, I'd catch her off guard before she even knew I was there, but...

strings.text:
煉悟
「グダグダ考えても仕方ねぇか」
オレは溜息をついて、アテもなく街を歩き始めた。
strings.translated: I let out a sigh and started walking through the city with no particular destination.

strings.text:
煉悟
「……ったく、結局時間の無駄かよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"...Damn, what a waste of time."

strings.text:
とっぷりと陽が暮れた時刻になって、オレは今日の
探索を諦めることにした。
strings.translated: By the time the sun had fully set, I decided to call off today's search.

strings.text:
今日一日、あちこち歩き回りながら蟲を飛ばしたが、
収穫らしい収穫は全くない。
strings.translated: I'd spent the whole day wandering all over the place with my Bugs out, and came up with absolutely nothing.

strings.text:
夕方頃に森に寄って、オレの蟲の腹が膨れたこと以外
は、骨折り損のくたびれもうけだった。
strings.translated: Aside from stopping by the forest in the evening to let my Bugs feed, it had been a complete waste of effort.

strings.text:
まあ、一日ですぐに見つかるとは思っちゃいないんだ
が……。
strings.translated: Well, I wasn't really expecting to find anything in just one day, but...

strings.text:
それよりも問題なのは、あっちがどれだけオレの情報
を得ているか、だ。
strings.translated: The bigger problem was how much information she had on me.

strings.text:
万が一、オレの住処がバレていたとしたら、おちおち
寝てもいられなくなる。
strings.translated: If my hideout had been compromised, I wouldn't be able to sleep easy.

strings.text:
もしかすると西の野郎に、どういう情報を流しておび
き寄せたのか、それを確認しといたほうがいいのかも
しれねぇな。
strings.translated: Maybe I should check in with that bastard Nishi and find out exactly what kind of information he'd leaked to lure her here.

strings.text:
背後に誰かの視線を感じた気がして、オレは思わず
足を止めた。
strings.translated: I felt someone's gaze on my back, and stopped in my tracks without thinking.

strings.text:
街中だから人は大勢いるが、誰かに見られているよう
な気がしたのだ。
strings.translated: There were plenty of people around in the city, but I had the distinct feeling someone was watching me.

strings.text:
暫く視線を感じた方向を睨み付けて、あの女がいない
かどうかを確認する。
strings.translated: I stared hard in the direction I'd felt the gaze, checking to see if that woman was anywhere nearby.
A bad feeling crept over me.

strings.text:
姿を見たわけでもないのに、あの女が近くにいるよう
な気がしてならなかった。
strings.translated: I hadn't even seen her, yet I couldn't shake the feeling that she was close.

strings.text:
怯えたような態度の自分に苛立ち、小さく舌打ちをす
る。
strings.translated: I clicked my tongue quietly, irritated at myself for acting so rattled.

strings.text:
確かにあの女のほうが戦い慣れてるかもしれねぇが、
怯える必要はどこにもない。
strings.translated: Sure, she might be more battle-hardened than me, but there was no reason to be afraid.

strings.text:
まともに正面から戦わなければ、幾らでも勝つ方法は
あるはずなのだ。
strings.translated: As long as I didn't fight her head-on, there had to be any number of ways to win.

Rengo
"Next time, I'll be the one who wins."

strings.text:
オレはそう呟くと、今日はもう隠れ家へと戻ることに
した。
strings.translated: I muttered that to myself, then decided to head back to the hideout for the night.

strings.text:
背後に感じたはずの視線は、気のせいだと思うことに
した……。
strings.translated: I chose to believe that the gaze I'd felt on my back was just my imagination...

strings.text:
人気のない路地裏を通っている時、不意に衣服の内側
で蟲どもが蠢いた。
strings.translated: I was cutting through a deserted back alley when the Bugs beneath my clothes suddenly stirred.

strings.text: どうやらまた腹が空いたらしい。
夕方ごろに喰ったはずなのに、意地汚い奴等だ。
strings.translated: I'd fed them just a few hours ago in the evening -- greedy little bastards.

strings.text:
煉悟
「仕方ねぇか。あの女と対峙しても、腹ペコで負け
　ちゃあシャレになんねぇからな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Fine, whatever. If I run into that woman and lose because my Bugs were starving,
that'd be no joke."

strings.text:
煉悟
「このまま森のほうに寄り道して――――」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I'll make a detour through the forest on the way back ----"

strings.text: それは、完全な油断だった。
strings.translated: It was a complete lapse in focus.

strings.text:
蟲の餌場をどこにするか、その思考で頭の中が埋め尽
くされて、自分の背後に迫っている殺気を感知しそこ
ねた。
strings.translated: My mind had been so consumed with where to take the Bugs to feed that I failed to sense the killing intent closing in from behind.

strings.text: ――あの女の蟲が、オレの右肩に食らい付いていた。
strings.translated: -- that woman's Bug had sunk its teeth into my right shoulder.

strings.text:
捕まえようと手を伸ばすが、それより早く蟲が空中に
逃げる。
strings.translated: I reached out to grab it, but the Bug darted into the air before I could.

strings.text:
そして、頭上を旋回しながら、カチカチと小刻みに
歯を鳴らす。
strings.translated: It circled above my head, clicking its mandibles in rapid, staccato bursts.

strings.text: 仲間を呼んでやがるな――――ッ！

舌打ちをしながら、ここでようやくオレも蟲を解き放
つ。
strings.translated: Clicking my tongue, I finally released my own Bugs.

strings.text:
今のうちに仕留めなければ、かなり危険な状況に陥っ
てしまう。
strings.translated: If I didn't take it down now, I'd find myself in a seriously dangerous situation.

strings.text:
何しろオレは本調子じゃないし、蟲の数も十に満たな
いのだ。
strings.translated: After all, I wasn't at full strength, and I had fewer than ten Bugs to my name.

strings.text: まともな戦闘を行うには、今は条件が悪すぎる。
strings.translated: The conditions were far too poor for a proper fight.

strings.text:
背中に羽虫のような羽を生やしたオレの蟲どもが、
空へと舞い上がる。
strings.translated: My Bugs, their backs sprouting wings like those of flying insects, took to the air.

strings.text:
数の上では二対一だが、飛行速度は明らかに敵のほう
が勝っていた。
strings.translated: In terms of numbers it was two against one, but the enemy's flight speed was clearly superior.

strings.text:
ものの数分のうちに一匹が食いつかれ、胴体を半分に
引きちぎられる。
strings.translated: Within a matter of minutes, one of mine was caught -- and torn clean in half.

strings.text: コイツは――あの女の蟲じゃない――――ッ！？
strings.translated: This thing -- it's not that woman's Bug -- !

strings.text:
肉を抉られた右肩を押さえながら、頭上の戦闘をじっ
と見つめる。
strings.translated: Pressing my hand against my gouged right shoulder, I watched the battle overhead.

strings.text:
姿形はさほど変わらないが、敵の蟲は運動能力そのも
のが違っていた。
strings.translated: Their appearance wasn't all that different, but the enemy Bug's raw physical capability was on another level.

strings.text:
あの女の蟲かどうかは分からないが、少なくともあの
晩に戦った蟲とは違う。
strings.translated: Whether it belonged to that woman or not, it was at least different from the Bug I'd fought that night.

strings.text:
そうこうしているうちに、オレの蟲は一匹目がやられ
ていた。
strings.translated: While I was busy thinking, the first of my Bugs had already been taken down.

strings.text:
くるりときびすを返して路地裏を走りながら、残った
蟲に撤退の合図を出す。
strings.translated: I spun on my heel and sprinted through the alley, signaling the remaining Bugs to retreat.

strings.text:
逃げるのは趣味じゃないが、このまま残り少ない蟲を
黙って殺されるわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: Running wasn't my style, but I couldn't just stand there and let my already dwindling Bugs get slaughtered.

strings.text:
今はとにかく逃げて、蟲の追撃を振り払うしかなかっ
た。
strings.translated: For now, all I could do was run and shake off the pursuing Bugs.
The question was where to run -- --

strings.text:
煉悟を襲撃したあと、サユリは携帯電話である人物と
連絡を取っていた。
strings.translated: After ambushing Rengo, Sayuri had used her cell phone to contact someone.

strings.text:
サユリ
「あの男を確認したわ。
　まさかとは思ってたけど、生きてた」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"I've spotted that man. I didn't think it was possible, but -- he's alive."

strings.text:
サユリ
「今、仕留められれば良かったんだけど……他の蟲を
　街に放してたのが仇になったわ」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"I would have liked to finish him off right then... but having released my other Bugs into the town came back to bite me."

strings.text: サユリが煉悟を見つけたのは、ただの偶然だった。
strings.translated: Sayuri's discovery of Rengo had been pure coincidence.

strings.text:
まさか、という思いを抱えつつ後を尾けて、路地裏に
入ったところを襲ったのだ。
strings.translated: Harboring a sense of disbelief, she had tailed him and struck the moment he entered the alley.

strings.text:
だが、手持ちの蟲が少なかったことが災いし、まんま
と逃げられてしまった。
strings.translated: But the fact that she had too few Bugs on hand had worked against her, and he'd managed to slip away.

strings.text:
サユリ
「あの様子だと、たぶん私のことを調べていたんで
　しょうね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"Judging by how he looked, he was probably investigating me."

strings.text:
サユリ
「ええ、分かってる。気を付けるわ」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"Yes, I understand. I'll be careful."

strings.text:
低い声で答えながら、サユリは薄暗い路地裏を見つめ
た。
strings.translated: Answering in a low voice, Sayuri stared into the dim alley.

strings.text: そこにはただ、冷たい風が吹き抜けていた……。
strings.translated: Nothing was there -- only a cold wind sweeping through...

strings.text:
奴に借りを作るのは癪だが、今はそうも言ってられな
い。
strings.translated: It galled me to owe that man a favor, but now wasn't the time to be picky.

strings.text:
走りながら携帯電話のボタンを押すと、幸いにして
西はすぐに出た。
strings.translated: I jabbed at my cell phone while running, and fortunately Nishi picked up right away.

strings.text:
西
「何事かね？　君のほうから掛けてくるとは珍しい」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"What's the matter? It's unusual for you to be the one calling."

strings.text:
煉悟
「あの女のものかどうか分からんが、今、蟲に追われ
　てる」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I don't know if it's that woman's or not, but I've got Bugs on my tail right now."

strings.text:
西
「ふむ、なるほど。……現在位置を教えてくれ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Hmm, I see. ...Tell me your current location."

strings.text:
今の会話で、状況からオレの求めているものを全て
察してくれたらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed he'd gathered everything I needed from the situation just from that brief exchange.

strings.text:
いけ好かない奴だが、こういう時は大いに使い道が
あった。
strings.translated: He was an insufferable man, but in moments like this, he was damn useful.

strings.text:
西
「今から指定するポイントへ。
　こちらからはユーリアを行かせよう」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Head to the point I'm about to give you.
 I'll send Yulia from our end."

strings.text:
煉悟
「あの女？　役に立つのかよ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"That woman? Is she actually going to be any use?"

strings.text:
西
「少なくとも、今の君よりはね」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"At least more than you are right now."

strings.text:
ムカつく言葉を残して、西のほうからさっさと電話を
切る。
strings.translated: Leaving those infuriating words behind, Nishi hung up first.

strings.text:
掛けなおして文句の一つも言ってやりたかったが、
生憎そんな暇はなさそうだった。
strings.translated: I wanted to call back and give him a piece of my mind, but unfortunately it didn't look like I had the time.

strings.text:
煉悟
「とにかく、今は逃げ延びるのが先決かッ！」

背後に蟲の気配を感じながら、オレは指定されたポイ
ントへと全力で駆けた。
strings.translated: Sensing the Bugs at my back, I ran at full speed toward the designated point.

strings.text: 走り続けること十五分。
オレは、西の指定したポイントへと到着していた。
strings.translated: I had arrived at the point Nishi had specified.

strings.text:
本当はもっと早くたどり着くつもりだったのだが、
右肩からの出血もあってか、思ったより体力が落ち
ているらしい。
strings.translated: I'd intended to get there faster, but between the blood loss from my right shoulder and everything else, my stamina had dropped more than I'd expected.

strings.text:
ここから、さらにどこかへ走れなどと言われたら、
ちょっとヤバイかもしれねぇな……。
strings.translated: If he told me to keep running somewhere from here, I might actually be in trouble...

strings.text:
いつからいたのか、そして挨拶もなしに、突然オレの
前に現れたユーリアが小さな筒を差し出していた。
strings.translated: Without any warning, Yulia had appeared before me -- I had no idea how long she'd been there -- and was holding out a small tube.

strings.text:
無表情、気配はない、ついでに説明やら何やら必要な
工程を幾つかすっ飛ばされた気がするが、とにかく差
し出された筒を受け取る。
strings.translated: No expression, no presence -- and I got the feeling she'd skipped over several necessary steps like explanations and whatnot, but regardless, I took the tube she held out to me.

strings.text: 生粋の蟲使いが、蟲を封じるために使用する道具だ。
strings.translated: It's a tool used by pure-blooded Bug Users to contain Bugs.

strings.text: つまり、この中に何かの蟲が入っているということ。
strings.translated: In other words, there was some kind of Bug sealed inside.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「まだ実験段階ですので、活動時間は三十秒程です」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"It is still in the experimental stage, so the active duration is approximately thirty seconds."

strings.text:
煉悟
「その間に始末しろって事かよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"So I've got to finish it off in that time."

strings.text:
蟲筒を構え、ここまで俺を追ってきた蟲のほうに視線
を送る。
strings.translated: I raised the Bug tube and turned my gaze toward the Bug that had been chasing me this far.

strings.text:
中身が分からないため多少――というか物凄ぇ不安は
あるが、この際贅沢は言ってられない。
strings.translated: Not knowing what was inside left me somewhat -- or rather, incredibly uneasy, but I was in no position to be picky.

strings.text:
あの女の蟲かどうかも分からねぇが、ここでぶっ潰し
てやる――――ッ！！
strings.translated: I didn't even know if it was that woman's Bug, but I was going to crush it right here -- !

strings.text:
蟲筒の中身が飛び出し、風を切るような音を立てなが
ら闇夜へと消える。
strings.translated: The contents of the canister burst out and vanished into the dark night with a sound like cutting wind.

strings.text:
羽虫タイプの蟲なのは分かったが、どんな能力を持っ
ているかまでは見当が付かない。
strings.translated: I could tell it was a winged-type Bug, but I had no idea what kind of ability it possessed.

strings.text:
ただ、オレが持っている蟲と比べて、恐ろしく速い事
だけはすぐに理解できた。
strings.translated: What I could grasp immediately, though, was that it was terrifyingly fast compared to the Bugs I had.

strings.text:
神経を集中させて敵の位置を探り、そこへと蟲を誘導
する。
strings.translated: I focused my nerves to locate the enemy's position and guided the Bug toward it.

strings.text:
明確な攻撃の方法を伝えられない以上、与える命令は
一つだった。
strings.translated: Since I had no way to tell it how exactly to attack, there was only one order I could give.

strings.text: 二匹の蟲が、空中を疾り抜ける。
strings.translated: The two Bugs tore through the air.

strings.text:
互いの肉体を傷付け合いながら、隙あらば相手を食い
殺そうとしていた。
strings.translated: They wounded each other's bodies, each looking for any opening to devour the other alive.

strings.text:
敵の蟲も同じような命令を受けているようで、執拗に
オレの蟲に牙を突き立てようとしている。
strings.translated: The enemy's Bug seemed to have received a similar order -- it relentlessly tried to sink its fangs into my Bug.

strings.text: 時間はあっと言う間に過ぎていく。
strings.translated: Time was flying by in an instant.

strings.text: 残された時間は二十秒程度。
それまでに、決着をつけなければならない。
strings.translated: I had to settle this before then.

strings.text:
煉悟
「やれっ！　ぶっ殺せっ！！」

意識を集中させ、念を送り込み、蟲にオレの殺意を
伝える。
strings.translated: I focused my consciousness, poured my will into it, and conveyed my killing intent to the Bug.

strings.text: 時間が過ぎるとともに、焦りが募る。
strings.translated: As the seconds ticked away, my impatience grew.

strings.text:
蟲同士の戦いはほぼ互角で、なかなか相手に致命傷を
与えることができない。
strings.translated: The battle between the Bugs was nearly even, and neither could land a decisive blow on the other.

strings.text: このまま制限時間を越えれば、それは事実上の敗北だ。
strings.translated: If the time limit passed like this, it would be a practical defeat.

strings.text:
オレは無意識のうちに奥歯を噛み締めていたが、それ
で結果が変わるはずもなかった。
strings.translated: I had unconsciously been grinding my back teeth, but that wasn't going to change anything.

strings.text: 二十七――二十八――二十九――――限界だッ！
刹那、耳障りな音が辺りに響き渡った。
strings.translated: In that instant, a grating sound rang out through the area.

strings.text:
上空を飛んでいたオレの蟲が、突如として内側から
弾けるように肉片を飛び散らせたのだ。
strings.translated: My Bug, which had been flying overhead, suddenly burst apart from the inside, scattering chunks of flesh.

strings.text:
ユーリアが言うところの、活動時間の限界が来たらし
い。
strings.translated: It seemed the active time limit that Yulia had mentioned had arrived.

strings.text: 残ってるのは、手持ちの蟲三匹。
strings.translated: All that remained were the three Bugs I had on hand.

strings.text:
だいぶ弱らせたとはいえ、果たしてこれで凌ぎ切れる
か――――ッ！？
strings.translated: Weakened as the enemy was, could I really hold out with just these -- !?

strings.text:
その音は、オレと蟲との闘いに、強引に割り込むよう
にして響き渡った。
strings.translated: That sound forced its way into the middle of my battle with the Bug, ringing out without warning.

strings.text:
敵の蟲が粉々に砕け散り、粘ついた体液が辺りに飛び
散る。
strings.translated: The enemy Bug shattered to pieces, and sticky bodily fluid splattered all around.

strings.text:
こればっかりは何が起こったのか理解するのに、多少
の時間を要してしまった。
strings.translated: This time, it took me a moment to work out what had just happened.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「周囲に敵と思われる存在はありません。
　……排除成功です」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"There are no presences in the vicinity that appear to be enemies.
 ...Elimination successful."

strings.text:
いったいどこに隠し持っていたのか、ユーリアの右手
に握られているのは大口径の拳銃。
strings.translated: Where she had been hiding it, I had no idea -- but what Yulia held in her right hand was a large-caliber handgun.

strings.text:
立ち昇る硝煙が、間違いなくコイツが撃った事を証明
していた。
strings.translated: The rising gunsmoke was proof beyond doubt that she had fired it.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ケッ！　ただの助手じゃ、ないって事かよ……」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Heh... so you're not just an assistant after all..."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「ついて来て下さい。先生がお待ちです」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Please follow me. The professor is waiting."

strings.text:
拳銃をスーツの内側に収めながら、ユーリアがさっさ
と自分だけ歩き始めてしまう。
strings.translated: Holstering the handgun inside her suit jacket, Yulia promptly started walking ahead on her own.

strings.text:
オレは釈然としないものを感じながらも、黙ってその
後をついて行く事にした……。
strings.translated: I felt a lingering dissatisfaction, but I kept my mouth shut and decided to follow after her...

strings.text:
西
「ふむ、さすがに生粋の蟲使いと言ったところか」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Hmm, a true Bug User through and through, I'd say."

strings.text:
優雅に紅茶なんぞを飲みながら、西の野郎が嬉しそう
につぶやいた。
strings.translated: That bastard Nishi murmured with evident pleasure, leisurely sipping his tea.

strings.text: 西の住んでいる屋敷の一室。
strings.translated: One room in the mansion where Nishi lived.

strings.text:
ユーリアについて行ったオレは、絵画やら彫刻やらが
飾られた、居心地の悪い空間で時を過ごしていた。
strings.translated: Following after Yulia, I found myself spending time in an uncomfortable space decorated with paintings and sculptures.

strings.text:
煉悟
「厄介なの呼んでくれたもんだなぁ。……あぁン？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"You sure called in something troublesome... ...Hah?"

strings.text:
西
「まさか蟲でそれほど差が出るものだとは思っていな
　くてね」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"I simply hadn't imagined there could be such a difference depending on the Bug,
 you see."

strings.text:
西
「……これでも驚いているのだよ？」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"...Even I am surprised, you know?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「こっちゃ命が無くなりかけたんだよっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I nearly lost my damn life out there!!"

strings.text: 乱暴にテーブルを叩く。
strings.translated: I slammed my hand hard against the table.

strings.text:
上に載っていたティーカップとソーサーがガチャンと
揺れた。
strings.translated: The teacup and saucer resting on top rattled with a loud clatter.

strings.text:
だが、西と言う男がこんなもんでビビるような奴じゃ
ない事くらい、オレも分かってる。
strings.translated: But even I knew that a man like Nishi wasn't the type to be rattled by something like this.

strings.text: 完全な八つ当たりだった。

西
「そういえば、例のクスリを与えた蟲はどうだったか
　な？」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Come to think of it, how did the Bug fare -- the one I gave that medicine to?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「クスリ？
　……ああ、餌を食わせる前にってアレか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Medicine?
 ...Oh, that stuff you said to give it before feeding?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「アレは、その前の戦闘で全部撃ち落されちまってる
　よ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"That one got shot down in the fight before this one,
 every last one of them."

strings.text: さすがに意外だったようで、西の声に真剣みが混じる。
strings.translated: That seemed to genuinely catch him off guard -- a note of seriousness crept into Nishi's voice.

strings.text:
まあ、生きてたとしても、今日の蟲相手には何もでき
なかっただろうが……。
strings.translated: Well, even if it had survived, it probably wouldn't have done anything against today's Bug...

strings.text:
煉悟
「クスリ？
　……ああ、餌を食わせる前にってアレか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Medicine?
 ...Oh, that stuff you said to give it before feeding?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「そういや、飲まし忘れてたなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Now that you mention it, I forgot to give it any."

strings.text: 西が、困ったような笑い声を漏らす。
strings.translated: Nishi let out a troubled little laugh.

strings.text:
どうやら、あのクスリを飲ませていると今回の事態も
何か変わる可能性があったらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed that if I had administered that medicine, there was a chance things might have turned out differently today.

strings.text:
西
「まあ、状況は理解した。
　今夜は泊まっていくといい」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Well, I understand the situation.
 You should stay the night."

strings.text:
煉悟
「言われなくてもそのつもり――――」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I was already planning on it----"

strings.text:
そう言いかけて、今、倉庫には苗床がいる事を思い出
した。
strings.translated: I started to say that, then remembered there was a Seedbed back at the warehouse right now.

strings.text:
部屋の鍵は掛けてるから逃げられる心配はないが、
あれだと飯も食えないはずだ。
strings.translated: The room was locked so there was no worry of her escaping, but she wouldn't be able to eat anything like that.

strings.text:
煉悟
「……いや、まあ別に死にゃしねーだろ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"...Nah, it's not like she'll die or anything."

strings.text:
煉悟
「新しい苗床の話だ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I'm talking about my new Seedbed."

strings.text:
苗床、という言葉で、西はおおよその事を察したらし
い。
strings.translated: The word Seedbed seemed to be enough for Nishi to grasp the general picture.

strings.text: こういう部分は、話がスムーズに通って楽な奴だ。
strings.translated: In moments like these, he's the kind of man who's easy to deal with -- things get through to him smoothly.

Nishi
"What sort of woman this time?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「選んで持って来たわけじゃねぇよ。
　ただの小娘だ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"It's not like I picked her out.
 Just some young girl."

strings.text: 西の眼が、怪しげに光ったように見えた。
strings.translated: Nishi's eyes seemed to gleam with a suspicious light.

strings.text: コイツの『悪趣味な部分』が、興味を持ったらしい。
strings.translated: That "vulgar side" of his appeared to have taken an interest.

Nishi
"And what use do you have for her after she delivers?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「今のところねぇな」

西
「では、事が済んだ後それを少し貸してもらえないか
　ね？」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Then, once the matter is concluded, might you lend her to me for a while?"

strings.text:
西
「最近は良い素材がなく困っていたのだ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"I've been at a loss lately -- good material has been hard to come by."

strings.text: あえて、『何』の素材かは訊ねない。
strings.translated: I deliberately chose not to ask what kind of material.

strings.text:
コイツの考え方そのものは嫌いじゃないが、趣味の
方向性は決定的にオレと合わないからだ。
strings.translated: It's not that I dislike his way of thinking itself, but the direction of his tastes is fundamentally incompatible with mine.

strings.text:
ここに連れて来られた女の大半が、普通に犯される、
もしくは殺されたほうがマシという目にあう。
strings.translated: The majority of women brought here end up suffering fates where being simply violated or killed outright would have been the better option.

strings.text:
ただ、だからといって、あの苗床を差し出さない理由
もない。
strings.translated: That said, that alone was no reason not to hand over that Seedbed.

strings.text:
今日のような緊急時にかくまってもらえる事を考えれ
ば、あの小娘ひとつで済むなら安いものだ。
strings.translated: Considering that he shelters me in emergencies like today, if one little girl is all it costs, that's a cheap price.

strings.text:
煉悟
「分かった。蟲を産んだら連れて来てやらァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Understood. Once she's birthed the Bug, I'll bring her over."

strings.text:
西
「ありがとう。……どんな素材か期待しているよ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Thank you. ...I look forward to seeing what kind of material she turns out to be."

strings.text:
柔らかい笑みを浮かべる西に、オレは短く嘆息し
た……。
strings.translated: I let out a short sigh at Nishi, who wore a soft smile on his face...

strings.text:
ソファーに横になって、胸に詰まったものを外に出す
ように吐息を漏らす。
strings.translated:
I lay down on the sofa and let out a breath,
as if trying to push out whatever was lodged in my chest.

strings.text:
外に出るかどうか迷ったが、結局面倒臭くなりここで
過ごすことにした。
strings.translated:
I had considered going out, but ultimately decided it was too much trouble
and chose to stay here instead.

strings.text: まだ、あの女にやられた傷が回復したわけじゃない。
strings.translated: The wounds that woman gave me hadn't healed yet.

strings.text:
今はできるだけ体を休めて、然るべき時に備えるのが
賢明だった。
strings.translated:
For now, the wise move was to rest my body as much as possible
and be ready when the time came.

strings.text:
物音――というよりも声のようなものが聞こえ、オレ
はソファーから体を起こした。
strings.translated:
I heard a sound -- or rather, something more like a voice --
and lifted myself off the sofa.

strings.text:
最初は気のせいかと思ったが、どうやら隣の部屋から
聞こえてくるらしい。
strings.translated:
At first I thought I was imagining it, but it seemed to be
coming from the room next door.

strings.text:
夢美
「い、たぁ……ああああああっ！」
部屋に入ると、足元に小娘の体が転がっていた。
strings.translated: When I entered the room, the girl's body was sprawled on the floor.

strings.text: 腹を押さえながら、ビクビクと体を痙攣させている。
strings.translated: She was clutching her stomach, her body twitching and convulsing.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ほう、育ち始めたか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Oh? Starting to grow, is it."

strings.text:
腹の中で蟲の卵が膨らみ始めたらしく、少し下腹部の
形が変わっていた。
strings.translated:
It seemed the Bug eggs inside her belly had begun to swell,
and the shape of her lower abdomen had changed slightly.

strings.text:
経過は順調らしいが、その分小娘の体に負担が掛かる
のは当然だ。
strings.translated:
The progress appeared to be on schedule, but naturally that meant
the strain on the girl's body was increasing accordingly.

strings.text: ロクに餌も与えられず、卵の成長による腹痛。
strings.translated: Barely any food given to her, and the stomach pain from the eggs growing.

strings.text:
さらには、狭い密室に閉じ込められているという状況
に発狂する可能性も考えたが――――
strings.translated:
On top of that, I had considered the possibility that being locked in
a cramped, sealed room might drive her mad -- but...

strings.text:
煉悟
「まっ、それはそれか……」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well... that's just how it goes."

strings.text:
小娘の肩を蹴っ飛ばして、うずくまっていた体を仰向
けにする。
strings.translated:
I kicked the girl's shoulder and flipped her
from her curled-up position onto her back.

strings.text:
暴れないように胸を踏み付けてやると、小娘の口から
カエルが潰れた時のような声が出た。
strings.translated:
I planted my foot on her chest to keep her from thrashing around,
and a sound like a crushed frog came out of the girl's mouth.

strings.text:
腹の膨らみ具合からいって、産まれるまでにはまだま
だ時間が掛かりそうだ。
strings.translated:
Judging by how much her belly had swollen, it still seemed like
it would take quite a while before the birth.

strings.text:
むしろこれからが、蟲の卵を育てる上でもっとも大切
な時期に入るとも言える。
strings.translated:
If anything, one could say she was entering the most critical period
for nurturing the Bug eggs.

strings.text:
煉悟
「おい、テメーの餌はテキトーに食ってろよ。
　蟲を産む前に死なれちゃかなわんからな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Hey, eat whatever scraps I toss you.
 I can't have you dying before you birth the Bug."

strings.text:
オレは小娘から足を離すと、ふんと鼻を鳴らして部屋
を出た。
strings.translated:
I lifted my foot off the girl, gave a short snort,
and walked out of the room.

strings.text:
背後では、小娘がいつまでも苦しそうに呻き続けてい
た……。
strings.translated:
Behind me, the girl kept groaning in agony
for a long, long time...

strings.text:
夢美
「ぎゃああぁああぁああぁぁぁぁーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーーーーっ！！！！」

煉悟
「カーッ！　うっせぇなぁ！！」
夜になって、小娘の声はさらに大きくなった。
strings.translated: As night fell, the girl's screaming grew even louder.

strings.text:
部屋を隔てる扉を通して、オレの安眠を邪魔するくら
いの絶叫だ。
strings.translated:
It was loud enough to pierce through the door separating our rooms
and ruin my sleep.

strings.text:
蟲どもも同じようで、オレに抗議するように周りに
集まってくる。
strings.translated:
The Bugs seemed to feel the same way, gathering around me
as if to lodge a complaint.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ちっ、黙らせてくるか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Tch. Guess I'll go shut her up."

strings.text:
扉を蹴飛ばしながら部屋に入って、小娘がどこにいる
か分からないままに叫ぶ。
strings.translated:
I kicked the door open and stormed into the room, shouting
without even knowing where the girl was.

strings.text:
てっきり床に転がっているのだろうと思っていたが、
実際には壁に爪を立てるようにして苦しんでいた。
strings.translated:
I had assumed she'd be sprawled on the floor, but
she was actually clawing at the wall as she writhed in agony.

strings.text:
夢美
「あ、あぁ、あ、かっ、はあっ、あ、お、ぉおっ、お、
　おぉっ、おう、ぅうおぉ―――――」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ah, aah, a, k-, haah, a, o, ooh, o,
 ooh, ou, uuooh..."

strings.text:
夢美

strings.translated: But the girl only kept groaning -- she showed no sign of hearing my voice at all.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ちっ、面倒かけさせやがって」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Tch. Giving me nothing but trouble."

strings.text:
右手に持っていた齧りかけのパンを、部屋の中に投げ
込む。
strings.translated: I tossed the half-eaten bread I'd been holding in my right hand into the room.

strings.text:
パンは狙いを僅かにそれて床に落ちたが、何かが投げ
込まれたことは小娘も気付いたようだった。
strings.translated: The bread missed its mark slightly and hit the floor, but the girl seemed to notice that something had been thrown in.

strings.text:
煉悟
「死なねぇように食ってろ。
　糞は、体力あるなら便所行ってやれ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Eat enough to keep yourself alive.
 If you've got the strength to take a dump, use the toilet."

strings.text:
オレはそういうと、これ以上臭いが漏れ出さないよう
にさっさとドアを閉めた。
strings.translated: With that, I quickly shut the door so the stench wouldn't keep leaking out.

strings.text: 小娘は、最後まで呻き続けていた……。
strings.translated: The girl kept groaning until the very end....

strings.text:
煉悟
「さぁて、どうしたもんか」
ソファーに寝転がって、昨日のことを考える。
strings.translated: I stretched out on the sofa and thought over yesterday's events.

strings.text:
西
「なるほど。よく分かった」

今の状況を掻い摘んで説明すると、電話の向こうで
西は納得したようにつぶやいた。
strings.translated: When I gave a brief rundown of the current situation, Nishi murmured in acknowledgment from the other end of the phone.

strings.text:
煉悟
「それだけかよ？
　テメーのせいで、オレはこんなに苦労してんだぜ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"That's all you've got to say?
 I'm going through hell because of you, you know."

strings.text:
西
「うむ、思ったより厄介な事になり始めているようだ
　ね」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Indeed, it seems things are starting to get more troublesome than I expected."

strings.text:
完全に他人事な口調に、携帯電話を握り潰したい衝動
に駆られる。
strings.translated: His completely detached tone made me want to crush the cell phone in my grip.

strings.text:
いや、コイツからすれば実際に他人事以外のなにもの
でもないのだろう。
strings.translated: Well -- to him, it probably was nothing more than someone else's problem.

strings.text:
たとえ原因を作ったのが自分だったとしても、それを
悔やむような性格じゃない。
strings.translated: Even if he was the one who caused it, he wasn't the type to lose any sleep over it.

strings.text:
西
「ともかく、状況は理解した。
　考えられる手をこちらでも打っておこう」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"In any case, I understand the situation.
 I'll look into what moves can be made on my end."

strings.text:
煉悟
「考えられる手ねぇ……」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"What moves can be made, huh..."

strings.text:
コイツのこの手の言葉に、過剰な期待をするのは禁物
だ。
strings.translated: It would be a mistake to get my hopes up too high when he talked like that.

strings.text:
むしろこの状況を好機として、さらに余計なことを
仕出かさないとも限らない。
strings.translated: If anything, there was no telling whether he might seize this situation as an opportunity and pull something even more unnecessary.

strings.text:
オレ達は確かにこうして話してはいるが、決して仲間
だとか友達だとか言う関係ではないからだ。
strings.translated: We were talking like this, sure -- but we were by no means allies or friends.

strings.text: どこか含むような響きを持たせて、西が電話を切る。
strings.translated: With a tone that carried some hidden implication, Nishi hung up.

strings.text:
オレは鼻を鳴らして携帯電話をテーブルに落とすと、
ごろんとソファーに仰向けになった。
strings.translated: I snorted and dropped the cell phone onto the table, then flopped onto my back on the sofa.

strings.text: 問題なのは敵の蟲の戦闘能力だ。
strings.translated: The problem was the combat capability of the enemy's Bugs.

strings.text: 正直、オレの持つ蟲とは比較にならない。
strings.translated: Honestly, there was no comparison to the Bugs I had.

strings.text:
焦っても仕方ないのは分かっているが、それでも気分
が落ち着かなかった。
strings.translated: I knew there was no point in panicking, but I still couldn't settle my nerves.

strings.text:
たまに、街に出てもう何人か『苗床』役をさらって来
ようかとも考えたが、半端に蟲の数を増やしたところ
で、結果は変わらないだろう。
strings.translated: Every now and then I thought about heading into town and snatching a few more people to use as Seedbeds -- but adding to my Bug count halfheartedly wasn't going to change the outcome.

strings.text: 重要なのは、あの女の居場所を探し出すこと。
strings.translated: What mattered was tracking down where that woman was hiding.

strings.text: 真正面からの戦いは絶対に避けること。
strings.translated: Avoiding a head-on fight at all costs.

strings.text:
そして、できれば奇襲して、殺すのではなくとっ捕ま
えて次の『苗床』にしてしまうこと。
strings.translated: And if possible, ambushing her -- not killing her, but capturing her and making her the next Seedbed.
Above all, this was the life I led.

strings.text: 蟲使いの女は、かなりの『貴重品』と言える。
strings.translated: A female Bug User could be considered quite the "prize."

strings.text:
煉悟
「やっぱり仔を産むには、母体も丈夫なほうがいいか
　らな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"After all, the sturdier the mother, the better for bearing offspring."

strings.text: やはり、逃げたり隠れたりするのは性に合わない。
strings.translated: Running and hiding just wasn't in my nature.

strings.text:
多少の危険は覚悟の上で、オレは女の情報を探し集め
る事にした……。
strings.translated: Accepting a certain degree of danger, I decided to start hunting down information on the woman....

strings.text:
西
「さて、今日の用件は何かな？」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"So then, what brings you here today?"

strings.text:
突然屋敷に押しかけたオレを、西はいつもの余裕ぶっ
た笑みで迎えた。
strings.translated: Nishi greeted me with his usual composed smile as I showed up at the mansion unannounced.

strings.text:
様子から察するに、用件のほうも想像がついてるらし
い。
strings.translated: Judging by his demeanor, he seemed to have already guessed what I was here for.

strings.text:
煉悟
「昨日の蟲は使えねぇのか？」

昨日の蟲というのは、もちろん活動時間三十秒のアレ
だ。
strings.translated: Yesterday's Bug -- that was, of course, the one with the thirty-second active window.

strings.text:
一匹だけでは大した役には立たないだろうが、それな
りに数を揃えれば十分な戦力になる。
strings.translated: A single one wouldn't be much use, but if I could gather enough of them, they'd make for a decent fighting force.

strings.text:
西
「あれはまだ実験段階の代物だからな。
　リスクが大きい」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"That one is still in the experimental stage.
 The risks are too great."

strings.text:
煉悟
「ハッ！　オレが、リスクのない毎日を送ってるよう
　にでも見えるってのかよ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Ha! Do I look like I'm living some kind of risk-free life to you?"

strings.text:
西
「何をリスクとするかによるな」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"It depends on what you consider a risk."

strings.text: 椅子に深く腰掛けながら、西が僅かに肩を揺する。
strings.translated: Nishi sinks deep into his chair, his shoulders shaking with a faint laugh.

strings.text:
眼鏡のズレを直すと、コイツにしては意外なことを
言ってきた。
strings.translated: He adjusts his glasses, then says something surprisingly out of character for him.

strings.text:
西
「蟲を貸し出す代わりに、ひとつ見返りを要求しても
　いいかな？」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"In exchange for lending you the Bug, would you mind if I asked for something in return?"

strings.text:
西
「例の素材――蟲の苗床の少女だが、丸一晩貸しては
　もらえないかね？」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"That specimen we discussed -- the girl who serves as a Bug's Seedbed. Would you lend her to me for a full night?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「あん？　昨日、貸すって言ったろ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Huh? I already said I'd lend her to you yesterday."

strings.text:
西
「そうなのだが、ここはあえて時間を指定しておこう
　と思ってね」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"So you did. But I thought I'd go ahead and specify the timeframe, just to be clear."

Rengo
"And that timeframe is one night?"

strings.text:
要するに、その一晩はあの小娘に何をしても文句を
言うなという事だ。
strings.translated: In other words, he was telling me not to complain about whatever he did to that little girl during that one night.

strings.text:
煉悟
「わざわざあの小娘を連れて来なくても、お前の助手
　で愉しめばいいと思うんだがな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"You don't need to go to the trouble of bringing that little brat over -- I'd think you could have your fun with your own assistant."

strings.text:
西
「いや、彼女は私にとって特別な存在でね。
　……なかなかそういう気分になれないのだよ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"No, she is someone special to me.
...I find it rather difficult to get in that sort of mood with her."

strings.text: コイツに、そんな人並みの感情があるとは驚きだ。
strings.translated: I was surprised to find that this man had such ordinary human feelings.

strings.text:
まあ、これも実際は額面通りに受け取っていい話なの
かどうかは分からないのだが……。
strings.translated: Though, in truth, I had no way of knowing whether even that was something to be taken at face value...

strings.text:
煉悟
「まあいい。一晩、好きに使え」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Fine. Use her for the night, however you like."

strings.text:
そう言ったときの西の顔は、清々しいくらいの笑みが
浮かんでいた……。
strings.translated: When he said that, Nishi's face wore a smile so serene it was almost refreshing...

strings.text:
煉悟
「今日も成果はなさそうだな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Doesn't look like today will amount to anything either."

strings.text:
森にやって来て蟲を放ったあと、オレは溜息混じりに
そんなことを呟いていた。
strings.translated: After releasing my Bugs in the forest, I muttered those words with a sigh.

strings.text: まだ陽は高いが、何となく今日もハズレの予感がする。
strings.translated: The sun was still high, but somehow I had a feeling today would be another dead end.

strings.text:
周囲にはオレの蟲以外の気配もなく、いたってのどか
な空気が流れていた。
strings.translated: There was no sign of anything around me besides my own Bugs, and a thoroughly peaceful air drifted through the area.

strings.text: 果たして、あの女はどこにいるのか。
strings.translated: Just where was that woman hiding?

strings.text:
まさか、どこかの部屋に閉じこもってるってことはな
いだろうが、根本的に行動時間が違う可能性はある。
strings.translated: It was unlikely she was holed up in some room somewhere, but there was a real possibility our active hours were simply different.

strings.text:
煉悟
「どこに寝泊りしてるかが分かれば楽勝なんだがな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"If I knew where she was sleeping, this would be a hell of a lot easier."

strings.text: 呟いたあと、小さく肩を揺らす。
strings.translated: After muttering that, I let out a small laugh.

strings.text: そう思っているのは、きっとあの女も同じだ。
strings.translated: The woman was probably thinking the exact same thing.

strings.text:
隠れ家の倉庫の場所がバレれば、今夜のうちにも襲っ
て来るだろう。
strings.translated: If the location of the hideout warehouse got out, she would come for us before the night was over.

strings.text: そうなる前に、女の居所を掴まなければならなかった。
strings.translated: I had to find out where she was before that happened.

strings.text:
不意に携帯電話が鳴って、オレは相手を確認もせず
通話ボタンを押した。
strings.translated: My cell phone suddenly rang, and I hit the answer button without even checking who it was.

strings.text: どうせこの電話に掛かってくるのは――――
strings.translated: After all, the only person who ever called this number was ----

strings.text:
煉悟
「良さそうに思うか？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Does it look like they're going well?"

strings.text:
西
「いや、予想していた通りのようで何よりだ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"No, it seems just as I expected. How reassuring."

strings.text: 相変わらずの西の態度に、舌打ちして口先を尖らせる。
strings.translated: I clicked my tongue at Nishi's same-as-ever attitude and pursed my lips.

strings.text:
口調から、オレの苦労を楽しんでいる様子が伝わって
きて虫唾が走った。
strings.translated: His tone made it clear he was enjoying my struggles, and it made my skin crawl.

strings.text:
コイツがもっと無能だったら、とっくに嬲り殺しにし
てるところだ。
strings.translated: If this guy were any less useful, I'd have beaten him to death long ago.

strings.text:
西
「なかなか難しいようだね。
　蟲使い同士の探り合いというのは……」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"It seems to be quite the challenge.
Two Bug Users trying to track each other down..."

strings.text:
煉悟
「まあ、オレもこういうのはあんまり経験したことが
　ねぇからな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, I don't have much experience with this kind of thing either."

strings.text:
西
「蟲使いが敵になるのは初めてだったね」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"This is your first time having a Bug User as an enemy, isn't it."

strings.text:
煉悟
「ああ、誰かさんのおかげでな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Yeah. Thanks to a certain someone."

strings.text: 皮肉を込めて言うと、電話の向こうで西が軽く笑った。
strings.translated: I said it with all the sarcasm I could muster, and Nishi gave a light laugh on the other end of the line.

strings.text:
……もっとも、オレもそんなものを期待してるわけ
じゃないんだが。
strings.translated: Not that I was expecting any.

strings.text:
西
「なに、幾つか訊きたいことが出来たのでね」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Oh, a few questions came to mind, that's all."

strings.text:
西
「蟲使いが蟲使いを探すとき、どうするのかと思って
　ね」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"I was wondering -- when a Bug User goes looking for another Bug User, how do they go about it?"

strings.text:
こっちは命が掛かってるってのに、どこまでも自分の
研究にしか興味がないらしい。
strings.translated: My life is on the line here, and all he cares about, as ever, is his research.

strings.text:
こんな奴と知り合ってしまったのは、ある意味幸運だ
し、ある意味不運だった。
strings.translated: Getting mixed up with a guy like this was, in a way, lucky -- and in another way, anything but.

strings.text:
煉悟
「何匹か蟲を飛ばして、他の蟲がいないか探すっての
　が基本だ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"The basics are sending out a few Bugs to scout around and see if there are any others nearby."

strings.text:
煉悟
「それ以外なら、オレ自身が他の蟲の気配がないか
　感じ取るくらいか……」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Beyond that, I can try to sense the presence of other Bugs myself... that's about it."

strings.text:
西
「それは行き当たりばったり、と言うのではないか
　ね？」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"That sounds rather hit-or-miss, wouldn't you say?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、否定はしねーよ」

煉悟
「本当はもっと探索力のある蟲なら、方法も変わって
　来るんだがな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"If I had Bugs with better tracking ability, the approach would change -- but I don't."

strings.text: いったい何を納得したのか、西の野郎が暫く沈黙する。
strings.translated: Whatever he'd just convinced himself of, that bastard Nishi went quiet for a moment.

strings.text:
こういう時は、だいたいロクでもない事を考えてるは
ずなんだが……。
strings.translated: Times like this, he's usually cooking up something no good...

strings.text:
西
「了解した。ともかく、彼女と再戦するにしても、
　暫くは時間が掛かるということのようだね」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Understood. In any case, it sounds like a rematch with her will take some time."

strings.text:
煉悟
「……まるで、さっさと戦ってほしいみたいな言い方
　だな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"...The way you say that, it's almost like you want me to hurry up and fight her."

strings.text: そう言って、西が含んだ笑いを漏らす。
strings.translated: With that, Nishi let out a knowing laugh.

strings.text:
要するにさっさと戦わせて、蟲のデータだか何だかが
欲しいらしい。
strings.translated: In short, he wanted me to fight sooner rather than later -- so he could get his Bug data, or whatever it was.

strings.text:
西
「ありがとう。……また、連絡する」
用件が済むと、西はさっさと電話を切った。
strings.translated: Once he had what he needed, Nishi hung up without ceremony.

strings.text:
正直、何のための電話だったのかよく分からないが、
必要な情報は得られたらしい。
strings.translated: Honestly, I wasn't sure what the point of the call had been -- but apparently he'd gotten the information he wanted.

strings.text:
オレは溜息をつきながら携帯電話をしまうと、あの女
の探索を再開した……。
strings.translated: I let out a sigh, pocketed my phone, and resumed my search for that woman...

strings.text: 女の蟲使いのことを調べるかどうか……。
strings.translated: Whether to look into the female Bug User or not...

strings.text:
考えているうちに時間が過ぎ、結局今日はこの部屋で
過ごす事にした。
strings.translated: I spent so long turning it over in my mind that the day slipped away, and in the end I decided to stay in the room.

strings.text:
あまりコソコソ嗅ぎ回るようなまねは好きではないし、
調べたところで何かが分かるとも思えない。
strings.translated: I never much liked sneaking around and poking my nose into things -- and I doubted digging would turn up anything useful anyway.

strings.text: 結局は、なるようになるしかないのだ。
strings.translated: In the end, I'd just have to let things play out.

strings.text:
煉悟
「さぁて、どうしたもんか」
今のところ、これといってやる事はない。
strings.translated: For now, there was nothing in particular to do.

strings.text:
新しい仕事があるわけでもないし、かと言って寝るだ
けなのも勿体無い。
strings.translated: No new jobs coming in, and just sleeping felt like a waste.

strings.text:
強いて言えば蟲の調整だが、それも何時間も費やすよ
うな作業ではなかった。
strings.translated: I could tune my Bugs, but that wasn't the kind of task that ate up hours.

strings.text:
いい女が近くにいれば、テキトーに犯すなりできるの
だが……。
strings.translated: If there was a decent woman nearby, I could always just take her... but.

strings.text:
煉悟
「……せっかくだし、使ってみるか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"...Might as well make use of what I've got."

strings.text:
オレはそう呟くと、ソファーから立ち上がり隣の部屋
へと足を向けた。
strings.translated: I muttered that to myself, rose from the sofa, and headed for the room next door.

strings.text: 扉を蹴飛ばすようにして、部屋の中に入る。
strings.translated: I kicked the door open and stepped inside.

strings.text:
小娘はベッドでうずくまるようにしていたが、オレを
見るなり大きく体を震わせた。
strings.translated: The girl was curled up on the bed, but the moment she saw me, her whole body shuddered.

strings.text:
腹もだいぶ膨れていて、そろそろ出産が近いことを
予感させる。
strings.translated: Her belly had swollen considerably -- a sign that the birth was drawing near.

strings.text: 小娘の頭を掴んで、ベッドから引き摺り下ろす。
strings.translated: I grabbed the girl by the head and dragged her off the bed.

strings.text:
代わりに自分が腰を下ろして、ズボンから剛直を取り
出した。
strings.translated: I took her place, settling onto the edge, and pulled my rigid cock free from my pants.

strings.text:
突然のことに小娘は目を白黒させていたが、説明も何
もなく、オレはソレを口の中に突っ込んだ……。
strings.translated: The girl's eyes went wide at the sudden turn of events -- but without a word of explanation, I shoved it into her mouth.

strings.text:
夢美
「むぐっ……んんんんんんんっ！！！」

その異物を突っ込まれた瞬間、少女の口からくぐもっ
た声が漏れた。
strings.translated: The instant that foreign object was forced inside, a muffled cry escaped the girl's lips.

strings.text: まるで石のように硬い、雄の象徴たる肉棒――――。
strings.translated: Hard as stone -- the rod of flesh, symbol of the male.

strings.text:
容赦なく一気に突き入れられたそれは、先端部で少女
の喉を完全に塞いでしまっていた。
strings.translated: Thrust in without mercy in a single stroke, its tip had completely sealed off the girl's throat.

strings.text: 声にならない悲鳴が、微かな吐息となって表される。
strings.translated: Screams that couldn't become screams, rendered as faint, ragged breath.

strings.text:
煉悟の太ももに手を当てて、必死に押しのけようとし
たが、そのか細い腕はあまりに無力だった。
strings.translated: She pressed her hands against Rengo's thighs and desperately tried to push him away -- but those slender arms were utterly powerless.

strings.text:
煉悟
「おい、もう少し口開けろ。歯が邪魔だ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Hey, open your mouth a little wider. Your teeth are in the way."

strings.text: 唇をこじ開けるようにして、さらに喉を突いた。
strings.translated: He pried her lips further apart and drove deeper into her throat.

strings.text:
そのあまりの苦しさに、少女は反射的に肉棒を吐き出
そうとした。
strings.translated: The suffocation was so overwhelming that the girl reflexively tried to spit the cock out.
