strings.text: まだ中身が半分ほど残っているペットボトル――――
strings.translated: A plastic bottle still about half full----

strings.text: 暇つぶし用の携帯ゲーム機――――
strings.translated: A handheld game console for killing time----

strings.text:
――後半に入ってからは、一族の村から盗み出して来
た本なんかが出てきた。
strings.translated: -- Toward the bottom, some books I'd stolen from the clan's village started turning up.

strings.text:
指南書のような物も含まれているが、まともに読んだ
ことは一度もない。
strings.translated: There were a few that looked like instructional manuals, but I'd never once read them properly.

strings.text:
この本の内容を知っていれば、少しはマシな戦い方が
できたのだろうか……。
strings.translated: If I'd known what was in these books, would I have been able to fight a little better...

strings.text:
オレは、本を撒き散らすようにして捨てると、さらに
何か無いかとナップザックの中を掻き回した。
strings.translated: I scattered the books aside and tossed them away, then dug around inside the knapsack looking for anything else.

strings.text: 指先に触れた乾いた感触に、オレは一瞬眉根を寄せた。
strings.translated: The dry texture that met my fingertips made me furrow my brow for a moment.

strings.text:
握ってみると、ニワトリの卵程度の大きさの球体が
確認できる。
strings.translated: When I closed my hand around it, I could make out a sphere roughly the size of a chicken's egg.

strings.text:
最初は何かのボールかと思ったが、それにしては硬く、
しかも表面にはゴツゴツとした段差があった。
strings.translated:
At first I thought it might be some kind of ball, but it was too hard for that,
and the surface was covered in rough, uneven ridges.

strings.text:
野球のボールかと思ったが、それにしては小さいし、
何より段差に規則性がない。
strings.translated:
I thought it might be a baseball, but it was too small for that,
and above all, the ridges had no regularity to them.

strings.text:
暫く考えてみたが答えが分からず、オレは仕方なく
それを引っ張り出してみた。
strings.translated:
I thought about it for a while but couldn't come up with an answer, so I had no choice but
to pull it out and take a look.

strings.text: すぐには言葉が出てこなかった。
strings.translated: Words didn't come to me right away.

strings.text: これは何と表現すればいいのか――――
strings.translated: How was I supposed to describe this----

strings.text:
――あえて言うなら、カラカラに干乾びさせた梅干の
種をニワトリの卵くらいの大きさにした球体。
strings.translated:
-- If I had to put it into words, it was a sphere the size of a chicken's egg
that looked like a completely dried-out umeboshi pit.

strings.text:
暫くじっと見つめたあと、オレは思わずその言葉を
こぼしていた。
strings.translated: After staring at it for a while, the word slipped out of me before I knew it.

strings.text: それは、紛れもなく卵だった。
strings.translated: There was no mistaking it -- it was an egg.

strings.text:
村に伝わっていた特別だか伝説だかの蟲がいて、それ
の卵――という話だった気がする――――。
strings.translated:
There was supposed to be some special or legendary Bug passed down in the village, and this
was its egg -- or something like that, if I remembered right----.

strings.text:
盗んでは来たものの、あまりに馬鹿馬鹿しくて実際に
は使わなかったのだろう。
strings.translated: I'd stolen it, but it was probably so absurd that I'd never actually used it.

strings.text:
本気にした事はないし、今も本気にしているわけじゃ
ない。
strings.translated: I'd never taken it seriously, and I wasn't taking it seriously now either.

strings.text:
普段なら笑い飛ばしたあと、卵を壁に投げ付けるか、
火で炙って試し食いでもしているだろう。
strings.translated:
Under normal circumstances, I'd have laughed it off and either hurled the egg at a wall
or held it over a flame to see how it tasted.

strings.text: だが、今はちょいとばかり状況が違う。
strings.translated: But right now, the situation was a little different.

strings.text: 戦力になる蟲なら、一匹でも多くほしいところなのだ。
strings.translated: If it could be a fighting Bug, I wanted every last one I could get.

strings.text: つい、と小娘のいる部屋のドアを見る。
strings.translated: His gaze drifted to the door of the room where the girl was.

strings.text:
今はだいぶマシになったのか、うずくまってはいるも
のの声を出すことはなくなっていた。
strings.translated: She seemed to be doing considerably better now -- she was still curled up, but she'd stopped making noise.

strings.text:
腹は妊婦のように膨れ、卵の成長が順調な事を示して
いる。
strings.translated: Her belly was swollen like a pregnant woman's, showing that the eggs inside were growing steadily.

strings.text:
だが、あれが無事孵ったとして、それであの女と渡り
合う事ができるかどうか。
strings.translated: But even if those hatched safely, the question remained whether that would be enough to go up against that woman.

strings.text: 正直、今のままでは、確実に勝てるとは言えない。
strings.translated: Honestly, the way things stood now, he couldn't say he'd win for certain.

Rengo
"Might as well give it a try..."

strings.text:
煉悟
「さぁて……どうなる事やら……」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well then... who knows how this'll go..."

strings.text:
少女の体を触手で拘束し、尻を高く上げさせた状態に
して、煉悟はニヤリと笑って見せた。
strings.translated: Rengo had restrained the girl's body with tentacles and forced her into a position with her rear raised high, and he grinned.

strings.text:
右手には、偶然見つけた特別なものらしい蟲の卵が
握られている。
strings.translated: In his right hand, he held the egg of what was supposedly a special Bug he'd found by chance.

strings.text:
夢美
「や、あぁ……な、何するの……？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"H-hey... wh, what are you doing...?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、何だと思う？」

わざと恐怖感を煽るようにして、煉悟が卵を少女の尻
に近づけていく。
strings.translated: Deliberately stoking her fear, Rengo brought the egg closer to the girl's rear.

strings.text:
特別な蟲だろうが何だろうが、卵である以上、挿入す
る場所は限られている。
strings.translated: Special Bug or not, as long as it was an egg, there were only so many places to insert it.

strings.text:
その事を感じ取ったのだろう、急に少女の体がガタガ
タと震え始めた。
strings.translated: The girl must have sensed what was coming -- her body suddenly began to tremble violently.

strings.text:
夢美
「む、無理……そんなの……入らない…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Th, that's impossible... something like that... won't fit..............."

strings.text:
煉悟
「そんなこたぁねぇよ。
　こういうのは、意外と何とかなるもんだ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"That ain't true.
 These things have a way of working out, surprisingly enough."

strings.text:
夢美
「や、だっ！　やだっ！！　やだあぁぁっ！！！」

夢美
「あ、ぐうぅううぅぅーーーーーーーーーっ！！！」
蟲の卵が、少女の肛門に押し込められる。
strings.translated: The Bug's egg was forced into the girl's anus.

strings.text:
途端に、強烈な圧迫感が下腹部を襲い、少女の口から
苦悶の声が吐き出された。
strings.translated: Instantly, an intense pressure assaulted her lower abdomen, and a groan of agony was wrenched from the girl's lips.

strings.text:
夢美
「い、痛いっ！　ああぁっ、痛いぃぃっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It, it hurts! Ahhh, it hurts!!"

strings.text:
煉悟
「オラ、じっとしてろ」

夢美
「いぃだぁあああぁああぁぁぁぁーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーーーっ！！！！」
卵の下部が、肛門の中に沈んでいく。
strings.translated: The lower half of the egg sank into the anus.

strings.text:
少女は床を這って逃げようとしたが、周りに集まって
いた蟲達の触手に拘束され、それもできない。
strings.translated: The girl tried to crawl across the floor and escape, but the tentacles of the Bugs gathered around her held her in place, and she couldn't.

strings.text:
煉悟はムリヤリにでも卵を挿入しようとしていて、
少女は頭の奥がずんっと重くなるのを感じた。
strings.translated: Rengo was forcing the egg inside no matter what, and the girl felt a heavy, sinking weight settle deep in the back of her skull.

strings.text:
手のひらに奇妙な違和感を覚えて、煉悟が卵から手を
離した。
strings.translated: A strange sensation in his palm made Rengo release the egg.

strings.text:
目を凝らしてみてみると、卵が小刻みに震えながら
徐々に直腸へと沈んでいく。
strings.translated: Peering closely, he could see the egg trembling in small, rapid shivers as it slowly sank deeper into the rectum.

strings.text:
それは、まるで生き物のような動きで、器用に表面を
うねらせながら移動していた。
strings.translated: It moved like a living thing, writhing and undulating its surface with uncanny dexterity as it traveled inward.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ふん、卵からして普通じゃねぇってか？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Heh, so even the egg ain't normal, huh?"

strings.text: この時点で、既に普通の卵とは違っている。
strings.translated: At this point, it was already unlike any ordinary egg.

strings.text:
伝説云々はともかくとして、普通ではない蟲が産まれ
る期待感は一気に高まっていった。
strings.translated: Legends aside, the anticipation of witnessing the birth of a truly extraordinary Bug surged rapidly.

strings.text:
問題だったのは、他の蟲の卵同様、人間の体内で孵化
するタイプかどうかという部分だったのだが……。
strings.translated: The question was whether it would hatch inside a human body, like the eggs of other Bugs -- but...

strings.text:
煉悟
「この分だと間違いじゃねぇみたいだな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Looks like it wasn't a mistake after all."

strings.text:
ひとまず様子を見守る事にして、煉悟はソファーに
腰を下ろした。
strings.translated: Deciding to watch and wait for now, Rengo settled himself down onto the sofa.

strings.text:
夢美
「が、あ、うっ……あ、がああぁぁっ！
　ぎっ、ひ、ひぎっ、いっ、ひぎいぃぃぃぃっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Gh, ah, ugh... a, gaaaahhh!
 Gk, hi, hgk, i, hgiiiiiiii!!"

strings.text:
卵がドリルのように回転しながら、少女の肛門を割り
開いていく。
strings.translated: The egg rotated like a drill, forcing the girl's anus open wider and wider.

strings.text:
いつの間にか形状も変化しているようで、球体から
楕円のような物体になっていた。
strings.translated: Its shape seemed to have changed at some point -- from a sphere, it had become something more like an oval.

strings.text:
夢美
「ぎゃっ……が、ぐうぅううぅぅぅっ！！！」

体が引き裂かれるような痛みと、下腹部の奥から込み
上げる排泄感が衝突する。
strings.translated: The agony of being torn apart collided with the urge to expel something welling up from deep in her lower abdomen.

strings.text:
額に汗をにじませながら、歯を食いしばって、体内に
侵入してくる異物を押し出そうとした。
strings.translated: Sweat beading on her forehead, she clenched her teeth and tried to push out the foreign object invading her body.

strings.text: 肛門付近に広がる感触は、蟲の触手とは全く違う。
strings.translated: The sensation spreading around her anus was nothing like the Bug's tentacles.

strings.text:
表面はカサカサに乾き、尖った部分が幾つもあって
柔らかい肉を引っ掻いてくる。
strings.translated: The surface was rough and dry, riddled with sharp protrusions that scraped against her soft flesh.

strings.text:
そんな物が体内に潜り込もうとするのだから、時間が
経つにつれ少女の苦しみは増す一方だった。
strings.translated: With something like that trying to burrow inside her, the girl's suffering only grew worse as the minutes passed.

strings.text:
夢美
「ぐ、う、うぅっ……は、入って、来ないでぇ……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Gh, ugh, uuugh... p, please... don't come in..."

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、頑張るなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Kuhih, you're putting up a fight."

strings.text:
煉悟
「だが、あんまり頑張ると、別のモンも出ちまうん
　じゃねぇかァ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"But if you push too hard, won't something else come out instead?"

strings.text: いやいやをするように、少女が首を横に振る。
strings.translated: The girl shook her head from side to side as if to say no, no.

strings.text:
だが、卵は無慈悲なまでに一定の力で、少女の体内を
目指し続けていた。
strings.translated: But the egg pressed on with merciless, steady force, relentlessly advancing toward the depths of her body.

strings.text: 首から上を真っ赤にして、少女が卵の侵入を拒絶する。
strings.translated: Flushed red from the neck up, the girl fought to reject the egg's intrusion.

strings.text:
煉悟の言う通り『別のモノ』が出てしまうかもしれな
かったが、卵の苦痛から逃れられるなら、それでも構
わなかった。
strings.translated: Just as Rengo had said, "something else" might come out -- but if it meant escaping the egg's torment, she didn't care.

strings.text: 五分……十分……十五分と時間が経過していく……。
strings.translated: Five minutes... ten minutes... fifteen minutes passed...

strings.text:
卵はいったんは三分の二ほどまで沈んだが、少女の
必死の抵抗によって半分程に押し戻され、また沈ん
では押し戻され、を繰り返していた。
strings.translated: The egg had sunk in about two-thirds of the way at one point, but the girl's desperate resistance had pushed it back to about halfway -- and so it went, sinking and being pushed back, over and over.

strings.text:
体力はそろそろ限界だが、それでも気力を振り絞って
少女は卵の侵入を拒み続ける……。
strings.translated: Her strength was nearly spent, yet she continued to summon every last shred of willpower to resist the egg's intrusion...

strings.text:
煉悟
「ちっ、情けねぇ。小娘相手に力負けしてんのかよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Tch. Pathetic. You're losing a contest of strength to a little girl."

strings.text:
なかなか挿入が終わらない卵に対し、煉悟は呆れたよ
うにつぶやいた。
strings.translated: Rengo muttered with exasperation at the egg, which showed no sign of finishing its insertion.

strings.text:
最初こそ面白くなりそうだと思ったのだが、あまりに
時間が掛かり過ぎて何となく冷めてくる。
strings.translated: He had thought at first that this might turn out to be entertaining, but it was taking far too long, and his interest had somehow gone cold.

strings.text:
同時に眠気が襲ってきて、さっさと終わらせてしまい
たいという気持ちのほうが強まっていった。
strings.translated: At the same time, drowsiness crept over him, and the desire to just get it over with grew stronger.

strings.text:
煉悟
「やれやれ。待つだけ時間の無駄か」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Good grief. Waiting around is just a waste of time."

strings.text:
呟きながらソファーから立ち上がって、ゆっくりと
少女に近付いていく。
strings.translated: Muttering to himself, he rose from the sofa and slowly approached the girl.

strings.text: そして、おもむろに片足を上げると――――
strings.translated: Then, he casually raised one foot -- and --

strings.text: 一度だけ、少女の体が大きく跳ね上がった。
strings.translated: Just once, the girl's body lurched violently upward.

strings.text:
背骨が折れそうなほどに体を仰け反らせ、白目を剥き
ながらまぶたを限界まで開く。
strings.translated: She arched her back as if her spine might snap, eyes rolling back, eyelids stretched open to their limit.

strings.text:
煉悟によって踏み付けられた卵は、完全に少女の直腸
に埋まってしまっていた。
strings.translated: The egg, stamped down by Rengo, had been buried completely inside the girl's rectum.

strings.text:
激痛を激痛と感じ取る余裕さえなく、少女はただか細
い呻き声だけを漏らす。
strings.translated: She had no capacity left to even register the searing pain as pain -- the girl could only let out a faint, thin moan.

strings.text:
卵がどうなったのか――それ以前に卵とは何の事だっ
たのか、思考がバラバラになって、自分がどこで何を
しているのかも思い出せない。
strings.translated: What had become of the egg -- or rather, what the egg even was in the first place -- her thoughts had shattered completely, and she could no longer remember where she was or what was happening to her.

strings.text:
唯一感じられるのは、体内に埋まった『何か』が、
ゆっくりと奥のほうへ移動している事だけだった。
strings.translated: The only thing she could feel was the "something" buried inside her body, slowly moving deeper.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、腹ン中で大切に育ててくれよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Kuhih, make sure you keep it nice and warm in that belly of yours."

strings.text:
煉悟
「何しろ伝説の蟲らしいからなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"It's supposed to be a legendary Bug, after all."

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒャヒャヒャヒャヒャヒャヒャッ！！！！」

ビクッ、ビクッと断続的に体を痙攣させる少女を見下
ろしながら、煉悟は心底愉快そうに笑った……。
strings.translated: Rengo laughed with genuine delight as he looked down at the girl, her body twitching and convulsing in intermittent spasms...

strings.text:
西から連絡があったのは、夜もだいぶ更けてからのこ
とだった。
strings.translated: It was well into the night when Nishi made contact.

strings.text:
西
「君に渡したいものがある」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"There's something I want to give you."

strings.text:
煉悟
「……今、何時だと思ってやがんだ、テメーは」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"...What time do you think it is, you bastard."

strings.text:
軽い殺意を込めて言ったが、西は気にした様子もなく
話を続ける。
strings.translated: I said it with a hint of genuine murderous intent, but Nishi showed no sign of caring and continued speaking.

strings.text:
西
「新しく開発した蟲なのだが、すぐにデータが取りた
　い」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"I've developed a new Bug, and I need data on it right away."

strings.text:
西
「すまないが、今から言う場所に向かってくれ。
　場所は――――――」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Sorry to ask, but head to the location I'm about to give you.
The place is --------"

strings.text:
煉悟
「ふざけんなっ！
　なんでわざわざこんな時間から、テメーの実験に
　付き合わなきゃなんねーんだよっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Don't screw with me!
Why the hell should I drag myself out at this hour
to play along with your experiments!!"

strings.text: 携帯電話に向かって怒鳴り声を上げる。
strings.translated: I shouted into the cell phone.

strings.text:
この時点で目は覚めてしまっていたが、それでも実験
になど付き合うつもりはない。
strings.translated: I was wide awake by this point, but that still didn't mean I had any intention of playing along with some experiment.

strings.text:
コイツの非常識さには慣れてるつもりだったが、今回
は久々に頭痛を覚えた。
strings.translated: I thought I'd gotten used to this guy's complete lack of common sense, but this time I felt a headache coming on for the first time in a while.

strings.text:
西
「急な話で申し訳ないが、よろしく頼む」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Sorry for the sudden call, but I'm counting on you."

strings.text:
西
「なに、きっと君も気に入ってくれるだろう」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Don't worry -- I'm sure you'll like it."

strings.text:
西
「成果を期待している」

一方的に言いたいことだけ言って、西がさっさと電話
を切る。
strings.translated: Nishi said what he wanted to say and hung up without waiting for a response.

strings.text:
オレの耳には虚しい電子音が聞こえ始め、暫くそのま
ま硬直してしまった。
strings.translated: A hollow dial tone began to fill my ear, and I stood frozen like that for a moment.

strings.text: ……頭の血管が何本か切れそうだ。
strings.translated: I felt like a few blood vessels in my head were about to burst.

strings.text:
いったい何を考えているのかは知らないが、言われた
通りにする必要などどこにもなかった。
strings.translated: I had no idea what the man was thinking, but there was absolutely no reason I had to do as I was told.

strings.text: 携帯電話を耳から離して、何もない虚空を見つめる。
strings.translated: I pulled the phone away from my ear and stared into empty space.

strings.text:
このままさっさと寝てしまおうかと思ったが、頭の中
では西の言葉が幾度となく繰り返されていた。
strings.translated: I thought about just going back to sleep, but Nishi's words kept replaying in my head over and over.

strings.text: まるで、重要なことをわざとぼかしたような話し方。
strings.translated: The way he spoke -- as if he were deliberately glossing over something important.

strings.text:
オレの興味が湧く程度に情報を与え、本当に指定され
た場所に行くかどうかを、まるでギャンブルのように
楽しんでいるのだろう。
strings.translated: He was probably enjoying it like a gamble, feeding me just enough information to pique my interest and waiting to see whether I'd actually show up at the designated location.

strings.text:
それが分かるからこそ無視しようとしたが、新しく
開発した蟲とやらには、やはり好奇心が湧いた。
strings.translated: Knowing that, I tried to ignore it -- but I couldn't help feeling curious about this so-called newly developed Bug.

strings.text:
アイツは非常識な変人だが、嘘だけはつかないタイプ
の人間らしい。
strings.translated: The man was an unreasonable eccentric, but he seemed to be the type who never told outright lies.

strings.text:
新しく蟲を開発したというのは、おそらく本当のこと
だろう。
strings.translated: The claim that he'd developed a new Bug was probably true.

strings.text:
それがどんなものなのか、見たいという気持ちは確か
にあった。
strings.translated: I had to admit I wanted to see what it was like.

strings.text:
オレは、ソファーから起き上がると、外出するための
準備を整えることにした。
strings.translated: I pulled myself up off the sofa and got ready to head out.

strings.text:
本当にオレが気に入る蟲がいれば、今夜のことは不問
にしてやることにした……。
strings.translated: If there really was a Bug I liked, I decided I would let tonight's business slide...

strings.text:
ユーリア
「お待たせしました」

西に指定された場所で待っていると、いつものスーツ
姿でユーリアがやって来た。
strings.translated: I waited at the location Nishi had specified, and Yulia showed up in her usual suit.

strings.text: 相変わらずの冷めた表情で、笑顔一つ浮かべやしない。
strings.translated: Her expression was as cold as ever -- not a trace of a smile.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「先生から蟲を預かってきました。
　どうぞお役に立てて下さい」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"The professor asked me to bring you these Bugs.
Please put them to good use."

strings.text: ユーリアから、数本の蟲筒を手渡される。
strings.translated: Yulia handed me several Bug tubes.

strings.text:
煉悟
「中身はどんな蟲だ、こりゃ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"What kind of Bug is inside these things?"

strings.text:
ユーリア
「私は知りません」
要するに、使う前に自分で確認しろという事らしい。
strings.translated: In other words, I was supposed to check for myself before using them.

strings.text: まあ、中身を言われても自分で確認はするのだが……。
strings.translated: Well, I would have checked myself even if she'd told me...

strings.text:
ユーリア
「それと、こちらがターゲットの泊まっているホテル
　の住所と部屋番号です」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Also, here is the address and room number of the hotel where the target is staying."

strings.text:
煉悟
「ああっ！？
　なんだそりゃっ！？　知ってんのかよ！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"What!?
What's that supposed to mean!? You knew all along!?"

strings.text:
ユーリア
「調べる方法はありますので」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"I have my ways of finding out."

strings.text:
煉悟
「チッ、読めてきたぜ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Tch. Starting to see the picture."

strings.text:
煉悟
「要するにこの蟲でオレとあの女を戦わせて、必要な
　データを取ろうって魂胆か」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"So the plan is to use these Bugs to make me and that woman fight each other, and collect whatever data you need from it."

strings.text:
舌打ちをして、あの女の居場所が書かれたメモを受け
取る。
strings.translated: I clicked my tongue and took the memo with the woman's location written on it.

strings.text:
結局、オレの行動もあの女の行動も、西の野郎には
筒抜けってことらしい。
strings.translated: In the end, it seemed that both my movements and that woman's were completely transparent to that bastard Nishi.

strings.text:
煉悟
「アイツも暇な奴だ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"The guy's got too much time on his hands."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「それでは、ご武運を……」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Well then... good luck to you."

strings.text:
煉悟
「テメーも、何かちったぁ手伝ってくれてもいいん
　じゃねーのか？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Couldn't you at least pitch in a little yourself?"

strings.text:
ユーリア
「そのような指示は受けていませんので」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"I have received no such instructions."

strings.text:
煉悟
「んで、オレとあの女の戦いを監視しろって指示は
　受けてるってか？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"But you have received instructions to keep watch over my fight with that woman, haven't you?"

strings.text:
ユーリア
「失礼致します」

オレの言葉など聞こえなかったかのように、ユーリア
が頭を下げて去って行く。
strings.translated: As if she hadn't heard a word I said, Yulia bowed her head and walked away.

strings.text: どこまでも気に食わない女だ。
strings.translated: That woman rubbed me the wrong way, through and through.

strings.text:
煉悟
「チャンスがあったらメチャクチャに犯してやる」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"If I ever get the chance, I'll rape her senseless."

strings.text:
オレはそう呟くと、蟲使いの女が泊まっているホテル
へと向かうことにした。
strings.translated: With those words muttered under his breath, I set off toward the hotel where the female Bug User was staying.

strings.text: 奇襲を掛けるには、ちょうど良い時間帯だった……。
strings.translated: It was the perfect time of night for a surprise attack...

strings.text:
あの女が泊まっているというホテルにやって来て、
オレは明かりの消えている、とある窓を見上げた。
strings.translated:
I arrived at the hotel where that woman was supposedly staying,
and looked up at a certain darkened window.

strings.text:
ユーリアから受け取ったメモによれば、二階の左から
二番目の窓が女の泊まっている部屋になるはずだ。
strings.translated: According to the memo I received from Yulia, the second window from the left on the second floor should be the room she's staying in.

strings.text: 小鳥のような蟲を出し、女の部屋の窓へと飛ばす。
strings.translated: I released a bird-like Bug and sent it flying toward the window of her room.

strings.text:
煉悟
「あの部屋にいる奴を叩きのめしてやれっ！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Beat the hell out of whoever's in that room!"

strings.text: 蟲に合図を送り、命令を下す。
strings.translated: I sent the signal to the Bug and issued my command.

strings.text:
あの女が本当にいるのかどうかは分からないが、奇襲
ならこの方法が一番手っ取り早い。
strings.translated: I had no way of knowing whether that woman was actually in there, but for a surprise attack, this was the quickest method.

strings.text:
オレの命令を受けた蟲は、一直線に部屋の窓を目指し、
何の躊躇いもなく――――
strings.translated: The Bug that received my order made a beeline straight for the room's window, without a moment's hesitation ----

strings.text: ――窓ガラスを突き破って部屋に入り込んだ。
strings.translated: -- and smashed through the glass, forcing its way inside.

strings.text:
いくらあの女でも、寝込みを襲われて平気でいられる
わけがない。
strings.translated: Even that woman couldn't possibly be fine after being attacked in her sleep.

strings.text: 暫く様子を窺っていると、いきなり蟲の気配が増えた。
strings.translated: As I watched and waited for a while, the presence of Bugs suddenly surged.

strings.text: あの女が蟲を使ったのだ。
strings.translated: That woman had used her Bugs.

strings.text: 大きな物音と、何かが崩れるような音が響き渡る。
strings.translated: A loud crash rang out, followed by the sound of something collapsing.

strings.text: 割れた窓から、女が飛び降りてきた。
strings.translated: The woman came leaping out through the shattered window.

strings.text:
サユリ
「くっ……あの蟲は………………ッ！」

煉悟
「いよぅ、会いたかったぜぇ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Hey there, been wanting to meet you."

strings.text: オレの姿を見て、女が目を丸くして驚く。
strings.translated: The woman's eyes went wide with shock at the sight of me.

strings.text:
こういう形で襲われるとは、夢にも思っていなかった
のだろう。
strings.translated: She must never have dreamed she'd be attacked in a way like this.

strings.text:
サユリ
「よくここが分かったわね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"How did you find me here?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「まーな。オレが見つけたわけじゃねーが」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Eh, I didn't find you myself."

strings.text:
サユリ
「……仲間がいたのね」
明らかに失敗したという顔を浮かべ、女が奥歯を噛む。
strings.translated: With an expression that clearly said she'd made a mistake, the woman ground her back teeth.

strings.text:
――と、ゆっくりと会話するつもりもないらしく、
オレに向かって蟲筒を構えた。
strings.translated: -- It seemed she had no intention of making idle conversation, as she leveled her Bug tube at me.

strings.text:
サユリ
「ちょうど良かったわ。
　私もあなたを捜していたところだったから」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"Perfect timing, actually.
I was just looking for you myself."

strings.text:
サユリ
「今度は確実に殺すわ」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"This time, I'll kill you for certain."

strings.text: 言いながら、オレもまた蟲筒を構える。
strings.translated: As I said it, I raised my own Bug tube.

strings.text:
奇襲がどの程度の効果になったのかは分からないが、
少なくとも十分な蟲を準備するだけの時間はなかった
はずだ。
strings.translated: I had no way of knowing how effective the surprise attack had been, but at the very least, she shouldn't have had time to prepare a full complement of Bugs.

strings.text:
一匹一匹が強力でも、手持ちの数が少なければ戦いに
勝利するのは難しい。
strings.translated: Even if each individual Bug was powerful, winning a fight was difficult if you didn't have enough of them on hand.

strings.text:
そして、実際それが関係しているのか、オレと女は
暫く睨み合ったまま動こうとはしなかった。
strings.translated: And whether that was actually a factor or not, the woman and I stood glaring at each other for a while, neither of us making a move.

strings.text:
おそらくは、そんな時間が出来てしまったからだろう、
オレはふと頭の隅にあった疑問を思い出し、何気なく
それを口にしてしまっていた。
strings.translated: It was probably because that kind of standoff had developed that I suddenly recalled a question that had been lurking in the back of my mind, and found myself casually voicing it.

strings.text:
煉悟
「先に聞いときたいんだが、伝説だかなんだかって
　蟲の話……聞いたことあるか？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"There's something I want to ask you first -- that story about some legendary Bug or whatever...
Have you heard of it?"

strings.text:
想像もしていなかった内容の質問だったのだろう、
女が怪訝な表情を浮かべる。
strings.translated: It must have been a question with content she never could have anticipated, because the woman's expression turned suspicious.

strings.text:
戦闘の構えこそ崩さなかったが、すぐに攻撃して来る
様子はなかった。
strings.translated: She kept her combat stance, but showed no sign of attacking immediately.

strings.text:
煉悟
「確か……何て言ったっけなァ？
　じゅ、じょう、ま……いや、じゅうむ……？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"What was it called again...
Ju, jo, ma... no, juumu...?"

strings.text: 確かに、その名前には聞き覚えがあった。
strings.translated: That name did ring a bell.

strings.text:
蟲でありながら獣のような姿をしているとか何とか、
村にいた頃に聞いた気がする。
strings.translated: I seemed to recall hearing about it back in the village -- something about a Bug that had the form of a beast despite being a Bug.

strings.text:
サユリ
「村から盗み出したのは……」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"So you're the one who stole it from the village..."

strings.text: 女の目が細められ、怒気がいっそう強まる。
strings.translated: The woman's eyes narrowed, her anger intensifying further.

strings.text:
どうやらあの蟲の卵は、今でも一族の連中にとっては
大切なものらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed that Bug's egg was still something precious to the clan, even now.

strings.text: ……年寄りどもの戯言じゃないって事か？
strings.translated: So it wasn't just the ramblings of those old fools?

strings.text:
適当に小娘のケツにぶち込んではみたものの、ちゃん
と使い方を調べてからのほうが良かったかもしれない。
strings.translated: I'd shoved it into some girl's ass on a whim, but maybe I should have looked into how to use it properly first.

strings.text: そう考えた途端、オレはもうひとつの失敗に気付いた。
strings.translated: The moment that thought crossed my mind, I realized I'd made another mistake.

strings.text:
煉悟
「どうせなら、お前に使えば良かったのか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Guess I should've used it on you instead."

strings.text:
サユリ
「あれを使ったというの！？」
つぶやいた後、ハッと気付いたように女が叫ぶ。
strings.translated: She muttered it, then gasped and cried out as if suddenly realizing something.

strings.text:
煉悟
「今、ちょうど苗床にしてる小娘がいてなァ。
　昨日、ケツの穴にぶち込んでやったところだ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I've got a girl I'm using as a Seedbed right now, see.
 I shoved it up her ass just yesterday."

strings.text:
煉悟
「さすがにギャアギャア喚いてうるさかったぜぇ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"She sure screamed her head off about it, I'll tell you that."

strings.text:
驚愕、というよりは恐怖に近い表情を浮かべながら、
女がオレを見つめる。
strings.translated: The woman stared at me, her expression less one of shock and more of something closer to fear.

strings.text:
だが、それも僅かな時間だけで、すぐに元の鋭い目つ
きに戻る。
strings.translated: But it only lasted a moment before her sharp gaze returned.

strings.text: さっきよりも、明らかな殺意が伝わってきた。
strings.translated: A killing intent far more pronounced than before radiated from her.

strings.text:
サユリ
「あなた、自分が何をしたか分かってるの！？
　獣魔蟲は人も蟲も喰うとされた、蟲姫の徒なの
　よっ！？」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"Do you have any idea what you've done!?
They say the Jumachuu devours both humans and Bugs alike -- it's a servant of the Bug Princess!"

strings.text: 女の意味不明な言葉に、オレは眉根を寄せた。
strings.translated: I furrowed my brow at the woman's incomprehensible words.

strings.text:
どこかで聞いたことがあるような気もしたが、ハッキ
リとは思い出せない。
strings.translated: It rang a vague bell somewhere, but I couldn't quite recall the details.

strings.text:
サユリ
「もう産まれたの？」

サユリ
「獣魔蟲がもう産まれたのかどうかを訊いてるの
　よっ！！」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"I'm asking whether the Jumachuu has hatched yet!!"

strings.text:
以前、戦った時より、明らかに女が動揺した様子を
見せている。
strings.translated: The woman was clearly more shaken than she had been during our previous fight.

strings.text:
そんなにヤバイものだったという自覚は、オレのほう
にはないのだが……。
strings.translated: For my part, I hadn't really grasped just how dangerous the thing was...

strings.text:
煉悟
「まだ産まれてねぇよ。
　昨日、卵を突っ込んだばっかだ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"It hasn't hatched yet.
 I only shoved the egg in yesterday."

strings.text:
オレの答えを聞いて、女が心底ホッとした様子で息を
吐く。
strings.translated: Hearing my answer, the woman exhaled with what looked like genuine relief.

strings.text:
あの蟲について、何らかの情報を持ってるのは間違い
なさそうだ。
strings.translated: There was no doubt she had some information about that Bug.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、テメーをとっ捕まえる理由が、一つ増えち
　まったな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Khih, looks like I've got one more reason to get my hands on you."

strings.text:
サユリ
「やれるものなら……やってみなさいっ！！」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"If you think you can... then try it!!"

strings.text: オレと女が、ほぼ同時に蟲を放つ。
strings.translated: The woman and I released our Bugs at nearly the same moment.

strings.text:
空中で二匹の蟲が食らい付き、尖った顎や牙を突き立
てる。
strings.translated: Two Bugs clashed in midair, driving their sharp mandibles and fangs into each other.

strings.text:
暫く揉み合いになったが、打ち破ったのはオレの蟲の
ほうだった。
strings.translated: They grappled for a while, but it was my Bug that broke through.

strings.text: 女が、さらに二匹の蟲を放つ。
strings.translated: The woman released two more Bugs.

strings.text:
対してオレも蟲を一匹放ち、空中で四匹の蟲が入り乱
れた。
strings.translated: I countered by releasing one of my own, and four Bugs tangled together in the air.

strings.text: ふと気付くと、女が背を向けて逃走を開始していた。
strings.translated: When I looked up, the woman had turned her back and started running.

strings.text: 角を曲がって姿を消し、その後も走り去る気配がする。
strings.translated: She rounded a corner and vanished, and I could still hear her footsteps fading into the distance.

strings.text:
術者がいなくなったため、当然蟲のコントロールは
甘くなり、オレの蟲が女の蟲を食い殺した。
strings.translated: With her controller gone, her Bugs naturally lost their edge, and my Bug devoured them.

strings.text:
煉悟
「逃がすかってんだよォッ！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Like hell I'm letting you get away!!"

strings.text: 女が逃げた路地を睨み付けながら、俺は咆哮した。
strings.translated: I roared, glaring down the alley she had fled into.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ちっ、どこ行きやがった！？」
女を追って路地を走る。
strings.translated: I ran down the alley in pursuit.

strings.text:
最初の角を曲がったところまでは確認したが、その後
がどこへ行ったのか分からない。
strings.translated: I confirmed she had turned at the first corner, but had no idea where she went after that.

strings.text:
この辺りの路地は複雑に入り組んでいて、何度も行き
止まりにぶち当たりながら女を捜した。
strings.translated: The alleys in this area were a tangled maze, and I hit dead end after dead end as I searched for her.

strings.text:
まさか、ホテルの周りの路地がこんなに複雑だとは
思ってもみなかった。
strings.translated: I never would have guessed the alleys around the hotel were this complicated.

strings.text: ここで逃がしちまったら、もう二度と奇襲は使えない。
strings.translated: If I let her slip away here, I'd never get another chance at a surprise attack.

strings.text: だが、どこに逃げたのかサッパリ分からない。
strings.translated: But I had absolutely no idea where she had fled.

strings.text: オレは、舌打ちしながら溜息をついたが――――
strings.translated: I clicked my tongue and let out a sigh -- but then --

strings.text:
突然、背後から感じた蟲の気配に振り返った瞬間、
右肩をバッサリと切られた。
strings.translated:
The instant I spun around at the sudden presence of a Bug I sensed behind me,
my right shoulder was slashed clean open.

strings.text:
サユリ
「本当に戦い方を知らない素人なのね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"You really are an amateur who doesn't know the first thing about fighting."

strings.text: 目の前に現れたのは、捜していた蟲使いの女。
strings.translated: Standing before me was the Bug User woman I had been searching for.

strings.text:
蟲筒を構えながら、完全に呆れたような表情を浮かべ
ている。
strings.translated: She had her Bug tube at the ready, wearing an expression of complete exasperation.

strings.text:
サユリ
「まさか、あなたが自分で追ってくるとは思わなかっ
　たわ」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"I never thought you'd actually come chasing after me yourself."

strings.text:
サユリ
「……何のための蟲なの？」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"...What are your Bugs even for?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「うるせぇっ！
　オレはオレの使いたいように使うっ！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Shut up!!
I use them however the hell I want!"

strings.text:
煉悟
「テメーなんざの指図は受けねぇっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I don't take orders from the likes of you!!"

strings.text:
サユリ
「誰も指図はしてないわ」

サユリ
「あなたがマヌケなことをしてくれたから、私も準備
　を整える時間ができたし」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"You were foolish enough to come after me yourself, so it gave me time to get
 prepared."

strings.text:
女の言葉に、オレは自分がとんでもない失敗を仕出か
したことに気付いた。
strings.translated: At the woman's words, I realized I had made a catastrophic blunder.

strings.text:
女を見失ってる間に、どうやら一度ホテルの部屋まで
戻られちまったらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed that while I had lost sight of her, she had managed to slip back to her hotel room.

strings.text: これで、奇襲を掛けた意味は殆ど無しだ。
strings.translated: That rendered the whole point of the surprise attack nearly meaningless.

strings.text:
サユリ
「今度こそ逃しはしない」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"This time, I won't let you escape."

strings.text: 女の周囲に、顎の尖った蟲が舞い降りてくる。
strings.translated: Around the woman, Bugs with pointed jaws descended through the air.

strings.text: 以前、オレの蟲をあっさりと切り刻んだヤツだ。
strings.translated: The same ones that had sliced my Bugs apart so effortlessly before.

strings.text:
手加減だとか、様子見だとかやれるような相手じゃな
い。
strings.translated: This wasn't an opponent I could afford to hold back against or feel out.

strings.text:
女の蟲が襲い掛かって来た瞬間、オレもまた蟲筒から
蟲を放つ。
strings.translated: The moment the woman's Bugs lunged at me, I fired my own Bug from its tube.

strings.text: この前、西から借りた実験段階の蟲だ。
strings.translated: The experimental-stage Bug I had borrowed from Nishi the other day.

strings.text: 強力な分、使えるのは三十秒間のみ――――ッ！
strings.translated: As powerful as it was, it could only be used for thirty seconds -- !

strings.text: オレの蟲が、女の蟲を打ち破る。
strings.translated: My Bug tore through the woman's Bugs.

strings.text: 宙を肉片が散り、その先に狼狽する女の姿が見える。
strings.translated: Chunks of flesh scattered through the air, and beyond them I could see the woman thrown into a panic.

strings.text:
このまま腕の一本も潰しちまえば、間違いなくオレの
勝ちだ。
strings.translated: If I could crush even one of her arms like this, the victory would be mine without question.

strings.text: 蟲に合図を送り、一直線に飛ばす。
strings.translated: I signaled my Bug and sent it flying in a straight line.

strings.text:
女は新たに蟲筒を構えていたが、生半可な強さの蟲で
は結果は変わらない。
strings.translated: The woman had readied a new Bug tube, but no Bug of middling strength would change the outcome.

strings.text:
女は、同種の蟲をさらに二匹放ったが、それも十秒
足らずでオレの蟲に食い殺された。
strings.translated: The woman released two more of the same kind of Bug, but they were devoured by my Bug in under ten seconds.

strings.text:
普通ならここで高笑いだが、この蟲に限って十秒は
かなり貴重な時間だ。
strings.translated: Normally I'd be laughing triumphantly right about now, but with this Bug, ten seconds was precious time.

strings.text:
次の蟲が放たれる前に、女に傷の一つも負わせたかっ
た。
strings.translated: I wanted to land at least one wound on the woman before she could release her next Bug.

strings.text: 残された時間は十秒弱。
女は、次の蟲筒を構えようとしたが――――
strings.translated: The woman moved to ready her next Bug tube -- but --

strings.text: オレの蟲が、女の右肩を掠めるように突っ込んだ。
strings.translated: My Bug drove into the woman's right shoulder in a grazing blow.

strings.text:
オレは、蟲をＵターンさせて再度攻撃しようと試みた
が、それより早く女の蟲が襲い掛かって来た。
strings.translated: I tried to turn my Bug around for another attack, but the woman's Bug came lunging at me even faster.

strings.text: 例の顎の尖った蟲が、オレの脇腹に食いついてくる。
strings.translated: That Bug with the pointed jaw bit into my side.

strings.text:
肉を抉られる痛みが走り抜けたが、もがいているよう
な暇はない。
strings.translated: A searing pain tore through me as it gouged into my flesh, but I had no time to struggle.

strings.text:
蟲を掴んで強引に引き剥がすと、力任せに宙に投げ捨
てた。
strings.translated: I grabbed the Bug and wrenched it off by force, then hurled it into the air.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ち、くしょうっ！　しまった…………」

strings.translated: The wound was far from shallow.

strings.text:
致命傷というほどじゃないが、すぐには血は止まりそ
うになかった。
strings.translated: Not quite a fatal wound, but the bleeding showed no sign of stopping anytime soon.

strings.text:
サユリ
「ここまでのようね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"Looks like this is the end for you."

strings.text:
自分の近くに蟲を引き戻した女が、冷めた口調で告げ
る。
strings.translated: The woman called her Bug back to her side and announced it in a cold, flat tone.

strings.text:
左右の手には一本ずつ蟲筒が握られていて、次でオレ
を殺すつもりなのは間違いない。
strings.translated: She held a Bug tube in each hand, and there was no doubt she intended to finish me off with the next strike.

strings.text:
対してオレは、切り札とも言える蟲を出してしまった
ため、これ以上は手の打ちようがなかった。
strings.translated: As for me -- I had already played what could be called my trump card, leaving me with no further moves to make.

strings.text:
せめて、逃げる時間だけでも稼げれば、話は変わって
くるのだが……。
strings.translated: If only I could buy enough time to escape, things might have turned out differently...

strings.text:
煉悟
（いや、その方法があるか）
strings.translated:
Rengo
(No -- wait. There's still one way.)

strings.text: 不意に、頭の中に浮かんだ手段。
strings.translated: A plan surfaced suddenly in my mind.

strings.text:
上手くいくかどうかは分からないが、考えている暇は
なかった。
strings.translated: Whether it would work or not, I had no time to think it over.

strings.text: 顎の尖った蟲が、三匹同時に突っ込んで来る――――
strings.translated: Three of those pointed-jaw Bugs came lunging at me simultaneously--------

strings.text:
――と、同時に、オレはある蟲を目の前に解き放ち、
女の蟲を迎え撃っていた。
strings.translated: -- At that same moment, I released a certain Bug right in front of me to intercept her Bugs.

strings.text:
一直線に襲って来た女の蟲を、突如出現した粘液状の
蟲が包み込む。
strings.translated: A viscous, mucus-like Bug suddenly appeared and enveloped the woman's Bugs as they charged in a straight line.

strings.text:
粘ついた己の肉を使って、三匹の蟲を捕獲しながら
地面に落ちた。
strings.translated: Using its own sticky flesh, it captured all three Bugs and dropped to the ground.

strings.text:
本来は、樹の上や地面の窪みなどに仕掛け、敵が掛か
るのを待つ蟲だ。
strings.translated: Normally, it's a Bug meant to be set as a trap -- laid in the branches of trees or hollows in the ground -- and left to wait for prey to stumble in.

strings.text:
粘着力が強いため、もしかしたらと思ったのだが、
どうやら上手くいったらしい。
strings.translated: I had a hunch its adhesive strength might do the trick, and it seemed I was right.

strings.text:
女の蟲はビクビクと悶えながら、粘液状の蟲に飲み込
まれていった。
strings.translated: The woman's Bugs writhed and convulsed as they were swallowed up by the mucus-like Bug.

strings.text:
サユリ
「そんなものまで持ってたのね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"So you were carrying something like that as well."

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、今日からだけどな」

サユリ
「……あなた、誰かから蟲をもらっているのね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"...Someone has been giving you Bugs."

strings.text:
煉悟
「そりゃあな……オレ一人で蟲を補充し続けるにゃ
　限界ってもんがあるからよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, yeah... there's a limit to how long I can keep restocking Bugs on my own."

strings.text:
煉悟
「強い蟲をもらう代わりに、こうして実験ってわけ
　だ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"In exchange for getting stronger Bugs, I run little experiments like this."

strings.text:
煉悟
「要するに、テメーみたいな蟲使いに、開発した蟲が
　どこまで通用するか見たいんだとよっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"In short, they want to see how far their developed Bugs can hold up against a Bug User like you!!"

strings.text: 撃ち出された蟲が宙を舞い、敵の蟲に牙を剥く。
strings.translated: The Bugs I fired flew through the air and bared their fangs at the enemy's Bugs.

strings.text:
その数はあっと言う間に十を超え、それでも尚、オレ
は蟲を撃ち続けた。
strings.translated: Their number surpassed ten in the blink of an eye, and still I kept firing.

strings.text:
これ以上、ちまちま一匹ずつ戦わせたところで意味は
ない。
strings.translated: There was no point in dragging this out one Bug at a time anymore.

strings.text: 女を倒すには、力ずくで圧しきる以外になかった。
strings.translated: To bring the woman down, I had no choice but to overwhelm her by sheer force.

strings.text:
多少の蟲の力の差はあったとしても、この方法なら
最後にモノを言うのは数だ。
strings.translated: Even if there were some difference in the Bugs' individual strength, with this method, what would matter in the end was numbers.

strings.text:
連続して撃ち出す分、蟲の動きは一直線と単純になる
が、それは女のほうも同じはずだった。
strings.translated: Firing them in rapid succession made the Bugs' movements simple and straightforward -- but the same should have been true for the woman.

strings.text:
サユリ
「やっぱり素人ね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"An amateur, just as I thought."

strings.text:
背中に鋭い痛みを受けて、オレは次に撃ち出そうとし
ていた蟲筒を取りこぼした。
strings.translated: A sharp pain struck me in the back, and I fumbled and dropped the Bug tube I had been about to fire next.

strings.text: 背中に突っ込んで来たのは蟲の気配。
strings.translated: Something had slammed into my back -- and I could sense it was a Bug.

strings.text:
仰向けになって地面に倒れ込むと、それより一瞬早く
蟲が飛び去った気配がした。
strings.translated: As I fell backward onto the ground, I sensed the Bug dart away a split second before I landed.

strings.text:
致命傷というほど深くはないが、体を動かそうとする
と背中が痛む。
strings.translated: Not deep enough to be fatal, but my back screamed with pain whenever I tried to move.

strings.text:
どうにかうつ伏せになって女を見たが、その時には
もうオレの蟲は全て食い尽くされていた。
strings.translated: I somehow managed to roll face-down and look up at the woman -- by then, every last one of my Bugs had been devoured.

strings.text:
サユリ
「馬鹿みたいに一直線に蟲を放つだけ……。
　しっかりと訓練を受けた蟲使いなら、まずやらない
　方法ね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"Just blindly firing Bugs in a straight line... That's something no properly trained Bug User would ever do."

strings.text:
サユリ
「撃ち出す蟲は、自分が的確に命令を与えられる数ま
　で……」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"The number of Bugs you release should never exceed what you can give precise commands to..."

strings.text:
サユリ
「これは、蟲使いの戦いにおいて基本中の基本よ」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"This is the most fundamental rule of Bug User combat."

strings.text:
呆れたような瞳で見下ろしてくる女に、オレは睨み付
けるような視線を送った。
strings.translated: I shot a glare up at the woman as she looked down at me with eyes full of exasperation.

strings.text: ――このまま死んでたまるかっ！
両手を地面について、痛みを堪えながら体を起こす。
strings.translated: I pressed both hands against the ground and forced my body upright, enduring the pain.

strings.text:
起こしたあと、どうするかは決めてなかったが、寝た
ままでいるわけにはいかなかった。
strings.translated: I had no plan for what to do once I was up -- but I couldn't just lie there.

strings.text:
だが、そんなオレに、女は冷たい眼差しを送りながら
蟲筒を向ける。
strings.translated:
But even as I struggled to my feet, the woman fixed me with a cold stare
and leveled her Bug tube at me.

strings.text:
サユリ
「今度こそ終わりよ」
今度こそ本当に殺される。
strings.translated: This time, I was really going to die.

strings.text:
本気でそう思った瞬間、オレと女の間に、予想もして
なかった奴が割り込んできた。
strings.translated:
The moment I truly believed that, someone I never could have expected
forced their way between me and the woman.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「戦闘対象を確認。捕獲します」

女が驚いている間に、ユーリアが信じられないような
スピードで接近した。
strings.translated:
While the woman stood there in shock, Yulia closed the distance at an
unbelievable speed.

strings.text:
瞬きする間に懐まで入り込んで、女の持っていた蟲筒
を弾き飛ばす。
strings.translated:
In the blink of an eye she was inside the woman's guard, knocking the
Bug tube right out of her hand.

strings.text:
もちろん、女は次の蟲筒を取り出そうとしたが、それ
をするだけの暇はどこにもなかった。
strings.translated:
Of course, the woman tried to reach for another Bug tube -- but she never
had the chance.

strings.text: ユーリアの拳が、女の腹にめり込む。
strings.translated: Yulia's fist drove deep into the woman's gut.

strings.text:
その一撃は、おそらく並みの人間の拳打より遥かに
重い。
strings.translated:
That single blow carried far more weight than any ordinary human punch
could ever hope to.

strings.text: 女はあっさりと意識を失い、その場に崩れ落ちた。
strings.translated: The woman lost consciousness without a fight and crumpled to the ground.

strings.text: それで、戦いは終わりだった……。
strings.translated: And with that, the battle was over...

strings.text:
ユーリア
「危ないところでしたね」

煉悟
「……どういうつもりだ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"...What do you think you're doing?"

strings.text:
ユーリア
「何がでしょう？」

煉悟
「なんでオレを助けたのかって聞いてんだよっ！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I'm asking why the hell you saved me!"

strings.text:
ユーリア
「殺されそうでしたので」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"You were about to be killed."

strings.text: さらりと、これ以上ないほどの事実だけを言い放つ。
strings.translated: She stated it plainly -- nothing more than the bare, undeniable truth.

strings.text: 確かに殺されそうになったのは間違いない。
strings.translated: There was no denying that I had nearly been killed.

strings.text: 助けてもらわなければ、たぶん死んでただろう。
strings.translated: If she hadn't stepped in, I'd probably be dead right now.

strings.text:
だが、それでユーリアの行動に納得がいくわけじゃな
い。
strings.translated:
But that didn't mean I was satisfied with Yulia's reasoning for what she
had done.

strings.text:
煉悟
「西の指示は受けてないんじゃなかったのか？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I thought you said Nishi hadn't given you any instructions?"

strings.text:
ユーリア
「あなたが死なないように、一応の注意はするよう
　言われていました」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"I was told to at least make some effort to keep you from dying."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「蟲のデータは十分に取ることができましたので、
　私の判断で戦いに割り込ませてもらいました」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"I had gathered sufficient data on the Bugs, so I made the judgment call
 to intervene in the fight myself."

strings.text:
煉悟
「せめてもう少し早いほうが、オレも怪我せずに済ん
　だんだがな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"If you'd stepped in even a little sooner, I could've gotten away without
 these injuries."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「お渡しした蟲の中に、傷を癒す蟲がいたはずです。
　使用して後に結果を報告して下さい」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Among the Bugs I gave you, there should be one that heals wounds.
 Please use it and report the results afterward."

strings.text:
どこまでも、西の手のひらの上で踊らされている事実
に、オレは忌々しさを感じずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated:
I couldn't help but feel a burning irritation at the fact that I was still
dancing in the palm of Nishi's hand, no matter what I did.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「彼女の身柄はこちらでお預かりしますが、よろしい
　ですね？」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"We will be taking custody of her -- that is acceptable, yes?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「ああ、実験台にでも何にでもしてやれ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Yeah, do whatever you want with her. Make her a test subject for all I care."

strings.text: 蟲使いの女を抱えたユーリアに、ひらひらと手を振る。
strings.translated: I gave a casual wave to Yulia as she hoisted the Bug User woman over her shoulder.

strings.text: この状況で、女を渡せとはさすがに言えない。
strings.translated: There was no way I could demand they hand the woman over to me, not in this situation.

strings.text:
せめて一度くらい、オレのモノで犯してやりたかった
が、結果が結果だけに諦めるしかなさそうだった。
strings.translated:
I would have liked to violate her at least once with what was mine -- but
given how things had turned out, I had no choice but to let it go.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「この女性が泊まっているホテルも、多少の騒ぎに
　なっているようです」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"It seems the hotel where this woman was staying has become something of
 a scene as well."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「彼女の荷物はあなたが回収しておいて下さい」

煉悟
「なんでオレが、そんな真似しなきゃなんねーんだ
　よ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Why the hell should I have to go and do something like that?"

strings.text:
オレの言葉を無視して、ユーリアが路地の奥へと消え
ていく。
strings.translated: Ignoring my words, Yulia disappeared into the depths of the alley.

strings.text: 結局のところ、最後に勝ったのは西のようなもんだ。
strings.translated: In the end, the one who came out on top was Nishi -- same as always.

strings.text:
ハラワタが煮えくり返るような思いがしたが、今は
傷を癒すのが先決だった。
strings.translated:
My gut was boiling with rage, but right now, tending to my wounds had
to come first.

strings.text:
敗北と、そして命を救われたという悔しさは、いつま
でもオレの胸に燻り続けた……。
strings.translated:
The bitterness of defeat -- and of having my life saved -- continued to
smolder in my chest long after...

strings.text: それを、みすみす撃たせるわけにはいかなかった。
strings.translated: There was no way I could let her fire that off freely.

strings.text: ひとまず、同じく飛行可能な鳥型の蟲を一匹放つ。
strings.translated: For now, I released a single bird-type Bug capable of flight.

strings.text:
対して女の蟲も、再び襲い掛かってきて、オレの蟲に
その尖った顎を突き立てた。
strings.translated:
In response, the woman's Bug came rushing at me again, driving its
sharp mandibles into my Bug.

strings.text: それは、一瞬の出来事だった。

オレの蟲を紙のように切り裂いた女の蟲が、そのまま
の勢いで突っ込んで来たのだ。
strings.translated:
The woman's Bug, having sliced through my Bug like paper, came
charging at me with the same momentum.

strings.text:
尖った顎がオレの喉に突き刺さり、そしてぐりっと
肉をねじる。
strings.translated:
Its sharp mandibles drove into my throat, then twisted
through the flesh with a grinding wrench.

strings.text:
煉悟
（おい……そんなことしたら…………）
口から、そして喉の傷から血が溢れる。
strings.translated: Blood poured from my mouth, and from the wound in my throat.

strings.text:
だが、その間にも、目の前の女が次の蟲筒を構えてい
て――――
strings.translated:
But even as that happened, the woman in front of me was readying
her next Bug tube --

strings.text:
煉悟
「行けっ！　見失うなよっ！！」
蟲を放って、逃げた女を追跡させる。
strings.translated: I released a Bug and had it pursue the fleeing woman.

strings.text:
もちろんオレも後を追うが、こういう場合は蟲を先行
させたほうが賢明だ。
strings.translated:
Of course I gave chase myself as well, but in situations like this,
it's wiser to send the Bug ahead.

strings.text:
路地も思っていた以上に入り組んでいて、自分だけで
追っていたら間違いなく見失っていただろう。
strings.translated:
The alleyways were far more labyrinthine than I'd expected --
if I'd been tracking her alone, I'd have surely lost her.

strings.text: 女を追っている蟲の気配が、いきなりプツンと切れた。
strings.translated:
Suddenly, the presence of the Bug I had tracking the woman
snapped out of existence.

strings.text: どうやら殺られちまったらしい。

だが、女がぐるっと路地を回ろうとしているのは、
何となく蟲の気配から読み取れていた。
strings.translated:
But from the faint trace of the Bug's presence, I could
roughly tell that the woman was looping around through the alleys.

strings.text:
煉悟
「そうか。戻るつもりだなっ！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I see. You're planning to double back!"

strings.text: 奇襲を受けたため、女はロクな準備が出来ていない。
strings.translated:
She'd been caught off guard by my ambush, so the woman hadn't been
able to make any proper preparations.

strings.text:
路地に逃げ込んだふりをして、ホテルの部屋に戻るつ
もりなのだろう。
strings.translated:
She must be planning to feign a retreat into the alleyways
and then return to her hotel room.

strings.text:
オレは急いで引き返すと、おそらくは女が出てくるで
あろう道で待ち伏せた。
strings.translated:
I hurried back and set up an ambush on the road
where the woman would most likely emerge.

strings.text: オレの読み通り、女が路地の向こう側から駆けて来る。
strings.translated: Just as I'd predicted, the woman came running from the other side of the alley.

strings.text: やっぱり、今はロクな蟲を持ってないらしい。
strings.translated: Sure enough, it seemed she didn't have any decent Bugs on her right now.

strings.text:
女はすっと目を細めると、観念したように蟲筒を構え
た。
strings.translated:
The woman narrowed her eyes slightly, then raised her Bug tube
as if resigning herself to her fate.

strings.text:
サユリ
「最初に戦ったときとは違って、随分賢くなったわ
　ね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"You've gotten quite a bit smarter than the first time we fought,
 haven't you."

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、勉強させてもらったんでな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Heh, I had a good teacher."

strings.text:
サユリ
「そう……それなら、その授業料――――」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"I see... Then the tuition for that lesson --"

strings.text:
サユリ
「――あなたの命で払ってもらうわっ！」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"-- you'll pay with your life!"

strings.text: 上空から一匹の蟲が舞い降りて来る。
strings.translated: A single Bug came swooping down from above.

strings.text:
前足が鎌のようになった蟲で、おそらくはオレが追尾
させていた蟲を始末したのがそれだろう。
strings.translated:
It was a Bug with forelegs shaped like scythes -- most likely the one
that had disposed of the Bug I'd sent in pursuit.

strings.text:
煉悟
「一気にぶっ潰してやるっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I'll crush you all at once!!"

strings.text:
女の蟲が襲い掛かって来た瞬間、オレもまた蟲筒から
蟲を放つ。
strings.translated: The moment the woman's Bugs lunged at me, I fired my own Bug from its tube.

strings.text: この前、西から借りた実験段階の蟲だ。
strings.translated: The experimental-stage Bug I had borrowed from Nishi the other day.

strings.text: 強力な分、使えるのは三十秒間のみ――――ッ！
strings.translated: As powerful as it was, it could only be used for thirty seconds -- !

strings.text: オレの蟲が、女の蟲を打ち破る。
strings.translated: My Bug tore through the woman's Bugs.

strings.text: 宙を肉片が散り、その先に狼狽する女の姿が見える。
strings.translated: Chunks of flesh scattered through the air, and beyond them I could see the woman thrown into a panic.

strings.text:
このまま腕の一本も潰しちまえば、間違いなくオレの
勝ちだ。
strings.translated: If I could crush even one of her arms like this, the victory would be mine without question.

strings.text: 蟲に合図を送り、一直線に飛ばす。
strings.translated: I signaled my Bug and sent it flying in a straight line.

strings.text:
女は新たに蟲筒を構えていたが、生半可な強さの蟲で
は結果は変わらない。
strings.translated: The woman had readied a new Bug tube, but no Bug of middling strength would change the outcome.

strings.text:
女は、同種の蟲をさらに二匹放ったが、それも十秒
足らずでオレの蟲に食い殺された。
strings.translated: The woman released two more of the same kind of Bug, but they were devoured by my Bug in under ten seconds.

strings.text:
普通ならここで高笑いだが、この蟲に限って十秒は
かなり貴重な時間だ。
strings.translated: Normally I'd be laughing triumphantly right about now, but with this Bug, ten seconds was precious time.

strings.text:
次の蟲が放たれる前に、女に傷の一つも負わせたかっ
た。
strings.translated: I wanted to land at least one wound on the woman before she could release her next Bug.

strings.text: 残された時間は十秒弱。
女は、次の蟲筒を構えようとしたが――――
strings.translated: The woman moved to ready her next Bug tube -- but --

strings.text: オレの蟲が、女の右肩を掠めるように突っ込んだ。
strings.translated: My Bug drove into the woman's right shoulder in a grazing blow.

strings.text:
オレは、蟲をＵターンさせて再度攻撃しようと試みた
が、それより早く女の蟲が襲い掛かって来た。
strings.translated: I tried to turn my Bug around for another attack, but the woman's Bug came lunging at me even faster.

strings.text: 例の顎の尖った蟲が、オレの脇腹に食いついてくる。
strings.translated: That Bug with the pointed jaw bit into my side.

strings.text:
肉を抉られる痛みが走り抜けたが、もがいているよう
な暇はない。
strings.translated: A searing pain tore through me as it gouged into my flesh, but I had no time to struggle.

strings.text:
蟲を掴んで強引に引き剥がすと、力任せに宙に投げ捨
てた。
strings.translated: I grabbed the Bug and wrenched it off by force, then hurled it into the air.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ち、くしょうっ！　しまった…………」

strings.translated: The wound was far from shallow.

strings.text:
致命傷というほどじゃないが、すぐには血は止まりそ
うになかった。
strings.translated: Not quite a fatal wound, but the bleeding showed no sign of stopping anytime soon.

strings.text:
サユリ
「ここまでのようね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"Looks like this is the end for you."

strings.text:
自分の近くに蟲を引き戻した女が、冷めた口調で告げ
る。
strings.translated: The woman called her Bug back to her side and announced it in a cold, flat tone.

strings.text:
左右の手には一本ずつ蟲筒が握られていて、次でオレ
を殺すつもりなのは間違いない。
strings.translated: She held a Bug tube in each hand, and there was no doubt she intended to finish me off with the next strike.

strings.text:
対してオレは、切り札とも言える蟲を出してしまった
ため、これ以上は手の打ちようがなかった。
strings.translated: As for me -- I had already played what could be called my trump card, leaving me with no further moves to make.

strings.text:
せめて、逃げる時間だけでも稼げれば、話は変わって
くるのだが……。
strings.translated: If only I could buy enough time to escape, things might have turned out differently...

strings.text:
煉悟
（いや、その方法があるか）
strings.translated:
Rengo
(No -- wait. There's still one way.)

strings.text: 不意に、頭の中に浮かんだ手段。
strings.translated: A plan surfaced suddenly in my mind.

strings.text:
上手くいくかどうかは分からないが、考えている暇は
なかった。
strings.translated: Whether it would work or not, I had no time to think it over.

strings.text: 顎の尖った蟲が、三匹同時に突っ込んで来る――――
strings.translated: Three of those pointed-jaw Bugs came lunging at me simultaneously--------

strings.text:
――と、同時に、オレはある蟲を目の前に解き放ち、
女の蟲を迎え撃っていた。
strings.translated: -- At that same moment, I released a certain Bug right in front of me to intercept her Bugs.

strings.text:
一直線に襲って来た女の蟲を、突如出現した粘液状の
蟲が包み込む。
strings.translated: A viscous, mucus-like Bug suddenly appeared and enveloped the woman's Bugs as they charged in a straight line.

strings.text:
粘ついた己の肉を使って、三匹の蟲を捕獲しながら
地面に落ちた。
strings.translated: Using its own sticky flesh, it captured all three Bugs and dropped to the ground.

strings.text:
本来は、樹の上や地面の窪みなどに仕掛け、敵が掛か
るのを待つ蟲だ。
strings.translated: Normally, it's a Bug meant to be set as a trap -- laid in the branches of trees or hollows in the ground -- and left to wait for prey to stumble in.

strings.text:
粘着力が強いため、もしかしたらと思ったのだが、
どうやら上手くいったらしい。
strings.translated: I had a hunch its adhesive strength might do the trick, and it seemed I was right.

strings.text:
女の蟲はビクビクと悶えながら、粘液状の蟲に飲み込
まれていった。
strings.translated: The woman's Bugs writhed and convulsed as they were swallowed up by the mucus-like Bug.

strings.text:
サユリ
「そんなものまで持ってたのね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"So you were carrying something like that as well."

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、今日からだけどな」

サユリ
「……あなた、誰かから蟲をもらっているのね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"...Someone has been giving you Bugs."

strings.text:
煉悟
「そりゃあな……オレ一人で蟲を補充し続けるにゃ
　限界ってもんがあるからよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, yeah... there's a limit to how long I can keep restocking Bugs on my own."

strings.text:
煉悟
「強い蟲をもらう代わりに、こうして実験ってわけ
　だ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"In exchange for getting stronger Bugs, I run little experiments like this."

strings.text:
煉悟
「要するに、テメーみたいな蟲使いに、開発した蟲が
　どこまで通用するか見たいんだとよっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"In short, they want to see how far their developed Bugs can hold up against a Bug User like you!!"

strings.text: 撃ち出された蟲が宙を舞い、敵の蟲に牙を剥く。
strings.translated: The Bugs I fired flew through the air and bared their fangs at the enemy's Bugs.

strings.text:
その数はあっと言う間に十を超え、それでも尚、オレ
は蟲を撃ち続けた。
strings.translated: Their number surpassed ten in the blink of an eye, and still I kept firing.

strings.text:
これ以上、ちまちま一匹ずつ戦わせたところで意味は
ない。
strings.translated: There was no point in dragging this out one Bug at a time anymore.

strings.text: 女を倒すには、力ずくで圧しきる以外になかった。
strings.translated: To bring the woman down, I had no choice but to overwhelm her by sheer force.

strings.text:
多少の蟲の力の差はあったとしても、この方法なら
最後にモノを言うのは数だ。
strings.translated: Even if there were some difference in the Bugs' individual strength, with this method, what would matter in the end was numbers.

strings.text:
連続して撃ち出す分、蟲の動きは一直線と単純になる
が、それは女のほうも同じはずだった。
strings.translated: Firing them in rapid succession made the Bugs' movements simple and straightforward -- but the same should have been true for the woman.

strings.text:
サユリ
「く、うっ！　うううぅっ！！！」
何匹目かの蟲を放ったあと、女が蟲を撃つのを止めた。
strings.translated: After I fired off another Bug, the woman stopped shooting hers.

strings.text: いや、止めたんじゃない。
撃つだけの蟲がなくなった証拠だ。
strings.translated: It was proof that she had no more Bugs left to fire.

strings.text:
サユリ
「あああああああああっ！！！」

連発したオレの蟲の攻撃に、女が悲鳴を上げながら
地面へと倒れ込む。
strings.translated: Screaming under the barrage of my Bugs, the woman collapsed to the ground.

strings.text:
手数を増やした分、狙いなど殆ど定められなかったが、
効果としては十分だ。
strings.translated: With so many shots fired at once, I had barely been able to aim -- but the effect was more than enough.

strings.text:
オレは蟲を連発するのを止め、オレ自身が持っていた
蟲を撃ち出す。
strings.translated: I stopped firing the rapid barrage and launched the Bug I had been holding in reserve.

strings.text:
ダンゴムシのような形をしたそれが地面に現れ、触手
を伸ばして女の体に絡み付かせた。
strings.translated: It appeared on the ground in the shape of a pill bug, extending its tentacles to coil around the woman's body.

strings.text:
サユリ
「あ、ああっ！　く、うううぅぅっ！！」

右手と右脚を触手に巻き付かれ、呻くような声を漏ら
す。
strings.translated: Her right arm and right leg were bound in tentacles, and she let out a low, agonized groan.

strings.text:
まだ左側が自由だったが、それで何かができるわけ
じゃない。
strings.translated: Her left side was still free -- but there was nothing she could do with it.

strings.text: 事実上、これでオレの勝ちだった……。
strings.translated: In effect, this was my victory...

strings.text:
西から受け取った蟲の中で、もっとも素早い蟲を撃ち
出す。
strings.translated: From among the Bugs I had received from Nishi, I launched the fastest one.

strings.text:
対して女も同じようなタイプの蟲を飛ばし、暫くは
空中戦が展開された。
strings.translated: The woman countered by sending out a similar type of Bug, and for a time, an aerial battle unfolded between them.

strings.text:
サユリ
「前のときよりマシな蟲を使ってるようね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"You're using better Bugs than last time."

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、テメーのためにわざわざ用意してやったん
　だよっ！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Heh -- I went out of my way to prepare them just for you!"

strings.text: 女が、さらに二本の蟲筒を構える。
strings.translated: The woman raised two more Bug tubes.

strings.text: オレももう一本を構え、ほぼ同時に撃ち出した。
strings.translated: I raised another of my own, and we fired almost simultaneously.

strings.text:
蟲一匹ずつの力は拮抗しているようだが、同時に操れ
る数の上で、オレのほうが劣勢だ。
strings.translated: Each individual Bug seemed evenly matched in strength, but in terms of how many I could control at once, I was at a disadvantage.

strings.text:
一匹が殺られればすぐに次を補充するものの、次第に
蟲がぶつかり合う位置が近くなってくる。
strings.translated: Each time one of mine was killed I replenished it immediately, but gradually the point where our Bugs clashed was drawing closer and closer.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ちくしょうっ！　こうなったら――――――」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Damn it! If it comes to this -- "

strings.text: 蟲筒を取り出して、さらに一匹放つ。
strings.translated: I pulled out a Bug tube and released one more.

strings.text:
女が三匹同時で来る以上、オレもその方法を取らなけ
れば勝ち目はない。
strings.translated: Since the woman was coming at me with three at once, I had no chance of winning unless I did the same.

strings.text:
だが、蟲の数を増やした瞬間、明らかに一匹ずつの
動きが鈍った。
strings.translated: But the moment I increased my number of Bugs, each one's movements clearly slowed.

strings.text: 動きが鈍った瞬間、オレの蟲が三匹とも突き殺された。
strings.translated: The instant they slowed, all three of my Bugs were killed.

strings.text:
肉片がパラパラと地面に落ち、女の蟲の矛先がオレに
向けられる。
strings.translated: Scraps of flesh scattered to the ground, and the woman's Bugs turned their aim toward me.

strings.text:
サユリ
「慣れないことはするものではなかったわね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"You shouldn't have tried something you're not used to."

strings.text: 女の蟲が羽を広げて、オレに襲い掛かろうとしている。
strings.translated: The woman's Bugs spread their wings and were poised to lunge at me.

strings.text:
オレはすぐに次の蟲を放とうとしたが、同じ蟲を放っ
ていては結果は変わらない。
strings.translated: I tried to immediately launch my next Bug -- but sending out the same kind would not change the outcome.

strings.text:
反射的に取り出したのは、今までとは全く違う蟲だっ
た。
strings.translated: What I reflexively pulled out was a Bug entirely unlike any I had used before.

strings.text:
一直線に襲って来た女の蟲を、突如出現した粘液状の
蟲が包み込む。
strings.translated: A viscous, mucus-like Bug suddenly appeared and enveloped the woman's Bugs as they charged in a straight line.

strings.text:
粘ついた己の肉を使って、三匹の蟲を捕獲しながら
地面に落ちた。
strings.translated: Using its own sticky flesh, it captured all three Bugs and dropped to the ground.

strings.text:
本来は、樹の上や地面の窪みなどに仕掛け、敵が掛か
るのを待つ蟲だ。
strings.translated: Normally, it's a Bug meant to be set as a trap -- laid in the branches of trees or hollows in the ground -- and left to wait for prey to stumble in.

strings.text:
粘着力が強いため、もしかしたらと思ったのだが、
どうやら上手くいったらしい。
strings.translated: I had a hunch its adhesive strength might do the trick, and it seemed I was right.

strings.text:
女の蟲はビクビクと悶えながら、粘液状の蟲に飲み込
まれていった。
strings.translated: The woman's Bugs writhed and convulsed as they were swallowed up by the mucus-like Bug.

strings.text:
サユリ
「そんなものまで持ってたのね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"So you were carrying something like that as well."

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、今日からだけどな」

サユリ
「……あなた、誰かから蟲をもらっているのね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"...Someone has been giving you Bugs."

strings.text:
煉悟
「そりゃあな……オレ一人で蟲を補充し続けるにゃ
　限界ってもんがあるからよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, yeah... there's a limit to how long I can keep restocking Bugs on my own."

strings.text:
煉悟
「強い蟲をもらう代わりに、こうして実験ってわけ
　だ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"In exchange for getting stronger Bugs, I run little experiments like this."

strings.text:
煉悟
「要するに、テメーみたいな蟲使いに、開発した蟲が
　どこまで通用するか見たいんだとよっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"In short, they want to see how far their developed Bugs can hold up against a Bug User like you!!"

strings.text: 撃ち出された蟲が宙を舞い、敵の蟲に牙を剥く。
strings.translated: The Bugs I fired flew through the air and bared their fangs at the enemy's Bugs.

strings.text:
その数はあっと言う間に十を超え、それでも尚、オレ
は蟲を撃ち続けた。
strings.translated: Their number surpassed ten in the blink of an eye, and still I kept firing.

strings.text:
これ以上、ちまちま一匹ずつ戦わせたところで意味は
ない。
strings.translated: There was no point in dragging this out one Bug at a time anymore.

strings.text: 女を倒すには、力ずくで圧しきる以外になかった。
strings.translated: To bring the woman down, I had no choice but to overwhelm her by sheer force.

strings.text:
多少の蟲の力の差はあったとしても、この方法なら
最後にモノを言うのは数だ。
strings.translated: Even if there were some difference in the Bugs' individual strength, with this method, what would matter in the end was numbers.

strings.text:
連続して撃ち出す分、蟲の動きは一直線と単純になる
が、それは女のほうも同じはずだった。
strings.translated: Firing them in rapid succession made the Bugs' movements simple and straightforward -- but the same should have been true for the woman.

strings.text:
サユリ
「やっぱり素人ね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"An amateur, just as I thought."

strings.text:
背中に鋭い痛みを受けて、オレは次に撃ち出そうとし
ていた蟲筒を取りこぼした。
strings.translated: A sharp pain struck me in the back, and I fumbled and dropped the Bug tube I had been about to fire next.

strings.text: 背中に突っ込んで来たのは蟲の気配。
strings.translated: Something had slammed into my back -- and I could sense it was a Bug.

strings.text:
仰向けになって地面に倒れ込むと、それより一瞬早く
蟲が飛び去った気配がした。
strings.translated: As I fell backward onto the ground, I sensed the Bug dart away a split second before I landed.

strings.text:
致命傷というほど深くはないが、体を動かそうとする
と背中が痛む。
strings.translated: Not deep enough to be fatal, but my back screamed with pain whenever I tried to move.

strings.text:
どうにかうつ伏せになって女を見たが、その時には
もうオレの蟲は全て食い尽くされていた。
strings.translated: I somehow managed to roll face-down and look up at the woman -- by then, every last one of my Bugs had been devoured.

strings.text:
サユリ
「馬鹿みたいに一直線に蟲を放つだけ……。
　しっかりと訓練を受けた蟲使いなら、まずやらない
　方法ね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"Just blindly firing Bugs in a straight line... That's something no properly trained Bug User would ever do."

strings.text:
サユリ
「撃ち出す蟲は、自分が的確に命令を与えられる数ま
　で……」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"The number of Bugs you release should never exceed what you can give precise commands to..."

strings.text:
サユリ
「これは、蟲使いの戦いにおいて基本中の基本よ」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"This is the most fundamental rule of Bug User combat."

strings.text:
呆れたような瞳で見下ろしてくる女に、オレは睨み付
けるような視線を送った。
strings.translated: I shot a glare up at the woman as she looked down at me with eyes full of exasperation.

strings.text: ――このまま死んでたまるかっ！
両手を地面について、痛みを堪えながら体を起こす。
strings.translated: I pressed both hands against the ground and forced my body upright, enduring the pain.

strings.text:
起こしたあと、どうするかは決めてなかったが、寝た
ままでいるわけにはいかなかった。
strings.translated: I had no plan for what to do once I was up -- but I couldn't just lie there.

strings.text:
だが、そんなオレに、女は冷たい眼差しを送りながら
蟲筒を向ける。
strings.translated:
But even as I struggled to my feet, the woman fixed me with a cold stare
and leveled her Bug tube at me.

strings.text:
サユリ
「今度こそ終わりよ」

煉悟
「さぁて、どうしてやろうか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Now then... what should I do with you?"

strings.text:
右腕と右脚を捕らえた女を見下ろしながら、オレは
ニヤニヤと口元を緩めて見せた。
strings.translated: I looked down at the woman whose right arm and right leg I had caught, and let a grin spread across my face.

strings.text:
同じ蟲使い、しかもレベルが上の相手を捕らえた喜び
は、言葉では言い表せないものがある。
strings.translated: The joy of capturing a fellow Bug User -- one even higher-ranked than me -- was something words couldn't quite express.

strings.text: 頭の中は、女をどう犯すかだけを考えていた。
strings.translated: My mind was filled with nothing but thoughts of how I would violate her.

strings.text:
サユリ
「惜しかったわね」
不意に、女がこんな言葉を吐く。
strings.translated: Suddenly, the woman let those words slip from her lips.

strings.text:
サユリ
「認めるわ。本当に危ないところだった」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"I'll admit it. That was truly close."

strings.text:
サユリ
「たとえば、そう……この戦い以前に、蟲を減らされ
　るようなことになっていたら危なかった」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"For instance... yes... if I had lost any more Bugs before this fight, it would have been dangerous."

strings.text:
煉悟
「テメェ……なに言ってやがる？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"What the hell are you talking about...?"

strings.text:
サユリ
「残りは四匹……本当にギリギリだった…………」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"Only four left... it really was right on the edge..."

strings.text: 突然、オレの背中を激痛が走り抜けた。
strings.translated: Suddenly, a searing pain tore through my back.

strings.text:
それと同時に、どこからともなく飛んできた蟲が、
女に絡み付いていた触手を切断する。
strings.translated: At the same moment, a Bug that had come flying from nowhere severed the tentacles that had been wrapped around the woman.

strings.text: 女の左手には――いつの間にか蟲筒が握られていた。
strings.translated: In the woman's left hand -- without my even noticing -- a Bug tube was now gripped tight.

strings.text:
サユリ
「でも、一番救われたのは、あなたのその性格かもし
　れないわね」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"But what really saved me might have been that personality of yours."

strings.text:
煉悟
「がああああああああああっ！！！！」
全身を切り裂かれ、仰向けになって倒れる。
strings.translated: My entire body was slashed open, and I collapsed onto my back.

strings.text:
背中にいた蟲は一瞬早く逃げ出し、女のもとへと戻っ
て行った。
strings.translated: The Bug that had been on my back escaped a split second earlier and returned to the woman's side.

strings.text: 女がゆらりと立ち上がり、衣服についた汚れを払う。
strings.translated: The woman rose slowly to her feet and brushed the dirt from her clothes.

strings.text:
地面に倒れ込んだオレに蟲筒を向けると、ひどく冷淡
な声で告げた。
strings.translated: She leveled her Bug tube at me as I lay crumpled on the ground, and spoke in a terribly cold voice.

strings.text:
サユリ
「最後の最後で油断したあなたの負けよ」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"You let your guard down at the very last moment. That's why you lost."

strings.text:
疲れ切っているはずなのに、オレは不意に目を覚まし
た。
strings.translated: Exhausted as I should have been, I suddenly found myself wide awake.

strings.text:
まだ、体のあちこちが痛むが、頭の中は妙にスッキリ
している。
strings.translated: My body still ached all over, but my head felt strangely clear.

strings.text:
それとも、これはまだ戦闘時の興奮が続いているとい
う事なのか……。
strings.translated: Or perhaps... this was simply the lingering excitement from the battle still running through me...

strings.text: 外の様子を窺うと、もう夜は明けているようだった。

"Oh, a Bug User nobody knows about in the open world can still be fairly well known once you look behind the scenes."

言ってのける。
strings.translated: Nishi said it casually, without any hint of boasting about his information network.

が、ソイツ等と接触するのが一苦労のはずだ。
strings.translated: Bug Users' existence -- sure, those who know, know, but making contact with them should be no small feat.

取ってきたのは、やはり西だった。
strings.translated: And yet, it was Nishi who had reached out to me immediately after I parted ways with the clan.

strings.text:

らく間違いないだろう。

西

　今後の準備を整えたほうが良いようだ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"In any case, it would be wise to assume the male Bug User is the stronger one and make your preparations accordingly."

strings.text:
煉悟
「そこんところは同感だな」

西
「今回の件は私の責任だ。
　協力できる事があればいつでも連絡してくれ」

"This matter is my responsibility.
 Contact me anytime if there's something I can help with."

られない。

西
「――と、その件でひとつ思い出した」
strings.translated:

"-- Oh, speaking of which, I just remembered something."

strings.text:
煉悟
「あン？　三十秒しか使えねぇあの蟲か？」

"Huh? That Bug that could only be used for thirty seconds?"

西

strings.text:
西
「それでも良ければ、こちらまで受け取りに来てく
　れ」

strings.text:
それはいい、と思った一方で、タイミングが良すぎる、
と思いもした。

確かにあの蟲が一分近く使用できるのなら、戦力とし
ては申し分ない。

strings.text:
煉悟
「……考えても無意味か」

西
「うん？　何か言ったかね？」
今ここで、ウジウジと可能性だけを考えても仕方ない。
strings.translated: There was no use sitting here brooding over mere possibilities.

strings.text: 世の中、なるようにしかならないのだから……。
strings.translated: The world goes the way it goes, no matter what...

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、気が向いたら取りに行ってやる」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, I'll come pick it up if I feel like it."

strings.text: 何となく冷めた口調で言って、オレは電話を切った。

「今は戦力の補強が先、か」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"For now, reinforcing my strength comes first."

strings.text:
これからどんな奴が来るにしても、今は戦える状況
じゃない。
strings.translated: Whoever ends up coming, I'm in no condition to fight right now.

先決だった……。
strings.translated: To get back on my feet, the first order of business was to make the girl birth some Bugs......

オレの携帯電話に西から連絡があったのは、その日の

strings.translated: It was that afternoon when Nishi contacted me on my cell phone.

strings.text:
何の用かと思いきや、ちょうどオレが直面している
問題の話だった。
strings.translated: I wondered what he wanted -- as it turned out, it was about the very problem I was currently facing.

strings.text:

strings.translated:
Nishi
"From what I've looked into on my end, it seems another male Bug User is heading this way."

strings.text:
西
「確実な情報ではない」

西
「ただ、厄介な仕事のとき、男女一組となって行動す
　ることがあったようだ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"However, it appears that on difficult jobs, they would sometimes operate as a male-female pair."

strings.text:
西
「その際は、女性のほうがサポート役に徹していたと
　いう話もある」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"There are also accounts that the woman played a strictly supporting role in those instances."

strings.text:
煉悟
「よくもまぁ、そんな情報を仕入れられるもんだな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I'm impressed you can dig up information like that."

「くれぐれも扱いには注意してくれたまえ」

"Handle them with the utmost care, if you would."

strings.text: 夕方近くになってから、オレは西の屋敷を訪れていた。
strings.translated: Toward evening, I paid a visit to Nishi's estate.

strings.text:
この話を受けるかどうかは迷ったのだが、今は戦力を
整えるのが先決だと判断したがゆえの行動だ。
strings.translated: I had hesitated over whether to accept this offer, but I decided that getting my strength in order took priority -- and so here I was.

strings.text:
例の『一分だけ活動できる蟲』は、合計で三匹作られ
ていた。
strings.translated: Nishi had made three of those so-called "Bugs that can only act for one minute" in total.

strings.text:
オレ自身は一匹だけと思っていただけに、これは嬉し
い誤算だ。
strings.translated: I had assumed there was only one, so this was a welcome surprise.

strings.text:
西
「一匹ずつなら構わないが、三匹同時にコントロール
　するのは避けたほうが良さそうだ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"One at a time is fine, but I'd advise against trying to control all three
 simultaneously."

strings.text:
西
「どうも主との同調を嫌がる傾向があってね、下手を
　すれば逆に蟲に襲われかねない」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"They seem to have a tendency to resist synchronizing with their master -- handle it poorly
 and you might find yourself on the receiving end of their attack."

strings.text:
煉悟
「まるで、実際にそういう事がありました、と言わん
　ばかりの口調だな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"You say that almost as if something like that has actually happened before."

strings.text:
かなり核心に近い部分を突付いてみたつもりだが、
西はさらりとかわす。
strings.translated:
I thought I'd prodded fairly close to the heart of the matter,
but Nishi brushed it off without missing a beat.

strings.text:
まあ、別に誰とどんな実験してようと、オレの知った
事じゃないんだが…………。
strings.translated: Well, it's none of my business who he's been running experiments with or what kind..........

strings.text:
煉悟
「ともかく、コイツは使わせてもらうぜ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Regardless, I'll be taking these off your hands."

strings.text:
目の前に並べられた三本の蟲筒を回収して、オレは
西の屋敷を後にした……。
strings.translated: I collected the three Bug tubes lined up before me and took my leave of Nishi's estate......

strings.text:
夢美
「ハッ……ハッ……ハッ……ハッ……ハッ…………」

夜になって隣の部屋を覗いてみると、ベッドの上で
小娘が荒い息を吐いていた。
strings.translated:
When night fell and I peered into the next room, the girl was lying on the bed,
breathing in ragged gasps.

strings.text:
腹はだいぶ膨らんでいて、これならあと数日のうちに
産まれるだろう。
strings.translated:
Her belly had swollen considerably -- at this rate,
it would be born within the next few days.

strings.text:
食事のほうも――スナック菓子とジュースの空き缶が
床に転がっている事からして、一応摂取はしているら
しい。
strings.translated:
As for food -- judging by the empty snack wrappers and juice cans
rolling around on the floor, she had at least been eating.

strings.text:
思ったよりも根性のある苗床に、オレはそれなりに
満足だった。
strings.translated:
I was reasonably satisfied with the Seedbed,
who had more backbone than I'd expected.

strings.text:
気のせいか、一瞬だけ小娘の腹がぐにゃっと動いた気
がした。
strings.translated:
Maybe it was my imagination, but for just a moment,
it looked like the girl's belly had twisted and writhed.

strings.text:
目を凝らして確認してみるが、二度目の確認はできな
い。
strings.translated:
I strained my eyes to confirm it,
but I couldn't catch it a second time.

strings.text:
単なる見間違いだったのかもしれないが、それにして
は大きく波打ったような動きに見えたのだが……。
strings.translated:
It may have simply been a trick of the eye, but even so,
the movement had looked like a large, rippling wave......

strings.text: ずっと考えていても仕方ない。
strings.translated: There was no point dwelling on it.

strings.text:
それよりも、室内に充満する排泄物やら何やらの臭い
があまりに酷く、これ以上居るのは限界だった。
strings.translated:
More pressing was the stench of waste and god-knows-what-else
filling the room -- it had grown unbearable, and I'd reached my limit.

strings.text:
オレはさっさと部屋を出ると、臭いが漏れないように
しっかりと部屋の扉を閉めた……。
strings.translated:
I left the room without delay and shut the door firmly behind me,
sealing the smell inside......

strings.text:
サユリ
「はうぅぅ……く、ふぅっ……うううぅぅぅっ！」
仄暗い部屋の中に、苦しげな呻き声が聞こえる。
strings.translated: From within the dimly lit room came the sound of agonized moaning.

strings.text:
手足を拘束具で固められた女性――サユリが歯を食い
縛りながら身悶えしている。
strings.translated:
A woman with her limbs bound in restraints -- Sayuri -- was writhing,
her teeth clenched tight.

strings.text: 蟲の毒――正確には媚薬を注入してから約十時間。
strings.translated: Approximately ten hours had passed since the Bug's venom -- an aphrodisiac, to be precise -- had been injected.

strings.text:
どの程度効果があるかは不明だったが、結果だけを
見れば煉悟の想像以上だった。
strings.translated:
How effective it would be had been unknown, but judging by the results alone,
it had exceeded even Rengo's expectations.

strings.text:
煉悟
「だいぶクスリがキマって来たみたいだなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Looks like the drug's really starting to kick in, huh."

strings.text:
部屋に入ってきた煉悟を見て、サユリがまぶたを細め
る。
strings.translated: Sayuri narrowed her eyes as she watched Rengo enter the room.

strings.text: 表情に映るのは怒りと戸惑いの色。
strings.translated: Her expression was painted with anger and confusion.

strings.text:
敵意は衰えていないが、欲情した雰囲気もしっかりと
伝わってくる。
strings.translated: Her hostility had not waned, but the heat of arousal came through just as clearly.

strings.text:
全身には汗の玉が浮かび上がり、秘裂から滴るのは
肌が蕩けるような愛液だった。
strings.translated:
Beads of sweat rose across her entire body, and dripping from her slit
was a slick, skin-melting flow of arousal.

strings.text: ぐっしょりと濡れた陰毛に、煉悟の手が伸び――――
strings.translated: Rengo's hand reached toward her soaking wet pubic hair ----
-- and plucked out a single strand.

strings.text:
煉悟
「さぁて、どうする？　オレとしては、今日はさっさ

Rengo
"So then, what'll it be? Personally, I wouldn't mind

strings.text:
潤んだ瞳からは涙が零れ、口は金魚のようにパクパク
と動かしていた。
strings.translated:
Tears spilled from her glistening eyes, and her mouth moved
open and shut like a goldfish gasping for air.

strings.text:
まだ完全に堕ちたわけではないが、それもそう遠くは
ないだろう。
strings.translated: She hadn't completely broken yet, but that point wasn't far off.

strings.text:

なかった。
strings.translated:
Rengo wasn't the type to rely on tricks when it came to women,
but he had never disliked watching a woman endure against pleasure.

「頼み事があるなら言ってみろよ」
strings.translated:

"If you've got something to ask of me, go ahead and say it."

strings.text:

「オレの気分次第じゃ、聞いてやらねぇ事もないぜ」

"Depending on my mood, I might just hear you out."

strings.text:

目をつり上げる。

strings.text:
