て何か抵抗していないと、心が折れてしまいそうだっ
た。
strings.translated:
Glaring wouldn't improve her situation, but if she didn't at least put up some resistance,
she felt her spirit might shatter entirely.

strings.text:
サユリ
「余計な……お世話、よ……」

煉悟
「そうかい。その割にゃ、顔が赤いんだがなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Is that so. Your face is pretty red for someone who says that."

strings.text:
サユリ
「そんな、こと……ないわ…………」

せせら笑う煉悟に、サユリはあえて真っ直ぐな怒りを
ぶつける。
strings.translated: Sayuri hurled her anger at Rengo as he sneered at her -- blunt and unguarded.

strings.text:
それが相手を楽しませるだけだと分かっていても、
物静かに耐えるだけの余裕はなくなっていた。
strings.translated:
Even knowing it only amused him, she no longer had the composure
to endure in quiet stillness.

strings.text:
下腹部の疼きはとっくに限界を超えており、手が自由
ならば自慰に浸っていてもおかしくない。
strings.translated:
The ache in her lower abdomen had long since surpassed its limit;
had her hands been free, it would not have been strange for her to have given in to self-pleasure.

strings.text:
今は蟲使い故の強靭な精神力で耐えているが、それも
壊れるのは時間の問題だった。
strings.translated:
For now, the iron willpower that came with being a Bug User was holding her together,
but it was only a matter of time before that too would crumble.

strings.text:
サユリ
「この、程度、で……私、を……堕とす、ことは……
　できない……わよ…………」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"You... won't be able... to break me... with something
 like this..............."

strings.text: それでも負けるわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: Even so, she could not afford to lose.

strings.text:
たとえ嘘だと見抜かれていても、サユリは蟲使いの
誇りを張り続けるしかなかった。
strings.translated:
Even if the lie was seen through, Sayuri had no choice but to keep holding up
the pride of a Bug User.

strings.text:
そうする事で、自らの内で暴れる欲望を抑え付けるし
かなかった。
strings.translated: It was the only way to keep the desire raging within her suppressed.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、腐っても蟲使いか。
　この手の毒は効きませんってかァ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Khi, still a Bug User through and through, huh.
 Saying this kind of poison won't work on you?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「そんじゃあ……もう一発くれてやるよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well then...... let me give you another dose."

strings.text:
サユリがギョッとした瞬間、煉悟の手のひらから一匹
の蟲が飛んだ。
strings.translated: The moment Sayuri flinched, a single Bug flew from Rengo's palm.

strings.text:
それは音もなくサユリの背後に回り、首筋に微かな
痛みを感じさせる。
strings.translated: It circled silently behind her, leaving a faint sting at the nape of her neck.

strings.text:
煉悟
「コイツは一発目よりちょいと強いぜぇ。
　いつまで耐えられるかなァ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"This one's a little stronger than the first.
 How long can you hold out, I wonder?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「ハッ、考え直すなら今のうちだぜ？
　無様な姿を晒したかねぇだろォ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Hah, better reconsider while you still can.
 You don't wanna make a fool of yourself, do ya?"

strings.text:
煉悟の挑発に、サユリが一瞬だけ不安そうな表情を
浮かべる。
strings.translated: At Rengo's taunt, Sayuri's expression flickered with a moment of unease.

strings.text:
蟲の持つ毒が如何に恐ろしいか、それをよく知ってい
るからだ。
strings.translated: She knew all too well just how terrifying the venom carried by Bugs could be.

strings.text: 強がりや気合で、どうにかなるようなものではない。
strings.translated: Sheer stubbornness and willpower were not enough to overcome it.

strings.text:
人を狂わせる毒なら狂わせるし、殺す毒なら必ず殺す
のだ。
strings.translated: A venom that drives people mad will drive them mad; a venom that kills will always kill.

strings.text:
修行で多少の抵抗力は備えているとしても、解毒され
ない以上、蟲使いと言えども毒に堕ちるのは当然の話
だった。
strings.translated: Even if training had given her some degree of resistance, without an antidote, even a Bug User succumbing to the poison was only natural.

strings.text:
サユリ
「貴方の蟲の毒なんて、どの程度効果があるのか疑問
　だわ」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"I have to wonder just how effective your Bug's venom actually is."

strings.text:
軽く鼻で笑って、サユリは口元に笑みを浮かべて見せ
た。
strings.translated: With a light scoff, Sayuri let a smile play at the corner of her lips.

strings.text: 今、できる限りの、最大にして最後の抵抗。
strings.translated: The greatest -- and final -- act of defiance she could manage right now.

strings.text:
煉悟もそれが分かっているのか、何度か頷いたあと
いきなりサユリの股間に手を伸ばした。
strings.translated: As if sensing that, Rengo gave a few nods, then suddenly reached his hand between Sayuri's legs.

strings.text:
煉悟
「いずれたっぷりと後悔させてやるぜぇ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I'll make you regret that plenty, sooner or later."

strings.text: サユリの陰核を摘みながら、煉悟がニヤニヤと笑う。
strings.translated: Rengo grinned as he pinched Sayuri's clitoris.

strings.text:
どんなに抵抗されたところで、しょせんは結果の見え
ている勝負だ。
strings.translated: No matter how much she resisted, the outcome of this contest was already decided.

strings.text:
自分を殺しに掛かってきた相手が無様に喘ぐ姿ほど、
見ていて爽快なものはなかった……。
strings.translated: Nothing was more satisfying than watching someone who had come to kill you writhe in shameless desperation...

strings.text:
食い物以外のものを買ったのは、果たして何ヶ月ぶり
だったのか……。
strings.translated: How many months had it been since I'd bought something other than food...

strings.text: 今、人気があるらしいサイクロン式の掃除機。
strings.translated: A cyclone vacuum cleaner that was apparently popular right now.

strings.text: 箱には『超強力』とか書かれている脱臭剤。
strings.translated: A deodorizer whose box was plastered with the words "Ultra Powerful."

strings.text: 雑巾数枚と軟質塩化ビニールのホース等々…………。
strings.translated: A few rags, some soft PVC hose, and so on...

strings.text:
ユーリア
「以上でよろしかったでしょうか」

待ち合わせの場所に行くと、必要な物を買い揃えた
ユーリアが立っていた。
strings.translated: When I arrived at the meeting spot, Yulia was already there, having bought everything on the list.

strings.text:
表情は相変わらず無いに等しいが、どことなく迷惑そ
うな雰囲気も伝わってくる。
strings.translated: Her expression was as blank as ever, but somehow an air of mild annoyance came through all the same.

strings.text:
まあ、要するに自分で買い物をするのが面倒で、西に
状況の説明、及び必要な物品の購入を頼み、こうなっ
たというわけだ。
strings.translated: In short, I had found shopping too much of a hassle, so I had asked Nishi to handle the explanation and procurement -- and this was the result.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「それでは、失礼します」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Well then, I'll take my leave."

strings.text:
煉悟
「もう帰るのか？　ジュースの一本くらい奢るぜ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Heading back already? I could at least spring for a juice or something."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「いえ、戻ってから仕事がありますので」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"No, I have work to get back to."

strings.text:
予想通りの回答をして、ユーリアが人ごみの中に消え
ていく。
strings.translated: Giving exactly the answer I had expected, Yulia disappeared into the crowd.

strings.text:
オレも本気で誘おうと思ったわけじゃないが、いつか
あの冷たい表情を壊してやろうとか、少しだけ考えて
しまったりする。
strings.translated: It wasn't as though I had genuinely meant the invitation, but I found myself thinking, just a little, that someday I'd like to crack that cold expression of hers.

strings.text:
まあ、西と敵対関係にでもならない限り、そんな日が
来るとは思えないのだが……。
strings.translated: Though I couldn't imagine that day ever coming, unless Nishi and I ended up on opposite sides...

strings.text:
ユーリアが買ってきた荷物は、それなりに重量があっ
た。
strings.translated: The bags Yulia had brought were considerable in weight.

strings.text:
本当なら誰かに持たせて帰りたいところだが、隠れ家
まで運ばせるわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: Ideally I would have had someone carry them for me, but I couldn't let anyone haul them all the way to the hideout.

strings.text: あの場所は、今のところ西にさえ明かしていないのだ。
strings.translated: That place hadn't been disclosed to Nishi yet, let alone anyone else.

strings.text: ……ま、アイツなら調べて知ってそうではあるが。
strings.translated: Well, knowing him, he'd probably already looked it up.

strings.text:
煉悟
「オレはこのまま帰るとして……蟲のほうをどうする
　か……」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I'll head straight back from here... but what to do about the Bugs..."

strings.text:
せっかく外に出たのだから、少し寄り道をするのも
悪くない。
strings.translated: Since I had gone to the trouble of coming outside, a small detour wouldn't hurt.

strings.text:
敵の攻撃に対して、常に周囲に気を配っておく必要は
あるが、餌を与えるなら今のうちという考え方もある。
strings.translated: I needed to stay alert to enemy attacks at all times, but there was also the argument that now was the best time to feed them.

strings.text:
煉悟
「帰りながら考えるか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I'll figure it out on the way back."

strings.text:
箱詰めにされた掃除機を持ち直して、オレは隠れ家へ
の帰路に着いた……。
strings.translated: Readjusting my grip on the boxed vacuum cleaner, I set off on the road back to the hideout...

strings.text:
煉悟
「ここらへんでいいか」

倉庫へと戻る途中、オレは蟲どもに餌を食わせるため
川辺にやって来ていた。
strings.translated: On the way back to the warehouse, I had stopped by the riverside to feed the Bugs.

strings.text:
本当にもう一人蟲使いが来ているなら、いつ襲われて
もおかしくはない。
strings.translated: If another Bug User really had arrived, there was no telling when an attack might come.

strings.text:
食わせられる時に食わせてねぇと、いざって時に蟲が
使い物にならなくなるからな。
strings.translated: If I didn't feed them when I had the chance, the Bugs would be useless when it actually mattered.

strings.text:
煉悟
「よぅし、たらふく食って来い」
掛け声とともに蟲どもを解放する。
strings.translated: With that call, I released the Bugs.

strings.text:
オレの上着の内側から、喜び勇んだようにダンゴムシ
のような蟲が這い出してきて、辺りに散っていった。
strings.translated: From inside my jacket, the pill bug-like Bugs crawled out with what seemed like eager delight, scattering in all directions.

strings.text: これで暫くの間、オレは無防備というわけだ。
strings.translated: For the time being, I was completely defenseless.

strings.text:
今のところ周囲に人の気配はないが、油断しないに
越したことはないだろう。
strings.translated: There was no sign of anyone nearby at the moment, but it wouldn't do to let my guard down.

strings.text:
木陰に移動して荷物を置くと、オレは息を殺すように
して蟲が戻るのを待ち続けた……。
strings.translated: Moving into the shade of a tree and setting down my things, I held my breath and waited for the Bugs to return...

strings.text:
煉悟
「ひぃ、ふぅ、みぃ…………よし、全部いるな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"One, two, three... good, they're all here."

strings.text:
戻って来た蟲の数を確認して、オレは無意識のうちに
安堵の息を漏らしていた。
strings.translated: Confirming the number of Bugs that had returned, I let out a breath of relief without even thinking.

strings.text:
次の敵を恐れてるわけじゃないが、何も起こらないに
越したことはない。
strings.translated: It wasn't that I feared the next enemy -- it was simply better if nothing happened at all.

strings.text:
蟲どもも十二分に栄養を得たらしく、中には昆虫を
食いながら戻ってきた奴もいた。
strings.translated: The Bugs seemed to have fed more than enough; some had even come back still eating insects.

strings.text:
煉悟
「オラ、さっさと食っちまえよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Come on, finish that off already."

strings.text:
他の蟲どもを服の中に収納しながら、呆れたように声
を漏らす。
strings.translated: I muttered in exasperation as I tucked the other Bugs back inside my clothes.

strings.text:
どれも同じような形をしている奴等だが、そこには
やはり若干の個性というものが存在していた。
strings.translated: They all looked more or less the same, yet each one did seem to have its own slight individuality.

strings.text:
蟲を回収しているとき、その中の一匹が全く動かない
ことに気付いた。
strings.translated: While collecting the Bugs, I noticed that one of them wasn't moving at all.

strings.text:
戻って来いという命令は下しているのだが、何故だか
それに従おうとしない。
strings.translated: I had issued the command to return, but for some reason it refused to comply.

strings.text:
最初は何らかの理由があって命令が届いてないのかと
思ったが、やがて蟲の胴体にある変化が見られるよう
になっていった。
strings.translated: At first I thought the order simply wasn't reaching it for some reason, but before long a strange change began to appear in the Bug's body.

strings.text: 蟲の胴体が、異様なスピードで痙攣を始める。
strings.translated: The Bug's body began convulsing at an alarming speed.

strings.text:
いや、痙攣と言うよりも、蟲の内側で何かが暴れてい
るような動きだった。
strings.translated: No -- it was less like convulsing and more like something was thrashing around inside the Bug.

strings.text: その事に気付き、一歩足を引いた瞬間――――
strings.translated: The moment I noticed this and took a step back ----

strings.text:
蟲が破裂するや否や、その内側から蜂のような蟲が
飛び出した。
strings.translated: The Bug burst apart, and from within it a wasp-like Bug came flying out.

strings.text: もちろん、オレの蟲じゃない。
strings.translated: Needless to say, it wasn't one of mine.

strings.text:
すぐさま逃げようとしたが、それより早く蟲の尻針が
オレの顔へと向けて放たれた。
strings.translated: I tried to flee immediately, but the Bug's stinger was already aimed at my face and fired before I could.

strings.text: 撃ち出された針が、オレの左胸に突き刺さる。
strings.translated: The launched stinger drove itself into my left chest.

strings.text:
幸いにして服の内側に忍ばせていた蟲が盾になったが、
そんな幸運が何度も続くわけがない。
strings.translated: Fortunately, a Bug I had hidden inside my clothes acted as a shield -- but there was no way that kind of luck would hold more than once.

strings.text:
オレは、この時点でようやく自分の蟲を解き放ち、
敵の蟲への攻撃を命令した。
strings.translated: Only at that point did I finally release my own Bugs and order them to attack the enemy Bug.

strings.text: 敵の蟲は、簡単に仕留めることができた。
strings.translated: The enemy Bug was easy enough to finish off.

strings.text:
オレの服から這い出た蟲の触手で、簡単にひねり潰す
ことができた。
strings.translated: The tentacles of the Bugs that crawled out from my clothes made short work of it, crushing it with ease.

strings.text: 蟲そのものの能力は、大して強くなかったらしい。
strings.translated: The Bug itself didn't seem to have much raw power.

strings.text:
オレの盾になり針を受けた蟲が、ビクビクと全身を
痙攣させていた。
strings.translated: The Bug that had shielded me and taken the stinger was convulsing violently all over its body.

strings.text:
どうやら毒が仕込まれていたようで、脚の一本も動か
すことができないらしい。
strings.translated: It appeared the stinger had been laced with poison -- the Bug couldn't move a single leg.

strings.text:
もしも、その毒針をオレ自身が受けていたとしたら、
今頃地面を這いつくばっていただろう。
strings.translated: If I had taken that poisoned stinger myself, I'd probably be writhing on the ground right now.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ちくしょう。本当にもう一人いやがった」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Damn it. There really was another one."

strings.text: ギリッと奥歯を噛んで、森の奥を睨み付ける。
strings.translated: I ground my back teeth and glared into the depths of the forest.

strings.text:
敵の蟲の一匹がたまたまこの森にいたのか、それとも
術者本人もこの近くにいるのか。
strings.translated: Had one of the enemy's Bugs simply happened to be in this forest, or was the Bug User themselves somewhere nearby?

strings.text: どちらにしても、この場所に長居する必要はない。
strings.translated: Either way, there was no reason to linger here.

strings.text:
オレは辺りを警戒しながら、できるだけ急いで倉庫へ
と戻ることにした……。
strings.translated: Staying alert to my surroundings, I made my way back to the warehouse as quickly as I could...

strings.text:
夢美
「あ、ぐっ……ぎいぃぃぃぃっ！！」
薄暗い倉庫の一室で、少女が苦悶の声を上げていた。
strings.translated: In a dim room of the warehouse, a girl was crying out in agony.

strings.text:
ベッドの上で仰向けになり、風船のように膨らんだ
腹を痙攣させている。
strings.translated: She lay on her back on the bed, her belly swollen like a balloon, convulsing.

strings.text: この数日間、少女はそれ以外の感覚を得ていない。
strings.translated: For the past several days, those were the only sensations the girl had known.

strings.text:
さすがに動くことができなくなったため、食事は男が
運んでくれるが、糞尿は股座に垂れ流し状態だった。
strings.translated: She had become unable to move, so the man brought her meals -- but she was left to soil herself where she lay.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぎゃっ！？　あぐ、おっ、おおおぉぉぉーーーー
　ーーーーーーっ！！！！」
腹の中で、卵の位置が時々変わる。
strings.translated: Inside her belly, the position of the eggs shifted from time to time.

strings.text:
卵そのものが膨張しているようで、結果として位置が
ズレてしまうらしい。
strings.translated:
It seemed the eggs themselves were expanding, which caused their position to
shift as a result.

strings.text:
その際、少女の肉体にかかる苦痛は想像を絶するもの
で、常に吐き気さえ催すほどだった。
strings.translated:
The pain inflicted on the girl's body during those moments was beyond imagination,
constantly enough to make her feel sick.

strings.text: 頭の中で、そんなことを考える。
strings.translated: That thought drifted through her mind.

strings.text:
そして、どうして自分が両親と一緒に死ぬことができ
なかったのか、そのことばかりを考える。
strings.translated:
And she kept thinking about why she hadn't been able to die
along with her parents.

strings.text:
死んでいれば、きっとこんな苦しい思いはしなかった
のにと、絶えることなく涙を流し続けた。
strings.translated:
If only she had died, she surely wouldn't have had to suffer like this --
and so she wept without end.

strings.text:
久しぶりに発した『言葉』は、誰にも届くことなく
消えた……。
strings.translated:
The "words" she had spoken for the first time in so long
vanished without reaching anyone......

strings.text:
黒ずんだ天井を視界に収めながら、オレは気分の悪い
目覚めを迎えていた。
strings.translated:
Staring up at the blackened ceiling, I was waking up
in a foul mood.

strings.text:
ソファーの上でまぶたは開けたものの、そこから動こ
うという気になれない。
strings.translated:
My eyes had opened on the sofa, but I couldn't bring myself
to move from there.

strings.text:
昨夜のことを引きずっているようで、妙に体が重たく
感じられた。
strings.translated:
It seemed I was still dragging last night with me -- my body felt
strangely heavy.

strings.text:
今のところまるで手掛かりはないが、このまま放って
おくわけにはいかない。
strings.translated:
I had no leads whatsoever at the moment, but I couldn't just
leave things as they were.

strings.text:
次の相手がどんな奴なのか、一秒でも早く情報を入手
する必要があった。
strings.translated:
I needed to get information on whoever my next opponent was
as fast as possible.

strings.text:
煉悟
「……っても、どうやって入手したもんか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"...easier said than done, though. How the hell am I supposed to get any?"

strings.text: 今のところ、確かな情報源があるわけじゃない。
strings.translated: It wasn't like I had any reliable sources of information right now.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、なるようになるか」
テーブルに手を伸ばして、食べかけのパンを口に運ぶ。
strings.translated: I reached across the table and brought a half-eaten piece of bread to my mouth.

strings.text:
食感はパサついててお世辞にもウマイとは言えなかっ
たが、とりあえず腹に入ればそれでいい。
strings.translated:
The texture was dry and stale -- I couldn't honestly call it good --
but as long as it filled my stomach, that was enough.

strings.text:
今のオレには、食ったものを味わうような余裕はない
のだ。
strings.translated: I wasn't in any state to savor what I ate right now.

strings.text:
頭の中は次の蟲使いのことと、これから産まれてくる
蟲どものことだけだった……。
strings.translated:
My mind was occupied with nothing but the next Bug User
and the Bugs that would soon be born......

strings.text:
座っていたソファーから立ち上がると、オレは奥の
部屋を見つめた。
strings.translated:
Rising from the sofa where I'd been sitting, I fixed my gaze on
the room in the back.

strings.text:
そこは、捕まえた蟲使いの女を監禁している部屋で、
昨日からくぐもった呻き声が聞こえてくる。
strings.translated:
That was where I was keeping the Bug User woman I'd captured,
and since yesterday I'd been hearing muffled groans coming from it.

strings.text:
蟲の毒による官能は十分高まっているようで、オレが
愉しむのも、情報を聞き出すのも頃合のはずだった。
strings.translated:
The Bug's venom had clearly worked its way up to full effect -- it should be
the right time for me to have my fun and pry some information out of her.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、カワイイ声で鳴いてもらうとするか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"heh, time to make her cry out in that cute little voice of hers."

strings.text:
オレはニヤリと笑うと、蟲使いの女がいる部屋へと
近付いていった……。
strings.translated: I grinned, then made my way toward the room where the Bug User woman was......

strings.text:
サユリ
「あ、ふぁ……かっ、は……ぁ…………」
吐息と喘ぎが混ざり合ったような声。
strings.translated: A voice like a tangle of sighs and gasps.

strings.text:
薄汚れた床の上で、サユリは四肢を拘束されたまま
もどかしそうに体を動かしていた。
strings.translated:
On the grimy floor, Sayuri writhed restlessly,
her limbs still bound.

strings.text: 蟲の毒を打たれてから、丸一日以上が経過。
strings.translated: More than a full day had passed since she was injected with the Bug's venom.

strings.text:
サユリの肉体と精神は既に限界を向かえ、いつ気が
狂ってもおかしくない状態にあった。
strings.translated:
Sayuri's body and mind had already reached their limit,
and she was in a state where losing her sanity at any moment wouldn't have been strange.

strings.text:
サユリ
「はぁ……あ、がっ……う、あぁああぁぁ…………」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"haa...... ah, gah...... uh, aah aah aah aah............"

strings.text:
喉の奥から搾り出すように呻きながら、サユリの身悶
えは続く。
strings.translated:
Moaning as though wringing the sounds from the back of her throat,
Sayuri's writhing continued.

strings.text:
全身は炎に包まれたかのように熱く、肌からは明らか
に異常な量の汗が噴き出していた。
strings.translated:
Her entire body burned as if engulfed in flames, and sweat
was pouring from her skin in clearly abnormal amounts.

strings.text:
サユリの思考は半ば停止し、自分の置かれた状況さえ
正確に把握できなくなってきている。
strings.translated:
Sayuri's thoughts had half-ceased to function, and she was losing
even her ability to accurately grasp her own situation.

strings.text:
必死に理性を掻き集めて抵抗するが、体の疼きはどう
にも止まりそうになかった。
strings.translated:
She desperately scraped together what reason she had left to resist,
but there was no sign the ache in her body would stop.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ちったぁ考えが変わったか？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"had a change of heart yet?"

strings.text:
部屋に入って来るなり、煉悟がニヤニヤしながら言っ
た。
strings.translated: Rengo said with a smirk the moment he stepped into the room.

strings.text:
埃まみれのベッドに腰掛けると、ずいっと顔を近づけ
るようにして背中を丸める。
strings.translated:
He sat down on the dust-covered bed and hunched his back,
leaning his face in close.

strings.text:
サユリ
「はっ、あ、うぅあっ……あ、ひ、ひくっ…………」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"hah, ah, uuah...... ah, hi, hic.............."

strings.text:
サユリ
「おね、が……我慢、が……もう………………」
サユリの言葉を確認して、煉悟は満足げに頷いた。
strings.translated: Confirming Sayuri's words, Rengo gave a satisfied nod.

サユリは暫くむせ返ったが、これでやっと自分も楽に
なれるという期待が、その瞳には満ち溢れていた。
strings.translated: Sayuri choked and sputtered for a while, but her eyes were brimming with anticipation -- the hope that she would finally get her own relief.

strings.text:
煉悟
「さぁて、ここで一つテメーに喋ってもらわなきゃな
　らねー事がある」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Now then, there's something I need you to tell me."

strings.text: サユリの表情に、さっと不安と失望が走り抜ける。
strings.translated: Anxiety and disappointment flashed across Sayuri's face.

strings.text:
煉悟
「昨日、別の蟲使いに襲われた。
　……テメーなら心当たりあんだろ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Yesterday, I was attacked by another Bug User.
 ...You'd know something about that, wouldn't you?"

strings.text: サユリの表情が俄かに変化する。

煉悟の読み通り、心当たりがあるのは間違いなさそう
だった。
strings.translated: Just as Rengo had predicted, it was clear she knew something.

strings.text:
煉悟
「オレのチ○ポ入れてほしけりゃ――――」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"If you want my c**k inside you ----"

strings.text: 低いドスの利いた声で、サユリが煉悟の言葉を遮る。
strings.translated: In a low, menacing voice, Sayuri cut Rengo off.

strings.text:
虚ろな瞳で見上げてくると、口元に微かな笑みを浮か
べて言った。
strings.translated: She looked up at him with hollow eyes, a faint smile playing at the corners of her lips as she spoke.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ほぅ、まだそんなこと言う力が残ってたのか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Hoh, so you've still got the strength to say something like that."

strings.text:
煉悟
「あぁン？　分かってんのか？
　どうせ明日にゃ喋るはめになるんだ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Hah? You understand what's happening?
 You're gonna end up talking tomorrow anyway."

strings.text:
煉悟
「まだ、ちゃんとした意識が残ってるうちに話したほ
　うが利口てもんだぜ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"It'd be smarter to talk now, while you've still
 got your wits about you."

strings.text: 煉悟が、サユリの頭を掴み上げる。
strings.translated: Rengo grabbed Sayuri by the head and lifted her up.

strings.text: だが、向けられてくる視線は何ら変わる事がなかった。
strings.translated: But the gaze she turned on him never changed.

strings.text:
サユリ
「絶対、に……はな、さ…………なぃ………………」
strings.translated:
Sayuri
"I will... never... talk... not... ever............"

strings.text:
煉悟
「ふん、それなら今日はお預けだな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Hmph. Then you get nothing today."

strings.text:
煉悟
「明日までに考えを変えとけ」

既にこの時点で正常な意識を失いかけているのか、
サユリがうわごとのように呟く。
strings.translated: Already on the verge of losing consciousness at this point, Sayuri murmured as if delirious.

strings.text:
煉悟は忌々しげに舌打ちすると、サユリを残して部屋
を後にした……。
strings.translated: Rengo clicked his tongue in irritation, then left the room, leaving Sayuri behind...

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、だいぶ育ったなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Khih, she's grown quite a bit."

strings.text:
小娘の様子を見に行ってみると、腹を風船のように
膨らませ、悶え苦しんでいた。
strings.translated: When I went to check on the girl, she was writhing in agony, her belly swollen like a balloon.

strings.text: 今日、もしくは明日のうちにも産まれそうな雰囲気だ。
strings.translated: It looked like it could happen today, or tomorrow at the latest.

strings.text:
煉悟
「よく膨らんだもんだ」

異常とも言える膨らみ方をした小娘の腹を見て、オレ
は半ば呆れたように呟いた。
strings.translated: Looking at the girl's belly, swollen to an almost abnormal degree, I muttered half in disbelief.

strings.text:
確かに蟲の卵を大量に植え付けはしたが、それでここ
まで大きくなることはない。
strings.translated: I had certainly implanted a large number of Bug eggs, but that alone shouldn't have caused this much growth.

strings.text:
何か別の要因――と言っても考えられるのは一つしか
ないのだが、それの影響と見るのが自然だった。
strings.translated: Some other factor -- though there was really only one thing it could be -- seemed to be the natural explanation.

strings.text:
煉悟
「このまま破裂したりしねぇだろーな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"She's not just going to burst, is she."

strings.text:
今、小娘に死なれたりしたら、獣魔蟲どころか普通の
蟲さえ得られなくなる。
strings.translated: If the girl died on me now, I wouldn't just lose Jumachuu -- I'd lose even ordinary Bugs.

strings.text:
そうなってしまったら、もはや次の蟲使いと戦うどこ
ろではない。
strings.translated: If that happened, fighting the next Bug User would be the least of my concerns.

strings.text:
最悪は西に借りを作ってでも、蟲を補充しなければな
らなかった。
strings.translated: Worst case, I'd have to swallow my pride and borrow from Nishi just to restock my Bugs.

strings.text:
煉悟
「……っていうか、元はと言えばアイツが蟲使いなん
　ざ呼び寄せるからこうなったんじゃねーか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"...Actually, when you get down to it, this whole mess happened because that guy went and called in Bug Users."

strings.text:
今後、こういった事が繰り返されるようなら、西との
付き合いを考えなければならない。
strings.translated: If this kind of thing kept repeating itself, I'd have to reconsider my relationship with Nishi.

strings.text:
メリットはあっても、それ以上のデメリットを喰らっ
てちゃ意味がないからな。
strings.translated: There might be benefits, but there's no point if the drawbacks outweigh them.

strings.text:
次の蟲使いがどの程度の強さかは分からないが、楽に
勝てる相手じゃないのは確かだ。
strings.translated: I had no idea how strong the next Bug User would be, but one thing was certain -- they wouldn't be an easy win.

strings.text:
煉悟
「獣魔蟲……コレが本物なら、話は変わってくるんだ
　がな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Jumachuu... if this is the real thing, that changes everything."

strings.text:
再び部屋を訪れると、小娘が白目を剥いて体を震えさ
せていた。
strings.translated: When I returned to the room, the girl was convulsing with her eyes rolled back in her head.

strings.text:
腹は異様な膨らみ方をしていて、こんな状態はオレも
見たことがない。
strings.translated: Her belly had swollen in a grotesque way unlike anything I had ever seen.

strings.text: 考えられる原因は、やはりあの特別な卵だった。
strings.translated: The only cause I could think of was, again, that special egg.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ほぅ、マジで獣魔蟲とかってのが育ってんのか？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Hoh, so a Jumachuu is actually growing inside her?"

strings.text:
自分でも半信半疑だった部分はあるが、こうしていつ
もと違うものを見ると期待が高まってしまう。
strings.translated: Part of me had been skeptical even about my own assessment, but seeing something so unlike the usual filled me with anticipation.

strings.text:
伝説では、人を喰うだの蟲を喰うだの言われている蟲
が、もしも本当に産まれたとしたら……。
strings.translated: If the Bug spoken of in legend -- said to devour humans, to devour other Bugs -- were truly to be born...

strings.text: そしてそれを、オレが操ることができたら……。
strings.translated: And if I could control it...

strings.text: 考えただけで身の毛がよだった。
strings.translated: Just thinking about it made my skin crawl.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒヒッ、よろしく頼むぜぇ」

オレは小娘に言いながら、ベロリと舌なめずりをし
た……。
strings.translated: I said it to the girl, then ran my tongue slowly across my lips...

strings.text: 夜になって、小娘の腹はさらに変化した。
strings.translated: By nightfall, the girl's belly had changed further.

strings.text: 膨らんだ表面が、ぐねぐねと蠢いている。
strings.translated: The swollen surface was writhing and squirming.

strings.text:
孵化したのかどうかは分からないが、体内で何かが
蠢いているのは間違いない。
strings.translated:
Whether it had hatched or not was unclear, but something was
undeniably writhing inside her body.

strings.text: 出産は、明日か、それとも明後日か……。
strings.translated: Would she give birth tomorrow, or the day after...?

strings.text: あまりの苦しみに耐え切れず、小娘が嘔吐する。
strings.translated: Unable to bear the agony any longer, the girl retched and vomited.

strings.text:
口から吐瀉物を撒き散らしながら、弱々しく咳き込ん
だ。
strings.translated:
She spewed the contents of her stomach from her mouth, then broke into
weak, wracking coughs.

strings.text:
だが、それですらも、オレには獣魔蟲が産まれる前兆
に見えて胸を躍らせた。
strings.translated:
But even that, to me, looked like a sign that Jumachuu was about
to be born -- and it made my heart race.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ……クヒヒヒヒャヒャヒャヒャヒャッ！！」

煉悟
「いいぜぇ、産まれて来い。早く産まれてきやがれ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Yeah, come on out. Hurry up and get yourself born already."

strings.text:
オレの言葉に応えるように、何かが小さな産声を上げ
たような気がした……。
strings.translated: As if in answer to my words, something seemed to let out a tiny birth cry...

strings.text:
それは、まだ夜も明けきっていない、肌寒い朝の日に
起こった……。
strings.translated: It happened on a chilly morning, when the night had not yet fully given way to dawn...

strings.text:
夢美
「ぎ――ぎゃああああああああああああっ！！！！」
真夜中の絶叫に、思わずソファーから飛び起きる。
strings.translated: The midnight shriek jolted me off the sofa before I even knew what I was doing.

strings.text:
どうやら、小娘に何らかの変化があったようで、オレ
はすぐさま部屋に駆け込んだ。
strings.translated: Something had clearly changed with the girl, and I immediately rushed into the room.

strings.text:
夢美
「う、ううっ……ぐううぅぅぅ………………ッ！」

風船のように膨らんだ腹を仰向けにして、少女が苦し
げに呻き声を漏らす。
strings.translated: Lying on her back with her balloon-swollen belly jutting upward, the girl let out agonized groans.

strings.text: 額には汗の雫が浮かび、顔は真っ赤に染まっている。
strings.translated: Beads of sweat glistened on her brow, and her face was flushed a deep crimson.

strings.text:
下腹部から伝わる鈍痛は時間とともに強くなり、手足
の先がピリピリと痺れた。
strings.translated: The dull ache radiating from her lower abdomen grew stronger with each passing moment, and a tingling numbness crept through her hands and feet.

strings.text: いよいよ、その瞬間が近付いている……。
strings.translated: The moment was drawing near at last...

strings.text:
少女が体内に宿した生命が、誕生の時を迎えようとし
ている。
strings.translated: The life the girl had harbored within her body was on the verge of entering the world.

strings.text:
それは、決して少女の望んだ結果ではなかったが、
ここまで来た以上、出さないわけにもいかない。
strings.translated: It was never the outcome she had wished for -- but having come this far, there was no holding it back.

strings.text:
歯を食い縛りながら痛みを堪え、下腹に力を込めて
その生物を押し出そうとした。
strings.translated: Biting down hard, she endured the pain and bore down with all her strength, trying to push the creature out.

strings.text:
夢美
「ぐうぅううぅううぅぅうううぅぅぅぅぅっ！！！」

掠れ気味な声を漏らしながら、少女は股間に意識を
集中させる。
strings.translated: Letting out a ragged, strained cry, the girl focused all her awareness on what lay between her legs.

strings.text:
果たしてどんなものが産まれてくるのか想像もつかな
かったが、このまま体内で飼い続けるよりはマシだ。
strings.translated: She had no idea what would emerge, but anything was better than keeping it inside her any longer.

strings.text:
毎日の苦痛から逃れ、楽になれるのなら、少女は何で
もするつもりだった。
strings.translated: If it meant escaping the daily torment and finding relief, the girl was prepared to do whatever it took.

strings.text:
煉悟
「さぁて、何匹出てくるかな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Now then, I wonder how many will come out."

strings.text:
近くのベッドに腰を下ろして、煉悟がじっと経緯を
見つめた。
strings.translated: Rengo settled himself on the nearby bed and watched the proceedings with steady, unblinking eyes.

strings.text:
出産シーンそのものに興味はないが、産まれてくる
蟲の数だけは把握しておく必要がある。
strings.translated: The act of birth itself held no interest for him -- but he needed to know exactly how many Bugs would emerge.

strings.text:
希望としては二十匹以上なのだが、それも神のみぞ
知る、だ。
strings.translated: His hope was twenty or more, but only God knew the answer.

strings.text:
夢美
「う、ぎぃっ！　い、ぁ、がっ、お、ごおおぉっ！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ugh, gii! I-ah, gah, oh, gooooh!"

strings.text:
競り上がってくる苦痛に鳴きながら、少女は膣内に
小さな違和感を覚えた。
strings.translated: Crying out against the surging pain, the girl felt a small, strange sensation inside her vagina.

strings.text:
何やら丸っこい物体が、狭い膣道を通り抜けようとし
ている。
strings.translated: Something round was attempting to force its way through the narrow passage.

strings.text:
刹那、みしっと子宮が軋むような感覚を覚え、次いで
身が引き裂かれるような痛みが走り抜けた。
strings.translated: In an instant she felt her womb creak as if being wrenched apart, and then a tearing, rending pain blazed through her.

strings.text:
夢美
「が、あおぉっ！？　ぎゃわああぁぁぁぁっ！！！」
卵から孵った蟲が、膣道を押し広げて移動を開始する。
strings.translated: The Bugs that had hatched from the eggs began to move, forcing the passage wider as they went.

strings.text:
一匹の大きさは大した事はないが、それが二匹、三匹、
五匹、十匹と固まっていくと話は別だ。
strings.translated: A single Bug was not so large on its own -- but when two, three, five, ten of them clumped together, that was another matter entirely.

strings.text:
膣道は限界まで拡張され、そこに無数の蟲が我先にと
集まっていた。
strings.translated: The passage was stretched to its limit, and a countless mass of Bugs was pressing toward it, each scrambling to be first.

strings.text:
外に出ようとする蟲の数が増えるたびに、少女の苦し
みは増大していく。
strings.translated: With every increase in the number of Bugs trying to force their way out, the girl's suffering grew.

strings.text:
しかも、膣道が詰まればその分だけ蟲の移動は遅くな
り、そこへ後から産まれた蟲が追いつきさらに膣道を
拡げようとして、完全な悪循環に陥っていた。
strings.translated: What was worse, the more the passage clogged, the slower the Bugs moved -- and then the ones hatching behind them caught up and pressed forward too, widening it further still, a perfect vicious cycle.

strings.text:
煉悟
「オラ、気張れよ。
　カワイイカワイイ子供達が出たがってんだろォ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Come on, push. Your precious little babies want out, don't they."

strings.text:
夢美
「げ、おっ、ぶげっ！　ご、べげおぉっ！！？」

膨らんだ腹に足を乗せて、煉悟がぐいっと体重を掛け
る。
strings.translated: Rengo placed his foot on her swollen belly and pressed down hard with his full weight.

strings.text:
少女は舌を出して悶え苦しみ、まさにそのカエルのよ
うな体型の如く下品な声で鳴いた。
strings.translated: The girl stuck out her tongue and writhed in agony, crying out in a vulgar, croaking voice -- much like the frog her bloated shape now resembled.

strings.text:
膣の中で、蟲の固まりがグジュッと音を立て、滑るよ
うにして少しだけ出口のほうに移動する。
strings.translated: Inside her, the clump of Bugs made a wet, squelching sound and slid just a little closer toward the exit.

strings.text:
外側でも膣口が薄く開き、そこから透明な体液が滴り
出していた。
strings.translated: On the outside, the opening had parted slightly, and clear fluid was dripping from it.

strings.text:
夢美
「い、ぐおぉっ！？　お、ごぁっ、あ、げあぁっ！！
　はぎっ、い、いぐおぉあぁっ、がぎゃあぁっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ii, guooh!? Oh, goah, ah, geaah!!
 Hgih, i-iguooaah, gagyaah!!"

strings.text:
全身がバラバラになるような激痛が、一定の間隔ごと
に襲ってくる。
strings.translated: A searing agony, as if her entire body were being torn apart, struck her at regular intervals.

strings.text:
蟲が揃って移動するたびに、下腹部が火箸を当てられ
たように熱くなった。
strings.translated: Each time the Bugs moved in unison, her lower abdomen blazed as though a hot iron had been pressed against it.

strings.text:
子宮の辺りではいまだ蟲が孵化しているようで、後か
ら後から膣道を進んでくる。
strings.translated: Near her womb, Bugs appeared to still be hatching, advancing through the passage one after another in an endless stream.

strings.text:
少女は下腹に力を込めて、一刻も早く蟲を産み出す事
に努めた。
strings.translated: The girl bore down with all her strength in her lower abdomen, straining to expel the Bugs as quickly as possible.

strings.text:
夢美
「あぐぅっ……う、ぐぃ……い、はぁっ！
　はっ、はふっ、ふうぅっ……くふぅ～～～っ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Aguu... u, gui... i, haa!
 Hah, hafu, fuuu...kufuu~~~!!"

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、本物の妊婦みてーな声だな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Khih, you sound just like a real pregnant woman."

strings.text:
必死にいきむ少女を見下ろして、煉悟がニヤニヤと
笑う。
strings.translated: Rengo stood over the desperately straining girl, grinning from ear to ear.

strings.text:
目的は産まれてくる蟲の数の確認だったが、それはそ
れとして暇潰しにはなる光景だった。
strings.translated: His purpose was to count the number of Bugs being born -- but setting that aside, it was still an entertaining sight to pass the time.

strings.text:
まるで、土中のモグラのように、少女の下腹の膨らみ
が徐々に膣口へと移動していく。
strings.translated: Like a mole burrowing through soil, the swelling in the girl's lower abdomen slowly migrated toward the vaginal opening.

strings.text:
股間付近の体液はさらにその量を増し、床面を濃く
染めていった。
strings.translated: The fluid near her groin increased further in volume, spreading darkly across the floor.

strings.text:
夢美
「ひ、ぐうぅ……い、だいぃぃぃぃぃ…………」

爪が食い込むかと思うほど拳を握り締め、少女が眉間
にしわを寄せる。
strings.translated: The girl clenched her fists so hard it seemed her nails might break skin, her brow furrowing deeply.

strings.text:
膣内で蟲の固まりが崩れたのか、若干痛みが和らいで
いた。
strings.translated: Perhaps the clump of Bugs inside her had broken apart -- the pain had eased somewhat.

strings.text:
先陣を切った一匹の蟲が、出口へ向けて一気に膣道を
進む。
strings.translated: The first Bug to lead the charge rushed through the vaginal passage all at once toward the exit.

strings.text:
早く産み落とそうとする少女の力みと重なって、その
頭部を膣口から外へと突き出した。
strings.translated: Combining with the girl's own desperate pushing to expel it sooner, its head was thrust out through the vaginal opening.

strings.text:
内側から膣口がこじ開けられる感覚に、少女の体が
びくんっと跳ね上がった。
strings.translated: At the sensation of the vaginal opening being pried apart from within, the girl's body lurched and convulsed.

strings.text:
黒ずんだ塊が、ギチギチと穴を拡張しようともがいて
いる。
strings.translated: A darkened mass was writhing and struggling, forcing the opening to stretch wider and wider.

strings.text:
体内で産まれた仔蟲が力を合わせるようにして、出口
となる穴に一斉に群がったのだ。
strings.translated: The larval Bugs born inside had joined forces, swarming all at once toward the opening that served as their exit.

strings.text:
結果、少女の膣は驚くほどの勢いで拡げられ、数匹の
仔蟲を一気に外へと吐き出した。
strings.translated: As a result, the girl's vagina was forced open with astonishing force, expelling several larval Bugs to the outside all at once.

strings.text:
夢美
「はがっ！　あ、ぎゃっ、ああああああああっ！！」

股関節が砕け散るかと思うほどの激痛が、少女の下半
身を突き抜けた。
strings.translated: A searing agony, as though her hip joints were being shattered, tore through the lower half of the girl's body.

strings.text:
本来の出口の大きさに対して、そこを通ろうとする
物体のサイズが明らかにオーバーしている。
strings.translated: The size of the object attempting to pass through was clearly far beyond what the opening was meant to accommodate.

strings.text:
まだ、本物の出産の経験もない少女にとって、それは
性器が破壊される感覚そのものだった。
strings.translated: For the girl, who had never experienced actual childbirth, it was the pure sensation of her genitals being destroyed.

strings.text:
一匹目が産まれると、あとは津波のような勢いのまま
だった。
strings.translated: Once the first one was born, the rest came with the force of a tidal wave.

strings.text:
二匹目、三匹目、四匹目――と、少女の股間から仔蟲
が産まれ、まだ短い脚で床の上を這い始める。
