strings.translated: The fact that she could drink water in front of me like this was proof enough that she'd grown somewhat accustomed to this life --

strings.text: ――それとも、恐怖という思考が鈍ってきただけか。
strings.translated: -- Or perhaps her capacity for fear had simply grown dull.

strings.text:
水を飲んでいた小娘が、急に小さな悲鳴を上げて後ず
さりした。
strings.translated: The girl, who had been drinking water, suddenly let out a small shriek and stumbled backward.

strings.text:
視線は床に向けられていて、体に巻き付けたシーツを
握り締めながら、一歩、二歩、三歩と後ろに下がって
いく。
strings.translated: Her gaze was fixed on the floor, and clutching the sheet wrapped around her body, she stepped back -- one step, two steps, three steps.

strings.text:
何事かと思い床を見てみると、そこにはあの期待外れ
の蟲の姿があった。
strings.translated: Wondering what had happened, I looked at the floor -- and there was that disappointing Bug of mine.

strings.text:
煉悟
「まだ生きてやがったのか」

オレが踏み潰した胴体部分からは体液が滲み、床に
緑色の帯を引いている。
strings.translated: From the section of its body I had crushed, bodily fluid seeped out, leaving a green trail across the floor.

strings.text: 普通の蟲なら、とっくに死んでるダメージだ。
strings.translated: Any ordinary Bug would have been long dead from damage like that.

strings.text:
獣魔蟲とか言うだけあって、普通の蟲よりはタフらし
い。
strings.translated: It was called the Jumachuu for a reason -- it seemed tougher than the average Bug.

strings.text:
……まあ、潰されて死なない蟲が欲しいなら、液状系
の蟲に勝るものはないのだが。
strings.translated: Well, if you wanted a Bug that wouldn't die from being crushed, nothing beats a liquid-type Bug.

strings.text: 短く声を漏らして、小娘が部屋に逃げ込んでいく。
strings.translated: With a short cry, the girl fled back into the room.

strings.text:
勢いよく扉が閉められ、胴体の潰れた蟲はその場に
置き去りにされた。
strings.translated: The door slammed shut behind her, leaving the crushed Bug abandoned where it lay.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、お母ちゃんに嫌われちまったなァ？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Khih -- your mama's gone and rejected you, hasn't she?"

strings.text:
オレの嘲笑をどう感じたのか、蟲はしばらくその場で
じっとしていたが、やがて諦めたように倉庫の隅のほ
うへ移動して行った。
strings.translated: Whatever it made of my mockery, the Bug stayed still for a while -- then, as if giving up, slowly made its way toward the corner of the warehouse.

strings.text:
床を体液で濡らしながら移動するその姿は、その蟲の
命があまり長くない事を感じさせた……。
strings.translated: The sight of it dragging itself across the floor, leaving a trail of bodily fluid, gave the impression that the creature didn't have much longer to live...

strings.text: その日の朝食は、珍しく小娘と一緒になった。
strings.translated: That morning, I ended up eating breakfast with the girl, which was unusual.

strings.text:
たまたま起きた時間が重なっただけなのだろうが、
奇しくもテーブルを挟んでの食事。
strings.translated: It was probably just coincidence that we happened to wake at the same time -- yet there we were, sharing a meal across the table from each other.

strings.text:
もっとも、小娘はスナック菓子を取ろうとしただけで、
その時にオレが起きてしまったがゆえに、その場から
動けなくなってしまっただけのようなのだが……。
strings.translated:
Though it seemed the girl had only been trying to grab some snacks,
and it was simply because I happened to wake up at that moment
that she'd been unable to move from the spot...

strings.text:
恐怖で体が凍り付いているせいか、返事一つまともに
できないらしい。
strings.translated:
Maybe fear had frozen her stiff -- she couldn't even manage
a proper reply.

strings.text:
煉悟
「動けるようになったんなら、掃除くらいしとけ。
　テメーのくせぇくせぇ糞の臭いが、こっちまで来て
　るからな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"If you can move again, go ahead and clean up.
 Your stinking, reeking shit smell is drifting
 all the way over here."

strings.text:
倉庫の隅にあるモップとバケツを指差して命令すると、
小娘はぽかんとした表情を浮かべた。
strings.translated:
I pointed to the mop and bucket in the corner of the warehouse and gave the order,
and the girl stared back at me with a blank expression.

strings.text: 思っていた反応とは、やや違う。
strings.translated: That wasn't quite the reaction I'd expected.

strings.text:
煉悟
「オレはやれっつってんだ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I'm telling you to do it."

strings.text: 一瞬にして恐怖の表情に戻って、小娘が頷いてみせる。
strings.translated: Her expression snapped back to one of fear in an instant, and the girl gave a nod.

strings.text:
ただ、伝わってくる様子から察するに、本人も掃除は
したかったらしい。
strings.translated: Though judging by the way she carried herself, she'd apparently wanted to clean up herself.

strings.text:
食事を終えると、すぐにモップとバケツと雑巾を持ち
出して、隣の部屋へと消えていった。
strings.translated:
The moment she finished eating, she grabbed the mop, bucket, and rags
and disappeared into the next room.

strings.text:
実際、この二週間の間にぶちまけた唾液、精液、小便、
排泄物、蟲の体液等々は尋常な量ではない。
strings.translated:
In truth, the saliva, semen, urine, excrement, Bug bodily fluids, and so on
that had been spilled over these past two weeks were no ordinary amount.

strings.text:
掃除するにしても、床を綺麗にするだけで一日掛かり
になりそうだった。
strings.translated: Even just cleaning the floor looked like it would take a full day's work.

strings.text: 夜になっても、小娘の掃除は続いていた。
strings.translated: Even as night fell, the girl's cleaning continued.

strings.text:
休みながらではあるが、自分が汚した箇所をひとつひ
とつ綺麗にしていってるらしい。
strings.translated:
She was taking breaks along the way, but it seemed she was going through
each spot she had dirtied and scrubbing it clean one by one.

strings.text:
扉を開けっ放しにしていた分、こっち側に臭いが流れ
てきたが、我慢できないほどではなかった。
strings.translated:
Since the door had been left open, the smell drifted over to my side,
but it wasn't bad enough to be unbearable.

strings.text:
夕食は相変わらずスナック菓子で済ませたが、これも
そろそろ飽き始めていた。
strings.translated: Dinner was the same as always -- snack food -- but I was starting to get tired of that too.

strings.text:
色々種類を買い揃えてはあったが、それでもやはり
限界というものはくる。
strings.translated: I'd stocked up on a variety of kinds, but even so, there's a limit to everything.

strings.text: 明日は、もう少し食事らしい食事をしたいもんだ。
strings.translated: Tomorrow, I'd like something that actually resembles a proper meal.

strings.text:
――などと考えていると、隣の部屋から小娘が逃げる
ようにして出てきた。
strings.translated:
-- I was thinking along those lines when the girl came rushing out of the next room
as if fleeing from something.

strings.text:
そして、怯えたような目で、部屋の中――特に、床の
ほうを見つめている。
strings.translated: She was staring into the room -- at the floor in particular -- with frightened eyes.

strings.text:
何事かと思いきや、部屋から這い出して来たのは、
例の『期待外れ』だった。
strings.translated:
Wondering what had happened, I saw what had crawled out of the room:
it was that "disappointment" from before.

strings.text:
体液の流出はだいぶ止まったようだが、潰れた胴体の
部分は相変わらず緑色に染まっている。
strings.translated:
The flow of bodily fluid seemed to have mostly stopped, but the crushed section of its torso
was still stained green as ever.

strings.text:
煉悟
「よく生きてるもんだ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Tough little thing, staying alive like that."

strings.text:
オレからも、小娘からも受け入れられない、胴体が
半分潰れた蟲――――。
strings.translated: Rejected by both me and the girl -- a Bug with half its body crushed --------

strings.text:
いっそここでトドメを刺したほうが、色々と丸く収ま
るのかもしれなかったが、それはそれで面倒なのでや
めた。
strings.translated:
It might have been cleaner all around to just finish it off right then and there,
but that seemed like its own kind of hassle, so I left it alone.

strings.text:
その程度の事くらい、自分で何とかしろというのが
本音だ。
strings.translated: Honestly, something like that it could damn well sort out on its own.

strings.text: 小娘が逃げると、蟲がそれを追いかける。
strings.translated: When the girl fled, the Bug gave chase.

strings.text:
どちらも人間が歩く程度のスピードだったが、周りを
グルグルグルグル動かれると、それはそれで気になっ
て仕方がない。
strings.translated:
Both were moving at roughly the pace of a walking human, but having them circle
around and around and around me was distracting enough that I couldn't ignore it.

strings.text:
目をつぶって寝ようかとも思ったが、小娘のパタパタ
という軽い足音と、蟲の這いずるずりずりという音が
混ざり合い、とても安眠できる空間ではなかった。
strings.translated:
I considered closing my eyes and going to sleep, but the girl's light pattering footsteps
and the Bug's dragging, scraping sounds mixed together,
making it anything but a space fit for peaceful sleep.

strings.text:
煉悟
「……ったく、うっせぇなァ」

パチンと指を鳴らして、ソファーの下にいる蟲どもに
合図を送る。
strings.translated: I snapped my fingers, sending a signal to the Bugs lurking beneath the sofa.

strings.text:
すると三、四匹の蟲が這い出してきて、一斉に小娘を
追いかけていた蟲へと牙を立てた。
strings.translated:
Three or four Bugs crawled out and sank their fangs into the Bug
that had been chasing the girl all at once.

strings.text:
小娘が驚いたときにはもう、蟲どもが一匹をよってた
かって嬲り殺し始めていた。
strings.translated:
By the time the girl's surprise registered, the Bugs had already ganged up on the lone one
and begun tearing it apart.

strings.text:
牙を突き立て、肉を切り裂き、触手で締め上げながら
全身を引き裂いていく。
strings.translated:
Sinking in their fangs, slicing through flesh, constricting with their tentacles
as they ripped the whole body to pieces.

strings.text: その光景を、小娘は真っ青な顔で凝視していた。
strings.translated: The girl stared at the scene with a face drained of all color.

strings.text:
夢美
「あ、や…………これ……し、死んじゃ…………」

言いたい事がちゃんと声にならないらしく、小娘が
歯をガチガチとぶつけながら喋る。
strings.translated:
It seemed she couldn't get what she wanted to say out properly, the girl's teeth
chattering together as she spoke.

strings.text: 涙で潤んだ目で、オレと蟲どもを交互に見ていた。
strings.translated: With eyes glistening with tears, she looked back and forth between me and the Bugs.

strings.text:
だが、小娘にできる事はそれが精一杯で、やがて蟲を
バラバラに引き裂いたあと、オレの蟲どもはソファー
の下へと戻った。
strings.translated:
But that was all the girl could do, and before long, after tearing the Bug to pieces,
my Bugs retreated back beneath the sofa.

strings.text: ソファーに深々と寝直して、オレはまぶたを閉じた。
strings.translated: I settled back deep into the sofa and closed my eyes.

strings.text:
小娘はまだ立ち尽くしているようだったが、少なくと
も安眠の邪魔にはならない。
strings.translated:
The girl still seemed to be standing there motionless, but at least
she wasn't disturbing my sleep.

strings.text:
オレは、呆然とする小娘の顔を思い出して「クヒッ」
と笑いながら、眠りの淵に落ちていった……。
strings.translated:
I recalled the girl's dumbfounded face, let out a "Khih," and drifted
down into the depths of sleep...

strings.text:
翌日、オレが目を覚ましたとき、蟲の死骸は既に無く
なっていた。
strings.translated: The next day, when I woke up, the Bug's carcass was already gone.

strings.text:
床には緑色の体液がシミとなっているだけで、肉片の
カケラも見つからない。
strings.translated: All that remained on the floor was a green stain of bodily fluid -- not a single scrap of flesh to be found.

strings.text:
おそらくは小娘が掃除したのだろうが、その気配に気
付かないくらい深く眠っていたのだとしたら、それは
それで問題だった。
strings.translated:
Most likely the girl had cleaned it up, but if I'd been sleeping so deeply
that I hadn't even noticed her doing it, that was a problem in its own right.

strings.text:
煉悟
「今日くらい餌をやんねぇとな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Gotta feed them today, at least."

strings.text: 今日は起きた直後から、足元に蟲が擦り寄ってくる。
strings.translated: From the moment I woke up, the Bugs were rubbing against my feet.

strings.text:
だいぶ腹を空かせているようで、しきりにオレの周り
を動き回っていた。
strings.translated:
They seemed quite hungry, constantly crawling
around me.

strings.text: 餌は、隠れ家の近くで与える事にした。
strings.translated: I decided to feed them near the hideout.

strings.text:
あまり好ましいやり方ではないが、遠出して見つかる
よりマシだろう。
strings.translated:
Not the most ideal approach, but better than venturing
far out and getting spotted.

strings.text:
既にこの辺りにまでレンと言う男が迫っていたらアウ
トだが、今のところその気配はなかった。
strings.translated:
If Ren had already closed in this far, I'd be done for --
but there was no sign of that yet.

strings.text:
ある程度行動範囲を狭めた形で、蟲どもを森の中に
解き放つ。
strings.translated:
I kept their range somewhat restricted and released
the Bugs into the forest.

strings.text:
ダンゴムシのような物体が雑草の奥へと消えて、辺り
は暫しの静寂に包まれた……。
strings.translated:
The pill-bug-like creatures vanished into the undergrowth,
and a brief silence settled over the area...

strings.text:
地面にごろんと寝転がって、木々の隙間から青空を
見つめる。
strings.translated:
I flopped down on the ground and stared up at the blue sky
through the gaps in the trees.

strings.text:
こんな状況でなければ一眠りするところだが、さすが
にその誘惑に乗るわけにはいかない。
strings.translated:
If things were different, I'd take a nap right here -- but
I couldn't afford to give in to that temptation.

strings.text:
いつ攻撃されても対処できるように、神経は常に張り
詰めさせておく必要があった。
strings.translated:
I had to keep my nerves on edge at all times,
ready to respond to an attack at any moment.

strings.text:
蟲どもに餌を与えた後は、いつものように倉庫で過ご
した。
strings.translated:
After feeding the Bugs, I spent the time as usual
in the warehouse.

strings.text:
小娘はと言えば今日も掃除に勤しんでるらしく、隣の
部屋から物音が聞こえる。
strings.translated:
The girl seemed to be busy cleaning again today --
I could hear sounds coming from the next room.

strings.text:
糞尿の臭いはだいぶ消えたようで、外の空気とそれほ
ど差は感じられなかった。
strings.translated:
The stench of filth had mostly faded, and the air
felt little different from outside.

strings.text:
ソファーに腰掛けたとき、ちょうど部屋からバケツを
持った小娘が出てきた。
strings.translated:
Just as I settled onto the sofa, the girl came out
of the room carrying a bucket.

strings.text:
どうやら、汚れた水を捨てに行くところだったらしい
のだが、オレの姿を見てピタリと足を止める。
strings.translated:
It seemed she was on her way to dump the dirty water,
but the moment she saw me, she froze in her tracks.

strings.text:
正直、必要以上に怖がられるのも、それはそれで鬱陶
しかった。
strings.translated:
Honestly, being feared more than necessary was its own
kind of annoyance.

strings.text: しょせん、コイツは道具でしかない。
strings.translated: In the end, this one was nothing but a tool.

strings.text: 数日前までは苗床で、今は掃除用具の一部だ。
strings.translated: A few days ago she was a Seedbed; now she's part of the cleaning equipment.

strings.text: それ以外のものを、オレはコイツに求めてはいない。
strings.translated: I asked nothing more of her than that.

strings.text: オレの気分次第では、性欲処理機という使い方もある。
strings.translated: Depending on my mood, there was also the use of her as a means to relieve my urges.

strings.text:
だが、基本的にオレ好みの女ではないため、いつも
その役目を果たせるわけではなかった。
strings.translated:
But she wasn't really my type, so she couldn't always
fulfill that role.

strings.text:
こんな状況でなければ、夜の街で好みの女を犯したほ
うが何倍も楽しいだろう。
strings.translated:
If things were different, I'd have far more fun forcing
myself on a woman I actually wanted out in the city at night.

strings.text:
そんなオレの思考を知るはずもなく、小娘は無防備に
も背中を向けて、バケツに新しい水を汲んでいた。
strings.translated:
Oblivious to my thoughts, the girl had her back turned to me,
vulnerably filling the bucket with fresh water.

strings.text:
水を汲み終えて部屋へと戻ろうとした時、珍しく小娘
から声をかけてきた。
strings.translated:
When she finished filling the bucket and turned to head back,
the girl spoke up -- which was unusual.

strings.text:
無視しても良かったんだが、あまりに珍しいのでつい
返事をしてしまう。
strings.translated:
I could have ignored her, but it was so out of the ordinary
that I found myself answering.

strings.text:
夢美
「昨日の蟲は……もう片付けたんですか……？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That Bug from yesterday... did you already clean it up...?"

strings.text: すぐには、小娘の言ってることが分からなかった。
strings.translated: For a moment, I didn't understand what she was talking about.

strings.text:
てっきりコイツが片付けたのだとばかり思ってたが、
この様子だと――――
strings.translated:
I had assumed she was the one who cleaned it up, but
from the look of things ----

strings.text:
煉悟
「お前が片付けたんじゃねぇのか？」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Wasn't it you who cleaned it up?"

strings.text:
自分で片付けなかった事を咎められているとでも思っ
たのか、小娘が肩を萎縮させる。
strings.translated:
Perhaps thinking she was being blamed for not cleaning it herself,
the girl shrank her shoulders.

strings.text:
まあ、別に誰が片付けたかなんてのは、大した問題
じゃないんだが……。
strings.translated: Well, it didn't really matter much who cleaned it up, but...

strings.text: それよりも問題は蟲のほうだ。
strings.translated: The real problem was the Bug itself.

strings.text:
オレも小娘も片付けてないのなら、何故床から死骸が
消えているのか。
strings.translated:
If neither I nor the girl had cleaned it up, why had the carcass
disappeared from the floor?

strings.text:
考えられる可能性は、死ぬと蒸発なり何なりして肉片
が消えてしまうタイプの蟲だった、というものだ。
strings.translated:
One possibility was that it was the type of Bug whose remains
evaporate or dissolve upon death.

strings.text:
液状系の蟲にはよく見られる現象で、特に珍しい死に
方というわけではない。
strings.translated:
It's a phenomenon commonly seen with liquid-type Bugs --
not a particularly unusual way to die.

strings.text:
ただ、あの蟲は液状系の蟲ではなかったのが、どうに
も気に掛かる。
strings.translated:
The only thing that nagged at me was that that Bug
had not been a liquid-type.

strings.text:
もしかすると、オレの蟲どもが夜中に喰らったのかと
思ったが、真実かどうか確かめるすべはなかった。
strings.translated:
I wondered if my own Bugs had devoured it in the night,
but there was no way to know for certain.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、どうでもいいか」

ソファーにどっしりと体重を掛けると、オレは暫く
眠るためまぶたを閉じた……。
strings.translated:
I sank my full weight into the sofa and closed my eyes
to sleep for a while...

strings.text: 床の上で、小娘がオレの精液を吐き出していた。
strings.translated: On the floor, the girl was spitting out my semen.

strings.text: コイツが何か仕出かしたわけじゃない。
strings.translated: It wasn't as if she had done anything wrong.

strings.text:
単にオレが暇を持て余していて、たまたま小娘がすぐ
近くを通って――――
strings.translated:
I had simply been bored, and the girl happened to pass
right by me ----

strings.text:
――たぶんまた、部屋の掃除をするつもりだったのだ
ろうが、オレはそれを無視して小娘を『使う』ことに
しただけの話だ。
strings.translated: -- She had probably come to clean the room again, but I simply ignored that and decided to 'use' the girl. That's all there was to it.

strings.text:
夢美
「う、ぇ……げほっ、げほげほっ…………！」

背中を丸めるようにして、小娘がどんどん精液を吐き
戻す。
strings.translated: Hunched over, the girl kept retching up my semen.

strings.text:
唾液と混ざり合った白い粘液が、ゆっくりと円形に
広がっていった。
strings.translated: The white viscous fluid, mixed with saliva, slowly spread out in a widening circle.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ついでにそこも掃除しとけよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Clean that up while you're at it."

strings.text:
背中を丸める小娘を見下ろしながら、吐き捨てるよう
に言う。
strings.translated: I said it like spitting out the words, looking down at the girl hunched over on the floor.

strings.text:
今のところ、コイツは苗床ですらないのだから、掃除
機代わりくらいやって当然だ。
strings.translated: For now, this one wasn't even a Seedbed -- so doing the work of a vacuum cleaner was the least she could manage.

strings.text:
一度目の出産からそろそろ一週間が経つし、近いうち
に次の産卵を行っても良いかもしれない。
strings.translated: It would be nearly a week since the first birth, so it might be time to perform the next egg-laying before long.

strings.text:
もっとも、小娘を次で使い捨てにするつもりなら、
今すぐにでも植え付けてやって良いのだが……。
strings.translated: Though if I intended to dispose of the girl after the next one, I could plant them in her right now...

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、そのへんも西からの連絡待ちか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, I guess that's another thing to wait on word from Nishi about."

strings.text:
果たして、新しい蟲の開発とやらが成功するのかどう
か。
strings.translated: Whether or not this so-called new Bug development would actually succeed.

strings.text:
それなりに期待しながら、オレは今日の一日を終え
た……。
strings.translated: With a fair measure of anticipation, I brought that day to a close...

strings.text:
西から呼び出しが掛かったのは、その日の夜になって
からだった。
strings.translated: The summons from Nishi came later that same night.

strings.text:
調べたい事があるからとか何とか言って、こっちの
都合はお構いなしだ。
strings.translated: He said something about having things he wanted to look into, with no regard whatsoever for my schedule.

strings.text:
もちろん、忙しいわけじゃなかったからすぐに向かっ
たが、何となく釈然としないものが胸に残る。
strings.translated: Of course, it wasn't as if I was busy, so I headed over right away -- but something vaguely unsatisfying lingered in my chest.

strings.text:
部屋に入ってきた西は、ゴム手袋に白衣といういつも
通りの姿だった。
strings.translated: Nishi walked into the room looking exactly as he always did -- rubber gloves and a lab coat.

strings.text:
どうせ今の今まで実験でも続けていたのだろう、コイ
ツらしいと言えばらしい登場の仕方だ。
strings.translated: He had probably been in the middle of some experiment right up until this moment. A fitting entrance, if nothing else.

strings.text:
煉悟
「……で、呼び付けた理由を聞かせてもらおうか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"...So, how about you tell me why you called me here."

strings.text:
西
「そう焦らないでくれ。
　きっと君も気に入るだろう話だ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Don't be so impatient.
 I'm sure you'll like what I have to say."

strings.text: 口ではそう言いながらも、実際のところ期待は高まる。
strings.translated: I said that, but in truth, my expectations were rising.

strings.text:
コイツはいけ好かない奴だが、蟲に関する知識と技術
においては信頼できる。
strings.translated: He was an insufferable man, but when it came to knowledge and skill regarding Bugs, he was reliable.

strings.text:
オレが気に入るだろうという話なら、たぶん気に入る
のだろう。
strings.translated: If he said I'd probably like it, then I probably would.

strings.text: 部屋の隅に控えていたユーリアに、西が指示を出す。
strings.translated: Nishi gave instructions to Yulia, who had been waiting quietly in the corner of the room.

strings.text:
ユーリアは軽く頷くと、オレ達の着いているテーブル
に布を被せた箱のような物を置いた。
strings.translated: Yulia gave a slight nod, then placed something on the table where we sat -- a box-like object covered with a cloth.

strings.text: そして、その布を取り払った瞬間――――
strings.translated: And then, the moment she pulled the cloth away ----

strings.text: すぐには声が出なかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't find my voice right away.

strings.text:
透明なアクリルケースの中に入っていたものを、オレ
はすぐに理解する事ができなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't immediately comprehend what was inside the transparent acrylic case.

strings.text:
外見を見る限りでは確かに蟲なのだが、そのサイズが
圧倒的に違う。
strings.translated: To all appearances it was certainly a Bug, but its size was overwhelmingly different.

strings.text:
おそらくは小型犬と同じくらいの大きさだが、蟲で
このサイズのものは滅多になかった。
strings.translated: It was probably about the size of a small dog -- and Bugs that size were exceedingly rare.

strings.text:
西
「君も知っての通り、蟲の平均サイズは手のひら程度。
　一時的に巨大化するものはいるが、その活動時間は
　限られている」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"As you know, the average Bug is roughly the size of a palm.
 Some can temporarily grow larger, but their active time
 is limited."

strings.text:
西
「例外を挙げるなら無尽蔵に分裂する液状タイプの蟲
　だが、それ以外でこのサイズは珍しいだろう？」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"The exception would be liquid-type Bugs that divide endlessly,
 but outside of those, a size like this is unusual, wouldn't you say?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「ああ、常識じゃありえねぇサイズだな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Yeah, that's a size that defies common sense."

strings.text:
煉悟
「蟲使いの一族でも、こんな馬鹿でかいサイズの蟲を
　扱えるのは、だいぶ限られてるはずだ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Even among Bug User clans, the ones who can handle a Bug
 this absurdly large must be pretty few and far between."

strings.text:
西
「大昔は、これ以上のサイズを当たり前のように操っ
　ていたとも言われているがね……まあ、それはどう
　でもいい話だ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"They say that in ancient times, controlling sizes even larger than this
 was commonplace... but that's neither here nor there."

strings.text:
蟲の種類は、資料に記録されているものを含めれば、
数百とも数千とも言われている。
strings.translated: The number of Bug species, including those recorded in documents, is said to number in the hundreds -- or even thousands.

strings.text:
だが、現代の蟲使いが使っているのは、そこいらの
昆虫よりやや大きめ程度のサイズが平均的で、こん
な小型犬みたいな蟲は、殆ど生存すらしていない。
strings.translated: But the Bugs used by modern Bug Users average out to only slightly larger than ordinary insects, and Bugs the size of a small dog like this one had barely survived into the present day.

strings.text:
たまに、一時的に巨大化して敵を襲う、もしくは雌を
犯す蟲もいるにはいるが、往々にして時間が限られて
いるのが現実だった。
strings.translated: There were some Bugs that temporarily grew large to attack enemies -- or to violate females -- but the reality was that their time was almost always limited.

strings.text:
つまり、今、オレの目の前でアクリルケースに入って
いる蟲は、『蟲使いが持つ蟲以上の力を持った蟲』と
いう事になる。
strings.translated: In other words, the Bug sitting in the acrylic case before me right now was a Bug that possessed power beyond what any Bug User's Bug should have.

strings.text:
西
「説明しても分からんだろう？
　……実験の成果とだけ答えておくよ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"You wouldn't understand even if I explained it.
 ...Let's just say it's the fruit of experimentation."

strings.text:
言い方は気に食わないが、確かにどうやったかなど
どうでもいい話だ。
strings.translated: I didn't like the way he said it, but honestly, how he did it didn't matter.

strings.text:
それよりも今は、この蟲をオレが扱えるのかどうかの
ほうが重大な問題だった。
strings.translated: What mattered far more right now was whether or not I could actually handle this Bug.

strings.text:
煉悟
「誰に向かってモノ言ってんだよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Who do you think you're talking to?"

strings.text:
慣らすのに暫く時間は掛かるだろうが、しょせん相手
は蟲だ。
strings.translated: It'll take some time to break it in, but at the end of the day, it's still just a Bug.

strings.text:
誰が主なのかを教え込ませれば、そこに図体は関係な
い。
strings.translated: Once I teach it who's master, size doesn't matter.

strings.text:
本来は、産まれた直後にやる事なのだが、他の蟲使い
の蟲になってないのなら、何とかなるだろう。
strings.translated: Normally, this is done right after birth -- but if it hasn't bonded to another Bug User yet, it should be manageable.

strings.text:
オレの言葉を受けて、西がアクリルケースの蓋を開け
る。
strings.translated: At my words, Nishi lifts the lid off the acrylic case.

strings.text:
蟲はその事を理解したのか、やや警戒する素振りを
見せながら、ゆっくりとテーブルの上に這い出して
きた。
strings.translated: Whether the Bug understood what was happening or not, it showed a flicker of wariness as it slowly crawled out onto the table.

strings.text:
その醜悪な姿たるや、ダンゴムシだとか何だとか一言
で言い表せる代物じゃない。
strings.translated: That grotesque form of its -- calling it a pill bug or anything else in a single word wouldn't do it justice.

strings.text:
全体的には長い芋虫のような形状だが、表面には幾つ
もの突起物が付いている。
strings.translated: Its overall shape was like a long caterpillar, but its surface was covered in numerous protrusions.

strings.text:
左右に生えた脚は片側だけでも十本以上あり、それら
の先端には鋭い爪が不気味に光っていた。
strings.translated: The legs sprouting from either side numbered more than ten on each flank alone, and their tips gleamed with sharp claws in an unsettling way.

strings.text:
果たして、オレと言う存在を理解しているのかどうか、
蟲の頭部がすいっとこちら側に向けられる。
strings.translated: Whether it had any grasp of what I was, the Bug's head swiveled smoothly in my direction.

strings.text:
煉悟
「クヒッ、いいツラしてんじゃねぇか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Khih -- now that's one hell of a face."

strings.text:
喉を鳴らして笑いながら、服の内側から一匹の蟲を
這い出させる。
strings.translated: Chuckling in my throat, I let one of my Bugs crawl out from inside my clothes.

strings.text:
蟲は、オレの足を伝って床に降り、自由に辺りを動き
回りながら餌を探し始めた。
strings.translated: The Bug slid down my leg to the floor and began roaming freely around the room, searching for food.

strings.text:
もちろん、こんな場所にヤツの食い物なんぞありはし
ない。
strings.translated: Of course, there was nothing here for it to eat.

strings.text:
オレがこの場所で、たった一匹だけ自由にした意味を、
この蟲は理解しなかったし、最後までする事もなかっ
た。
strings.translated: The meaning behind me setting just this one Bug loose in this place -- the creature never understood it, and never would.

strings.text:
煉悟
「特別サービスだ。……食えよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Consider it a special service. ...Go ahead and eat."

strings.text:
テーブルの上でじっとしている怪物のような蟲に、
オレはそう命令を下した。
strings.translated: I gave that order to the monster-like Bug sitting motionless on the table.

strings.text:
怪物のような蟲――仮に怪蟲とでも言うべきか、ソイ
ツは暫くオレを見ていたが、やがてゆっくりと頭部を
蟲のほうに向けると――――
strings.translated: The monster-like Bug -- call it a freak Bug, perhaps -- stared at me for a moment, then slowly turned its head toward the other Bug, and then --

strings.text: 油断していたせいもあるだろう。
strings.translated: Part of it was that I had let my guard down.

strings.text:
しかし、怪蟲の動きはオレの想像を遥かに上回ってい
た。
strings.translated: But the freak Bug's speed far exceeded anything I had imagined.

strings.text:
図体がでかい分、動きは遅いかと思ったが、実際はそ
の逆だ。
strings.translated: I thought that with a body that big, it would move slowly -- but the reality was the exact opposite.

strings.text:
太い十本以上の脚から生み出される瞬発力は、他の蟲
には真似できない速度があった。
strings.translated: The explosive force generated by more than ten thick legs gave it a speed no other Bug could match.

strings.text:
怪蟲は、鋭い牙を蟲に突き立て、あっという間に食い
尽くしてしまった……。
strings.translated: The freak Bug drove its sharp fangs into the other Bug and devoured it whole in the blink of an eye...

strings.text:
煉悟
「コイツのどこに不満を持てってんだよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Where the hell am I supposed to find fault with this thing?"

strings.text:
西
「ただ、飼い慣らすとなると、それなりに大変だとは
　思うがね」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Still, taming it will be quite the ordeal, I imagine."

strings.text:
とてもじゃないが、コイツに餌を与え続けて飼うのは
手間が掛かりすぎる。
strings.translated: There was no way around it -- keeping this thing fed and under control would be far too much trouble.

strings.text:
今回だけ、レンとか言う男との戦いにだけ使って、
あとは西に世話をさせるのが得策だろう。
strings.translated: The smart play would be to use it just this once against that man called Ren, then leave it in Nishi's care afterward.

strings.text:
どうせコイツも、この怪蟲を手放したいとは思ってな
いだろうしな。
strings.translated: Besides, Nishi probably had no intention of letting this freak Bug go either.

strings.text:
西
「さて、どうする？　連れて帰るかね？」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"So, what will you do? Take it home with you?"

strings.text:
西
「実のところ、これがどこまで飼い主に忠実なのかは
　不明だったりするわけだが……」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Truth be told, just how loyal this thing will be to its owner is... somewhat unclear."

strings.text:
煉悟
「寝込みを襲われても文句は言えねぇって事か」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Meaning I can't complain if it jumps me in my sleep."

Nishi
"Well, yes. That's about the size of it."

strings.text:
強力な蟲なのは間違いないが、相応のリスクも覚悟し
なければならない。
strings.translated: There was no doubt it was a powerful Bug -- but I'd have to be prepared for the risks that came with it.

strings.text:
煉悟
「せっかくだし、連れて帰るとするか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Might as well take it home with me."

strings.text: 予想通りといった風に、西が頷く。
strings.translated: Just as expected, Nishi gives a nod.

strings.text:
何から何まで西の敷いたレールを走っているようで
あまりいい気分はしなかったが、今は黙っておく事
にした。
strings.translated: It felt like I was running along rails that Nishi had laid out from start to finish, and I didn't much like the feeling -- but I decided to keep my mouth shut for now.

strings.text:
煉悟
「実戦で使ったら報告しろってんだろ。
　そのくらいはやってやる」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"You want me to report back if I use it in a real fight. Fine, I'll do at least that much."

strings.text:
西
「ありがとう。期待しているよ」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"Thank you. I'm counting on you."

strings.text: 口先を尖らせて、怪蟲のほうに視線を戻す。
strings.translated: I curl my lip and turn my gaze back toward the freak Bug.

strings.text:
――と、ビー玉のような目が、じっとオレのほうを
見つめていた。
strings.translated: -- A pair of marble-like eyes were staring straight back at me.

strings.text:
気が合うか合わないか、今の時点では何とも言えな
かった……。
strings.translated: Whether we'd get along or not -- at this point, I honestly couldn't say...

strings.text:
煉悟
「下手にオレが世話しても、十分に餌を与えられるか
　分からねぇしな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I don't know if I can feed it properly
 if I'm the one taking care of it."

strings.text:
西
「なるほど。そういう考え方もあるか」
strings.translated:
Nishi
"I see. That's one way to look at it."

strings.text:
煉悟
「それに、何となくロクな目にあわねーような気もす
　るんでな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Besides, I've got a gut feeling
 it'd only bring me grief."

strings.text:
目を細めて睨み付けると、西の野郎が軽く肩を揺らし
た。
strings.translated: I narrowed my eyes and glared at him, and that bastard Nishi's shoulders shook with a light laugh.

strings.text:
否定しないあたり、オレの直感もまんざらハズレじゃ
ないらしい。
strings.translated: The fact that he didn't deny it told me my instincts weren't too far off the mark.

strings.text:
一瞬、首を絞めてやりたくなったが、ここはぐっと
耐えることにした。
strings.translated: For a moment I wanted to wring his neck, but I held myself back.

strings.text:
煉悟
「適当に他の蟲をよこせ。
　蟲が足んねーのは事実だからな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Just give me some other Bugs instead.
 It's true I'm running short on them."

strings.text:
西
「分かった。用意しよう」

オレの要求に、西は変わらぬ笑みを浮かべながら頷い
た……。
strings.translated: Nishi nodded at my request, that same smile never leaving his face...

strings.text:
煉悟
「この辺まで来ればいいか……」

西の屋敷を出てから、オレはどうにかこの場所まで
怪蟲を運び込んでいた。
strings.translated: After leaving Nishi's mansion, I had somehow managed to haul the freak Bug all the way out here.

strings.text:
まあ、森の近くまで自動車で送ってもらったのだが、
それを差し引いてもコイツを移動させるのは楽じゃな
い。
strings.translated: Well, he did have someone drive me close to the forest by car, but even accounting for that, moving this thing was no easy task.

strings.text:
小型犬サイズの異生物となると、人目につかないよう
にするのは一苦労だった。
strings.translated: Keeping something the size of a small dog out of sight was a real ordeal.

strings.text:
今は夜だからマシだが、昼間はとても持ち運びできる
ような蟲じゃない。
strings.translated: It was easier now since it was nighttime, but this was not a Bug you could carry around in broad daylight.

strings.text:
つまり、この蟲を使う以上、敵を迎え撃つという方法
しか取れないという事だ。
strings.translated: In other words, as long as I was using this Bug, my only option was to wait and intercept the enemy.

strings.text:
煉悟
「それはそれで厄介だな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"That's its own kind of headache."

strings.text:
小僧をおびき出すにしても、かなり場所が限定されて
しまう。
strings.translated: Even if I wanted to lure the kid out, my options for location were severely limited.

strings.text:
隠れ家で戦うのは避けたいが、その近くでしか戦えそ
うにないのもまた事実だった。
strings.translated: I wanted to avoid fighting at my hideout, but the truth was I couldn't seem to fight anywhere far from it either.

strings.text:
煉悟
「もっと小さくなってくれりゃ便利なんだがな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"It'd sure be handy if you could shrink down a little."

strings.text: 怪蟲は、大人しくオレの後を付いてくる。
strings.translated: The freak Bug followed quietly behind me.

strings.text:
脚があるわりには、ズリズリと地面を擦る音が聞こえ
た。
strings.translated: Despite having legs, I could hear a dragging, scraping sound as it moved along the ground.

strings.text:
何か物音がしたような気がして振り返ると、怪蟲の
胴体から太い触手が伸びていた。
strings.translated: I thought I heard something and turned around -- a thick tentacle had extended from the freak Bug's body.

strings.text:
先端には首を絞められた小鳥がいて、どうやら即死し
ているらしく、無抵抗に怪蟲の口の中に消えていった。
strings.translated: At the tip was a small bird with a wrung neck, apparently dead on the spot, and it disappeared into the freak Bug's mouth without a struggle.

strings.text:
悪食、と言うべきか、とにかく餌となる生物の規模が
普通の蟲とは完全に違っていた。
strings.translated: Voracious was one word for it -- in any case, the scale of prey this thing fed on was completely different from any ordinary Bug.

strings.text:
怪蟲の触手が、オレの服の内側にまで滑り込もうとし
ていた。
strings.translated: One of the freak Bug's tentacles was trying to slip inside my clothes.

strings.text:
すぐに距離を取りながら叩き落とすが、それでも触手
はゆっくりと近付いて来る。
strings.translated: I quickly put distance between us and knocked it away, but the tentacle kept slowly creeping closer.

strings.text: 服の内側には、仕込んでいるオレの蟲が数匹いた。
strings.translated: Inside my clothes, I had several of my own Bugs stashed away.

strings.text:
煉悟
「食い意地の張ったヤツだな」
直感的に――危険を感じた――――。

当たり前だが、コイツはまだ完全にオレの蟲になった
わけじゃない。
strings.translated: Obviously, this thing hadn't fully become my Bug yet.

strings.text:
コイツが餌と見なせば、オレの所有する蟲も容赦なく
餌になるのだ。
strings.translated: If it decided something was prey, even the Bugs I owned would be devoured without mercy.

strings.text:
それを止める事が、今の段階で果たして可能なのかど
うか……。
strings.translated: Whether it was even possible to stop that at this stage...

strings.text:
煉悟
「ちったぁ我慢しろよ。
　戦力がお前一匹ってわけにゃいかねぇんだ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Show a little restraint.
 I can't have you be my only fighting force."

strings.text:
ぼやきながら後ずさりするが、それを追うようにして
怪蟲が前進して来る。
strings.translated: I muttered and backed away, but the freak Bug advanced as if to pursue me.
In short, it was dead set on eating.

strings.text: さて、これをどう収めたもんか……。
strings.translated: Now, how was I supposed to handle this...

strings.text:
触手はしつこくオレを追いかけてきて、懐の蟲を諦め
る気配は全くなかった。
strings.translated: The tentacle kept stubbornly chasing after me, showing no sign of giving up on the Bugs in my pocket.

strings.text:
まともに戦っても、オレの持ってる蟲で敵うはずがな
い。
strings.translated: Even if I fought it head-on, there was no way the Bugs I had could match it.

strings.text:
かといって、このままみすみす蟲を食わせるわけにも
いかない。
strings.translated: But I couldn't just stand here and let it eat my Bugs either.

strings.text: じりじりと後ずさりしながら考えていると――――
strings.translated: As I backed away slowly, racking my brain --

strings.text: ポケットの中に、三本の蟲筒がある感触を覚えた。
strings.translated: I felt something in my pocket -- three Bug tubes.

strings.text:
こんな物あったか、と思ったが、以前西からサービス
としてもらった蟲だ。
strings.translated: I wondered when I'd gotten those, then remembered -- they were Bugs Nishi had given me as a bonus a while back.

strings.text:
貰いっぱなしですっかり忘れてたが、コイツなら或い
は――――
strings.translated: I'd completely forgotten about them since he gave them to me, but with these, maybe --

strings.text:
煉悟
「少し痛い目を見せてやるか」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Maybe I should give it a little taste of pain."

strings.text: 蟲筒を取り出して、怪蟲のほうに向ける。
strings.translated: I pulled out the Bug tube and aimed it at the freak Bug.

strings.text:
敵うとは思ってないが、上手くコントロールすれば、
大人しくさせる事くらいはできるかもしれない。
strings.translated:
I didn't think I could beat it, but if I controlled things carefully,
maybe I could at least calm it down.

strings.text:
オレは、一縷の望みを託すようにして、蟲筒の中身を
放った。
strings.translated:
Clinging to that slim hope, I released the contents
of the Bug tube.

strings.text: 激痛がオレを襲ったのは、蟲を放った直後だった。
strings.translated: The searing pain hit me the instant I released the Bug.

strings.text:
首に焼けるような痛みが広がり、全身から一気に汗が
噴き出す。
strings.translated:
A burning agony spread across my throat, and sweat burst
from every pore all at once.

strings.text:
視線を落とすと、放った蟲がオレの喉に食らい付いて
いた。
strings.translated:
When I looked down, the Bug I'd released had sunk its fangs
into my throat.

strings.text:
いったい何が起こったのか、この時点でも、まだオレ
は理解していなかった。
strings.translated:
Even at that point, I still didn't understand
what had just happened.

strings.text:
煉悟
（狂ってやがるのか？）
暴走という言葉が頭に浮かぶ。
strings.translated: The word "rampage" floated into my mind.

strings.text: 術者が未熟な場合、たまに蟲が襲い掛かって来る現象。
strings.translated: When the user lacks skill, Bugs sometimes turn and attack -- that phenomenon.

strings.text:
滅多に起きないはずだが、西の改良した蟲なら考えら
れないこともない。
strings.translated:
It rarely happens, but with Bugs that Nishi had modified,
it wasn't entirely unthinkable.

strings.text: オレの制御の及ばない蟲を――――――

蟲の牙が喉を食い破った瞬間、オレの世界は赤一色に
染まった。
strings.translated:
The moment the Bug's fangs tore through my throat, my world
was dyed a single shade of red.

strings.text:
全身はやけにふわふわしていて、赤い液体の中を浮か
んでいるように感じられる。
strings.translated:
My whole body felt strangely weightless, as if I were
floating through a sea of red liquid.

strings.text:
それは、射精にも似た快感があり、思わず体がびくび
くと震えてしまうほどだった。
strings.translated:
There was a pleasure to it not unlike climax, enough to make
my body shudder and convulse against my will.

strings.text: これが――オレの人生の終わりだった――――。
strings.translated: This was -- the end of my life -- -- -- --.

strings.text:
オレは蟲どもに合図を下すと、森の奥へ逃げるよう
指示した。
strings.translated:
I signaled my Bugs and ordered them to flee
deep into the forest.

strings.text:
戦っても勝てないのなら、せめて数が減らないように
するべきだ。
strings.translated:
If fighting meant losing, the least I could do
was keep the numbers from dwindling.

strings.text:
服の内側から、十匹以上の蟲が飛び出したが、怪蟲の
伸ばした触手によって次々と捕獲されていった。
strings.translated:
More than ten Bugs burst out from inside my clothes, but the freak Bug's
stretching tentacles snatched them up one after another.

strings.text:
捕まった蟲どもは、あっと言う間に怪蟲の口へと運ば
れ、あとはバリバリムシャムシャと美味しく平らげら
れていく。
strings.translated:
The captured Bugs were whisked into the freak Bug's maw in no time at all,
and then devoured with a crunch and a munch, every last one.

strings.text:
しかも、図体の割には素早い動きで蟲どもを追いかけ、
茂みの奥へと消えていった。
strings.translated:
On top of that, it chased after my Bugs with movements surprisingly swift for its size,
and vanished into the depths of the undergrowth.

strings.text: やがて、森の奥から騒々しい音が聞こえ始め――――
strings.translated: Before long, a clamorous noise began rising from deep in the forest -- -- -- --

strings.text:
煉悟
「どうだ？　満足したかァ？」

もはや諦めの境地に立って、オレは疲れ果てた声を
漏らした。
strings.translated:
Having reached a state of pure resignation, I let out
an utterly exhausted groan.

strings.text: 最終的に食われた蟲の数は八匹。
strings.translated: In the end, eight of my Bugs had been eaten.

strings.text:
今の手持ちの数を考えると、決して楽観視できない
損失だった。
strings.translated:
Considering how many I had on hand right now, it was a loss
I couldn't afford to take lightly.

strings.text: まさか、こんなに悪食な奴だったとは……。
strings.translated: I never expected the thing to be such a glutton...

strings.text:
怪蟲の強さを実感することはできたが、オレが扱いき
れるのかという不安は残る。
strings.translated:
I'd gotten a real sense of the freak Bug's strength, but the worry
of whether I could actually handle it still lingered.

strings.text:
煉悟
「コイツで襲わせて、トドメはオレの蟲でやったほう
　が確実かもな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"It might be more reliable to use this thing for the initial assault
 and finish the job with my own Bugs."

strings.text:
まだ見ぬ敵との戦いを頭の中でシミュレートしながら、
オレは怪蟲を見つめた。
strings.translated:
Running simulations in my head of battles against enemies yet unseen,
I stared at the freak Bug.

strings.text:
腹がいっぱいになったからなのか、怪蟲は気持ち悪い
くらい大人しかった……。
strings.translated:
Maybe because its belly was full, the freak Bug was disturbingly
docile...

strings.text:
いつものようにソファーで眠っていたオレが起きる
と、小娘が驚いたような声を上げた。
strings.translated:
When I woke up from sleeping on the sofa as usual,
the little girl let out a startled cry.

strings.text:
一体何をしていたのか、倉庫の隅のほうで床面に膝を
つけて座っている。
strings.translated:
Whatever she'd been doing, she was kneeling on the floor
over in the corner of the warehouse.

strings.text: その視線の反対側を見てみると――――
strings.translated: I looked in the direction opposite her gaze, and -- -- -- --

strings.text:
煉悟
「……まだ生きてやがったのか」
小娘の反対側で、一匹の蟲が蠢いていた。
strings.translated: On the far side from the girl, a single Bug was squirming.

strings.text:
全身、緑色の体液で汚れてはいるが、それは紛れもな
く例の『期待外れ』だった。
strings.translated:
Its whole body was smeared with green fluid, but it was unmistakably
that same "disappointment" from before.

strings.text:
そういえば死骸がどっか行ったとかって話だったが、
どうやら死んでなかったらしい。
strings.translated:
Come to think of it, there'd been talk of the corpse going missing somewhere --
it seemed it hadn't been dead after all.

strings.text:
だが、あれだけオレの蟲どもに食い付かれていた事を
考えると、俄かには信じがたい光景だった。
strings.translated:
But given how thoroughly my Bugs had been gnawing on it,
it was a sight I could barely bring myself to believe.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ただの蟲じゃないってのは間違いないみたいだな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Looks like there's no doubt it's no ordinary Bug."

strings.text:
あれだけバラバラにされて生きているという事は、
生命力が強いとか言うレベルじゃない。
strings.translated:
The fact that it was still alive after being torn apart like that
was beyond anything you could call mere vitality.

strings.text:
見た目よりずっと液状系の蟲に近い存在なのか、もし
くは何かしら死なない理由があるのか。
strings.translated:
Whether it's closer in nature to a liquid-type Bug than it appears, or
whether it has some reason it simply cannot die --

strings.text:
まあ、どっちにしても、戦力の増強になるとは思えな
いのだが……。
strings.translated:
Either way, I couldn't see it becoming any kind of
reinforcement...

strings.text:
煉悟
「それは、食わせるつもりか？」
蟲の傍らには、二、三枚のクッキーが置かれていた。
strings.translated: Beside the Bug, two or three cookies had been set out.

strings.text:
最初は何故そんな場所にあるのか分からなかったが、
どうやら小娘が用意したらしい。
strings.translated:
At first I couldn't figure out why they were there,
but it seemed the girl had prepared them.

strings.text:
夢美
「お、お腹、空いてる、みたいだったから……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It... it looked like it was... hungry..."

strings.text:
遠くから見守っているつもりだったらしい小娘が、
青褪めた顔をしながら答える。
strings.translated:
The girl, who had apparently been trying to watch from a distance,
answered with a pale face.

strings.text: 蟲に情でも移ったのかどうか知らんが馬鹿な奴だ。
strings.translated: I don't know if she'd grown attached to the Bug or what, but what a fool.

strings.text:
結論から言って蟲はそんな物は食わないし、食ったと
ころで大した栄養分にはならない。
strings.translated:
To put it plainly, Bugs don't eat that sort of thing, and even if they did,
it wouldn't amount to much nutrition.

strings.text:
本気で餌を与えるつもりなら、外に出て昆虫でも獲ら
せたほうが手っ取り早かった。
strings.translated:
If she genuinely wanted to feed it, it would've been faster
to go outside and catch some insects.

strings.text:
煉悟
「本気で食わせる気があるんなら、テメーのマン汁で
　も啜らせてやるんだな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"If you're serious about feeding it, you'd better let it
  lap up your pussy juice."

strings.text:
煉悟
「マ○コから出た、テメーのいやらしー汁の事だよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"The nasty slick that drips out of your c**t, that's what."

strings.text:
オレの言っている事の意味を理解したらしく、小娘の
頬にさっと赤みが差す。
strings.translated:
She seemed to grasp what I was saying, and a flush
spread quickly across the girl's cheeks.

strings.text:
煉悟
「言っとくが冗談じゃないぜ？
　蟲は人間の体液でも栄養分にできるからな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I'm not joking, just so you know.
  Bugs can get nutrition from human bodily fluids."

strings.text:
煉悟
「簡単な話だろ。
　ソイツの前で股ァ開けば勝手に吸い付いて来る」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Simple enough, isn't it?
  Just spread your legs in front of it and it'll latch on by itself."

strings.text:
煉悟
「吸い付いてこなかったら、それだけ弱ってるって事
　だ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"If it doesn't latch on, that just means
  it's that much weaker."

strings.text:
煉悟
「マ○コかケツの穴に、テメーで直接触手をぶち込ん
　でやるんだな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"In that case, you shove its tentacles straight into
  your c**t or your ass yourself."

strings.text:
ちらりと蟲のほうを見つめて、小娘が恥ずかしそうに
うつむく。
strings.translated: She glanced over at the Bug, then looked down shyly.

strings.text:
まさか本気で実行するとは思えないが、実行したらし
たで見物だった。
strings.translated:
I didn't really think she'd actually go through with it, but if she did,
it would be quite a sight.

strings.text:
小娘の顔が、急に恐怖に凍り付いたようになったので
何かと思ったが、倉庫の入り口のところにいる怪蟲に
ようやく気付いたらしい。
strings.translated:
The girl's face suddenly froze with terror, and I wondered what had happened --
but it seemed she'd finally noticed the freak Bug
waiting at the entrance to the warehouse.

strings.text:
どうやら悲鳴すら上げられない様子で、唇が小刻みに
わなないていた。
strings.translated:
She didn't even seem able to scream; her lips were
trembling in tiny, rapid shivers.

strings.text:
煉悟
「楽しみにしてろよ。
　いずれコイツの仔を孕ませてやるからよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Look forward to it.
  Sooner or later I'll have this thing knock you up."

strings.text:
小娘の体がびくんっと震え、顔面がさらに蒼白になっ
た。
strings.translated:
The girl's body gave a violent shudder, and her face
went even more deathly pale.

strings.text:
初めて蟲に犯された時の記憶が甦ってきたようで、
全身がガタガタと震え始める。
strings.translated:
It seemed the memory of the first time she'd been violated by a Bug had come rushing back,
and her whole body began to tremble uncontrollably.

strings.text:
本当なら今すぐに犯してやりたいところだが、さすが
に連れて来たばかりの怪蟲でそれをするのは躊躇われ
る。
strings.translated:
Honestly I'd have liked to violate her right then and there, but I hesitated
to do that with a freak Bug I'd only just brought in.

strings.text:
下手に人間の体液の味を占められると、オレにまで
危険が及ぶ可能性があるからだ。
strings.translated:
If it got a taste for human bodily fluids too carelessly,
there was a chance the danger would extend to me as well.

strings.text:
もう少しオレが飼い主だと教え込んでからでも、遅く
はない……。
strings.translated:
There was no rush -- I could afford to wait until I'd drilled it into the thing
that I was its master...

strings.text:
オレは、怪蟲を倉庫の隅のほうに待機させると、ごろ
んとソファーに寝転がって、暫く眠ることにした。
strings.translated:
I had the freak Bug stand by in the corner of the warehouse, then
flopped down on the sofa and decided to sleep for a while.

strings.text: 小娘はずっと、ガタガタと震えていた……。
strings.translated: The girl kept trembling the whole time...

strings.text:
煉悟
「ま、好きにしろ。
　どうせ期待外れのゴミ蟲だ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, do whatever you want.
  It's just a worthless disappointment of a Bug anyway."

strings.text:
煉悟
「生きてたところで、何の役にも立ちゃしない」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Even if it stays alive, it won't be any use to anyone."

strings.text:
挑発するように言ってみたが、小娘の反応は変わらな
かった。
strings.translated: I said it to provoke her, but the girl's reaction didn't change.

strings.text:
どうも本気で悩んでいるようだが、コイツは自分自身
が餌とそう変わりない立場だって事を、まだちゃんと
理解していないらしい。
strings.translated:
She seemed to be genuinely troubled, but it seemed she still hadn't properly
understood that she herself was in a position not so different from the Bug's -- just another piece of feed.

strings.text: しょせんは、どちらも道具。
strings.translated: In the end, both were just tools.

strings.text:
『苗床』も『蟲』も、オレにとっては生きるための
踏み台でしかない。
strings.translated:
"Seedbed" and "Bug" alike -- to me, they were nothing more than
stepping stones for survival.

strings.text:
その事実を、今後の中でじっくりと教え込んでやるの
は、ひとつの暇潰しになりそうだった……。
strings.translated:
Drilling that fact into her over time was shaping up to be
a fine way to pass the hours...

strings.text:
その異変に気付いたのは、ちょうど昼飯を食おうかと
考えていた頃だった。
strings.translated:
I noticed the change right around the time I was thinking
I ought to eat lunch.

strings.text:
何気なくソファーの下に目をやって、そこにいるはず
の蟲どもを確認しようとする。
strings.translated:
I casually glanced under the sofa, intending to check
on the Bugs that should have been there.

strings.text:
だが、いつもなら遠くからでも一、二匹は見えるはず
のものが、今日に限ってサッパリ見つからない。
strings.translated:
But where I'd normally be able to spot one or two of them even from a distance,
today I couldn't find a single one.

strings.text:
不審に思ってソファーの下を覗き込んでみると、オレ
の蟲は一匹もいなくなっていた。
strings.translated:
Suspicious, I crouched down and peered under the sofa --
not one of my Bugs was there.

strings.text: どこか別の場所に待機させていただろうか。
strings.translated: Had I stationed them somewhere else?

strings.text:
記憶をたどりながら室内を見回し、そしてふと怪蟲の
周りがやけに汚れているのに気付いた。
strings.translated:
I searched my memory and scanned the room, and then I happened to notice
that the area around the freak Bug was unusually filthy.

strings.text:
目を凝らしてみると、小さな肉片が幾つか転がってい
る。
strings.translated: Squinting to get a better look, I could see several small scraps of flesh scattered about.

strings.text:
今にも暴れ出したくなる衝動を抑え込みながら、ゆっ
くりと怪蟲へと近付いていく。
strings.translated: Suppressing the urge to fly into a rage, I slowly approached the freak Bug.

strings.text: 怪蟲は、臆した様子もなくその場でじっとしていた。
strings.translated: The freak Bug sat perfectly still, showing no sign of fear.
My suspicion had been right on the mark.

strings.text: 怪蟲の口の周りが、蟲の体液で汚れている。
strings.translated: The freak Bug's mouth was stained with the bodily fluids of my Bugs.

strings.text:
おそらくは昨日の晩の内に、美味しくいただかれてし
まったようだった。
strings.translated: It seemed they had been enjoyed as a tasty meal sometime during the previous night.

strings.text:
煉悟
「ふっざけんなよ、テメェ……」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"You've got to be kidding me..."

strings.text: 頭の血管が何本か切れた気がした。
strings.translated: I felt like several blood vessels in my head had just burst.

strings.text: だが、今はコイツに構ってる場合じゃない。
strings.translated: But now wasn't the time to deal with this thing.

strings.text:
一体何匹の蟲が餌食になったのか、その確認が最優先
だった。
strings.translated: My first priority was figuring out exactly how many of my Bugs had fallen prey to it.

strings.text: ……結論から言えば、見事に全滅だったわけだが。
strings.translated: To put it plainly, they had been wiped out completely.

strings.text:
煉悟
「厄介なもん持って来ちまったかもしんねぇな」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"I might've brought something real troublesome home with me."

strings.text: こうなっては、腹を括るしかない。
strings.translated: There was nothing left to do but steel myself and accept it.

strings.text:
今から新しい蟲を産ませるだけの時間はないし、それ
をしたところで奴の蟲に敵いはしない。
strings.translated: I didn't have time to breed new Bugs from scratch, and even if I did, they wouldn't stand a chance against his Bugs.

strings.text:
オレにできる事と言えば、この場所が奴に見つかる前
に、こっちから勝負を仕掛ける事くらいだった。
strings.translated: The only thing I could do was strike first, before he tracked down this location.

Rengo
"No choice but to go for it."

strings.text: 低い声でつぶやいて、オレは深々と溜息をついた……。
strings.translated: I muttered in a low voice and let out a long, heavy sigh...

strings.text:
夕方近くになって隣の部屋を覗いてみると、小娘の
様子がおかしい事に気付いた。
strings.translated: When I peeked into the next room toward evening, I noticed the girl was acting strange.

strings.text: 床の一点をじっと見て、ぴくりとも動こうとしない。
strings.translated: She was staring fixedly at a single point on the floor, not moving a muscle.

strings.text:
釣られてその方向に目を向けてみると、『期待外れ』
が丸まって横向きになっていた。
strings.translated: Following her gaze, I saw that "Disappointment" had curled up and was lying on its side.

strings.text:
夢美
「動かなく……なっちゃった……」

煉悟
「くたばったんだろ」
放心した様子の小娘に、単純な事実を突き付ける。
strings.translated: I laid the simple truth out for the dazed girl.

strings.text:
もともと、今日まで生きていたほうが不思議だったの
だ。
strings.translated: Honestly, it was more surprising that it had survived this long to begin with.

strings.text: これでやっと、目障りなものがひとつ消えた。
strings.translated: At least now one eyesore was gone.

strings.text:
煉悟
「これで、お前のガキどもは殆どくたばったなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"That means almost all your little brats are dead now."

strings.text:
ニヤニヤと笑いながら言ってやると、小娘がどこか
驚いたようにオレを見上げた。
strings.translated: I said it with a smirk, and the girl looked up at me with something like surprise.

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲……死んじゃったの……？」

煉悟
「まあ、色々あってな。残ってるのは殆どいねーよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Well, a lot happened. Barely any of them are left."

strings.text:
煉悟
「さすがにお前のガキだ。
　ロクに盾にもなりゃしねぇ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Figures, coming from your brood.
 They weren't worth a damn as shields."

strings.text: 小娘が呆然とした顔を浮かべる。

どうやら、自分が産んだ蟲がもう死んでいたというの
が、かなり意外だったらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed she was genuinely caught off guard to learn that the Bugs she had birthed were already dead.

strings.text:
しばらく視線を宙に漂わせたあと、また『期待外れ』
を見てぽつりとつぶやいた。
strings.translated: After letting her gaze drift through the air for a moment, she looked back at "Disappointment" and murmured softly.

strings.text:
夢美
「お墓……作ってあげてもいい？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Can I... make a grave for it?"

strings.text:
煉悟
「ゴミ箱にでも捨てとけ」
吐き捨てるように言って、オレは小娘に背中を向けた。
strings.translated: I spat the words out and turned my back on the girl.

strings.text:
今更、『期待外れ』がどうなったところで、何かが
変わるわけじゃない。
strings.translated: At this point, nothing was going to change no matter what happened to "Disappointment."

strings.text:
当面の問題は、『レンと戦うまでに、オレに何が出来
るか』と言う事だった……。
strings.translated: The pressing issue at hand was -- what could I do before the fight with Ren...

strings.text:
何ヶ月ぶりかと言うトレーニングを終えて、オレは
疲れ果てた体をソファーに横たえた。
strings.translated: After finishing my first training session in what felt like months, I collapsed my exhausted body onto the sofa.

strings.text:
さすがに、あんな化け物みたいな蟲を、訓練も無しに
実戦で使う気にはなれない。
strings.translated: I couldn't bring myself to use a monster Bug like that in actual combat without any preparation.

strings.text:
強力なのは確かなのだから、オレが完全に使いこなせ
るようになれば、誰が相手でも敵じゃねぇ。
strings.translated: It was undeniably powerful -- if I could master it completely, no one would be a match for me.

strings.text: そう考えると、肉体に感じる疲労も妙に心地良かった。
strings.translated: Thinking about it that way, even the fatigue weighing on my body felt strangely satisfying.

strings.text:
さすがに、産まれて数日しか経っていない蟲を、その
まま実戦で使う気にはなれない。
strings.translated: Still, I couldn't bring myself to throw a Bug that had only been born a few days ago straight into real combat.

strings.text:
今のうちに戦い方ってもんをみっちりと教え込んで、
オレの手足に仕立て上げる必要があった。
strings.translated: I needed to drill it thoroughly on how to fight and shape it into a proper extension of myself.

strings.text:
煉悟
「問題なのは残された時間か……」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"The problem is how much time I have left..."

strings.text:
状況を考えると、今は少しでも蟲と同調する訓練に
時間を費やすべきだ。
strings.translated: Given the situation, I should be spending every spare moment training to synchronize with the Bug.

strings.text:
果たして、その時間がどの程度あるのかは分からない
が、やった分だけはしっかり力になるだろう。
strings.translated:
I had no way of knowing just how much time I had left,
but whatever effort I put in would surely pay off.

strings.text:
煉悟
「昔は、よくこんなの毎日やってたよなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Man... I used to do this kind of thing every single day back then."

strings.text: そっとまぶたを閉じて、昔のことに思いを馳せる。
strings.translated: I gently closed my eyes and let my thoughts drift back to the past.

strings.text:
蟲を使うだけ技能を磨かせられた日々は、オレにとっ
て地獄以外のなにものでもなかった。
strings.translated:
Those days of being pushed to hone my skills with nothing but Bugs were,
for me, nothing short of hell.

strings.text: 結界の張られた閉鎖空間。
strings.translated: A sealed, enclosed space surrounded by barrier wards.

strings.text:
互いを常に監視するような人間関係は、思い出すだけ
でも反吐が出そうになる。
strings.translated:
The way everyone constantly watched each other -- just remembering it
was enough to make me sick.

strings.text: あの一族は異常なのだ。

蟲のような異生物と生きてる人間が、正常なわけはな
いのだ。
strings.translated: People who lived alongside alien creatures like Bugs could never be normal.

strings.text: 子供の頃から過酷な訓練を強いるのも――――
strings.translated: Forcing brutal training on children from an early age --------

strings.text: その結果、死者が出ても良しとする考え方も――――
strings.translated: And the mindset that accepted deaths as a result --------

strings.text: 女の胎を介して蟲を産むのも――――
strings.translated: Birthing Bugs through a woman's womb --------

strings.text:
他にも色々あるが、そういうものを全てひっくるめて、
あの一族はおかしいのだ。
strings.translated:
There were plenty of other things too, but taking all of it together,
that clan was simply wrong.

strings.text:
頭のどこかが狂った連中の集まりが、『蟲使い』なの
だ。
strings.translated:
A gathering of people with something twisted in their heads -- that was
what "Bug Users" were.

strings.text: だから、逃げ出す連中は正常。
strings.translated: So those who ran away were the sane ones.

strings.text: 正常だから、一族のもとでは暮らせない。
strings.translated: Because they were sane, they couldn't live among the clan.

strings.text: 暮らせないから、逃げ出す。
strings.translated: Because they couldn't live there, they ran.

strings.text: それが、今の蟲使いの姿だった。
strings.translated: That was the reality of Bug Users today.

strings.text:
煉悟
「殺されてたまるかよ」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Like hell I'm going to let them kill me."

strings.text:
煉悟
「あんな狂った連中に殺されてたまるかよっ！」
strings.translated:
Rengo
"Like hell I'm going to let a bunch of twisted freaks like that kill me!"

strings.text: オレは低い声で叫ぶと、汚れきった天井を睨み付けた。
strings.translated: I snarled in a low voice and glared up at the filth-stained ceiling.

strings.text:
ようやく、それなりに安定した今の生活を手に入れた
のだ。
strings.translated: I had finally managed to build a life that was, at least, reasonably stable.

strings.text:
それを、くだらん掟に従う馬鹿どもに壊されるつもり
はなかった。
strings.translated: I had no intention of letting a pack of idiots who followed some worthless code tear it apart.

strings.text:
煉悟
「オレは……絶対に殺されねぇ…………ッ！」

誓いにも似たオレの言葉は、虚空へと吸い込まれ消え
ていった……。
strings.translated: Those words, almost like a vow, were swallowed up by the empty air and vanished...

strings.text:
煉悟がいなくなってからも、少女は部屋でぼんやりと
時を過ごしていた。
strings.translated: Even after Rengo was gone, the girl sat in the room, idly letting time pass.
There was nothing in particular to do.

strings.text: 今は空腹も感じていない。
strings.translated: She wasn't feeling hungry right now.

strings.text:
退屈だが痛みを伴うような事をされないだけ、幸せな
時間だった。
strings.translated: It was dull, but at least nothing was being done to cause her pain -- in that sense, it was a peaceful time.

strings.text:
ドア付近の壁にいた黒い影に、少女は短く悲鳴を上げ
た。
strings.translated: The girl let out a short shriek at the dark shadow clinging to the wall near the door.

strings.text:
びくっと体を震わせて後ずさりすると、そこにいるも
のに目を凝らす。
strings.translated: She flinched, her body trembling as she backed away, then strained her eyes to make out what was there.

strings.text:
最初は信じられなかったが、部屋にいたのは間違いな
く、あの『期待外れ』の蟲だった。
strings.translated: She couldn't believe it at first, but there was no mistaking it -- the thing in the room was that "disappointment" of a Bug.

strings.text:
昨日は死んだと思ったため、倉庫の隅に隠すように
安置したのだが、どうやら生きていたらしい。
strings.translated: She had thought it was dead yesterday, so she had tucked it away in a corner of the warehouse -- but apparently it had survived.

strings.text:
それは、少女にとって嬉しいような、そうでないよう
