strings.text:
優斗
「違う違うっ！　彼女じゃないっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"No no no! She's not my girlfriend!!"

strings.text:
優斗
「その……映画に付き合ってもらってるだけだ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"It's just... she's keeping me company for the movie."

strings.text:
史郎
「ほう、優斗のほうからモーションかけた、と」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"So Yuuto was the one who made a move, then."
It seemed he had dug his own grave.

strings.text:
史郎
「どこで知り合ったの？」

史郎
「あれ？　もしかしてお店？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Wait -- could it be the shop?"

strings.text:
優斗
「俺、毎朝あそこで済ませてるし」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I stop by there every morning."

strings.text:
史郎
「へーっ、そうだったのか」

史郎
「おっと、悪い。素直に答えられるはずないよね」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Oops, my bad. Can't exactly answer that honestly, can you."

strings.text:
史郎
「要するに初デートってことか」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"So basically, this is a first date."

strings.text:
史郎
「あっちに行くって事は映画だろ？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Heading over that way means it's a movie, right?"

strings.text:
史郎
「手を握ることばっかり意識して、終わったら映画の
　内容覚えてませんとかでした、とかってならないよ
　うにな」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Just make sure you don't spend the whole time thinking about holding her hand and end up not remembering a single thing about the movie afterward."

strings.text:
優斗
「そ、そんなこと考えてないっ！」

顔を真っ赤にして叫ぶ優斗に、夢美は史郎と同じ事を
考えてしまった。
strings.translated: Yumemi found herself thinking the exact same thing as Shirou as Yuuto shouted back, his face bright red.

strings.text:
もっとも、この反応を見れば百人が百人、同じ事を
思うのだろうが……。
strings.translated: Though, given that reaction, any one of a hundred people would have thought the same thing...

strings.text:
夢美
（嘘がつけない人なんだ……）

しどろもどろになる優斗を見ながら、夢美は内心そん
な事を思っていた。
strings.translated: Watching Yuuto stumble over his words, Yumemi quietly thought to herself.

strings.text:
史郎
「ま、あんまり邪魔するのも悪いし、今日はこのくら
　いにしてやるよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Well, I've bothered you two enough. I'll leave it at that for today."

strings.text:
史郎
「それじゃあ、夢美ちゃん。
　また今度、お店のほう行くからね」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Take care then, Yumemi-chan.
 I'll be stopping by the shop again sometime."

strings.text:
夢美
「あ、はい。ありがとうございます」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Oh, yes. Thank you very much."

strings.text: 大きく手を振って、史郎が二人を通り過ぎていく。
strings.translated: Waving broadly, Shirou walked past the two of them.

strings.text:
夢美と優斗はその背中を見つめながら、ほぅっと息を
漏らしていた。
strings.translated: Yumemi and Yuuto watched his retreating figure and let out a quiet sigh.

strings.text:
夢美
「大学のお友達ですか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Is he a friend from university?"

strings.text:
優斗
「……って言っても、話すようになったのは最近なん
　だけど」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"...Well, we only really started talking recently, though."

strings.text:
夢美
「優しそうな人ですね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"He seems like a kind person."

strings.text:
夢美と史郎が話していると、遠くのほうで史郎が手を
振っていた。
strings.translated: As Yumemi and Yuuto were talking, Shirou could be seen waving from a distance.

strings.text: 何事かと二人で視線を送っていると――――
strings.translated: The two of them looked over, wondering what it was about -- and then --

strings.text:
史郎
「今度一緒に、ＡｎｚＵの制服見に行こうなーっ！」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Let's go check out the AnzU uniforms together sometime!"

strings.text: ――そんな言葉を残して、今度こそ去って行く。
strings.translated: -- leaving those words behind, he finally walked away for good.

strings.text:
後に残された二人、と言うよりも優斗は、唖然とした
表情を浮かべていた。
strings.translated: Left behind -- or rather, Yuuto in particular -- wore a completely dumbfounded expression.

strings.text:
優斗
「あの……俺、制服目当てじゃないから……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Um... I'm not there for the uniforms..."

strings.text:
夢美
「はい……一応……分かってるつもりです」

気まずい空気が流れたまま、二人は暫くその場から
動くことができなかった……。
strings.translated: An awkward silence hung between them, and for a while, neither of them could bring themselves to move.

strings.text:
夢美
「本当にご馳走様でした」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Thank you so much for the meal."

strings.text:
駅前にあるレストランを出て、夢美はぺこりと頭を
下げた。
strings.translated: Stepping out of the restaurant near the station, Yumemi gave a small bow.

strings.text:
時刻は既に午後八時を過ぎており、辺りはとっぷりと
日が暮れている。
strings.translated: It was already past eight in the evening, and the area was wrapped in deep darkness.

strings.text:
肌に触れる空気はやや冷たく、吐く息も微かに白かっ
た。
strings.translated: The air against their skin was slightly cold, and their breath came out faintly white.

strings.text:
優斗
「この時間になると、まだまだ寒いね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"It's still pretty chilly at this hour."

strings.text:
夢美
「でも昼間は結構暑いから、あんまりいっぱい着たく
　ないんですよね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But it gets pretty warm during the day, so I don't really want to wear too many layers."

strings.text:
優斗
「ああ、分かる分かる」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Yeah, I get it, I get it."

strings.text: 映画館を出てから、二人の会話量はぐっと増した。
strings.translated: Since leaving the movie theater, the two of them had talked much more freely.

strings.text:
映画そのものを話題にできたからと言うのが大きな
理由だが、それでも少しずつ他の話もできるように
なっていった。
strings.translated: The biggest reason was simply that the movie itself gave them something to talk about -- but even so, little by little, they had begun to talk about other things too.

strings.text:
互いにまだ緊張している部分はあるが、それでも最初
の頃に比べれば随分マシだ。
strings.translated: There was still some tension between them, but even so, it was far better than when they had first met.

strings.text:
男と二人きりで、しかも夜道でありながら笑顔で会話
ができるのは、夢美にとって大きな進歩と言えた。
strings.translated: For Yumemi, being able to smile and chat alone with a man -- even on a dark night road -- was a significant step forward.

strings.text: やがて、夢美のマンションの前までたどり着いていた。
strings.translated: Before long, they had arrived in front of Yumemi's apartment building.

strings.text:
夢美
「すいません。わざわざ送ってもらっちゃって」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm sorry... you didn't have to walk me all the way home."

strings.text:
優斗
「いや、こっちから誘ったんだし、このくらいはしな
　いとね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"No, I'm the one who asked you out -- the least I could do is walk you back."

strings.text:
夢美
「私、こういうの初めてで……今日は本当に楽しかっ
　たです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I've never done anything like this before... I had a really wonderful time today."

strings.text:
優斗
「そう言ってもらえるとホッとするよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Hearing that is such a relief."

strings.text:
夢美
「それじゃあ……また、お店来て下さいね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well then... please come by the shop again sometime."
A sudden silence fell between them.

strings.text:
あとは別れの言葉を交わせばいいだけのはずなのに、
どちらもそれをする事ができない。
strings.translated: All they needed to do was exchange parting words -- and yet neither of them could bring themselves to do it.

strings.text:
何より優斗の物言いたげな様子が、しっかりと夢美に
も伝わっていた。
strings.translated: Above all, the way Yuuto looked as though he had something more to say came through to Yumemi loud and clear.

strings.text:
優斗
「俺……前から、ずっと君のこと見てて…………」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I... I've been watching you for a while now, and..."

strings.text:
優斗
「いいなって、思ってて……」

優斗
「良かったら、俺と付き合ってくれないかな？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"If it's okay with you... would you go out with me?"

strings.text:
微かに頬を赤くしながらも、優斗が真っ直ぐに夢美を
見つめながら言う。
strings.translated: His cheeks faintly flushed, Yuuto said it while looking straight at Yumemi.

strings.text: それは、何となく予感していた事……。
strings.translated: It was something she had vaguely sensed was coming...

strings.text: いつか来るだろうと思っていた質問。
strings.translated: A question she had thought would arrive someday.

strings.text: それに対する答えを、夢美はまだ用意していなかった。
strings.translated: And yet Yumemi had not prepared an answer for it.

strings.text:
夢美
「あたし、そういうの……ダメなんで……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I... can't do that sort of thing..."

strings.text: 頭で考えるより、そんな言葉が口から飛び出していた。
strings.translated: The words had left her mouth before she had even thought them through.

strings.text:
優斗は少しだけ驚いた様子を見せたが、やがて苦笑い
を浮かべながら少し俯く。
strings.translated: Yuuto looked slightly surprised, but after a moment he let out a wry smile and cast his gaze downward.

strings.text: 小さなつぶやきが、夜気に吸い込まれて消えた。
strings.translated: That small murmur was swallowed up by the night air and vanished.

strings.text: 互いに次の言葉が出ず、暫く無言の時が流れる……。
strings.translated: Neither could find the next words to say, and a long silence passed between them...

strings.text:
夢美は心の中で、自分の口から出た言葉について考え
ていた。
strings.translated: In her heart, Yumemi was turning over the words that had come out of her own mouth.
-- I can't do that sort of thing.

strings.text:
正直なところ、本当にダメなのかどうかすら分からな
い。
strings.translated: Honestly, she wasn't even sure whether that was truly the case.

strings.text:
優斗といる間は楽しかったし、これからもあんな付き
合いができればいいと思う。
strings.translated: She had enjoyed every moment spent with Yuuto, and she hoped they could keep spending time together like that.

strings.text:
だが、いざ告白されると、頭の中に湧いたのは忌まわ
しい過去の出来事だった。
strings.translated: But the moment she was actually confessed to, what rose up in her mind was the memory of a wretched past.

strings.text:
少なくともこの時点において、優斗は夢美の過去を
知らない。
strings.translated: At the very least, at this point in time, Yuuto knew nothing of Yumemi's past.

strings.text:
犯されたことも、蟲を産んだことも、人を殺したこと
も、何一つとして知らないはずだ。
strings.translated: He knew nothing -- not that she had been violated, not that she had given birth to Bugs, not that she had killed someone.

strings.text:
それを、隠したまま付き合っても良いのか、それとも
全てを打ち明けた上で、もう一度優斗に判断してもら
わなければならないのか――――
strings.translated: Was it all right to be with him while keeping all of that hidden -- or did she need to lay everything bare and let Yuuto make his decision again?

strings.text: ――夢美には、その判断が付かなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi could not reach an answer.

strings.text:
夢美の答えを受け止めて、優斗がいつもの笑みを取り
戻す。
strings.translated: Taking in Yumemi's answer, Yuuto reclaimed his usual smile.

strings.text:
多分に強がりは混じっていたが、真っ直ぐに夢美の目
を見つめていた。
strings.translated: There was no small amount of bravado in it -- but he held Yumemi's gaze without looking away.

strings.text:
優斗
「それじゃあ……さよなら…………」
軽く手を振りながら、優斗が夜道に消えていく。
strings.translated: Giving a small wave, Yuuto disappeared into the night.

strings.text:
夢美は暫くそれを見つめていたが、ふと気付くと頬に
涙をこぼしていた。
strings.translated: Yumemi watched him go for a while, and then, before she realized it, tears were spilling down her cheeks.

strings.text: この場合、泣くとしたら優斗のほうだ。
strings.translated: If anyone should be crying here, it was Yuuto.

strings.text: 自分は振った側なのだから、涙など出すべきではない。
strings.translated: She was the one who had turned him down -- she had no right to shed tears.

strings.text: そっと指先で拭うと、吐息を漏らして夜空を見上げた。
strings.translated: She gently wiped her eyes with her fingertips, let out a soft breath, and looked up at the night sky.
This is surely for the best.

strings.text:
本当のことを知られるくらいなら、きっとこういう
終わり方のほうが綺麗なはずだ。
strings.translated: If he ever learned the truth, an ending like this would surely be cleaner.

strings.text: だから、何も泣くことなどない――――。
strings.translated: So there was no reason to cry -- none at all.

strings.text:
小さく嗚咽を漏らしながら、夢美はマンションの中へ
と入っていった。
strings.translated: Stifling a small sob, Yumemi made her way inside the apartment building.

strings.text: 背中を向けたその肩が、微かに上下に震えていた……。
strings.translated: The shoulders of her retreating back trembled faintly, up and down...

strings.text:
夢美
「私なんかの、どこがいいんですか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"What is it you even like about someone like me?"

strings.text:
思ってもみなかった夢美の言葉に、優斗はぽかんとし
た表情を浮かべた。
strings.translated: Caught completely off guard by Yumemi's words, Yuuto's face went blank.

strings.text:
交際に対する答えなのか、それとも別の言葉なのか、
よく分かっていない。
strings.translated:
Whether it was an answer to his confession, or something else entirely --
he could not quite tell.

strings.text:
夢美
「私……昔、誘拐された事があるんです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I was... kidnapped, once. When I was younger."

strings.text:
優斗の混乱を煽るように、夢美が微笑を浮かべながら
言う。
strings.translated: As if to deepen Yuuto's confusion, Yumemi said it with a smile on her face.

strings.text:
その表情は、ＡｎｚＵで見せていた営業スマイルとも、
今日のデートで見せていた可愛らしい笑顔とも違って
いた。
strings.translated: That expression was different from the professional smile she wore at AnzU, and different from the sweet smile she had shown him on their date today.

strings.text:
優斗
「え、と……ごめん、よく聞こえなかった、のかな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Uh... sorry, I don't think I... heard that right."

strings.text:
夢美
「誘拐されたんです。大きな男の人に……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I was kidnapped. By a large man..."

strings.text:
決して知らない言葉ではないはずなのに、優斗は自分
がつぶやいた言葉の意味を理解していなかった。
strings.translated: It was not a word he was unfamiliar with -- and yet Yuuto could not grasp the meaning of what he had just murmured.

strings.text: 頭の中で、『誘拐』以外の漢字を探すが出てこない。
strings.translated: His mind scrambled for any other word to describe it, but nothing came -- nothing except "abduction."

strings.text:
そんな優斗を楽しげに見つめると、夢美はくるりと
背中を向けて足早に歩き始めた。
strings.translated: Watching Yuuto with what seemed like amusement, Yumemi turned her back to him and began walking away at a brisk pace.

strings.text:
マンションから離れるように、逃げるように、暗い
夜道をあても無く進む。
strings.translated: She moved away from the apartment building -- as if fleeing -- pressing forward along the dark road with no particular destination.

strings.text: やや慌てた様子で、優斗もその後を追う。
strings.translated: Looking slightly flustered, Yuuto hurried after her.

strings.text:
だが、夢美の隣に並ぶ事ができず、少し距離を保った
状態で歩いた。
strings.translated: But he could not bring himself to walk beside her, and kept a small distance between them as he followed.

strings.text:
夢美
「一ヶ月くらいかな？
　薄暗い倉庫にずーっと閉じ込められて……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"About a month, I think?
 I was locked up the whole time in a dim warehouse..."

strings.text:
夢美
「私、いつか殺されるって思ってた」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I thought he was going to kill me someday."

strings.text:
夢美
「その男に、私が何をされたか聞きたいですか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Do you want to know what that man did to me?"

strings.text:
慌てるでもなく、驚くでもなく、ましてや夢美を蔑む
こともなく、ただじっと話を聞いている。
strings.translated: He was not flustered, not shocked -- and certainly not looking down on Yumemi. He simply listened in silence.

strings.text:
対して夢美のほうも何かの答えを期待しているわけで
はなかったし、そもそも何を目的として自分がこんな
話を始めたのか分かっていなかった。
strings.translated: For her part, Yumemi was not expecting any particular answer from him -- and she did not even know what had possessed her to start telling him any of this.

strings.text:
黙っていれば知られずに済んだはずの事を、何故だか
わざわざ自分から話している。
strings.translated: This was something that could have stayed hidden forever if she had just kept quiet, and yet here she was, bringing it up herself.

strings.text:
あとで後悔するだろうなと思いながら、どうしても
言葉を止めることができなかった。
strings.translated: She knew she would regret it later -- and still, she could not stop the words from coming.

strings.text:
夢美
「あそこにホテルがありますね」
突然、夢美がぴたりと足を止める。
strings.translated: Suddenly, Yumemi came to a dead stop.

strings.text:
振り向いて笑顔を浮かべ、やや小首を傾げながら口を
開いた。
strings.translated: She turned around, a smile on her face, and tilted her head slightly as she spoke.

strings.text:
ふと気付けば、やや離れたところに小さなホテルが
見えた。
strings.translated: When he looked, he noticed a small hotel a short distance away.

strings.text:
普通のホテルというよりも、どちらかと言えば男女の
関係のために使用される目的のものだ。
strings.translated: It was less of an ordinary hotel and more the kind of establishment used for a particular purpose between men and women.

strings.text:
その意味に気付いた優斗が、悲しそうに表情をゆがめ
る。
strings.translated: Yuuto, realizing what she meant, twisted his face into a pained expression.

strings.text:
優斗
「そんなつもりじゃ、なかったんだけどな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"That wasn't what I had in mind."

strings.text:
夢美
「私も、こんなこと言うつもりじゃなかったんですけ
　どね……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I didn't mean to say something like this either..."

strings.text: 一瞬だけ寂しそうに笑い、夢美がまた背中を向ける。
strings.translated: She smiled for just a moment with a lonely look, then turned her back to him again.

strings.text:
夢美
「私、そんなに初々しい娘じゃないですよ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm not exactly an innocent girl, you know."

strings.text:
どこか冷めた風な夢美の告白を聞いて、優斗は微かに
双眸を細めた。
strings.translated: Hearing Yumemi's confession, delivered in that oddly detached way, Yuuto narrowed his eyes ever so slightly.

strings.text:
口調はサバサバしているのに、何故だかその背中は
悲しげに震えているように見える。
strings.translated: Her tone was breezy and matter-of-fact -- and yet, for some reason, her back looked as though it was trembling with sadness.

strings.text:
夢美の言っている事がどこまで本当かは分からなかっ
たが、ただの冗談には聞こえなかった。
strings.translated: How much of what Yumemi was saying was true, she couldn't be sure -- but it didn't sound like a mere joke.

strings.text: 暫く――どちらも無言で道を歩く――――。
strings.translated: For a while -- both of them walked in silence.

strings.text:
戸惑っているのは実は夢美も同じで、自分でも何故
こんな話をしてしまったのか分からなかった。
strings.translated: In truth, Yumemi was just as flustered, and she herself didn't understand why she had said such a thing.

strings.text:
額には汗が滲み、胸の鼓動は高まり、微かな息苦しさ
さえ感じられる。
strings.translated: Sweat beaded on her forehead, her heart pounded in her chest, and she even felt a faint tightness in her breathing.

strings.text: 誰の目にも、夢美が動揺しているのは明らかだ。
strings.translated: To anyone's eyes, it was plain that Yumemi was shaken.

strings.text:
果たして、今、優斗が何を思っているのかそれを考え
るだけで怖くてたまらなかった。
strings.translated: Just thinking about what Yuuto might be feeling right now was enough to fill her with unbearable dread.

strings.text:
夢美
「それじゃあ、失礼します」

急に挨拶をして、夢美はマンションのほうへ走り始め
た。
strings.translated: With that abrupt farewell, Yumemi broke into a run toward the apartment building.

strings.text: これ以上、あの沈黙した空気に耐えられなかった。
strings.translated: She couldn't bear that suffocating silence any longer.

strings.text: 一体、自分は何をしたいのだろう。
strings.translated: Just what was it she wanted, anyway?

strings.text:
優斗に忌まわしい過去を知ってもらって、それで何を
認めるのだろう。
strings.translated: She had let Yuuto know about her wretched past -- and what did she expect him to accept from that?

strings.text:
考えても出てくるのは涙ばかりで、一度泣き始めると
あとはもう止まらなかった。
strings.translated: No matter how hard she thought, all that came were tears, and once she started crying, there was no stopping.

strings.text:
胸が締め付けられるような思いを抱えながら、夢美は
街灯に照らされた夜道を駆けて行った……。
strings.translated: With a feeling like her chest was being wrung tight, Yumemi ran down the night road bathed in streetlight...

strings.text:
時計の針が正午を回った頃、夢美はベッドの上で丸く
なっていた。
strings.translated: By the time the clock hands had passed noon, Yumemi was curled up on her bed.

strings.text:
何をするでもなく、枕を抱いて、ぼんやりと窓の外を
見つめている。
strings.translated: She wasn't doing anything in particular -- just hugging her pillow, staring vacantly out the window.

strings.text: デートをするには絶好の日和だった。
strings.translated: It was a perfect day for a date.

strings.text:
もう、青年が指定した時間から一時間以上は過ぎてい
る。
strings.translated: It had already been over an hour past the time the young man had specified.

strings.text:
行かなかった理由は特にはないが、行く理由も特には
見当たらなかった。
strings.translated: There was no particular reason she hadn't gone, but she couldn't find any particular reason to go, either.

strings.text: 青年には連絡していない――と言うよりもできない。
strings.translated: She hadn't contacted the young man -- or rather, she couldn't.

strings.text:
考えてみれば携帯電話の番号さえ知らされていないた
め、行かない事を伝えようにも方法がなかった。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, she hadn't even been given his cell phone number, so there was no way to let him know she wasn't coming.

strings.text: 今からでも行ってみるべきだろうか。
strings.translated: Should she try going even now?

strings.text:
よくある映画や小説のように、青年が映画館の前で
ずっと待っている姿を想像して胸がざわついたが、
今更行ったところでかえって気まずくなるだけのよう
な気もする。
strings.translated: Like something out of a movie or novel, she imagined him standing in front of the cinema, waiting and waiting -- and her chest stirred uneasily. But she also had a feeling that showing up at this point would only make things more awkward.

strings.text:
気分を変えるように言って、夢美はベッドの下を覗き
込んだ。
strings.translated: As if to change her mood, Yumemi said that and peered under the bed.

strings.text:
――と、言葉を理解したかのように蟲が這い出てきて、
嬉しそうにピンク色の触手を伸ばした。
strings.translated: As though it had understood her words, the Bug crawled out and happily extended its pink tentacles.

strings.text:
夢美の指と蟲の触手が絡み合い、暫く戯れのような
時間を過ごす。
strings.translated: Yumemi's fingers and the Bug's tentacles intertwined, and they spent a little while in something like play.

strings.text:
人と蟲の間でとれる、数少ないコミュニケーションの
ひとつだ。
strings.translated: It was one of the few forms of communication possible between a person and a Bug.

strings.text:
夢美
「よっし、今日は久々にアンタのご飯でも開発しちゃ
　おう」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Alright, today let's finally develop some new food for you."

strings.text:
夢美
「最近、新メニューがなくて、家でのご飯が偏ってた
　もんね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Lately there haven't been any new menu items, so your meals at home have been getting pretty one-sided."

strings.text:
夢美
「この前は、確か牛肉を食べたはずだから……今日
　は…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Last time I'm pretty sure you had beef, so today..."

strings.text:
一人でブツブツと言いながら、夢美がキッチンへと
向かう。
strings.translated: Muttering to herself, Yumemi headed to the kitchen.

strings.text:
食器棚から一冊の大学ノートを取り出すと、パラパラ
とページをめくってうなり始めた。
strings.translated: She pulled a notebook from the cupboard and began flipping through the pages with a groan.

strings.text:
ノートには、この五年間で発見した蟲に関するあらゆ
る情報、知識が書かれており、特に多いのが食べ物に
ついてだった。
strings.translated: The notebook contained every piece of information and knowledge about Bugs she had discovered over the past five years, and the most numerous entries by far were about food.

strings.text:
最初の頃は何を与えていいのか分からず、人間の食べ
物から動物の餌、果ては漢方薬まで試した時期がある。
strings.translated: In the early days, she had no idea what to feed it, and there was a period when she tried everything from human food to animal feed and even herbal medicine.

strings.text:
結果としては、それなりに何でも食べるようなのだが、
比較的汁気のあるものを好むことが分かってきた。
strings.translated: The result was that it seemed to eat just about anything, but she had come to understand that it preferred things with relatively more liquid.

strings.text:
今のところ大好評なのが、オレンジジュースに桃の缶
詰の汁だけを混ぜたもの。
strings.translated: The current crowd-pleaser was a mix of orange juice with only the syrup from canned peaches.

strings.text:
夢美にはとても飲めたものではなかったが、蟲のほう
は一滴残さず触手で吸い取った。
strings.translated: It was something Yumemi herself could never bring herself to drink, but the Bug sucked it up with its tentacles without leaving a single drop.

strings.text:
夢美
「未だに味覚がよく分かんないのよね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I still can't quite figure out its sense of taste."

strings.text:
果たして、甘いものを甘いと感じているのか、辛いも
のを辛いと感じているのか甚だ疑問だ。
strings.translated: Whether it actually perceived sweet things as sweet, or spicy things as spicy -- that was a profound mystery.

strings.text:
ジュースを好む一方で、先日は生の牛肉を喜んで食べ
ており、蟲のご飯のメニューを増やすのは、今や夢美
の趣味のひとつだった。
strings.translated: On one hand it favored juice, yet just the other day it had happily eaten raw beef, and expanding the Bug's meal menu had become one of Yumemi's hobbies.

strings.text:
夢美
「今日は魚にしてみようかな」
冷蔵庫からアジを取り出し、手早く料理し始める。
strings.translated: She took a horse mackerel out of the refrigerator and began cooking it quickly.

strings.text:
基本的に作るのは自分の食べるもので、蟲の食事は
その余り物が常だ。
strings.translated: Basically, what she cooked was for herself, and the Bug's meal was always whatever was left over.

strings.text:
以前は蟲のためだけに料理していた事もあったのだが、
食べてもらえないと捨てざるを得ない物が出来上がる
場合が多かったため、現在の方法に変えていた。
strings.translated: There had been a time before when she cooked solely for the Bug, but since uneaten food often ended up having to be thrown away, she had switched to the current method.

strings.text:
アジは切れ味の良い包丁によって素早く解体されてい
き、最後には油で揚げられてから揚げになった。
strings.translated: The horse mackerel was swiftly broken down by a sharp knife, and in the end it was deep-fried into karaage.

strings.text:
夢美
「さっ、出来たよーっ！」

テーブルの上に、ご飯と味噌汁、サラダ、そしてアジ
のから揚げを用意する。
strings.translated: She set out rice, miso soup, salad, and the horse mackerel karaage on the table.

strings.text: 夢美はもちろん普通の皿。
strings.translated: Yumemi's food was served on a regular plate, of course.

strings.text:
蟲は、ドッグフードを入れる容器にアジのから揚げが
一つだけ用意されていた。
strings.translated: For the Bug, a single piece of horse mackerel karaage had been placed in a dog food bowl.

strings.text:
ベッドから降りてきた蟲がソファーに這い上がり、
夢美の隣に落ち着く。
strings.translated: The Bug climbed down from the bed, crawled up onto the sofa, and settled in beside Yumemi.

strings.text: 触手を伸ばそうとして、頭部をぺしっと叩かれた。
strings.translated: It reached out a tentacle -- and got a light smack on the head.

strings.text:
夢美
「こら、いただきます、まだでしょ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Hey, we haven't said grace yet."

strings.text: 夢美が胸の前で手を合わせる。
strings.translated: Yumemi pressed her hands together in front of her chest.

strings.text:
蟲は、ゆらゆらと触手を動かし続けていたが、その
先端がやや一点に集められているようにも見えた。
strings.translated: The Bug kept swaying its tentacles, though the tips seemed to draw together slightly toward a single point.

strings.text:
夢身なりに気持ちを込めて言って、櫻井家の昼食が
始まった。
strings.translated: She said it with genuine feeling in her own way, and lunch at the Sakurai household began.

strings.text: 味のほうは、夢美的には問題なし。
strings.translated: As for the taste, Yumemi had no complaints.

strings.text:
気になるのは蟲のほうなのだが、最初はから揚げを
触手の先で突付くだけで、なかなか食べようとはし
なかった。
strings.translated: What concerned her was the Bug -- at first it only poked at the karaage with the tip of its tentacle and showed no sign of actually eating.

strings.text:
もっとも、新しいメニューを出したときは、だいたい
こんな反応なので、すぐに好き嫌いを判断することは
できない。
strings.translated: That said, this was pretty much its usual reaction whenever a new dish was introduced, so she couldn't judge its likes and dislikes right away.

strings.text: 様子を見守ること十分――――。
strings.translated: Ten minutes of watching and waiting...

strings.text:
やがて、蟲は触手を引っ込めてしまい、容器にはアジ
のから揚げがそのまま残された。
strings.translated: Eventually, the Bug retracted its tentacles, leaving the horse mackerel karaage untouched in the bowl.

strings.text: どうやら口に合わなかったらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed the dish hadn't agreed with its palate.

strings.text:
軽く落胆しながらも、夢美はそっと蟲の背中を撫でて
やった。
strings.translated: Mildly disappointed, Yumemi gently stroked the Bug's back.

strings.text:
夢美
「仕方ないね。好き嫌いはあって当然だもん」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Oh well. Everyone has things they like and don't like."

strings.text:
夢美
「確かオレンジジュースがあったはずだから、それ
　持ってきてあげるね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm pretty sure there's some orange juice -- I'll go get it for you."

strings.text: 食事の手を止めて、再びキッチンへと戻る。
strings.translated: She set down her chopsticks and headed back to the kitchen.

strings.text:
蟲のほうは夢美の言葉を理解したようで、嬉しそうに
触手を揺らしていた。
strings.translated: The Bug seemed to understand Yumemi's words, swaying its tentacles happily.

strings.text:
大学ノートには『アジのから揚げは×』の一行が追加
された……。
strings.translated: A new line was added to the notebook: "Horse mackerel karaage -- X"...

strings.text:
するすると伸びて来た蟲の触手が、夢美のズボンの中
に潜り込んできた。
strings.translated: The Bug's tentacle slithered out and crept inside Yumemi's pants.

strings.text: どうやら昼間から、体液を要求しているらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed to be demanding her bodily fluids, even in the middle of the day.

strings.text:
夢美
「ちょ、こらっ、ダメだって。この前、したでしょ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Hey -- knock it off. We just did this the other day."

strings.text:
少し座っている位置をずらして抵抗するが、その程度
で触手から逃れることはできない。
strings.translated: She shifted her position slightly to resist, but that wasn't nearly enough to escape the tentacle.

strings.text:
夢美は溜息をつくと、苦笑しながら蟲の頭部を突付い
た。
strings.translated: Yumemi let out a sigh and poked the Bug's head with a wry smile.

strings.text:
夢美
「はいはい、分かりました。
　期待させちゃった分、ちゃんと責任取らないとね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Okay, okay, I get it.
 I got your hopes up, so I guess I have to take responsibility."

strings.text:
一旦食事の手を止めて、おもむろにズボンとショーツ
を脱ぐ。
strings.translated: She paused her meal and casually pulled off her pants and underwear.

strings.text:
ソファーに片足を上げて大きく股を開くと、あとは蟲
の好きにさせた。
strings.translated: She propped one leg up on the sofa and spread her legs wide, then let the Bug do as it pleased.

strings.text:
夢美
「んふっ、ん……もぐもぐ…………。
　飲み込んでる間は、強くしないでよぉ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Mmph, mm... nom nom...
 Don't go so hard while I'm still swallowing."

strings.text:
夢美はアジのから揚げを食べながら、蟲は夢美の体液
を吸収しながら、櫻井家ののどかな午後は過ぎていっ
た……。
strings.translated: As Yumemi ate her horse mackerel karaage and the Bug absorbed Yumemi's bodily fluids, the peaceful afternoon at the Sakurai household drifted by...

strings.text:
夢美
「ありがとうございました～」

店に残っていた午前中の最後の客を見送りながら、
夢美は元気良く声を掛けた。
strings.translated: Yumemi called out cheerfully as she saw off the last morning customer remaining in the shop.

strings.text:
モーニングセットのオーダータイムも過ぎたため、
これから昼頃までは、比較的緩やかな時間が続く。
strings.translated: The morning set order period had ended, and from here until around noon, a relatively quiet stretch of time would follow.

strings.text:
夢美はテーブルの後片付けをしながら、ついと窓際の
席に目を向けた。
strings.translated: As Yumemi cleared the tables, she glanced over toward the window seat.

strings.text: 誰も座っていない四番テーブル。
strings.translated: Table four -- empty, with no one sitting there.

strings.text:
たまたま用事があったのか、それとも昨日の一件が
影響しているのか……。
strings.translated: Whether he simply had something to do today, or whether yesterday's incident had something to do with it...

strings.text:
杏子
「夢美ちゃん、少し休憩しなさい」

そう言いながら、杏子がカウンターに一杯の紅茶を出
す。
strings.translated: As she said so, Anzu set a cup of tea on the counter.

strings.text: 微かなハーブの香りが、夢美の鼻先をくすぐった。
strings.translated: A faint herbal scent tickled Yumemi's nose.

strings.text:
カウンターの席に座り、夢美はうつむき加減につぶや
いた。
strings.translated: Yumemi sat down at the counter seat and murmured with her eyes cast downward.

strings.text:
杏子は、向かい側でコップを拭きながら、いつも通り
の柔らかい笑みを浮かべる。
strings.translated: Anzu stood on the other side, wiping a glass, wearing her usual gentle smile.

strings.text:
夢美
「お得意さんだったのに」

杏子
「あのお客様のこと？」
昨日の結果を、夢美は掻い摘んで話して聞かせた。
strings.translated: Yumemi gave Anzu a brief summary of what had happened yesterday.

strings.text:
実のところ昨日よりも、今日のほうが罪悪感が強まっ
ている。
strings.translated: Truth be told, she felt even more guilty today than she had yesterday.

strings.text: 夢美の話を聞いて、杏子は納得したようにうなずいた。
strings.translated: Listening to Yumemi's story, Anzu nodded as if it all made sense.

strings.text:
杏子
「私は二人のこと、実はお似合いだと思ってたんだけ
　ど、余計なお節介しちゃったかしら？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"You know, I actually thought you two were well-suited for each other... I hope I didn't stick my nose in where it didn't belong?"

strings.text:
夢美
「杏子さんは……知ってたんですか？」

杏子
「だいぶ前から、そんな気はしてたわ」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"I had a feeling for quite a while now."

strings.text:
杏子
「だって彼、ずっと夢美ちゃんのこと見てたから」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Because he was always watching you, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text:
杏子
「彼が夢美ちゃんをデートに誘おうとしてた日は、
　どことなく様子がおかしかったし……きっと純粋
　な人なのね」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"On the day he was trying to ask you out on a date, there was something a little off about him... He must be a sincere person."

strings.text:
純粋と言われても、夢美にはそれを肯定も否定もでき
ない。
strings.translated: Even being told he was sincere, Yumemi could neither confirm nor deny it.

strings.text: 当面の問題は、仕事に集中できないという事だった。
strings.translated: The immediate problem was that she couldn't focus on her work.

strings.text:
杏子
「決めた。夢美ちゃん、今日はお休みしなさい」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"That settles it. Yumemi-chan, take the day off."

strings.text:
杏子
「特別休暇。たまにはいいでしょう」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Special leave. It's fine every once in a while."

strings.text:
夢美
「いえ、大丈夫です。ちゃんとやれます」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"No, I'm fine. I can manage."

strings.text:
杏子
「ダメよ。これは店長命令」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"No arguing. That's an order from the manager."

strings.text: 杏子がニッコリとした笑顔で宣言する。
strings.translated: Anzu declared it with a bright smile.

strings.text:
命令と言われては、夢美も従わないわけにはいかな
かった。
strings.translated: When told it was an order, Yumemi had no choice but to comply.

strings.text:
夢美
「それじゃあ、今日はこれで失礼します」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well then, I'll be taking my leave for today."

strings.text:
杏子
「あっ、ちょっと待って」

着替えを済ませて店を出ようとする夢美を、カウン
ターの奥から杏子が呼び止めた。
strings.translated: Yumemi had finished changing and was about to leave the shop when Anzu called out to her from behind the counter.

strings.text:
杏子
「持って行きなさい」
杏子の手から、半透明のタッパーが手渡される。
strings.translated: Anzu handed her a translucent plastic container.

strings.text:
中身はクッキーのようで、コーヒーのような色をした
お菓子が入っていた。
strings.translated:
The contents appeared to be cookies -- little treats the color of coffee
were nestled inside.

strings.text:
杏子
「今、開発中の新メニュー。
　元気が出るはずだから、良かったら食べてみて」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"It's a new menu item I'm currently developing.
It should cheer you up -- try it if you'd like."

strings.text:
夢美
「あ……ありがとうございます」

驚いたあと、元気良く礼を言って夢美は頭を下げ
た……。
strings.translated: After her initial surprise, Yumemi gave a cheerful word of thanks and bowed her head...

strings.text:
夢美
「あの、杏子さん……お掃除、終わりました」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Um, Anzu-san... I'm done with the cleaning."

strings.text:
雑巾を片手にした夢美が、カウンター越しに厨房へと
向かって声を掛ける。
strings.translated: Yumemi, cloth in hand, called out toward the kitchen from across the counter.

strings.text:
厨房の入り口からは杏子が顔を出して、ニッコリと
笑顔を返してくれた。
strings.translated: Anzu poked her head out from the kitchen entrance and returned a warm smile.

strings.text:
杏子
「ありがとう。今、ココア淹れるから待っててね」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Thank you. I'll brew some cocoa now, so wait just a moment."

strings.text:
そう言って、杏子が顔を引っ込めてから程なく、厨房
から甘いココアの香りが漂い始める。
strings.translated: With those words, Anzu pulled her head back inside, and before long, the sweet scent of cocoa began drifting from the kitchen.

strings.text:
夢美は、カウンターの一番端の席に座ると、壁に飾ら
れた絵を見つめながら、ココアが出てくるのを待った。
strings.translated: Yumemi sat down at the seat at the far end of the counter, and waited for the cocoa to arrive while gazing at the painting on the wall.

strings.text: 杏子と出会ってから、一ヶ月――――。
strings.translated: One month since she had met Anzu...

strings.text:
暇になったときは店に通うようになった夢美は、徐々
に杏子と親しくなっていった。
strings.translated: Whenever she had nowhere to be, Yumemi had started coming to the shop, and gradually grew closer to Anzu.

strings.text:
最初は客として、よくカウンターの端の席に着き、
そこで何時間も店内の様子を眺めて過ごした。
strings.translated: At first, as a customer, she would often take the seat at the far end of the counter and spend hours there, watching the goings-on inside the shop.

strings.text: 忙しそうな杏子と、楽しそうな客達。
strings.translated: Anzu looking busy, and the customers looking happy.

strings.text:
たまに杏子が失敗して客に頭を下げる姿もあったが、
基本的にはいつも穏やかな雰囲気に満たされていた。
strings.translated: There were times when Anzu made a mistake and had to bow her head to a customer, but for the most part, the atmosphere was always calm and gentle.

strings.text:
杏子
「お家の人は心配しないの？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Doesn't your family worry about you?"

strings.text: そう聞かれたから、両親はいないと答えた。
strings.translated: When asked that, she answered that she had no parents.

strings.text:
杏子
「家族は？　親戚の人と一緒に住んでたりするの？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"What about family? Do you live with any relatives?"

strings.text: そう聞かれたから、一人で暮らしていると答えた。
strings.translated: When asked that, she answered that she lived alone.

strings.text:
杏子
「学校は？　行ってないの？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"What about school? Aren't you going?"

strings.text: そう聞かれたから、行っていないと答えた。
strings.translated: When asked that, she answered that she wasn't.

strings.text:
本人は無自覚だったが、杏子が夢美のことを気にし始
めたのは、その頃からだ。
strings.translated: Yumemi herself wasn't aware of it, but that was around the time Anzu began to take an interest in her.

strings.text:
杏子
「良かったら、お店の手伝いをしてみない？
　報酬はウチのモーニングセットでどうかしら？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"If you'd like, why don't you help out at the shop?
How does our morning set sound as payment?"

strings.text: 始まりは、そんな杏子の提案からだった。
strings.translated: It had all started with that proposal from Anzu.

strings.text: ほんの少しだけのお手伝い。
strings.translated: Just a little bit of help.

strings.text: 最初はテーブルを拭き、椅子の位置を揃えるだけ……。
strings.translated: At first, it was only wiping down the tables and straightening the chairs...

strings.text:
それが、床のモップ掛けやトイレ掃除、さらには事務
所の片付けと、時間が経つとともに仕事が増えていっ
た。
strings.translated: But as time went on, the work grew -- mopping the floors, cleaning the restroom, and even tidying up the office.

strings.text: 朝早くに店に訪れ、夕方近くになって家に帰る。
strings.translated: She would arrive at the shop early in the morning and head home as evening drew near.

strings.text: それが、今の夢美の生活だった。
strings.translated: That had become Yumemi's daily routine.

Anzu
"Here you go, sorry for the wait."

strings.text:
モーニングセットとココアをトレイに載せて、杏子が
厨房から出てきた。
strings.translated: Anzu came out of the kitchen carrying a morning set and cocoa on a tray.

strings.text:
時間は午前九時を回っているが、店がオープンするま
でにはまだ一時間ほどある。
strings.translated: It was just past nine in the morning, but there was still about an hour before the shop would open.

strings.text:
夢美は、早速モーニングセットを食べ始めたが、何故
だかその様子を杏子がじっと見つめていた。
strings.translated: Yumemi wasted no time digging into her morning set, and for some reason, Anzu was watching her intently the whole while.

strings.text:
杏子
「ねぇ、夢美ちゃん。
　食べながらでいいから聞いてほしいんだけど……」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Hey, Yumemi-chan.
 Feel free to keep eating while you listen, but..."

strings.text:
杏子
「正式に、ウチで働いてみるつもりはない？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Have you ever thought about working here officially?"

strings.text: 杏子の言葉に、夢美の体がぴたりと止まる。
strings.translated: At Anzu's words, Yumemi's body went perfectly still.

strings.text:
サンドイッチを咥えたまま視線だけを向け、真意を
確かめるようにじっと杏子を見つめた。
strings.translated: She kept the sandwich in her mouth and simply shifted her gaze, staring at Anzu as if trying to confirm her sincerity.

strings.text:
杏子
「正直に言うとね、夢美ちゃんがいてくれて、本当に
　助かってるの」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"To be honest with you, having you here has been a real lifesaver, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text:
杏子
「私だけじゃ、たぶん今みたいにお店を回すことはで
　きなかった」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"On my own, I probably couldn't have kept the shop running the way it does now."

strings.text:
杏子
「だから私としては、夢美ちゃんをアルバイトとして
　雇って、今後もお店の仕事を手伝ってもらいたいん
　だけど……どうかしら？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"So personally, I'd love to take you on as a part-timer and have you keep helping out around the shop going forward... what do you think?"

strings.text:
杏子の提案を理解するのに、夢美はかなりの時間を
要した。
strings.translated: It took Yumemi quite a while to process Anzu's proposal.

strings.text:
まさか自分にそんな話が振られるなど、思ってもみな
かったのだ。
strings.translated: It had never even crossed her mind that such an offer might come her way.

strings.text:
夢美
「あたしなんかで……いいんですか…………？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Are you sure... you want someone like me...?"

strings.text:
杏子
「『あたしなんか』って事はないと思うんだけど？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"I don't think there's any 'someone like me' about it."

strings.text:
杏子
「夢美ちゃんさえ良かったら、是非このお店で働いて
　もらえないかしら？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"If you're willing, I'd really love for you to work here at this shop."

strings.text:
杏子の真っ直ぐな笑顔に、じわじわと喜びが込み上げ
る。
strings.translated: Faced with Anzu's straightforward smile, a warmth of joy slowly welled up inside her.

strings.text: 夢美は、やや顔を赤らめながら俯くと――――
strings.translated: Yumemi looked down with a slight blush on her cheeks, and then --

strings.text: そう言って、こくんと頷いてみせた……。
strings.translated: With those words, she gave a small, earnest nod...

strings.text:
夢美
「あーっ、こらこらこらっ！！」

そろそろ寝ようかという頃になって、蟲が怪しげな
行動を取っていることに気付いた。
strings.translated: It was around the time she was thinking of going to bed that she noticed the Bug behaving suspiciously.

strings.text:
夢美愛用のハンドバッグの中に触手を差し入れ、杏子
からもらったタッパーを引きずり出している。
strings.translated: It had slipped a tentacle into Yumemi's beloved handbag and was dragging out the tupperware she had received from Anzu.

strings.text:
夢美
「ダメよ。私がもらったんだから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"No you don't. Anzu gave that to me."

strings.text:
素早くタッパーを取り返し、胸に抱きながらソファー
に座る。
strings.translated: She quickly snatched the tupperware back and sat down on the sofa, clutching it to her chest.

strings.text:
全て自分で食べてしまおうというわけではないが、
最初の一枚くらいは、やはり自分の口に入れたかった。
strings.translated: She didn't intend to eat every last piece herself, but she at least wanted the first one to go into her own mouth.

strings.text:
開発中の新メニューという事は、夢美自身、初めて
口にする食べ物のはずだ。
strings.translated: It was a new menu item still in development -- which meant it should be something Yumemi herself had never tasted before.

strings.text:
見かけはただのクッキーだが、杏子が開発している
以上、何かしらの工夫があるのではと期待ができた。
strings.translated: It looked like an ordinary cookie on the surface, but since Anzu was the one developing it, she expected there to be some kind of twist.

strings.text:
片手に持っていたタッパーをテーブルの上に置いて、
夢美は急いでキッチンに駆け込んだ。
strings.translated: She set the tupperware down on the table and rushed into the kitchen.

strings.text:
口では「辛い」と言ったが、実際のはそんな生半可な
ものではない。
strings.translated: She had said "spicy," but the reality of it was nothing so mild.

strings.text:
クッキーに挟んであるのは激辛のワサビだったが、
おそらくはクッキーそのものにも同じ物が煉り込ま
れている。
strings.translated: Sandwiched inside the cookie was an intensely hot wasabi filling, and most likely the cookie itself had the same ingredient kneaded right into it.

strings.text:
とてもではないが、ＡｎｚＵで出せるような代物では
なかった。
strings.translated: There was simply no way this could be served at AnzU.

strings.text:
夢美
「う～っ、舌がビリビリする」

洗い場でクッキーを吐き出しながら、夢美は杏子の
言葉を思い出していた。
strings.translated: As she spat the cookie out into the sink, Yumemi found herself recalling Anzu's words.

strings.text:
杏子
『今、開発中の新メニュー。
　元気が出るはずだから、良かったら食べてみて』
strings.translated:
Anzu
"A new menu item I'm working on right now.
 It should give you a little energy boost, so feel free to try it if you'd like."

strings.text: 冷静に考えてみると、果てしなくおかしい。
strings.translated: Thinking about it calmly, it was utterly absurd.

strings.text:
いつもの杏子なら、味見をして感想を聞かせて、と
言うはずのところだ。
strings.translated: The usual Anzu would have asked her to taste it and share her impressions.

strings.text:
元気が出るはずだから、と言う部分は、いかにもこの
結果を予測しての科白だった。
strings.translated: The part about it giving her energy -- that line had clearly been delivered with full knowledge of how this would turn out.

strings.text:
涙目になって何度もうがいをしながらも、夢美の口元
にはくっきりとした形の笑みが浮かんでいた。
strings.translated: Teary-eyed and gargling repeatedly, Yumemi still wore a clear, unmistakable smile at the corners of her mouth.

strings.text: 確かに元気にはなれた気がする。
strings.translated: She did feel like she had gotten a boost of energy, in a way.

strings.text:
ワサビ入りクッキーと一緒に、胸につかえていたもの
が吐き出されたような気がする。
strings.translated: It felt as though whatever had been stuck in her chest had been spat out right along with the wasabi cookie.

strings.text:
まんまと騙されはしたが、夢美の心は不思議と穏やか
なものに満ちていた。
strings.translated: She had been well and truly tricked, yet Yumemi's heart was filled with a strangely quiet peace.

strings.text:
夢美
「でもコレどうしよう。十枚くらいあったけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But what am I supposed to do with these? There were like ten of them..."

strings.text:
ようやく辛みが引いたところで、夢美はクッキーの
処理法について考えた。
strings.translated: Now that the burning had finally faded, Yumemi turned her thoughts to what to do with the cookies.

strings.text:
いくら激辛クッキーとはいえ、捨ててしまうのは忍び
ない。
strings.translated: As intensely spicy as they were, she couldn't bring herself to just throw them away.

strings.text:
そのまま食べる事はできなくとも、何らかの使い道は
ありそうだった。
strings.translated: Even if she couldn't eat them as-is, there had to be some use for them.

strings.text:
だが、そんな都合の良い方法を、そう簡単に思いつく
はずもない。
strings.translated: But a convenient solution like that wasn't going to come to her so easily.

strings.text:
頭を悩ませながらリビングに戻ってみると、そこには
予想もしていなかった光景が広がっていた。
strings.translated: Mulling it over, she headed back to the living room -- and found a scene she never could have anticipated.

strings.text:
夢美
「えっ、これ食べてるの？」

タッパーに触手を伸ばして、蟲がクッキーを口へと
運んでいた。
strings.translated: The Bug had extended a tentacle into the tupperware and was carrying a cookie up to its mouth.

strings.text:
口と言っても口吻の先端に付いている小さな穴なのだ
が、細かく砕いたクッキーのカケラを、その中に落と
し込んでいた。
strings.translated: "Mouth" was perhaps generous -- it was a tiny opening at the tip of its proboscis -- but it was dropping finely crumbled cookie fragments into it all the same.

strings.text:
夢美
「アンタの味覚……よく分かんないわ……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I really don't understand your taste buds..."

strings.text:
呆然とする夢美を真正面に、蟲はただ黙々とクッキー
を食べ続けた……。
strings.translated: With Yumemi standing there in a daze right in front of it, the Bug simply continued eating the cookies in silence...

strings.text:
夢美
「いらっしゃいませ～っ！」
ＡｎｚＵの店内に、夢美の元気な声が響いていた。
strings.translated: Yumemi's cheerful voice rang out through the interior of AnzU.

strings.text:
いつも通り、というよりも、いつも以上に元気な様子
で、フロアの仕事をせっせとこなしている。
strings.translated: Not just her usual self -- she was even livelier than usual, bustling through her floor duties.

strings.text:
杏子には朝のうちにお礼を言い、ついでに文句も付け
て笑われた。
strings.translated: She had thanked Anzu early that morning, and tacked on a complaint for good measure -- which only made Anzu laugh.

strings.text: もちろん、新メニューなどという話は嘘っぱちだ。
strings.translated: Of course, the whole story about a new menu item had been a complete lie.

strings.text:
「いつか仕返しします」と宣言して、夢美は今日の
仕事についている。
strings.translated: After declaring "I'll get you back for this someday," Yumemi had thrown herself into today's work.

strings.text: ＡｎｚＵの客足は、いつもより若干多めだった。
strings.translated: AnzU was seeing slightly more customers than usual.

strings.text:
出社前のサラリーマンが多いのはいつもの事だが、
たまにしか来ない客が何人かいる。
strings.translated: The crowd of office workers before their commute was nothing new, but several customers who only came in now and then had turned up too.

strings.text:
どうやら偶然重なってしまったようで、朝だというの
に席が二つ三つしか空いていない。
strings.translated: It seemed they had all happened to show up at the same time -- and for morning hours, only two or three seats remained open.

strings.text:
おかげで、用意していた分のモーニングセットはすぐ
に無くなってしまった。
strings.translated: As a result, the morning sets they had prepared sold out almost immediately.

strings.text:
夢美
「いらっしゃいませ。こちらへどうぞ」

夢美
「あっ、いらっしゃいま――――」

二人続けて客が入ってきたところで、夢美はハッと
息を呑んだ。
strings.translated: Two customers had walked in one after another, and Yumemi caught her breath sharply.

strings.text:
今日も来ないと思っていた青年の姿が、ドアの前にあ
る。
strings.translated: Standing at the door was the young man she had assumed wouldn't come again today.

strings.text:
夢美
「あ……っと……こちらへ……どうぞ…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ah... um... right this way... please..."

strings.text:
しどろもどろになりながら、空いている席へと案内す
る。
strings.translated: Flustered and stumbling over her words, she guided him to an open seat.

strings.text:
普通に振舞えばいいのか、それともまず謝ったほうが
いいのか、夢美の頭は混乱するばかりだった。
strings.translated: Whether to act normal, or to apologize first -- Yumemi's mind was in complete disarray.

strings.text:
優斗
「この前はごめん。変なこと言っちゃって」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Sorry about the other day. I said some weird things."

strings.text:
夢美
「い、いえ……私の、ほう、こそ…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"N-no... it was... my fault... too..."

strings.text:
夢美
「あっ、えと……今日は、いつものですか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Oh, um... today, will it be the usual?"

strings.text:
優斗
「うん、お願いします」

夢美
「かしこまりましたっ！」
やや裏返った声を上げながら、厨房のほうまで戻る。
strings.translated: Her voice cracking slightly, she hurried back toward the kitchen.

strings.text:
他の客よりずっと早足で、傍目には優斗から逃げてい
るようにも見えた。
strings.translated: She was moving far faster than she did for any other customer -- to any onlooker, it probably looked like she was fleeing from Yuuto.

strings.text:
夢美
「杏子さん、モーニング…………ぁ………………」

そこまで言いかけて、はたと今日はモーニングセット
が終わっていた事を思い出す。
strings.translated: She caught herself mid-sentence, suddenly remembering that the morning sets had already sold out today.

strings.text: ウェイトレスとしてはあるまじき失態だ。
strings.translated: A blunder utterly unbecoming of a waitress.

strings.text:
肩を縮こまらせながら優斗の席に戻ると、話し始める
より先にぺこぺこと頭を下げた。
strings.translated: She hunched her shoulders and returned to Yuuto's table, bowing her head repeatedly before she could even get a word out.

strings.text:
夢美
「すいません。本当にすいません」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm so sorry. I'm really so sorry."

strings.text:
優斗
「いや、無いものはどうしようもないし」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"It's fine, there's nothing to be done if they're out."

strings.text:
優斗
「……あの、頭、止めていいよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"...Um, you can stop bowing now."

strings.text: 優斗に指摘されて、ようやく動きを止める。
strings.translated: Only when Yuuto pointed it out did she finally stop moving.

strings.text:
気付けば周りの客にも苦笑されていて、恥ずかしくて
堪らなかった……。
strings.translated: She noticed the other customers around her were smiling wryly too, and she wanted to sink into the floor from embarrassment...

strings.text:
平静を装おうとしても、動揺はしっかり顔に出てしま
う。
strings.translated: No matter how hard she tried to appear calm, her agitation showed plainly on her face.

strings.text: 何か言わなければならない。

注文を受けた客達に料理を運びながら、夢美は優斗の
ことばかり考えていた。
strings.translated: As she carried dishes out to the customers who had ordered, Yumemi's thoughts kept drifting back to Yuuto.

strings.text:
せめて一言謝らなければ、胸のモヤモヤしたものが
晴れない。
strings.translated: Unless she at least said a word of apology, the unsettled feeling in her chest wouldn't go away.

strings.text:
仕事中、ずっとその機会を窺っていたが、なかなか
そんな暇は訪れなかった。
strings.translated: She had been watching for an opportunity throughout her shift, but the moment never seemed to come.

strings.text: 十分と掛からずに、優斗は食事を終えてしまった。
strings.translated: It took him less than ten minutes to finish his meal.

strings.text:
夢美は急いでレジに入り、注文したメニューの金額を
告げる。
strings.translated:
Yumemi hurried behind the register and called out
the total for the order.

strings.text:
優斗はお釣りが要らないよう小銭できっちりと支払い、
「ご馳走様」とだけ言って店を後にしようとした。
strings.translated:
Yuuto paid the exact amount in coins so as not to need change,
said only "Thank you for the meal," and made to leave the shop.

strings.text: 呼び止める声は、自然と出てしまった。
strings.translated: The words to call him back slipped out before she could stop herself.

strings.text: ドアに手を掛けていた優斗が、驚いた様子で振り返る。
strings.translated: Yuuto, who had his hand on the door, turned around with a look of surprise.

strings.text:
レジには次の客が金を払おうとしていたが、それに
構っている余裕はなかった。
strings.translated: The next customer was already trying to pay at the register, but she had no room to worry about that.

strings.text:
夢美
「えっと……お、一昨日は…………その…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Um... th-the day before yesterday... that is..."

strings.text:
自分が何を伝えるべきかも分からず、必死に言葉を探
す。
strings.translated: She desperately searched for words, not even sure what she needed to say.

strings.text:
胸の奥から罪悪感が湧き上がってきて、それがいっそ
う夢美の気持ちを焦らせた。
strings.translated: A wave of guilt welled up from deep in her chest, and it only made Yumemi feel all the more frantic.

strings.text:
言いたかった事はあるはずなのに、頭の中で考えが
まとまらない。
strings.translated: She knew there was something she wanted to say, but her thoughts refused to come together in her head.

strings.text:
しかも、レジには次々と客が並び始めていて、夢美は
何をどうすればいいのか分からなくなり始めていた。
strings.translated: On top of that, customers were beginning to line up one after another at the register, and Yumemi was starting to lose track of what she should even do.

strings.text:
杏子
「お待たせ致しました」
横から滑り込むようにして、杏子がレジに入った。
strings.translated: Anzu slipped in from the side and took over the register.

strings.text: 同時に肘で夢美を押して、場所を変わるように促す。
strings.translated: At the same time, she nudged Yumemi with her elbow, urging her to step aside.

strings.text:
夢美は驚きながらもレジから離れ、恐々と杏子の顔を
見つめた。
strings.translated: Yumemi stepped away from the register in surprise, and looked up at Anzu's face with nervous eyes.

strings.text:
杏子
「夢美ちゃん、五番テーブルの料理が出来てるから
　運んでおいてちょうだい」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Yumemi-chan, the order for table five is ready --
 go ahead and bring it out, would you?"

strings.text:
いつもより強めの口調で言われ、夢美は急いで厨房へ
と飛び込んだ。
strings.translated: Spoken to in a firmer tone than usual, Yumemi rushed into the kitchen.

strings.text:
優斗のことは気になったが、今は仕事の真っ最中なの
だ。
strings.translated: She was worried about Yuuto, but she was in the middle of work right now.

strings.text:
自分の都合で、他の客に迷惑を掛けるなどあってはな
らない事だった。
strings.translated: She could not afford to let her personal matters inconvenience the other customers any further.

strings.text:
結局、客足が落ち着く十一時過ぎまで、夢美はただひ
たすらに働いた。
strings.translated: In the end, Yumemi did nothing but work, right up until past eleven when the flow of customers finally died down.

strings.text: 優斗のことは、仕事中は忘れるよう努めた……。
strings.translated: She made an effort to put Yuuto out of her mind while she was working...

strings.text:
杏子
「今日のは、夢美ちゃんらしくなかったわね」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"That wasn't like you at all today, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text:
店が一段落した頃になって、杏子が夢美をカウンター
の席に座らせた。
strings.translated: Once the shop had settled down, Anzu had Yumemi take a seat at the counter.

strings.text:
ちょうど他の客はおらず、二人きりで話をする事がで
きる。
strings.translated: As luck would have it, there were no other customers, and the two of them could talk alone.

strings.text:
夢美の前には温かいココアが置かれていて、甘い香り
を鼻先に漂わせていた。
strings.translated: In front of Yumemi sat a warm cup of cocoa, its sweet scent drifting to her nose.

strings.text:
杏子
「分かってると思うけど、公私混同は控えてもらわな
　いと、お店のほうとしても困るの」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"I think you already know this, but mixing personal matters with work puts the shop in a difficult position -- I need you to keep that in check."

strings.text:
杏子
「それに、お客様に今日のような迷惑をかけるのも
　ね」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"And causing trouble for customers the way you did today, as well."
She had no words to offer in return.

strings.text:
本当なら、もっと頭ごなしに怒鳴られてもおかしくは
ないはずだ。
strings.translated: Honestly, it wouldn't have been strange for Anzu to have yelled at her far more harshly.

strings.text:
夢美と優斗のことは、あくまでプライベートのことで、
店には何の関係もないのだから……。
strings.translated: What happened between Yumemi and Yuuto was strictly a private matter -- it had nothing to do with the shop...

strings.text:
夢美
「本当に……すいませんでした…………」

杏子
「そう思うのなら、早く問題を解決しないとね」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"If you feel that way, then you'd better resolve the problem quickly."

strings.text:
夢美
「それは、もう、大丈夫です」
苦笑いを浮かべながら、そう答える。
strings.translated: She answered with a wry smile on her face.

strings.text:
優斗とのわだかまりがすぐに消えるとは思わないが、
店に迷惑を掛けないよう努める事はできる。
strings.translated:
She didn't expect the awkwardness between her and Yuuto to disappear overnight, but
she could at least make sure not to cause any more trouble for the shop.

strings.text:
普通の客と同じように、今まで通りに接すればそれで
いいのだ。
strings.translated: All she had to do was treat him like any other customer -- the same as always.

strings.text: 難しく考える必要はなかった。
strings.translated: There was no need to overthink it.

strings.text:
杏子
「いらっしゃいませ」
店のドアが開いて、客が一人入ってきた。
strings.translated: The shop door opened and a single customer walked in.

strings.text:
夢美は、すぐに椅子から立ち上がろうとしたが、ドア
の前に立っている人物を見て体を硬直させる。
strings.translated: Yumemi moved to stand up from her chair right away, but froze when she saw who was standing at the door.

strings.text:
椅子から中途半端に腰を浮かせた状態で、夢美が短く
声を漏らす。
strings.translated: Half-risen from her chair, Yumemi let out a small sound.

strings.text: 杏子が、夢美の隣の席を促した。
strings.translated: Anzu gestured toward the seat next to Yumemi.

strings.text:
杏子
「夢美ちゃん、あとはお願いね」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Yumemi-chan, I'll leave the rest to you."

strings.text: 完璧な不意打ちだった。

こんな時間に優斗が店を訪れるなど、考えてもみな
かった。
strings.translated: She had never even considered that Yuuto might visit the shop at this hour.

strings.text: まず、何を、どう、声を掛ければ良いのか……。
strings.translated: First of all, what should she say -- how should she even approach him...?

strings.text:
夢美
「い、いらっしゃい、ませ」
今更とは思ったが、椅子から立ち上がって頭を下げる。
strings.translated: She thought it was rather strange, but she rose from her chair and bowed her head.

strings.text:
そして、いつもなら席へ案内するところだが、これは
必要なかった。
strings.translated: Normally she would have guided him to a seat, but that wasn't necessary here.

strings.text:
杏子
「どうぞ、当店のサービスです」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Here you are, compliments of the house."

strings.text:
カウンターに着いた優斗の前に、杏子がコーヒーを
差し出す。
strings.translated: Anzu set a cup of coffee in front of Yuuto as he settled at the counter.

strings.text:
どう考えても、普通にやって来た客に対する接し方で
はなかった。
strings.translated: It was not, by any stretch of the imagination, how one would treat an ordinary customer who had simply walked in.

strings.text:
杏子
「もう一度、ゆっくり話してごらんなさい」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Now then, take your time and tell her again."

strings.text:
悲鳴のような声を上げる夢美に、杏子がにっこりと
笑顔を浮かべる。
strings.translated: Anzu flashed a warm smile at Yumemi, who let out a sound close to a shriek.

strings.text:
そして、おそらくは気を遣ったのだろう、厨房のほう
へと引っ込んで行った。
strings.translated: Then, likely out of consideration for them, she retreated toward the kitchen.

strings.text:
優斗
「とりあえず、座ったら？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Why don't you sit down, for starters?"

strings.text: 優斗に促されて、今まで座っていた席に着く。
strings.translated: Prompted by Yuuto, she took her seat -- the same one she had been sitting in before.

strings.text:
緊張しているためか全身が強張っていて、胸の奥に
詰まるものを感じた。
strings.translated: Her whole body was stiff, whether from nerves or something else, and she felt a tightness deep in her chest.

strings.text:
優斗
「お店のほうにまで……迷惑掛けちゃったかな？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Coming all the way to your workplace... I hope I haven't caused you any trouble?"

strings.text:
夢美
「南さんのせいじゃ、ないです……」
かばっているわけでも何でもない。
strings.translated: She wasn't trying to cover for him or anything like that.

strings.text:
今回の件は、店に迷惑をかけた夢美が全面的に悪いの
だ。
strings.translated: This whole situation was entirely Yumemi's fault -- she was the one who had caused trouble for the shop.

strings.text:
優斗
「あ、いや、何でもないよ」
胸の前で手を振って、優斗が苦笑いを浮かべる。
strings.translated: He waved a hand in front of his chest and gave a wry smile.

strings.text:
店には来てみたものの、何を話せばいいのか分からな
い様子だ。
strings.translated: He had come to the shop, but it seemed he wasn't sure what to say now that he was here.

strings.text: 前を向いたまま、黙ってコーヒーを飲んでいる。
strings.translated: He kept his gaze forward, drinking his coffee in silence.

strings.text:
これは、たぶん、夢美が何かを言わなければならない
のだ。
strings.translated: This was probably something Yumemi had to say herself.

strings.text: そうしなければ、話が前に進まないのだ。
strings.translated: If she didn't, things would never move forward.

strings.text:
夢美
「この前は……あんなこと、言って……ごめんなさ
　い……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"About the other day... what I said... I'm sorry..."

strings.text:
優斗
「あんなことって言うのは……付き合えないって話の
　こと？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"What you said -- you mean about not being able to go out with me?"

strings.text: 声に出すのが辛く、夢美は黙ったまま頷いた。
strings.translated: It was too painful to say aloud, so Yumemi simply nodded in silence.

strings.text:
優斗
「あれは仕方ないよ。
　好きでもない相手とは付き合えないんだし」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"That couldn't be helped. You can't date someone you don't have feelings for."

strings.text:
優斗
「そりゃ、俺もショックは受けたけど……こういう
　のって誰が悪いってわけでもないから」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Sure, I was hurt... but it's not like anyone's to blame for something like this."

strings.text: 上手い言葉が見つからない。
strings.translated: She couldn't find the right words.

strings.text:
いっそ過去のことを話してしまおうかと思ったが、
それをするだけの勇気は出なかった。
strings.translated: She considered just telling him everything about her past, but she couldn't muster the courage to do it.

strings.text:
夢美
「私、南さんが思ってるような娘じゃないです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm not the kind of girl you think I am, Minami-san."

strings.text:
優斗
「思ってるようなって？」

言いよどむ夢美に、優斗が不思議そうな表情を浮かべ
る。
strings.translated: Yuuto looked puzzled as Yumemi trailed off.

strings.text: 意味が理解できないのも無理はない。
strings.translated: It was no wonder he couldn't make sense of it.

strings.text:
夢美は、必死に別の説明を探したが、結局口から出た
のは考えての言葉ではなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi desperately searched for another way to explain, but what finally came out of her mouth was not something she had thought through.

strings.text:
夢美
「怖いんです……男の人が…………」

夢美
「昔、すごく怖い目に遭って……それで…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Something terrible happened to me a long time ago... and so..."

strings.text:
夢美
「だから、南さんの気持ちは、本当に、嬉しかったけ
　ど…………でも……………………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That's why... your feelings, Minami-san, they really did make me happy, but... but..."

strings.text: 自分でもよく分からないままに、涙が零れ落ちてきた。
strings.translated: Without quite understanding why, tears began to spill down her cheeks.

strings.text:
泣き落としを使っているようで嫌だったが、止めよう
としても止まらない。
strings.translated: She hated that it looked like she was using tears to manipulate him, but no matter how hard she tried to stop, she couldn't.

strings.text:
だが、話を途中で切るわけにもいかず、とにかく自分
の気持ちを正直に打ち明けた。
strings.translated: Even so, she couldn't leave things half-said -- so she pressed on, laying her feelings bare as honestly as she could.

strings.text:
夢美
「お付き合い、しても……いつか、幻滅されるんじゃ、
　ないかって……嫌われるんじゃ、ないかって……
　おも、った、ら…………怖くて………………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"If we were together... I kept thinking... someday you'd be disappointed in me... that you'd come to hate me... and when I thought that... I got so scared..."

strings.text:
優斗
「付き合えないって言うのは、それで？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Is that why you said you couldn't go out with me?"

strings.text: 嗚咽を漏らしながら、夢美がこくこくと頷く。
strings.translated: Yumemi nodded again and again, stifling her sobs.

strings.text:
優斗のほうも、どう声を掛けていいものやら分からず、
視線を宙に漂わせていた。
strings.translated: Yuuto, for his part, didn't know what to say either, and let his gaze drift into the air.

strings.text:
夢美の心に深く刻まれた傷が見えたような気がして、
次の言葉が出てこなかった。
strings.translated:
It felt as though I could see the wound carved deep into Yumemi's heart,
and the next words wouldn't come.

strings.text:
一度だけまぶたを閉じて、自分がしてやれる最善の事
を探す。
strings.translated: He closed his eyes once, searching for the best thing he could do for her.

strings.text:
たったこれだけの説明でも、夢美がそこにどれほどの
勇気をつぎ込んだか痛いほど伝わってきた。
strings.translated: Even from that brief explanation alone, he could feel keenly just how much courage Yumemi had poured into those words.

strings.text: その想いに、今度は自分が応えてやりたかった。
strings.translated: Now he wanted to be the one to answer that feeling in kind.

strings.text:
夢美
「この前は、あんな話をして……ごめんなさい……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"About what I said before... I'm sorry..."

strings.text: 真剣な顔をして、優斗が首を横に振る。
strings.translated: With a serious expression, Yuuto shook his head.

strings.text:
優斗
「驚いたけど……君が悪いわけじゃないし……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I was surprised, but... it's not your fault..."

strings.text:
夢美
「でも……分かりますよね？」

夢美
「私が…………どういう体なのか…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"What kind of... shape I'm in... inside..."

strings.text: 一呼吸だけ間をおいて、優斗がうなずく。
strings.translated: After a single breath's pause, Yuuto nodded.

strings.text:
男に一ヶ月もの監禁されたと聞けば、その先に何が
あったのか、だいたい想像はつくだろう。
strings.translated: Hearing that she had been held captive by a man for a whole month, anyone could probably imagine what must have followed.

strings.text:
もっとも、その想像ですら、現実は超えている事にな
るのだが……。
strings.translated: Though even that imagination, in all likelihood, fell short of reality...

strings.text:
優斗
「でも、それで軽蔑したりとか、嫌ったりとかはしな
　いよ……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"But that doesn't mean I think less of you, or that I hate you
 for it..."

strings.text:
微笑んでいいのかどうか分からなかったのだろう、
優斗の顔に中途半端な苦笑が浮かぶ。
strings.translated: Perhaps unsure whether smiling was appropriate, a half-formed, pained smile crossed Yuuto's face.

strings.text:
優斗
「信じてもらえるか分からないけど、俺は、まだ君と
　付き合いたいって思ってるし……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I don't know if you'll believe me, but... I still want to be with you..."

strings.text: 真剣な眼差しが、夢美を見つめていた。
strings.translated: His earnest gaze was fixed on Yumemi.

strings.text:
優斗の気持ちが痛いほど伝わってきて、胸が締め付け
られる。
strings.translated: His feelings came through so clearly it was almost painful, and her chest tightened.

strings.text:
それに応じることができれば、いったいどれほど幸せ
だろうか……。
strings.translated: If only she could answer them -- how happy would that make her...

strings.text: 人を信じることが、怖い。
strings.translated: She was afraid to trust another person.

strings.text:
いつか全てを知られたとき、優斗が自分から去って行
くような気がして、それが堪らなく怖かった。
strings.translated: She had a feeling that someday, when he learned everything, Yuuto would walk away from her -- and that thought was unbearably terrifying.

strings.text:
夢美の様子を察したのだろう、優斗がコーヒーを飲ん
で一つだけ溜息をつく。
strings.translated: He must have sensed how Yumemi was feeling -- Yuuto took a sip of his coffee and let out a single sigh.

strings.text:
暫くまぶたを閉じたあと、ふと思いついたように口を
開いた。
strings.translated: After closing his eyes for a moment, he opened his mouth as if something had just come to him.

strings.text:
優斗
「友達からっていうのは、ダメかな？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"What if we started as friends? Would that be okay?"

strings.text:
優斗の言葉を聞いて、夢美がおそるおそる視線を向け
た。
strings.translated: Hearing Yuuto's words, Yumemi cautiously turned her gaze toward him.

strings.text: 視線を合わせると、優しい微笑みが返ってくる。
strings.translated: When their eyes met, a gentle smile came back to her.

strings.text:
優斗
「付き合うとか付き合わないは抜きにして、友達から
　始めてみないかな？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Setting aside whether we're together or not -- what if we tried starting as friends?"

strings.text:
優斗
「俺はもう気持ちを伝えちゃってるから、普通の友達
　みたいには接しにくいかもしれないけど……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I've already told you how I feel, so I might not be able to act like a normal friend exactly, but..."

strings.text: 全くないと言えば嘘になる。
strings.translated: She couldn't say there was nothing to it -- that would be a lie.

strings.text:
友達とは言っても、そこに優斗の気持ちがある事は、
夢美もすでに知っているのだ。
strings.translated: Friends or not, Yumemi already knew that Yuuto's feelings were there.

strings.text: 上手く接していけるのかどうか、自信はない。
strings.translated: She had no confidence in whether she could handle that well.

strings.text:
だが、これを拒んでは、自分が一生同じことを繰り返
すのも目に見えていた。
strings.translated: But if she refused this, it was plain to see she would spend her whole life repeating the same pattern.

strings.text: これから一生、自分はあの男の影に怯えるのだろうか。
strings.translated: Would she spend the rest of her life cowering in the shadow of that man?

strings.text:
自分を犯した男の影に、怯えたまま一生を過ごすのだ
ろうか。
strings.translated: Would she really live out her days trembling in the shadow of the man who had violated her?

strings.text: そんな人生は、絶対に嫌だった。
strings.translated: She absolutely refused to accept a life like that.

Yumemi
"If... being friends... is okay with you..."

strings.text:
夢美
「友達から、で……よければ……私………………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Starting as friends... if that's okay... I..."

strings.text: 上手く言葉が見つからない。
strings.translated: She couldn't find the right words.

strings.text:
こんな調子で大丈夫なのかと、喋りながら不安になっ
た。
strings.translated: She grew anxious as she spoke, wondering if she could really manage this.

strings.text:
だが、夢美がどんなに言いよどんでも、優斗はじっと
待っていてくれる。
strings.translated: But no matter how much Yumemi stumbled over her words, Yuuto waited quietly for her.

strings.text:
夢美が全てを言い終わるのを、急かさず待っていてく
れる。
strings.translated: He waited without rushing her, until she had said everything she needed to say.

strings.text:
夢美
「怖い、けど……自信も、ないけど…………私も……
　このままじゃ……嫌だから……………………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm scared, and... I don't have confidence either... but... I also...
 the way things are now... I hate it, so..."

strings.text:
夢美
「だから、友達から、始めさせて下さい」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"So please... let me start as your friend."

strings.text: 胸がホッと軽くなった。
strings.translated: A warm relief spread through her chest.

strings.text:
体から緊張が抜けていって、いつの間にか自分が汗だ
くになっていた事に気付いた。
strings.translated: The tension drained from her body, and she realized she had broken into a sweat without even noticing.

strings.text: 目尻から涙が零れそうになり、思わず顔を背けて拭う。
strings.translated: Tears threatened to spill from the corners of her eyes, and she turned her face away to wipe them.

strings.text:
何かに対してこんなに安心したのは、もしかすると
初めてかもしれなかった……。
strings.translated: It might have been the first time she had ever felt so relieved about anything...

strings.text:
優斗
「それじゃあ、ご馳走様でした」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Well then, thank you for the meal."

strings.text:
夢美
「はい、またのお越しをお待ちしております」
いつもの明るい声で言って、優斗を見送る。
strings.translated: She called out in her usual bright voice and watched Yuuto leave.

strings.text:
歩いている途中で優斗が手を振ってきて、夢美もつら
れて手を振り返した。
strings.translated: Partway down the street, Yuuto turned and waved, and Yumemi found herself waving back.

strings.text: 優斗が店に居たのは一時間程。
strings.translated: Yuuto had been in the shop for about an hour.

strings.text: だが、夢美には永遠とも思えるくらい長い時間だった。
strings.translated: But to Yumemi, it had felt like an eternity.

strings.text: その間、他に客が来なかったのは幸いだ。
strings.translated: It was fortunate that no other customers had come in during that time.

strings.text: 店に戻ろうとすると、杏子がドアの前に立っていた。
strings.translated: When she turned to go back inside, Anzu was standing in front of the door.

strings.text:
一部始終を見ていたのだろう、嬉しそうに唇をしなら
せている。
strings.translated: She had clearly watched the whole thing unfold -- her lips were curled in a pleased smile.

strings.text: 夢美は気恥ずかしくなって、ぷいっと顔を背けた。
strings.translated: Yumemi felt her face flush with embarrassment and turned away with a huff.

strings.text:
夢美
「なに、ニヤニヤしてるんですか？」

杏子
「あら、そんな顔してた？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Oh my, was I making that kind of face?"

strings.text:
杏子
「きっと気のせいよ」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"I'm sure it's just your imagination."

strings.text:
そう言いながら、杏子がドアのプレートを引っくり返
すのが目に入った。
strings.translated: As she said that, Yumemi noticed Anzu flip the sign on the door.

strings.text:
杏子
「さっ、今日の残りもお願いね」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Now then, I'll leave the rest of today to you."

strings.text:
呼び止めようとしたが、それより早く杏子が店に戻っ
てしまう。
strings.translated: She tried to call her back, but Anzu had already slipped inside before she could.

strings.text:
引っくり返されたプレートは『ＯＰＥＮ』の文字を
表示していて、それがどういう意味なのか、夢美に
分からないはずがなかった。
strings.translated: The flipped sign now displayed the word "OPEN," and there was no way Yumemi could mistake what that meant.

strings.text: 言葉に様々な思いを乗せて、夢美がうんと伸びをする。
strings.translated: Pouring all manner of feelings into those words, Yumemi stretched out with all her might.

strings.text: 頭上に広がる空は、今日もいい天気だった……。
strings.translated: The sky spreading above her was clear and beautiful today, just as it had been...

strings.text:
夢美
「あ、すいません。
　今日はモーニングは切れちゃって」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Oh, I'm sorry. We're out of the morning set today."

strings.text: 青年が残念そうに笑う。
strings.translated: The young man smiled with a look of disappointment.

strings.text:
しばらく考える風に天井を見上げたあと、もう一度
笑って軽く頭を下げた。
strings.translated: He gazed up at the ceiling for a moment as if thinking it over, then smiled again and gave a small bow.

strings.text: 席を立って、青年が店を出て行く。
strings.translated: He rose from his seat and left the shop.

strings.text: 夢美は、ただ黙ってそれを見送るしかなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi could only watch him go in silence.

strings.text: この日以来、青年が店に来ることはなくなった……。
strings.translated: From that day on, the young man never came to the shop again...

strings.text:
食事をして風呂に入って、パジャマに着替えたあと
ベッドに体を転がす。
strings.translated:
After eating dinner and taking a bath, she changed into her pajamas
and flopped down onto the bed.

strings.text:
柔らかな弾力に身を任せながら天井を見つめ、今日の
出来事を思い返した。
strings.translated:
She let herself sink into the soft, yielding mattress and stared up at the ceiling,
reflecting on the day's events.

strings.text:
枕元には蟲がいて、何を考えているのかじっと夢美の
顔を見つめている……。
strings.translated:
The Bug was at her bedside, staring intently at Yumemi's face,
as if lost in thought...

strings.text:
夢美
「良かったのかな、これで……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Was this okay... the way things turned out...?"

strings.text: 蟲の頭をツンと突いて、独り言のようにつぶやく。
strings.translated: She poked the Bug's head with a finger and murmured, as if talking to herself.

strings.text:
答えなど返ってくるはずもないのに、ついそんな言葉
を続けてしまった。
strings.translated:
She knew there was no way it would answer, yet she found herself
continuing anyway.

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲のアンタに言っても分かんないか」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I guess talking to you about it wouldn't make sense, would it -- you're just a Bug."

strings.text:
もう二、三度突付いてみると、それに応えるように、
蟲も自らの触手を絡めてきた。
strings.translated:
After poking it two or three more times, the Bug responded in kind,
wrapping its tentacles around her finger.

strings.text:
優しい手触りが、不思議と夢美の気持ちを軽くしてい
く……。
strings.translated: The gentle, soft sensation strangely lightened Yumemi's heart...

strings.text: とりあえず、悪い形にはなっていないはずだった。
strings.translated: At any rate, things hadn't turned out badly.

strings.text:
未だうやむやになっている部分はあるが、少なくとも
以前のように話はできる。
strings.translated:
There were still parts left unresolved, but at least
they could talk like before.

strings.text:
今後のことは分からないが、気まずくなったまま店に
来られなくなるよりはずっとマシだった。
strings.translated:
Whatever the future held, it was far better than things staying awkward
and him never coming to the shop again.

strings.text:
夢美
（私……ホッとしてるんだ…………）

優斗がまた店に来てくれるようになった事に、夢美は
自分でも驚くほど安堵を覚えていた。
strings.translated:
Yumemi felt a sense of relief -- even surprising herself --
that Yuuto had started coming to the shop again.

strings.text:
つい先日まで、ロクに意識さえした事のなかった相手
に、今は多少なりとも興味を抱いている。
strings.translated:
Until just recently, he had been someone she had barely even noticed,
yet now she found herself at least somewhat interested in him.

strings.text:
告白されたから気になり始めた――というのは、決し
て悪いことでも不純なことでもないだろう。
strings.translated:
Starting to take notice of someone because they confessed to you --
that was neither a bad thing nor an impure one.

strings.text:
自分の想いがどこまで育つのは、それはまだ分からな
かったが、今の夢美にとって優斗の存在は、ほんの少
しだけ特別なものになりつつあった。
strings.translated:
She didn't yet know how far her own feelings would grow,
but for Yumemi right now, Yuuto's presence was slowly becoming
something just a little bit special.

strings.text: 小声でつぶやいて、夢美はそっとまぶたを閉じた。
strings.translated: She murmured softly and gently closed her eyes.

strings.text: 指にはまだ、蟲の触手が絡み付いていた……。
strings.translated: The Bug's tentacles were still wound around her slender fingers...

strings.text: 小声でつぶやいて、夢美はそっとまぶたを閉じる。
strings.translated: She murmured softly and gently closed her eyes.

strings.text:
指に絡んでいた蟲の触手が、少しずつ夢美の体のほう
に伸びて来た。
strings.translated:
The Bug's tentacles, which had been coiled around her finger, slowly
began to extend toward Yumemi's body.

strings.text:
手首から肘まで、肌を滑るように移動して、脇の下へ
と入り込んでいく。
strings.translated:
They moved from her wrist to her elbow, gliding across her skin,
slipping in beneath her arm.

strings.text:
いつもなら、このまま応じても何ら問題はないのだが、
今夜は少しだけ気が引けた。
strings.translated:
On any other night, she would have had no reason to refuse,
but tonight she felt just a little reluctant.

strings.text:
夢美
「ごめん、今日はちょっと…………」

触手を指で摘んで拒否の意思を示すと、蟲はすぐに
それを理解した。
strings.translated:
She pinched the tentacle between her fingers to signal her refusal,
and the Bug understood immediately.

strings.text:
伸ばしていた触手を引き戻し、それらを全て胴体の
内側へと収納する。
strings.translated:
It drew back the tentacles it had extended and retracted them all
back inside its body.

strings.text:
表情など無いはずなのに、その時の蟲はどこか寂しそ
うな雰囲気だった。
strings.translated:
It had no face to speak of, yet in that moment the Bug seemed
somehow lonely.

strings.text:
夢美
「男の人と付き合ったら、こういうのも浮気になるの
　かな？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"If I started dating a guy, would something like this
 count as cheating?"

strings.text: 蟲の背中を撫でながら、ふとそんな事を考える。
strings.translated: She stroked the Bug's back and let the thought drift through her mind.

strings.text:
夢美としては、浮気などというつもりは毛頭無いが、
男側から見ればそうも言っていられないのかもしれな
い。
strings.translated:
As far as Yumemi was concerned, she had no intention of calling it cheating,
but from a man's perspective, he might not be able to say the same.

strings.text:
自分の付き合っている女が、夜な夜な蟲と肌を重ねて
いる……。
strings.translated: His girlfriend, spending night after night entwined with a Bug...

strings.text:
どの角度から見ても、男側が喜びそうな要素はひとつ
もなかった。
strings.translated:
No matter how you looked at it, there was not a single element
a man would be happy about.

strings.text:
夢美
「もしかすると、いつかアンタとできなくなる日も
　来ちゃうのかもしれないね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Maybe someday, a day will come when I can't do this
 with you anymore."

strings.text:
慈しむように蟲を撫でながら、夢美はぼんやりと未来
について想像した。
strings.translated:
She stroked the Bug tenderly and let her thoughts drift
vaguely toward the future.

strings.text:
自分の隣に優斗が立っている光景が浮かび、ほのかに
顔が赤くなった。
strings.translated:
An image surfaced of Yuuto standing by her side, and her cheeks
flushed faintly.

strings.text: 夢美には、二つの収入源があった。
strings.translated: Yumemi had two sources of income.

strings.text:
一つは説明するまでもなく、ＡｎｚＵのアルバイト代
だ。
strings.translated: One of them needed no explanation -- her part-time wages from AnzU.

strings.text: 毎月二十五日に銀行口座へと支払われている。
strings.translated: Paid into her bank account on the twenty-fifth of every month.

strings.text:
一日の労働時間にばらつきがあるため収入は幅がある
が、だいたい十七万から二十万ほどだ。
strings.translated:
Since her daily hours varied, so did her earnings,
but it came to roughly 170,000 to 200,000 yen.

strings.text:
本来、これだけでは今の生活を維持することはできな
い。
strings.translated: On its own, this would not normally be enough to sustain her current lifestyle.

strings.text: それを可能にしているのが、もう一つの収入源だった。
strings.translated: What made that possible was her other source of income.

strings.text: 明細票を片手に、夢美が小さく溜息をついた。
strings.translated: Statement in hand, Yumemi let out a small sigh.

strings.text:
つい今し方銀行から出てきたところで、今月の収入を
確認したところだ。
strings.translated:
She had just come out of the bank a moment ago
and had checked this month's earnings.

strings.text: バイト料の入金と、もうひとつ――――
strings.translated: The deposit of her part-time wages, and one other thing ----

strings.text: 入金されていた額は三十万円。

夢美が今の生活を始めてから、毎月必ず同じ日に振り
込まれている。
strings.translated: Ever since Yumemi had started her current lifestyle, it had been transferred on the same day every month without fail.

strings.text:
だから、実のところ夢美はアルバイトなどしなくても
生きていける。
strings.translated: So in truth, Yumemi could get by without working a part-time job at all.

strings.text:
極端に金遣いの荒い生活をしなければ、もっと好きな
物を買ったり、旅行に行ったりする事も可能なのだ。
strings.translated: As long as she didn't live extravagantly, she could even buy more of what she wanted or go on trips.

strings.text:
――と言うよりも、この金の振り込まれている理由を
考えると、必要以上に遣い込むことができなかった。
strings.translated: Rather -- when she thought about the reason this money was being sent to her, she couldn't bring herself to spend more than necessary.

strings.text:
大した理由もなく、五年間毎月三十万円もの金を振り
込む事などできるはずもない。
strings.translated: No one could possibly wire 300,000 yen every month for five years without some reason behind it.

strings.text: そこにある理由は、おそらく裏側の――――――
strings.translated: And the reason behind it probably lay in the hidden world --

strings.text:
夢美
「ああ、もうっ！　考えるのやめやめっ！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ugh, enough already! I'm done thinking about it!"

strings.text:
果たしてこの人物が何者なのか、夢美はあまり考えな
いようにして過ごしてきた。
strings.translated: Whoever this person was, Yumemi had made a point of not dwelling on it too much.

strings.text:
考えたところで答えが出るものではないし、出たとこ
ろで何かが変わるわけでもない。
strings.translated: Thinking about it wouldn't give her any answers, and even if it did, nothing would change.

strings.text:
むしろ入金がストップするなどの変わり方をすると、
少々厄介なことになるのだ。
strings.translated: If anything, a change like the payments suddenly stopping would be rather inconvenient.

strings.text:
いつまでも続けられる生活ではないと思いながら、
今年で五年目――――。
strings.translated: Knowing this couldn't go on forever, yet here she was, five years in --

strings.text:
自分で勝手に名付けた『足長オジサン』に感謝しなが
ら、夢美はＡｎｚＵへの道のりを急いだ……。
strings.translated: Silently grateful to the "Daddy-Long-Legs" she had named on her own, Yumemi hurried on her way to AnzU...

strings.text: その日、優斗が初めてカウンター席に着いた。
strings.translated: That day, Yuuto sat at the counter for the first time.

strings.text:
夢美と話がしやすいと思ったのか、一番端の椅子に
腰を下ろす。
strings.translated: Perhaps thinking it would be easier to talk to Yumemi there, he settled into the seat at the far end.

strings.text:
そこは、仕事がない時は夢美がよく待機している場所
で、実際その席に座った客と話すこともよくある。
strings.translated: That spot was where Yumemi often waited when she had no work to do, and she did frequently end up chatting with customers who sat there.

strings.text:
優斗は夢美と視線を合わせると照れたように笑い、
夢美もまた頬を赤らめながら笑みを返した。
strings.translated: When Yuuto caught Yumemi's eye, he smiled with a hint of shyness, and Yumemi smiled back, her cheeks flushing slightly.

strings.text:
ふと気が付けば、会話はどちらからともなく始まって
いた……。
strings.translated: Before either of them realized it, a conversation had begun, as if on its own...

strings.text:
夢美
「今日も、これから学校なんですか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Are you heading to school again today?"

strings.text:
優斗
「うん、まぁ……いつもと同じことの繰り返しだけど
　ね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Yeah, more or less... same thing as always, really."

strings.text:
優斗
「データの整理ばっかりだから、あんまり学生って
　気分でもなくなってるけど」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"It's mostly just sorting through data, so I don't really feel like a student anymore."

strings.text:
夢美
「他の勉強ってしないんですか？」

優斗
「いや、しないとマズイんだけどね」
優斗がコーヒーを飲みながら苦笑いを浮かべる。
strings.translated: Yuuto gave a wry smile as he sipped his coffee.

strings.text:
後先考えず研究に没頭している様子が、手に取るよう
に分かった。
strings.translated: It was plain to see that he was constantly absorbed in his research.

strings.text:
夢美
「それって、好きな授業だけ真面目に受けてるのと
　変わらないような気がしますけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That sounds like you're just seriously attending the classes you like and skipping the rest..."

strings.text:
優斗
「いや、実際そうだよ。
　さすがに担当の教授にもバレかけてて、こっちはい
　いから他の講義に出ろって言われてる」
strings.translated:
