Yuuto
"No, that's pretty much exactly what it is.
My professor's even starting to catch on -- he keeps telling me to stop worrying about his class and go to my other lectures."

strings.text: 教授の立場からすれば当然の発言だ。
strings.translated: From a professor's perspective, that was a perfectly reasonable thing to say.

strings.text:
意外と大雑把というか無計画なところに、夢美は妙な
親近感を覚えてしまった。
strings.translated: The unexpectedly carefree, unplanned side of him gave Yumemi a strange sense of kinship.

strings.text:
実際、夢美も綿密なスケジュールを立てて行動するほ
うではない。
strings.translated: In truth, Yumemi wasn't exactly the type to map out a careful schedule herself.

strings.text:
その日の気分に左右される事が多く、だからこそこう
してＡｎｚＵで働けているとも言えた。
strings.translated: She was often swayed by the mood of the day -- and in a way, that was precisely why she was able to work at AnzU.

strings.text:
――と、店のドアが開いて、夢美は素早く仕事に戻っ
た。
strings.translated: Just then -- the shop door opened, and Yumemi quickly returned to her duties.

strings.text:
優斗も何気なくその方向を見たが、次の瞬間ギョッと
目を丸くする。
strings.translated: Yuuto glanced over in that direction too, but in the next instant his eyes went wide with alarm.

strings.text:
史郎
「おーっ、いたいた。こんな時間に来てたのか」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Oh -- there you are. You were here at this hour?"

strings.text:
夢美
「い、いらっしゃいませ」
店に入って来たのは、優斗の友人である史郎だった。
strings.translated: The one who had walked in was Shirou, a friend of Yuuto's.

strings.text:
出迎えた夢美を見ると、人懐っこそうな笑顔を浮かべ
る。
strings.translated: Catching sight of Yumemi as she greeted him, he broke into an easygoing smile.

strings.text:
夢美
「おはようございます。お席のほうへ――――」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Good morning. Right this way to your seat --"

strings.text:
史郎
「あ、優斗の隣でいいから」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Oh, next to Yuuto is fine."

strings.text:
そう言って、夢美を素通りするようにして、優斗の隣
の席へ着く。
strings.translated: Saying that, he brushed past Yumemi and took the seat beside Yuuto.

strings.text:
優斗はげんなりとして額を押さえ、さも邪魔するなと
言わんばかりの顔で史郎を見ていた。
strings.translated: Yuuto looked utterly deflated, pressing his hand to his forehead with an expression that said as clearly as words: don't bother me.

strings.text:
夢美
「あの、ご注文はお決まりでしょうか」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Um, have you decided on your order?"

strings.text:
史郎
「モーニングセット一つ」

史郎
「なんだよーっ。こんな時間に来てるなら、誘ってく
　れればいいのにさぁーっ！」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Come on! If you were gonna be here at this hour, you could've invited me!"

strings.text:
優斗
「こうなると思ったから誘わなかったんだ」

史郎
「それにしても、ここってウェイトレスさんが間近で
　見られる特等席じゃないか」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Still though, this is a prime seat for getting a close look at the waitress, isn't it."

strings.text:
史郎
「真面目な顔して案外やることエロぃね、このこの」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Acting all serious but you're actually pretty naughty, aren't you, huh, huh?"

strings.text:
優斗を肘で突付きながら、史郎は朝からハイテンショ
ンだ。
strings.translated: Shirou was in high spirits even this early in the morning, jabbing Yuuto in the ribs with his elbow.

strings.text:
対してさっきまで元気だったはずの優斗のほうが、
急にクールダウンしてしまったように見える。
strings.translated: Meanwhile, Yuuto -- who had seemed perfectly cheerful just moments ago -- looked as though he had suddenly cooled right down.

strings.text:
史郎
「いやーっ、やっぱここの制服って可愛いよなぁ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Man, the uniforms here really are cute, aren't they?"

strings.text:
優斗
「頼むから大きな声でそういうことを言うなっ！」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Please, don't say things like that so loudly!"

strings.text: 本気で嫌そうな様子で、優斗が史郎を睨む。
strings.translated: Yuuto glared at Shirou with a look of genuine disgust.

strings.text:
だが、史郎は全く動じた様子は見せず、ポンポンと
優斗の肩を叩いて顔を寄せた。
strings.translated: But Shirou showed no sign of being fazed at all, patting Yuuto on the shoulder a couple of times and leaning in close.

strings.text:
史郎
「いずれはこの周りから冷ややかな目で見られる中、
　メイドさんについて熱～いトークを交わす喜びが
　分かってくるから」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Someday you'll come to understand the joy of having a passionate conversation about maids while the people around you look on with cold, contemptuous eyes."

strings.text:
優斗
「そんなもの分かりたくもない……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I have no desire to understand any such thing..."

strings.text:
史郎
「あれ？　ボク、もう注文したけど？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Hm? I already placed my order, didn't I?"

strings.text:
夢美
「あっ！　す、すいませんっ！！」

つい二人の会話を真正面で聞いてしまった夢美は、
慌てて厨房の杏子へと注文を伝えた。
strings.translated: Having inadvertently listened to the two of them talk from right in front of them, Yumemi hurried to pass the order along to Anzu in the kitchen.

strings.text:
優斗と話せなくなったのは残念だが、そもそも仕事中
なのだから、これで良かったようにも思う。
strings.translated: It was a shame she hadn't been able to talk with Yuuto, but she was on the clock after all -- so perhaps this was for the best.

strings.text:
――と、考えながらも優斗のほうに視線を送ると、
困ったような微苦笑が返された。
strings.translated: Even so, as she thought that, she glanced over toward Yuuto, and was met with a helpless, wry little smile.

strings.text:
優斗と何かが繋がっているような気がして、嬉しかっ
た……。
strings.translated: It made her happy -- as though something had connected between her and Yuuto...

strings.text:
史郎
「ん～、美味しかったぁ」
食事を終えて、優斗と史郎がレジの前まで移動する。
strings.translated: Having finished eating, Yuuto and Shirou made their way over to the register.

strings.text:
史郎は心底満足したようで、ニコニコ顔を浮かべなが
ら腹を摩っている。
strings.translated: Shirou looked thoroughly satisfied, rubbing his stomach with a big grin on his face.

strings.text:
優斗と史郎が店を出て行こうとしたところで、夢美は
思わず声をかけていた。
strings.translated: Just as Yuuto and Shirou were about to leave the shop, Yumemi had called out to them without thinking.

strings.text: 何故、そんな事をしたのか、自分でもよく分からない。
strings.translated: She wasn't entirely sure herself why she had done it.

strings.text:
優斗
「あ……お釣り、違ってた？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Oh... did I get the wrong change?"

strings.text:
夢美
「あ、ち、違いますっ！　合ってますっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"N-no, that's not it! The change is right!!"

strings.text:
夢美
「えっと……その……いってらっしゃい。
　今日も勉強、頑張って下さいね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Um... well... take care.
 Good luck with your studies today."

strings.text:
やや照れたような、少年じみた笑顔を浮かべて、優斗
がＡｎｚＵを出て行く。
strings.translated: With a boyish, slightly bashful smile, Yuuto walked out of AnzU.

strings.text:
史郎は相変わらずのニコニコ顔で、夢美に大きく手を
振りながら店のドアをくぐっていった。
strings.translated: Shirou, grinning as always, gave Yumemi a big wave as he passed through the door.

strings.text:
夢美は、そんな二人の背中を見送りながら、短く一度
だけ嘆息した。
strings.translated: Yumemi watched the two of them go, and let out a single quiet sigh.

strings.text:
今日はもう優斗に会えないと思うと、少しだけ寂し
かった……。
strings.translated: The thought that she wouldn't see Yuuto again for the rest of the day left her feeling just a little lonely...

strings.text:
杏子
「あっ、夢美ちゃん。
　悪いんだけどこれ、貼っておいてくれない？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Oh, Yumemi-chan. Sorry to bother you, but could you put this up for me?"

strings.text:
午前中の仕事が一段落してから、杏子が一枚の紙を
手渡してきた。
strings.translated: After the morning rush had settled down, Anzu handed her a single sheet of paper.

strings.text:
夢美
「アルバイトの募集？」

受け取った紙を見つめながら、夢美が意外そうに言葉
を漏らす。
strings.translated: Yumemi murmured in surprise as she looked over the paper she had been given.

strings.text:
杏子
「最近、お客様の数が増えてきて、二人だけだと
　ちょっと大変になってきたでしょう」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"The number of customers has been picking up lately, and it's getting a little tough with just the two of us, isn't it."

strings.text:
杏子
「これから暑くなるし、今のうちにと思って」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"It's going to get hotter soon, so I figured now was the time."

strings.text:
――などと答えながらも、夢美としてはあまり必要性
は感じなかった。
strings.translated: She answered something to that effect, though Yumemi herself didn't really feel the need for it.

strings.text:
確かに仕事は大変だが、今のところそれを苦痛に感じ
たことはない。
strings.translated: The work was certainly demanding, but she had never found it painful.

strings.text:
この店唯一のウエイトレスという立場もこっそりと
気に入っていたし、このまま杏子と二人だけでも……
という気持ちのほうが今は大きかった。
strings.translated: She had quietly grown fond of her position as the shop's one and only waitress, and right now the feeling of wanting to keep it just the two of them -- her and Anzu -- was stronger.

strings.text:
杏子
「もし、新しい子が来たら夢美ちゃんが先輩になるわ
　けだから、そのときはよろしくね」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"If a new girl does come on, you'll be her senior, Yumemi-chan, so I'll be counting on you when that happens."
Not a bad ring to it.

strings.text:
頭の中で後輩が増えたときの光景をイメージして、
夢美はほくそ笑んだ。
strings.translated: Yumemi smiled to herself, picturing in her mind what it would be like when she had a junior to look after.

strings.text:
夢美
「外と内、どっち貼ります？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Should I put it on the outside or the inside?"

strings.text:
杏子
「ん～、夢美ちゃんにお任せ」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Hmm, I'll leave that up to you, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text:
普段の性格は細かいのだが、何故だかこういった割り
と重要な事柄に対しては頓着がなくなる。
strings.translated: Anzu was usually particular about details, yet for some reason she got careless about fairly important things like this.

strings.text:
どうやら根はのんびり屋のようで、本人から聞いた話
によると、普段の生活は意外とだらしないらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed her true nature was easygoing -- according to what Anzu herself had said, her day-to-day life was surprisingly sloppy.

strings.text:
ともあれ、今は張り紙をする場所を決めなければなら
なかった。
strings.translated: In any case, she had to decide where to put up the notice.

strings.text:
普通に考えれば、外に貼ったほうが集まりはいいだろ
う。
strings.translated: Thinking about it normally, posting it outside would draw more applicants.

strings.text:
だが、夢美としては、この店を利用してくれている客
の誰かに来てほしいという淡い期待感があった。
strings.translated: But Yumemi had a faint hope that someone who was already a regular customer of the shop might apply.

strings.text:
アルバイトの募集用紙を見つめながら、夢美は独り言
のようにつぶやいた……。
strings.translated: She murmured to herself, almost like a private thought, as she stared at the part-time job posting...

strings.text:
夢美
「ま、こんなもんかな」

アルバイトの募集用紙は、結局外に向けて貼ることに
した。
strings.translated: In the end, she decided to post the part-time job notice facing outward.

strings.text:
仕事が忙しいのは事実なのだし、ここは少しでも人目
に触れる場所を選ぶべきだと判断したのだ。
strings.translated: It was true that work kept them busy, and she had decided it was best to put it where as many people as possible would see it.

strings.text:
店内から大通りに向けられた張り紙には、最低限の
情報と、杏子直筆の猫らしき動物のマークが入って
いた。
strings.translated: The notice, visible from the main street through the shop window, contained the bare minimum of information and a drawing of what appeared to be a cat, sketched by Anzu herself.

strings.text:
夢美
「誰か来るといいけど……」

期待と不安を胸に抱きながら、夢美は仕事に戻っ
た……。
strings.translated: With a mix of hope and anxiety in her heart, Yumemi returned to work...

strings.text:
レジの置いてある台――それの真後ろにある壁に張り
紙をして、夢美は満足げにうなずいた。
strings.translated: She posted the notice on the wall directly behind the register counter, and Yumemi nodded with satisfaction.

strings.text:
店内に貼ると決めてからも、どこに貼るか散々迷った
のだが、結局必ず客が通過するレジのそばにしたとい
うわけだ。
strings.translated: Even after deciding to post it inside, she had agonized at length over exactly where -- and in the end settled on a spot near the register, which every customer was sure to pass.

strings.text:
夢美
「誰か来るといいけど……」

期待と不安を胸に抱きながら、夢美は仕事に戻っ
た……。
strings.translated: With a mix of hope and anxiety in her heart, Yumemi returned to work...

strings.text:
夢美
「いらっしゃいませ……何名様でしょうか……お席の
　ほうへご案内いたします……ご注文をお伺いしても
　よろしいでしょうか……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Welcome... how many in your party... right this way to your table... may I take your order..."

strings.text:
店のフロアの中央に立って、夢美は呪文のようにそん
な言葉を呟いていた。
strings.translated: Standing in the middle of the floor, Yumemi was murmuring those words to herself like an incantation.

strings.text: ＡｎｚＵで働き始めてから二年目――――。
strings.translated: It was her second year working at AnzU.

strings.text:
この日は、初めてフロアの仕事をする事になっており、
二週間も前から頭の中に叩き込んでいた言葉を復唱し
ていた。
strings.translated: Today was the first time she would be working the floor, and she was reciting lines she had been drilling into her head for two full weeks.

strings.text:
杏子
「そんなに緊張しなくても大丈夫よ」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"You don't have to be so nervous, it'll be fine."

strings.text: 厨房から顔を出した杏子が、苦笑いしながら言う。
strings.translated: Anzu poked her head out from the kitchen, saying it with a wry smile.

strings.text:
だが、接客業などした事のない夢美にとって、緊張す
るなというほうが無理な話だった。
strings.translated: But for Yumemi, who had never worked in customer service before, being told not to be nervous was easier said than done.

strings.text:
夢美
「杏子さんっ、何かあったら本当に助けて下さいよ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Anzu-san, please, if anything happens, you have to help me!"

strings.text:
杏子
「はいはい、ちゃんと見てるわよ」

カウンターに身を乗り出すようにして言う夢美に、
杏子は軽い調子で答えながら首を引っ込める。
strings.translated: Yumemi leaned over the counter as she said it, and Anzu answered lightly before pulling her head back.

strings.text: 明らかに、緊張している夢美を楽しんでいる顔だった。
strings.translated: It was obvious she was enjoying the sight of Yumemi all flustered.

strings.text:
夢美
「大丈夫……あれだけ練習したんだから…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It's fine... I practiced so much..."

strings.text:
軽く握り拳を作りながら、壁に掛かった時計を見つめ
る。
strings.translated: She made a small fist and stared at the clock hanging on the wall.

strings.text:
午前十時を五分ほど過ぎたところで、いつ客が入って
来てもおかしくはない。
strings.translated: It was just past ten in the morning -- the first customer of the day could walk in at any moment.

strings.text:
むしろ、いつもの事を考えれば、あと五分もしないう
ちに今日最初の客が入ってくるはずだった。
strings.translated: In fact, going by the usual pattern, the first customer should be arriving within the next five minutes.

strings.text: 突然、背後から声を掛けられ、飛び上がるほど驚く。
strings.translated: She was suddenly called from behind and nearly jumped out of her skin.

strings.text:
振り返ると杏子が苦笑しながら、夢美の胸元にそっと
手を伸ばして制服のリボンを整えた。
strings.translated: She turned around to find Anzu smiling wryly as she gently reached toward Yumemi's chest and straightened the ribbon on her uniform.

strings.text:
杏子
「少し曲がってたわよ」
微かに頬を赤くしながら、夢美がやや下を向く。
strings.translated: Her cheeks flushing faintly, Yumemi looked slightly downward.

strings.text:
杏子に優しくされていると、時々母親に世話をされて
いるような気分になって恥ずかしかった。
strings.translated: Whenever Anzu was kind to her, she sometimes felt as though her mother were fussing over her, and it made her embarrassed.

strings.text:
杏子
「気楽に……って言っても無理かもしれないけど、
　夢美ちゃんなら、きっとすぐに慣れると思うわ」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Try to relax... I know that's easier said than done, but I'm sure you'll get used to it in no time, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text:
杏子
「だから、もっと自信を持って……ね？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"So have a little more confidence in yourself, okay?"

strings.text:
杏子の微笑みを受けて、少しだけ胸が軽くなったよう
な気がした。
strings.translated: Receiving Anzu's smile, she felt as though a small weight had lifted from her chest.

strings.text:
不安が消えたわけではないが、少なくとも気分は楽に
なった。
strings.translated: The anxiety hadn't disappeared, but at least she felt a little better.

strings.text: 務めて笑顔を返し、杏子とともに小さく笑い合う。
strings.translated: She forced a smile in return, and the two of them shared a small laugh together.

strings.text:
――と、店のドアが開いて、夢美は緊張しながら来店
した客のもとへと近付いていった。
strings.translated: Just then, the shop door opened, and Yumemi nervously made her way toward the arriving customer.

strings.text:
杏子が、厨房に戻りながらも見守る中、最初に出た
言葉は――――
strings.translated: As Anzu watched from the kitchen doorway, the first words that came out of Yumemi's mouth were --

strings.text:
夢美
「お、お席のほうにご案内いたしますっ！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"P-please right this way to your seat!"

strings.text: 背後で、杏子が小さく吹いたのが聞こえた……。
strings.translated: Behind her, she heard Anzu stifle a small laugh...

strings.text:
夢美
「ん～、だいぶ遅くなっちゃったなぁ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Hmm, I ended up staying pretty late, didn't I."

strings.text: ＡｎｚＵを出た頃には、陽はとっぷりと暮れていた。
strings.translated: By the time she left Cafe AnzU, the sun had fully set.

strings.text: 今日は少し雲も出ているようで、月の光も翳り気味だ。
strings.translated: It seemed there were a few clouds out tonight, and the moonlight was somewhat dimmed.

strings.text:
自宅のマンションまでは、歩いて十分ほどの距離だっ
たが、普段はあまり暗くならないうちに帰るようにし
ていた。
strings.translated:
Her apartment was only about a ten-minute walk away,
but she usually made a point of heading home before it
got too dark.

strings.text:
理由としては色々あるが、その最たるものは暗闇への
恐怖だ。
strings.translated:
There were various reasons for this, but the greatest
of them was her fear of the dark.

strings.text:
闇の中にいると、どうしても過去が思い起こされ、
自然と体が震えてきてしまう。
strings.translated:
Whenever she was in the darkness, the past would inevitably
come flooding back, and her body would begin to tremble
on its own.

strings.text:
背後からあの男が現れ、また自分を連れ去ってしまう
のではないかと、そんな恐怖が常につきまとうのだっ
た。
strings.translated:
The fear that the man from before might appear behind her
and take her away again -- that dread clung to her always.

strings.text: 夜でも歩けるようになったのは、ここ一年ほどの事。
strings.translated: It had only been about a year since she had become able to walk at night.

strings.text:
ＡｎｚＵから自宅のマンションまでの間、しかも大き
な道に限定されるが、一人でも普通に帰ることができ
る。
strings.translated:
Only along the stretch between AnzU and her apartment,
and only on the main road -- but she could now make it
home alone without incident.

strings.text:
他人にとっては何でもない事のように思えるだろうが、
夢美にとっては大きな進歩だった。
strings.translated:
To anyone else it might seem like nothing at all, but
for Yumemi it was a tremendous step forward.

strings.text: ――少しずつ慣れていけばいい。
strings.translated: Little by little -- it was fine to take it slowly.

strings.text:
そんな風に考えることができるようになったのは、
杏子がいてくれたからこそだ。
strings.translated:
The fact that she had come to think that way
was entirely because Anzu had been there for her.

strings.text:
不安なとき、悲しいとき、そして悩んでいるとき、
杏子は必ず的確なアドバイスをくれた。
strings.translated:
Whenever she was anxious, sad, or troubled,
Anzu always gave her exactly the right advice.

strings.text:
口に出した事はないが、夢美にとって杏子は母親のよ
うな存在でもあった。
strings.translated:
She had never said it aloud, but to Yumemi,
Anzu was something like a mother figure.

strings.text:
幸いにしてと言うべきか、帰り道にある家々の窓から
は、まだ明るい光が漏れていた。
strings.translated:
Fortunately -- if that was the right word -- warm light
still spilled from the windows of the houses along her way home.

strings.text: これがあるとないのとでは、安心感がまるで違う。
strings.translated: Having those lights on made all the difference to her peace of mind.

strings.text:
近くに人がいると実感するだけで、夢美の足取りは
軽くなれた。
strings.translated:
Simply feeling that people were nearby was enough
to lighten Yumemi's step.

strings.text: 夜の帰り道でも、必要以上に怖がらずに済んだ。
strings.translated: Even on the dark walk home, she could manage without being more frightened than necessary.

strings.text:
不意に、背後に人の気配を感じたような気がして、
夢美は思わず足を止めた。
strings.translated:
Suddenly, she felt as though she sensed someone's presence
behind her, and Yumemi stopped in her tracks without thinking.

strings.text: 振り返ってみるが誰もいない。
strings.translated: She turned to look, but there was no one there.

strings.text: 誰もいないが誰かいるような気がする。
strings.translated: No one was there, and yet she felt as though someone was.

strings.text:
ただの気のせいだとは思ったが、夢美は何となく怖く
なって自宅までの道のりを急いだ。
strings.translated: She told herself it was just her imagination, but Yumemi felt a vague unease creep over her and hurried the rest of the way home.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……はぁ…………」
嫌な気配は、ずっと背中に纏わりついて来た。
strings.translated: The unpleasant presence clung to her back the entire way.

strings.text:
まるで、粘り気のある粘土のように、夢美の体を後ろ
へ引き戻そうとする。
strings.translated:
Like sticky, viscous clay, it seemed to pull
Yumemi's body backward.

strings.text: 誰かがいるわけではない。
何かが聞こえるわけでもない。
strings.translated: There was nothing to be heard.

strings.text: だが、それでも何かが追いかけて来るように感じる。
strings.translated: And yet, something felt as though it were chasing her.

strings.text:
夢美は、途中から早足になって、自宅のマンションの
前に着く頃には大きく肩で息をしていた。
strings.translated:
Yumemi had quickened her pace partway through, and by the time she reached the front of her apartment building,
she was breathing hard, her shoulders heaving with each breath.

strings.text:
振り返っても誰もいないのに、何故だか誰かに追い立
てられているような気がする。
strings.translated:
Even when she turned around and saw no one, she felt
for some reason as though something were hounding her.

strings.text:
とにかく怖くて、吐き気がするほど恐ろしくて、部屋
までの階段を一気に駆け上がった。
strings.translated:
She was simply terrified -- so frightened she felt sick --
and she sprinted up the stairs to her room in one go.

strings.text: 部屋に駆け込むや否や、夢美は勢いよくドアを閉めた。
strings.translated: The moment she burst into her room, Yumemi slammed the door shut behind her.

strings.text: 同時に鍵を掛けて、ノブをしっかりと握り締める。
strings.translated: She locked it at the same time and gripped the knob tightly.

strings.text:
今にも誰かが開けてきそうな気がして、心臓が破裂し
そうだった。
strings.translated:
Her heart felt ready to burst, certain that someone
would try to open it at any moment.

strings.text:
額からはどっと汗が噴き出し、雫が顎のほうへと垂れ
てくる。
strings.translated: Sweat poured from her forehead and dripped down toward her chin.

strings.text:
夢美は、暫くそのままの体勢で固まっていたが、やが
て少しずつ力を抜いてドアへと背中を預けた。
strings.translated:
She remained frozen in that position for a while, but eventually let the tension drain from her body little by little,
leaning her back against the door.

strings.text: ようやく体に安堵感が染み渡っていく。
strings.translated: At last, a sense of relief began to seep through her body.

strings.text:
ただの気のせいだったのかもしれないが、それでも
部屋に入って初めて安心することができた。
strings.translated:
It may have been nothing but her imagination, but only
now that she was inside did she finally feel safe.

strings.text:
――と、何か柔らかいものを踏んだ感触を覚えて、
夢美はふと足元を見下ろした。
strings.translated:
Then -- she felt something soft underfoot, and
Yumemi glanced down at her feet.

strings.text:
ドアの隙間から差し込んだのだろう、足元に一通の
封筒が落ちていた。
strings.translated:
It must have been slipped through the gap under the door --
a single envelope lay on the floor at her feet.

strings.text: 差出人の名前も何もない、ただの白い封筒。
strings.translated: A plain white envelope with no sender's name or anything written on it.

strings.text:
拾い上げてみようとした瞬間、一瞬だけ悪寒がして
手を止めた。
strings.translated:
The moment she reached down to pick it up, a sudden chill ran through her
and she froze.

strings.text: 自分にそう言い聞かせて、封筒を拾い上げる。
strings.translated: She told herself that and picked up the envelope.

strings.text:
外からでは中身が何なのか分からなかったが、指先に
伝わってくる感触はやや硬い。
strings.translated:
She couldn't tell from the outside what was inside, but
the sensation transmitted through her fingertips was somewhat stiff.

strings.text:
微かに震える指で封を切ると、中に詰まっている物を
引っ張り出した。
strings.translated:
With trembling fingers, she tore open the envelope and
pulled out what was stuffed inside.

strings.text:
封筒の中から出てきた物を見た瞬間、夢美は思わずそ
れを投げ捨てていた。
strings.translated: The moment she saw what had come out of the envelope, Yumemi had already thrown it away without thinking.

strings.text:
十枚ほどの写真が、バラバラと宙を舞って足元に落ち
る。
strings.translated: About ten photographs scattered through the air and fell at her feet.

strings.text:
そこに映されていたのは、蟲の触手に犯されている
夢美の姿だった。
strings.translated: What was captured in them was an image of Yumemi being violated by Bug tentacles.

strings.text: あまりの衝撃に言葉が続かない。
strings.translated: The shock was so overwhelming that words failed her.

strings.text:
全身を触手に絡め取られ、股間を犯されている自分の
姿を凝視し続けた。
strings.translated: She kept staring at the image of herself -- her entire body entwined in tentacles, her groin being violated.

strings.text:
何故なら、写真に写っている夢美は、五年前ではなく
今の夢美の顔をしているからだ。
strings.translated: Because the Yumemi in the photographs had her current face -- not the face she had five years ago.

strings.text:
じっと見ていると、顔の部分だけ後から貼り付けたも
のだと分かった。
strings.translated: Staring closely, she could tell that only the face had been pasted on afterward.

strings.text: だが、それで平気になれるわけではない。
strings.translated: But that didn't make it any easier to bear.

strings.text:
むしろ恐怖は高まる一方で、頭の中がグラグラと揺れ
た。
strings.translated: If anything, the fear only kept mounting, and her head swam with vertigo.

strings.text:
――と、夢美が帰ってきた事に気付いた蟲が、触手を
揺らしながら近付いて来る。
strings.translated: Just then -- the Bug, having sensed Yumemi's return, came creeping toward her, its tentacles swaying.

strings.text: 自分でも想ってもみなかった言葉が出た。
strings.translated: Words she never thought she'd say came out of her mouth.

strings.text:
蟲の触手がぴたりと止まり、暫くその場で待機したあ
と、すごすごとソファーの下に戻っていく。
strings.translated: The Bug's tentacles stopped dead, and after waiting in place for a moment, it slunk back under the sofa.

strings.text:
言葉そのものは通じなくとも、夢美が本気で拒絶した
ことは理解したようだった。
strings.translated: Even if the words themselves hadn't gotten through, it seemed to understand that Yumemi had truly rejected it.

strings.text:
足元に広がった写真を見つめながら、夢美はガタガタ
と体を震わせた。
strings.translated: Staring at the photographs spread across the floor, Yumemi's body shook uncontrollably.

strings.text: ただの嫌がらせではない。

たとえ合成写真でも、こんな物を送りつけてくる以上、
夢美の過去を知っている誰かの仕業なのは間違いない。
strings.translated: Even if they were doctored photos, whoever sent something like this clearly knew about Yumemi's past -- there was no doubt about that.

strings.text:
夢美は唐突に吐き気を催すと、靴を履いたまま洗面所
へ走り込み――――
strings.translated: Yumemi was suddenly overcome with nausea, and still wearing her shoes, she ran into the bathroom --

strings.text:
夢美
「うげええぇぇぇぇぇーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーっ！！！！」

strings.translated: -- and vomited right then and there.

strings.text:
結局、写真はライターで焼いて処分したが、ヘドロ
のように溜まった恐怖は、どうする事もできなかっ
た……。
strings.translated: In the end, she burned the photographs with a lighter and disposed of them, but the fear that had built up like sludge inside her -- there was nothing she could do about that...

strings.text:
煉悟と言う蟲使いに誘拐されてから、夢美の運命は
大きな変化を迎える事となった。
strings.translated: From the moment she was kidnapped by the Bug User called Rengo, Yumemi's fate underwent a great change.

strings.text:
繰り返される日々は恐怖で塗りたくられ、『人』では
なく『物』として扱われる日が何日も続いた。
strings.translated: The days that repeated themselves were painted over with terror, and day after day she was treated not as a 'person' but as an 'object.'

strings.text:
それまで見た事もなかった蟲に犯され、卵を産み付け
られ、数日後には出産を迎えた。
strings.translated: She was violated by Bugs she had never seen before, had eggs implanted inside her, and days later came the birth.

strings.text:
体内から別の生物が産まれてくる感覚は、今も鮮明に
思い出す事ができる。
strings.translated: The sensation of another living creature being born from within her body -- she can still recall it vividly even now.

strings.text:
産道、または直腸をナメクジのような蟲が這いずって
くるあのおぞましい感覚。
strings.translated: That horrifying sensation of slug-like Bugs crawling through the birth canal, or through the rectum.

strings.text:
小水や排泄物とともに、別の生命を体外へとぶちまけ
たあの体験は、今尚夢美の心に深い傷となって残って
いた。
strings.translated: That experience of expelling another life form from her body along with urine and waste -- it remained as a deep scar in Yumemi's heart even now.

strings.text:
自分を誘拐した男を殺し、あの倉庫から逃げ出した後、
夢美の心の支えになってくれたのは、他ならぬ自分が
産み落とした蟲だった。
strings.translated: After killing the man who had kidnapped her and escaping from that warehouse, what became Yumemi's emotional support was none other than the Bugs she herself had given birth to.

strings.text:
『期待外れ』と言われたその蟲がいたからこそ、夢美
は完全な孤独の中に身を置かずに済んだのだ。
strings.translated:
It was precisely because of that Bug -- the one called a "disappointment" -- that Yumemi
was spared from being utterly alone.

strings.text: あの忌まわしい倉庫から逃げ出して一週間後。
strings.translated: One week after fleeing from that accursed warehouse.

strings.text:
夢美は、物を入手する事において、もっとも短絡的な
行為である『万引き』をもって、自らの生命を繋げて
いた……。
strings.translated: Yumemi was keeping herself alive by shoplifting -- the crudest, most shortsighted way there was to get anything...

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ…………！」

盗んだ物を胸に抱えて、少女は荒い息をつきながら
走っていた。
strings.translated: Clutching her stolen goods to her chest, the girl ran with ragged breath.

strings.text:
目の前に壁のようにそびえ立つ大人達の脇をすり抜け
ながら、大通りを真っ直ぐに南下する。
strings.translated: Weaving past the adults who loomed before her like walls, she headed straight south down the main road.

strings.text: 背後からは、誰かが追いかけて来る気配。
strings.translated: From behind -- the sense of someone giving chase.

strings.text:
その気配から、少女は必死に、ただひたすらに逃げ続
けた。
strings.translated: From that presence, the girl kept running desperately, with nothing but the single-minded will to escape.

strings.text: 人ごみに紛れて、いきなり路地裏へと曲がる。
strings.translated: She slipped into the crowd and suddenly turned into an alley.

strings.text:
――と、さらに角をひとつ曲がったところで、今度は
反対に大通りへと戻る。
strings.translated: Then -- rounding one more corner, she reversed course and headed back out onto the main road.

strings.text:
これをするだけで、だいぶ相手を混乱させる事ができ
た。
strings.translated: That alone was enough to throw her pursuer into considerable confusion.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……はぁ…………」
走る速度を少し緩めて、そっと後ろを振り返る。
strings.translated: She eased her running pace slightly and glanced back over her shoulder.

strings.text: 誰かが追って来る様子は無し。
strings.translated: No sign of anyone giving chase.

strings.text:
だが、少女は足を止める事なく、そのまま郊外にある
森を目指した。
strings.translated: Still, the girl didn't stop moving, and pressed on toward the forest on the outskirts of town.

strings.text: そこが――ここ数日の少女の棲家だった――――。
strings.translated: That place -- had been the girl's dwelling for the past few days.

strings.text:
森の奥深くに分け入って、少女は誰に対するでもなく
つぶやいた。
strings.translated: Venturing deep into the forest, the girl murmured to no one in particular.

strings.text:
もちろん、少女以外に人の姿はないし、これから来る
誰かと待ち合わせをしているわけでもない。
strings.translated: Of course, there was no other person present, nor was she waiting for anyone to arrive.

strings.text:
少女が声を掛けたのは、人間以外の生物に対してだっ
た。
strings.translated: The one she had spoken to was not a human being.

strings.text: 湿った切り株の上に、盗って来た物を並べる。
strings.translated: She arranged the things she had stolen on top of a damp tree stump.

strings.text:
収穫はスナック菓子が二袋と、ペットボトルのお茶が
一本。
strings.translated: The haul was two bags of snack chips and one bottle of tea.

strings.text: 今日を乗り切るには、十分な食料だった。
strings.translated: It was enough food to get through the day.

strings.text:
バリバリと袋を破って、泥に汚れた手のまま中に突っ
込む。
strings.translated: She tore the bag open with a crinkle and thrust her mud-caked hand inside.

strings.text:
清潔な食べ物など、ここ数ヶ月、少女には無縁の代物
だった。
strings.translated: Clean food had been a stranger to the girl for the past several months.

strings.text:
自分が生きていることの意味を考える暇もなく、ただ
生きるためだけの行動を取る。
strings.translated: No time to ponder the meaning of her own existence -- she acted only for the sake of staying alive.

strings.text:
万引きは悪い事だとか、食事の前に手は洗ったほうが
いいだとか、そんなものは生死の選択の前では無意味
なルールでしかなかった。
strings.translated: Things like shoplifting being wrong, or washing your hands before eating -- before the choice between life and death, such things were nothing but meaningless rules.

strings.text: 生きるために必要なのは食べる事。
strings.translated: What she needed to live was to eat.

strings.text: そのためならば、時には他の生命さえ奪う必要もある。
strings.translated: And for that, there were times when she even had to take other lives.

strings.text:
現に、この時少女のもっとも身近にいる生命は、それ
を毎日のように見せてくれていた。
strings.translated: In fact, the life closest to the girl at that moment showed her exactly that, day after day.

strings.text:
藪の中から出てきた一匹の蟲に、少女は何の感慨もな
い声で言った。
strings.translated: The girl said it in a flat, indifferent voice to a single Bug that had emerged from the undergrowth.

strings.text:
冷たい、のとは少し違う、相手にしていない雰囲気が
そこにはあった。
strings.translated: It wasn't quite coldness -- more an air of simply not engaging with the other at all.

strings.text:
蟲は、バッタか何かを捕まえているようで、モシャモ
シャと動く口から太い脚が見えていた。
strings.translated: The Bug seemed to have caught a grasshopper or something; a thick leg was visible jutting from its churning maw.

strings.text:
いつだったか、通っていた学校の先生がそんな風に
言っていたのを思い出した。
strings.translated: She recalled a teacher at the school she had once attended saying something like that.

strings.text:
他にも、食物連鎖だとか弱肉強食だとか、蟲を見てい
るとそんな言葉ばかりが浮かぶ。
strings.translated: Food chains, survival of the fittest -- watching the Bug, those were the only words that came to mind.

strings.text:
だが、実際に世の中はそういうシステムで成り立って
いることを、少女は漠然と感じ取っていた。
strings.translated: But the girl had a vague, instinctive sense that the world truly did operate on such a system.

strings.text:
夢美
「寝る場所、探さないと……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I need to find somewhere to sleep..."

strings.text:
もそもそとスナック菓子を食べながら、少女はついと
町のほうに視線を向けた。
strings.translated: Munching absently on her snack chips, the girl cast her gaze toward the town.

strings.text:
この町に来たのは今日の午前中で、その前はもっと
小さな田舎町に隠れ住んでいた。
strings.translated: She had arrived in this town that morning; before that, she had been hiding in a smaller, more rural town.

strings.text:
旅をしているつもりはないが、当てもなく町から町へ
渡り歩いているのは事実だ。
strings.translated: She had no intention of traveling, yet the fact remained that she drifted from town to town with no destination in mind.

strings.text:
では、何故そんな事をするのかと言えば、実のところ
自分でもよく分かっていない。
strings.translated: As for why she did such a thing -- honestly, even she didn't quite understand.

strings.text:
ただ、何か得体の知れないものから逃げているようで、
それで警察に行く事もできないでいた。
strings.translated: She only felt as though she were fleeing from something unknown, and that was why she couldn't bring herself to go to the police.

strings.text:
この時、少女自身は気付いていなかったが、体には
疲労が蓄積され、そろそろ限界を迎えようとしていた。
strings.translated: The girl herself hadn't noticed, but fatigue had been accumulating in her body, and she was approaching her limit.

strings.text:
いや、限界などとっくに超えていて、しかしそれでも
生きたいという想いが、少女の体を突き動かしている
に過ぎなかった。
strings.translated: No -- she had long since surpassed her limit, and it was nothing more than the will to live that kept her body moving.

strings.text: 少女は気付いていない。
自分の体が、如何に痩せ細っているのかを――――。
strings.translated: How terribly thin her own body had become ---.

strings.text: 少女は気付いていない。

自分の着ている服が、如何に汚れ、擦り切れ、みすぼ
らしいかを――――。
strings.translated: How filthy, worn, and ragged the clothes on her back had become ---.

strings.text: 少女は気付いていない。

自分自身が、如何に『表』の世界から外れてしまった
のかを――――。
strings.translated: How far she herself had strayed from the world of the 'surface' ---.

strings.text:
少女が、とある少女と出会ったのは、まだそんな生活
を続けているときだった……。
strings.translated: It was while she was still living that kind of life that the girl encountered a certain other girl...

strings.text:
写真の一件から一夜明けて、夢美は陰鬱な朝を迎えて
いた。
strings.translated: The morning after the incident with the photograph, Yumemi woke to a gloomy day.

strings.text:
ベッドの上で体は起こしたものの、そこから下りるだ
けの気力がない。
strings.translated: She had managed to sit up in bed, but lacked the will to climb down from it.

strings.text:
一夜明ければ何か変わるのではないかと期待したが、
そんな事にはならなかった。
strings.translated: She had hoped that a night's sleep might change something, but it hadn't.

strings.text: 夢美の過去を彷彿とさせる写真。
strings.translated: A photograph that evoked Yumemi's past.

strings.text:
眠ったことで多少は落ち着いたものの、混乱が収まっ
たわけではない。
strings.translated: Sleep had calmed her somewhat, but the confusion had not subsided.

strings.text:
むしろ、冷静に考えられる部分が増えてしまったため、
胸の奥の恐怖は増す一方だった。
strings.translated: If anything, having grown more capable of thinking clearly only made the fear lurking deep in her chest grow worse.

strings.text: 一つは、犯人がどうやって夢美の過去を知ったか。
strings.translated: One was how the culprit had learned of Yumemi's past.

strings.text: もう一つは、何の意味があってこんな事をするのか。
strings.translated: The other was what purpose lay behind doing such a thing.

strings.text:
夢美の過去を知る人間は、極少数に限られているはず
だし、その首謀者とも言える男はすでに死んでいる。
strings.translated: The number of people who knew Yumemi's past should have been extremely small, and the man who could be called the ringleader was already dead.

strings.text:
一体どういう経緯で知られてしまったのか、まずそれ
が分からなかった。
strings.translated: How they had come to know about it in the first place -- that was the first thing she couldn't figure out.

strings.text: 単なるいやがらせにしては、不可解な点が多すぎる。
strings.translated: For a simple act of harassment, there were far too many inexplicable elements.

strings.text:
あれから五年も経った今、何故あのことを蒸し返そう
としているのか。
strings.translated: Five years had passed since then -- so why was someone trying to dredge it all up again now?

strings.text: そして、写真に写っていた触手は何なのか。
strings.translated: And then there were the tentacles in the photograph -- what were those?

strings.text:
まじまじと確認したわけではないが、合成写真のよう
な類には見えなかった。
strings.translated: She hadn't examined it closely, but it hadn't looked like the kind of thing that was composited or faked.

strings.text:
誰かが本当に蟲に襲われた写真に、夢美の顔を貼り付
けた物にしか思えなかった。
strings.translated: It seemed like nothing other than a real photograph of someone being attacked by a Bug, with Yumemi's face pasted onto it.

strings.text: 写真を通して伝わってくる悪意――――。
strings.translated: The malice that came through in that photograph...

strings.text: それが、夢美の体をがんじがらめにしていた。
strings.translated: It was that malice which had her body bound tight, unable to move.

Yumemi
"What am I going to do..."

strings.text: 体が重く、全く動く気力が湧かない。
strings.translated: Her body felt heavy, and she couldn't summon the will to move at all.

strings.text: 一人でいたいような、いたくないような――――
strings.translated: She wanted to be alone -- and yet she didn't...

strings.text:
――仕事に行きたいような行きたくないような、そん
なハッキリしない気分だった……。
strings.translated: She wanted to go to work -- and yet she didn't. That was the vague, indecisive mood she was in...

strings.text:
夢美
「いらっしゃいませ」

その日のＡｎｚＵの店内にも、ウエイトレス姿の夢美
の姿があった。
strings.translated: That day, Yumemi was once again present inside AnzU, dressed in her waitress uniform.

strings.text:
いつもよりやや声に元気が感じられないものの、全体
的には明るい雰囲気を絶やしていない。
strings.translated: Her voice lacked its usual energy, but overall she kept up her bright demeanor without letting it slip.

strings.text:
今日は休むことも考えたのだが、それで気分が晴れる
とも思えなかったため、結局出勤することにしたのだ。
strings.translated: She had considered calling in sick today, but didn't think it would do anything to lift her spirits, so she had ended up coming in after all.

strings.text:
杏子は、夢美の様子がおかしい事にすぐ気付いたが、
「何でもない」と説得して仕事に当たらせてもらった。
strings.translated: Anzu had noticed right away that something was off with Yumemi, but Yumemi had convinced her it was nothing and been allowed to work.

strings.text:
杏子
「夢美ちゃん、少し休憩挟んだほうが良くない？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Yumemi-chan, don't you think you should take a little break?"

strings.text:
夢美
「大丈夫です。むしろ絶好調ですよ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm fine. I'm actually in top form."

strings.text:
杏子
「それならいいんだけど……」

口元には笑みを浮かべながらも、杏子はまだ心配そう
だ。
strings.translated: Anzu smiled faintly, but still looked worried.

strings.text:
ＡｎｚＵで働き始めて三年以上経つため、夢美の変化
にはそれなりに敏感だった。
strings.translated: Yumemi had been working at AnzU for over three years now, so Anzu was fairly attuned to any change in her.

strings.text:
夢美
「いらっしゃいませ～」

正午を過ぎた頃に次の客が入ってきて、夢美はすぐに
空いている席への案内を務めた。
strings.translated: Just past noon, the next customers came in, and Yumemi promptly guided them to an open table.

strings.text:
この時間帯にしては珍しく、夢美と同年代の少女二人
組みだ。
strings.translated: Unusually for this time of day, it was a pair of girls around Yumemi's age.

strings.text:
？？？
「へぇ、唯がこんな雰囲気のお店に来てるなんて、
　ちょっと意外……」
strings.translated:
???
"Huh, I'm a little surprised to see Yui coming to a place with this kind of atmosphere..."

strings.text:
？？？
「私も、最近見つけたばっかりなんだけどね」
strings.translated:
???
"I only just found it myself, actually."

strings.text:
どうやら少女のうちの一人は、以前一度来たことがあ
るらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed one of the girls had been here once before.

strings.text:
窓際の席に座ると、夢美の手からメニュー表を受け
取って柔らかく笑んだ。
strings.translated: They sat down at a window seat, took the menu from Yumemi's hands, and smiled softly.

strings.text:
だが、夢美の目を引いたのはそちらの少女ではなく、
向かい合って座る妙に落ち着いた雰囲気の少女のほう
だった。
strings.translated: But what caught Yumemi's eye was not that girl -- it was the one sitting across from her, a girl with a strangely composed air about her.

strings.text:
思わず溜息が漏れてしまうほどに、その少女は美人
だった。
strings.translated: The girl was beautiful enough to make Yumemi sigh without even thinking.

strings.text:
――鼻は高く、唇は健康的なピンク色をしていて、
ただ喋っているだけでも気品というものが感じられる。
strings.translated: A high nose, lips a healthy shade of pink -- just the way she spoke carried a sense of elegance.

strings.text: 正直、夢美は近くで見惚れてしまっていた。
strings.translated: Honestly, Yumemi had been standing there staring at her up close.

strings.text:
夢美
「ご、ご注文が決まりましたらお呼び下さいっ！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"P-please call us when you're ready to order!"

strings.text: 慌てて頭を下げて、夢美はその場を退散した。
strings.translated: She bowed hastily and retreated from the spot.

strings.text:
少女二人は不思議そうに首を傾げていたが、すぐに
メニュー表に視線を戻す。
strings.translated: The two girls tilted their heads in puzzlement, but quickly turned their eyes back to the menu.

strings.text:
あれこれ話し始めた様子からして、決まるまでには
少し時間が掛かりそうだった。
strings.translated: From the way they began chatting about this and that, it looked like it would take a little while before they decided.

strings.text:
杏子
「夢美ちゃん、三番テーブルのお客様だけど、お水が
　ないんじゃない？」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Yumemi-chan, the customers at table three -- don't they need water?"

strings.text: 店の中だと言うのに、思わず大声を上げてしまう。
strings.translated: She let out a loud yelp despite being inside the shop.

strings.text: 三番テーブルは、例の少女二人組みの席だった。
strings.translated: Table three was the table with the pair of girls in question.

strings.text:
席に案内するとき、多少慌ててしまったため、そのま
ま水を運ぶのを忘れていたらしい。
strings.translated: She had been a bit flustered when seating them, and it seemed she had simply forgotten to bring water.

strings.text:
おそるおそる振り返ると、杏子の呆れたような視線が
返って来た。
strings.translated: Bracing herself, she turned around to find Anzu's exasperated gaze waiting for her.

strings.text:
夢美
「す、すぐに持って行きます」

杏子
「そうしてちょうだい」

トレイに水を二つ載せて、やや早足で三番テーブルに
向かう。
strings.translated: She loaded two glasses of water onto a tray and headed toward table three at a brisk pace.

strings.text: 最近では珍しい失敗だった。
strings.translated: It was a rare mistake for her these days.

strings.text:
夢美
「申し訳ありません。お水を――――」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm so sorry. Here is your water--"

strings.text: それは、真後ろからの衝撃だった。
strings.translated: The impact came from directly behind her.

strings.text:
トレイに水を載せて運んでいた夢美の腰に、硬い物が
とんっと当たったのだ。
strings.translated: Something hard had bumped into Yumemi's hip as she carried the tray of water.

strings.text:
何も持っていなければ、おそらく咄嗟にバランスを
取ることもできただろう。
strings.translated: Had she not been holding anything, she might have been able to catch her balance in an instant.

strings.text:
だが、この時の夢美は左手でトレイを持っていたため、
反射的に右手で体を支えるのが精一杯だった。
strings.translated: But at that moment, Yumemi was holding the tray in her left hand, and all she could manage was to brace herself with her right.

strings.text:
体の傾きに合わせるようにして、水の入ったコップが
テーブルの上に落ちる。
strings.translated: As her body tilted, the glass of water slid off and fell onto the table.

strings.text:
まず、ゴツッと重い音が鳴り、続いてコップがテーブ
ルの上を転がったかと思うと――――
strings.translated: First came a heavy thud, then the glass rolled across the table -- and then--

strings.text: ――床に落ちたコップが、盛大な音を立てて割れた。
strings.translated: -- the glass hit the floor and shattered with a tremendous crash.

strings.text: 悲鳴のような声を上げた。
strings.translated: She let out a cry that was almost a scream.

strings.text:
杏子から言われている『絶対にやってはいけない事』
トップクラスの大失敗だ。
strings.translated: This was a top-tier blunder among the things Anzu had told her she must absolutely never do.

strings.text:
しかも、コップの水がまともに掛かってしまったらし
く、片方の――――
strings.translated: And on top of that, it seemed the water had splashed directly onto one of them--

strings.text:
――夢美が、美人だと感じたほうの少女の服が、ずぶ
濡れになっていた。
strings.translated: -- the girl Yumemi had thought was beautiful was now completely soaked.

strings.text:
今までにもコップを割った事はあるが、ここまで派手
にやらかした事はない。
strings.translated: She had broken glasses before, but she had never made such a spectacular mess of things.

strings.text:
夢美
「少々お待ち下さいっ！！　今、拭く物を――――」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Please wait just a moment!! I'll get something to wipe it up--"

strings.text: フワリと柔らかいものが、夢美の指に押し当てられた。
strings.translated: Something soft was pressed against Yumemi's fingers.

strings.text:
右手中指の第二関節から上を、純白のハンカチが包み
込んでいる。
strings.translated: A pure white handkerchief was wrapped around the upper half of her right middle finger, above the second knuckle.

strings.text:
ふと気付けば、布に血が滲んでいて、今になって痛み
が伝わってきた。
strings.translated: When she noticed, blood had already seeped into the cloth, and only now did the pain begin to register.

strings.text:
どうやらテーブルで体を支えたときに、擦り剥いてし
まったらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed she had scraped it when she braced herself against the table.

strings.text:
？？？
「服は乾かせば済みますから、まずは傷の手当てをし
　て下さい」
strings.translated:
???
"The clothes can be dried, so please tend to your wound first."

strings.text:
杏子
「お客様、ご迷惑をお掛けして本当に申し訳ありませ
　ん」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"We are truly sorry for the inconvenience, miss."

strings.text:
背後から杏子がやって来て、少女達に深々と頭を下げ
た。
strings.translated: Anzu had come up from behind and bowed deeply to the two girls.

strings.text:
そして、状況を一瞥したあと、夢美を立ち上がらせて
にっこりと微笑む。
strings.translated: Then, after a quick glance at the situation, she helped Yumemi to her feet and smiled warmly.

strings.text:
杏子
「ここは私がやっておくから、夢美ちゃんは怪我の
　手当てをしてらっしゃい」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"I'll take care of things here, so go get that wound looked after, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text: 杏子の言葉は、ある種の命令も混じっていた。
strings.translated: There was a certain undeniable authority mixed into Anzu's words.

strings.text:
夢美はしゅんと肩を落とすと、ハンカチで指を押さえ
ながら事務室へと戻って行った……。
strings.translated: Yumemi's shoulders drooped, and she made her way back to the office, pressing the handkerchief against her finger...

strings.text:
夢美
「すいません。絆創膏、探すのに手間取っちゃって」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Sorry. It took me a while to find a bandage."

strings.text:
フロアに水をぶちまけてから五分後、夢美が戻ってく
ると店内はすっかり元通りになっていた。
strings.translated: Five minutes after spilling water all over the floor, Yumemi returned to find the shop completely back to normal.

strings.text:
テーブルを濡らしていた水は綺麗に拭き取られ、床も
ガラスの欠片一つ残っていない。
strings.translated: The water that had soaked the table had been wiped clean, and not a single shard of glass remained on the floor.

strings.text:
杏子は夢美が戻って来た事を確認すると、トレイの上
にケーキを載せながら尋ねた。
strings.translated: Anzu confirmed that Yumemi had returned, then asked her a question while placing a slice of cake on a tray.

strings.text:
杏子
「怪我のほうは大丈夫？」

夢美
「はい。ちょっと擦っただけです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yes. I just scraped it a little."

strings.text:
そう答えながら、店内を見回して先ほどの少女達を
探す。
strings.translated: As she answered, she looked around the shop for the two girls from before.

strings.text:
だが、既に帰ってしまったのか、どの席を見てもそれ
らしい姿はなかった。
strings.translated: But they seemed to have left already -- she couldn't spot anyone who looked like them at any of the seats.

strings.text:
杏子
「先ほどのお客様なら、あの後すぐに帰ったわよ」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"Those customers from earlier left right after, you know."

strings.text:
杏子
「押されたんだし、気にしないでって言ってたわ」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"They said not to worry about it since you were bumped into."

strings.text:
杏子
「そう言ってたわよ。
　ちょうど後ろを通った人の体が当たったって」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"That's what they said. Apparently someone passing behind you knocked into you."

strings.text:
言われてみれば、何か硬いものが腰に当たった記憶が
ある。
strings.translated: Now that she thought about it, she did remember something hard hitting her hip.

strings.text:
あれはもしかすると、後ろを通った客の肘だったのか
もしれない。
strings.translated: It might have been the elbow of a customer who had been walking past behind her.

strings.text:
夢美
「ハンカチ、返しそびれちゃった」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I never got to return the handkerchief."

strings.text: レースの刺繍が施された白地のハンカチ。
strings.translated: A white handkerchief with lace embroidery.

strings.text:
一応、水で洗ってはきたが、赤いシミは完全には消え
てくれなかった。
strings.translated: She had rinsed it with water, but the red stain had not come out completely.

strings.text:
杏子
「また来てくれる事を祈るしかないわね」
strings.translated:
Anzu
"I suppose all we can do is hope they come back."

strings.text:
杏子が頬に手を当てながら、苦笑いを浮かべながら
言った……。
strings.translated:
Anzu pressed a hand to her cheek and said it
with a wry smile...

strings.text:
ベッドの上でぐったりと横になって、夢美は重い溜息
をついた。
strings.translated:
Yumemi lay sprawled across her bed and let out
a heavy sigh.

strings.text: 時刻は正午を少し過ぎた頃――――。

結局、ＡｎｚＵの仕事は休むことにして、何をするで
もなく無為に時間を過ごしていた。
strings.translated:
In the end, she had decided to skip her shift at AnzU,
and was spending the time idly, doing nothing in particular.

strings.text:
頭の中は例の写真のことばかりで、気が休まらないど
ころか、不安や恐怖ばかりが大きくなってくる。
strings.translated:
Her mind was consumed entirely by those photographs,
and rather than finding any peace, she felt only her anxiety and fear growing larger.

strings.text:
考えても分かるはずのない事を、ベッドの上で延々と
考え続けていた。
strings.translated:
She lay on her bed, endlessly turning over questions
that had no answers.

strings.text:
夢美
「買い物でもして来ようかな……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Maybe I should go out and do some shopping..."

strings.text: ごろんと寝返りを打って窓の外を見る。
strings.translated: She rolled over and gazed out the window.

strings.text:
今日もいい天気のようで、散歩をするには丁度良い
日和のようだった。
strings.translated:
It looked like another fine day -- just the right weather
for a walk.

strings.text:
少なくとも部屋の中で、悶々とした思いに捕らわれて
いるよりは、遥かにマシに感じられる。
strings.translated:
At the very least, it seemed far better than staying cooped up
in her room, trapped in her own brooding thoughts.

strings.text:
夢美
「うん、そうしようっ！」

自分を鼓舞するように言って、夢美はようやくベッド
から下りた。
strings.translated:
She said it as if to rally herself, and at last climbed
out of bed.

strings.text: ――と、それに合わせたかのように、腹の虫が鳴く。
strings.translated: And then -- as if on cue, her stomach growled.

strings.text:
考えてみれば、今日は朝からロクなものを食べていな
かった。
strings.translated:
Come to think of it, she hadn't eaten anything decent
all day.

strings.text:
夢美は、冷蔵庫の中にあるものを思い出そうとしたが、
どうせなら食事も外でする事にしようと考えなおし、
早速支度に取り掛かった。
strings.translated:
Yumemi tried to recall what was in the refrigerator, but decided
she might as well eat out while she was at it,
and promptly began getting ready.

strings.text:
何かをする目的を得ただけで、気分が少しだけ楽にな
れた……。
strings.translated:
Simply having something to do was enough to lift
her spirits just a little...

strings.text: ――今日は外に出るべきではなかった。
strings.translated: -- She should not have gone outside today.

strings.text:
そう思ったのは、とっぷりと日の暮れた夜道を歩いて
いる最中のことだった。
strings.translated:
That thought came to her as she walked the darkened
night streets, the sun long since set.

strings.text: 時刻は午後十時を少し過ぎた頃。
strings.translated: It was just past ten o'clock in the evening.

strings.text:
もっと早く帰ろうと思いつつも、実際にはこんな時間
になってしまった。
strings.translated:
She had meant to head home earlier, but somehow
it had gotten to be this late.

strings.text: 理由は、自宅に帰りたくなかったから……。
strings.translated: The reason was that she hadn't wanted to go home...

strings.text:
もしもまた、部屋にあの写真が届いていたらどうしよ
う。
strings.translated:
What if another one of those photographs had been
delivered to her room.

strings.text:
今度はあんな偽物ではなく、本物の写真が入っていた
らどうしよう。
strings.translated:
What if this time it wasn't a fake, but a real
photograph inside.

strings.text:
そう考えれば考えるほど怖くなって、自宅に帰ること
ができなかったのだ。
strings.translated:
The more she thought about it, the more frightened she became,
and she had found herself unable to return home.

strings.text: 息を呑んで、夜道を足早に進む。
strings.translated: She swallowed hard and quickened her pace along the night road.

strings.text:
昼間のうちは良かったが、夜になれば怖いのは外も
変わらない。
strings.translated:
It had been fine during the day, but once night fell,
being outside was no less frightening.

strings.text:
どちらにしても恐怖に襲われる結果になり、夢美は
諦めて家路に着いたのだった。
strings.translated:
Either way she would end up gripped by fear -- and so Yumemi
had given up and turned her feet toward home.

strings.text: 肌に纏わり付く空気が、いつもより冷たい。
strings.translated: The air clinging to her skin felt colder than usual.

strings.text:
何かに引っ張られているかのように、全身が重く感じ
る。
strings.translated:
Her whole body felt heavy, as though something
were pulling her down.

strings.text:
通い慣れたはずの道が、何故だか今夜は初めて通って
いるような気がしてならなかった。
strings.translated:
The road she knew so well somehow felt tonight
like she was walking it for the very first time.
There was no sign of anyone around.

strings.text:
まるで、この道だけ世界から切り離されてしまったよ
うな感覚に陥るほど、町はしんと静まり返っていた。
strings.translated:
The town was so utterly still and silent that she felt
as though this road alone had been severed from the rest of the world.

strings.text: 珍しいことではないはずだった。
strings.translated: It shouldn't have been anything unusual.

strings.text:
ＡｎｚＵの仕事で遅くなり、こんな雰囲気の道を通る
ことも何度かあったはずだった。
strings.translated:
There had been plenty of times she'd stayed late at AnzU
and walked home through an atmosphere just like this.

strings.text:
それだと言うのに――何故だか今夜は体が震えるほど
怖い。
strings.translated:
And yet -- for some reason, tonight she was frightened
enough to tremble.

strings.text:
背後で人の気配がした気がして、夢美はびくっと足を
止めた。
strings.translated:
She sensed a presence behind her, and Yumemi froze
with a start.

strings.text: 今、確かに、人の足音が、聞こえた――気がした。
strings.translated: Just now -- she was sure -- she had heard -- footsteps -- or thought she had.

strings.text:
おそるおそる振り返ってみるが、やはりそこには誰も
いない。
strings.translated:
She turned around slowly, cautiously -- but of course,
there was no one there.

strings.text:
だが、ホッとする事はできず、夢美はフラフラとした
足取りでまた歩き始めた。
strings.translated:
Even so, she felt no relief, and Yumemi began walking again
with unsteady steps.
Someone was standing right in front of her.

strings.text:
暗闇でシルエット程度しか分からないが、誰かが夢美
の前に立っていた。
strings.translated:
In the darkness she could make out only a silhouette,
but someone was standing there before Yumemi.

strings.text: 肌に感じるのは、食い入るように見つめる視線。
strings.translated: What she felt on her skin was a gaze -- boring into her.

strings.text:
闇の中にあっても、相手が自分を見ていることを、
夢美は敏感に感じ取っていた。
strings.translated:
Even in the darkness, Yumemi could sense acutely
that the other person was watching her.

strings.text:
今まで自分を追いかけて来た何かが、ついに追いつい
て来た気がした。
strings.translated:
It felt as though whatever had been following her all this time
had finally caught up.

strings.text:
夢美は、反射的に一歩後ずさりして逃げようとしたが、
その瞬間――――
strings.translated: Yumemi reflexively stepped back and tried to flee -- but in that instant --------

strings.text:
人間の形をしていたシルエットから、突如それ以外の
影が現れる。
strings.translated:
From the silhouette that had been human in shape, something else suddenly emerged --
a shadow unlike anything before.

strings.text:
グネグネとヘビのようにうねるそれは、長く伸びて
夢美のほうに襲い掛かってきた。
strings.translated:
It writhed and coiled like a snake, stretching long
as it lunged toward Yumemi.

strings.text: きびすを返して、その場から逃げ出す。
strings.translated: She spun on her heel and bolted from the spot.

strings.text:
悲鳴を上げようとしたが、喉がカラカラになって呻き
声しか出なかった。
strings.translated:
She tried to scream, but her throat had gone bone-dry,
and only a strangled groan escaped her.

strings.text: とにかく、どこでもいい。

もっと人通りのある場所まで逃げ切れれば、何とかな
るかもしれない。
strings.translated:
If she could just make it somewhere with more people around,
she might have a chance.

strings.text:
漠然とそんな事を感じながら、大通りのほうへ向けて
走る。
strings.translated:
Clinging to that vague hope, she ran
toward the main street.

strings.text:
突然、背後から何かがぶつかって来て、夢美は道路の
上に転がった。
strings.translated:
Suddenly something slammed into her from behind,
and Yumemi tumbled onto the road.

strings.text: 顔の真横を、羽虫のようなものが飛び去っていく。
strings.translated: Something like a winged insect flew past, right beside her face.

strings.text:
ハッキリと姿を見なくとも、それが普通の昆虫でない
のはすぐに分かった。
strings.translated:
Even without getting a clear look at it, she knew instantly
that it was no ordinary insect.

strings.text:
そして、再び夢美を狙って攻撃しようとしている事も、
直感的に感じ取ることができた。
strings.translated:
She could also sense instinctively
that it was turning to attack her again.

strings.text: 必死に立ち上がって逃げようとする。
strings.translated: She desperately scrambled to her feet and tried to run.

strings.text: だが、その進路には、既にあの影が立っていた。
strings.translated: But the shadow was already standing in her path.

strings.text: 声も出ないほどに恐ろしい。
strings.translated: She was so terrified she couldn't even scream.

strings.text: 相手がただの人間でない事は、もはや間違いなかった。
strings.translated: There was no longer any doubt -- that figure was not merely human.

strings.text:
夢美
（いやあぁぁぁーーーーーーーーーーーっ！！！！）
心の中で悲鳴を上げて、夢美は細い路地に逃げ込んだ。
strings.translated: Screaming inside her heart, Yumemi fled into a narrow alley.

strings.text:
その先に何があるのかは、この時点では夢美はまだ
気が付いていなかった。
strings.translated:
At that point, Yumemi had not yet realized
what lay ahead.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁっ……はぁっ……はぁっ……はぁっ…………」

散々影に追い回された挙句、たどり着いたのは森の中
だった。
strings.translated:
After being chased relentlessly by the shadow,
she found herself deep in a forest.

strings.text: その時になって初めて分かる。

自分は逃げているつもりで、実はここに誘導されてい
たのだ。
strings.translated:
She had thought she was running away -- but in truth,
she had been herded here all along.

strings.text:
この場所ならば、ちょっとやそっとの事では人は来な
い。
strings.translated:
In a place like this, no one would come
no matter what happened.

strings.text:
何をするにしても、それが人目につきたくない行為な
らば、ここほど打ってつけの場所はなかった。
strings.translated:
Whatever one wished to do, if it was something best kept from prying eyes,
there was no place more suited for it than here.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ…………！」
先ほどより息が上がっていた。
strings.translated: She was even more out of breath than before.

strings.text:
姿は見えないものの、自分を追ってきた影は間違いな
くこの近くにいる。
strings.translated:
The shadow that had been pursuing her was nowhere to be seen,
but it was certainly somewhere close by.

strings.text:
もはや、どこへ逃げればいいのかも分からなくて、
夢美はただガタガタと震えるばかりだった。
strings.translated:
She no longer knew which way to run,
and Yumemi could do nothing but tremble uncontrollably.

strings.text: 森の中から、男の声が響く。
strings.translated: A man's voice echoed from within the forest.

strings.text:
突然、真正面から何かが襲ってきて、夢美は反射的に
身を屈めてかわした。
strings.translated:
Something came at her head-on without warning,
and Yumemi reflexively ducked to dodge it.

strings.text:
振り返ると、野球ボールくらいの生き物が、羽音を
鳴らしながら飛び回っている。
strings.translated:
When she looked back, a creature about the size of a baseball
was buzzing through the air.

strings.text: それは――紛れもなく『蟲』だった――――！

？？？
「それとも、普段は持ってないのかい？」
strings.translated:
???
"Or do you not usually carry one?"

strings.text: 脇腹に追突してきた蟲に、夢美の体が跳ね飛ばされる。
strings.translated: A Bug slammed into her side, and Yumemi's body was sent flying.

strings.text:
幸いにして平たいところに尻餅を着いたが、蟲の攻撃
はそれで終わったわけではなかった。
strings.translated:
She was lucky enough to land flat on her backside,
but the Bug's assault was far from over.

strings.text: 夢美の正面で、蟲が滞空している。
strings.translated: The Bug hovered in the air directly in front of Yumemi.

strings.text:
それから逃れるすべなど、夢美は何一つとして持ち合
わせてはいなかった。
strings.translated:
She had no means whatsoever
of escaping it.
-- She was going to be killed!

strings.text:
相手の目的も何も分からないままに、夢美は自分の
死を覚悟した。
strings.translated:
Without even knowing the other party's purpose,
Yumemi braced herself for death.

strings.text:
次に蟲が飛んできた瞬間、自分の腹が食い破られる様
を想像した。
strings.translated: The moment the Bug came flying at her next, she imagined her own stomach being torn open.

strings.text:
その予感が正しかったのかどうか、蟲が大きく前傾姿
勢をとった瞬間――――
strings.translated: Whether that premonition was correct or not -- the instant the Bug lurched sharply forward --------

strings.text:
今、まさに、夢美に襲い掛かろうとしていた蟲が、
木っ端微塵に砕け散った。
strings.translated: The Bug that had been on the verge of attacking Yumemi was shattered into splinters.

strings.text: その代わりに見えたのは、別の蟲の影。
strings.translated: What replaced it was the shadow of a different Bug.

strings.text:
だが、そのスピードは先ほど砕かれた蟲とは比較にな
らないほど速く、すぐに森の奥に消えていった。
strings.translated: But its speed was incomparably faster than the Bug that had just been destroyed, and it vanished into the depths of the forest in an instant.

strings.text: ややあって、誰かが逃げていく足音が聞こえる……。
strings.translated: A moment later, the sound of someone fleeing on foot could be heard...

strings.text:
夢美を狙っていた誰かが、この場から立ち去ったよう
だった。
strings.translated: It seemed that whoever had been targeting Yumemi had left the scene.
And then -- a voice from behind --------

strings.text:
夢美が尻餅を着いたまま振り返ると、真後ろに一人の
男が立っていた。
strings.translated: Still sitting where she had fallen, Yumemi turned around to find a man standing directly behind her.

strings.text: 全身黒ずくめの、表情をサングラスで隠した青年。
strings.translated: A young man dressed entirely in black, his expression hidden behind sunglasses.

strings.text:
？？？
「この場でじっとしていて下さい。
　すぐに終わらせます」
strings.translated:
???
"Stay right where you are.
 I'll finish this quickly."

strings.text: 青年が、何か筒のような物を前に向ける。
strings.translated: The young man pointed something resembling a tube forward.

strings.text:
対して森の奥からは、夢美を襲い続けていた蟲と同じ
大きさのものが、何匹も向かって来ているところだっ
た。
strings.translated: From deep within the forest, several Bugs the same size as the ones that had been attacking Yumemi were closing in.

strings.text:
青年が短く声を漏らした瞬間、筒から何かが発射され
る。
strings.translated: The instant the young man let out a short cry, something was fired from the tube.

strings.text:
それが蟲だと理解するのに、目で見て確認する必要は
なかった。
strings.translated: There was no need to look with her own eyes to understand that it was a Bug.

strings.text:
森の中に二種類の羽音が響き渡り、それとともに他の
昆虫や鳥が逃げていく。
strings.translated: Two kinds of wingbeats echoed through the forest, and along with them, other insects and birds fled.

strings.text:
弾丸のように撃ち出された蟲は、容赦なく相手の蟲を
粉々に砕いていった。
strings.translated: The Bug fired like a bullet mercilessly shattered the enemy Bugs into pieces.

strings.text:
その時の音は爆竹のそれに似ていて、夢美は思わず
耳を塞いでしまった……。
strings.translated: The sound at that moment resembled that of firecrackers, and Yumemi couldn't help but cover her ears...

strings.text: 時間にして一分と少し――――。
strings.translated: Just over a minute had passed --------

strings.text:
うずくまっている夢美に手を差し伸べようともせず、
青年が淡々とした表情で言った。
strings.translated: Making no move to offer a hand to Yumemi as she huddled on the ground, the young man spoke in a flat, expressionless tone.

strings.text:
まるで、野良犬でも追っ払ったかのような、その程度
のことでしかなかったかのような口振りだ。
strings.translated: His manner of speaking was as if he had done nothing more than chase off a stray dog -- as if it were that trivial a matter.

strings.text:
夢美はこわごわと青年を見上げたが、返って来たのは
氷のように冷たい雰囲気だけだった。
strings.translated: Yumemi looked up at the young man with fearful eyes, but all that came back to her was an atmosphere as cold as ice.

strings.text:
？？？
「本来、姿を現すのは禁じられているのですが、やむ
　を得ない事態でしたので……」
strings.translated:
???
"I am normally forbidden from revealing myself, but the circumstances were unavoidable, so..."

strings.text: 青年の言っている事が、半分も理解できない。
strings.translated: She couldn't understand even half of what the young man was saying.

strings.text:
いきなり現れて「護衛」だと言われても、夢美には
何のことやらサッパリ分からなかった。
strings.translated: To be suddenly told by someone who had appeared out of nowhere that he was her "bodyguard" -- Yumemi hadn't the faintest idea what any of it meant.

strings.text:
――と、青年が懐から携帯電話を取り出し、耳に当て
た。
strings.translated: -- At that, the young man reached into his breast pocket, produced a mobile phone, and held it to his ear.

strings.text:
？？？
「はい、不測の事態でしたので…………」

話をしていると言うよりも、誰かから指示を受けてい
るような、そんな雰囲気の会話だった。
strings.translated: Rather than holding a conversation, it felt more like he was receiving instructions from someone -- that was the atmosphere of the exchange.

strings.text:
そして、暫くして青年は電話を切ると、いまだ座り込
んだままの夢美に向かって、さらりと告げた。
strings.translated: And then, after a short while, the young man ended the call and turned to Yumemi, who was still sitting on the ground, and said plainly:

strings.text:
？？？
「今後は貴女の身近で護衛しろとの事です」
strings.translated:
???
"I have been ordered to guard you from close by going forward."

strings.text: 意味の分からないことが増えた。
strings.translated: The number of things she didn't understand had grown.

strings.text:
レン
「自己紹介が遅れました。
　僕は蟲使いのレンと言います」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Forgive the late introduction.
 My name is Ren. I am a Bug User."

strings.text:
レン
「我が一族の長の命により、今後は貴女のそばで護衛
　を続けさせていただきます」
strings.translated:
Ren
"By order of the head of my clan, I will continue to serve as your bodyguard from this point forward."

strings.text:
蟲使いという言葉に、夢美は自分の心臓が鷲掴みにさ
れたような感覚を味わった。
strings.translated: At the words "Bug User," Yumemi felt as though her heart had been seized in an iron grip.

strings.text:
つまり、今、目の前にいる青年は、自分に蟲を産ませ
た男の仲間ということだ。
strings.translated: In other words, the young man standing before her right now was an associate of the man who had made her birth Bugs.

strings.text:
恐怖は極限に達し、呻き声の一つさえ出すことができ
なかった。
strings.translated: Her fear had reached its peak, and she could not even manage a single groan.

strings.text:
その後は、わけも分からないまま、レンの手を借りて
自宅のマンションへと戻った。
strings.translated: After that, still not understanding any of it, she let Ren help her back to her apartment.

strings.text:
自分の身に何が起こったのか、誰よりも夢美が理解し
ていなかった……。
strings.translated: Of anyone, it was Yumemi herself who understood least of all what had happened to her...

strings.text:
『イジメ』というものを、少女自身はよく知らなかっ
た。
strings.translated: The girl herself didn't know much about "bullying."

strings.text:
仲間外れにされたり、自分の物を隠されたり、適当な
噂を流されたり…………。
strings.translated: Being left out, having her things hidden, having rumors spread about her...

strings.text:
少女が体験した事に比べれば、取るに足らない行為で
しかなかったが、それでも現実にそれで苦しむものは
大勢いる。
strings.translated: Compared to what the girl herself had experienced, these were trivial acts -- yet there were still many who suffered greatly from them in the real world.

strings.text:
満足な救いの手も差し伸べられず、ただ人気のない所
で泣くだけの毎日。
strings.translated: No helping hand was ever extended to her -- just day after day of weeping alone in deserted places.

strings.text:
それは、奇しくも少女が体験した事と似ており、だか
らこそ二人は共感し合えたのかもしれなかった。
strings.translated: And yet, it was strangely similar to what the girl had experienced herself -- which was perhaps why the two of them were able to understand each other.

strings.text:
食事を摂っていたところで、少女は自分以外の気配を
感じて話しかけた。
strings.translated: While eating her meal alone, the girl sensed the presence of someone else and called out.

strings.text:
相手が誰なのか――人間なのかどうかすら定かではな
かったが、そんなものはどうでもいい。
strings.translated: She couldn't be sure who -- or even what -- it was, but that hardly mattered.

strings.text:
重要なのは、自分と蟲以外の『何か』が、すぐ間近に
いるという事実だった。
strings.translated: What mattered was the simple fact that something other than herself and the Bugs was close by.

strings.text:
木陰から出てきたのは、自分とそう年の変わらない
少女。
strings.translated: Stepping out from the shade of the trees was a girl not much different in age from herself.

strings.text:
何が「ごめんなさい」なのかは分からないが、やけに
怯えた目で夢美を見ていた。
strings.translated: She didn't know what there was to be sorry for, but the girl was staring at Yumemi with terribly frightened eyes.

strings.text: だが、怯えているのは夢美も同じだ。
strings.translated: But Yumemi was just as frightened herself.

strings.text:
絶対に誰も来ないと思っていたからこそ、こんな森で
食事をしていたというのに……。
strings.translated: She had only been eating out here in the forest because she was certain no one would ever come...

strings.text:
二人の少女は、暫く怯えた視線を交わしながら、その
華奢な体を小刻みに震わせていた……。
strings.translated: The two girls exchanged fearful glances for a while, their slender bodies trembling in small, fitful shivers...

strings.text:
？？？
「それじゃあ、ずっとここらへんにいるんだ」
strings.translated:
???
"So you've been staying around here this whole time."

strings.text: 話しかけたのはどちらからだったか……。
strings.translated: Which of them had spoken first...

strings.text:
三十分後、夢美と少女は、平べったい岩場に腰を下ろ
して話をしていた。
strings.translated: About thirty minutes later, Yumemi and the girl were seated on a flat stretch of rock, talking.

strings.text:
？？？
「お父さんもお母さんもいなくて、寂しくない？」
strings.translated:
???
"Aren't you lonely, with no father or mother around?"

strings.text: 問われるまでもなく、当たり前の話だ。
strings.translated: It went without saying -- she didn't even need to be asked.

strings.text:
蟲と一緒に暮らしているとはいえ、やはり両親がいな
いのは寂しい。
strings.translated: Even if she did live with Bugs, not having her parents around was still lonely.

strings.text:
夢美
「お父さんとお母さん、いるの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Do you have a father and mother?"

strings.text: 少女が寂しそうに顔を伏せる。
strings.translated: The girl lowered her face with a forlorn look.

strings.text: 夢美にはよく分からない話だった。

仕事で忙しくとも、両親は生きているのだから寂しが
る必要はない。
strings.translated: Even if they were busy with work, her parents were still alive -- there was no reason to feel lonely.

strings.text:
家に居れば、いずれは帰ってくるのだから、少女が
悲しげな表情を浮かべる理由がよく分からなかった。
strings.translated: As long as they were alive, they would come home eventually, so Yumemi couldn't quite grasp why the girl wore such a sad expression.

strings.text: だから、すぐに興味を失って話題を変えた。
strings.translated: So she quickly lost interest and changed the subject.

strings.text:
夢美
「なんでここに来たの？」

？？？
「……ここなら、誰もいないと思ったから」
strings.translated:
???
"...Because I thought no one would be here."

strings.text: また、よく分からない話が出た。
strings.translated: Another thing she didn't quite understand.

strings.text:
両親が生きていて、家もあって、さらには学校にも
通っていると言っていた。
strings.translated: She had said her parents were alive, that she had a home, and that she even attended school.

strings.text: それなのに、何故こんな場所に来るのだろうか。
strings.translated: So why would she come to a place like this?

strings.text:
誰もいない生活がいいのなら、今すぐにでも代わって
やりたい……。
strings.translated: If she wanted a life with no one around, Yumemi would have gladly traded places with her right then and there...

strings.text:
？？？
「馬鹿が移るとか、足が太いとか、おっぱいが大きい
　とか……」
strings.translated:
???
"They say I'm stupid, that my legs are fat, that my chest is too big...
 and things like that..."

strings.text: 言われてみると、少女の胸は大きかった。
strings.translated: Now that she mentioned it, the girl's chest was large.

strings.text:
服の上から見積もっても、夢美の三倍はあろうかとい
う膨らみだ。
strings.translated: Even estimating through her clothes, it was a swell perhaps three times the size of Yumemi's.

strings.text:
夢美は、特に羨ましいとは感じなかったが、それで
イジメられる事もあるという事実に、少しだけ同情
した。
strings.translated: Yumemi didn't particularly envy her for it, but she felt a small pang of sympathy upon learning that it was actually a reason to be bullied.

strings.text: 顔を伏せっていた少女に、一本の筒を手渡す。
strings.translated: She held out a small tube to the girl who had been hanging her head.

strings.text:
少女は、それを見てパチクリと瞬きをすると、不思議
そうに首を傾げた。
strings.translated: The girl blinked at it a few times, then tilted her head with a puzzled look.

strings.text: 筒を持ったまま、少女の体がびくんっと震える。
strings.translated: Still holding the tube, the girl's body gave a startled jolt.

strings.text: 顔色が真っ青になって、筒を持つ手が硬直した。
strings.translated: Her face went pale, and the hand holding the tube went rigid.

strings.text:
倉庫から逃げ出す際、床に落ちていた一本を、夢美は
密かに隠し持っていたのだ。
strings.translated: When she had slipped out of the warehouse earlier, Yumemi had secretly pocketed one of the tubes that had fallen to the floor.

strings.text: これといった用途を考えていたわけではない。
strings.translated: She hadn't had any particular use in mind for it.

strings.text:
ただ、もしかすると何かの役に立つかもしれないと、
そう考えて持ち歩いていただけだった。
strings.translated: She had simply thought it might come in handy for something, and had been carrying it around ever since.

strings.text:
夢美
「うん、蟲が入ってるの」

夢美
「中から出すと怖いかも」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It might be scary if you let it out."

strings.text: 少女が、蟲筒を突き返してくる。
strings.translated: The girl shoved the Bug tube back at her.

strings.text: 夢美は一度それを受け取ると、首を傾げながら尋ねた。
strings.translated: Yumemi took it back, then asked with a tilt of her head.

strings.text:
？？？
「だって……怖い虫が、入ってるんでしょ？」
strings.translated:
???
"But... there's a scary bug inside, right?"

strings.text:
夢美
「すぐに逃げればいいと思う」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I think you just have to run away quickly."

strings.text:
夢美
「開けなかったら出てこないから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It won't come out if you don't open it."

strings.text: 少女が、夢美と蟲筒を交互に見比べる。
strings.translated: The girl looked back and forth between Yumemi and the Bug tube.

strings.text:
怖がってはいるものの、蟲筒に対してそれなりの興味
はあるようだった。
strings.translated: She was hesitant, but she seemed to have some degree of curiosity about the Bug tube.

strings.text:
夢美
「イジメられたら、開けてみたら？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"If they bully you, try opening it."

strings.text: 戸惑いながら、少女が夢美の手から蟲筒を取り出す。
strings.translated: Still uncertain, the girl took the Bug tube from Yumemi's hand.

strings.text: 暫くじっと見つめたあと、顔を上げて夢美に尋ねた。
strings.translated: After staring at it for a while, she looked up and asked Yumemi.

strings.text:
？？？
「ありがとう。虫さん、使ってみるね」
strings.translated:
???
"Thank you. I'll try using the bug."

strings.text: 蓋を開けて逃げるだけ。
strings.translated: Just open the lid and run.

strings.text: 今度イジメられたら試してみよう。
strings.translated: Next time she got bullied, she'd give it a try.

strings.text:
中に詰まっているものの正体もよく理解しないまま、
少女は一度だけ蟲筒を撫でた。
strings.translated: Without really understanding what was packed inside, the girl stroked the Bug tube once.

strings.text:
夢美
「お母さんに言ったら？」
ふと思ったことを口にした。
strings.translated: A thought crossed her mind, and she spoke it aloud.

strings.text:
夢美はイジメに遭ったことはなかったが、困ったこと
があれば必ず母親に相談していた。
strings.translated: Yumemi had never been bullied, but whenever she had a problem, she always talked to her mother about it.

strings.text:
すると母親は、夢美に必ず的確なアドバイスをくれる
のだ。
strings.translated: Her mother would always give her exactly the right advice.

strings.text: それと同じことを、少女もすればいいと思った。
strings.translated: She thought the girl should do the same.

strings.text:
？？？
「お母さん、仕事で帰って来るの遅いもん」
strings.translated:
???
"My mom gets home late from work."

strings.text:
夢美
「帰って来たら話せば？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Can't you talk to her when she gets back?"

strings.text:
？？？
「まだ寝てないって怒られるもん」
strings.translated:
???
"She'd get mad at me for still being up."

strings.text: 少女の答えに夢美は驚いた。
strings.translated: Yumemi was surprised by the girl's answer.

strings.text:
もちろん、母親に怒られたことはあったが、そんな
理由で怒られたことはない。
strings.translated: Of course, she had been scolded by her own mother before -- but never for a reason like that.

strings.text: 夢美には想像ができない環境の話だった。
strings.translated: It was a world Yumemi couldn't even imagine.

strings.text: こういう時、自分ならどうしていただろう。
strings.translated: What would she herself have done in a situation like this?

strings.text:
話したくても話せないとき、自分なら何をしていただ
ろう。
strings.translated: When she wanted to talk but couldn't, what would she have done?

strings.text: 考えた末、思い出した方法が一つだけあった。
strings.translated: After thinking it over, she remembered one method.

strings.text:
夢美
「うん、お母さんにお手紙書くの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yeah, you write a letter to your mom."

strings.text:
？？？
「お母さんは、家にいる人だよ？」
strings.translated:
???
"But my mom lives in the same house, you know?"

strings.text:
夢美
「だから、おうちのどこかに置いておくの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That's why you leave it somewhere around the house."

strings.text:
今まで考えたこともなかったのか、少女が驚いた様子
で夢美を見る。
strings.translated: The girl stared at Yumemi with a look of surprise, as if the idea had never once crossed her mind.

strings.text:
そして、暫く考えるような仕草を見せたあと、また
不安げな顔をして尋ねてきた。
strings.translated: Then, after a moment of seeming to think it over, she looked up with an anxious expression and asked.

strings.text:
？？？
「お母さん、読んでくれるかな？」

夢美
「読んでくれると思うよ」

夢美
「うちのお母さん、読んでくれたし」
夢美の話を聞いて、少女の目に少しの希望が灯った。
strings.translated: Hearing Yumemi's story, a small flicker of hope lit up in the girl's eyes.

strings.text: 口元には微かな笑みが浮かんでいた。
strings.translated: A faint smile played at the corners of her lips.

strings.text:
夢美
「暗くなってきたね」

そろそろ夕刻に差し掛かっているようで、少しずつ
森の景色が見えにくくなっていた。
strings.translated: It seemed evening was drawing near, and the forest scenery was slowly becoming harder to see.

strings.text:
夢美
「あたし、もう行くね」

夢美
「あっち……蟲、迎えに行くの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Over there... I'm going to pick up my Bug."

strings.text:
夢美
「ご飯食べて、戻ってきてるはずだから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It should be back after eating."

strings.text:
夢美の言っていることが、少女にはよく分からなかっ
た。
strings.translated: The girl couldn't quite make sense of what Yumemi was saying.

strings.text:
こんな時間に虫取りでもするのかなと、心の中で首を
かしげていた。
strings.translated: She tilted her head inwardly, wondering if Yumemi was going bug-catching at this hour.

strings.text:
夢美
「それじゃあ、バイバイ」
互いに手を振って、別れる。
strings.translated: They waved to each other and parted ways.

strings.text: 夢美は、足元の雑草を踏み締めて、さらに森の奥へ。
strings.translated: Yumemi pressed through the weeds underfoot, heading deeper into the forest.

strings.text: 少女は、急な坂道を下りて、家族とともに住む家へ。
strings.translated: The girl descended the steep slope toward the home where she lived with her family.

strings.text: これが、夢美の、思い出でも何でもない事の一つ……。
strings.translated: This was one of those things -- not quite a memory, not quite anything -- that belonged to Yumemi.

strings.text: とある街の路地裏に、一組の男女の姿があった。
strings.translated: In a back alley of a certain town, a pair -- a man and a woman -- could be seen.

strings.text:
一人は北畠史郎という名前で、真鈴ヶ崎統華大学に
通う学生。
strings.translated: One of them was a student named Kitabatake Shirou, enrolled at Masuzugasaki Touka University.

strings.text: もう一人は、九条アゲハという名の少女だった。
strings.translated: The other was a girl by the name of Kujou Ageha.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「……で、頼みたいことって何？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"...So, what is it you want me to do?"

strings.text:
アゲハが、むっとした表情を浮かべながら、腰に手を
当てて深い溜息をつく。
strings.translated: Ageha let out a deep sigh, hand on her hip, a sullen look on her face.

strings.text:
対して史郎はニコニコとした笑顔を浮かべながら、
薄汚れた壁にもたれかかっていた。
strings.translated: Shirou, by contrast, wore a cheerful smile as he leaned against the grimy wall.

strings.text:
史郎
「先生からの伝言。
　ある女の子のことを調べてもらいたいんだってさ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"A message from the professor.
He wants you to look into a certain girl."

strings.text:
史郎
「資料はこれに入ってる」

史郎が茶色い封筒を取り出し、アゲハがそれをひった
くる。
strings.translated: Shirou produced a brown envelope, and Ageha snatched it from him.

strings.text:
必要でない事以外は、話したくないという雰囲気が
ありありと見て取れた。
strings.translated: It was plain to see that she had no desire to speak about anything beyond what was strictly necessary.

strings.text:
史郎
「まだ未確認の情報だけど、彼女……その資料の娘な
　んだけど、蟲使いの関係者らしいんだ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"It's still unconfirmed, but she -- the girl in those documents --
 apparently has ties to a Bug User."

strings.text:
『蟲使い』という言葉を聞いて、アゲハの目がつり上
がった。
strings.translated: At the words "Bug User," Ageha's eyes narrowed sharply.

strings.text:
瞳には尋常ならざる怒りが浮かび、手にした封筒を
じっと見つめている。
strings.translated: An extraordinary rage surfaced in her gaze as she stared fixedly at the envelope in her hand.

strings.text:
史郎
「ちょっと特別な蟲を持ってるみたいでね、先生がす
　ごく興味を持ってる」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"It seems she carries a rather special Bug -- the professor is very interested."

strings.text:
史郎
「あっ、そうそう。彼女、ＡｎｚＵってお店で働いて
　るんだけど、今、ちょうどバイトの募集してるみた
　いだよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Oh, right, right. She works at this place called AnzU -- apparently they're looking for part-time help right now."

strings.text:
史郎
「使えるようだったら、使ってみれば？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"If it seems useful, why not give it a try?"

strings.text: 史郎がニッと口の端をゆがめる。
strings.translated: Shirou twisted the corner of his mouth into a grin.

strings.text: アゲハはただ、手にした封筒を見つめ続けていた……。
strings.translated: Ageha simply continued to stare at the envelope in her hand...

strings.text:
レン
「おはようございます」

夢美
「おはよう……ございます…………」

いつもとは違う一日の始まりに、夢美の気分はすこぶ
る良くなかった。
strings.translated: The start of a day unlike any other had left Yumemi in a thoroughly foul mood.

strings.text: 家の中に若い男がいる。
strings.translated: There was a young man inside her home.

strings.text:
しかも、昨日までその存在さえ知らなかった、全くの
赤の他人がだ。
strings.translated: A complete stranger, at that -- someone whose very existence she hadn't even known about until yesterday.

strings.text:
昨夜は混乱して拒みもしなかったが、一日経つと自分
がとんでもない事を許可してしまったのが分かる。
strings.translated: Last night she'd been too flustered to refuse, but a day later, she could see just how reckless a thing she had permitted.

strings.text:
だが、今更追い出すわけにもいかなければ、昨夜助け
られたのは紛れもない事実なのだ。
strings.translated: And yet, she couldn't very well throw him out now -- the fact that he had saved her last night was undeniable.

strings.text:
今、この蟲使いのレンを追い出すだけの勇気は、夢美
にはなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi simply didn't have the courage to drive this Bug User, Ren, away.

strings.text:
夢美
「食事作るけど、食べる？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm making food -- do you want some?"

strings.text:
レン
「よろしいのですか？」

夢美
「一人分も二人分も手間は変わらないから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Cooking for one or two is the same amount of trouble."

strings.text: ぶっきらぼうに言って、キッチンに向かう。
strings.translated: She said it bluntly and headed for the kitchen.

strings.text:
自分が助けられた身だというのは分かっているが、
それでも蟲使いに対して素直に礼を言う気にはなれ
ない。
strings.translated: She understood that she owed him her life, but even so, she couldn't bring herself to thank a Bug User sincerely.

strings.text: そもそも、夢美を狙った相手も蟲を使って来たのだ。
strings.translated: After all, the one who had attacked her had used Bugs as well.

strings.text:
また、蟲使い同士の争いに巻き込まれただけの可能性
も十分に考えられた……。
strings.translated: There was every possibility that she had simply been caught in the crossfire of a dispute between Bug Users...

strings.text:
朝食は、トーストと目玉焼き、キャベツの盛り合わせ
で済ませる事にした。
strings.translated: For breakfast, she settled on toast, fried eggs, and a side of cabbage.

strings.text:
夢美
「聞きたい事があるんだけど、いい？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Mind if I ask you something?"

strings.text:
レン
「僕に答えられることであれば……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"If it is something I am able to answer..."

strings.text: トーストを齧りながら、レンが目も合わせずに答える。
