strings.translated: She could hear her own voice, bewildered by the pain.

strings.text:
熱いものが波紋状に広がってきて、夢美の体を覆いつ
くしていく。
strings.translated: Something hot spread outward in ripples, washing over Yumemi's body and consuming it whole.

strings.text: 一体、何が起こっているのか。
混乱が恐怖を呼び、恐怖が痛みを呼ぶ。
strings.translated: Confusion summoned fear, and fear summoned pain.

strings.text:
頭の奥がずんと重くなり、吐き気さえ催し始めた
とき――――
strings.translated: A heavy weight settled deep in the back of her head, and nausea began to rise -- and then --

strings.text:
レン
「気がつきましたか？」

近くでレンの声が聞こえて、夢美は微かにまぶたを
開けた。
strings.translated: Ren's voice came from nearby, and Yumemi faintly opened her eyelids.

strings.text: ぼやけた視界の中に、灰色の壁が飛び込んでくる。
strings.translated: Through her blurred vision, a gray wall swam into view.

strings.text:
首を回してレンの姿を探そうとしたが、何故だか体が
思ったように動かなかった。
strings.translated: She tried to turn her head to look for Ren, but for some reason her body refused to move the way she wanted.

strings.text: 頭の後ろに、何か硬いものが触れている……。
strings.translated: Something hard was pressing against the back of her head...

strings.text:
徐々に視界は戻ってきたが、その一方で違和感も増し
ていった。
strings.translated: Her vision gradually returned, but with it came a growing sense of wrongness.

strings.text:
全身が後ろへ引っ張られて、血が背中のほうに溜まっ
ているような気がする。
strings.translated: Her body felt as though it were being pulled backward, blood pooling toward her back.

strings.text:
あちこちに鈍い痛みが感じられ、それら全てが熱を
帯びていた。
strings.translated: A dull ache radiated from all over, and every point of pain was burning with heat.

strings.text: 姿が見えないまま、レンの声だけが聞こえる。
strings.translated: She could not see him -- only Ren's voice reached her.

strings.text:
何が幸運なのかサッパリ分からなかったが、ここに
至ってようやく自分が生きている事を理解した。
strings.translated: She had no idea what was fortunate about any of this, but it was only now that she finally understood she was still alive.

strings.text:
記憶は曖昧だが、どこかでレンが誰かと戦っていたは
ずだ。
strings.translated: Her memories were hazy, but somewhere, Ren had been fighting someone -- she was sure of it.

strings.text: それを見ていた夢美は、確かに――――
strings.translated: Yumemi had been watching -- and then she had --

strings.text: 右肩に激痛が走り、夢美は声を出して呻いた。
strings.translated: A sharp pain shot through her right shoulder, and Yumemi let out an audible groan.

strings.text: 軽く身をよじり、両肩を強張らせる。
strings.translated: She gave a slight twist of her body, both shoulders going rigid.

strings.text:
その時初めて、自分が床に寝かされているのだと気付
いたが、突如襲ってきた激痛の前ではどうでもいい事
だった。
strings.translated: It was only then, for the first time, that she realized she had been laid out on the floor -- but in the face of the sudden, searing agony that struck her, it hardly seemed to matter.

strings.text:
まるで、焼けた火箸を押し付けられたような、そんな
熱とともに痛みは加速度的に増してくる。
strings.translated: Like a red-hot poker being pressed into her flesh -- the pain surged with that burning heat, growing more intense by the moment.

strings.text:
レン
「暫くは痛むと思いますが、死ぬよりはマシでしょ
　う」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It will hurt for a while, I think, but it beats dying."

strings.text:
レン
「その蟲に感謝する事ですね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"You should be grateful to that Bug."

strings.text: 痛みと熱の影響で、夢美の額に大量の汗が噴き出す。
strings.translated: From the pain and the heat, a torrent of sweat broke out across Yumemi's brow.

strings.text:
まるで皮膚の内側に手を突っ込まれて、肉を掻き回さ
れているような感覚に、吐き気とおぞましささえ感じ
始めていた。
strings.translated: It felt as though a hand had been thrust beneath her skin, stirring through her flesh -- a sensation so revolting it was beginning to make her sick.

strings.text:
怪我か病気か――少なくとも、今まで夢美が体験した
事のない刺激が、右肩を中心に広がっている。
strings.translated: Injury or illness -- whatever it was, a stimulus unlike anything Yumemi had ever experienced was spreading outward from her right shoulder.

strings.text: 痛みが恐怖を呼び、恐怖が混乱を運ぶ。
strings.translated: Pain summoned fear, and fear brought confusion.

strings.text: 思考がバラバラに砕け散り、瞳から涙が零れ落ちた。
strings.translated: Her thoughts shattered into pieces, and tears spilled from her eyes.

strings.text:
「痛い」などという言葉では表せない痛みが、じわじ
わと夢美の体を蝕んでいく。
strings.translated: A pain that the word "hurt" could not begin to describe crept through Yumemi's body, gnawing at her bit by bit.

strings.text: 右肩から広がる痛みが、ある一部分にだけ届かない。
strings.translated: The pain spreading from her right shoulder was not reaching one particular spot.

strings.text:
全身が悲鳴を上げるほどの激痛だというのに、何故だ
か右腕に伝わっている感覚がない。
strings.translated: The agony was enough to make her whole body scream -- and yet, for some reason, she felt nothing in her right arm.

strings.text:
呼吸さえままならない状態で、上半身を起き上がらせ
る。
strings.translated: Even breathing was a struggle, yet she forced her upper body upright.

strings.text:
耐え難い痛みよりも、その原因が分からない事のほう
が怖かった。
strings.translated: More than the unbearable pain itself, it was not knowing the cause that frightened her.

strings.text: 目線は、自然と右肩へ向けられ、そして――――――
strings.translated: Her gaze turned naturally toward her right shoulder -- and then --

strings.text: その時の衝撃を、一体何と表せばいいのか。
strings.translated: How could one even begin to describe the shock of that moment?

strings.text: 右腕から先が『無』いのではない。
strings.translated: It was not that her arm beyond the shoulder was simply "gone."

strings.text: 右腕から先に『何か』が『在』った。
strings.translated: There was "something" "there" beyond her right arm.

strings.text:
まるで、海中に生えた珊瑚のような、網目状の不気味
な形をしたものが、夢美の右肩から先に引っ付いてい
る。
strings.translated: Like coral growing in the sea -- something with an eerie, mesh-like form clung to Yumemi's right shoulder and beyond.

strings.text:
細長い枝のような部分がミミズの如くうねり、互いに
絡み合って常にその形を変えていた。
strings.translated: Slender, branch-like tendrils writhed like earthworms, coiling around one another, their shape constantly shifting.

strings.text: 喉から絞り出すようにして、声が出る。
strings.translated: The sound was wrung from her throat.

strings.text:
右肩の先にあるものをじっと凝視するが、やはり理解
には至らない。
strings.translated: She stared fixedly at the thing extending from her right shoulder, but still could not comprehend it.

strings.text:
夢美の持っている知識を総動員しても、これが怪我な
のか病気なのかさえ分からなかった。
strings.translated: Even drawing on every last bit of knowledge she possessed, she could not tell whether this was an injury or a disease.

strings.text:
夢美
「あぅ……あ、あぁ…………ぁぁぁ………………」

耐え難かったはずの激痛が、次第に恐怖に上塗りされ
ていく。
strings.translated: The agonizing pain that should have been unbearable was gradually being painted over by fear.

strings.text:
右肩を振って『何か』を払いのけようとしたが、枝の
部分が揺れるだけで、大した変化は生まれなかった。
strings.translated: She tried shaking her right shoulder to brush "it" away, but only the branch-like parts swayed -- no significant change came of it.

strings.text: ぐちゅり、と粘着質の音が聞こえる。
strings.translated: A wet, sticky sound reached her ears.

strings.text:
赤黒い枝と枝が絡み合って、糸を引きながら一本の
太い枝に変わっていく。
strings.translated: The dark red branches coiled around one another, drawing threads between them as they merged into a single thick limb.

strings.text:
それはまるで、夢美の右腕の代わりに、何か別の生物
が生え変わろうとしているような、そんな光景にさえ
見えた……。
strings.translated: It looked almost as though, in place of Yumemi's right arm, some entirely different creature was trying to grow in its stead...

strings.text: 顎を引いて、右肩から先にある『何か』から逃げる。
strings.translated: She pulled her chin in, recoiling from the "something" extending beyond her right shoulder.

strings.text: 果たして、この生物をどうするべきか――――
strings.translated: What was she supposed to do with this creature --

strings.text:
――引きちぎるべきか放っておくべきか、夢美は可能
なかぎりの思考力を掻き集めて考えた。
strings.translated: -- tear it off, or leave it alone? Yumemi gathered every last scrap of her reasoning and tried to think.

strings.text:
レン
「余計なことはしないほうがいい」
strings.translated:
Ren
"You'd better not do anything rash."

strings.text: いつから居たのか、真正面にレンが立っていた。
strings.translated: She had no idea when he had arrived, but Ren was standing directly in front of her.

strings.text:
相変わらず表情は無いも同然で、戸惑う夢美を見下ろ
している。
strings.translated: His expression was as blank as ever, and he looked down at the bewildered Yumemi.

strings.text:
夢美のほうはと言えば、裸を隠すのも忘れてレンを
見上げていた。
strings.translated: Yumemi, for her part, was staring up at Ren, having forgotten entirely to cover her nakedness.

strings.text:
夢美
「こ、これ……腕……。
　わた、私の……う、腕が………………」

レン
「ええ、復元しているところです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Yes. It is in the process of being restored."

strings.text: レンの説明を聞いて、夢美は思考を止めた。
strings.translated: Hearing Ren's explanation, Yumemi's thoughts ground to a halt.

strings.text:
言われたことの意味が分からず、恐怖に引き攣ったま
まの表情でレンを見つめていた。
strings.translated: Unable to grasp the meaning of what he had said, she stared at him, her face still frozen in terror.

strings.text:
その間にも、右腕の『何か』はウネウネと蠢きながら、
枝同士を絡み合わせていく。
strings.translated: All the while, the "something" on her right arm writhed and squirmed, weaving the branches together.

strings.text:
レン
「覚えていませんか？　自分がどうなったのかを」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Do you not remember? What happened to you?"

strings.text:
夢美
「ど、どうなっ…………い、言われても…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Wh, what happened... I, even if you tell me..."

strings.text:
記憶が混濁して、自分の身に何が起こったのかが分か
らない。
strings.translated: Her memories were muddled, and she could not tell what had happened to her.

strings.text:
理解しているのは、右腕が異常な状態になっているこ
とだけだ。
strings.translated: The only thing she understood was that her right arm was in an abnormal state.

strings.text: 病気か怪我か、それとも別の何かか……。
strings.translated: Illness, injury, or something else entirely...

strings.text:
レン
「貴女は、合蟲人間に蟲を奪われる際、右腕も一緒に
　もがれてしまったのです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"When the Bug-fused human took your Bug from you, it tore off your right arm along with it."

strings.text:
レン
「その合蟲人間は僕が倒しましたが、その後の貴女を
　救ったのは貴女の蟲です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I defeated that Bug-fused human, but it was your Bug that saved you afterward."

strings.text:
レンの思わぬ言葉に、夢美はもう一度右肩から先に
在るものを見つめた。
strings.translated: Startled by Ren's unexpected words, Yumemi looked once more at what extended from her right shoulder.

strings.text:
その生物らしきものは、レンと話をしている間も、
黙々と何かの作業を進めている。
strings.translated: The creature-like thing continued its silent work even as she spoke with Ren.

strings.text:
だが、どこをどう見れば、夢美とともに暮らしていた
蟲となるのか。
strings.translated: But no matter how she looked at it, how could this possibly be the Bug that had lived alongside her?

strings.text: 似ても似つかないどころか、似る似ない以前の問題だ。
strings.translated: It was not merely unrecognizable -- the question of resemblance did not even apply.

strings.text:
普通に考えれば、レンにからかわれているとしか思え
ない。
strings.translated: By any normal measure of thinking, it seemed like nothing more than Ren playing a trick on her.

strings.text: 夢美の胸に、じわりと懐かしいものが込み上げる。
strings.translated: Something warm and familiar welled up slowly in Yumemi's chest.

strings.text:
言葉では表せない何かが、右腕の先にあるものと
繋がっているような気がした。
strings.translated: She felt as though something beyond words connected her to whatever lay at the end of her right arm.

strings.text:
レン
「復元を開始して、ほぼ一日が経過しています」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Nearly a full day has passed since the restoration began."

strings.text:
レン
「時間が掛かるのか、復元自体が困難なのか」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Either it simply takes time, or the restoration itself is difficult --"

strings.text: そう言って、レンが考え込むように蟲を見つめる。
strings.translated: Saying this, Ren gazed at the Bug as if lost in thought.

strings.text:
だが、夢美にはそのとき、漠然と蟲の『迷い』のよう
なものを感じ取っていた。
strings.translated: But in that moment, Yumemi vaguely sensed something like "hesitation" from the Bug.

strings.text:
右腕が復元できないのではなく、復元してしまっても
良いのかどうか、蟲がそれを迷っているように感じら
れたのだ。
strings.translated: It was not that the Bug was unable to restore her arm -- rather, she felt as though it was uncertain whether it was even permitted to do so.

strings.text:
刹那、心臓がとくんっと跳ね、夢美は囁くように蟲に
語りかけていた。
strings.translated: In an instant, her heart gave a small leap, and Yumemi found herself whispering to the Bug.

strings.text: 頭の中で、自分の右腕をイメージする。
strings.translated: She pictured her right arm in her mind.

strings.text:
それに意味があるのかどうかは分からなかったが、
少しでも蟲の助けになればと考えたのだ。
strings.translated: She did not know whether it would mean anything, but she thought that even a little, it might help the Bug.

strings.text:
やがて、右肩から先のものが明確な意思を持ったかの
ように動き始め、徐々にひとつの形を作り出していっ
た。
strings.translated: Before long, the thing extending from her right shoulder began to move as though it had found a clear purpose, gradually forming itself into a single shape.

strings.text:
試行錯誤しながら、一本ずつ枝を絡めるように、夢美
の右腕の形を作り出していった。
strings.translated: Through trial and error, twining the branches one by one, it began to reconstruct the form of Yumemi's right arm.

strings.text:
それは、とてもゆっくりとした動作で、機敏性は皆無
に等しかったが、まるで設計図でもあるかのように、
指の一本一本まで丁寧に復元していく。
strings.translated: The movements were very slow, almost entirely lacking in agility, yet as though working from a blueprint, it carefully restored each finger, one by one.

strings.text:
正直、ずっと見ていると気持ち悪かったが、夢美は
あえて目を離さなかった。
strings.translated: Honestly, watching it for too long made her feel ill, but Yumemi deliberately kept her eyes on it.

strings.text:
レン
「先ほどとは動きが変わりましたね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"The movement has changed from before."

strings.text:
蟲によって構成された右腕を見つめながら、レンが
ぽつりと零すように言った。
strings.translated: Gazing at the right arm being formed from Bugs, Ren murmured quietly, as if letting the words slip out.

strings.text:
レン
「これは、夢美さんが命じたのですか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Did you order it to do this, Yumemi-san?"

strings.text:
夢美
「命じたっていうか、お願いしたっていうか……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It's less that I commanded it, and more that I... asked it..."

strings.text:
戸惑いがちに答える夢美に、レンが真剣な顔で考え込
む。
strings.translated: Yumemi answered hesitantly, and Ren fell into deep thought, his expression serious.

strings.text:
だが、実際夢美に命令したつもりはないのだから、
少なくとも嘘は言っていない。
strings.translated: But since she truly had not intended to give any order, she was at least not lying.

strings.text:
蟲がどう解釈したかは分からないが、夢美はただ
右腕を直してくれるよう『お願い』をしただけだった。
strings.translated: She did not know how the Bug had interpreted it, but Yumemi had simply made a "request" -- asking it to please fix her right arm.

strings.text:
もっとも、本当に右腕が復元されるのかどうかまでは、
分からないのだが……。
strings.translated: Though whether her right arm would actually be restored... that, she still did not know.

strings.text:
夢美
（右腕……なくなっちゃったんだ…………）
strings.translated:
Yumemi
(My right arm... it's really gone............)

strings.text:
復元がどうこうよりも、そっちのほうにようやく実感
が湧いた。
strings.translated: More than any thought of restoration, that was what finally began to feel real to her.

strings.text:
落ち着いて思い返してみれば、確かに合蟲人間に右腕
をもぎ取られた記憶がある。
strings.translated: When she calmed down and thought back, she did indeed have a memory of the Bug-fused human tearing her right arm off.

strings.text:
血も大量に噴き出し、そこで意識を失ってしまったの
だ。
strings.translated: Blood had gushed out violently, and she had lost consciousness then and there.

strings.text: 普通に考えれば、失血死しているような大怪我。
strings.translated: By any normal measure, it was the kind of injury that should have killed her from blood loss.

strings.text:
生きているだけ幸運だと喜ぶべきところなのかもしれ
ないが、やはり胸に込み上げてくる衝撃を拭い切るこ
とはできなかった。
strings.translated: Perhaps she ought to rejoice that she was lucky just to be alive -- yet she could not wipe away the shock welling up inside her chest.

strings.text: 果たして、これからどうなってしまうのか。
strings.translated: What on earth would become of her from here?

strings.text: 失った右腕は、果たしてどこまで復元されるのか。
strings.translated: Just how far would her lost right arm be restored?

strings.text:
時間が経てば経つほどに、不安ばかりが募っていっ
た……。
strings.translated:
The more time passed, the more her anxiety only grew...
and grew.

strings.text: 復元が始まってから一週間後。
strings.translated: One week after the restoration had begun.

strings.text:
朝、起きた夢美の目に、本物と何ら変わらない右腕の
姿が飛び込んできた。
strings.translated: When Yumemi woke that morning, the sight of a right arm indistinguishable from the real thing leapt into her eyes.

strings.text:
昨日までは、赤黒く、全体的にミミズが絡み合ったよ
うな状態になっていたため、これは不意打ちを受けた
も同然だった。
strings.translated: Up until yesterday, it had been dark red and blackened, the whole thing tangled up like a mass of earthworms -- so this caught her completely off guard.

strings.text:
右腕が完成した喜びよりも、驚きのほうが勝って声を
出すこともできない。
strings.translated: The surprise far outweighed any joy at her right arm being complete, and she could not even make a sound.

strings.text:
だが、その形、色、質感などは、どこからどう見ても
人間の腕そのものだ。
strings.translated: Yet its shape, color, and texture were, no matter how she looked at it, those of a human arm.

strings.text:
これが蟲で出来ているとは、知っていなければ誰も
信じないだろう。
strings.translated: Anyone who did not already know would never believe this was made of Bugs.

strings.text:
そっと撫でてみると、夢美の言葉に応えるかのように、
右腕全体がどくんっと鳴った。
strings.translated: When she gently stroked it, as if in answer to Yumemi's words, the entire right arm gave a deep throb.

strings.text:
心臓の音とは全く別物の、夢美ではない生き物の存在
が確かにそこにあった。
strings.translated: Entirely unlike the sound of a heartbeat -- the unmistakable presence of a living creature that was not Yumemi was there.

strings.text: その瞬間、夢美の胸に初めて喜びが込み上げる。
strings.translated: In that instant, joy welled up in Yumemi's chest for the first time.

strings.text:
自分の腕が復元されたことよりも、蟲がちゃんと生き
ていることにホッと安堵の息を漏らした。
strings.translated: More than the restoration of her own arm, it was knowing the Bug was still alive that made her breathe a quiet sigh of relief.

strings.text: そう呟いて、夢美は己の右腕を抱き締めた……。
strings.translated: Murmuring that, Yumemi hugged her own right arm close...

strings.text:
レン
「そうですか。終わりましたか」

朝食を持って部屋に入って来たレンに、右腕のことを
伝えると、特に驚いた様子もなくそう返された。
strings.translated: When Ren came into the room carrying a meal and she told him about her right arm, he returned those words without any particular sign of surprise.

strings.text:
一緒に喜べとまでは言わないが、反応の乏しさに何と
なく肩透かしを食らってしまう。
strings.translated: She wasn't asking him to celebrate with her, but his lack of reaction left her feeling somehow deflated.

strings.text:
多少、体の調子はどうか、腕に違和感はないかなど
を聞かれたが、あくまで事務的な確認に過ぎないよ
うだった。
strings.translated: He asked a few things -- how she was feeling, whether there was any discomfort in the arm -- but it seemed to be nothing more than a routine check.

strings.text:
レン
「では、早速ですが、これからの事をお話しておこう
　と思います」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Well then, without further delay, I'd like to speak with you about what comes next."

strings.text:
テーブルの向かい側の席でスープを飲みながら、レン
が淡々とした口調で言う。
strings.translated: Ren said this in a matter-of-fact tone, sipping his soup from the seat across the table.

strings.text:
レン
「貴女には、今後は僕とともに行動してもらいます」
strings.translated:
Ren
"From here on, you will be acting alongside me."

strings.text:
レン
「マンションの部屋は荒らされてしまいましたし、
　何より一度襲われている以上、戻って生活するのは
　危険過ぎる」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Your apartment has been ransacked, and more than anything, since you've already been attacked once, returning there to live would be far too dangerous."

strings.text:
レンの説明を受けて、夢美はふと一週間前の出来事を
思い出した。
strings.translated: Hearing Ren's explanation, Yumemi suddenly recalled the events of a week ago.

strings.text:
自分自身のことが大変で、すっかり頭から抜け落ちて
いたが、マンションのほうでも大きな混乱があったの
は想像に難くない。
strings.translated: She had been so consumed with her own situation that it had completely slipped her mind, but it was not hard to imagine that there had been considerable chaos at the apartment building as well.

strings.text:
夢美
「マンションのほうって大丈夫だったの？
　蟲とか怪物とか、誰かに見られたんじゃない？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Is the apartment building okay? Weren't the Bugs and monsters seen by someone?"

strings.text:
レン
「神武側が情報の広がりを最小限に留めているようで
　す」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It seems the Jinmu side is keeping the spread of information to a minimum."

strings.text:
レン
「合蟲人間も一定時間後に姿を消しましたし、今のと
　ころハッキリと目撃した人はいないようです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"The Bug-fused humans also disappeared after a certain amount of time, and so far it appears no one got a clear look."

strings.text:
夢美
「爆発とかしてたけど……」

レン
「それは彼等が何とかするでしょう。
　合蟲人間まで持ち出して来たのですから、後処理を
　考えていないはずはありませんし」
strings.translated:
Ren
"They'll handle that somehow. They went so far as to deploy Bug-fused humans -- they couldn't possibly have failed to plan for the cleanup."

strings.text: 当たり前のことのように、レンが断言する。
strings.translated: Ren stated it as though it were the most natural thing in the world.

strings.text:
マンションのほうが問題ないと言うのなら、夢美は
それを信じるしかない。
strings.translated: If Ren said there was no problem with the building, then Yumemi had no choice but to believe him.

strings.text:
それよりも当面の問題は、これから自分がどうなるか
ということだった。
strings.translated: More pressing than that, however, was the immediate question of what would become of her going forward.

strings.text:
あんな怪物に、あんな襲われ方をしたとあっては、
これからはどこに住んでも安心はできない。
strings.translated: Having been attacked by monsters like that, she could never feel safe no matter where she lived.

strings.text:
レンの言うように暫く身を隠すのが安全というのは
分かるが、その後どうなるのかが全く想像がつかな
かった。
strings.translated: She understood that hiding for a while, as Ren suggested, was the safer option -- but she had no idea what would come after.

strings.text:
夢美
「一つ訊きたいんだけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"There's something I want to ask..."

strings.text:
夢美
「狙われたのは私？　それともこのコ？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Was it me they were after? Or this little one?"

strings.text:
部屋が襲われたときの光景を思い出して、右腕を撫で
ながらそんな疑問を口にした。
strings.translated:
Recalling the scene when the apartment was attacked, she stroked her right arm
as she voiced the question.

strings.text: 窓際にいたレンが、ゆっくりと視線を向ける。
strings.translated: Ren, standing by the window, slowly turned his gaze toward her.

strings.text:
夢美
「何となく感じてたけど、このコは普通の蟲とは違う
　のよね？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I had a feeling, but... this one isn't an ordinary Bug, is it?"

strings.text:
夢美
「ちょっと変わった蟲とか、そういう意味じゃなく
　て？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Not just in the sense of being a slightly unusual Bug?"

strings.text: 夢美が真っ直ぐにレンに視線を向ける。
strings.translated: Yumemi fixed her gaze directly on Ren.

strings.text:
レンは腕組みをして暫し逡巡すると、やがて夢美の
右腕に目を移して語り始めた。
strings.translated:
Ren folded his arms and hesitated for a moment, then shifted his eyes to Yumemi's
right arm and began to speak.

Ren
"The Retainer of the Bug Princess ----"

strings.text:
レン
「呼ばれ方は色々ありますが、我々蟲使いにとって、
　伝説の蟲とされている存在がいました」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It goes by many names, but there exists a being that we Bug Users have long regarded
 as a legendary Bug."

strings.text:
レン
「それらは、各地に在る我々の森に祭られていたり、
　封じられていたりしたのですが、七、八年前にその
　うちの一つが盗まれました」
strings.translated:
Ren
"These are things that have been enshrined or sealed away in our forests across the land -- but seven or eight years ago, one of them was stolen."

strings.text:
レン
「一族から抜けようとした一人の蟲使いが、村に祭ら
　れていた獣魔蟲、『刻凍る果ての獣魔』の卵を持ち
　出したのです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"A Bug User who tried to leave the clan took the egg of the Jumachuu enshrined in our village -- the one called 'the Beast Demon of the Frozen End.'"

strings.text:
レン
「何故、そう呼ばれているのかは分かりません。
　村に古くから伝わっているので」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I don't know why it is called that. It has been passed down in the village since ancient times."

strings.text:
レン
「ともかく、我々にとってはこれは非常に大きな問題
　でした」
strings.translated:
Ren
"In any case, this was an extremely serious matter for us."

strings.text:
レン
「獣魔蟲は、伝説上では全てを喰らう蟲ともされ、
　我々にとってあまり好ましい存在ではありません
　でしたから」
strings.translated:
Ren
"In legend, the Jumachuu is said to devour all things -- and it was not
a welcome presence among us."

strings.text:
夢美
「全てを、喰らうって……。
　このコ結構好き嫌いするけど…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Devours everything... but this little one is actually quite picky about food..."

strings.text:
蟲との生活を思い返しながら、夢美が戸惑いがちに
反論する。
strings.translated: Yumemi offered a hesitant objection, her mind drifting back to their life together.

strings.text:
この五年間、蟲の好きなものを発見するのにどれだけ
の労力を要したことか……。
strings.translated: How much effort had it taken over these five years just to discover what the Bug liked to eat...

strings.text:
ただ、それはレンも分かっているらしく、ゆっくりと
頷いて見せた。
strings.translated: Ren seemed to understand that as well, and gave a slow nod.

strings.text:
レン
「要するにそういう事です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"That is, in essence, the situation."

strings.text:
レン
「我々にとって獣魔蟲はあくまで伝説上の蟲であり、
　それ以上のものではありませんでした」
strings.translated:
Ren
"For us, the Jumachuu was nothing more than a legendary creature -- nothing beyond that."

strings.text:
レン
「卵が盗まれたのは確かに大きな問題でしたが、重要
　なのはむしろその後――――」
strings.translated:
Ren
"The theft of the egg was certainly a serious problem, but what mattered even more was what came after ----"

strings.text:
レン
「――本当に卵が孵り、蟲が産まれたという事実のほ
　うだったのです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"---- The fact that the egg truly hatched, and the Bug was born."

strings.text:
夢美
「全てを喰らう……とか、そういうのがあるから？」
どことなく何かを含んだように、レンがつぶやく。
strings.translated: Ren murmured it as though there were something more behind the words.

strings.text:
そこには、夢美には言いたくない、もしくは言えない
何かがあるように感じられた。
strings.translated: It felt as though there was something he did not want to tell Yumemi -- or perhaps could not.

strings.text:
レン
「ともかく重要なのは、我々にとって獣魔蟲は好まし
　い存在ではないということです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"In any case, what matters is that the Jumachuu is not a welcome presence for us."

strings.text:
レン
「率直に言ってしまえば、封印、もしくは消滅させる
　のが望ましい」
strings.translated:
Ren
"To put it plainly, it would be preferable to seal it away -- or destroy it."

Yumemi
"Wh-what do you mean by that!!"

strings.text:
レンの思わぬ言葉に、夢美は声を荒げながらベッドか
ら立ち上がった。
strings.translated: Shocked by Ren's unexpected words, Yumemi raised her voice and stood up from the bed.

strings.text:
好ましい存在でないという話は先ほども聞いたが、
だからといって、封印やら消滅やらという話を容認
できるわけがない。
strings.translated: She had already heard that it was not a welcome presence -- but that was no reason she could accept talk of sealing it away or destroying it.

strings.text:
蟲使いにとっては好ましくない蟲であっても、夢美に
とっては大切な家族なのだ。
strings.translated: Even if it was a Bug unwelcome to Bug Users, to Yumemi it was precious family.

strings.text:
レン
「落ち着いて下さい。
　それをするつもりなら、五年前にやっています」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Please calm down.
 If we intended to do that, we would have done so five years ago."

strings.text:
夢美
「それは……そうかもしれないけど…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That's... you may be right, but..."

strings.text: 安心もできなければ納得もできない。
strings.translated: She could neither relax nor accept it.

strings.text:
レン
「封印や消滅は、伝説を過剰に恐れる一部の老人達の
　意見です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Sealing and destruction are the opinions of a few elders who fear the legend excessively."

strings.text:
レン
「我々の長は、今のところ様子見に徹しています」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Our leader is, for the time being, taking a wait-and-see approach."

strings.text:
夢美
「様子見って……最終的には封印とか消滅とかさせる
　可能性もあるってことでしょ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Wait-and-see... that means there's still a possibility they'll end up sealing it away or destroying it, right?"

strings.text:
レン
「それは否定しません」

レン
「もっとも、今はそれも簡単にはいかなくなってしま
　いましたが……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Though at this point, even that would not be so easily done..."

strings.text:
果たして、そこにはどんな感情が込められているのか、
夢美の右腕を見つめるレンの目が細められる。
strings.translated: Just what emotions lay behind those words -- Ren's eyes narrowed as he gazed at Yumemi's right arm.

strings.text:
レン
「ですが、仮に封印なり消滅なりをしなければならな
　くなった時は、おそらくは夢美さんにも危険が及ん
　でいるときですよ」
strings.translated:
Ren
"But if it ever comes to the point where we must seal or eliminate it, that will likely
 be a time when you yourself are in danger, Yumemi-san."

strings.text:
夢美
「そんなこと……あるわけない…………」
やや語尾を小さくして、夢美は反論した。
strings.translated: Trailing off slightly at the end, Yumemi offered her rebuttal.

strings.text:
蟲が自分を襲うなどと思っているわけではないが、
それに対する証拠を示せるわけではない。
strings.translated: She did not believe the Bug would attack her -- but she had no evidence to prove otherwise.

strings.text:
今はただ、夢美にとって望まぬ未来が来ないように
祈るしかなかった。
strings.translated: For now, all she could do was pray that an unwanted future would not come for her.

strings.text:
レン
「ですので……ここからは夢美さんの話になりますが、
　貴女には蟲を使えるだけの技術を身につけてもらお
　うと思っています」
strings.translated:
Ren
"So... this is where we get to the matter of you, Yumemi-san -- we intend to have you acquire the skills necessary to use a Bug."

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲を使えるだけの……技術？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"The skills necessary to... use a Bug?"

strings.text:
レン
「今の貴女と蟲の状態は、常識では考えられません」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Your current state -- yours and the Bug's -- is beyond anything conventional wisdom can account for."

strings.text:
レン
「今後、何が起こるかは、我々にも予測不可能です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"What may happen going forward is impossible for us to predict."

strings.text:
レン
「しかし、貴女がその右腕を使役できるようになれば、
　何かが起こったとしても、獣魔蟲を抑えることがで
　きるかもしれない」
strings.translated:
Ren
"However, if you were to gain control over that right arm,
then should something occur, you may be able
to keep the Jumachuu in check."

strings.text:
レン
「多分に希望的観測が含まれてはいますが、何もしな
　いよりはマシでしょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It contains a fair amount of wishful thinking, but it is better than doing nothing."

strings.text: そこまで聞いて、夢美はピンと来るものがあった。
strings.translated: Hearing that much, something clicked for Yumemi.

strings.text:
何となく遠まわしに言われているような気がするが、
つまりレンの言葉を要約すると――――
strings.translated: It felt as though he was speaking in a roundabout way, but in short, to summarize Ren's words ----

strings.text:
夢美
「私に、蟲使いになれって事？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"You're telling me to become a Bug User?"

strings.text:
レン
「そういう事になりますね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"That is what it comes down to, yes."

strings.text:
夢美
「もしも、断わったら……？」

レン
「貴女の処遇はその時に考えますが、少なくとも
　獣魔蟲は渡してもらいます」
strings.translated:
Ren
"We will consider your situation at that time, but at the very least, we will be taking the Jumachuu."

strings.text:
レン
「貴女の右腕をもぎ取ってでも……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Even if we have to tear off your right arm..."

strings.text: レンに言われて、夢美は全身の毛を逆立たせた。
strings.translated: At Ren's words, every hair on Yumemi's body stood on end.

strings.text:
さらりと言われてしまったが、レンの宣言は脅迫以外
のなにものでもない。
strings.translated: It was delivered so casually, yet Ren's declaration was nothing short of a threat.

strings.text:
今までと同じ生活に戻るような選択肢は、もうどこに
も存在してないのだ。
strings.translated: The option of returning to her old life no longer existed anywhere.
There was no real choice to be made.

strings.text:
右腕をもぎ取るとまで言われて、どうして拒否する事
ができるだろう。
strings.translated: After being told they would tear off her arm, how could she possibly refuse?

strings.text:
夢美は真っ直ぐにレンを見ると、ハッキリとした口調
で告げた。
strings.translated: Yumemi looked straight at Ren and told him in a clear, firm tone.

strings.text:
夢美
「私、このコとは離れられない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I can't be apart from this one."

strings.text:
レン
「では、蟲使いになるということですね？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"So you will become a Bug User, then?"

strings.text:
夢美
「今のところは、そういう事にしとく」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"For now, that's how it's going to be."

strings.text:
夢美
「正直、なりたいなんて思ってないけど、このコと
　別れないためには、それしかないみたいだし」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Honestly, it's not something I ever wanted -- but if that's what it takes to stay with this one, I don't have much choice."

strings.text:
レン
「理由は問いません。
　我々としても、これはひとまずの処置ですので」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I won't ask your reasons.
For our part, this is only a provisional arrangement as well."

strings.text:
夢美
「また不安を煽るような事をさらりと…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"There you go again, casually saying something unsettling............"

strings.text: 前途多難――なのかどうかさえ、今はよく分からない。
strings.translated: The road ahead was fraught with hardship -- or so it seemed, though even that was hard to say for certain right now.

strings.text:
ただ、これからも蟲と一緒にいたいと、それだけは
胸を張って言うことができた。
strings.translated: Even so, there was one thing she could say with her head held high -- that she wanted to stay with the Bug, now and going forward.

strings.text:
レン
「それでは、貴女には今後蟲使いのトレーニングを
　積んでもらいながら、僕の仕事の手伝いをしても
　らいます」
strings.translated:
Ren
"In that case, you will undergo Bug User training from here on while assisting me with my work."

strings.text:
夢美
「仕事の手伝いって……あなた何の仕事してるの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Assisting with your work... what kind of work do you do, exactly?"

strings.text:
レン
「現在の任務は、神武社社長令嬢、神武美弥香の身柄
　の確保です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"My current mission is to secure the person of Jinmu Miyaka, daughter of the president of Jinmu Corporation."

strings.text:
いきなり不穏な臭いが漂ってきて、夢美は一瞬口を
噤んだ。
strings.translated: An ominous scent drifted in without warning, and Yumemi fell momentarily silent.

strings.text:
言葉の上では、身柄の確保という表現を用いている
が――――
strings.translated: The words used were "secure her person" -- but --

strings.text:
夢美
「要するに誘拐って事よね？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"In other words, you mean kidnapping, right?"

strings.text:
レン
「ありていに言えば……」

それは、奇しくも五年前、夢美自身が体験した事と
酷似していた。
strings.translated: Strangely enough, it bore a striking resemblance to what Yumemi herself had experienced five years ago.

strings.text:
当然、誘拐した後に何をするのか、不安にならないわ
けがない。
strings.translated: Naturally, she couldn't help but feel anxious about what would be done to the person after the kidnapping.

strings.text:
夢美
「その人を……蟲で犯すの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Are you going to... violate her with Bugs?"

strings.text:
レン
「今のところその必要性は感じていませんが？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I don't feel that will be necessary at this point."

strings.text:
夢美
「しないって約束してくれない？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Can you promise me you won't?"

strings.text: 夢美の言葉に、レンはやや悩むように声を漏らした。
strings.translated: At Yumemi's words, Ren let out a sound as if wrestling with the question.

strings.text: だが、すぐに首を横に振って、夢美のほうを見つめる。
strings.translated: But he quickly shook his head and turned his gaze toward Yumemi.

strings.text:
レン
「約束はできません。必要であればやります」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I cannot promise. If it becomes necessary, I will do it."

strings.text:
レン
「ただ、そうならないよう善処はしようと思いますが、
　それで如何でしょうか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"However, I intend to do my best to ensure it doesn't come to that -- will that suffice?"

strings.text:
如何でしょうかと問われても、夢美にＮＯと言う権限
はない。
strings.translated: Being asked "will that suffice" was one thing, but Yumemi had no authority to say no.

strings.text: 不満はあるが、今はレンの言葉を信じるしかなかった。
strings.translated: She was dissatisfied, but for now she had no choice but to take Ren at his word.

strings.text:
夢美
「分かったわよ。とりあえずはそれでお願い」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Fine. For now, I'll go with that."

strings.text: レンの手から、携帯電話がひとつ渡される。
strings.translated: A cell phone was passed from Ren's hand to hers.

strings.text:
レン
「今後、離れて行動することがあるかもしれません」
strings.translated:
Ren
"There may be times going forward when we act separately."

strings.text:
レン
「僕との専用になりますが、持っていてください」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It will only connect to me, but please keep it with you."

strings.text:
渡された携帯電話はやや古いタイプで、全体的には
赤色をしていた。
strings.translated: The cell phone she'd been handed was a somewhat older model, red in color overall.

strings.text: 説明書はないらしいが、必要な機能は何となく分かる。
strings.translated: There didn't seem to be a manual, but she could more or less figure out the necessary functions.

strings.text:
夢美
「でも、携帯なら私も持ってるけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But I already have a cell phone of my own..."

strings.text:
レン
「それはこちらで処分します。渡してください」
strings.translated:
Ren
"We will dispose of that one. Hand it over."

strings.text:
さも当然のように言われ、夢美はややムッとしながら
も携帯電話を手渡した。
strings.translated: Said so matter-of-factly, Yumemi handed over her cell phone with a slight scowl.

strings.text:
これからの生活を考えれば、確かに必要ないものかも
しれないが、簡単に「処分する」と言われるのはあま
り気分の良いものではない。
strings.translated: Thinking about her life from here on, it was true she probably wouldn't need it -- but being told so casually to "dispose of it" didn't sit well with her.

strings.text:
受け取った瞬間、レンが躊躇いなく携帯電話をへし折
る。
strings.translated: The moment he took it, Ren snapped the cell phone in two without a moment's hesitation.

strings.text: そして、目を丸くして驚いた夢美に気付くと――――
strings.translated: And when he noticed Yumemi staring at him wide-eyed in shock --

strings.text: ――と、平然とした顔で聞き返してきた。
strings.translated: -- he looked back at her with a perfectly calm expression.

strings.text: 夢美は、早くも蟲使いをやめたくなっていた……。
strings.translated: Yumemi was already beginning to want out of this Bug User business...

strings.text:
櫻井夢美は、唐突に家族を失い、それまで当たり前
だった幸せを微塵に破壊された……。
strings.translated: Sakurai Yumemi suddenly lost her family, and the happiness she had always taken for granted was shattered to pieces...

strings.text: 蟲に犯され、純潔を散らされた瞬間。
strings.translated: The moment she was violated by a Bug, her purity stripped away.

strings.text: 卵を植え付けられ、『苗床』として過ごす日々。
strings.translated: Days spent as a "Seedbed," eggs planted inside her.

strings.text:
苦痛と不安の先に産まれ出たものは、異形の生物達
だった。
strings.translated: What was born from the depths of pain and anxiety were creatures of aberrant form.

strings.text: 夢美を誘拐したのは、銀髪で大柄の男だった。
strings.translated: The one who had abducted Yumemi was a large man with silver hair.
His personality was crude and violent.

strings.text:
夢美のことを人間としては扱わず、『苗床』、もしく
は自らの性欲処理機として使った。
strings.translated: He never treated Yumemi as a human being -- using her as a "Seedbed," or simply as an outlet for his own desires.
Days that were nothing short of hell.

strings.text: 犯され、穢され、大切なものを幾つも奪われた。
strings.translated: Violated, defiled, stripped of so many precious things.

strings.text: いや、それだけではない。

時には取引の材料に使われ、人間でも蟲でもない生物
に延々と犯され続けた。
strings.translated: At times she was used as a bargaining chip, violated endlessly by creatures that were neither human nor Bug.

strings.text:
自分が壊れるかと思うほどの力で、穴という穴を貫か
れ続けた。
strings.translated: Pierced through every opening with a force that made her feel she might break.

strings.text: それは、地獄と呼ぶ他ない体験だった……。
strings.translated: It was an experience that could only be called hell...
There was no hope. Nothing at all.

strings.text:
このまま自分は死ぬのだろうと、埃まみれのベッドの
上で何度も震えた。
strings.translated: She trembled countless times on that dust-covered bed, certain she would die here.

strings.text: 安心して眠れた夜など、一度としてなかった……。
strings.translated: There was not a single night she could sleep in peace...

strings.text: やがて、変化が訪れたのは一匹の蟲との触れ合い。
strings.translated: And yet, in time, change came through an encounter with a single Bug.

strings.text:
自らを慕ってくる我が仔の姿に、夢美は少しずつ心を
動かされた。
strings.translated: Watching the little one that had grown attached to her, Yumemi felt her heart slowly begin to stir.

strings.text:
恐怖に彩られた生活が、ほんの少しだけ温かな色に
変わっていった。
strings.translated: A life painted entirely in fear began, little by little, to take on a faint warmth.
-- I don't want it to die.

strings.text: 決意したきっかけは、そんな思いだった。
strings.translated: That feeling was what set her resolve in motion.

strings.text:
我が仔を守るため倉庫の中を駆け回り、何かしら使え
る物はないかを探した。
strings.translated: -- To protect her little one, she ran through the warehouse, searching desperately for anything she could use.

strings.text:
吐き気を催すほどの恐怖を抑えて、必死に蟲を守る
方法を探し続けた。
strings.translated: Suppressing a fear so overwhelming it made her sick, she kept searching for a way to keep the Bug safe.

strings.text:
意識を取り戻したとき、夢美の目の前には男の死体が
転がっていた。
strings.translated: When she regained consciousness, a man's corpse lay sprawled before her eyes.

strings.text:
辺り一面は血の海で、手のひらにぬるりとした感触が
伝わってくる。
strings.translated: The surroundings were a sea of blood, and a slick, wet sensation spread across her palm.

strings.text:
人を殺したという事実は、すぐには現実のものとして
は感じられなかった。
strings.translated: The fact that she had killed a person did not register as real, not right away.

strings.text:
まだ、どこか夢の中にでもいるような気がして、暫く
その場で呆然と立ち尽くしていた……。
strings.translated: She still felt as though she were somewhere inside a dream, and for a while she stood there, rooted to the spot in a daze...

strings.text: 一ヶ月ぶりに得られた自由。
strings.translated: Freedom -- for the first time in a month.

strings.text:
蟲の触手と手を繋ぎながら、夢美は真っ赤な夕陽を
見上げながら歩いた。
strings.translated: Hand in hand with her Bug's tentacle, Yumemi walked beneath the blazing red sunset.

strings.text:
血の滲んだシーツを身に纏いながら、森の出口へ通じ
る道を歩いた。
strings.translated: She walked the path leading out of the forest, wrapped in blood-soaked sheets.

strings.text: 恐いとは感じなかった。

自分が独りではないと、常に感じることができたか
ら……。
strings.translated: Because she could always feel that she was not alone...

strings.text:
右手に巻き付いた触手が、独りではないと伝えてくれ
たから……。
strings.translated: Because the tentacle coiled around her right hand told her she was not alone...

strings.text: 失ったものは多くある。
strings.translated: There is much she has lost.

strings.text: 戻らないものは幾つもある。
strings.translated: There are many things she will never get back.

strings.text: 泣いても、叫んでも、それはもう変わらない事実だ。
strings.translated: No matter how much she cries, no matter how much she screams, those are facts that will never change.

strings.text: だが、それでも夢美は生きている。
生きて、自由を得て、傍らには我が仔までいる。
strings.translated: Alive, free, and with her little one by her side.

strings.text: だから――夢美は生き抜くことに決めた――――。
strings.translated: And so -- Yumemi decided she would survive ---.

strings.text:
レンについて行くと決めてからの一週間は、本当に
目まぐるしく過ぎていった。
strings.translated:
The week after she decided to follow Ren passed in a truly
blinding blur.

strings.text:
夢美を取り巻く環境はガラリと変化し、住む場所から
食事に至るまで、全てが『管理』された生活になった。
strings.translated:
The environment surrounding Yumemi changed completely, and her life became one of total "management" -- from where she lived
down to what she ate.

strings.text: 若い男女などと言う関係は、何の意味も持たない。
strings.translated: The fact that they were a young man and woman together meant nothing whatsoever.

strings.text:
プライベートと呼べるものは一切なく、夢美の生活は
二十四時間、レンの目の届くところに置かれた。
strings.translated:
There was no such thing as privacy. Yumemi's life was placed
within Ren's sight twenty-four hours a day.

strings.text:
最初の三日間は、レンが滞在していたホテルで過ごし
た。
strings.translated: The first three days were spent at the hotel where Ren had been staying.

strings.text:
外に出ることは許されず、一日中部屋でテレビばかり
を見ている生活だった。
strings.translated: She was not permitted to go outside, and spent her days doing nothing but watching television in the room.

strings.text:
その間、夢美に関することをレンが処理したらしいが、
詳しいことは知らされていない。
strings.translated:
During that time, Ren apparently handled everything related to Yumemi's affairs,
though she was not told the details.

strings.text:
四日目にはホテルをチェックアウトし、行き先も告げ
られないまま移動させられた。
strings.translated: On the fourth day, they checked out of the hotel, and she was moved without being told their destination.

strings.text: 交通手段はバスと電車を使用。
strings.translated: Their means of transportation were buses and trains.

strings.text:
夢美の蟲はリュックサックに入れて、なるべく人の
少ない時間帯を選んで移動した。
strings.translated: Yumemi's Bugs were packed into a backpack, and they traveled during hours when as few people as possible would be around.

strings.text: ホテルを出てから五時間――――。
strings.translated: Five hours after leaving the hotel...

strings.text:
どこの街にあるのかも分からないレストランに連れて
行かれ、そこで見知らぬ老人と顔を合わせた。
strings.translated:
She was taken to a restaurant in a town she didn't recognize,
where she came face to face with an unfamiliar old man.

strings.text: 誰なのかは知らないし、その説明もなかった。
strings.translated: She didn't know who he was, and no explanation was given.

strings.text: ただ、レンと老人が十分ほど話をしただけ……。
strings.translated: All that happened was Ren and the old man talked for about ten minutes...

strings.text:
会話の雰囲気から、老人もまた蟲使いなのだろうと、
それだけが夢美に理解できた唯一の事だった。
strings.translated:
From the tone of the conversation, the only thing Yumemi could gather
was that the old man was likely a Bug User as well.

strings.text: そして、再び移動すること三時間。
strings.translated: And then, another three hours of travel.

strings.text:
どことなく見覚えのある街に首を傾げながら、案内さ
れた先は、予想もしていなかった場所だった。
strings.translated: Tilting her head at the vaguely familiar town, she was led to a place she never could have anticipated.

strings.text:
どす黒い記憶が巡るのを感じながら、夢美は眉根を
寄せた。
strings.translated: Feeling dark, murky memories swirling through her mind, Yumemi furrowed her brow.

strings.text:
最初は似ているだけかと思ったが、それにしては記憶
と一致している箇所が多すぎる。
strings.translated: At first she thought it only resembled the place, but there were far too many details that matched her memory.

strings.text:
レン
「ここ数年の間に使われた形跡もなく、まさに隠れ家
　としては最適です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"There are no signs of anyone having used it in the past several years. It's truly ideal as a hideout."

strings.text:
レン
「以前は、とある蟲使いが使っていましたが、彼は
　もういないので問題ないでしょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"A certain Bug User made use of it before, but since he's no longer around, that shouldn't be a problem."

strings.text: その蟲使いのことならば、夢美はよく知っていた。
strings.translated: As for that Bug User -- Yumemi knew him well.

strings.text:
名前こそ聞く機会はなかったが、外見、性格、喋り方
は今も鮮明に思い出すことができる。
strings.translated: She'd never had the chance to learn his name, but his appearance, his personality, the way he spoke -- she could still recall them all with vivid clarity.

strings.text: そして、犯された時の感触も――――――。
strings.translated: And the sensation of being violated by him -- that too.

strings.text:
レン
「どういう意味ですか？」

夢美
「ホテルでもいいじゃない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"A hotel would be fine, wouldn't it?"

strings.text:
レン
「先ほど言った通りです。
　ここは隠れ家として最適だ」
strings.translated:
Ren
"As I said before.
This place is ideal as a hideout."

strings.text:
レン
「それ以外の理由はありません」

そっけなく言いながら、埃の溜まった床に荷物を下ろ
す。
strings.translated: He said it flatly, setting his luggage down on the dust-covered floor.

strings.text:
灰色の粉がもわっと宙に舞ったのが見えて、夢美は
思わず顔をしかめた。
strings.translated: A gray cloud of powder billowed up into the air, and Yumemi couldn't help but grimace.

strings.text:
十分な金はあるはずなのに、「隠れ家として最適」な
だけでこの場所を選ぶというのは、どうにも理解し難
い。
strings.translated: They surely had more than enough money, yet choosing this place solely because it was "ideal as a hideout" was something she found difficult to understand.

strings.text:
立場上、隠れやすい場所を好むのは分からなくもない
が、そのために不衛生な場所で過ごすのは、本末転倒
な気がしなくもなかった。
strings.translated: She could understand that his position made him prefer places that were easy to hide in, but spending time in an unsanitary place for that reason felt like it was missing the point entirely.

strings.text:
夢美
「こんなところで暮らしてると、すぐに体調悪くなる
　んだから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Living in a place like this, you'll get sick before you know it."

strings.text:
レン
「ご心配には及びません。
　床が腐り切った廃屋で過ごすよりマシです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"There is no need for concern.
It's better than spending time in an abandoned building with a rotting floor."

strings.text:
夢美
「そんな建物と比べてどうするのよ……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Why are you comparing it to something like that..."

strings.text:
溜息をつきながら、カビの生えたソファーにリュック
サックを下ろす。
strings.translated: Sighing, she set her backpack down on the mold-covered sofa.

strings.text: だが、むっと嫌な臭いがして、すぐに持ち上げた。
strings.translated: But a foul, musty smell hit her, and she immediately lifted it back up.

strings.text:
当時はまだ使い物になっていたが、さすがに五年も
経つとカビだらけだ。
strings.translated: It had still been usable back then, but five years on, it was no surprise it was covered in mold.

strings.text:
座っただけで病気になりそうな気がして、夢美は少し
ソファーから離れた位置に移動した。
strings.translated: Feeling like she might get sick just from sitting on it, Yumemi moved to a spot a little away from the sofa.

strings.text:
夢美
「たぶん、奥の部屋のベッドもダメだと思うんだけ
　ど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm pretty sure the bed in the back room is no good either..."

strings.text:
大した問題ではないとでも言うように、レンがさらり
と答える。
strings.translated: Ren answered smoothly, as if it were hardly worth worrying about.

strings.text:
これ以上文句を言っても、状況が変わることはなさそ
うだった。
strings.translated: It seemed that no amount of further complaints would change the situation.

strings.text:
夢美
「それで、私は何をすればいいの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"So, what am I supposed to do?"

strings.text: レンの思わぬ言葉に、目が点になる。
strings.translated: Ren's unexpected words left her staring blankly.

strings.text:
レン
「貴女もご指摘の通り、このまま過ごすには非常に
　不衛生です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"As you yourself pointed out, staying here as it is would be extremely unsanitary."

strings.text:
レン
「必要と思われる道具は買っておきましたから、僕の
　持って来た黒い鞄のほうを確認して下さい」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I purchased what I thought would be necessary, so please check the black bag I brought with me."

strings.text:
夢美
「ちょっと待って！　私、掃除するためにここに来た
　わけじゃないんだけど」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Hold on a minute! I didn't come here to clean."

Ren
"Then what did you come here for?"

strings.text:
夢美
「な、何って……言われても…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Wh-what for... I mean... I don't..."

strings.text: 問われても、答えられるはずがない。
strings.translated: Even if asked, there was no way she could answer.

strings.text:
夢美はただ案内されるまま、ここに連れて来られたに
過ぎないのだ。
strings.translated: Yumemi had simply been led here -- brought along without any say in the matter.

strings.text: そこに主体性など、あるはずもなかった。
strings.translated: There was no agency in that. There never could have been.

strings.text:
夢美
「分かった、分かりました。
　ピッカピカに掃除すればいいんでしょ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Fine, fine. I'll scrub it until it sparkles, okay?"

strings.text:
拗ねたように溜息を漏らし、黒い鞄のほうへ近付いて
いく。
strings.translated: She let out an exasperated sigh and walked toward the black bag.

strings.text:
チャックを開けて中身を確認してみると、どっさりと
雑巾が出てきた。
strings.translated: She unzipped it and checked the contents -- out came a heaping pile of rags.

strings.text:
夢美
「それは見れば分かるけど……」

念のため中身を引っ張り出してみるが、出てくるのは
色違いの雑巾ばかり。
strings.translated: She pulled everything out just to be sure, but all that came out were rags in different colors.

strings.text: 要するに、これで掃除しろということらしい。
strings.translated: In short, it seemed she was expected to clean with these.

strings.text:
夢美は、軽い頭痛を覚えながら額を押さえ、ジト目で
レンを見つめた。
strings.translated: Yumemi pressed her hand to her forehead, a dull headache setting in, and fixed Ren with a withering stare.

strings.text:
まさか蟲使いの掃除は、全て雑巾で行われるというわ
けではないだろう。
strings.translated: Surely Bug Users didn't do all their cleaning exclusively with rags.

strings.text: 常識がないのか、それとも頓着がないのか。
strings.translated: Was he simply ignorant of common sense, or did he just not care?

strings.text:
何にしても、雑巾だけで掃除し切れる汚れ具合ではな
かった。
strings.translated: Either way, the level of filth here was not something that could be handled with rags alone.

Yumemi
"Do you have any money on you right now?"

strings.text:
レン
「必要な分はありますが？」

夢美
「貸して。必要な道具買ってくるから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Lend it to me. I'll go buy the supplies we need."

strings.text:
レン
「それでは駄目でしたか？」

夢美
「足りないものがいっぱいあるの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"We're missing a whole bunch of stuff."

strings.text: 呆れたように言う夢美に、レンは表情一つ変えない。
strings.translated: Yumemi said it with exasperation, and Ren's expression didn't change in the slightest.

strings.text: 財布を手渡すと、付け加えるように言った。
strings.translated: He handed over his wallet and added, as an afterthought:

strings.text:
レン
「ついでに、今晩の食事もお願いします」
strings.translated:
Ren
"While you're at it, please take care of tonight's dinner as well."

strings.text:
夢美
「ふぁっくしょんっ！！」

霧のように舞い上がる埃の中で、夢美が箒を片手に
盛大なくしゃみをした。
strings.translated: In a cloud of dust swirling like mist, Yumemi let out a tremendous sneeze, broom in hand.

strings.text: 短い髪が揺れて、肩がぶるりと震える。
strings.translated: Her short hair swayed, and her shoulders shuddered.

strings.text:
ある程度予感はしていたが、長年放置されていた倉庫
の掃除は、一筋縄ではいかなかった。
strings.translated: She had half-expected it, but cleaning a warehouse that had been left abandoned for years was no simple task.

strings.text:
箒とちりとりで埃を掻き集め、せっせと外に放り出し
てはいるが、作業開始してから一時間で全体の半分も
終わっていない。
strings.translated: She swept the dust into piles with a broom and dustpan, tossing it all outside bit by bit -- but an hour into the work, she hadn't even finished half of it.

strings.text:
せめて掃除機が使えればまだマシなのだが、電気が
通っていない以上、どうする事もできない。
strings.translated: A vacuum cleaner would have made things considerably easier, but with no electricity running to the building, there was nothing to be done.

strings.text:
さらに悪いのは水道も壊れている事で、掃除をしても
とても人の住める場所になるとは思えなかった。
strings.translated: Worse still, the plumbing was broken -- even after cleaning, she couldn't imagine this place becoming somewhere fit for a person to live.

strings.text:
夢美
「……っとに、どこ行ったのよ、あいつ」

灰色の埃の舞う部屋で、夢美は疲れたように溜息をつ
いた。
strings.translated: In the gray, dust-filled room, Yumemi let out a tired sigh.

strings.text:
果たしてどういうつもりなのか、部屋に帰ってきたと
きレンの姿がなかったのだ。
strings.translated: For whatever reason, when she had returned to the room, Ren was nowhere to be found.

strings.text:
変わっていた点といえば、テーブルの上に置手紙が
あった事くらい……。
strings.translated: The only thing that had changed was a note left on the table...

strings.text:
内容は『出かけてきます』の一言で、正直あってもな
くてもあまり意味はなかった。
strings.translated: Its contents were a single line -- "Going out" -- which, honestly, was barely worth having written at all.

strings.text:
服の襟首をパタパタと動かしながら、夢美は小さく
眉根を寄せた。
strings.translated: She fanned the collar of her shirt back and forth, brow furrowing slightly.

strings.text:
風呂に入りたかったが、あいにくこの建物には、そん
な上等なものはない。
strings.translated: She wanted nothing more than a bath, but unfortunately, this building had no such luxury.

strings.text:
出力の弱いシャワーが一本備え付けてあるだけで、
体の汚れはそれで洗い流すのが常だった。
strings.translated: There was only a single weak shower installed, and washing off with that was the usual routine.

strings.text:
もっとも、今は水が通っていないため、それですら
使えないのだが……。
strings.translated: Of course, with the water currently out, even that was unusable...

strings.text: 時間が経つごとに、記憶は少しずつ甦ってくる。
strings.translated: With each passing moment, her memories returned little by little.

strings.text:
監禁され、蟲に犯され、卵を産み付けられ、そして
最後には出産させられた。
strings.translated: Confined. Violated by Bugs. Eggs laid inside her. And finally -- forced to give birth.

strings.text:
悪い夢だったとして片付けておきたかった事実が、
鎌首をもたげるようにして、夢美の前に突き付けら
れている。
strings.translated: The facts she had wanted to write off as a bad dream reared their heads like a serpent rising to strike, thrusting themselves before Yumemi once more.

strings.text:
何一つ抵抗することができず、体の隅々まで穢された
一ヶ月間――――。
strings.translated: A month in which she could not resist a single thing -- her body defiled to its very core.

strings.text:
最近になってようやく忘れることができるようになっ
てきたというのに、これでは何の意味もない。
strings.translated: She had only just recently managed to put it all behind her -- and now it was as if none of that progress meant anything.

strings.text:
テーブルやソファー、壁にある目立つ傷、今は使えな
い水道、さらには床に捨てられていたスナック菓子の
袋など、夢美の記憶を刺激するものは多かった。
strings.translated: The tables and sofa, the conspicuous scratches on the walls, the water that no longer ran, even the empty snack bags left scattered on the floor -- there was no shortage of things to stir Yumemi's memories.

strings.text: ここには、夢美の悪夢の全てが詰まっていた……。
strings.translated: Every last piece of her nightmare was contained within these walls...

strings.text:
夢美
「は～っ、ちょっと休憩……」

掃除道具のついでに買っておいたビニールシートを
敷いて、夢美は固い床面に腰を下ろした。
strings.translated: She spread out a vinyl sheet she had bought along with the cleaning supplies, and lowered herself onto the hard floor.

strings.text:
カビだらけのソファーには座る気がしないため、やむ
を得ない処置だ。
strings.translated: She had no desire to sit on the mold-covered sofa, so this was the only option.

strings.text:
本当は外に出たかったのだが、今の自分の立場を考え
ると、屋内のほうが幾分気が楽だった。
strings.translated: She would have preferred to go outside, but given her current circumstances, staying indoors felt somewhat easier on her nerves.

strings.text:
夢美が声を掛けると、今までリュックサックの中に
入っていた蟲が、のそのそと近付いてきた。
strings.translated: At Yumemi's call, the Bug that had been nestled inside her backpack crept slowly toward her.

strings.text:
夢美のそばまで来ると、甘えるように触手を出して
肌を撫でる。
strings.translated: Once it reached her side, it extended its tentacles and stroked her skin, as if seeking affection.

strings.text:
そろそろお腹が空いているのだろうが、与えられるも
のといえば、ペットボトルの烏龍茶くらいだった。
strings.translated: It was probably getting hungry by now, but the only thing she had to offer was a bottle of oolong tea.

strings.text:
夢美
「ごめんね。あんまり栄養になんないので」
紙コップに烏龍茶を注いで、蟲の前に差し出す。
strings.translated: She poured some oolong tea into a paper cup and held it out in front of the Bug.

strings.text:
蟲はコップの中に触手を突っ込むと、そこから烏龍茶
を吸収し始めたようだった。
strings.translated: It plunged its tentacles into the cup and appeared to begin absorbing the tea from within.

strings.text:
室内には薄い闇が忍び始めていて、やや肌寒さを感じ
る。
strings.translated: A thin darkness had begun to creep into the room, and the air carried a faint chill.

strings.text:
このまま夜になれば、きっとここは何も見えないくら
いに暗くなるだろう。
strings.translated: If night fell like this, the place would surely become so dark that nothing could be seen at all.

strings.text:
不意にあることに思い至り、夢美は立ち上がって照明
のスイッチに駆け寄った。
strings.translated: Something suddenly occurred to her, and Yumemi jumped to her feet and hurried over to the light switch.

strings.text:
悪い予感を覚えつつもＯＮにしてみるが、やはりと
言うべきか天井の蛍光灯に変化はない。
strings.translated: With a bad feeling already gnawing at her, she flipped it to ON -- and sure enough, the fluorescent light on the ceiling showed no sign of life.

strings.text:
電気が止まっているのだから、当たり前と言えば当た
り前の話だった。
strings.translated: The electricity had been cut off, so it was only natural, when she thought about it.

strings.text:
夢美
「懐中電灯くらい買ってくれば良かった」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I should have bought a flashlight while I was at it."

strings.text: ぼやきながら溜息をつく。
strings.translated: She muttered to herself and let out a sigh.

strings.text: 今からなら、まだ十分に間に合うだろう。
strings.translated: If she left now, she could still make it in time.

strings.text:
二度も買い物に行くのは少し面倒だったが、夜を完全
な暗闇の中で過ごすよりはマシだ。
strings.translated: Going out to shop a second time was a bit of a hassle, but it was better than spending the night in total darkness.

strings.text:
問題なのは、既にレンが手を打っている可能性だった
が、本人がいなければそのあたりを確認することもで
きない。
strings.translated: The concern was whether Ren had already taken care of it -- but with him nowhere to be found, there was no way to check.

strings.text:
夢美は仕方なく、もう一度買い物に行こうかと考え
て――――
strings.translated: Yumemi reluctantly began to consider making another trip to the store -- and then --

strings.text: ――倉庫の中に、レンの姿があることに気付いた。
strings.translated: -- she noticed that Ren was standing inside the warehouse.

Yumemi
"...You nearly gave me a heart attack."

strings.text:
夢美
「帰って来たんなら声くらい掛けなさいよ。
　びっくりするじゃない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"If you came back, you could at least say something.
 You scared me half to death."

strings.text:
レン
「ただいま戻りました」

不満を全開にする夢美に対し、レンの態度はやはり
変わらない。
strings.translated: Yumemi made no effort to hide her irritation, but Ren's demeanor remained unchanged as always.

strings.text:
ビニールシートのほうに近付いていくと、右手に抱え
ていた荷物をそこに下ろした。
strings.translated: He walked over to the vinyl sheet and set down the bundle he had been carrying in his right arm.

strings.text: ロゴマークも何もない、茶色の紙袋。
strings.translated: A plain brown paper bag with no logo or markings of any kind.

strings.text:
よく書類などを収めるために使われそうなサイズだが、
それにしては横に大きく膨らんでいた。
strings.translated: It looked like the sort used to hold documents, but it was bulging out considerably to the sides.

strings.text:
レン
「あとでこれに着替えておいて下さい」

夢美
「着替える？　服なの、それ？」

レン
「蟲使いの装束です。
　内側に幾つかの呪式印を縫い付けています」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It is a Bug User's garment.
 Several ritual seals have been sewn into the lining."

strings.text:
レン
「蟲との繋がりを強めるための、制服だと思っていた
　だければ結構です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Think of it as a uniform -- one that strengthens your bond with your Bug.
 That should be sufficient."

Yumemi
"Sorry. That means nothing to me."

strings.text:
レン
「まあ、実際に着てみたほうが早いでしょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Well, it will be faster to simply try it on."

strings.text:
レンの意図するところは分からないが、着替えができ
るのはありがたい。
strings.translated: She had no idea what Ren was getting at, but having a change of clothes was a welcome relief.

strings.text: 早速、隣の部屋に入って試着してみることにした。
strings.translated: She decided to step into the next room right away and try it on.

strings.text: 蟲使い装束、なるものを着てから程なく。
strings.translated: Shortly after putting on what was apparently a Bug User's garment --

strings.text:
夢美は自分の体を見回しては、低い唸り声を漏らして
いた。
strings.translated: Yumemi looked herself over and let out a low groan.

strings.text:
装束は全体的に黒を基調としており、色合い自体は
嫌いではない。
strings.translated: The outfit was predominantly black overall, and she did not dislike the color scheme itself.

strings.text: 肌触りも良いし、何よりサイズもピッタリだ。
strings.translated: The fabric felt nice against her skin, and above all, the size was a perfect fit.

strings.text:
何故、ピッタリのサイズを選ぶことができたのか、と
いう点については、今回は保留。
strings.translated: As for how he had managed to select exactly the right size -- that was a question she would set aside for now.

strings.text:
問題なのはそのデザインで、とても街中を歩けるよう
な代物ではない。
strings.translated: The problem was the design itself. It was not the sort of thing one could walk around town wearing.

strings.text:
夢美
「なんでお腹のところが開いてるのよぉ。
　半分おっぱいの下見えてるじゃない……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Why is the stomach part open like this?
You can practically see the bottom half of my chest..."

strings.text:
夢美
「スカートも短いしスリット入ってるしぃ～」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"The skirt is short AND it has a slit in it~"

strings.text: 裾をまくってみると、簡単に下着が見えた。
strings.translated: When she lifted the hem, her underwear was immediately visible.

strings.text: 履いているのは薄いピンクのショーツ、しかも自前だ。
strings.translated: What she had on underneath were light pink shorts -- her own, at that.

strings.text:
何故、こんな服を着なければならないのか甚だ疑問
ではあったが、レンの命令とあっては拒むわけにも
いかない。
strings.translated: She had serious doubts about why she had to wear something like this, but since it was Ren's order, she had no grounds to refuse.

strings.text:
左の二の腕に空っぽの蟲筒を装着して、準備完了だっ
た。
strings.translated: She strapped the empty Bug tube onto her left upper arm, and her preparations were complete.

strings.text:
倉庫の中央で待っていたレンが、部屋から出てきた
夢美に観察するような視線を送る。
strings.translated: Ren, who had been waiting in the center of the warehouse, cast an appraising look at Yumemi as she emerged from the room.

strings.text:
暫くして頷くと、「問題ないでしょう」と一言だけ
言った。
strings.translated: After a moment he gave a nod and said simply, "That should do."

strings.text:
レン
「そういえば一つ言い忘れていましたが、眠る場所を
　決めておいて下さい」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Oh, there was one thing I forgot to mention -- please decide where you will sleep."

strings.text:
レン
「この倉庫内であれば、どこでも構いませんので」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Anywhere inside this warehouse will do."

strings.text:
この部屋のソファーも、隣の部屋のベッドも、まとも
に寝られる状態ではない。
strings.translated:
Neither the sofa in this room nor the bed in the next room were in any condition
to sleep in properly.

strings.text:
清潔感だけを考えるなら、買ってきたばかりのビニー
ルシートの上が一番良いだろう。
strings.translated: If cleanliness alone were the concern, the top of the vinyl sheet they had just bought would probably be the best option.

strings.text:
ただ、そこで寝るとなると、硬い床に雑魚寝するのと
変わらないわけだが……。
strings.translated: Though sleeping there would be no different from lying on the hard floor...

strings.text:
夢美
「あ、そうだ。ここ、電気来てないでしょ？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Oh, right. There's no electricity here, is there?"

strings.text:
夢美
「夜になったら真っ暗になるんだけど、懐中電灯とか
　買っておいたほうが良くない？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Once it gets dark it'll be pitch black in here -- shouldn't we buy a flashlight or something?"

strings.text:
レン
「その手配なら先ほどしてきました。
　夜までには、電気と水が使えるはずです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I already arranged for that a little while ago.
By nightfall, you should be able to use electricity and water."

strings.text:
おそらく真っ当な方法ではないのだろうが、それを
追求したところで意味はない。
strings.translated: It was probably not accomplished through any legitimate means, but there was no point in pressing the matter.

strings.text:
それよりも電気と水が使えると聞いて、ここでの生活
がようやく現実味を帯びてきた気がした。
strings.translated: More than that, hearing that electricity and water would be available made the prospect of living here finally feel real.

strings.text:
夢美
「ね、シャワーは？　お湯は使えるの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Hey, what about a shower? Can we use hot water?"

strings.text:
レン
「いえ。使えるのはそこの水道水とトイレだけです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"No. All you have is the tap water over there and the toilet."

strings.text: レンが、倉庫の隅に備え付けられていた水道を指差す。
strings.translated: Ren pointed to the faucet installed in the corner of the warehouse.

strings.text:
夢美
「……要するに、手を洗うくらいならできるって事
　ね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"...So basically, I can wash my hands. That's about it."

strings.text:
夢美
「お風呂とかどうするつもり？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"What are we supposed to do about bathing?"

strings.text:
レン
「必要ですか？
　長く滞在しても二、三週間程度だと思いますが」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Is that necessary?
I expect we won't be staying longer than two or three weeks at most."

strings.text:
夢美
「三週間も居るなら要るでしょ、普通は……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"If we're here for three weeks, of course it's necessary -- normally speaking..."

strings.text: レンとの感覚のズレを感じて、夢美は額に手を当てた。
strings.translated: Sensing the gap between her and Ren's sensibilities, Yumemi pressed a hand to her forehead.

strings.text:
二人の生活スタイルには、男女という性別を差し引い
ても大きな開きがあるらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed the two of them had vastly different lifestyles -- and not simply because of the difference in gender.

strings.text: 蟲使いがどうだとか言う以前の問題だった。
strings.translated: That was a problem entirely separate from anything to do with Bug Users.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁ……水で我慢するしかないのね……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Haah... I guess I'll just have to make do with cold water..."

strings.text: 幸いにして季節は冬ではない。
strings.translated: Fortunately, it was not the middle of winter.

strings.text: 昼間であれば、水でも何とかなるかもしれなかった。
strings.translated: During the daytime, cold water might just be manageable.

strings.text: ……今日はもう、その時刻は過ぎてしまったが。
strings.translated: Not that it helped today -- that time had already passed.

strings.text:
夢美
「ま、とにかく、水と電気が使えるようになるのは
　いい事だし、掃除する身としても助かるわ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well, anyway, it's a good thing that we'll have water and electricity working again --
it'll make things a lot easier for me as the one doing the cleaning."

strings.text:
夢美
「床は一度、水で洗い流したほうがいいかなって思っ
　てたところだし」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I was thinking I should rinse down the floor with water at some point anyway."

strings.text:
レン
「随分綺麗にしているのですね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"You have tidied things up quite a bit."

strings.text:
レン
「埃の量がだいぶ減りました」
strings.translated:
Ren
"The amount of dust has decreased considerably."

strings.text:
夢美
「だってずっと箒で掃いてたし……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well, I was sweeping with the broom this whole time..."

strings.text:
レン
「寝る場所の確保だけで十分だと思っていたもので」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I thought simply securing a place to sleep would be sufficient."

strings.text:
夢美
「……それ、掃除って言わない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"...That's not what you'd call cleaning."

strings.text:
今後の生活がどうなるのかはともかく、レンとの感覚
の差を埋めるための課題は多そうだった……。
strings.translated: Whatever their future life here would look like, it seemed there were many hurdles ahead in bridging the gap between her and Ren's sensibilities...

strings.text: 夜になって、倉庫は真っ暗闇に包まれていた。
strings.translated: Night fell, and the warehouse was swallowed in complete darkness.

strings.text:
レンも夢美も寝る体勢をとってはいるが、時間的には
まだ休むには早い。
strings.translated:
Both Ren and Yumemi had settled into sleeping positions, but it was still
too early to actually rest.

strings.text:
暗くて何も見えないから、休む以外にする事がないの
だ。
strings.translated: It was too dark to see anything, leaving them with nothing to do but rest.

strings.text: 電気が来なかったわけではない。
strings.translated: It was not that the electricity had failed to come through.

strings.text:
蛍光灯が壊れていて、スイッチを押しても電気がつか
なかったのだ。
strings.translated: The fluorescent light was broken -- when they flipped the switch, nothing came on.

strings.text:
二人とも完全に陽が落ちてから気付いたが、その時に
はもう後の祭りだ。
strings.translated: Neither of them had noticed until the sun had fully set, and by then it was too late.

strings.text:
明日、レンが買いに行くことで納得し、今日はさっさ
と寝ることにした。
strings.translated: They agreed that Ren would go buy a replacement tomorrow, and decided to go to sleep early for the night.

strings.text:
幸いにして体は疲れ切っているため、睡魔はすぐに
襲ってきた。
strings.translated: Fortunately, their bodies were utterly exhausted, and sleep came for them quickly.

strings.text:
夢美
「これから色々大変になりそうだね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Things are going to get pretty rough from here on out, huh."

strings.text: 蟲を抱きながら、夢美はか細い声でつぶやいた。
strings.translated: Cradling the Bug against her chest, Yumemi murmured in a thin voice.

strings.text:
いつもはベッドの下で寝ているため、こうして胸に
抱くのは久しぶりだ。
strings.translated: It usually slept beneath her bed, so holding it like this -- close to her chest -- felt like something she hadn't done in a long time.

strings.text:
硬質な床はやや冷たかったが、今はその感触が気持ち
良かった。
strings.translated: The hard floor was slightly cold, but somehow that sensation felt pleasant right now.

strings.text:
夢美
「覚えてる？　ここ、アンタの産まれた場所だよ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Do you remember? This is the place where you were born."

strings.text: 胸を締める感情は、不思議と落ち着いていた。
strings.translated: The emotion squeezing at her chest was, strangely, calm.

strings.text:
夢美にとって悪夢の始まりであるこの場所を、あまり
抵抗なく受け入れていた。
strings.translated: She had accepted this place -- the very beginning of her nightmare -- with surprisingly little resistance.

strings.text:
おそらくは、何の説明もされず、突然連れて来られた
からだろう。
strings.translated: That was probably because she had been brought here suddenly, without any explanation.

strings.text:
倉庫に足を踏み入れて、そこで初めてこの場所を思い
出し、一度だけ恐怖に体を震わせて、すぐに平静を取
り戻した。
strings.translated: She had stepped into the warehouse, and only then remembered what this place was. She shuddered once with fear -- and then quickly regained her composure.

strings.text:
散々なまでに体を穢され続けた場所だが、悲鳴を上げ
て逃げ出すような醜態を晒すことはなかった。
strings.translated: It was a place where her body had been defiled again and again, yet she did not make a spectacle of herself by screaming and fleeing.

strings.text:
もしもこれが、ここに来る前に行き先を告げられてい
たらどうだろう。
strings.translated: But what if she had been told their destination before they arrived here?

strings.text:
それでも平静を保って、この薄汚れた床に立つことが
できただろうか。
strings.translated: Would she still have been able to keep her composure and stand on this grimy floor?

strings.text:
答えは分からなかったし、それを分かろうとも思わな
かった。
strings.translated: She didn't know the answer, and she had no desire to find out.

strings.text: しょせんは、「もしも」の話だ。
strings.translated: It was all just "what if," in the end.

strings.text:
考えたところで『今』は変わらないし、『これから』
に影響が出るわけでもない。
strings.translated: Thinking about it wouldn't change the "now," and it wouldn't affect what came "next."

strings.text:
蟲使いとしての道を歩き始めた以上、レンの言った通
り過去は捨てなければならない。
strings.translated: Having set foot on the path of a Bug User, she had to cast aside the past, just as Ren had said.

strings.text: 楽しかった事も……悲しかった事も………………。
strings.translated: The happy things... the sad things...............

strings.text: 不意に蟲の触手が、優しく夢美の頬を撫でた。
strings.translated: Suddenly, the Bug's tentacle gently brushed against Yumemi's cheek.

strings.text:
まるで涙を拭うように、目の下辺りを執拗に擦り付け
てくる。
strings.translated: As if wiping away tears, it rubbed persistently just beneath her eyes.

strings.text:
夢美
「大丈夫。ちゃんと自分の意思で決めたことだから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It's okay. I made this decision of my own free will."

strings.text:
夢美
「本当に蟲使いになるかどうかは分からないけど、
　アンタのことは、私が護ってあげるからね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I don't know yet if I'll truly become a Bug User, but I'll protect you -- I promise."

strings.text: 蟲使いの間から、特別視されている蟲。
strings.translated: A Bug regarded as special among Bug Users.

strings.text:
それでいて、五年前は「期待外れ」だと言われ捨てら
れた蟲。
strings.translated: And yet, five years ago, it had been called a disappointment and thrown away.

strings.text:
お世辞にも可愛いとは言えないし、犬猫のように愛嬌
のある仕草を見せるわけでもない。
strings.translated: It couldn't be called cute by any stretch of the imagination, nor did it show the endearing gestures of a dog or cat.

strings.text:
今でこそ慣れはしたが、触手はやや湿っていて、最初
の頃は頬を撫でられるのが気持ち悪かった。
strings.translated: She was used to it by now, but the tentacles were slightly damp, and in the beginning she had found it unpleasant when they brushed her cheek.

strings.text:
鳥肌が立ち、思わず顔を引いてしまった事が何度もあ
る。
strings.translated: There had been many times she had gotten goosebumps and instinctively pulled her face away.

strings.text:
だが、そのとき決まって、弱々しく触手を揺らす蟲が、
とても寂しそうに見えてしまったのだ。
strings.translated: But every time she did, the Bug would weakly sway its tentacles, and it always looked so terribly lonely.

strings.text: 誰からも求められず、親である夢美からも拒絶される。
strings.translated: Wanted by no one, rejected even by Yumemi, its own parent.

strings.text:
何十匹もいた兄弟達も全て死に、蟲はこの世のどこに
も居場所を持たなかった。
strings.translated: All of its dozens of siblings had died, and the Bug had no place to belong anywhere in this world.

strings.text:
胸に抱えられる程度の小さな存在が、世界の全てから
否定されていた。
strings.translated: A small creature that could be cradled in one's arms -- denied by everything in the world.

strings.text: その事に気付いた時、夢美は初めて思った。
strings.translated: When she realized that, a thought came to Yumemi for the very first time.

strings.text:
この蟲と自分との間に、果たしてどれだけの違いがあ
るというのか……。
strings.translated: Just how different were the two of them, really -- herself and this Bug...?
It didn't have to be much.

strings.text:
この広い世界において、たった一人と一匹がともに
暮らす場所くらい、あってもいいではないか。
strings.translated: In this wide world, surely there could be room for just one person and one Bug to live together.

strings.text:
どんなに否定されても、世界の片隅に居場所くらい
あってもいいではないか。
strings.translated: No matter how much they were denied, surely they deserved at least a small corner of the world to call their own.

strings.text:
たとえそれが、傷の舐め合いのようなものだったとし
ても、独りになるよりはずっとマシだった……。
strings.translated: Even if it was nothing more than two wounded creatures licking each other's wounds, it was far better than being alone...

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲使いの村ってところに行ったら、アンタと友達に
　なってくれるコもいるのかな？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I wonder -- if we go to this Bug User village, will there be anyone who'll be friends with you?"

strings.text: 蟲の背中を撫でながら、不意にそんな言葉が漏れた。
strings.translated: Stroking the Bug's back, those words slipped out of her before she knew it.

strings.text:
今まで考えたこともなかったが、もしかすると蟲は、
他の蟲と暮らしたほうが幸せなのだろうか。
strings.translated: She had never thought about it before, but perhaps the Bug would be happier living among other Bugs.

strings.text:
一日の大半を、誰もいないマンションの部屋で過ごす
ような生活よりも、蟲使いの村に行ったほうが、幸せ
に暮らすことができるのだろうか。
strings.translated: Rather than spending most of each day alone in an apartment with no one else around -- perhaps it could live more happily if it went to a Bug User's village.

strings.text:
ぼんやり考えていると、右手の指に触手が絡まってき
た。
strings.translated: As she drifted through these vague thoughts, a tentacle wound itself around the fingers of her right hand.

strings.text:
まるで、母親が子供の手を握るような、そんな仕草
だった……。
strings.translated: It was a gesture like a mother taking her child's hand...

strings.text:
夢美
「ありがと…………おやすみ………………」

蟲の背中をひと撫でして、夢美は静かにまぶたを閉じ
た……。
strings.translated: She gave the Bug's back one last stroke, and Yumemi quietly closed her eyes...

strings.text:
右腕を抱き締めるようにしながら、夢美はか細い声で
つぶやいた。
strings.translated: Holding her right arm as if embracing it, Yumemi murmured in a thin voice.

strings.text:
姿形は違っても、不思議とそこに蟲がいることを感じ
取ることができる。
strings.translated: Even though its shape and form were different, she could somehow sense the Bug's presence there.

strings.text:
硬質な床はやや冷たかったが、今はその感触が気持ち
良かった。
strings.translated: The hard floor was slightly cold, but somehow that sensation felt pleasant right now.

strings.text:
夢美
「覚えてる？　ここ、アンタの産まれた場所だよ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Do you remember? This is the place where you were born."

strings.text: 胸を締める感情は、不思議と落ち着いていた。
strings.translated: The emotion squeezing at her chest was, strangely, calm.

strings.text:
夢美にとって悪夢の始まりであるこの場所を、あまり
抵抗なく受け入れていた。
strings.translated: She had accepted this place -- the very beginning of her nightmare -- with surprisingly little resistance.

strings.text:
おそらくは、何の説明もされず、突然連れて来られた
からだろう。
strings.translated: That was probably because she had been brought here suddenly, without any explanation.

strings.text:
倉庫に足を踏み入れて、そこで初めてこの場所を思い
出し、一度だけ恐怖に体を震わせて、すぐに平静を取
り戻した。
strings.translated: She had stepped into the warehouse, and only then remembered what this place was. She shuddered once with fear -- and then quickly regained her composure.

strings.text:
散々なまでに体を穢され続けた場所だが、悲鳴を上げ
て逃げ出すような醜態を晒すことはなかった。
strings.translated: It was a place where her body had been defiled again and again, yet she did not make a spectacle of herself by screaming and fleeing.

strings.text:
もしもこれが、ここに来る前に行き先を告げられてい
たらどうだろう。
strings.translated: But what if she had been told their destination before they arrived here?

strings.text:
それでも平静を保って、この薄汚れた床に立つことが
できただろうか。
strings.translated: Would she still have been able to keep her composure and stand on this grimy floor?

strings.text:
答えは分からなかったし、それを分かろうとも思わな
かった。
strings.translated: She didn't know the answer, and she had no desire to find out.

strings.text: しょせんは、「もしも」の話だ。
strings.translated: It was all just "what if," in the end.

strings.text:
考えたところで『今』は変わらないし、『これから』
に影響が出るわけでもない。
strings.translated: Thinking about it wouldn't change the "now," and it wouldn't affect what came "next."

strings.text:
蟲使いとしての道を歩き始めた以上、レンの言った通
り過去は捨てなければならない。
strings.translated: Having set foot on the path of a Bug User, she had to cast aside the past, just as Ren had said.

strings.text: 楽しかった事も……悲しかった事も………………。
strings.translated: The happy things... the sad things...............

strings.text: 不意に右腕がぴくぴくと震えた。

まるで夢美を心配するような感情が、胸に染み込むよ
うにして伝わってくる。
strings.translated: An emotion that seemed almost like worry for Yumemi seeped into her chest, conveyed through that trembling.

strings.text:
夢美
「大丈夫。ちゃんと自分の意思で決めたことだから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It's okay. I made this decision of my own free will."

strings.text:
夢美
「本当に蟲使いになるかどうかは分からないけど、
　アンタのことは、私が護ってあげるからね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I don't know yet if I'll truly become a Bug User, but I'll protect you -- I promise."

strings.text: 蟲使いの間から、特別視されている蟲。
strings.translated: A Bug regarded as special among Bug Users.

strings.text:
それでいて、五年前は「期待外れ」だと言われ捨てら
れた蟲。
strings.translated: And yet, five years ago, it had been called a disappointment and thrown away.

strings.text:
お世辞にも可愛いとは言えないし、犬猫ほどに愛嬌の
ある仕草を見せるわけでもない。
strings.translated: One could hardly call it cute, and it showed none of the endearing gestures of a dog or cat.

strings.text:
今でこそ慣れはしたが、触手はやや湿っていて、最初
の頃は頬を撫でられるのが気持ち悪かった。
strings.translated: She was used to it by now, but the tentacles were slightly damp, and in the beginning she had found it unpleasant when they brushed her cheek.

strings.text:
鳥肌が立ち、思わず顔を引いてしまった事が何度もあ
る。
strings.translated: There had been many times she had gotten goosebumps and instinctively pulled her face away.

strings.text:
だが、そのとき決まって、弱々しく触手を揺らす蟲が、
とても寂しそうに見えてしまったのだ。
strings.translated: But every time she did, the Bug would weakly sway its tentacles, and it always looked so terribly lonely.

strings.text: 誰からも求められず、親である夢美からも拒絶される。
strings.translated: Wanted by no one, rejected even by Yumemi, its own parent.

strings.text:
何十匹もいた兄弟達も全て死に、蟲はこの世のどこに
も居場所を持たなかった。
strings.translated: All of its dozens of siblings had died, and the Bug had no place to belong anywhere in this world.

strings.text:
胸に抱えられる程度の小さな存在が、世界の全てから
否定されていた。
strings.translated: A small creature that could be cradled in one's arms -- denied by everything in the world.

strings.text: その事に気付いた時、夢美は初めて思った。
strings.translated: When she realized that, a thought came to Yumemi for the very first time.

strings.text:
この蟲と自分との間に、果たしてどれだけの違いがあ
るというのか……。
strings.translated: Just how different were the two of them, really -- herself and this Bug...?
It didn't have to be much.

strings.text:
この広い世界において、たった一人と一匹がともに
暮らす場所くらい、あってもいいではないか。
strings.translated: In this wide world, surely there could be room for just one person and one Bug to live together.

strings.text:
どんなに否定されても、世界の片隅に居場所くらい
あってもいいではないか。
strings.translated: No matter how much they were denied, surely they deserved at least a small corner of the world to call their own.

strings.text:
たとえそれが、傷の舐め合いのようなものだったとし
ても、独りになるよりはずっとマシだった……。
strings.translated: Even if it was nothing more than two wounded creatures licking each other's wounds, it was far better than being alone...

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲使いの村ってところに行ったら、アンタと友達に
　なってくれるコもいるのかな？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I wonder -- if we go to this Bug User village, will there be anyone who'll be friends with you?"

strings.text: 右腕を撫でながら、不意にそんな言葉が漏れた。
strings.translated: The words slipped out as she stroked her right arm.

strings.text:
今まで考えたこともなかったが、もしかすると蟲は、
他の蟲と暮らしたほうが幸せなのだろうか。
strings.translated: She had never thought about it before, but perhaps the Bug would be happier living among other Bugs.

strings.text:
一日の大半を、誰もいないマンションの部屋で過ごす
ような生活よりも、蟲使いの村に行ったほうが、幸せ
に暮らすことができるのだろうか。
strings.translated: Rather than spending most of each day alone in an apartment with no one else around -- perhaps it could live more happily if it went to a Bug User's village.

strings.text: ぼんやり考えていると、また右腕がぴくぴくと震えた。
strings.translated: As she drifted through these vague thoughts, her right arm twitched again.

strings.text:
まるで、夢美を励ますような、そんな動きに感じられ
た。
strings.translated: It felt like a movement meant to encourage her.

strings.text:
夢美
「ありがと…………おやすみ………………」

自分の右腕に励まされると言うのは奇妙な気分だった
が、嬉しいものは嬉しい。
