世の中には、こんな穢し方もあるのだなと、妙に遠い
ところにある意識で思いながら、肉体のほうが悲鳴を
上げ始める。
strings.translated: So there are ways to defile a person like this in this world, she thought, her consciousness drifting somewhere strangely far away, while her body began to scream.

strings.text:
唯
「げぼっ！　ぶ、ぐえぇぇぇっ！！！」

粘り気のある濁った色の液体が、ゴボゴボと唯の口か
ら溢れ出る。
strings.translated: A viscous, murky liquid gurgled and overflowed from Yui's mouth.

strings.text:
呼吸は完全に止まり、誰が見ても危険と分かる状況に
陥っていた。
strings.translated: Her breathing had stopped entirely, and she had fallen into a state that anyone could see was critical.

strings.text:
美弥香
「本当なのっ！　本当にもう何も知らないのっ！！」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"It's the truth! I really don't know anything else!!"

strings.text:
どうやら、レンに説明を終えたらしい美弥香が、必死
の形相で叫んでいる。
strings.translated: Miyaka, who appeared to have finished explaining things to Ren, was screaming with a look of desperate anguish.

strings.text:
しかしもう、唯にはその姿を見ることも、声を聞くこ
ともできなかった。
strings.translated: But by now, Yui could neither see her nor hear her voice.
Only, at the very last moment -- -- -- --

strings.text:
美弥香
「早くっ！　唯がっ、唯が死んじゃうぅっ！！！」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Hurry! Yui is -- Yui is going to die!!!"

strings.text: 美弥香だけは、無事でありますようにと――――
strings.translated: Please let Miyaka, at least, be safe -- -- -- --

strings.text:
美弥香
「お願いだから唯を助けてっ！！！」

唯
「ぐぶげええぇええぇえええぇぇぇーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーーーーっ！！！！」

美弥香
「いぃぃやあぁああぁぁぁーーーーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーーっ！！！！」

口、そして鼻から液状の蟲を噴き出して、ぐるんっと
唯の目が反転する。
strings.translated: Liquid Bugs erupted from her mouth and then her nose, and Yui's eyes rolled back in her head.

strings.text:
唯
「ぶぎゃああああああああああああああああああああ
　あああああああああああああああああああああああ
　あああああああああああああああああっ！！！！」

まるで、喉の奥で破裂したかのような勢いで、液状の
蟲が噴き出した。
strings.translated: With a force as though something had burst deep in her throat, liquid Bugs came spraying out.

strings.text:
何かの例えではなく、文字通り唯の口から蟲が噴き出
した。
strings.translated: This was no figure of speech -- Bugs literally erupted from Yui's mouth.

strings.text:
そして、その強烈な刺激に反応した肉体からも、膣内
の体液や直腸に残っていた蟲の一部がひねり出されて
いた。
strings.translated: And responding to that violent stimulus, her body too expelled fluids from her vagina, along with some of the Bugs that had remained in her rectum.

strings.text:
美弥香
「あ、あぁ……あぁああぁぁ……………………」

幼馴染が迎えた壮絶な末路に、美弥香はもう言葉も
出なかった。
strings.translated: Faced with the devastating end her childhood friend had met, Miyaka could no longer find any words.

strings.text:
あまりのショックに涙もすっかり乾いてしまい、小刻
みに体を震わせるのが精一杯だ。
strings.translated: The shock was so overwhelming that even her tears had dried up completely, and all she could manage was to tremble in small, fitful shudders.

strings.text:
レン
「その様子だと、どうやら本当に全てを話していただ
　けたようですね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Judging by that reaction, it seems you truly did tell us everything."

strings.text:
レン
「彼女の拷問は、ここまでにしておきましょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"We'll leave her torture at that."

strings.text:
無感情に言って、レンが唯の体から蟲を引き上げさせ
る。
strings.translated: He said it without emotion, and Ren had the Bugs withdraw from Yui's body.

strings.text:
だが、そこに残っていたのは、もはや手遅れとしか
言いようのない、瀕死の唯の姿だけだった……。
strings.translated: But what remained there was nothing but the sight of Yui, half-dead, in a state that could only be called beyond saving......

strings.text:
レン
「さて、念のためもう一度説明してもらえますか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Now then, would you mind explaining it all to me once more, just to be sure?"

strings.text:
凌辱された唯を天井に吊るしたまま、レンは相変わら
ずパイプ椅子に座って美弥香に話しかけた。
strings.translated: Leaving the violated Yui hanging from the ceiling, Ren sat in his folding chair as before and addressed Miyaka.

strings.text:
レン
「お友達の……名前は、確か…………」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Your friend's... name, if I recall... ..."

strings.text:
美弥香
「ユーリア……アレクセエヴナ・ベラーヤ…………」

美弥香
「私と知り合う前から、その研究員の助手をしていて、
　たぶん貴方の知りたいことも、彼女のほうが知って
　います」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"She had been working as that researcher's assistant even before she met me,
 and she probably knows more about what you want to know
 than I do."

strings.text:
レン
「彼女と連絡は取れますか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Can you get in contact with her?"

strings.text:
美弥香
「携帯電話の……番号なら…………」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Her cell phone... number, I have..............."

strings.text: 口調は穏やかだが、拒否を許さぬ命令。
strings.translated: His tone was gentle, but it was a command that permitted no refusal.

strings.text:
暫く躊躇った様子を見せたあと、美弥香はその番号を
口にした……。
strings.translated: After a moment's visible hesitation, Miyaka spoke the number aloud......

strings.text:
レンが倉庫を出て行ったあと、夢美は天井から吊るさ
れていた唯を床に下ろしていた。
strings.translated: After Ren had left the warehouse, Yumemi had lowered Yui from where she hung on the ceiling down to the floor.

strings.text:
粘着質の体液が手のひらに付着したが、そんなものを
気にしているだけの余裕はない。
strings.translated: The viscous bodily fluid clung to her palms, but she had no room to spare worrying about such things.

strings.text:
触手が襲って来ないかと不安ではあったものの、幸い
してそれは杞憂に終わった。
strings.translated: She was anxious that the tentacles might attack, but fortunately that fear proved unfounded.

strings.text:
唯を埃まみれの床に寝かせて、夢美は涙声になりなが
ら呟いた。
strings.translated: Laying Yui down on the dust-covered floor, Yumemi murmured through a voice on the verge of tears.

strings.text:
夢美
「こんな……酷いこと、するなんて…………」
カタカタと全身が震える。

まぶたの裏側が熱くなって、堪えようとしても嗚咽が
止まらなかった。
strings.translated: The backs of her eyelids grew hot, and no matter how hard she tried to hold it in, the sobbing wouldn't stop.

strings.text:
唯がどんな凌辱を受けたのか、夢美は直接見てはいな
い。
strings.translated: Yumemi did not witness directly what violation Yui had been subjected to.

strings.text:
どんな蟲で何をされ、そしてどういう結末に至ったの
か、それを実際に目で見たわけではない。
strings.translated: She had not seen with her own eyes what Bugs were used, what was done, or what end result had been reached.

strings.text: だが、容易に想像はついた。
strings.translated: But she could easily imagine it.

strings.text:
唯の肉体が生々しく伝えてくれる傷痕と、ドア越しに
聞こえていた獣のような絶叫が、レンのしたことを確
かな形をもってイメージさせていた。
strings.translated: The raw wounds that Yui's body conveyed so vividly, and the beast-like screaming that had filtered through the door -- together they painted a clear and certain picture of what Ren had done.

strings.text:
怒りや憎しみ、そして後悔といった感情が、夢美の
胸の奥を渦巻く。
strings.translated: Anger, hatred, and regret swirled together in the depths of Yumemi's chest.

strings.text:
蟲使いがどんな存在か知っていたはずなのに、それを
止めることができなかった。
strings.translated: She had known what kind of beings Bug Users were -- and yet she had been unable to stop it.

strings.text:
唯がこれから恥辱と屈辱を味わうと分かっていたのに、
自分の身可愛さに部屋を出てしまった。
strings.translated: She had known that Yui was about to be subjected to shame and humiliation, and yet she had left the room out of concern for her own safety.

strings.text:
その時、既に自分が堕ちるところまで堕ちていたこと
を、夢美はハッキリと理解した。
strings.translated: In that moment, Yumemi understood with stark clarity that she had already fallen as far as one could fall.

strings.text: 一体、自分は何をやっているのか。
strings.translated: What on earth was she doing?

strings.text:
蟲使いという一族がどんな存在か、五年前から知って
いたはずなのに、何故そんなものになろうなどと一度
でも思ってしまったのか…………。
strings.translated: She had known since five years ago what kind of beings the Bug User clan were -- so why had she ever, even once, thought of becoming one of them...?

strings.text:
疑問と後悔がない交ぜになって、夢美の思考をさらに
掻き乱した。
strings.translated: Doubt and regret tangled together, throwing Yumemi's thoughts into further disarray.

strings.text:
美弥香
「唯に……触れないで下さい……」

ベッドの上で俯いていた美弥香が、真っ赤に腫らした
目で夢美に視線を送っていた。
strings.translated: Miyaka, who had been sitting hunched over on the bed, turned her swollen red eyes toward Yumemi.

strings.text:
美弥香
「下ろしてくれた事には感謝します」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"I am grateful that you brought her down."

strings.text:
美弥香
「でも、これ以上は唯に触れないで下さい」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"But please -- don't touch Yui any further."

strings.text: 夢美に向けられる、純粋な怒り。

美弥香の立場からすれば、夢美も十分に蟲使いなのだ
から当然だ。
strings.translated: From Miyaka's perspective, Yumemi was every bit as much a Bug User -- so of course she felt that way.

strings.text:
後悔などする資格さえないのだと、否応なく悟らされ
た。
strings.translated: It was made painfully clear to her that she didn't even have the right to feel regret.

strings.text:
夢美
「あの……なにか、拭く物、持ってきますから……
　それで…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Um... I'll go get something to wipe her down with...
 and then..."

strings.text:
美弥香は一瞬何か言いかけたが、確かに拭く物は必要
だと判断したのか、拒否する事はなかった。
strings.translated: Miyaka seemed about to say something for a moment, but apparently decided that yes, something to wipe with was indeed necessary -- and so she did not refuse.

strings.text:
その後、夢美は薄汚れた雑巾を届け、拭く物がそれし
かなかったことを侘び、刺すような美弥香の視線から
逃げるように部屋を後にした……。
strings.translated: After that, Yumemi brought a grimy rag, apologized that it was the only thing available to wipe with, and then left the room as if fleeing from Miyaka's piercing gaze...

strings.text:
突然部屋に入るなり、夢美が薄いベージュのコートを
美弥香に突き出した。
strings.translated: Yumemi had burst into the room and thrust a thin beige coat at Miyaka without preamble.

strings.text: まだ買ってきたばかりの、真新しいロングコートだ。
strings.translated: It was a brand-new long coat, just purchased.

strings.text:
だが、美弥香のほうはワケが分からず、目を丸くして
体を硬直させてしまう。
strings.translated: But Miyaka couldn't make sense of it, and froze with her eyes wide.

strings.text:
反射的に受け取ってしまったコートと夢美を、交互に
見比べていた。
strings.translated: She glanced back and forth between the coat she had reflexively taken and Yumemi.

strings.text:
夢美
「やっぱり……こんなの…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I just can't... something like this..."

strings.text:
夢美の視線が、今はベッドに寝かされている唯に向け
られる。
strings.translated: Yumemi's gaze turned toward Yui, who was now lying on the bed.

strings.text:
蟲の体液はだいぶ拭き取られているが、いまだベッタ
リと濡れた髪の毛が、凌辱の荒々しさを物語っていた。
strings.translated: Most of the Bug fluid had been wiped away, but her hair still clung wetly in matted strands, telling the story of how brutal the violation had been.

strings.text:
美弥香
「どういうつもりですか？」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"What do you think you're doing?"

strings.text:
夢美
「許して……もらおうとは思ってません」

夢美
「でも、あなた達を逃がしたいのは本当なんです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But I truly do want to help you both escape."

strings.text:
美弥香は暫く考えた様子を見せたが、やがて受け取っ
たロングコートを唯に着させ始めた。
strings.translated: Miyaka appeared to think it over for a moment, then at last began putting the long coat on Yui.

strings.text: 今は逃げるのが最優先だと判断したらしい。
strings.translated: She seemed to have decided that escaping was the top priority for now.

strings.text:
二人で協力して唯にコートを着させ、すぐに倉庫から
逃げ出した。
strings.translated: The two of them worked together to get the coat on Yui, then immediately fled the warehouse.

strings.text:
ざくざくと枯れ木を踏み締めながら、夢美と美弥香、
そして美弥香におぶられた唯が、森の中を進んでいる。
strings.translated: Crunching over dead branches underfoot, Yumemi, Miyaka, and Yui -- carried on Miyaka's back -- made their way through the forest.

strings.text:
とても道とは言えない砂と泥の混ざった地面を、転ば
ないように慎重に歩いている。
strings.translated: They walked carefully over ground that was a mix of sand and mud, barely deserving to be called a path, taking care not to stumble.

strings.text: 会話らしい会話はない。
strings.translated: There was no real conversation between them.

strings.text:
小刻みに美弥香の吐息が聞こえるだけで、あとは森に
棲む鳥達の鳴き声がこだましていた。
strings.translated: Only Miyaka's labored breathing could be heard at short intervals; beyond that, the calls of birds living in the forest echoed all around.

strings.text:
夢美
「そこ、段差になってます」
先行する夢美が、足場の悪い部分を美弥香に伝える。
strings.translated: Yumemi, leading the way, warned Miyaka about the uneven footing ahead.

strings.text:
何度か行き来しているため、それなりに歩きやすい
場所は覚えていた。
strings.translated: Having passed through several times before, she had a decent sense of where the easier paths were.

strings.text:
美弥香も返事こそしないものの、夢美の注意した場所
を見つめながら、そこを迂回するようにして歩いてい
る。
strings.translated: Miyaka said nothing in reply, but kept her eyes fixed on the spot Yumemi had warned her about and walked around it.

strings.text:
額にはじっとりと汗が浮かび、流れた雫が頬を伝って
顎へと落ちていた。
strings.translated: A sheen of sweat had formed on her brow, and droplets ran down her cheeks to fall from her chin.

strings.text:
夢美
「そこを降りれば、だいぶ歩きやすくなりますから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Once you get down from there, it'll be much easier going."

strings.text:
傾斜が急な地面を滑るようにして降り、夢美は後ろを
振り返った。
strings.translated: Yumemi slid down the steep slope and turned to look back.

strings.text:
美弥香も、ちょうどその場所を降りようとしていた
が――――
strings.translated: Miyaka was just about to descend that same spot -- but then --

strings.text:
――唯を背負っていた分重かったためか、ずずずっと
地面が沈みバランスを崩してしまった。
strings.translated: Perhaps because of the added weight of carrying Yui on her back, her feet sank into the ground with a sliding lurch, and she lost her balance.

strings.text:
急いで駆け寄った夢美が、手を伸ばして美弥香の体を
支える。
strings.translated: Yumemi rushed over in a hurry and reached out to support Miyaka's body.

strings.text:
結果、美弥香は転倒そのものは免れ、無事幅の広い道
に降り立つことができた。
strings.translated: As a result, Miyaka managed to avoid falling outright, and safely made it down onto the wider path below.

strings.text:
美弥香
「……ありがとう、ございます」

ぎこちなくはあるが、美弥香の口から謝意が述べられ
る。
strings.translated: Stilted as it was, Miyaka offered her thanks aloud.

strings.text:
夢美は、それだけで胸が熱くなってしまい、思わず涙
が零れそうになるのをぐっと堪えた。
strings.translated: That alone was enough to make Yumemi's chest ache with warmth, and she had to fight hard to keep the tears from spilling over.

strings.text:
夢美
「ここまで来れば、大丈夫だと思います」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I think we'll be all right from here."

strings.text:
三十分ほどかけて街まで降りてきて、夢美はホッと胸
を撫で下ろした。
strings.translated: After spending about thirty minutes making their way down into town, Yumemi let out a sigh of relief.

strings.text:
レンがいなくとも、何らかの蟲の妨害があるのではと
心配していただけに、思わず口元に笑みが浮かんでし
まう。
strings.translated: She had been worried that even without Ren, there might be some kind of Bug interference -- so she couldn't help but let a smile cross her lips.

strings.text:
人通りはそれなりに多かったが、誰も唯のコートの下
が裸だとは気付いていないようだった。
strings.translated: There were quite a few people about, but no one seemed to notice that Yui was naked beneath her coat.

strings.text: 夢美が、自分の使っている携帯電話を差し出す。
strings.translated: Yumemi held out her own cell phone.

strings.text:
果たして、美弥香が使ってくれるかどうか不安だった
が、意外にもすんなりと受け取ってもらう事ができた。
strings.translated: She had been anxious about whether Miyaka would accept it, but to her surprise, it was taken without any fuss.

strings.text:
美弥香がどこかに連絡し、場所を人目の付かない区画
に移動してから十分後――――。
strings.translated: Miyaka contacted someone, they moved to a less conspicuous part of the area, and ten minutes later ----

strings.text:
小さなビルの前に一台の自動車が停まったのを確認し
て、美弥香が短く「あれです」と言った。
strings.translated: A single car pulled up in front of a small building, and Miyaka said simply, "That's them."

strings.text: 白い車体の、全体的に丸みを帯びた軽自動車。
strings.translated: A white compact car with rounded lines all over.

strings.text:
運転席に乗っているのは女性のようで、しきりに車内
から辺りを見回していた。
strings.translated: The driver appeared to be a woman, who kept glancing around from inside the vehicle.

strings.text:
美弥香
「私達はもう大丈夫です。
　ここまで、ありがとうございました」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"We'll be fine from here.
 Thank you so much for everything."

strings.text: 会釈をして、美弥香が自動車のほうへ歩いていく。
strings.translated: With a small bow, Miyaka walked toward the car.

strings.text:
――と、途中で足を止めて振り返り、複雑そうな表情
で夢美を見つめた。
strings.translated: But -- partway there, she stopped and turned back, fixing Yumemi with a complicated expression.

strings.text:
美弥香
「貴女はまた、彼の元へ戻るのですか？」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Are you going back to him?"

strings.text:
ほんの僅かな間だけ言葉に詰まり、そして微かに笑み
を浮かべながら首を横に振る。
strings.translated: She faltered for just a brief moment, then gave a faint smile and shook her head.

strings.text:
夢美
「ちょっと用事ができちゃったんで」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Something's come up that I need to take care of."

Yumemi
"Yes, something I need to do."

strings.text:
笑うべきかどうか迷ったが、結局口元に笑みを浮かべ
て夢美はうなずいた。
strings.translated: She wasn't sure whether to laugh, but in the end a smile came to her lips and Yumemi nodded.

strings.text:
それは、美弥香と唯を逃がすと決めたときから、夢美
の胸の奥で考えていたこと。
strings.translated: It was something Yumemi had been turning over in the back of her mind ever since she decided to let Miyaka and Yui escape.

strings.text:
今の時点で、レンのそばにいて不自然ではない自分に
しかできないこと。
strings.translated: Something that only she -- someone who could be at Ren's side without raising suspicion -- could do at this point.

strings.text:
かつて自分自身を犯した蟲使いをそうしたように、
今度はレンをそうするしかなかった。
strings.translated: Just as she had done to the Bug User who had once violated her, she would have to do the same to Ren now.

strings.text:
美弥香
「分かりました。お気をつけて……」

夢美のこれからを察したのか、美弥香がそう言って
再び背を向ける。
strings.translated: Perhaps sensing what lay ahead for Yumemi, Miyaka said that and turned away once more.

strings.text:
そして、路上に停止していた自動車に乗り込むと、
あっという間にその場から走り去って行った。
strings.translated: Then she climbed into the car that had been waiting at the roadside, and it sped away in an instant.

strings.text:
無事、美弥香と唯を逃がせたことに、夢美はひとまず
安堵した。
strings.translated: For now, Yumemi felt a wave of relief that she had safely gotten Miyaka and Yui away.

strings.text:
この程度で償いになったとは思っていないが、少なく
とも二人が危地を脱したことを嬉しく思った。
strings.translated: She didn't think this was nearly enough to make amends, but she was glad, at least, that the two of them had escaped danger.

strings.text: あとは――自分次第だった――――。
strings.translated: The rest -- was up to her.

strings.text:
誰もいない倉庫の隅で、夢美は膝を抱えながら夜を
迎えていた。
strings.translated: In the corner of an empty warehouse, Yumemi sat hugging her knees as night closed in around her.

strings.text:
辺りには肌寒い空気が漂い、じっとしていると思わず
体が震えてしまう。
strings.translated: A chilly air hung over everything, and if she stayed still too long, her body would begin to tremble.

strings.text:
夢美の傍らには一本の包丁が用意されていて、その刃
はあちこちがボロボロに欠けていた。
strings.translated: Beside Yumemi lay a single kitchen knife, its blade chipped and ragged in places.

strings.text:
この倉庫内で見つけたのだが、かなり古い物らしく、
錆びも酷くて、とても本来の用途では使えそうもない。
strings.translated: She had found it somewhere in the warehouse, but it seemed quite old -- badly rusted, and clearly unfit for any normal use.

strings.text: 使い道があるとすれば、それは殆ど限られていた。
strings.translated: If it was good for anything at all, there were very few things it could be used for.

strings.text: そう、たとえば――五年前のあの時のように――――。
strings.translated: Yes -- for instance, just like that time five years ago.

strings.text: 溜息をつくと、白い息が一瞬だけ舞った。
strings.translated: She let out a sigh, and a puff of white breath hung in the air for just a moment.

strings.text:
今夜はかなり冷え込んでいるようで、明日には雪でも
降っているのではないかとさえ思えた。
strings.translated: Tonight was bitterly cold -- cold enough that she half expected snow by morning.

strings.text: レンはまだ帰って来ない。

仕事が長引いているのか、それとも何かアクシデント
でもあったのか。
strings.translated: Whether his business was running long, or whether something had gone wrong.

strings.text:
心配はするが、無事帰って来てほしいという気持ちは
薄い。
strings.translated: She worried, but the feeling that she wanted him to come back safely was thin.

strings.text:
むしろ、このままレンが帰って来なければ、これから
自分はどうなるのだろうと、そっちのほうを考えてし
まう。
strings.translated: Rather, she found herself thinking about what would become of her if Ren never came back at all.

strings.text:
このまま蟲使いから解放されるのか、それとも別の
蟲使いの管理下に置かれるのか。
strings.translated: Would she be freed from the Bug Users like this, or would she be placed under the control of another?

strings.text:
無意識のうちに右腕を撫でると、蟲がぴくっと応えた
ような気がした。
strings.translated: Without thinking, she stroked her right arm, and she felt the Bug twitch in response.

strings.text:
突然の物音に顔を上げると、扉を開けてレンが帰って
来た。
strings.translated: She looked up at a sudden noise, and the door swung open -- Ren had returned.

strings.text:
ふらふらとした足取りで、全身から血を滴らせながら
ソファーのほうに歩み寄っていく。
strings.translated: He staggered forward on unsteady feet, blood dripping from his entire body, making his way toward the sofa.

strings.text: 顔は平然としているが顔色は悪い。
strings.translated: His expression was calm, but his complexion was ashen.

strings.text: 明らかに出血が酷いと分かる状態だった。
strings.translated: It was plain to see that he was bleeding badly.

strings.text: 思わずその場から立ち上がり、レンのほうに駆け寄る。
strings.translated: She couldn't help but spring to her feet and rush to Ren's side.

strings.text:
肩を貸してソファーのところまで支えると、ゆっくり
と仰向けに寝かせた。
strings.translated: She lent him her shoulder and helped him to the sofa, then slowly laid him down on his back.

strings.text: レンの全身には、細かな傷が幾つも刻まれていた。
strings.translated: Ren's body was covered in countless small cuts.

strings.text:
大半は切り傷だが、中には肉が抉れたような崩れ方を
している部分もある。
strings.translated: Most were slash wounds, but some areas had caved in as though the flesh had been gouged out.

strings.text:
何があったのかは定かでないが、芳しい成果を上げて
きたわけではないようだ。
strings.translated: Whatever had happened was unclear, but it was obvious he hadn't come back with favorable results.

strings.text:
レン
「逃げる準備をして下さい。
　いずれ追っ手がやって来ます」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Prepare to flee.
Pursuers will be coming before long."

strings.text:
レン
「多少の時間稼ぎはしていますが、あまり長くはもた
　ないでしょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I've bought us some time, but it won't last long."

strings.text:
レンの言葉は静かだったが、その中には確かな焦りが
感じられた。
strings.translated: Ren's voice was quiet, but there was unmistakable urgency beneath it.

strings.text: どうやら本当に危険が迫っているらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed the danger was truly closing in.

strings.text: レンとともに逃げるのか、それとも――――――――
strings.translated: Would she flee together with Ren, or would she ----------------

strings.text: 夢美は、決断しなければならなかった……。
strings.translated: Yumemi had to make a decision...

strings.text:
殆ど視界の利かない森は、夢美が想像していた以上に
危険な場所だった。
strings.translated: The forest, where visibility was almost nonexistent, was a far more dangerous place than Yumemi had imagined.

strings.text:
濃密な闇は木々の輪郭さえ失わせ、目の前にある地面
が上がっているのか下がっているのかさえ分からない。
strings.translated: The dense darkness swallowed even the outlines of the trees, leaving her unable to tell whether the ground ahead was rising or falling.

strings.text:
木漏れ日のように差し込んでくる月明かりが、辛うじ
て間近のものを見せてくれたが、歩くのは殆ど手探り
状態だった。
strings.translated: Moonlight filtered through like rays between leaves, barely illuminating what was directly in front of her, but walking was almost entirely a matter of feeling her way forward.

strings.text: レンに肩を貸して歩くこと三十分。
strings.translated: Thirty minutes of walking with him leaning on her shoulder.

strings.text:
――いや、命の限界が近いのか、レンの足取りに力は
ない。
strings.translated: -- no, the limits of his life were near; Ren's steps had no strength left in them.

strings.text:
逃げるにしても行き先さえ聞いていないため、単に
あの倉庫から離れているだけだった。
strings.translated: Even as they fled, she hadn't been told where they were going, so they were simply putting distance between themselves and the warehouse.

strings.text: レンが足を滑らせ、夢美に全ての体重が掛かった。
strings.translated: Ren's foot slipped, and his full weight came down on Yumemi.

strings.text:
反射的に足は踏ん張ったものの、支え切ることができ
ず倒れ込んでしまう。
strings.translated: She braced her legs on instinct, but couldn't hold him up, and they both went down.

strings.text:
緩やかな勾配の坂道で、夢美はレンに覆い被されるよ
うな形になってしまった。
strings.translated: On a gently sloping incline, Yumemi ended up with Ren collapsed on top of her.

strings.text:
レン
「どうやら、ここまでのようですね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It seems this is as far as I go."

strings.text:
レン
「血が足りなくなってきたようです。
　もう、あまり前が見えません」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I'm running out of blood.
I can barely see what's in front of me anymore."

strings.text:
レン
「蟲の準備を怠りました」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I neglected to prepare my Bug."

strings.text:
闇夜で顔はよく見えないが、レンの息遣いが弱まって
いくのが感じられる。
strings.translated: His face was hidden in the darkness of the night, but she could feel his breathing growing weaker.

strings.text:
夢美はどうすればいいのか分からず、自分の体や手の
ひらに感じる生温い感触に、おろおろするばかりだっ
た。
strings.translated: Yumemi had no idea what to do, and she could only panic at the lukewarm sensation she felt against her body and the palms of her hands.

strings.text:
レン
「夢美さん、貴女はこのまま逃げて下さい。
　駅の東口の改札前で、一族の人間が待っています」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Yumemi-san, please run on without me.
Someone from the clan is waiting at the east exit of the station, in front of the ticket gate."

strings.text:
レン
「相手は貴女の顔を知っているので、おそらく接触し
　てくるでしょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"She knows your face, so she will most likely make contact with you."

strings.text:
夢美
「そんな……み、見捨てて行けって言うの！？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"You can't be serious... you're telling me to abandon you and go!?"

strings.text:
レン
「このまま連れて行かれても同じことです。
　僕の体はもう保ちません」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It makes no difference if you drag me along.
My body won't hold out."

strings.text:
まるで他人事のように言うレンに、かえって夢美のほ
うが焦ってしまう。
strings.translated: Ren spoke as though it were someone else's problem entirely, and that only made Yumemi more frantic.

strings.text:
まだ、何かできることがあるのではないかと、レンを
助ける方法があるのではないかと、持っている知識の
全てを総動員して考えた。
strings.translated: She racked every piece of knowledge she had, wondering if there was still something she could do, some way she could save him.

strings.text: レンの口から、どろりとした体液が吐き出された。
strings.translated: A thick, viscous fluid spilled from Ren's mouth.

strings.text: 暗闇に遮られていてもハッキリと分かる血の感触……。
strings.translated: The feel of blood -- unmistakable even through the darkness that obscured everything...

strings.text:
もう本当に体が保たないところまできているのだと、
夢美は否応なく理解する事ができる。
strings.translated: Yumemi could not help but understand that his body had truly reached the point where it could no longer hold on.

strings.text:
まるで風船が萎むように、レンの声が小さくなってい
く。
strings.translated: Like a balloon slowly deflating, Ren's voice grew smaller and smaller.

strings.text: 夢美の体に覆い被さったまま、死に至ろうとしている。
strings.translated: Still draped over Yumemi's body, he was drifting toward death.

strings.text:
それは、おそらく、もう、どう頑張っても変えられな
い決定された事項なのだ。
strings.translated: That was, most likely, an already-decided fact -- one that could no longer be changed no matter how hard anyone tried.

strings.text:
今から急いで森を出て、レンを病院に連れて行っても、
そこまではもう体が保たないのだ。
strings.translated: Even if she rushed out of the forest right now and brought Ren to a hospital, his body would not hold out long enough to get there.

strings.text:
この先、自分が生き延びることだけを考えるなら、
レンの言葉に従うべきだった。
strings.translated: If she thought only of surviving from this point on, she ought to do as Ren said.

strings.text:
レンの体をここに置いて、自分は駅に向かうべきだっ
た。
strings.translated: She ought to leave Ren's body here and head for the station herself.

strings.text:
だが、その決断を下せないうちに、レンがふと何かに
気付いたように体を起こす。
strings.translated: But before she could bring herself to make that decision, Ren suddenly raised himself up as though he had noticed something.

strings.text: 立ち上がってきびすを返し、その視線の先に――――
strings.translated: He stood and turned on his heel, his gaze falling upon ----

strings.text: ――一人の少女を映し出していた。
strings.translated: -- a single girl, reflected in his line of sight.

strings.text:
照度を増した月明かりの中で、冷たい声が紡ぎ出され
る。
strings.translated: In the brightening moonlight, a cold voice rang out.

strings.text:
満身創痍でありながらも立ち上がったレンに対し、
何の躊躇いもなく走り込み、そして――――
strings.translated: Without a moment's hesitation, she charged at Ren -- who had risen to his feet despite being battered and broken -- and then ----

strings.text:
ユーリアの右手に仕込んだナイフが一閃し、レンの
首を裂いた。
strings.translated: The knife concealed in Yulia's right hand flashed -- and slashed open Ren's throat.

strings.text:
頚動脈の辺りから、面白いくらいの勢いで血が噴き出
す。
strings.translated: From somewhere near the carotid artery, blood sprayed out with almost absurd force.

strings.text:
レンの体が一度だけビクンッと震えたが、それが最期
の反応だった。
strings.translated: Ren's body shuddered once -- and that was his final response.

strings.text:
膝から崩れ落ちるようにして、レンがうつ伏せに倒れ
る。
strings.translated: As though his knees simply gave way beneath him, Ren collapsed face-down onto the ground.

strings.text:
切られた首からは、ドクドクと血が流れ出しているよ
うで、死に至るのは決定的だ。
strings.translated: Blood poured steadily from the cut at his throat -- his death was certain.

strings.text:
そして、それを理解しているからこそ、ユーリアの
視線は既に夢美へと向けられていた。
strings.translated: And because she understood that, Yulia's gaze had already shifted to Yumemi.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「その姿……貴女も蟲使いですね？」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"That appearance... you're a Bug User as well, aren't you?"

strings.text:
ユーリア
「櫻井夢美さんですか？」

突然名前を呼ばれ、夢美はぽかんとした表情を浮かべ
た。
strings.translated: Her name called out so suddenly, Yumemi's face went blank with bewilderment.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「美弥香さんからお話は聞いています。
　二人を助けていただき、ありがとうございました」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Miyaka-san told me about you.
 Thank you for helping those two."

strings.text:
どうやら、美弥香と唯は無事帰り着くことができたら
しい。
strings.translated: It seemed that Miyaka and Yui had managed to make it back safely.

strings.text: そこから、ユーリアに夢美のことが伝わったのだろう。
strings.translated: From there, word of Yumemi must have reached Yulia.

strings.text:
自分の身の危険が去ったわけでもないのに、夢美は
少しだけホッとしてしまった。
strings.translated: Even though the danger to herself had not yet passed, Yumemi felt just a small measure of relief.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「貴女は、彼を裏切ったのですか？」

倒れたレンを見つめながら、ユーリアが冷たい声で
訊いた。
strings.translated: Gazing down at the fallen Ren, Yulia asked in a cold voice.

strings.text:
夢美
「う、裏切ったっていうか……あれは、酷すぎるって
　思ったから…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"B-betray... I mean, it wasn't exactly that... I just thought what was happening was too cruel..."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「そうですね。
　佐々原さんはとても酷い状態でした」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"I see.
 Sasahara-san was in a terrible state."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「命に別状はありませんが、心には深い傷を……一生
　消えることのない傷を負ったでしょう」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Her life is not in danger, but the wound left on her heart... it is a wound she will carry for the rest of her life."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「ですが……もし、貴女と遭遇しても、貴女のことは
　見逃すよう、美弥香さんからお願いされています」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"But... even if I were to encounter you, Miyaka-san has asked me to let you go."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「どこへ行くつもりだったのかは知りませんが、アテ
　があるのなら行って下さい」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"I don't know where you were planning to go, but if you have somewhere to be, please go."

strings.text:
それだけ言い残して、ユーリアがくるりときびすを返
す。
strings.translated: With only those words left behind, Yulia turned on her heel.

strings.text:
夢美のことなど興味をなくしたかのように、森の奥へ
去って行こうとする。
strings.translated: As though she had lost all interest in Yumemi, she moved to disappear deeper into the forest.

strings.text:
だが、一度だけ足を止めて振り返ると、じっとレンを
見つめながら呟いた。
strings.translated: But she stopped once and looked back, and murmured while gazing steadily at Ren.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「彼は……貴女を迎えに来たのですね」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"He came... to find you, didn't he."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「深手を負った彼が、何故危険を冒してまでこの森へ
　戻ったのかずっと考えていましたが……」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"I had been wondering all along why he would risk returning to this forest despite his grievous wounds..."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「彼を信じて待つ貴女を、放ってはおけなかったから
　なのですね」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"It was because he could not bring himself to abandon you -- waiting here, trusting in him."

strings.text: 言われて初めて気付いた。
strings.translated: She had not realized it until it was said aloud.

strings.text:
追っ手が迫っていると分かっていながら、レンは何故
わざわざ隠れ家の倉庫へと戻ってきたのか。
strings.translated: Even knowing that pursuers were closing in, why had Ren gone out of his way to return to the storehouse hideout?

strings.text:
駅に仲間がいるのなら、何故すぐにそこへ向かわな
かったのか。
strings.translated: If there were allies waiting at the station, why had he not gone straight there?

strings.text: 少し考えれば分かることだ。
strings.translated: Think about it even a little, and the answer was plain.

strings.text:
夢美――正確には蟲なのかもしれないが、それを迎え
に来たからだ。
strings.translated: He had come to retrieve Yumemi -- or perhaps, more precisely, the Bug -- but he had come for her.

strings.text:
だが――夢美は知らない事だったが――痛みを感じな
いレンの体質が、命の危機を伝えるのが遅れたのだろ
う。
strings.translated: But -- though Yumemi had no way of knowing this -- Ren's constitution, which left him unable to feel pain, must have delayed the warning that his life was in danger.

strings.text:
自分がもっと重傷だと認識していれば、或いは別の
未来が選択されていたかもしれない。
strings.translated: Had he recognized just how gravely wounded he truly was, perhaps a different future might have been chosen.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「失礼。余計なことを詮索してしまいました」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Forgive me. I pried into something that was none of my business."

strings.text:
そう言って、今度こそユーリアが深い闇の中へと消え
る。
strings.translated: With those words, Yulia vanished at last into the deep darkness.

strings.text:
辺りには元の静寂が戻り、夢美だけがただ一人取り残
された。
strings.translated: Silence reclaimed the surroundings, and Yumemi alone was left behind.

strings.text:
地面に尻餅を着いたような体勢で、暫くユーリアの
去った方向を見つめる。
strings.translated: She sat where she had fallen -- as though she had dropped straight to the ground -- and stared for a long moment in the direction Yulia had gone.

strings.text:
ぼんやりしている暇はないと分かっていたが、すぐに
は動くことができなかった。
strings.translated: She knew she had no time to sit in a daze, yet she could not bring herself to move.

strings.text:
レンの言葉に従うのなら、このまま駅に向かい、そこ
で待っている蟲使いと接触するべきだ。
strings.translated: If she were to follow Ren's instructions, she should head to the station and make contact with the Bug User waiting there.

strings.text:
その後がどうなるかは分からないが、アテと言うなら
アテが一つだけあるとは言える。
strings.translated: She had no way of knowing what would come after that -- but if she could call it a lead, then she had exactly one.

strings.text: だが、それが不安に繋がらないわけではなかった。
strings.translated: That, however, did nothing to ease her anxiety.

strings.text:
夢美がたった一人で行ったとして、温かく歓迎される
とは思えない。
strings.translated: She could not imagine being welcomed warmly if she arrived there all alone.

strings.text: むしろ、蟲使い達が今の夢美をどう見るのか……。
strings.translated: Rather -- how would the Bug Users see Yumemi as she was now...?

strings.text: 考えるだけで身が竦む思いがした。
strings.translated: The mere thought of it made her body shrink with dread.

strings.text: つぶやいて、そっと体に触れてみる。
strings.translated: She murmured his name and gently reached out to touch him.

strings.text:
まだ微かに体温は残っているが、血が足りないためか
想像していた以上に冷たかった。
strings.translated: A faint warmth still lingered in his body, but perhaps from the blood loss, he was colder than she had imagined.

strings.text: 既に事切れているのは、闇を通してでも伝わってくる。
strings.translated: Even through the darkness, it was plain that he had already passed.

strings.text:
何年もの間、夢美を陰から護ってくれていたらしい
蟲使いの青年は、もうどこにも生きてはいないのだっ
た。
strings.translated: The young Bug User who had apparently watched over Yumemi from the shadows for so many years -- he was no longer alive anywhere in this world.

strings.text: 立ち上がり、前を向いて、歩き出す。
strings.translated: She stood up, faced forward, and began to walk.

strings.text:
夜のカーテンを手で掻き分けるようにして、森の向こ
う側に広がっている街を目指す。
strings.translated: Parting the curtain of night with her hands, she set her sights on the town spreading out beyond the forest.

strings.text:
どんなに不安でも、どんなに悲しんでも、レンはもう
戻って来ない。
strings.translated: No matter how frightened she was, no matter how deep her grief -- Ren was never coming back.

strings.text:
これからの道は、自分一人で歩いて行くしかないのだ
と、強く心に言い聞かせた。
strings.translated: She told herself firmly, over and over, that the road ahead was hers to walk alone.

strings.text: 右腕が、何かを訴えるように痙攣する。
strings.translated: Her right arm convulsed, as though pleading with her.

strings.text:
あまりに違和感がないため、つい忘れがちになってし
まう事を思い出させてくれる。
strings.translated: It reminded her of something she tended to forget, simply because it felt so natural.

strings.text:
夢美
「そうだね。アンタもいるんだもんね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Right. You're here too, aren't you."

strings.text:
夢美は口元に微かな笑みを浮かべると、力強く頷いて
返した。
strings.translated: A faint smile touched Yumemi's lips, and she gave a firm nod in return.

strings.text: 今までも、その関係でやってきたのだ。
strings.translated: That was how it had always been between them.

strings.text:
多少、目に見えなくなった部分はあるが、それで繋が
りが切れたわけではない。
strings.translated: Some things had become invisible, yes -- but that did not mean the bond was severed.

strings.text:
むしろ、以前よりも強くなったと言っても良い関係に、
夢美は全身に張り詰めていた緊張が解けていくのを感
じた。
strings.translated: If anything, it was a bond she could call stronger than before -- and with that thought, Yumemi felt the tension that had gripped her entire body slowly begin to release.

strings.text:
右手を硬く握り締めて、夢美は力強い一歩を踏み出し
た。
strings.translated: Gripping her right hand tight, Yumemi took one powerful step forward.

strings.text:
レンも、蟲使いも、そして神武も振り切るようにして、
深い森の中を歩き出して行ったのだった……。
strings.translated: As if shaking free of Ren, the Bug Users, and Jinmu alike, she walked on into the depths of the forest...

strings.text:
夢美
「うわぁ～っ、海だぁ～～～っ！！！」

走らせていた自転車を停めて、夢美が感激した様子で
声を上げた。
strings.translated: She brought her bicycle to a stop and cried out, overcome with wonder.

strings.text: 照り付ける日差しの下。
道路に沿うようにして伸びるガードレールの向こう側。
strings.translated: Beyond the guardrail running alongside the road.

strings.text: そこに深い紺碧の海が広がっていた。
strings.translated: There, a deep cobalt sea stretched out before her.

strings.text:
空には真っ白な入道雲が出ていて、季節が夏であるこ
とを実感させてくれる。
strings.translated: Towering white cumulonimbus clouds filled the sky, making the summer season feel utterly real.

strings.text:
夢美
「ほら、見える？
　こんな綺麗な海見るの初めてでしょ？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Hey, can you see it?
  You've never seen such a beautiful ocean before, have you?"

strings.text: 右手を空高く掲げて、夢美はそう話しかけた。
strings.translated: Raising her right hand high into the air, Yumemi spoke those words.

strings.text:
言葉が通じているのかどうかは分からないが、それで
もピクピクと震えるようにして応えてくれる。
strings.translated: Whether or not it could understand her words, she did not know -- but it answered her all the same, trembling with a faint little twitch.

strings.text:
――レンの死を看取ってから、夢美はあちこちを点々
としながら過ごした。
strings.translated: -- Since she had seen Ren die, Yumemi had drifted from place to place.

strings.text: それまでの生活を全て捨て、新しい道を歩み始めた。
strings.translated: She had left her entire former life behind and set out on a new path.

strings.text: 当然、楽な道のりだったわけがない。
strings.translated: Naturally, it had been anything but easy.

strings.text:
その日その日のアルバイトで、何とか食いつないでき
た。
strings.translated: She had scraped by day to day on whatever part-time work she could find.

strings.text:
当てもなく歩き続け、とにかく生きることを最優先に
生きてきた。
strings.translated: She had walked on without any destination, keeping survival her one and only priority.

strings.text: そうやって、生き抜くすべを学んでいった。
strings.translated: And in doing so, she had learned how to endure.

strings.text:
夢美
「ねぇ、せっかく沖縄に来たんだし、ちょっとくらい
　泳いでいこっか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Hey, we came all the way to Okinawa -- want to go for a swim while we're here?"

strings.text: 右手を掲げたまま話しかける。
strings.translated: She spoke to the air with her right hand still raised.

strings.text:
事情を知らない人間が見れば、奇妙な独り言にしか
聞こえないだろう。
strings.translated: To anyone who didn't know the circumstances, it would have sounded like nothing more than a strange monologue.

strings.text:
だが、これが夢美にとっての大切なコミュニケーショ
ンだった。
strings.translated: But this was Yumemi's most cherished form of communication.

strings.text: この旅の中で、一瞬たりとも孤独を感じたことはない。
strings.translated: Not once during this journey had she felt alone.

strings.text: 話しかければ応えてくれる。
strings.translated: If she spoke, something would answer.

strings.text: 時々は、逆に何かを訴えられることもある。
strings.translated: Sometimes, it would even seem to be trying to tell her something in return.

strings.text: だからこそ、夢美は強く生き続けることができた。
strings.translated: That was precisely why Yumemi had been able to keep living, and living strong.

strings.text: 自分が独りではないのだと、常に感じることができた。
strings.translated: She could always feel that she was not alone.

strings.text:
夢美
「ふふ～ん、お母さんのセクシーな水着姿を見せてあ
　げようじゃないの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Heh heh, how about I show you your mama's sexy swimsuit look?"

strings.text: つんつん、と右腕を突付く。
strings.translated: She poked at her right arm with a fingertip.

strings.text:
――と、ピクピクと皮膚が痙攣したような反応が返っ
て来た。
strings.translated: And then -- her skin twitched back in a faint, spasming response.

strings.text:
夢美
「え～と、ビーチはあっちのほうかな」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Hmm, the beach should be over that way..."

strings.text:
夢美
「それじゃ……
　親子揃って初の海水浴にしゅっぱ～つ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well then...
   Time for mother and child to set off on their very first swim together!"

strings.text:
夢美は元気良く叫ぶと、自転車のペダルに力を込めて
再び走り出した。
strings.translated: Yumemi cried out with all her energy, then bore down on the bicycle pedals and set off again.

strings.text:
遠くのほうから聞こえてくる潮騒が、まるで自分達を
歓迎してくれているような気がした……。
strings.translated: The sound of the waves drifting in from far away felt as though it were welcoming them both...

strings.text: この先、どうなるのかは分からない。
strings.translated: What lay ahead, she did not know.

strings.text: 未来への当てなど、何一つとしてない。
strings.translated: She had not a single clue what the future held.

strings.text: だが、きっと道は続くだろう。
strings.translated: But surely, the road would go on.

strings.text:
どんなに険しくとも、どんなに暗闇に包まれようとも、
道はどこまでも導いてくれるだろう。
strings.translated:
No matter how steep, no matter how shrouded in darkness,
the road would guide her on and on without end.

strings.text: まだ、終わりには遠い人生を、力の限り走り続ける。
strings.translated: She ran with all her strength down a life still far from its end.

strings.text: きっとゴールはあるだろう。
strings.translated: Surely there was a finish line somewhere.

strings.text: たどり着く先はあるだろう。
strings.translated: Surely there was a destination waiting at the end.

strings.text:
だから今は、ただそれを信じて、夢美は長いアスファ
ルトの道を走って行ったのだった……。
strings.translated: And so for now, trusting only in that belief, Yumemi ran on down the long asphalt road...

strings.text: 何かを言う暇もなかった。
strings.translated: There was no time to say anything.

strings.text:
ユーリアの腕が振るわれたかと思った瞬間、夢美の首
が切り裂かれた。
strings.translated: The instant Yulia's arm swung, Yumemi's throat was slashed open.

strings.text:
かろうじて呻き声のようなものを出せたかどうか、
それさえも自分では判断できない。
strings.translated: Whether she had managed even a faint groan, she couldn't tell even herself.

strings.text: 右手で傷口を押さえると、どくんっと蟲が騒いだ。
strings.translated: When she pressed her right hand to the wound, the Bug stirred with a thud.

strings.text:
そして、首の傷を癒そうと触手を伸ばそうとした
矢先――――
strings.translated: And just as it extended its tendrils to try to heal the wound at her throat--------

strings.text:
ユーリア
「蟲は使わせません」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"I won't let you use the Bug."

strings.text: 閃光が走り抜け、夢美の右腕が肘から切り落とされた。
strings.translated: A flash of light tore through the air, and Yumemi's right arm was severed at the elbow.

strings.text: 首に当てていた腕が落ち、その傷口から触手が蠢く。
strings.translated: The arm she had pressed to her neck fell away, and from the wound, tendrils began to writhe.

strings.text:
そこで初めて、ユーリアも夢美の体が普通でない事に
気付き、じっと観察するような視線を送りつけてきた。
strings.translated: Only then did Yulia notice that Yumemi's body was not normal, and she fixed her with a steady, analytical gaze.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「それは、まさか獣魔蟲ですか？」

ユーリア
「貴女の体に……寄生している…………？」

多少、動揺は混じっているものの、ユーリアの分析は
正確だ。
strings.translated: There was some degree of shock mixed in, but Yulia's analysis was accurate.

strings.text: そして、次に腕を振り上げた瞬間――――
strings.translated: And then, the moment she raised her arm again--------

strings.text:
最後に光るものを見たような気がしたあと、夢美の
意識がぶつりと途切れた。
strings.translated: After what felt like a final flash of light, Yumemi's consciousness was severed with a snap.

strings.text:
殺されたのか、それとも気絶しただけなのかは分から
ない。
strings.translated: Whether she had been killed, or had merely lost consciousness, she could not tell.

strings.text:
ただ、自分はもう二度と目覚める事はないのだろうと、
何故だかそんな思いが胸に広がっていた。
strings.translated: Only a feeling -- that she would never wake again -- spread through her chest, for reasons she could not explain.

strings.text:
夢美
（私……逃げ切れなかったよ……）

そんな悲しい謝罪が、櫻井夢美の最期の思いだっ
た……。
strings.translated: That sorrowful apology was the last thought of Sakurai Yumemi...

strings.text:
夢美
「ま、待ってて。包帯か何かないか探してみるから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"W-wait. Let me look for some bandages or something."

strings.text:
後ずさりながら言って、今まで自分が座っていた場所
に戻る。
strings.translated: She said it while backing away, returning to the spot where she had been sitting until now.

strings.text:
そこには、あらかじめ用意しておいた包丁が、濁った
光を反射させていた。
strings.translated: There, a kitchen knife she had prepared in advance reflected a murky light.

strings.text: 覚悟は――既にしたはずだ――――。
strings.translated: She had already steeled herself -- or so she had thought--------

strings.text: 震える指で、包丁に手を伸ばす。
strings.translated: With trembling fingers, she reached for the knife.

strings.text:
喉がカラカラに渇いて、額から汗の雫が流れ落ちてき
た。
strings.translated: Her throat was parched dry, and a bead of sweat trickled down from her brow.

strings.text:
こんな単純な方法が、果たしてレンに通用するのだろ
うか。
strings.translated: Would such a simple method even work on Ren?

strings.text: もしかすると、既に気付かれているのではないか。

様々な疑念を振り払いながら、包丁の柄を握ろうとす
る。
strings.translated: Shaking off the flood of doubts, she tried to grip the handle of the knife.

strings.text:
レン
「あの二人は逃がしましたか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Did you let those two escape?"

strings.text:
ソファーに寝たままのレンに尋ねられ、夢美はビクッ
と体を震わせた。
strings.translated: Asked by Ren, who lay still on the sofa, Yumemi gave a startled shudder.

strings.text: 何故、そんな質問をしてくるのか。
strings.translated: Why would he ask something like that.

strings.text:
既に二人を逃がしたことを知っているのか、それとも
何か別の方法で察しているのか。
strings.translated: Did he already know she had let the two of them escape, or had he sensed it through some other means?

strings.text: 夢美は、カチカチと歯が鳴るのを堪えながら答えた。
strings.translated: Yumemi answered, fighting to keep her chattering teeth under control.

strings.text:
レン
「貴女なら、そうするかもしれないと思っていたの
　で……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I thought that you, of all people, might do something like that..."

strings.text: レンが、淡々とした言葉で告げる。
strings.translated: Ren stated it in his usual flat, detached tone.

strings.text:
本音か嘘かは分からなかったが、少なくとも夢美を
責めるつもりはないらしい。
strings.translated: Whether it was the truth or a lie, she couldn't tell -- but at the very least, he didn't seem to have any intention of blaming Yumemi.

strings.text: それが、一度は胸に決めたはずの覚悟を鈍らせる……。
strings.translated: And that was what dulled the resolve she had once steeled herself to carry out...

strings.text:
レン
「必要な情報は得ましたし、面倒になりそうだった芽
　は潰しました」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I obtained the necessary information, and I have nipped anything that might have become troublesome in the bud."

strings.text:
レン
「明日にでも、別の担当者がこの町にやって来るで
　しょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"By tomorrow, a different operative will be arriving in this town."

strings.text:
レン
「今、僕らの最優先事項は生き残ることですので、
　神武美弥香も佐々原　唯も、もう必要はありませ
　ん……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Our top priority right now is survival, so Jinmu Miyaka and Sasahara Yui are no longer needed..."

strings.text: ごくりと息を呑んで、包丁を握り締める。
strings.translated: She swallowed hard and tightened her grip on the kitchen knife.

strings.text: 今更、後戻りはできない。
strings.translated: There was no turning back now.

strings.text:
レンの、そして蟲使いの本性を知ってしまった今、
この危険人物達を野放しにする事はできないのだ。
strings.translated: Now that she knew the true nature of Ren -- and of Bug Users -- she could not allow these dangerous individuals to roam free.

strings.text:
自分のような、そして唯のような被害者をこれ以上
増やさないのためにも、夢美はやり遂げなければな
らないのだった。
strings.translated: To keep victims like herself, and like Yui, from multiplying any further, Yumemi had to see this through.

strings.text:
大きく間隔を空けて呼吸をして、包丁を握る手に力を
込める。
strings.translated: She drew slow, measured breaths with long intervals between them, pouring strength into the hand gripping the knife.
If she was going to do it, now was the only chance.

strings.text:
レンが帰ってきた直後は動揺してしまったが、これほ
どのチャンスはもう二度と訪れないだろう。
strings.translated: She had faltered when Ren first returned, but an opportunity like this would never come again.

strings.text: 包丁を後ろ手に隠して、レンに近付いていく。
strings.translated: She concealed the kitchen knife behind her back and crept closer to Ren.

strings.text:
幸いだったのはレンが頭を向けていることで、接近中
は視界の外になることだ。
strings.translated: What worked in her favor was that Ren lay with his head toward her -- she would be outside his field of vision as she approached.

strings.text:
もちろん、気付かれていないという保障はどこにもな
いが、精神的には幾らかマシだった。
strings.translated: Of course, there was no guarantee he hadn't noticed her, but it was at least somewhat easier on her nerves.

strings.text: 包丁を握り締めた右手に力を込める。
strings.translated: She poured strength into her right hand, gripping the knife tight.

strings.text: 何度か瞬きをしたあと、もう目をつぶらないと誓う。
strings.translated: She blinked several times, then swore to herself she would not close her eyes again.

strings.text:
呼吸を止めて、少しでも接近する気配が消えるよう
努める。
strings.translated: She held her breath, doing her best to erase any trace of her approach.

strings.text:
レンの顔が見えてきて、目を閉じていることを確認す
る。
strings.translated: Ren's face came into view; she confirmed that his eyes were closed.

strings.text: 薄汚れたソファーの傍らに立つ。
strings.translated: She stood beside the grimy sofa.

strings.text: もう、いつでも実行に移せる距離だ。
strings.translated: She was close enough to act at any moment.

strings.text:
不安や躊躇いがないわけではなかったが、夢美はその
全てをこの瞬間だけ捨て去ることにした。
strings.translated: It wasn't that she felt no anxiety or hesitation -- but Yumemi chose to cast all of it aside, just for this one instant.

strings.text: そして、包丁を持った手を頭上に振り上げ――――
strings.translated: And she raised the hand holding the knife high above her head--------

strings.text:
レンの胸に包丁を付きたてた瞬間、ずぐりと肉の裂け
る感触が伝わってきた。
strings.translated: The moment she drove the knife into Ren's chest, a wet, tearing sensation traveled through her hands as flesh split apart.

strings.text:
同時に、閉じられていたレンのまぶたがカッと開き、
視線がついっと夢美に向けられる。
strings.translated: At the same instant, Ren's closed eyelids snapped open, and his gaze flicked sharply toward Yumemi.

strings.text:
そこには、怒りや悲しみといった感情はなく、ただ
無表情に見つめてくる眼が浮かんでいるだけだった。
strings.translated: There was no anger there, no sorrow -- only a pair of eyes staring back at her with blank, empty indifference.

strings.text:
やがて、レンの視線が自分の胸に移され、そこで初め
て何が起こったのかを理解する。
strings.translated: Then his gaze shifted down to his own chest, and it was only then that he seemed to understand what had happened.

strings.text: 小さく溜息をつくと、くんっと右手を動かし――――
strings.translated: He let out a small sigh, then jerked his right hand--------

strings.text: 強い衝撃を受けて、夢美の体が弾き飛ばされた。
strings.translated: Struck by a powerful impact, Yumemi's body was sent flying.

strings.text:
背中から床に落ちたあと、滑るようにして壁際まで
転がる。
strings.translated: She hit the floor back-first, then skidded and rolled all the way to the wall.

strings.text:
痛みを堪えながら顔を上げると、頭上には無数の蜂の
ような蟲が飛び回っていた。
strings.translated: Fighting through the pain, she lifted her head -- and above her, countless wasp-like Bugs were swarming through the air.

strings.text: レンの右手には、三本の蟲筒が握られている――――。
strings.translated: In Ren's right hand, three Bug tubes were clutched tight--------.

strings.text:
レン
「殺すつもりであれば、もっと力を込めるべきです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"If you intended to kill, you should have put more force into it."

strings.text:
レン
「貴女には、その覚悟が足りなかった」

まるで他人事のように言って、レンが静かにまぶたを
閉じる。
strings.translated: He said it as if it were someone else's problem, and quietly closed his eyes.

strings.text:
夢美はすぐに逃げ出そうとしたが、何故だかその時に
はもう体が全く動いてはくれなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi tried to flee immediately, but for some reason her body refused to move at all.

strings.text:
レン
「僕がこんな状態ですので、貴女の体の自由を奪わせ
　てもらいました」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Given my current condition, I took the liberty of robbing you of your freedom of movement."

strings.text:
レン
「右腕の蟲にまで効果があるかは分かりませんでした
　が、一応効いているようですね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I wasn't sure whether it would work on the Bug in your right arm as well, but it seems to be effective."

strings.text: 夢美はハッとして右腕に力を込めた。
strings.translated: Yumemi snapped to attention and tried to put strength into her right arm.

strings.text:
だが、レンの言う通り、右腕も他と同様動かすことが
できない。
strings.translated: But just as Ren had said, her right arm was no more movable than the rest of her.

strings.text:
蟲化させてみようとも思ったが、麻痺しているためか
それも不可能だった。
strings.translated: She tried to make it transform into its Bug form, but perhaps because of the paralysis, even that was impossible.

strings.text: 次第に恐怖が込み上げてくる。
strings.translated: Fear began to well up inside her.

strings.text:
レンの殺害に失敗し、今度は自分が囚われの身となっ
てしまったのが理解できる。
strings.translated: She understood now -- she had failed to kill Ren, and now she herself was the one taken captive.

strings.text:
殺されるのか、それともそのほうがマシだと思わせら
れるほどの苦痛を味わうのか。
strings.translated: Would she be killed, or would she be made to suffer pain so great that death would seem preferable?

strings.text:
やがて、レンの放った蟲がゆっくりと近付いてきて、
夢美の凌辱劇が開始された……。
strings.translated: And before long, the Bugs Ren had released slowly drew near, and Yumemi's violation began...

strings.text:
夢美
「い、やぁっ！　放してっ！　放してぇっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"N-no! Let go! Let go of me!!"

strings.text:
足元に転がった種のような物から、突如として触手が
伸び、夢美の体を拘束していった。
strings.translated: From seed-like objects that had rolled to the floor, tentacles suddenly extended and began to bind Yumemi's body.

strings.text:
細長い無数の触手がズボンの隙間から入り込み、柔肌
の上を競り上がっていく。
strings.translated: Countless slender tentacles slipped through the gaps in her clothing and crept upward over her bare skin.

strings.text:
暴れて抵抗ができたのは最初の数秒だけで、手足の
自由を奪われたのはあっという間だった。
strings.translated: She could only struggle and resist for the first few seconds -- her limbs were stripped of all freedom in an instant.

strings.text:
乱暴に衣服を引き裂かれながら、夢美の体が宙に吊り
上げられていく。
strings.translated: Her clothes were torn away violently as Yumemi's body was hoisted up into the air.

strings.text:
夢美
「た、たす、けてっ！　やあぁっ！　助けてっ！！
　助けてぇーーーーーーーーっ！！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"H-help me! No! Help me!! Help meeeee!!!"

strings.text:
涙声になって悲鳴を上げながら、夢美は必死に触手を
払い落とそうとした。
strings.translated: Screaming at the top of her lungs, Yumemi desperately tried to shake the tentacles off.

strings.text:
そんな事をしても無駄だと頭では分かっていたが、
何もせずただ凌辱されるほど度胸が据わっているわ
けでもない。
strings.translated: Her mind knew it was useless, but she didn't have the nerve to simply endure the violation without doing anything.

strings.text:
むしろ、過去に蟲に犯された記憶が甦り、夢美の頭を
錯乱させていた。
strings.translated: Rather, memories of being violated by Bugs in the past resurfaced, throwing Yumemi's mind into chaos.

想像できるはずもなかった。
strings.translated: There was no way she could have imagined that she had been made to birth Bugs for that purpose.

strings.text:
だが、そんな夢美の前で、レンは次々と仔蟲を手に取
り、自らの『食事』と『薬』の役目として使っていっ
た。
strings.translated: But before Yumemi's eyes, Ren picked up the larval Bugs one after another, using them as his own 'food' and 'medicine.'

strings.text:
夢美の視線に気付いたのだろう、レンはぽつりと言葉
を漏らす。
strings.translated: He must have noticed Yumemi's gaze, for Ren let slip a quiet murmur.

strings.text:
レン
「こうして使うためのものですから」
strings.translated:
Ren
"They exist to be used this way."

strings.text:
その言葉を無情と感じるべきか、それともこの蟲は
食用なのだと理解するべきか…………。
strings.translated: Whether to feel his words were heartless, or to understand that these Bugs were simply food..............

strings.text: 夢美の膣を通って、さらに数匹の蟲が産まれる。
strings.translated: Several more Bugs were born, passing through Yumemi's vagina.

strings.text:
同時に三匹の蟲が這い出てきたので、膣口は限界以上
に拡がっていた。
strings.translated: Three Bugs had crawled out simultaneously, stretching the vaginal opening far beyond its limits.

strings.text:
どこかの筋肉がブチッと切れた気がしたが、それさえ
も夢美には、快楽なのか苦痛なのか分からない刺激と
して伝わる。
strings.translated: Somewhere inside her, a muscle seemed to snap with a tearing sensation -- yet even that reached Yumemi as a stimulus she could not distinguish as pleasure or pain.

strings.text:
ただ、刺激そのものは強烈で、夢美は自分でも気付か
ないうちに失禁していた。
strings.translated: The stimulation itself was overwhelming, and before she even realized it, Yumemi had lost control of her bladder.

strings.text:
夢美
「はっ、はががっ！　あ、ぎっ、ぎあぁああぁっ！！
　あがっ、あ、ひぎっ、ひ、うぎいぃぃぃっ！！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ha--, hagaggh! A--, gih--, giaaahh!! Aggh--, a--, higih--, hi--, ugiiiii!!!"

strings.text:
時間が経つとともに、圧迫感を覚える場所が少しずつ
変わってきた。
strings.translated: As time passed, the location of the pressure she felt shifted little by little.

strings.text:
子宮内の蟲は全て膣道に移動したようで、今は膣口付
近が大渋滞を起こしている。
strings.translated: It seemed all the Bugs inside her womb had migrated into the vaginal canal, and now a massive traffic jam was forming near the vaginal opening.

strings.text:
しかも、それらが大挙して出口に押し寄せてくるため、
夢美の膣は人間の赤子を産むのと変わらない大きさに
まで拡がってしまっていた。
strings.translated: Moreover, as they surged en masse toward the exit, Yumemi's vagina had been stretched to a size no different from that of a woman delivering a human infant.

strings.text:
夢美
（ああっ、産まれてっ！　早く産まれてぇっ！！）
strings.translated:
Yumemi
(Aahh, come out! Be born already, please!!)

strings.text: 腹の奥に、大きな塊が蠢くのを感じた。
strings.translated: She felt a large mass writhing deep within her belly.

strings.text:
今まで生んだ仔蟲の倍以上はあろうかという蟲が、
夢美の体内を移動していた。
strings.translated: A Bug at least twice the size of any larva she had birthed so far was moving through her body.

strings.text:
どうやら一匹だけ成長過多の蟲がいたらしく、それが
一番後ろから他の蟲を押し出そうとしている。
strings.translated: It seemed one Bug had grown excessively large, and it was pushing the others out from behind.

strings.text:
結果、膣口はさらに拡げられ、それによる刺激は夢美
の脳髄を貫いた。
strings.translated: As a result, the vaginal opening was stretched even further, and the stimulation from that pierced straight through Yumemi's very brain.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぎゃあぁあぁぁぁぁぁっ！！！」

卵から孵った仔蟲がボトボトと床に落ち、膣内はつい
に最後の一匹となった。
strings.translated: The larval Bugs that had hatched from the eggs dropped wetly to the floor one after another, and at last only one remained inside her.

strings.text:
仔蟲とは呼べないサイズの仔蟲が、締まりの悪くなっ
た膣口を押し通ろうとする。
strings.translated: A larva too large to be called a larva was trying to force its way through the now-slack vaginal opening.

strings.text:
その強さは今までの比ではなく、もしかすると内臓ご
と外に出てくるのではないかと思うほど、強烈な圧迫
感が夢美を襲った。
strings.translated: The force of it was incomparable to anything before -- the crushing pressure that assaulted Yumemi was so intense she feared her very organs might be pushed outside her body.

strings.text:
やがて、ビキッと股関節に直接響くような刺激が走り
抜け――――――――
strings.translated: Then, a sensation that seemed to reverberate directly through her hip joints like a crack shot through her--------

strings.text:
夢美
「うぅぅうぅぐおぉおおぉおぉぉおおおぉぉぉぉーー
　ーーーーーーーーーーっ！！！！！」

獣の咆哮にも似た声を上げて、夢美が限界まで背中を
仰け反らせる。
strings.translated: Letting out a cry like the roar of a wild beast, Yumemi arched her back to its very limit.

strings.text:
刹那、ずずずっと仔蟲が胴体の半分程を露出させ、
キチキチと歯を鳴らしながら短めの触手を揺らした。
strings.translated: In that instant, the larval Bug slowly exposed roughly half of its body, clicking its mandibles as it swayed its stubby tentacles.

strings.text: 大きさは、他の仔蟲のざっと三倍。
strings.translated: Its size was roughly three times that of the other larval Bugs.

strings.text:
背中には段差が付いていて、動くたびにそれが夢美の
膣内を掻き回していたらしい。
strings.translated: Its back had ridges along it, and with every movement they had apparently been churning through the inside of Yumemi's vagina.

strings.text:
さらにずるりと胴体が抜け出ると、愛液がぷしゃっと
飛沫を上げた。
strings.translated: As its body slid out further with a wet slither, a spray of love juices splashed into the air.

strings.text:
夢美
「お、おごぉっ……お、きぃ……こん、な……の……
　があっ、あ、うぐあぁっ、キツイ、いぃぃっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"O-oghh... o-kii... s-so... big......
 aahh, a, uguaahh, it's so tight, iiiii!!"

strings.text:
股間が破壊されそうな感覚に、夢美は大きくまぶたを
開いた。
strings.translated: At the sensation that her groin was about to be torn apart, Yumemi opened her eyelids wide.

strings.text:
痛みとも快楽ともつかない刺激は相変わらずだが、
胸が詰まり息苦しさを感じる。
strings.translated: The stimulation that was neither pain nor pleasure remained unchanged, but her chest felt constricted and she could barely breathe.

strings.text:
刺激の強さに肺が痙攣しているようで、このまま死ん
でしまうのではないかと、心の奥底で恐怖した。
strings.translated: It was as though the intensity of the stimulation was sending her lungs into spasms, and deep within her heart, she felt a terror that she might die just like this.

strings.text:
仔蟲は、周囲を見回すように頭部をぐるりと動かした
あと――――
strings.translated: The larval Bug rotated its head around as if surveying its surroundings -- and then----

strings.text: ――自らの重みでべちゃりと床に落ちた。
strings.translated: -- and it dropped to the floor under its own weight with a wet splat.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、
　はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、
　はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ！！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah,
 hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah,
 hah, hah, hah, hah, hah!!!"

strings.text:
大きく肩で息をしながら、夢美がぐったりと体を脱力
させる。
strings.translated: Breathing hard from her shoulders, Yumemi let her body go completely limp.

strings.text:
これほど大きな蟲を産むとは思わなかったため、神経
が麻痺するほどに全身の力を使い果たしていた。
strings.translated: She had never expected to birth a Bug so large -- she had spent every last ounce of strength in her body to the point where her nerves had gone numb.

strings.text:
膣口は開きっぱなしの状態になり、陰唇を拡げなくと
も赤い秘肉を覗き見ることができる。
strings.translated: Her vaginal opening remained spread wide, and the red inner flesh was visible without even needing to part the labia.

strings.text:
四肢はぴくぴくと痙攣を続け、口の端からはだらしな
く涎の筋が垂れていた。
strings.translated: Her limbs continued to twitch and spasm, and a slovenly trail of drool hung from the corner of her mouth.

strings.text:
レン
「次の母体も産まれましたか」
strings.translated:
Ren
"So the next mother has been born as well."

strings.text: ふと気付けば、レンがソファーから立ち上がっていた。
strings.translated: It was then that she noticed Ren had risen from the sofa.

strings.text:
まだ顔は青白いものの、表情には幾分生気が戻ってい
る。
strings.translated: His face was still pale, but some measure of vitality had returned to his expression.

strings.text:
右手には仔蟲を持ち、相変わらず傷口に押し当ててい
たが、出血は完全に止まったようだった。
strings.translated: In his right hand he still held a larval Bug pressed against his wound as before, but the bleeding appeared to have stopped completely.

strings.text:
レン
「それでは、僕は一旦村に戻ろうと思います」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Now then, I think I'll return to the village for the time being."

strings.text:
レン
「蟲も底をついてしまいましたし、何よりこんな体で
　すからね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"My Bugs have run out, and above all, I'm in no condition to carry on."

strings.text:
レン
「貴女には、二つの選択肢があります」

レン
「ここで僕に殺されるか、それとも蟲使いの村へ行き、
　そこで永遠に蟲を産み続けるか」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Either you are killed by me here, or you go to the Bug Users' village
 and continue birthing Bugs there for eternity."

strings.text:
レン
「貴女に残された道は、そのどちらかしかない」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Those are the only two paths left to you."

strings.text: 意識を保つことができなくなる。
strings.translated: She can no longer hold onto consciousness.

strings.text:
何か質問をされたような気がしたが、それを思考する
だけの力が、既に夢美には残されていなかった。
strings.translated: She felt as though she had been asked some kind of question, but Yumemi no longer had the strength left to even process a thought.

strings.text:
レン
「困りましたね。
　貴女に選んでもらおうと思ったのですが……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"How troubling.
 I had hoped you would choose for yourself..."

strings.text:
レン
「仕方ありません。
　僕なりに、貴女のためになるほうを選びましょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"There's nothing for it, then.
I will choose on your behalf -- whichever I believe is best for you."

strings.text: レンが何かを言っている。
レンが何かをしている。

そんな気配だけが伝わってきたが、夢美にはそれを
正しく認識するだけの力が残されていなかった……。
strings.translated: Only that vague sense reached her, but Yumemi no longer had the strength left to perceive it clearly...

strings.text: レンのその言葉を最後に、夢美の意識は途切れた……。
strings.translated: Those final words from Ren were the last thing Yumemi heard before her consciousness faded...

アゲハ

アゲハの部屋は、一言で言えば女の子らしい部屋だっ
た。
strings.translated: Ageha's room, in a word, was every bit a girl's room.

strings.text:
とにかく物が多くあり、その大半は綺麗だったり可愛
かったりする。
strings.translated: There were simply a lot of things in it, and most of them were either pretty or cute.

strings.text:
動物のぬいぐるみが部屋の片隅を占めており、空間の
雰囲気作りに一役買っていた。
strings.translated: Stuffed animals occupied one corner of the room, lending the space a certain atmosphere.

strings.text:
種類も様々で、イヌ、ネコ、ウサギ、キツネ、タヌキ、
サル、ワニ、果てはヘビ等もいたが、そのいずれもが
マスコット的な愛嬌を秘めている。
strings.translated: The variety was impressive -- dogs, cats, rabbits, foxes, raccoons, monkeys, crocodiles, even snakes -- yet every single one of them had a mascot-like charm to it.

strings.text: 部屋の南側には、いわゆる勉強机があった。
strings.translated: Along the south wall of the room sat what could only be called a study desk.

strings.text:
棚は二段構えになっていて、その上下ともに参考書が
ずらりと並んでいる。
strings.translated: It had a two-tiered shelf, and both levels were lined with reference books.

strings.text:
