strings.text:
夢美
「朝の電話って、何だったの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That phone call this morning -- what was it about?"

strings.text:
電話の内容を思い出したのか、アゲハの表情がやや
真面目になる。
strings.translated: As if recalling the contents of the phone call, Ageha's expression grew somewhat serious.

strings.text:
暫く考えるように視線を宙に漂わせたあと、正面から
夢美の顔を見て口を開いた。
strings.translated: After letting her gaze drift through the air as though thinking for a moment, she looked Yumemi in the face and spoke.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「先生……アタシの保護者の人がね、夢美ちゃんの蟲
　を見てみたいって言ってるの……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Sensei... my guardian wants to take a look at your Bug, Yumemi-chan..."

strings.text:
言いながら、アゲハの部屋に置いてきた蟲のことを
思い出す。
strings.translated: As she said it, she remembered the Bug she had left back in Ageha's room.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「一週間くらい、貸してほしいんだって」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"They want to borrow it for about a week."

strings.text:
夢美
「う、ん……その人、蟲の何をしてる人なの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Uh, sure... but what does this person do with Bugs?"

strings.text:
一週間という時間よりも、むしろ蟲に対して何をする
のかのほうが気になる。
strings.translated: Rather than the week-long timeframe, what concerned her more was what would be done to the Bug.

strings.text:
妙な薬でも打たれ、最悪蟲が死ぬようなことになれば、
夢美はきっと一生後悔するだろう。
strings.translated: If it were injected with some strange drug and, worst case, ended up dying, Yumemi would surely regret it for the rest of her life.

strings.text:
だが、立場上の問題なのか、アゲハが困っているのも
十分によく分かった。
strings.translated: Still, she could tell well enough that Ageha was in a difficult position, likely due to her circumstances.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「たぶん、注射器で体液を抜かれて、細胞とか遺伝子
　とかそういうの調べるんだと思う」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Probably they'll draw out some body fluid with a syringe and examine the cells and genes and stuff like that, I think."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あとは……個室に入れて生態の観測するくらいじゃ
　ないかなぁ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"And after that... maybe just put it in a private room and observe its behavior."

strings.text:
夢美
「最後に解剖されちゃったりとかは？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"What about getting dissected at the end?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あ、それないっ！　そういうの絶対ないからっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Oh, that won't happen! Absolutely not, I promise!"

strings.text: アゲハが驚いたように言って、顔の前で手を横に振る。
strings.translated: Ageha said it as if startled, waving her hand in front of her face.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「夢ちゃんと蟲の関係は話してあるから、そういう
　酷いことはしないと思う」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I've told them about the relationship between you and your Bug, so I don't think they'd do anything that cruel."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あ、それと、別に夢ちゃんのこと、教えようと思っ
　て教えたわけじゃないからね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Oh, and -- I didn't tell them about you on purpose, just so you know."

strings.text: アゲハが、申し訳なさそうに肩を落とす。

こういう事態になってしまった事に対して、それなり
に責任を感じているらしい。
strings.translated: She seemed to feel a fair amount of responsibility for how things had turned out.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「昨日の蟲、もう少し長く借りとこっかなって思って、
　それでそのお願いしてたら夢ちゃんの事に話がいっ
　ちゃって…………」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I was thinking of borrowing yesterday's Bug for a little longer, and while I was asking about that, the conversation somehow got to you..."

strings.text:
夢美
「ああ、そういうこと――――」

夢美
「――ってなに！？　私に聞くより先に、レンタル
　延長してるんじゃない！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"-- Wait, WHAT!? You already extended the rental before even asking me!!"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あ、ああ～っ、ま、なんと申しましょうか」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Ah, uh, well, how shall I put this..."

strings.text:
明らかに「しまった」という顔をして、アゲハが後ず
さりする。
strings.translated: With a look that clearly said "oops," Ageha took a step back.

strings.text:
要するに、朝は夢美をからかっただけで、蟲は既に
今日も借りる事が決定していたのだ。
strings.translated: In short, she had only been teasing Yumemi that morning -- she had already arranged to borrow the Bug again today.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ま、まあまあ、結果オーライってことで」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"N-now, now, all's well that ends well, right?"

strings.text:
夢美
「何が結果オーライよ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"What do you mean, 'all's well that ends well'?"

strings.text:
夢美
「そんなイタズラするなら、蟲、貸してあげない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"If you're going to pull tricks like that, I won't lend you the Bug."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ええ～～っ、そんなぁ～～～～っ！」
アゲハが眉を下げて、顔の前で手を合わせる。
strings.translated: Ageha lowered her brows and pressed her palms together in front of her face.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「お願いっ！　絶対一週間で返してもらうからっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Please! I promise I'll have it back in exactly one week!"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「夢ちゃんっ！　このとーりっ！！」

思ったよりも真剣に、と言うよりも必死に、アゲハが
頼み込んでくる。
strings.translated: More earnestly than expected -- desperately, even -- Ageha pleaded with her.

strings.text:
夢美はしばらく考えたが、居候をしている自分の立場
を振り返ると「ＮＯ」とは言えなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi thought it over for a moment, but when she considered her own position as someone living under Ageha's roof, she couldn't bring herself to say no.

strings.text:
夢美
「本当に一週間だけだからね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It's only one week, you hear me?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あ、ありがとうっ！！」

アゲハがパッと顔を上げて、花が咲いたような笑顔を
浮かべる。
strings.translated: Ageha's face lit up, blooming into a smile like a flower in full bloom.

strings.text:
――と、同時に携帯電話を取り出すと、どこかに掛け
てすぐに結果を伝えた。
strings.translated: At the same time, she pulled out her cell phone, called someone, and immediately relayed the result.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「はい、貸してもらえることになりました」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Yes, she's agreed to lend it."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「そうです。先生が見たがってた蟲です。
　でも、絶対に一週間で返して下さい」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Yes. It's the Bug you wanted to see, Sensei.
But please, absolutely return it within one week."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「はい…………はい、お願いします…………」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Yes... yes, I'm counting on you..."

strings.text: 会話は一分ほどで済み、アゲハは電話を切った。
strings.translated: The call lasted about a minute, and then Ageha hung up.

strings.text:
夢美のほうを振り返ると、安堵の笑みを浮かべながら
一言。
strings.translated: She turned back toward Yumemi, a relieved smile on her face, and said simply:

strings.text:
アゲハ
「今から家に行って回収するって」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"They're coming to pick it up now."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それで、今日を含めて絶対一週間で返すって」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"And they promised to return it in exactly one week, counting today."

strings.text:
夢美
「そう……うん、分かった……」

今から連れて行かれるという事は、一週間後まで蟲と
は会えないという事だ。
strings.translated: Being taken away starting now meant she wouldn't be able to see the Bug for a whole week.

strings.text:
まさか、こうも急に話が進むとは思っていなかったた
め、朝、蟲に触れて来なかった事を少しだけ後悔した。
strings.translated: She hadn't expected things to move so quickly -- and so she felt a small pang of regret that she hadn't reached out to the Bug that morning.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あっ、もうこんな時間っ！
　急がないと遅刻しちゃうよっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Oh, look at the time!
We have to hurry or we'll be late!"

strings.text:
夢美
「えっ？　あ、本当だ」

アゲハ
「急ごっ、夢ちゃん！」

先に走り始めるアゲハを追って、夢美はＡｎｚＵへ
向けて駆け出した。
strings.translated: Chasing after Ageha, who had already broken into a run, Yumemi dashed off toward AnzU.

strings.text:
一週間後、蟲が戻ってきたら思いきり抱き締めてやろ
うと、そんなことを考えながら、青い空の下を駆けて
行ったのだった……。
strings.translated: She thought to herself that when the Bug came back in a week, she would squeeze it tight -- and with that thought in her heart, she ran beneath the blue sky...

strings.text:
夢美
「いらっしゃいませ」

アゲハ
「いらっしゃいませ～」
ＡｎｚＵでの時間は、何事もなく順調に過ぎていった。
strings.translated: And so, time at AnzU passed smoothly, without incident.

strings.text:
開店直後はいつも通りの忙しさで、厨房とフロアを
何度も往復する。
strings.translated: Right after opening, it was as busy as always, and they went back and forth between the kitchen and the floor countless times.

strings.text:
大変と言えば大変だったが、余計なことを考えなくて
済むのは、ある意味幸運だった。
strings.translated: Exhausting as it was, in a way it was fortunate -- it left no room for unnecessary thoughts.

strings.text:
自分を襲った連中が来るのではないかという不安は
あったが、今のところそれはない……。
strings.translated: There was some anxiety that the people who had attacked her might show up, but so far, there was no sign of that...

strings.text:
夢美
「今日は風が強いね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"The wind is really strong today."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「玄関の前、落ち葉だらけですね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"The front entrance is covered in fallen leaves."

strings.text:
二人で外を眺めながら、風に流されていく落ち葉を
目で追う。
strings.translated: The two of them gazed outside together, following the fallen leaves as they were carried away by the wind.

strings.text:
台風でも近付いているのか、午後になってから、空に
浮かぶ雲が猛烈なスピードで流されていた。
strings.translated: Perhaps a typhoon was approaching -- since the afternoon, the clouds floating in the sky had been racing by at a furious speed.

strings.text:
夢美
「雨、降らないといいけど」

アゲハ
「傘、持って来てないですからね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"We didn't bring umbrellas, after all."

strings.text:
夢美
「まあ、降ったら降った時なんだけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well, if it rains, it rains..."

strings.text:
アゲハとなら、雨に濡れながら帰るのも楽しいかもし
れない。
strings.translated: Walking home in the rain with Ageha might actually be fun.

strings.text:
水溜りをわざと踏みながらアスファルトを走って、
家に着いたら二人で風呂に入るのだ。
strings.translated: They would splash through puddles on purpose as they ran along the asphalt, and when they got home, the two of them would take a bath together.

strings.text:
そこで、体を重ねるなら重ねて、ついでに例の蟲も
使って快楽を与え合う。
strings.translated: And there... if they ended up tangled together, they could use that Bug of theirs to give each other pleasure while they were at it.

strings.text:
倫理的、社会的、もしくは人間的に問題が多数ある気
がするが、夢美はそれでも構わなかった。
strings.translated: There were probably numerous ethical, social, and human problems with that, but Yumemi didn't mind at all.

strings.text:
夢美
「いらっしゃいませ」

アゲハ
「いらっしゃいませ～」
ＡｎｚＵでの時間は、何事もなく順調に過ぎていった。
strings.translated: And so, time at AnzU passed smoothly, without incident.

strings.text:
開店直後はいつも通りの忙しさで、厨房とフロアを
何度も往復する。
strings.translated: Right after opening, it was as busy as always, and they went back and forth between the kitchen and the floor countless times.

strings.text:
大変と言えば大変だったが、余計なことを考えなくて
済むのは、ある意味幸運だった。
strings.translated: Exhausting as it was, in a way it was fortunate -- it left no room for unnecessary thoughts.

strings.text:
自分を襲った連中が来るのではないかという不安は
あったが、今のところそれはない……。
strings.translated: There was some anxiety that the people who had attacked her might show up, but so far, there was no sign of that...

strings.text:
それよりも、マンションの部屋に置いてきた蟲のこと
が時々気になってしまい、思わず自宅の方向を見つめ
てしまうことがあった。
strings.translated: More than that, she sometimes found herself worrying about the Bug she had left back in her apartment, and would catch herself staring in the direction of her home without thinking.

strings.text:
夢美
「今日は風が強いね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"The wind is really strong today."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「玄関の前、落ち葉だらけですね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"The front entrance is covered in fallen leaves."

strings.text:
二人で外を眺めながら、風に流されていく落ち葉を
目で追う。
strings.translated: The two of them gazed outside together, following the fallen leaves as they were carried away by the wind.

strings.text:
台風でも近付いているのか、午後になってから、空に
浮かぶ雲が猛烈なスピードで流されていた。
strings.translated: Perhaps a typhoon was approaching -- since the afternoon, the clouds floating in the sky had been racing by at a furious speed.

strings.text:
夢美
「雨、降らないといいけど」

アゲハ
「傘、持って来てないですからね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"We didn't bring umbrellas, after all."

strings.text:
夢美
「まあ、降ったら降った時なんだけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well, if it rains, it rains..."

strings.text:
アゲハとなら、雨に濡れながら帰るのも楽しいかもし
れない。
strings.translated: Walking home in the rain with Ageha might actually be fun.

strings.text:
水溜りをわざと踏みながらアスファルトを走って、
家に着いたら二人で風呂に入るのだ。
strings.translated: They would splash through puddles on purpose as they ran along the asphalt, and when they got home, the two of them would take a bath together.

strings.text:
そこで、体を重ねるなら重ねて、最後は一緒のベッド
で寝る。
strings.translated: And then, if they ended up tangled together, they would fall asleep in the same bed at the end of it all.

strings.text:
倫理的、社会的、もしくは人間的に問題が多数ある気
がするが、夢美はそれでも構わなかった。
strings.translated: There were probably numerous ethical, social, and human problems with that, but Yumemi didn't mind at all.

strings.text:
夢美
「私、外、掃除して来るね」

夢美
「アゲハは、お店のほうお願い」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ageha, can you handle the shop?"

strings.text: アゲハに店のことを任せて、夢美は店の外に出た。
strings.translated: Leaving the shop in Ageha's hands, Yumemi stepped outside.

strings.text:
今日はあまり客が来る様子はないが、玄関前の惨状を
放っておくわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: There didn't seem to be many customers coming today, but she couldn't just leave the mess in front of the entrance as it was.

strings.text:
空を見上げて軽く溜息をつくと、店の周りをぐるりと
見回した。
strings.translated: She glanced up at the sky with a small sigh, then looked around at the area surrounding the shop.

strings.text:
夢美
「掃除するにしても、どこから手をつけたものや
　ら……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Now, where do I even start cleaning..."

strings.text:
真面目に掃除をする気はあるのだが、それ以前に風が
強くて今も落ち葉が飛んでいる。
strings.translated: She genuinely intended to clean up, but the wind was still so strong that leaves were still flying around even now.

strings.text:
この分ではいくら掃除をしても、一時間もすれば元に
戻ってしまいそうだった。
strings.translated: At this rate, no matter how much she cleaned, it seemed like everything would be back to the way it was within an hour.

strings.text:
夢美
「ま、やらないよりマシと信じて……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well, I have to believe it's better than doing nothing..."

strings.text:
事務室から持って来た箒で、玄関の前に溜まっている
落ち葉を掃く。
strings.translated: Using a broom she'd brought from the office, she swept the fallen leaves that had piled up in front of the entrance.

strings.text:
道路に出せば自動的にどこかへ飛んで行ってくれるの
で、ある意味いつもの掃除より楽だった。
strings.translated: Once she pushed them out onto the road, the wind would carry them off somewhere automatically -- in a way, it was easier than her usual cleaning.

strings.text:
もっとも、それを掃除と言うのかどうかは微妙だと
夢美自身が感じているのだが……。
strings.translated: Whether that could really be called cleaning, though, was something Yumemi herself had her doubts about...

strings.text:
風の音に混じって人の気配を感じたのは、ちょうど
そんな考え事をしている時だった。
strings.translated: It was right in the middle of such musings that she sensed a human presence amid the sound of the wind.

strings.text: ふと顔を上げると、夢美の正面にレンが立っていた。
strings.translated: She looked up on a whim, and there was Ren, standing directly in front of her.

strings.text:
相変わらずの黒いコートと、それに合わせたサングラ
スを掛けている。
strings.translated: He wore the same black coat as always, paired with matching sunglasses.

strings.text: 果たして、何を目的としてここへ現れたのか……。
strings.translated: What exactly had brought him here...

strings.text:
レンから発せられる雰囲気にただならぬものを感じて、
夢美は緊張した。
strings.translated: Something in the atmosphere Ren gave off was far from ordinary, and Yumemi tensed up.

strings.text:
レン
「このまま逃げ続けるつもりですか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Do you intend to keep running forever?"

strings.text:
レン
「自分のやっている事が、現実から目を背けるだけの
　行為だと気付いていないのですか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Are you not aware that what you are doing is nothing more than turning your eyes away from reality?"

strings.text: 何の感情も読み取れない言葉で、レンが静かに尋ねる。
strings.translated: Ren asked quietly, his words carrying no readable emotion.

strings.text:
口調から察するに、今現在、夢美がどこでどう暮らし
ているのか、全て把握しているようだった。
strings.translated: Judging by his tone, he appeared to have a complete grasp of where Yumemi was living and how she was getting by at this very moment.

strings.text: だが、それならば話は早い。
strings.translated: But if that was how it was, then there was nothing to deliberate over.

strings.text: 誰に何と言われようと、夢美の答えは決まっていた。
strings.translated: No matter what anyone said to her, Yumemi's answer was already decided.

strings.text:
アゲハとともにいたいという想いだけは、絶対に曲げ
る事ができなかった。
strings.translated: The desire to be with Ageha -- that alone was something she could never bring herself to abandon.

strings.text:
夢美
「私は……今の生活を続けたいの……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I... want to keep living the way I am now..."

strings.text:
夢美
「守ってくれたあなたの言うことを聞かなかったのは
　悪かったって思ってるけど、それでも私はアゲハと
　一緒にいたいの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I know I was wrong not to listen to you after you protected me, but even so -- I want to stay with Ageha."

strings.text:
レン
「彼女に危険が及ぶとしてもですか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Even if she were to be put in danger because of you?"

strings.text:
夢美がもっとも恐れている部分を指摘され、思わず
言葉に詰まった。
strings.translated: He had pointed out the very thing Yumemi feared most, and she found herself at a loss for words.

strings.text:
自分がアゲハのそばにいる事で、アゲハに危険が及ぶ
可能性――――。
strings.translated: The possibility that by staying at Ageha's side, she might bring danger upon Ageha...

strings.text:
今まで考えなかったわけではないが、解決法が見つか
らず放置してきたのだ。
strings.translated: It wasn't that she had never thought about it before -- she simply hadn't found a solution, and had left it unaddressed.

strings.text:
レン
「貴女を襲った者達が、今後も貴女を襲う可能性は
　十分にあります」
strings.translated:
Ren
"There is every chance that those who attacked you will attack you again in the future."

strings.text:
レン
「彼女のことを考えるのであれば、貴女は一刻も早く
　あの家から出るべきだ」
strings.translated:
Ren
"If you truly care about her, you should leave that house as soon as possible."

strings.text:
アゲハと離れたくないという想いが、夢美の口を噤ま
せる。
strings.translated: The desire not to be separated from Ageha sealed Yumemi's lips shut.

strings.text:
レンの言っていることは分かるが、今の夢美にとって
アゲハと離れた生活など何の価値もなかった。
strings.translated: She understood what Ren was saying, but to Yumemi right now, a life apart from Ageha held no value whatsoever.

strings.text:
そんな想いを感じ取ったのかどうか、レンが小さく
吐息を漏らして口を開く。
strings.translated: Whether he sensed those feelings or not, Ren let out a small breath and opened his mouth.

strings.text:
レン
「あの蟲を手放せば、貴女を狙う理由がなくなる可能
　性はあります」
strings.translated:
Ren
"If you were to give up that Bug, there is a possibility that the reason for targeting you would disappear."

strings.text:
レン
「あの連中の目的は、貴女自身よりも蟲のほうでしょ
　うから、貴女が蟲を手放せば狙われなくなる可能性
　は十分に考えられます」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Those people's goal is likely the Bug itself rather than you personally -- so if you give up the Bug, there is every reason to think you would no longer be targeted."

strings.text:
レン
「蟲はどうしましたか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"What has become of the Bug?"

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲は……蟲の研究をしてる人がいて、今はその人の
　ところにいってるはず…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"The Bug... there's someone who researches Bugs, and it should be with them right now..."

strings.text: 夢美の話を聞いて、レンが怪訝そうな表情を浮かべた。
strings.translated: Hearing Yumemi's words, Ren's expression shifted to one of suspicion.

strings.text:
夢美
「なんか、そういう事をしてる人達がいるみたいで、
　私の蟲を見てみたいって言ってきたから……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Apparently there are people who do that sort of thing, and they said they wanted to take a look at my Bug, so..."

strings.text:
夢美
「一週間くらいで返してくれるらしいんだけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"They said they'd return it in about a week, but..."

strings.text:
自分で言いながら、夢美はだんだんと不安になってき
た。
strings.translated: As she said it herself, Yumemi began to feel increasingly uneasy.

strings.text:
もしかすると、自分はとんでもない事を仕出かしてし
まったのではないかと、胸がざわつき始める。
strings.translated: A restless feeling stirred in her chest -- the thought that perhaps she had done something truly terrible.

strings.text:
アゲハの言葉を信じないわけではないが、思案するよ
うな仕草のレンを見ていると、急に蟲に会いたくなっ
てしまった。
strings.translated: She didn't distrust Ageha's word, but watching Ren stand there as if lost in thought, she suddenly found herself desperately wanting to see the Bug.

strings.text:
夢美
「や、やっぱり、やめたほうがいかな」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"M-maybe I should... call it off after all."

strings.text:
レン
「やめたほうがいいでしょうね」

レン
「あとの事はこちらで処理します」
strings.translated:
Ren
"We will handle things from here."

strings.text: それだけ言って、レンがきびすを返す。
strings.translated: With only those words, Ren turned on his heel.

strings.text:
重要なのは蟲の所在であって、夢美のことは二の次と
いった態度だった。
strings.translated: His attitude made it clear that what mattered was the Bug's whereabouts -- Yumemi herself was an afterthought.

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲は……私のマンションに…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"The Bug is... at my apartment............"

strings.text:
レン
「では、あの蟲は僕が回収しようと思いますが、問題
　はありませんか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Then, I intend to retrieve that Bug myself -- do you have any objections?"

strings.text: レンに問われて、夢美はしばらく逡巡した。
strings.translated: Asked so directly, Yumemi hesitated for a moment.

strings.text:
回収するという事は、もうあの蟲とは自由に会えない
という事だ。
strings.translated: Retrieval meant she would no longer be able to see that Bug freely.

strings.text:
当然、寂しくはあったが、満足に世話のできない今を
考えれば、レンに預かってもらっていたほうがずっと
安心はできる。
strings.translated: Naturally, that saddened her -- but given that she couldn't properly care for it right now, leaving it in Ren's keeping would be far more reassuring.

strings.text:
それに、他の蟲と一緒にいたほうが、あの蟲も寂しく
ないかもしれない。
strings.translated: Besides, being with other Bugs might mean that one wouldn't feel so lonely either.

strings.text:
誰もいないマンションで過ごさせるよりは、ずっと蟲
のためになるような気がした。
strings.translated: It seemed far better for the Bug than leaving it alone in an empty apartment.

strings.text:
夢美
「その、一つだけ条件……じゃなくて、お願いがある
　んだけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Um... just one condition -- no, not a condition, a request..."

strings.text:
夢美
「あのコを戦いの道具にはしないでほしいの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Please don't turn that little one into a tool for fighting."

strings.text:
夢美
「できれば蟲が安心してくらせる森とか、そういうと
　ころで飼ってあげてほしい」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"If possible, I want you to keep it somewhere it can live in peace -- a forest, or somewhere like that."

strings.text:
レン
「随分と勝手な言い草ですね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"That's quite a selfish thing to ask."

strings.text: 何を言われても文句は言えない。
strings.translated: She had no right to complain, whatever he said.

strings.text:
レンの指示を無視して、アゲハの家に転がり込んだの
は、夢美が現実から逃げたからなのだ。
strings.translated: It was Yumemi who had ignored Ren's instructions and fled to Ageha's home -- running away from reality.

strings.text: それを、忘れたわけではない。

だが、それでも、夢美はあの蟲が戦いの道具にはなっ
てほしくなかった。
strings.translated: But even so, Yumemi couldn't help but wish that the Bug would never become a tool for fighting.

strings.text:
やがて、これ以上話しても無駄だと考えたのか、レン
が微かに頷いた。
strings.translated: Eventually, as if deciding there was no point in talking further, Ren gave a faint nod.

strings.text:
レン
「それでは、失礼します」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Well then, if you'll excuse me."

strings.text:
きびすを返して、レンがＡｎｚＵとは反対の方向へと
去って行く。
strings.translated: He turned on his heel and walked away in the direction opposite AnzU.

strings.text:
夢美はその背中を見つめながら、もう会うこともない
であろう蟲のことを想った。
strings.translated: Yumemi watched his retreating figure and thought of the Bug she would likely never see again.

strings.text:
夢美
「ごめんね……さよなら…………」

アゲハ
「先輩、掃除済みましたか？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Senpai, are you done with the cleaning?"

strings.text:
レンが立ち去ってから程なくして、店内からアゲハが
出てきた。
strings.translated: Shortly after Ren left, Ageha came out from inside the shop.

strings.text:
辺りを見回して全く掃除が済んでない状況を見ると、
不思議そうに首を傾げる。
strings.translated: She looked around, and seeing that the cleaning was nowhere near finished, tilted her head in puzzlement.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「夢ちゃん、寝てた？」

夢美
「こんなところでどうやって寝るのよ……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"How would I even sleep out here..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「じゃあ、やっぱり風のせい？
　今日は掃除するだけ無駄かもしれないね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Then it really is the wind's fault?
Maybe cleaning today is just a waste of time."

strings.text:
夢美の声に元気がない事に気付いたのだろう、アゲハ
が心配そうな様子で話しかけてくる。
strings.translated: She must have noticed that Yumemi's voice lacked its usual energy -- Ageha approached with a worried look.

strings.text:
夢美は、どう答えたものかと迷ったが、結局精一杯の
笑顔を浮かべてごまかす事にした。
strings.translated: Yumemi wasn't sure how to answer, but in the end she decided to put on the best smile she could and brush it off.

strings.text:
夢美
「ううん、何でもない」

アゲハが何か言おうとしたところで、夢美はいきなり
正面から抱きついた。
strings.translated: Just as Ageha was about to say something, Yumemi suddenly threw her arms around her from the front.

strings.text:
アゲハがよろめきながら慌てるが、夢美を押しのけよ
うとはしない。
strings.translated: Ageha stumbled and flustered, but made no move to push Yumemi away.

strings.text:
店の前であるため周りの様子を気にしながらも、そっ
と夢美の背中に手を回した。
strings.translated: Mindful of their surroundings since they were in front of the shop, she gently wrapped her arms around Yumemi's back.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「夢ちゃん、やっぱり変……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Yume-chan, something really is off with you..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「へっ！？　な、なに、突然！？」

アゲハ
「ま、まぁ……いいけど…………」

ちょうど辺りに誰もいない事を確認しながら、アゲハ
が戸惑いながら頷く。
strings.translated: Checking that no one was around, Ageha gave a flustered nod.

strings.text:
夢美がゆっくりと顔を寄せて、アゲハが目をつぶって、
二人はほんの数秒間だけ互いの唇を重ね合わせた。
strings.translated: Yumemi slowly leaned in, Ageha closed her eyes, and for just a few seconds the two pressed their lips together.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「は、んふぅ……む、ちゅうぅ…………」

夢美
「んっ、れろっ……ふ、はあぁぁ…………」

僅かに口を開けて、アゲハの口内で舌を絡めて、夢美
は暫く至福の時を楽しんだ。
strings.translated: Parting her lips slightly, Yumemi twined her tongue with Ageha's inside her mouth, savoring the blissful moment for a while.

strings.text:
この温もりと感触があれば、他には何も要らないと
本気で思った。
strings.translated: She genuinely felt that as long as she had this warmth and this feeling, she needed nothing else.

strings.text: 息が苦しくなったところで、二人は自然と顔を離した。
strings.translated: When breathing became difficult, the two naturally drew apart.

strings.text: 辺りを確認してみるが、誰かに見られた様子はない。
strings.translated: She glanced around, but it didn't seem like anyone had seen them.

strings.text:
アゲハの顔がほのかに赤くなっているのを見て、夢美
は思わず吹き出してしまった。
strings.translated: Seeing Ageha's face flushed a faint shade of red, Yumemi couldn't help but burst out laughing.

strings.text:
夢美
「何でもない。アゲハが可愛かったから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Nothing. You were just so cute, Ageha."

strings.text:
笑顔のまま言って、もう一度レンが立ち去った方向に
目をやる。
strings.translated: Still smiling, she cast her gaze once more in the direction Ren had gone.

strings.text:
もはや夢美にできる事はないが、せめてあの蟲が幸せ
に過ごせますようにと、胸の奥で祈りを捧げた。
strings.translated: There was nothing more Yumemi could do, but deep in her heart she offered a quiet prayer -- that that Bug might live out its days in happiness.

strings.text:
それが、『母親』として、夢美がしてやれる最後のこ
とだった……。
strings.translated: That was the last thing Yumemi could do... as a "mother."

strings.text: レンとの接触から、さらに数日が経過した……。
strings.translated: Several more days passed since that encounter...

strings.text:
毎日の生活はそれなりに安定していて、アゲハとの
関係も比較的上手くいっている。
strings.translated: Daily life had settled into a comfortable rhythm, and things with Ageha were going relatively well.

strings.text:
先日、『卵焼きにマヨネーズをかけるかどうか』で
初めて喧嘩をしたが、すぐに仲直りもできた。
strings.translated: The other day they had their first fight -- over whether or not to put mayonnaise on tamagoyaki -- but they made up quickly.

strings.text:
ＡｎｚＵでの仕事も役割を分担できるようになってき
て、アゲハも立派なウェイトレスになりつつあった。
strings.translated: At AnzU, they had begun dividing up their duties, and Ageha was well on her way to becoming a proper waitress.

strings.text: 二人のベッドは、相変わらず一つだった。
strings.translated: Their bed was still just the one, as always.

strings.text:
一緒に寝るのが苦ではないからと言うのもあるが、
体を重ねない日がほぼ皆無だったからだ。
strings.translated: Part of it was that neither of them minded sharing, but there were almost no nights when they didn't end up tangled together.

strings.text:
昼は友達、夜は恋人といった関係が、ゆっくりとだが
確実に出来上がりつつある。
strings.translated: A relationship of friends by day and lovers by night was slowly but surely taking shape.

strings.text:
気にしていた『危険』については、今のところそれら
しい気配はなかった。
strings.translated: As for the "danger" she had been worried about, there had been no sign of anything like that for the time being.

strings.text: 何もかもが順調に流れていた。

この時間が永遠に続いて欲しいと思うほどに、夢美の
日常は今までになく満たされていた。
strings.translated: Yumemi's everyday life was more fulfilled than it had ever been -- so much so that she wished this time could go on forever.

strings.text:
恋をしていると言っていいのか、愛を育んでいると
言っていいのか。
strings.translated: Whether it was right to call it falling in love, or right to call it nurturing something deeper -- she wasn't sure.

strings.text:
どちらとも正しいようで、どちらとも間違っているよ
うな気もする。
strings.translated: Both felt correct somehow, and yet both felt somehow wrong.

strings.text:
ただ、確かに言えることは、夢美にとって九条アゲハ
という存在は、なくてはならないものになっている事
だった……。
strings.translated: But one thing she could say for certain was that Kujou Ageha had become someone Yumemi simply could not do without...

strings.text: 真鈴ヶ崎の町を歩きながら、夢美がうんと伸びをした。
strings.translated: Yumemi stretched her arms up high as she walked through the streets of Masuzugasaki.
A lazy afternoon on a day off ----.

strings.text:
夢美はアゲハとともに町に出て、ブラブラとあちこち
を歩き回っていた。
strings.translated: Yumemi had come out into town with Ageha, and the two were wandering here and there without any particular destination.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「夢ちゃん、楽しそうだね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You look like you're having fun, Yume-chan."

strings.text:
夢美
「そりゃあ初めてのデートだしね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well, it is our first date, after all."

strings.text:
『デート』という響きに、夢美は思わず顔がほころん
だ。
strings.translated: The word "date" made Yumemi's face break into an involuntary smile.

strings.text:
今日はアゲハと『恋人』として町に出た初めての日で、
それ故に朝からテンションも高い。
strings.translated: Today was the first day she had gone out into town with Ageha as her "girlfriend," and her mood had been high since morning because of it.

strings.text:
二人で手を繋いで町を歩くだけで、心臓がドキドキし
て破裂しそうだった。
strings.translated: Just walking through town hand in hand, her heart was pounding so hard she thought it might burst.

strings.text:
夢美
「映画、何時からだっけ？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"What time does the movie start again?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「え～っと、確か三時じゃなかったっけ？」

夢美
「あんまり時間ないね。急ごうか」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"We don't have much time. Should we hurry?"

strings.text: 早足で映画館へと向かう。
strings.translated: They quickened their pace toward the movie theater.

strings.text:
内容はごくありふれたアクション物らしいのだが、
アゲハが「見たいなぁ」とつぶやいた一言で行く事
が決定した。
strings.translated: The film was apparently a fairly run-of-the-mill action movie, but the decision to go had been made the moment Ageha murmured, "I'd love to see that."

strings.text:
正直、夢美はあまり好みではなかったが、アゲハが
喜んでくれるのならそれが一番なのだ。
strings.translated: Honestly, it wasn't really Yumemi's taste, but if it made Ageha happy, that was all that mattered.

strings.text:
早足で歩いているとき、ふとアゲハのほうを見ると、
大きな胸がゆっさゆっさと揺れていた。
strings.translated: As they walked at a brisk pace, she happened to glance over at Ageha and noticed her large chest swaying with every step.

strings.text:
夢美
「やっぱりアゲハの胸っておっきいなぁ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ageha's chest really is huge, isn't it."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「へっ？　や、もぉ……エッチ…………」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Huh? Geez... you're such a perv..."

strings.text: 本気で照れたように言って、アゲハが両手で胸を隠す。
strings.translated: She said it as though genuinely embarrassed, covering her chest with both hands.

strings.text:
その仕草がまた可愛らしくて、夢美は思わず抱き締め
たくなる衝動に駆られた。
strings.translated: That gesture was so adorable that Yumemi was seized by an almost irresistible urge to pull her into a hug.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「前にも言ったけど、アタシは夢ちゃんくらいが
　良かったんだよ？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I've said it before, but I always wished I was more like Yume-chan's size, you know?"

strings.text:
夢美
「そんなにいいかなぁ」
自分の体をしげしげと眺めて、夢美が首を傾げる。
strings.translated: Yumemi tilted her head, looking herself over with a critical eye.

strings.text:
揉めばそれなりに弾力は返ってくるが、アゲハの胸の
柔らかさを知ってしまうと、やはり物足りない。
strings.translated: When she squeezed, there was some give -- but having felt how soft Ageha's chest was, it just didn't compare.

strings.text: 一度でいいから、俗に言う巨乳になってみたかった。
strings.translated: Just once, she had wanted to know what it felt like to have what people called a big chest.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「胸なんか大きくても、なんにもいいことないよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Having a big chest doesn't do you any good, you know."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ううん、何でもない」
笑顔で首を横に振って、アゲハが夢美の手を取る。
strings.translated: Shaking her head with a smile, Ageha took Yumemi's hand.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「さっ、早く行こっ！」

二人は笑顔を交し合って、映画館へと駆けて行っ
た……。
strings.translated: The two exchanged smiles and ran off toward the movie theater...

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ん～、面白かったぁ～」
映画館を出たところで、アゲハがうんと伸びをした。
strings.translated: Ageha stretched her arms up high as they stepped out of the movie theater.

strings.text:
顔は興奮気味で、どうやら十分に満足することができ
たらしい。
strings.translated: Her face was flushed with excitement -- she had clearly gotten more than her fill.

strings.text:
映画の内容は、夢美が思っていたよりもアクション
中心で、終始女の子が銃と刀を振り回していたが、
それなりに楽しむことはできた。
strings.translated: The movie had been far more action-heavy than Yumemi had expected, with a girl swinging guns and swords around from start to finish, but she had managed to enjoy it well enough.

strings.text:
唯一問題だったのは、敵であるゾンビやモンスターが
非常にリアルだったため、時々本気で怖かったことな
のだが……。
strings.translated: The one problem was that the enemy zombies and monsters had been disturbingly realistic, which had genuinely scared her more than once...

strings.text:
アゲハ
「来年は２もあるみたいだし、また来ようねっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Looks like there's going to be a Part 2 next year -- let's come back for that too!"

strings.text: 多少無理をして笑顔を作る。

アゲハと映画に行きたくないわけではないが、出来れ
ばもう少しソフトな内容のほうが好ましい。
strings.translated: It wasn't that she didn't want to go to the movies with Ageha -- she just would have preferred something a little less intense.

strings.text:
とりあえず頷きはしたものの、来年の『２』とやらの
内容が、やや不安だった。
strings.translated: She had nodded along for now, but she was a little anxious about what this "Part 2" next year might have in store.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「……で、これからどうしよっか？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"...So, what do you want to do now?"

strings.text:
夢美
「適当にお店でも見て回る？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Want to just browse some shops?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「うん、アタシはいいよ」
以前と同じく、アゲハと二人で町を回る。
strings.translated: Just like before, the two of them wandered through town together.

strings.text:
これといって買うものはなかったが、ブラブラと歩き
ながら興味のあるものを見つけてはその店に入る、を
繰り返した。
strings.translated: There wasn't anything in particular they needed to buy, but they kept walking at a leisurely pace, ducking into whatever store caught their eye, over and over again.
In other words, they were just window shopping.

strings.text:
もちろん、本当に欲しいものがあれば買うのだが、
今日のところは何も見つからなかった。
strings.translated: Of course, if they found something they truly wanted, they would buy it -- but today, nothing turned up.

strings.text: ただ、ファッションショップに入ったとき――――
strings.translated: Though, when they stepped into a fashion shop --

strings.text:
アゲハ
「夢ちゃん、こんなのどう？　超ミニのスカート」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Yume-chan, what do you think of this? A super-mini skirt."

strings.text:
夢美
「それ、歩いててもほとんど見えちゃうと思うんだけ
　ど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm pretty sure you'd be showing everything just walking around in that..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「そこはホラ、見せてＯＫなのってあるじゃない」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Oh come on, there are ways to make that okay, you know."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「夢ちゃんってスカート履かないの？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Do you not wear skirts, Yume-chan?"

strings.text:
夢美
「ん～、ジーパンとかのが楽だから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Hmm, jeans and stuff are just more comfortable."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「そっか～。似合うと思ったんだけど」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Aw, too bad~. I thought it would suit you."

strings.text:
アゲハが選んだのは、ヒラヒラが付いた非常に短い
スカートだった。
strings.translated: What Ageha had picked out was an extremely short skirt with frilly layers.

strings.text:
下着が見えそうだという点を差し引いても、あまり
自分に似合う気はしない。
strings.translated: Even setting aside the fact that it looked like it would show her underwear, she couldn't really picture it suiting her.

strings.text:

脚をもぞもぞと動かすと、無意味に勃起した肉棒が
感じられて眉根を寄せた。
strings.translated: When she shifted her legs restlessly, she became aware of a meaningless erection pressing against her, and she furrowed her brow.

strings.text: もしかすると、原因はこれのせいなのではないか。
strings.translated: Could this be the cause of it all?

strings.text:
長い時間付けっぱなしにすると、体調に異変を来たす
のではないか。
strings.translated: Perhaps leaving it attached for too long was throwing her body into disorder.

strings.text:
多分に推測の域は出なかったが、他に考えられそうな
原因が見当たらなかった。
strings.translated: It was largely speculation, but she couldn't think of any other likely cause.

strings.text: 涙の混じった声で、愛しい人物の名前を呼ぶ。
strings.translated: In a tearful voice, she called the name of the one she loved.

strings.text:
それでアゲハが戻って来てくれるとは思わないが、
声に出さずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: She didn't think that would bring Ageha back, but she couldn't help saying it aloud.

strings.text:
これから自分がどうなるのか分からず、胸の奥から
恐怖が込み上げてきた。
strings.translated: She had no idea what was going to happen to her, and fear welled up from somewhere deep in her chest.

strings.text:
祈るように吐き出された言葉は、部屋の天井に吸い込
まれて消えた。
strings.translated: The words, breathed out like a prayer, were swallowed by the ceiling of the room and vanished.

strings.text:
アゲハが帰ってきたのは、午後十一時を回ってから
だった……。
strings.translated: Ageha didn't return until well past eleven o'clock at night...

strings.text:
一夜が明けても、夢美の体は一向に回復する兆しを
見せなかった。
strings.translated: Even after a full night had passed, Yumemi's body showed no sign of recovering.

strings.text:
手足の先には痺れたような感覚が付きまとい、微熱が
続いている。
strings.translated: A numb sensation clung to the tips of her hands and feet, and a low fever persisted.

strings.text:
重病と言うわけではなかったが、ベッドから起き上
がって歩き回れるほど楽な状態でもなかった。
strings.translated: It wasn't exactly a serious illness, but she was far from well enough to get out of bed and walk around.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「夢ちゃん、具合どう？」

アゲハ
「お粥作ったけど、食べられる？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I made some rice porridge -- do you think you can eat?"

strings.text:
ベッドの上で上半身だけを起こして、アゲハの作った
お粥を口に運ぶ。
strings.translated: She propped herself up in bed and brought the rice porridge Ageha had made to her lips.

strings.text:
痺れが舌まで回っているのか、よく味が分からなかっ
たが、できるだけ美味しそうに食べることにした。
strings.translated: Whether the numbness had spread to her tongue she wasn't sure, but she couldn't taste it well -- still, she decided to eat as though it were delicious.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「とにかく、薬飲んで大人しくしてること」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"For now, take your medicine and stay put."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「お昼休みには、ご飯作りに帰って来るから」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I'll come back at lunch to make you something to eat."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それじゃ、行ってきます」

夢美
「行ってらっしゃい」

ギリギリまで夢美を看病したあと、アゲハは忙しなく
部屋を出て行った。
strings.translated: After tending to Yumemi until the very last moment, Ageha hurried out of the room.

strings.text: 時計を見ると、いつもより二十分も遅い。
strings.translated: Glancing at the clock, she saw it was twenty minutes later than usual.

strings.text:
走れば何とか間に合う時間ではあるが、アゲハにそん
な苦労をさせてしまった自分に、夢美は微かな苛立ち
を感じていた。
strings.translated: It was still early enough to make it if she ran, but Yumemi felt a faint irritation at herself for having put Ageha through such trouble.

strings.text:
夢美
「これ、蟲の、せいじゃ……ない、よね……？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"This isn't... because of the Bug... is it... ?"

strings.text:
そっと股間に手を伸ばしてみると、そこには相変わら
ず怒張した肉棒が引っ付いていた。
strings.translated: She gently reached a hand toward her groin, and found the same swollen erection still clinging there.

strings.text:
アゲハは既に「先生」に連絡してくれたらしいが、
蟲を引き剥がすための薬を作るのに二、三日掛かる
のだという。
strings.translated: Ageha had apparently already contacted "Sensei," but it would take two or three days to prepare the medicine needed to remove the Bug.

strings.text:
予定では、明日か明後日には薬が届けられるらしいの
だが、それは今の夢美にとって途方もなく長い時間だ
った。
strings.translated: According to the plan, the medicine would arrive tomorrow or the day after -- but to Yumemi in her current state, that felt like an impossibly long time.

strings.text:
飲んだ風邪薬が効いてきたのか、急に強い眠気が襲っ
てきた。
strings.translated: Perhaps the cold medicine she had taken was kicking in -- a sudden, powerful drowsiness washed over her.

strings.text: 頭の奥がグラグラ揺れて、視界が二重になっていく。
strings.translated: The back of her head swayed and spun, and her vision began to double.

strings.text:
すぐに目を閉じて何も見ないことにしたが、今度は
重い頭痛がし始めて、最後には耳鳴りさえ聞こえる
ようになっていった。
strings.translated: She closed her eyes at once and tried to shut everything out, but a heavy headache set in, and eventually she even began to hear a ringing in her ears.

strings.text:
夢美
（これ、風邪じゃないかも……）
strings.translated:
Yumemi
(This might not be a cold after all...)

strings.text:
アゲハには風邪だと言って風邪薬を飲んだのだが、
どうもそれにしては症状が違う。
strings.translated: She had told Ageha it was a cold and taken cold medicine accordingly, but the symptoms didn't quite match.

strings.text:
上手くは説明できないが、何かが体の中に染み込んで
くるような感覚がして気分が悪かった。
strings.translated: She couldn't explain it well, but there was a sensation of something seeping into her body, and it made her feel ill.

strings.text:
夢美
（早く、治らないかなぁ……）
strings.translated:
Yumemi
(I hope it gets better soon...)

strings.text:
直接脳が揺さぶられているような感覚に耐えながら、
夢美は深い眠りに落ちていった……。
strings.translated: Enduring the sensation of her brain being shaken directly from within, Yumemi sank into a deep sleep...

strings.text:
夢美が目を覚ましたとき、部屋の照明が明るい光を
放っていた。
strings.translated: When Yumemi awoke, the room's light was casting a bright glow.

strings.text:
視線を窓に移すとカーテンが掛かっていて、壁の時計
は１１の数字を指している。
strings.translated: She turned her gaze to the window and saw the curtains were drawn; the clock on the wall pointed to the number 11.

strings.text:
最初は意味が分からず、ぼんやりと時計を見つめるし
かなかった。
strings.translated: At first she couldn't make sense of it, and could only stare blankly at the clock.

strings.text:
アゲハが出て行ってからまだ二、三時間ほどしか経っ
ていないはずなのだが、それにしては何かが大きく
違っている。
strings.translated: It had only been two or three hours since Ageha left -- or so it should have been, yet something felt drastically off.

strings.text:
暫く考えたあと、窓の外が夜になっている事に気付い
て、夢美はもう一度声を漏らした。
strings.translated: After thinking for a while, Yumemi noticed that outside the window it was already night, and she let out another small sound.

strings.text:
視界の外からアゲハが姿を現し、上から夢美の顔を
覗き込んでくる。
strings.translated: Ageha appeared from outside Yumemi's field of view and peered down at her face from above.

strings.text:
夢美
「う、ん……あんまり、変わらないかな？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Mm, yeah... not much better, I think?"

strings.text: アゲハが残念そうに肩を落とす。
strings.translated: Ageha let her shoulders drop with a look of disappointment.

strings.text:
そして、困ったような笑みを浮かべながら、夢美を
励ますように言った。
strings.translated: Then, with a troubled smile, she spoke as if to encourage Yumemi.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ずっと寝てたから、それで体が疲れちゃったのかも
　ね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You were sleeping this whole time, so maybe that's what wore your body out."

strings.text:
アゲハにしてみれば、何気ない一言だったのかもしれ
ない。
strings.translated: For Ageha, it may have been nothing more than a casual remark.

strings.text:
夢美を励まそうと、無難な言葉を探してきたのかもし
れない。
strings.translated: Perhaps she had searched for a safe thing to say in order to cheer Yumemi up.

strings.text:
だが、それは今の夢美にとって、絶対に聞き流すこと
のできない言葉だった。
strings.translated: But for Yumemi as she was now, those were words she absolutely could not let pass without notice.

Yumemi
"This whole time... I was sleeping...............?"
She hadn't been aware of it at all.

strings.text: 寝ていたという感覚すらなかった。
strings.translated: She didn't even have the sensation of having slept.

strings.text:
まるで、時間が吹っ飛んでしまったような感覚が胸を
かすめていく。
strings.translated: It was as if a chunk of time had simply been blown away -- that feeling grazed her chest.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「もう遅いけど、何か食べる？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"It's late, but do you want something to eat?"

strings.text:
アゲハに問われて、夢美は自分が空腹を感じているこ
とに気付いた。
strings.translated: Asked by Ageha, Yumemi realized she was feeling hungry.

strings.text:
今の今まで寝ていたのであれば、十二時間以上何も
食べていない事になる。
strings.translated: If she had truly been sleeping all this time, it meant she hadn't eaten anything for over twelve hours.

strings.text:
だが、食欲があるかと言えばそうでもなくて、結局
朝と同じようにお粥を頼んだ。
strings.translated: Even so, she couldn't quite say she had an appetite, and in the end she asked for porridge, just like she had in the morning.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「オッケー、ちょっと待っててね」
パッと笑顔を浮かべて、アゲハが部屋を出て行く。
strings.translated: Flashing a bright smile, Ageha left the room.

strings.text: その様子は、いつものアゲハと何ら変わりがない。
strings.translated: Her manner was no different from the usual Ageha.

strings.text:
朝起きて、ＡｎｚＵに行って、仕事をして、帰ってく
る。
strings.translated: Waking up in the morning, going to AnzU, working, coming home.

strings.text:
いつもと同じ生活をしたアゲハの姿が、ごく普通に
あった。
strings.translated: Ageha, who had spent the day just as she always did, was simply there, perfectly ordinary.

strings.text:
全く眠った気がせず、疲れなど一向にとれていなかっ
た。
strings.translated: She felt not the slightest sense of having slept, and her fatigue had not lifted in the least.

strings.text: 普通ではない時間の経過……。

だが、これが誰かのイタズラなどではなく、確かに窓
の外が夜になっているのは、カーテン越しにも確認す
ることができた。
strings.translated: Yet this was no one's prank -- she could confirm through the curtains that it was indeed night outside the window.

strings.text:
夢美
「腕に……変な模様……できてる……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"On my arm... there's a strange mark..."

strings.text:
ふと、自分の腕を見て、そこに奇妙な模様ができてい
る事に気付いた。
strings.translated: Glancing at her own arm, she suddenly noticed a peculiar pattern had formed there.

strings.text:
いや、それは模様というよりは、腕の皮膚が微かに
黒く変色したもののようにも見える。
strings.translated: No -- it was less a pattern and more a faint darkening of the skin on her arm, as if it had discolored slightly black.

strings.text:
指先で擦ってみたが、それで色が薄くなることはな
かった……。
strings.translated: She tried rubbing it with her fingertip, but the color did not fade...

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ん～、疲れてるだけじゃないのかなぁ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Hmm, couldn't it just be that you're tired?"

strings.text:
アゲハに相談してみても、返ってきた答えは月並みと
言えば月並みだった。
strings.translated: Even when she consulted Ageha, the answer she got back was, if anything, perfectly ordinary.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アタシも、ちょっと寝るだけのつもりだったのに、
　気付いたら何時間も経ってたことあるし」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I mean, I've had times where I only meant to sleep for a bit and then suddenly hours had gone by before I knew it."

strings.text:
夢美
「うん……でも、そうじゃなくて…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yeah... but that's not quite it..............."

strings.text: 詳しく説明しようと思ったがやめた。
strings.translated: She had thought to explain in more detail, but stopped herself.

strings.text: きっとこの感覚は、体験してみなければ分からない。
strings.translated: This feeling was probably something you couldn't understand unless you'd experienced it yourself.

strings.text:
深く寝ていたのではなく、寝ていたという事実を感じ
取れないのだ。
strings.translated: It wasn't that she had slept deeply -- it was that she couldn't perceive the very fact of having slept at all.

strings.text: ただ、疲れているのとはわけが違った。
strings.translated: That was something altogether different from simply being tired.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それより、腕の痣のほうが気になるね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"More than that, the bruise on your arm is what worries me."

strings.text: 変色した腕を見て、アゲハが心配そうに眉根を寄せる。
strings.translated: Looking at the discolored arm, Ageha furrowed her brow with concern.

strings.text:
今のところ痛みや痒みといった症状はないが、不気味
な痣であることに違いはなかった。
strings.translated: There was no pain or itching at the moment, but it was an unsettling bruise all the same.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「いつできたか分かんないんだよね？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You don't know when it appeared?"

strings.text:
夢美
「昨日はなかったと思うけど…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I don't think it was there yesterday, but..............."

strings.text:
昨日は気付かなかっただけで、少しずつ変色していた
という可能性もゼロではない。
strings.translated: There was also the possibility -- not zero -- that she simply hadn't noticed it yesterday and it had been gradually discoloring all along.

strings.text:
病院に行くことも考えたが、何でもないことを大袈裟
に扱おうとしているだけのような気もして、口には出
さなかった。
strings.translated:
She had considered going to the hospital, but it felt like she was making
a big deal out of nothing, so she kept the thought to herself.

strings.text:
アゲハもまた同じだったのか、病院に行こうとは言い
出さなかった……。
strings.translated: Ageha must have felt the same way -- she never suggested going to the hospital either....

strings.text: これが、変化の始まりだった……。
strings.translated: This was where the changes began....

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それじゃあ、アタシ、もう行かないといけないか
　ら」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Well, I have to get going now."

strings.text:
身支度を済ませたアゲハが、ベッドに寝たままの夢美
に向かって声を掛けた。
strings.translated: Ageha, having finished getting ready, called out to Yumemi, who was still lying in bed.

strings.text:
夢美
「うん……行ってらっしゃい…………」

アゲハ
「ホントに大丈夫？
　アタシ、今日休んだほうが良くない？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Are you sure you're okay?
Maybe I should stay home today?"

strings.text:
夢美
「だい、じょぶ……薬、飲んで……おとなしく、して
　るから……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm... fine... I'll take my medicine... and rest quietly..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「う、ん……調子悪かったらお店に連絡してね？
　すぐに帰って来るから」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"O-okay... but if you feel worse, call the shop, alright?
I'll come right home."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それじゃ、行ってきます」

心配そうな視線を残しながら、アゲハが部屋を出て行
く。
strings.translated: Ageha left the room, casting one last worried glance behind her.

strings.text:
夢美も、本音を言えば傍に居てもらいたかったのだが、
とても口に出すことはできなかった。
strings.translated: Truthfully, Yumemi wanted her to stay -- but she could never bring herself to say it.

strings.text: 体の調子は相変わらず悪い。
strings.translated: Her body still felt no better.

strings.text:
微熱は今も続いており、起きている間は頭痛にも悩ま
された。
strings.translated: The low-grade fever persisted, and a headache plagued her throughout her waking hours.

strings.text: 体の変調を感じ始めてから三日目――――。
strings.translated: Three days since she first began to feel something was wrong with her body--------.

strings.text: ただの風邪にしては治りが遅すぎる。
strings.translated: It was taking far too long to recover for a simple cold.

strings.text:
本当は病院に行くべきなのかもしれないが、いつも
昼間は寝てしまうため機会を逸していた。
strings.translated:
She knew she probably should go to the hospital,
but she kept sleeping through the daytime and missing her chance.

strings.text:
夢美
（私、どうしちゃったんだろう……）
独りになると、急に不安が押し寄せてくる。
strings.translated: Alone, a sudden wave of anxiety washed over her.

strings.text:
自分がこのまま深い眠りについて、もう二度と目を
覚まさないのではないかと、そんな思考に陥っていく。
strings.translated: She found herself sinking into the thought that she might drift off into a deep sleep and never wake again.

strings.text:
いずれアゲハが帰って来るのだから、そんな事にはな
らないと言い聞かせても、胸の奥で燻る不安感は拭い
きれなかった。
strings.translated: She told herself that Ageha would be back eventually, so it couldn't come to that -- but the unease smoldering in her chest refused to go away.

strings.text: ベッドの傍らに立っている、一人の男の姿――――。
strings.translated: The figure of a man, standing at the side of her bed--------.

strings.text:
最初は夢でも見ているのかと思ったが、レンは確かに
そこに存在していた。
strings.translated: At first she thought she might be dreaming, but Ren was unmistakably there.

strings.text:
レン
「これから一族の村へ戻るので、その事を伝えに寄っ
　たのですが……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I came to tell you that I'll be returning to the clan's village soon, but..."

strings.text:
奇怪な変化を遂げつつある夢美を見て、レンは微かに
目を細めていた。
strings.translated: Seeing Yumemi, who was undergoing such strange changes, Ren narrowed his eyes ever so slightly.

strings.text:
怒っているような、それでいて呆れているような、
そんな複雑な表情に見える。
strings.translated: He looked angry somehow -- and yet also exasperated. A complicated expression.

strings.text:
レン
「誰がやりましたか？」

レン
「貴女をこんな姿にしたのは……一緒に住んでいる
　女性ですか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"The one who left you in this state... is it the woman you live with?"

strings.text: 問われている事の意味が分からない。
strings.translated: She didn't understand what he was asking.

strings.text: 誰が、誰に、何をしたのかと訊いているのだろう。
strings.translated: He was probably asking who had done something -- and what.

strings.text:
――などと考えていると、急にレンが思いも寄らない
行動を取った。
strings.translated: As she was turning that over in her mind, Ren suddenly did something she never expected.

strings.text:
夢美
「きゃっ！？　ち、ちょっと…………！！」

いきなり布団を捲り上げたレンが、夢美のパジャマに
手をかけ上着を左右に開いた。
strings.translated: He suddenly threw back the covers, grabbed the front of Yumemi's pajama top, and pulled it open to both sides.

strings.text: 夢美を見下ろすレンの表情が、明らかに硬くなる。
strings.translated: The expression on Ren's face as he looked down at Yumemi visibly hardened.

strings.text:
首から胸、腹へと視線を移動させ、さらにズボンを
下ろしてその中まで確認した。
strings.translated: His gaze traveled from her neck to her chest, then to her stomach, and he even pulled down her pants to check beneath them.

strings.text:
夢美は、もちろん恥ずかしくて堪らなかったが、鬼気
迫るレンの表情を見ていると、抵抗することができな
い……。
strings.translated: Yumemi was of course mortified, but the desperate intensity on Ren's face made it impossible for her to resist....

strings.text:
レン
「この……全身の黒い痣は…………」
strings.translated:
Ren
"These... black bruises all over your body..............."

strings.text:
夢美
「ん、なんか……少し前から出てきて…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yeah, they... started showing up a little while ago..............."

strings.text:
夢美
「治りが遅いから、やっぱり病院行ったほうがいいの
　かなって思ってるんだけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"They're taking so long to heal, I was thinking maybe I should go to the hospital after all..."

strings.text:
レン
「今すぐにでも行くべきです」
そう言ってレンが体を離す。
strings.translated: With that, Ren pulled away from her.

strings.text:
視線を窓の外に向けると、普段より低い声でつぶやい
た。
strings.translated: He turned his gaze toward the window and murmured in a lower voice than usual.

strings.text:
レン
「帰るのは、もう少し先になりそうですね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It seems my return will have to wait a little longer."

strings.text:
レン
「これは、僕の失態です」

意味の分からない言葉を残して、レンが部屋を出て行
く。
strings.translated: Leaving those cryptic words behind, Ren walked out of the room.

strings.text:
そこに、何となく不吉なものを感じはしたが、夢美に
はどうする事もできなかった。
strings.translated: She sensed something vaguely ominous in that, but there was nothing Yumemi could do.

strings.text:
それよりも、アゲハが帰ってきたら病院に連れて行っ
てもらおうと――――
strings.translated: More than anything, she thought she would ask Ageha to take her to the hospital when she got home----

strings.text: ――そんな事しか頭になかった。
strings.translated: -- That was the only thing on her mind.

strings.text:
アゲハが家に帰って来なくなってから、一週間が過ぎ
ようとしていた……。
strings.translated: A week had nearly passed since Ageha stopped coming home......

strings.text:
バイト先か、それとも帰り道か――いずれにしても
何かあったのは間違いない。
strings.translated: Whether it happened at her part-time job or on the way home -- either way, something had clearly gone wrong.

strings.text:
ＡｎｚＵには最初の日に電話を掛けてみたが、何故だ
か繋がらなかった。
strings.translated: She had tried calling AnzU on the first day, but for some reason the call wouldn't connect.

strings.text:
自分の知らないところで、しかし自分のすぐ身近で、
確実に何かが起こっている。
strings.translated: Somewhere beyond her knowledge, yet right at her side, something was definitely happening.

strings.text:
それも人命を左右するような、そんな規模の事態が
起こっている。
strings.translated: Something on a scale that could decide whether people lived or died.

strings.text:
すぐにアゲハを捜しに行きたかったが、その気持ちに
体がついて来てくれなかった。
strings.translated: She desperately wanted to go search for Ageha right away, but her body refused to follow her heart.

strings.text: 深夜になって目を覚ます。
strings.translated: She woke in the dead of night.

strings.text:
最近は、時間の感覚がバラバラで、規則正しい生活な
ど全く出来ていない。
strings.translated: Lately, her sense of time had completely fallen apart, and any semblance of a regular routine was entirely gone.

strings.text:
一日のうちの殆どをベッドで過ごし、移動する必要が
あるときは、芋虫のように床を這っていた。
strings.translated: She spent most of each day in bed, and when she needed to move, she crawled across the floor like a caterpillar.

strings.text: 当たり前だが、これは風邪の症状ではない。
strings.translated: Needless to say, these were not the symptoms of a cold.

strings.text:
夢美の想像も及ばないような重病にかかっている可能
性も、十分に考えられた。
strings.translated: It was entirely possible she had contracted some grave illness beyond anything Yumemi could imagine.

strings.text: 病院に行ったほうがいいかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe she should go to a hospital.

strings.text:
そうは思いながらも、夢美の頭の中はアゲハの事で
いっぱいだった。
strings.translated: Even as she thought that, Yumemi's mind was consumed entirely by thoughts of Ageha.

strings.text:
突然帰って来なくなった彼女に何があったのか、それ
ばかりが気になって仕方がない。
strings.translated: What had happened to her -- to make her stop coming home so suddenly -- that was all she could think about.

strings.text:
自分の体よりも、アゲハの無事を確認する事のほうが、
今の夢美にとっては重要だった。
strings.translated: Confirming that Ageha was safe mattered more to Yumemi right now than her own body.
Lately, her vision had been warping.

strings.text:
ぼやけ始めたのはもう少し前からだが、ここ数日は
見えているものがぐにゃりと折れ曲がるのだ。
strings.translated:
Things had started to blur a little while before, but over the past few days,
what she saw would twist and bend out of shape.

strings.text:
このままでは、いずれ這って移動するのでさえ困難に
なってしまうかもしれない。
strings.translated: At this rate, even crawling to move around might eventually become impossible.

strings.text:
緩やかに、しかし確実に迫ってくる死を感じて、夢美
はぶるりと体を震わせた。
strings.translated: Sensing death closing in -- slowly, but without fail -- Yumemi shuddered.

strings.text: 何かの気配を感じて、夢美は微かに首を動かした。
strings.translated: Sensing some kind of presence, Yumemi faintly turned her head.

strings.text:
自分以外の誰かが、部屋の中にいる――ような気がす
る。
strings.translated: She had the feeling that someone other than herself was in the room.

strings.text:
思わずアゲハの名前を口にしかかったが、満足に動か
ない体は、それさえも許してはくれなかった。
strings.translated: She nearly called out Ageha's name on instinct, but her body, barely able to move, would not even allow her that.

strings.text:
どこか遠くのほうから、レンの声が聞こえたような気
がした。
strings.translated: She thought she heard Ren's voice, coming from somewhere far away.

strings.text:
ぼやけて折れ曲がった世界の中に、辛うじて人間と
分かる形のものが動いている。
strings.translated: Within a world blurred and bent out of shape, something that could just barely be recognized as human was moving.

strings.text:
助けて――夢美はそう言おうとしたが、やはり声は
出てくれなかった。
strings.translated: Help me -- Yumemi tried to say it, but again, no voice would come.

strings.text:
何度も何度も繰り返したが、言葉どころか単語一つ
発音する事もできない。
strings.translated: She tried again and again, but she couldn't produce so much as a single word, let alone a full sentence.

strings.text:
夢美は、一瞬絶望にとらわれたが、すぐにレンなら
何とかしてくれるのでは、と希望を持ち直した。
strings.translated: Yumemi was seized by despair for a moment, but quickly rallied herself with the hope that Ren might be able to do something.

strings.text:
レン
「効果……ある……かりませ…………試し…………」

レンが何を言っているのか、夢美には殆ど伝わらな
かった。
strings.translated: Almost none of what Ren was saying reached Yumemi.

strings.text:
ただ、口の中に何かが入ってきている事に、暫くして
から気付いた。
strings.translated: Only after a short while did she notice that something was entering her mouth.

strings.text: 温かく、サラサラとした、液体――――。
strings.translated: Something warm, smooth, flowing -- a liquid----.

strings.text:
それは自然と夢美の喉へと流れ、体内へと入り込んで
いった。
strings.translated: It flowed naturally down Yumemi's throat and made its way inside her body.

strings.text:
一体何を飲まされたのか、もちろん夢美が分かるはず
もない。
strings.translated: Of course, there was no way Yumemi could know what she had been made to drink.

strings.text:
きっと薬だと思う一方、一思いに楽になる毒薬なので
はないかと考えた。
strings.translated: Part of her thought it must be medicine, while another part wondered if it might be a poison to put her out of her misery.

strings.text:
突然、胸がカッと熱くなったかと思うと、次の瞬間に
は声が出た。
strings.translated: Suddenly, a burning heat flared in her chest -- and in the very next moment, her voice returned.

strings.text:
夢美
「う、ぇ……けほっ……かはっ、けほけほっ！」

レン
「僕の声が聞こえますか？」

レン
「聞こえているようですね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It seems you can hear me."

strings.text:
レン
「夢美さん……貴女は、自分の状態を認識する事が
　できていますか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Yumemi-san...... are you able to recognize your own condition?"

strings.text:
夢美を思いやった言葉一つなく、レンが冷めた声で
訊ねてくる。
strings.translated: Without a single word of concern for Yumemi, Ren asked in a cold voice.

strings.text:
だが、自分の状態を知りたいのは、むしろ夢美自身
なのだ。
strings.translated: But it was Yumemi herself who wanted to know her own condition more than anyone.

strings.text:
ゆっくりと、発音を確認するようにしながら言うと、
レンは短く溜息をついたようだった。
strings.translated: She spoke slowly, as if confirming each syllable, and Ren seemed to let out a brief sigh.

strings.text: それが何を意味していたのか――――
――終ぞ、夢美が知る事はなかった。
徐々に視界が戻ってきた。
strings.translated: Her vision gradually began to return.

strings.text:
折れ曲がっていた空間が元に戻り、視界に入る物体が
くっきりとした輪郭を持ち始める。
strings.translated: The warped space straightened itself out, and the objects in her field of view began to take on sharp, clear outlines.

strings.text:
その先にいたのはやはりレンで、相変わらずの冷たい
視線で夢美を見下ろしていた。
strings.translated: Beyond them stood Ren, as expected, looking down at Yumemi with the same cold gaze as always.

strings.text: ホッとしたように、彼の名前を呼ぶ。
strings.translated: She called his name, as if in relief.

strings.text:
嬉しくて涙が出そうになって、これで助かるかもしれ
ないという希望が、胸で確かな形を持ち始めていた。
strings.translated: She was so happy she nearly cried, and the hope that she might yet be saved began to take solid shape within her chest.

strings.text:
レン
「感覚が戻ってきたようですね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It seems your senses are returning."

strings.text:
左の手のひらに無地のハンカチを巻きながら、レンが
確認するように言う。
strings.translated: Ren said, as if confirming it, while wrapping a plain handkerchief around his left palm.

strings.text:
ハンカチは真新しい血で滲んでいたが、夢美の意識は
すぐに別のところに飛んだ。
strings.translated: The handkerchief was soaked with fresh blood, but Yumemi's attention immediately leapt elsewhere.

strings.text: 必死に言葉を紡ぎ出す。
strings.translated: She desperately strung the words together.

strings.text:
レンは暫く黙っていたが、やがて意を決したように
頷いて見せた。
strings.translated: Ren was silent for a moment, but eventually gave a nod, as though he had made up his mind.

strings.text:
レン
「何か方法がないか模索してみましょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I will look into whether there is some way to help you."

strings.text:
レン
「しかし、それをするにもここでは無理です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"However, it cannot be done here."

strings.text:
レン
「貴女には、我々の村まで来ていただきます」
strings.translated:
Ren
"You will be coming with us to our village."

strings.text:
それが何を意味するのか、夢美はすぐには分からな
かった。
strings.translated: Yumemi could not immediately grasp what that meant.

strings.text: ここではないどこかへ行く……。

それが、自分にとって良い事なのかどうか、すぐに
判断を下すことができない。
strings.translated: She could not immediately judge whether that would be a good thing for her or not.

strings.text:
だが、「村に行かない」という選択肢は無いも同然で、
結局はレンに全てを任せるしかないのだった。
strings.translated:
But the option of "not going to the village" was as good as nonexistent,
and in the end, she had no choice but to leave everything in Ren's hands.

strings.text:
唯一気掛かりなのは、またアゲハと会うことができる
かどうかなのだが…………。
strings.translated: The one thing that weighed on her mind was whether she would ever be able to see Ageha again...........

strings.text:
最近は考える余裕をなくしていたが、アゲハが行方不
明になっていた事を思い出す。
strings.translated: She had not had the mental space to think about it lately, but she remembered now that Ageha had gone missing.

strings.text:
その途端、夢美の中で物事の優先度が大きく組み変
わった。
strings.translated: In that instant, the order of priorities within Yumemi shifted dramatically.

strings.text:
レンは表情を変えず問い返したが、すぐに「あぁ」と
声を漏らした。
strings.translated: Ren asked back without changing his expression, but quickly let out a quiet "Ah."

strings.text:
レン
「九条アゲハの事ですね」

レン
「彼女はもういません」
サラリ、と奇妙なことを言われた。
strings.translated: He said something strange, so casually.

strings.text:
レン
「彼女は僕のほうで処理しておきました」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I have taken care of her on my end."

strings.text:
レン
「残念ながら、Ｄｒ．Ｗｅｓｔには逃げられてしまい
　ましたが……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Unfortunately, Dr. West managed to escape, but......"

strings.text: 今、レンは何と言ったのだろう。
strings.translated: Wait -- what had Ren just said?

strings.text: 夢美の頭の中で、レンの言葉が反響を繰り返す。
strings.translated: Ren's words echoed over and over inside Yumemi's head.

strings.text: ――彼女は僕のほうで処理しておきました。
strings.translated: -- I have taken care of her on my end.

strings.text: ――かのじょはぼくのほうでしょりしておきました。
strings.translated: -- i have taken care of her on my end.

strings.text: ――カノジョハボクノホウデショリシテオキマシタ。
strings.translated: -- I HAVE TAKEN CARE OF HER ON MY END.

strings.text: ――ボクノホウデショリシテオキマシタ。
strings.translated: -- TAKEN CARE OF HER ON MY END.

strings.text: ざわっ、と夢美の中で血が滾った。
strings.translated: With a shudder, the blood surged within Yumemi.

strings.text:
鈍っていた全神経が、急速な勢いで本来の感覚を取り
戻し始める。
strings.translated: Every nerve that had gone numb began rapidly reclaiming its original sensation.

strings.text:
頭の中が一度だけ真っ白になり、次の瞬間にはレンの
言葉をパズルのように組み立て――――
strings.translated: Her mind went pure white for just a moment, and in the very next instant she assembled Ren's words like pieces of a puzzle--

strings.text:
――さらには、ここ数日の出来事からアゲハの行動を
推測し、その先にある結論にたどり着いた。
strings.translated: -- and further, from the events of the past few days, she inferred Ageha's actions, and arrived at the conclusion that lay beyond them.

strings.text:
夢美
「レン……あなた…………アゲハを………………」
途端に物凄い力が湧き上がった。
strings.translated: In an instant, a tremendous surge of strength welled up inside her.

strings.text:
ベッドから跳ね起きると同時に、手を伸ばしてレンに
掴みかかる。
strings.translated: She leapt out of bed and simultaneously reached out, lunging at Ren.

strings.text:
あまりに勢いが強すぎて自分で驚いたが、そんなもの
はどうでもいい。
strings.translated: The force of it surprised even herself, but that didn't matter.

strings.text:
果たして右手を伸ばしたのか左手を伸ばしたのか、
それさえも分からないままに、夢美の手はレンの首
に『巻き付いて』いた。
strings.translated: Whether she had extended her right hand or her left, she couldn't even tell -- and yet Yumemi's hand had 'coiled around' Ren's neck.
A faint sense of wrongness -- something slightly off.

strings.text: だが、それも今はどうでもいい。
strings.translated: But that, too, didn't matter right now.

strings.text:
重要なのはレンの首を捕らえられたという事で、この
まま力を込めれば――――
strings.translated: What mattered was that she had seized Ren's neck, and if she just poured her strength into it----

strings.text:
突然、腹部に激しい衝撃を受け、夢美は壁まで吹っ飛
ばされた。
strings.translated: Suddenly a violent impact struck her abdomen, and Yumemi was sent flying into the wall.

strings.text:
今度は背中に強い衝撃が襲い掛かり、跳ね返って床ま
で転落する。
strings.translated: This time a powerful blow slammed into her back, and she bounced off and tumbled to the floor.

strings.text:
顔面から落ちたため首の辺りがグキッと鳴ったが、
痛みを感じるより先に立ち上がった。
strings.translated: She had landed face-first, and something in her neck cracked with a sickening sound -- but she was on her feet before she even registered the pain.

strings.text: 見失っている暇はない。
strings.translated: She couldn't afford to lose sight of him.

strings.text:
すぐにレンの位置を確認し、同時に自分の体勢を整え
る。
strings.translated: She immediately confirmed Ren's position and at the same time steadied her stance.

strings.text:
ついさっきまでベッドで寝たきりだったとは思えない
ほど、夢美の体は言うことを聞いてくれた。
strings.translated: Her body obeyed her with a responsiveness that seemed impossible for someone who had been bedridden just moments ago.

strings.text:
レン
「無茶をすると死にますよ」
strings.translated:
Ren
"You'll die if you push yourself like that."

strings.text:
夢美
「アアァアアァァアァァァァァッ！！！！」

strings.translated: She extends her left arm as well.

strings.text: もう一本の腕も伸ばす。

頭の片隅にまた違和感を覚えたが、そんなものは全身
を駆け巡る憎悪によって焼き尽くされた。
strings.translated: A faint sense of wrongness flickered in the back of her mind again, but it was incinerated by the hatred coursing through every inch of her body.

strings.text: 伸ばせ――伸ばせ――伸ばせ――伸ばせ――――ッ！
届け――届け――届け――届け――届け――――ッ！
strings.translated: Get there -- get there -- get there -- get there -- get there ----!

strings.text: 大小様々な腕が、レンに向かって伸びていく。
strings.translated: Arms of all shapes and sizes stretched out toward Ren.

strings.text:
手の先が五本の指になっていないものもあったが、
巻き付いて首を絞められればそれで十分だった。
strings.translated: Some of them did not end in five fingers, but as long as they could coil around his neck and squeeze, that was enough.

strings.text:
それに対して、レンは短く溜息をつくと、夢美の目を
見つめながら短くつぶやく。
strings.translated: In response, Ren let out a short sigh, and murmured quietly while gazing into Yumemi's eyes.

strings.text:
レン
「僕は別に構いませんが――――」
世界は一瞬にして闇に包まれた。
strings.translated: And in an instant, the world was swallowed by darkness.

strings.text:
背中のほうで爆音が聞こえたかと思った瞬間、夢美は
世界の全てから切り離されていた。
strings.translated: She thought she heard an explosion somewhere behind her -- and in that same moment, Yumemi was severed from everything in the world.

strings.text: 意識も、思考も、感覚も、全てが無に帰している。
strings.translated: Consciousness, thought, sensation -- all of it returned to nothing.

strings.text:
最後に何か――いや、誰か――を求めたが、それも
叶うことはなかった。
strings.translated: At the very end she reached for something -- no, someone -- but even that wish went unfulfilled.

strings.text:
つまり、これ以降のことは、死んでしまった櫻井夢美
には無関係のことで――――
strings.translated: In other words, everything that followed had nothing to do with Yumemi Sakurai, who was now dead----

strings.text:
レンの蟲が、一瞬にして夢美の命を奪い去ったこと
も――――
strings.translated: That Ren's Bug had stolen Yumemi's life in an instant----

strings.text:
その時の夢美の姿が、人間とは似ても似つかない姿を
していたことも――――
strings.translated: That Yumemi's appearance in that moment bore no resemblance whatsoever to a human being----

strings.text:
その後、証拠隠滅のために、夢美の肉体がアゲハの家
ごと灰にされたことも――――
strings.translated: That afterward, to eliminate all evidence, Yumemi's body was reduced to ash along with Ageha's house----

strings.text:
――全ては、その後に起こった事実でしかないのだっ
た。
strings.translated: All of it -- all of it was nothing more than fact, unfolding after the fact.

strings.text: 夢美の体調は、なかなか良くならなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi's condition showed no signs of improvement.

strings.text:
全身から常に力が抜けるような感覚に陥り、満足に
ベッドから起き上がることもできない。
strings.translated: She was constantly overcome by a sensation of strength draining from her entire body, and she could not even manage to sit up in bed properly.

strings.text:
腕に出来ていた痣のような模様は、次第にその範囲を
広げていき、今では肩から首筋にまで及んでいるよう
だった。
strings.translated: The bruise-like markings that had formed on her arms were gradually spreading, and by now they seemed to have reached from her shoulders up to her neck.

strings.text: 自分の体が変わっていく……。

ベッドに寝たきりの生活の中で、夢美は漠然とその事
を感じていた。
strings.translated: Confined to her bed, Yumemi felt this in a vague, formless way.

strings.text:
自分の体が何かに犯されている事を、得体の知れない
恐怖とともに感じていた。
strings.translated: She felt, with a nameless dread, that something was violating her body.

strings.text:
これから自分がどうなってしまうのか、どう変わって
しまうのか、考えるだけでも恐ろしい。
strings.translated: Just thinking about what would become of her, how she would change -- it was terrifying.

strings.text:
だが、そんな夢美を挑発するかのように、男性器を
模した股間のモノも、少しずつそのサイズを拡大さ
せていった。
strings.translated: And yet, as if to taunt her in her state, the thing between her legs -- shaped like a male organ -- was also slowly, steadily growing in size.

strings.text:
果たして、肉棒が取り外せなくなってから何日が経っ
たのか……。
strings.translated: How many days had it been since the flesh-rod had become impossible to remove...

strings.text:
アゲハの言っていた薬は未だに届かず、肉棒はもはや
完全に夢美の体の一部と成り果てていた。
strings.translated: The medicine Ageha had spoken of still had not arrived, and the flesh-rod had by now become completely and utterly a part of Yumemi's body.

strings.text:
元が蟲である事など、最近はたまに忘れている時もあ
る。
strings.translated: The fact that it had originally been a Bug -- lately, there were moments when she even forgot that.

strings.text:
一体、何故こんな事になってしまったのか、後悔する
にしてもどこから後悔すればいいのか――――
strings.translated: Just what had gone so wrong, and where exactly she should begin to regret it -- she couldn't even tell anymore----

strings.text:
――夢美は起きている間中、そんなことばかりを考え
ていた。
strings.translated: -- All the while she lay awake, those were the only thoughts that filled Yumemi's mind.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ…………！」
ふらつく足取りで、夢美が部屋に戻ってくる。
strings.translated: Yumemi returned to the room on unsteady feet.

strings.text:
すり足で床を移動しながら、息も絶え絶えになって
ベッドに崩れ落ちた。
strings.translated: Shuffling across the floor, barely able to breathe, she collapsed onto the bed.

strings.text:
体が燃えるように熱く、思考が全くと言っていいほど
働かない。
strings.translated: Her body burned with fever, and her thoughts refused to function at all.

strings.text:
めまいは常に襲ってきて、油断すればすぐに睡魔に
呑み込まれた。
strings.translated: Dizziness assailed her constantly, and the moment she let her guard down, sleep swallowed her whole.

strings.text: 節操もなく欲情する肉体。
strings.translated: Her body aroused itself without shame or restraint.

strings.text:
弱っているにも関わらず、股間の肉棒だけはいつも
いきり立っていた。
strings.translated: Weak as she was, the flesh-rod between her legs was always rigid and demanding.

strings.text:
トイレに行けば女性器からの放尿に合わせて精液を
吐き出し、そのたびに不要な快楽を送り込んでくる。
