strings.text: その日、レンは朝から珍しく長電話をしていた。
strings.translated: That day, Ren had been on an unusually long phone call since morning.

strings.text:
何の飾り気もない携帯電話を耳に当てて、適当な間隔
で「はい」と返事をしている。
strings.translated: He held a plain, unadorned cell phone to his ear, responding with "yes" at measured intervals.

strings.text:
会話をしているというよりは、ただ一方的に何かを
伝えられている雰囲気だった。
strings.translated: It felt less like a two-way conversation and more like he was simply being told something, one-sidedly.

strings.text:
レン
「分かりました。では、そのように……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Understood. Then we will proceed accordingly..."

strings.text: 最後にそう言って、レンは電話を切った。
strings.translated: With those final words, Ren ended the call.

strings.text: 夢美と優斗は、様子を窺いながらも朝食の準備中だ。
strings.translated: Yumemi and Yuuto, meanwhile, were preparing breakfast while keeping a watchful eye on him.

strings.text: 尋ねられたところで分かるはずもない。
strings.translated: Yumemi had been asked, but she had no way of knowing.

strings.text:
もともと付き合いがあったわけではないし、愉快に
話をする間柄でもないのだ。
strings.translated: They had never had any real dealings with him to begin with, and they were hardly on terms for pleasant conversation.

strings.text:
常にまとった黒いコートのように、レンの心は闇に
閉ざされている。
strings.translated: Like the black coat he always wore, Ren's heart was sealed away in darkness.

strings.text:
レン
「予定が変わりました」

抑揚のない声で言いながら、レンが床に一本ずつ蟲筒
を置いていく。
strings.translated: Speaking in a flat, expressionless tone, Ren set the Bug Tubes down on the floor one by one.

strings.text:
すると、倉庫内を徘徊していた全ての蟲達が、一斉に
蟲筒のほうに集まり始めた。
strings.translated: At that, every Bug that had been wandering about the warehouse began gathering toward the Bug Tubes all at once.

strings.text:
レン
「貴女の獣魔蟲のことを、もっと詳しく調べるという
　ことです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It means we will be investigating your Jumachuu in greater detail."

strings.text:
あくまで視線は蟲筒のほうに向けながら、レンが物静
かな口調で話す。
strings.translated: His gaze still fixed on the Bug Tubes, Ren spoke in his quiet, measured tone.

strings.text:
蟲筒には、まとめて数匹の蟲が自分から入り込んでい
て、満員になったらしいところで蓋が閉められていた。
strings.translated: Several Bugs had crawled into the tubes on their own, and once they were full, the lids had been sealed shut.

strings.text:
レン
「南優斗さん。貴方にも来てもらいます」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Minami Yuuto. You will be coming as well."

strings.text: やはり視線はそのままに、レンがさらりと言い放った。
strings.translated: Still without shifting his gaze, Ren said it casually, as if it were nothing.

strings.text: 拒否権など全く感じさせない口調だ。
strings.translated: His tone left absolutely no room for refusal.

strings.text:
夢美
「ちょっと、なんで優斗……南さんまで強制的なの
　よ？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Wait, why is Yuuto -- why is Minami-san being forced into this too?"

strings.text:
レン
「蟲使いのことを知られてしまった以上、簡単に帰す
　わけにはいきません」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Now that he knows about Bug Users, we cannot simply let him go."

strings.text:
レン
「元はと言えば貴女のせいなのですよ？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"This is your fault, when you get down to it."

strings.text:
つい、と向けられたレンの冷めた視線が、夢美の言葉
を詰まらせる。
strings.translated: Ren's cold gaze, turned toward her in an instant, cut off Yumemi's words.

strings.text:
レン
「貴女が勝手な行動を取らなければ、南優斗さんが
　ここにいる事はなかった」
strings.translated:
Ren
"If you hadn't acted on your own, Minami Yuuto would not be here."

strings.text:
レン
「そして、おそらくは今回のような移動の必要もな
　かったのです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"And most likely, there would have been no need for a move like this either."

strings.text:
レン
「貴女は、自分の立場というものをもっと正確に理解
　するべきだ」
strings.translated:
Ren
"You need to understand your own position far more accurately."

strings.text:
容赦ないレンの言葉に、夢美は顔を俯かせるしかな
かった。
strings.translated: Faced with Ren's merciless words, Yumemi had no choice but to hang her head.

strings.text: 何一つとして反論できない。
strings.translated: There was not a single thing she could argue against.

strings.text:
今、ここに優斗がいるのは、間違いなく夢美の責任な
のだ。
strings.translated: There was no doubt about it -- the fact that Yuuto was here right now was Yumemi's responsibility.

strings.text:
優斗が、「俺も行く」と言ったとき、それを拒否しな
かった夢美の責任なのだ。
strings.translated: It was Yumemi's responsibility for not refusing when Yuuto said "I'm coming too."

strings.text:
今更、これ以上優斗を巻き込まないでほしいなどとは
言えなかった。
strings.translated: She could not now say she didn't want him dragged into this any further.

strings.text:
優斗
「分かった。俺も行けばいいんだね？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Alright. I just have to come along too, right?"

strings.text: 気にしなくていいと言うように、優斗が優しく微笑む。
strings.translated: As if to say she shouldn't worry about it, Yuuto smiled gently.

strings.text:
それを見て、夢美はもう何も言えなくなってしまっ
た……。
strings.translated: Seeing that, Yumemi found herself unable to say anything more...

strings.translated:
