strings.translated: As if to say she shouldn't worry about it, Yuuto smiled gently.

strings.text:
それを見て、夢美はもう何も言えなくなってしまっ
た……。
strings.translated: Seeing that, Yumemi found herself unable to say anything more...

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……」
倉庫を出発してから、ほぼ丸一日。
strings.translated: Nearly a full day had passed since they left the warehouse.

strings.text:
レンに連れて来られた先は、薄霧の漂う肌寒い森の中
だった。
strings.translated: The place they had been brought to was a chilly forest shrouded in thin mist.

strings.text:
散々引っ張りまわされたため、どこにある森なのかは
サッパリ分からない。
strings.translated: They had been dragged around so relentlessly that Yumemi had no idea where this forest even was.

strings.text:
遠く離れた県なのか、それとも案外隣町だったりする
のか。
strings.translated: It might be in some faraway prefecture, or, for all she knew, the next town over.

strings.text: どちらにしても、今の夢美達には些細な問題だった。
strings.translated: Either way, it was a trivial concern for Yumemi and the others right now.

strings.text: 森の中を歩くこと三時間――――。
strings.translated: Three hours of walking through the forest ----

strings.text:
一体どこへ連れて行こうというのか、レンは疲れた
様子もなくさらに奥へと進んでいた。
strings.translated: With no sign of fatigue whatsoever, Ren pressed even deeper inside -- wherever it was he intended to take them.

strings.text: 夢美達のほうを振り返ることは殆どない。
strings.translated: He almost never looked back toward Yumemi and the others.

strings.text:
興味がないのか、それとも気配で分かるから振り返ら
ないのか、どちらにしても冷たい態度であることに変
わりはない。
strings.translated: Whether he simply had no interest in them, or whether he could sense their presence without looking -- either way, his cold attitude remained unchanged.

strings.text:
このまま死ぬまで歩かされるのではないかと、夢美は
そんなあらぬ想像まで掻き立てられるようになってい
た。
strings.translated: Yumemi had begun entertaining the absurd notion that they might be made to walk until they dropped dead.

strings.text:
夢美
「あの、やっぱり一つ持ちましょうか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Um, should I carry one of those after all?"

strings.text:
優斗
「ん、いや……大丈夫だよ…………」
優斗の手には、買い物袋が左右一つずつ下がっていた。
strings.translated: Yuuto had a shopping bag hanging from each hand.

strings.text:
ここに来る途中、レンに「一週間分の食料が要る」と
言われ、コンビニエンスストアで慌てて詰め込んだも
のだ。
strings.translated: On the way here, Ren had told them they would need "a week's worth of food," and they had hastily crammed supplies into bags at a convenience store.

strings.text:
その時、ついでにリュックサックのような、荷物を
運びやすい物も買っておけば良かったのだが、今更
言ってもあとの祭りだった。
strings.translated: They should have bought something like a backpack at the same time to make carrying things easier, but it was too late to say so now.

strings.text:
夢美
「ねぇ、まだ着かないの？」
耐えかねたようにして、夢美が口を開いた。
strings.translated: Unable to bear it any longer, Yumemi spoke up.

strings.text:
これ以上歩くのであれば、そろそろ一度休憩をとって
も良い頃だ。
strings.translated: If they were going to keep walking, it was about time they took a break.

strings.text:
長時間、道無き道を歩いたためか、ふくらはぎの辺り
が痛みを覚えていた。
strings.translated:
Perhaps owing to the long hours of walking through trackless terrain, her calves
had begun to ache.

strings.text:
レン
「もう着いてますよ」
前を向いて歩いたまま、レンがそんな言葉を口にした。
strings.translated: Ren said those words without breaking stride, still facing forward.

strings.text: 夢美はもちろん、優斗も驚いて足を止めてしまう。
strings.translated: Not just Yumemi -- Yuuto too stopped in his tracks, startled.

strings.text:
その気配を察したのか、ようやくレンも足を止めて
二人のほうを振り返った。
strings.translated:
As if sensing their hesitation, Ren finally stopped as well
and turned back to look at them.

strings.text:
レン
「目的地はここです」

訝しげに眉を寄せながら辺りを見回してみるが、今ま
で歩いてきた場所と比べてみても、特に変わった様子
はない。
strings.translated:
She furrowed her brow in suspicion and looked around, but compared
to everywhere they had walked through, nothing seemed
particularly different.

strings.text:
強いて言うなら、視界に入ってくる昆虫の数が増えた
気はしたが、その程度の変化しか感じ取れなかった。
strings.translated:
If anything, she had the impression that the number of insects
coming into view had increased -- but that was the only change she could detect.

strings.text:
優斗
「もしかして、この森自体が目的地？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Could it be that this forest itself is the destination?"

strings.text:
優斗
「今まで俺達が歩いてた理由は？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Then why have we been walking all this time?"

strings.text:
レン
「できるだけ森の深いところのほうが都合が良かった
　もので」
strings.translated:
Ren
"It was more convenient to be as deep
 into the forest as possible."

strings.text:
何となく話が妙な方向に転がり始めたのを、夢美は
漠然と感じていた。
strings.translated:
Yumemi had a vague sense that the conversation
was beginning to drift in a strange direction.

strings.text:
目的地に向かっているのではなく、既に目的地には
着いている――――。
strings.translated:
They were not heading toward their destination --
they had already arrived at it.

strings.text:
歩いていた理由は、できるだけ森の深いところに行く
ため――――。
strings.translated:
The reason they had been walking was to go
as deep into the forest as possible.

strings.text:
夢美
「冗談じゃないわよ……」

急に疲労感が増して、夢美はその場にへたり込んでし
まった。
strings.translated:
Suddenly overcome by a wave of exhaustion, Yumemi
collapsed right where she stood.

strings.text:
ふくらはぎに留まっていた痛みが太ももまで上がって
きて、残されていた体力を削り取っていく。
strings.translated:
The pain that had been confined to her calves crept up into her thighs,
draining away what little stamina she had left.

strings.text:
優斗もしゃがみ込んだりはしなかったものの、感じて
いる疲労は夢美と同じようだった。
strings.translated:
Yuuto hadn't crouched down, but the fatigue he was feeling
seemed no different from Yumemi's.

strings.text:
レン
「どうかしましたか？」

優斗
「念のために聞いておきたいんですけど、あとどのく
　らい歩くつもりだったんですか？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Just to be safe, I'd like to ask -- how much further
 were you planning to make us walk?"

strings.text:
レン
「いえ、特には決めていませんが」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I hadn't decided anything in particular."

strings.text: さすがに不快感をあらわにして、優斗が溜息をつく。
strings.translated: Unable to hide his irritation any longer, Yuuto let out a sigh.

strings.text:
買い物袋を地面に置くと、背中を丸めるようにして
うな垂れてしまった。
strings.translated:
He set the shopping bags down on the ground and slumped forward,
hunching his back as his head drooped.

strings.text:
レン
「そろそろ限界ですか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Are you already at your limit?"

strings.text:
レン
「そうですか。では、ここまでにしましょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I see. Then we will stop here."

strings.text:
レンがそう言うのを聞いて、二人はホッと安堵の息を
漏らした。
strings.translated: Hearing Ren say that, the two of them let out a breath of relief.

strings.text:
釈然としない部分は多くあるが、とりあえずこれ以上
歩かなくて済むのは幸いだ。
strings.translated:
There were plenty of things that still didn't sit right, but at least
they wouldn't have to walk any further -- that much was a blessing.

strings.text:
適当な岩場を見つけると、ぐったりした様子でそこに
腰を下ろした。
strings.translated:
Finding a suitable rocky outcrop, they sank down onto it
with exhausted, listless expressions.

Yumemi
"Ahh, god, my legs are done..."

strings.text:
優斗
「こんなに歩いたのは久しぶりだなぁ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I haven't walked this much in ages."

strings.text:
太ももを揉みながら、優斗が苦笑いを浮かべながら
言う。
strings.translated: Yuuto said it with a wry smile, kneading his thighs.

strings.text:
歩いている間は「大丈夫」と言っていたが、実際には
かなり体力的に限界だったらしい。
strings.translated:
He had said "I'm fine" while they were walking, but in reality
he had apparently been quite close to his physical limit.

strings.text:
額に汗を滲ませた優斗と、左右に置かれた買い物袋を
見ていると、夢美の申し訳なさは募るばかりだった。
strings.translated:
Looking at Yuuto with sweat beading on his forehead, and at the shopping bags
set down on either side of him, Yumemi's guilt only continued to grow.

strings.text:
優斗
「それで、ここに来てどうするんですか？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"So, now that we're here -- what are we supposed to do?"

strings.text:
レン
「生き抜いて下さい」
太ももを揉んでいた優斗の手が止まる。
strings.translated: Yuuto's hands, which had been kneading his thighs, went still.

strings.text:
夢美もまた驚いて目を丸くすると、じっとレンの横顔
を見つめてしまった。
strings.translated:
Yumemi too widened her eyes in shock and found herself
staring fixedly at Ren's profile.

strings.text:
レン
「僕は仕事があり、一週間は戻って来ることができま
　せん」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I have work to attend to, and I will not be able to return
 for one week."

strings.text:
レン
「その間、この森で生き抜いて下さい」
strings.translated:
Ren
"In that time, survive in this forest."

strings.text:
休息を取ることができたのも束の間、話がさらに怪し
げな方向へと進み始める。
strings.translated:
They had barely had a moment to rest before the conversation
began moving in an even more unsettling direction.

strings.text:
夢美の表情からも、優斗の表情からも、一切の余裕が
消えていった。
strings.translated:
Every trace of composure vanished from both
Yumemi's face and Yuuto's.

strings.text:
夢美
「い、生き抜くってどういう事よ？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"S-survive? What do you mean by that?"

strings.text:
レン
「言葉のままの意味です」
レンの鋭い視線が、夢美の胸をざわつかせる。
strings.translated: Ren's sharp gaze sent a ripple of unease through Yumemi's chest.

strings.text: 冗談で言っているのではない。
strings.translated: He was not saying it as a joke.

strings.text:
レンはいたって真面目に、二人に「生き抜け」と命じ
ているのだ。
strings.translated: Ren was, in complete earnest, ordering the two of them to "survive."

strings.text:
だが、そんな命にまで関わるような展開になるなど、
夢美はまったく考えてもいなかった。
strings.translated: But Yumemi had never once imagined things would escalate to the point of threatening their very lives.

strings.text:
夢美
「ち、ちょっと待って……。
　生き抜けって、こんな森で……何の準備もなく？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"W-wait a moment...
 Survive -- in a forest like this... with no preparation whatsoever?"

strings.text:
レン
「食料は一週間分買い込んだはずでは？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"You bought a week's worth of food, did you not?"

strings.text:
夢美
「それしかしてないじゃないっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That's the ONLY thing we did!!"

strings.text:
自分が疲れているのも忘れて、夢美は大声を出しなが
らレンに詰め寄った。
strings.translated: Forgetting her own exhaustion, Yumemi raised her voice and pressed closer to Ren.

strings.text:
いくらなんでも、自分の命を懸けるにしてはあまりに
準備不足だ。
strings.translated: No matter how you looked at it, this was far too little preparation for something that put their lives on the line.

strings.text:
今までキャンプひとつしたことのない夢美にとって、
レンの命令は、緩慢に殺されるための広大な墓地に
案内されたようなものだった。
strings.translated: To Yumemi, who had never so much as been camping, Ren's order felt like being led into a vast graveyard to die a slow death.

strings.text:
夢美
「今すぐ森の外に出してっ！
　こんなところ、一日だってもたないわよっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Let me out of this forest right now!
There's no way I'd last even a single day in a place like this!!"

strings.text:
レン
「それならそれで構いません」

バッサリと切り捨てるように言われ、夢美はその場で
絶句した。
strings.translated: His words cut her down without a moment's hesitation, and Yumemi was left speechless on the spot.

strings.text: レンの言葉が、頭の中で反芻される。
strings.translated: Ren's words echoed back through her mind.

strings.text: それは、つまり、要するに――――
strings.translated: That meant -- in other words -- to put it plainly ----

strings.text:
優斗
「俺達が死んでも、構わないってことですか？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"You're saying... it doesn't matter if we die?"

strings.text:
夢美が口から出せなかったことを、優斗が青褪めた顔
で尋ねた。
strings.translated: What Yumemi couldn't bring herself to say, Yuuto asked with a pale, ashen face.

strings.text:
優斗
「ちょっと待ってくれ！
　そんなことして何の意味があるんだっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Hold on a minute!
What's the point of doing something like that?!"

strings.text: 荒々しい口調で、今度は優斗が食って掛かる。
strings.translated: His tone rough and agitated, Yuuto now turned on Ren himself.

strings.text: だが、レンは眉一つ動かさずに答えた。
strings.translated: But Ren answered without so much as a twitch of his brow.

strings.text:
レン
「貴方に意味はありません」
strings.translated:
Ren
"There is no point, as far as you are concerned."

strings.text:
レン
「もう一度言いますが、貴方は我々のことを知り過ぎ
　ている」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I will say it once more -- you know far too much about us."

strings.text:
レン
「この森へ来ていただいたのは我々が監視しやすいか
　らであって、蟲使いの訓練をさせるためではありま
　せん」
strings.translated:
Ren
"We brought you to this forest because it is easier for us to keep watch over you -- not to put you through Bug User training."

strings.text:
レン
「貴方の今後は、現在一族の長老達が協議しているは
　ずです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Your future is currently being deliberated by the clan elders."

strings.text:
優斗
「もしかして、その協議の結果次第じゃ…………」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Could it be, depending on how that deliberation goes..."

strings.text:
レン
「貴方の命をいただく事になるかもしれません」
strings.translated:
Ren
"We may find it necessary to take your life."

strings.text:
自分の置かれた状況を初めて理解して、優斗の顔が
青褪める。
strings.translated: For the first time truly grasping the situation he was in, Yuuto's face went pale.

strings.text:
それは夢美も同じで、まさかそんな事になっていると
は想像もしていなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi was no different -- she had never imagined things had come to this.

strings.text:
レン
「騙した？　何をです？」

夢美
「何をって……だ、だから…………ッ！！」
次の言葉が出てこない。

騙されたような気がしていたが、記憶を思い返すと
レンは一度も優斗を助けるとは言っていない。
strings.translated: She felt as though she had been deceived, but when she cast her mind back, Ren had never once said he would save Yuuto.

strings.text: ただ、自分達とともに森に来るよう命令しただけだ。
strings.translated: He had simply ordered them to come with him into the forest.

strings.text:
それに従えば優斗を助けるとは、ただの一言も言って
いないのだった。
strings.translated: Not a single word had been said about saving Yuuto in exchange for their compliance.

strings.text:
レン
「人のことよりも、貴女は自分のことを考えたほうが
　いい」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Rather than worrying about others, you would do well to think about yourself."

strings.text:
レン
「森で生き抜くというのは、蟲使いが幼少期に体験す
　る訓練のひとつです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Surviving in the forest is one of the trials that Bug Users undergo in their early years of training."

strings.text:
レン
「そこで、この訓練の意味を見出せれば生き抜ける」
strings.translated:
Ren
"If you can find meaning in this trial, you will survive."

Yuuto
"And if you can't find it..."

strings.text: 氷のように冷たい声でレンが告げる。
strings.translated: Ren spoke in a voice as cold as ice.

strings.text:
嘘や冗談を言っている目つきではないし、レンがそん
な事を言う人間でないのは、夢美もよく知っている。
strings.translated: His eyes held no trace of a lie or a joke, and Yumemi knew well enough that Ren was not the kind of person to say such things lightly.

strings.text: この森で訓練の意味を見出せなければ、死ぬ。
strings.translated: If they could not find meaning in this forest, they would die.

strings.text:
そして夢美の死は、おそらく優斗の死も直結している
のだ。
strings.translated: And Yumemi's death would, in all likelihood, mean Yuuto's death as well.

strings.text:
それらの事実に気付いたとき、様々なものが夢美の肩
に重く圧し掛かってきた。
strings.translated: When she became aware of all these facts, a crushing weight settled heavily onto Yumemi's shoulders.

strings.text:
優斗
「何か……生き残るための、アドバイスのようなもの
　はないのかな？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Isn't there... some kind of advice, maybe, for how to survive?"

strings.text:
さすがに自分の身の危険を感じ始めたのか、優斗が
恐る恐るレンに尋ねる。
strings.translated: Perhaps finally sensing the danger to his own life, Yuuto asked Ren with a timid, hesitant voice.

strings.text:
レン
「アドバイス、ですか？」

レン
「強いて言うのなら、夢美さんが明確な理由を持って
　その服を脱ごうとしたとき、訓練の第一段階は通過
　したと考えて良いでしょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"If I were to offer anything, it would be this -- when Yumemi-san finds a clear reason to want to remove that garment, you may consider the first stage of the trial complete."

strings.text: 蟲使いの装束を見下ろして、夢美が不思議そうに呟く。
strings.translated: Yumemi murmured in puzzlement, looking down at her Bug User's attire.

strings.text:
どういう意味かサッパリ分からなかったが、それは
自分で見つけろという事らしい。
strings.translated: She had no idea what it meant, but it seemed she was expected to find the answer herself.

strings.text:
レン
「それでは、ご武運を……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Well then... best of luck to you..."

strings.text:
嫌味か、それとも本心か――そう言葉を残してレンが
去って行く……。
strings.translated: Sarcasm, or did he mean it? -- With those parting words, Ren walked away...

strings.text: 夢美と優斗は、不安げにそれを見送るしかなかった。
strings.translated: All Yumemi and Yuuto could do was watch him go, unease written plainly on their faces.

strings.text:
優斗の左右の手に握られた買い物袋が、弱々しく揺れ
ていた……。
strings.translated: The shopping bags clutched in Yuuto's hands swayed weakly...

strings.text:
夢美と優斗のもとを立ち去ったあとも、レンは暫く
森に滞在していた。
strings.translated: Even after leaving Yumemi and Yuuto behind, Ren lingered in the forest for a while longer.

strings.text: 遠く離れた場所から、夢美と優斗を監視していた。
strings.translated: From a distance, he kept watch over Yumemi and Yuuto.

strings.text:
当然の反応だが、二人とも呆然としてその場から動こ
うとしない。
strings.translated: Their reaction was only natural -- both of them stood rooted to the spot, dazed and unmoving.

strings.text:
自分達が何をすればいいのかも分からないようで、
不安げに森の中を見回していた。
strings.translated: They seemed to have no idea what they were supposed to do, and kept glancing around the forest with anxious eyes.

strings.text:
レン
「あとのことは、よろしくお願いします」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I leave the rest in your hands."

strings.text: 果たして、それは誰に向けた言葉なのか。
strings.translated: To whom, exactly, were those words directed?

strings.text:
返ってきたのは言葉ではなく、微かに揺れる木々の
ざわめきだった。
strings.translated: What answered him was not words, but the faint rustling of the trees swaying in the breeze.

strings.text:
どこか不安そうな、まるで抗議するような、そんな
雰囲気が森の空気に漂っている。
strings.translated: Something uneasy -- almost like a protest -- seemed to drift through the air of the forest.

strings.text:
レン
「全ては長の決定です。
　……異議を唱えるなら直接どうぞ」
strings.translated:
Ren
"This is the Elder's decision.
 ...If you have objections, take them up with him directly."

strings.text: 静かなレンの言葉に、辺りから抗議の気配が消える。
strings.translated: At Ren's quiet words, the air of protest faded from the surroundings.

strings.text:
それは、納得したと言うよりも、レンの威圧感に呑ま
れたような消え方だった。
strings.translated: It vanished not so much out of acceptance, but as though swallowed by the weight of Ren's presence.

strings.text:
レン
「これは、我々一族にとって大きな賭けです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"This is a great gamble for our clan."

strings.text:
レン
「獣魔蟲が伝説通りの蟲なのか、それとも特殊な能力
　を持った程度の蟲なのか――――」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Whether the Jumachuu is truly the Bug of legend, or merely a Bug with some special ability--"

strings.text:
レン
「――この一週間で判断します」
strings.translated:
Ren
"-- We will make our judgment within this one week."

strings.text:
レン
「あなた方の役目は、これからこの森で起こるあらゆ
　る出来事を長に報告すること」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Your role from here on is to report to the Elder every single thing that occurs in this forest."

strings.text:
レン
「見たまま、聞いたまま、そして感じたままを、正確
　に報告して下さい」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Report back exactly what you see, what you hear, and what you feel."

strings.text: レンが一旦言葉を区切り、何人かが頷く気配がした。
strings.translated: Ren paused briefly, and there was a sense of several presences nodding in acknowledgment.

strings.text:
――と、森の空気に漂っていた緊張感が一気に増し、
突然強い風が吹き抜ける。
strings.translated: -- And then, the tension hanging in the forest air surged all at once, and a sudden strong wind swept through.

strings.text:
それが――まるで何かを運んできたような気がして、
レンは薄く目を細めた。
strings.translated: It felt as though that wind had carried something with it -- and Ren narrowed his eyes ever so slightly.

strings.text:
神武社襲撃のためレンは森を離れたが、頭の中は既に
その後の事に向けられていた。
strings.translated: Ren had left the forest for the raid on Jinmu Corporation, but his mind was already turned toward what would come after.

strings.text:
次にこの森に帰って来るとき、自分にとって何か大き
な事が起こる予感がして、そればかりが気になってい
た……。
strings.translated: He had a premonition that something momentous awaited him the next time he returned to this forest -- and that thought alone kept nagging at him...

strings.text:
優斗
「これはまあ、いいとして……これも大丈夫か」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Well, this is fine... but what about this one."

strings.text:
優斗
「これが三日以内にお召し上がり下さい、で……
　こっちが開封後なるべくお早めに、と…………」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"'Please consume within three days,' so... and this one says 'best consumed as soon as possible after opening,'..."

strings.text:
レンが立ち去って程なく、優斗が買い物袋の中身を
確認し、すぐに食べなければならない物とそうでな
い物を選り分けていた。
strings.translated: Not long after Ren had gone, Yuuto was sorting through the contents of the shopping bags, separating what needed to be eaten soon from what could wait.

strings.text:
一つ一つ賞味期限を確認しては、右と左の買い物袋に
入れ直している。
strings.translated: He checked the expiration date on each item one by one, redistributing them between the left and right bags.

strings.text:
努めて明るい独り言を口に出してはいるが、表情には
まだ切羽詰ったものを感じ取ることができた。
strings.translated: He kept up a deliberately cheerful stream of muttering, but his expression still carried an unmistakable air of desperation.

strings.text: 夢美は何もできなかった。

これからどうすればいいのか、全く考えがまとまらな
かった。
strings.translated: She had no idea what to do from here -- her thoughts refused to come together at all.

strings.text:
頭の中は真っ白に染まっていて、視線は宙を漂ってい
る。
strings.translated: Her mind had gone completely blank, her gaze drifting aimlessly through the air.

strings.text:
既に命を懸けた一週間は始まっているのだが、その
実感は全く湧かなかった。
strings.translated: The life-or-death week had already begun, yet the reality of it hadn't sunk in at all.

strings.text:
食料の詰め換えを済ませた優斗が、結果を見て小さな
溜息をつく。
strings.translated: Having finished repacking the food, Yuuto let out a small sigh as he surveyed the results.

strings.text:
夢美を見て後頭部を掻いたあと、やや無理をしたよう
な笑顔を作って話しかけた。
strings.translated: He glanced at Yumemi, scratched the back of his head, then put on a somewhat forced smile and spoke to her.

strings.text:
夢美はちらりと視線を向けたが、すぐに地面のほうに
戻してしまった。
strings.translated: Yumemi glanced briefly in his direction, but quickly looked back down at the ground.

strings.text:
優斗
「ん、まぁ、仕方ないよ。
　まさかこうなるとは、俺も思ってなかったし」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Hm, well... nothing we can do about it now.
 I didn't expect things to turn out like this either."

strings.text:
優斗
「ついて行くって決めたのは俺なんだから、夢美ちゃ
　んが気にする事じゃないよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I'm the one who decided to come along, so it's not something you need to worry about, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text:
多分に強がりを含んだ言葉を掛けて、優斗が場違いに
明るい笑みを見せる。
strings.translated: The words carried more than a little bravado, and Yuuto flashed a smile that seemed oddly out of place.

strings.text:
だが、それでも夢美の様子は沈んだままで、優斗と
視線を合わせようともしなかった。
strings.translated: But even so, Yumemi's mood remained sunken, and she made no effort to meet Yuuto's eyes.

strings.text:
優斗は困ったように頭を掻いたが、そのとき夢美が
ぽつりと呟いた。
strings.translated: Yuuto scratched his head in bewilderment -- and it was then that Yumemi murmured softly.

strings.text:
夢美
「そうじゃないんです」

夢美
「私、安心してたんです」

夢美
「あいつが、優斗さんも連れて行くって言ったとき、
　迷惑が掛かるのは分かってたけど…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"When he said he was taking you along too, Yuuto-san -- I knew it would cause you trouble, but..."

strings.text:
夢美
「でも、私一人じゃないんだって……一人で変なとこ
　ろに連れて行かれるよりは、二人のほうがいいって、
　心のどこかで思ってた…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But... I thought, at least I'm not alone... that having two of us being dragged off to some strange place was better than going alone... somewhere in my heart, I thought that..."

strings.text:
すぐに何かを言おうとして、優斗が大きく後ずさりし
た。
strings.translated: Yuuto started to answer at once -- then lurched a big step backward.

strings.text:
ハエのような昆虫が顔の真横を通過したらしく、飛び
去った背後の森をじっと見つめている。
strings.translated: A fly-like insect had apparently passed right beside his face, and he stood staring into the forest behind where it had flown off.

strings.text:
普段なら笑ってもいいところなのだろうが、今はとて
もそんな気分にはなれない。
strings.translated: Under normal circumstances, it might have been worth a laugh -- but right now, she couldn't bring herself to feel that way at all.

strings.text:
優斗もまた軽く咳払いをすると、夢美からはやや視線
を外して、口を開いた。
strings.translated: Yuuto gave a small cough, then averted his gaze slightly from Yumemi and opened his mouth.

strings.text:
優斗
「夢美ちゃんと一緒にいる時間が増えるって」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"That I'd get to spend more time with you, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text:
足元の草を踏み締めながら、優斗が少し坂になったと
ころを上っていく。
strings.translated: Yuuto trudged through the grass underfoot, climbing a slight incline.

strings.text:
夢美は視線で追ったが、優斗は顔を向けようとはしな
かった。
strings.translated: Yumemi followed him with her eyes, but Yuuto made no move to turn and face her.

strings.text:
優斗
「倉庫に押しかけたときもそう……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Same thing when I pushed my way into the warehouse..."

strings.text:
優斗
「君のことが心配だったってのは嘘じゃないけど、
　男と二人で倉庫で過ごしてるって言うのがすごく
　気になった」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"It's not a lie that I was worried about you,
 but what really got to me was hearing you'd been
 spending time alone in a warehouse with some guy."

strings.text:
優斗
「あの時はカッコ付けたこと言ったけど、本音なんて
　そんなもんだよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I said something cool-sounding back then, but
 that's the honest truth of it."

strings.text:
優斗
「レンって人と初めて会ったときもそう。
　すごくカッコイイ人だったから、最初の日は色々
　想像した」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Same thing when I first met that Ren guy.
 He was so good-looking that on that first day,
 I let my imagination run wild."

strings.text:
優斗
「あの人と君が、実は恋人同士なんじゃないか、とか、
　そうじゃなくても、夜は何かとナニなんじゃないか、
　とか…………」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Like, maybe the two of you were actually lovers,
 or even if not, maybe at night things got... you know...
 something like that..."

strings.text:
夢美
「そ、そんな事してませんっ！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"W-We never did anything like that!"

strings.text: 身を乗り出すようにして夢美が叫ぶ。
strings.translated: Yumemi cried out, practically throwing herself forward.

strings.text: 優斗も苦笑いしながら、数回頷いて返した。
strings.translated: Yuuto gave a strained smile in return and nodded a few times.

strings.text:
優斗
「分かってる。蟲をかわすトレーニングとか、倉庫の
　中の汚さとか見たとき、そういう次元の話じゃない
　んだって思ったから」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I know. When I saw the training to dodge Bugs,
 and how filthy it was inside that warehouse,
 I realized it wasn't that kind of situation at all."

strings.text:
優斗
「この世には、本当に一般には知られてない事があっ
　て、俺はそっち側を覗いたんだって分かったから」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I understood then that there are things in this world
 that are truly unknown to ordinary people,
 and that I'd gotten a glimpse of that side of things."

strings.text:
優斗の話を聞いて、夢美はホッとした様子で岩に座り
直した。
strings.translated: Listening to Yuuto, Yumemi seemed to relax, and she resettled herself on the rock.

strings.text:
レンが美形なのは認めるが、特別な感情を抱いたこと
は一切ない。
strings.translated: She could admit that Ren was handsome, but she had never once harbored any special feelings for him.

strings.text:
ましてや体を重ねるなど、夢美自身が想像したことも
なかった。
strings.translated: Let alone the thought of being physically intimate with him -- that had never even crossed Yumemi's mind.

strings.text:
だからこそ、一瞬でも優斗にそんな目で見られていた
事が、たまらなく悲しかった。
strings.translated: Which was precisely why it was unbearably painful to know that, even for a moment, Yuuto had looked at her that way.

strings.text:
夢美
「私……ちゃんとした形で、そういう風になった事な
　いです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I've... never been with anyone in a proper way like that."

strings.text:
夢美
「男の人としたのなんて、昔、犯されたときだけで、
　今でもやりたい放題やってるとか、そういうのはな
　いです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"The only time I've ever been with a man was when I was violated, a long time ago.
 It's not like I've been doing whatever I want with whoever I want."

strings.text:
優斗
「あ、ごめん。
　そんな風に考えてたわけじゃないんだけど」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Ah, sorry.
 I didn't mean it like that."

strings.text: やや慌てたように、優斗が言いつくろう。

だが、そんな事は説明されるまでもなく、夢美自身、
分かっていた。
strings.translated: But that much went without saying -- Yumemi already knew it herself.

strings.text:
優斗は、ただ夢美とレンの関係が気になっただけなの
だ。
strings.translated: Yuuto had simply been bothered by the nature of Yumemi's relationship with Ren.

strings.text:
二人の間にそういった肉体関係もあるのではと、不安
になっただけなのだ。
strings.translated: He had simply grown anxious, wondering if there might be a physical relationship between the two of them.

strings.text:
それが分かっていながら、夢美はわざと棘のある返事
をかえしてしまった。
strings.translated: And knowing all of that, Yumemi had deliberately given him a barbed reply.

strings.text:
その棘が優斗だけでなく、自分にも刺さると分かって
いながら言ってしまった。
strings.translated: She had said it knowing full well that the barb would pierce not only Yuuto, but herself as well.

Yumemi
(What a horrible woman I am...)

strings.text:
自分の腕を抱き締めるようにして、強く指を食い込ま
せる。
strings.translated: She wrapped her arms around herself, fingers digging in tight.

strings.text: 刺さった棘が、深く心臓まで達した気がした。
strings.translated: The barb she had driven in felt as though it had sunk deep, all the way to her heart.

strings.text:
背負っていたリュックサックがもぞもぞと動き、夢美
は慌ててチャックを開けた。
strings.translated: The backpack she had been carrying began to squirm, and Yumemi hurriedly unzipped it.

strings.text:
上下に割れた出入り口から、器用に触手を引っ掛けて
蟲が這い出てくる。
strings.translated: Through the opening that split apart top and bottom, the Bug deftly hooked its tentacles and crawled out.

strings.text:
ゴタゴタですっかり忘れていたが、ここに来るまで
リュックサックの中に詰めておいたのだ。
strings.translated: In all the commotion she had completely forgotten, but she had packed it inside the backpack for the journey here.

strings.text:
夢美
「ごめんね。狭かったでしょ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Sorry. It must have been cramped in there."

strings.text:
夢美の姿を認めると、蟲は甘えたように膝の上に降り
た。
strings.translated: Upon recognizing Yumemi, the Bug descended onto her lap as if seeking affection.

strings.text: 細長い触手を伸ばして、腕や腰に巻き付かせてくる。
strings.translated: It extended its long, slender tentacles and wound them around her arms and waist.

strings.text:
夢美
「こら、くすぐったいって」

優斗と気まずくなっていたところだけに、蟲が出てき
てくれたのは幸いだった。
strings.translated: Coming as it did just as things had grown awkward between her and Yuuto, the Bug's appearance was a welcome relief.

strings.text:
――と、蟲が何かに気付いたように、頭部を反対のほ
うに向けた瞬間、
strings.translated: And then -- just as the Bug turned its head in the opposite direction, as if noticing something,

strings.text:
ざあっ、と一陣の風が吹き抜けたように、何かが一斉
に辺りから逃げ出した。
strings.translated: As if a sudden gust of wind had swept through, everything in the vicinity fled all at once.

strings.text:
夢美の座っている場所を中心に、森に棲んでいた全て
の生き物が、気配さえ感じ取れないほど遠くへ逃げて
いった。
strings.translated: Centered on where Yumemi sat, every living creature that had dwelt in the forest fled so far away that not even a trace of their presence could be felt.

strings.text:
これには、夢美のみならず優斗も気付いたようで、
何事かと辺りを見回していた。
strings.translated: Not only Yumemi, but Yuuto seemed to notice as well, and he looked around, wondering what was happening.

strings.text: ある一つの感情が、夢美の肌に伝わってきていた。
strings.translated: A single emotion was making itself felt on Yumemi's skin.

strings.text:
何故、そんな風に感じるのかは分からなかったが、
確信をもってその感情を受け止めることができた。
strings.translated: Why she felt that way, she couldn't say -- but she was able to receive that emotion with absolute certainty.

strings.text:
森に棲んでいた全ての生き物達が、一斉に『何か』に
怯えた。
strings.translated: Every living creature that had dwelt in the forest was seized all at once by fear of "something."

strings.text: いや、何に怯えたのかなど、考えるまでもない。
strings.translated: No -- there was no need to even wonder what they feared.

strings.text: 夢美の連れて来た蟲に、この森全体が恐怖したのだ。
strings.translated: The entire forest trembled in fear of the Bug Yumemi had brought with her.

strings.text:
それはあたかも、森の中で猛獣が吼えた瞬間に似てい
た……。
strings.translated: It was as if a wild beast had roared somewhere deep in the woods...

strings.text:
優斗
「何だろう。嵐でも来るのかな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I wonder what that was. A storm coming, maybe?"

strings.text:
夢美
「ど、どうなんでしょうね」

優斗
「こういう変化には注意したほうがいい。
　一種の警告かもしれないからね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"It's best to pay attention to changes like that.
 It could be a kind of warning."

strings.text:
幸か不幸か、優斗は森の雰囲気が変化した原因には
気付いていないようだった。
strings.translated: For better or worse, Yuuto didn't seem to have noticed the true cause of the shift in the forest's atmosphere.

strings.text: ともあれ、何となく会話ができてしまった。
strings.translated: At any rate, somehow they had managed to fall into conversation.

strings.text:
優斗もこの流れを逃すまいと思ったのか、夢美に近付
いてきて、蟲を覗き込むように腰を低くした。
strings.translated: Perhaps sensing an opportunity he couldn't afford to miss, Yuuto drew closer to Yumemi and crouched down to peer at the Bug.

strings.text:
優斗
「すごく賢い子なんだね」

夢美
「はい。私の言うことも、結構理解してくれて……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yes. She understands quite a lot of what I say..."

strings.text:
夢美
「この子がいてくれたから、私は一人にならずにすん
　だんです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Having her around is the reason I never had to be alone."

strings.text:
ゴツゴツとした背中を撫でながら、夢美が愛しそうな
声で話す。
strings.translated: Stroking the Bug's rough, jagged back, Yumemi spoke in a tender voice.

strings.text:
最近は倉庫でのトレーニングが忙しかったため、こう
してゆっくりと撫でてやる時間が減っていた。
strings.translated: Training at the warehouse had kept her busy lately, and she'd had less and less time to sit and stroke the Bug like this.

strings.text:
声を掛けてやる時間も、餌を与える回数も格段に減っ
ていた。
strings.translated: The time she spent talking to it, the number of times she fed it -- both had dropped sharply.

strings.text: その寂しさを、蟲はきっと我慢していたのだろう。
strings.translated: The Bug had surely been enduring that loneliness in silence.

strings.text:
夢美がくたくたになって、ビニールシートの上で寝て
しまうのを、甘えたい気持ちを我慢して見守っていた
のだろう。
strings.translated: It had held back its desire for affection and watched over Yumemi as she collapsed from exhaustion and fell asleep on the vinyl sheet.

strings.text:
その事を思うと、夢美は胸が締め付けられるように
痛んだ。
strings.translated: When she thought of that, Yumemi felt a tightening ache in her chest.

strings.text:
夢美
「ごめんね。母親、失格だね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm sorry. I'm a failure of a mother, aren't I?"

strings.text: 蟲の胴体を抱えて、ぎゅっと胸で抱き締める。
strings.translated: She wrapped her arms around the Bug's body and hugged it tightly to her chest.

strings.text:
この蟲を自分の子供だと思えるようになったのは、
一体いつの頃からだっただろうか。
strings.translated: When had she come to think of this Bug as her own child?

strings.text:
考えてもすぐには思い出せなかったが、重要なのは
今の気持ちだった。
strings.translated: She couldn't recall right away even when she tried, but what mattered was how she felt right now.

strings.text:
夢美
「うん、アンタもいるんだもんね。
　絶対に一週間生き延びて、レンを一回くらい引っ叩
　いてやんないと」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yeah, you're here too, aren't you.
 I absolutely have to survive this week and slap Ren at least once."

strings.text:
優斗
「ああ、それはいい目標かも」

優斗
「俺も一発くらい殴ってみようかな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Maybe I'll try landing a punch too."

strings.text:
夢美
「いいんじゃないですか。
　こっちは命が懸かってるんだから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Why not.
 Our lives are on the line here, after all."

strings.text: ようやく顔を見合わせて、互いに肩を揺らして笑う。
strings.translated: At last they looked at each other and laughed, shoulders shaking.

strings.text:
まだ、どこかぎこちなさはあったものの、気分はだい
ぶ軽くなっていた。
strings.translated: There was still a trace of awkwardness between them, but the mood had grown considerably lighter.

strings.text:
夢美
「あの、さっきはごめんなさい」

夢美
「優斗さんがそういうつもりじゃないって分かってて、
　あんなこと言っちゃって……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I knew you didn't mean it that way, and I still said those things..."

strings.text:
優斗
「あ、いや……
　俺のほうこそ、変なこと勘ぐっちゃって……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Ah, no...
 I'm the one who jumped to weird conclusions..."

strings.text:
気まずそうにしながらも、優斗が真っ直ぐに視線を
向けてくる。
strings.translated: Looking a little awkward, Yuuto turned his gaze directly toward her.

strings.text:
優斗
「これだけはハッキリ言っておくけど、俺、夢美ちゃ
　んのこと、そういう風に思ったことないから」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I want to be clear about one thing -- I have never once thought of you as that kind of girl, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text:
優斗
「まあ、知らないことのほうがいっぱいあるから、
　俺の勝手なイメージで話しちゃってる部分もある
　と思うんだけどね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Well, there's still a lot I don't know about you, so I think some of what I said came from my own assumptions."

strings.text:
優斗
「だから、その……こういう事にはなっちゃったけど、
　夢美ちゃんの事、少しでも知りたいって思ってる」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"So... even though things ended up like this, I want to know more about you, even just a little."

strings.text:
蟲を抱いた胸の奥が、じんと熱くなってくるのを感じ
た。
strings.translated: She felt a warm, spreading heat deep in the chest that held the Bug.

strings.text:
誰かからこんなにも真剣に想われたのは、夢美の人生
において初めての事だ。
strings.translated: Being thought of this sincerely by someone -- it was the first time in Yumemi's life.

strings.text:
これからの問題は山積みだが、少なくとも今この時点
で自分は不幸ではないと、そう思うことができた。
strings.translated: The problems ahead were piling up, but at least right now, in this moment, she could tell herself she was not unhappy.

strings.text:
優斗
「……っと、そろそろ行こうか。
　いつまでもここに座ってても仕方ないし」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"...Right, we should get going.
 No point sitting here forever."

strings.text:
照れ隠しなのか、すっくと立ち上がって優斗が森の奥
を見つめた。
strings.translated: Whether out of embarrassment or not, he stood up straight and stared into the depths of the forest.

strings.text:
頬が微かに赤いのが、夢美の座っている位置からでも
分かる。
strings.translated: His cheeks were faintly red -- visible even from where Yumemi sat.

strings.text:
蟲を抱きながら立ち上がると、また森がざわっと揺れ
た気がした。
strings.translated: As she stood up with the Bug in her arms, she thought she felt the forest rustle again.

strings.text:
ピリッと電気が走ったような刺激が、夢美の右腕を
走り抜けた。
strings.translated: A sharp, electric jolt ran through Yumemi's right arm.

strings.text:
腕が痺れたというわけではなく、右腕の代わりをして
くれている蟲が、何かを伝えてくれているような気が
する。
strings.translated: It wasn't that her arm had gone numb -- it felt more like the Bug serving as her right arm was trying to tell her something.

strings.text: 夢美は顔を上げると、ぐるりと辺りを見回してみた。
strings.translated: Yumemi raised her face and looked around at her surroundings.

strings.text:
暗い蒼のベールが掛かった森は、いつの間にかその
雰囲気を一片させていた。
strings.translated: The forest, draped in its dark veil of blue, had shifted its atmosphere entirely without her noticing.

strings.text:
誰もいないはずの空間から、自分達へ向けられた敵意
のようなものを感じる。
strings.translated: From a space where no one should have been, she sensed something like hostility directed toward the two of them.

strings.text:
まるで、森そのものが夢美を拒絶しているような、
そんな気配が漂っているような気がした。
strings.translated: It felt as though the forest itself was rejecting Yumemi -- that kind of presence seemed to hang in the air.

strings.text:
夢美の様子が変わったことに気付いたのだろう、優斗
が遠慮がちに声をかけてきた。
strings.translated: He must have noticed the change in Yumemi's demeanor -- Yuuto called out to her hesitantly.

strings.text: 先ほどの話が尾を引いているのか、表情は硬い。
strings.translated: Perhaps the earlier conversation was still weighing on him; his expression was stiff.

strings.text:
夢美
「いえ……何となく、誰かに見られてるような気がし
　たんです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"No... it just felt like someone was watching us, somehow."

strings.text: 眉根を寄せながら、優斗が辺りの様子を窺う。
strings.translated: Furrowing his brow, Yuuto scanned the area.

strings.text:
だが、視界には人間の姿どころか、昆虫一匹見つける
ことはできなかった。
strings.translated: But no matter how hard he looked, there wasn't a single human in sight -- not even an insect.

strings.text:
優斗
「誰かいませんかーっ！」
大きめの声を出して、優斗が森に呼びかけた。
strings.translated: Yuuto called out into the forest in a raised voice.

strings.text:
誰かを呼ぶというよりは、自分達の居場所を伝えるた
めのような声の出し方だ。
strings.translated: It sounded less like he was trying to summon someone and more like he was announcing their presence.

strings.text:
暫く待ってはみたが、予想通り誰かがやって来る気配
はない。
strings.translated: They waited for a while, but as expected, there was no sign of anyone approaching.

strings.text:
本当に誰もいないのかどうかは分からなかったが、
少なくとも二人を助けてくれるような人物は、そば
にはいないようだった。
strings.translated: Whether there was truly no one there, they couldn't say -- but at the very least, there didn't seem to be anyone nearby who would come to their aid.

strings.text:
優斗
「やっぱり誰もいないみたいだね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Looks like there's really no one here after all."

strings.text: 優斗と視線を合わせて、夢美がぎこちなく笑う。
strings.translated: Yumemi met Yuuto's gaze and smiled awkwardly.

strings.text:
先ほどの気まずさが、いっそう増して二人の間を流れ
ていった。
strings.translated: The lingering awkwardness from before swelled even further and drifted between the two of them.

strings.text:
優斗
「あの、さ……さっきはごめん……」

夢美
「い、いえ、私こそ、あんな言い方しちゃって」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"N-no, I'm the one who said it like that..."

strings.text:
優斗
「言い訳してるみたいでナンだけど、俺、夢美ちゃん
　のこと、本当にそんな風に思ってたわけじゃないか
　ら……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I know it sounds like I'm making excuses, but... I never really thought of you as that kind of girl, Yumemi-chan..."

strings.text:
優斗
「結局、たぶん、レンって人に妬いてただけで……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"In the end, I was probably just jealous of that Ren guy..."

strings.text:
優斗
「その……ほら、夢美ちゃんのこと、お店で働いてる
　以上の事は知らなかったから、だから…………」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"That... well, you know -- I didn't know anything about you beyond working at the shop, so that's why..."

strings.text:
必死に説明しようとして声が高くなり、すぐに萎むよ
うに小さくなっていく。
strings.translated: He tried desperately to explain himself, his voice rising, then quickly deflating into something small.

strings.text:
だが、優斗が何を言わんとしたのかは、何となく夢美
にも伝わった。
strings.translated: But somehow, what Yuuto was trying to say still managed to reach Yumemi.

strings.text:
優斗
「こういうのがダメなんだよな、俺は……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"This is what's wrong with me..."

strings.text:
優斗
「いや、よく友達に言われるんだ。
　お前は大事なことほど、グジグジしてるって」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"No, it's just -- my friends tell me all the time. They say I get all wishy-washy about the things that matter most."

strings.text:
優斗
「まあ、とにかく……その……えっと…………」

優斗
「だから、その……こういう事にはなっちゃったけど、
　夢美ちゃんの事、少しでも知りたいって思ってる」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"So... even though things ended up like this, I want to know more about you, even just a little."

strings.text: 胸の奥が、じんと熱くなってくるのを感じた。
strings.translated: She felt a warm, spreading heat deep in her chest.

strings.text:
誰かからこんなにも真剣に想われたのは、夢美の人生
において初めての事だ。
strings.translated: Being thought of this sincerely by someone -- it was the first time in Yumemi's life.

strings.text:
これからの問題は山積みだが、少なくとも今この時点
で自分は不幸ではないと、そう思うことができた。
strings.translated: The problems ahead were piling up, but at least right now, in this moment, she could tell herself she was not unhappy.

strings.text:
優斗
「……っと、そろそろ行こうか。
　いつまでもここに座ってても仕方ないし」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"...Right, we should get going.
 No point sitting here forever."

strings.text:
照れ隠しなのか、すっくと立ち上がって優斗が森の奥
を見つめた。
strings.translated: Whether out of embarrassment or not, he stood up straight and stared into the depths of the forest.

strings.text:
頬が微かに赤いのが、夢美の座っている位置からでも
分かる。
strings.translated: His cheeks were faintly red -- visible even from where Yumemi sat.

strings.text:
――と、その時、不意に右腕がびりっと痺れたように
震えた気がした。
strings.translated: -- And then, all of a sudden, her right arm seemed to tremble as if jolted by a sharp electric shock.

strings.text: 温かな時間は終わり、現実の冷たさが忍び寄ってくる。
strings.translated: The warmth of that moment ended, and the cold of reality crept in.

strings.text:
優斗の気持ちは嬉しいが、いつまでもその話をしてい
るわけにもいかなかった。
strings.translated: Yuuto's feelings made her happy, but she couldn't keep dwelling on that conversation forever.

strings.text:
優斗
「そうか。もう夕方なんだ」

徐々に暗くなっている森の様子に気付いて、優斗の
表情にも緊張感が戻った。
strings.translated: Noticing how the forest had grown steadily darker, the tension returned to Yuuto's expression as well.

strings.text:
話したいこと、話さなければならない事は多くあった
が、今は全て後回しだった。
strings.translated:
There was much she wanted to say, much she knew she had to say --
but all of it could wait until later.

strings.text:
優斗
「あのレンって人は一週間生き延びろって言ってたけ
　ど、どうする？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"That Ren guy said to survive for a week -- what do you want to do?"

strings.text:
夢美
「え、っと……何が、でしょう？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Uh, um... what do you mean, exactly?"

strings.text:
優斗
「本当にここで一週間過ごすか、それとも森を出る
　か」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Whether we really spend a week here, or leave the forest."

strings.text:
優斗に言われて、「森を出る」という選択肢もある事
に気付いた。
strings.translated: Prompted by Yuuto, she realized that "leaving the forest" was also an option.

strings.text: ここに来るまで約三時間。
strings.translated: It had taken about three hours to get here.

strings.text:
それは裏を返せば、三時間程度で森を出ることもでき
るという事だ。
strings.translated: Which meant, in other words, that they could also leave the forest in roughly three hours.

strings.text:
なんとなく、レンが「森の奥のほうが都合が良い」と
言っていた理由が分かったような気がした。
strings.translated: She felt as though she now understood, vaguely, why Ren had said "deeper in the forest is more convenient."

strings.text:
夢美
「出られるなら、出たいですけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"If we can get out, I'd want to... but..."

strings.text:
優斗
「じゃあ、今日は寝られる場所を探して、明日出口の
　ほうに歩いてみようか」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Then let's find somewhere to sleep tonight, and try walking toward the exit tomorrow."

strings.text: 優斗の提案に、夢美は笑顔で賛成した……。
strings.translated: Yumemi smiled and agreed with Yuuto's suggestion...

strings.text: 森の夜が訪れるのは、思いのほか早かった。
strings.translated: Night came to the forest sooner than she had expected.

strings.text:
都会より遥かに濃密な闇が、夢美と優斗の体を包み込
んでくる。
strings.translated: A darkness far denser than anything in the city closed in around Yumemi and Yuuto.

strings.text:
肌に触れる空気は一気に冷たさを増し、冬でもないの
に体が震えるほど寒かった。
strings.translated: The air against her skin turned bitterly cold all at once -- cold enough to make her shiver, and it wasn't even winter.
A week with their lives on the line ----

strings.text:
日中のうちにあった余裕は、単に覚悟が足りないだけ
だった。
strings.translated: The ease she had felt during the day had only meant she hadn't truly braced herself.

strings.text:
体が凍えるほどの冷気を浴びれば、自分がいかに甘い
考えを抱いていたのかが分かる。
strings.translated: Bathed in cold that chilled her to the bone, she understood just how naive her thinking had been.

strings.text: 出られるなら出たい、ではない。
strings.translated: It wasn't a matter of wanting to leave if they could.

strings.text:
氷のような岩場で膝を抱えながら、夢美は心の底から
この森を出たいと感じていた。
strings.translated:
Hugging her knees on the ice-cold rocks, Yumemi felt it from the bottom of her heart --
she wanted out of this forest.

strings.text: 夢美の隣で、優斗がうつらうつらと舟を漕いでいた。
strings.translated: Beside Yumemi, Yuuto was nodding in and out of sleep.

strings.text:
互いに体を寄せ合っているため、相手の動きはすぐに
伝わってくる。
strings.translated: Since they were pressed close together, every movement the other made was immediately felt.

strings.text:
だが、視界を覆った深い闇は、たった数十センチ先の
優斗の顔ですら、見るのを許してはくれなかった。
strings.translated: But the deep darkness blanketing her vision would not permit her to see even Yuuto's face, just a few dozen centimeters away.

strings.text:
硬く握り合った手の感触だけが、唯一感じられるぬく
もりだった。
strings.translated: The warmth of their tightly clasped hands was the only warmth she could feel.

strings.text:
胸に詰まっていたものを吐き出すように、重たい溜息
を漏らす。
strings.translated: She let out a heavy sigh, as if expelling something that had been lodged in her chest.

strings.text:
眠くて眠くてたまらなかったが、肌に染み込むような
冷気が、睡魔さえも凍り付かせていく。
strings.translated: She was desperately, unbearably sleepy, but the cold seeping into her skin was freezing even the urge to sleep.

strings.text:
恐怖が一種の興奮状態に陥らせているのか、カタカタ
と震えながらじっと目の前の闇を見つめていた。
strings.translated: Perhaps fear had worked her into a kind of agitated state; she sat trembling, staring fixedly into the darkness before her.

strings.text:
自分が寝ていたことに気付いたのか、真横から優斗の
声が聞こえた。
strings.translated: Yuuto must have realized he had dozed off; his voice came from right beside her.

strings.text: 答えると、優斗が軽く笑った気配がする。
strings.translated: When she answered, she sensed Yuuto give a quiet laugh.

strings.text:
優斗
「ごめん。俺、何か話してたよね？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Sorry. I was saying something, wasn't I?"

strings.text:
夢美
「はい。今の大学に入ったあたりの事を……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yes. Something about when you started at your current university..."

strings.text:
この暗闇の中にあって、互いの気を紛らわせる行為と
いえば会話しかなかった。
strings.translated: In this darkness, conversation was the only thing they had to distract each other.

strings.text:
話題は何でもよく、とにかく喋ることだけで、寒さや
恐怖から目を背けることができた。
strings.translated: The topic didn't matter -- just talking was enough to keep their minds off the cold and the fear.

strings.text:
優斗
「そっか、話しながら寝ちゃったのか」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I see, so I fell asleep mid-conversation."

strings.text:
夢美
「はい、だんだん声が小さくなっていったから、分か
　りやすかったですよ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yes. Your voice kept getting quieter, so it was pretty obvious."

strings.text:
優斗
「起こしてくれれば良かったのに」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"You could have woken me up."

strings.text:
夢美
「そんなの悪いです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I didn't want to bother you."

strings.text:
これが真冬の気温なのであれば、夢美は肩を揺するな
りして起こしただろう。
strings.translated: If this had been the dead of winter, Yumemi would have shaken his shoulder to rouse him.

strings.text:
だが、凍死するほど寒いわけではないため、そのまま
眠らせることにしたのだ。
strings.translated: But since it wasn't cold enough to freeze to death, she had decided to let him sleep.

strings.text:
優斗
「今、何時くらいかな？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"What time do you think it is now?"

strings.text:
夢美
「さあ？　どうなんでしょうね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Who knows? I have no idea."

strings.text: 辺りを見回すが、やはり何も見えない。
strings.translated: She looked around, but still couldn't see anything.

strings.text:
時折、昆虫か何かの気配や音はするが、変化らしい
変化はそれだけだ。
strings.translated: There were sounds and signs of insects or something nearby, but that was the only change to speak of.

strings.text:
何時間後になるかは分からない日の出まで、夢美は
ただ体を縮こまらせて、寒さに耐えるしかなかった。
strings.translated: Until sunrise -- however many hours away that might be -- all Yumemi could do was curl herself up and endure the cold.

strings.text:
――と、優斗の手がぴくっと跳ね、夢美の手を強く
握り締めた。
strings.translated: Then -- Yuuto's hand gave a sudden twitch and gripped hers tightly.

strings.text: 話しかけてみるが反応はない。
strings.translated: She tried speaking to him, but got no response.

strings.text: どうやら、また眠ってしまったらしかった。
strings.translated: It seemed he had fallen back asleep.

strings.text:
夢美
「早く……朝にならないかな…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I wish morning would come... already..."

strings.text:
何も見えない事が分かっていながら頭上を見上げて、
夢美は白い息を吐いた……。
strings.translated: Knowing full well she couldn't see anything, Yumemi looked up overhead and breathed out a white puff of air...

strings.text:
小川のせせらぎを聞きながら、夢美と優斗はぼんやり
とその場に立ち尽くしていた。
strings.translated: Listening to the babbling of a small stream, Yumemi and Yuuto stood there in a daze, rooted to the spot.

strings.text: 渡る場所がない、というわけではない。
strings.translated: It wasn't that there was no place to cross.

strings.text:
むしろ立ち尽くしている理由はその逆で、渡っていい
ものかどうかが判断できなかったからだ。
strings.translated: Rather, the reason they stood frozen was the opposite -- they couldn't decide whether they should cross at all.

strings.text:
夢美の手を引いて先行していた優斗が、溜息混じりに
額を押さえた。
strings.translated: Yuuto, who had been leading Yumemi by the hand, pressed his hand to his forehead with a sigh.

strings.text: レンに連れられて来たときは、小川など渡っていない。
strings.translated: When Ren had brought them here, they hadn't crossed any stream.

strings.text:
道を間違えたのか、それとも来るときは気付かなかっ
ただけか……。
strings.translated: Had they taken a wrong turn, or had they simply not noticed it on the way here...?

strings.text:
優斗
「夢美ちゃん、少し休もうか？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Yumemi-chan, shall we rest for a bit?"

strings.text:
眠気でフラフラになっていた夢美は、辛うじて返事を
かえす事ができた。
strings.translated: Yumemi, swaying on her feet from drowsiness, managed to squeeze out a reply.

strings.text:
歩き始めてまだ一時間程しか経っていないが、そろそ
ろ限界だ。
strings.translated: They had only been walking for about an hour, but she was already reaching her limit.

strings.text:
昨晩、なかなか眠れなかった影響が、ここにきて猛烈
な睡魔を夢美に運んでいた。
strings.translated: The effect of not being able to sleep well last night was now bearing down on Yumemi in the form of an overwhelming wave of sleepiness.

strings.text:
優斗
「あっちに行こう。
　地面が平たいし、草も乾いてるみたいだから」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Let's go over there.
 The ground is flat, and the grass looks dry."

strings.text:
生あくびをしながら答えて、夢美はやや硬い地面のと
ころまで連れて行かれた。
strings.translated: Answering with a half-formed yawn, Yumemi was led over to a patch of firmer ground.

strings.text:
あまり寝心地が良さそうな感触ではなかったが、
この際、贅沢は言っていられない。
strings.translated: It didn't feel like it would be particularly comfortable to sleep on, but under the circumstances, she was in no position to be picky.

strings.text: 体を伸ばして眠れる分、昨日より何倍もマシだった。
strings.translated: Being able to stretch out and sleep made it many times better than the night before.

strings.text:
優斗
「俺、ちょっとその辺見回って来るから。
　ここで待っててね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I'm going to take a look around the area for a bit.
 Wait here for me."

strings.text: とても遠いところから、優斗の声が聞こえる。
strings.translated: Yuuto's voice reached her from somewhere very far away.

strings.text: 返事をしようと思ったが、あまりに気だるくてやめた。
strings.translated: She thought about responding, but felt too lethargic to bother.

strings.text:
まともに思考が働かず、とにかく眠ることだけを体が
求めていた。
strings.translated: Her thoughts refused to function properly -- her body was demanding nothing but sleep.

strings.text:
優斗が離れていく気配を感じながら、夢美は深い眠り
へと落ちていった。
strings.translated: Sensing Yuuto moving away, Yumemi sank down into a deep sleep.

strings.text:
背中を包み込む地面の感触は、思ったよりも心地良
かった……。
strings.translated: The feeling of the ground enveloping her back was more comfortable than she had expected...

strings.text:
夢美が目を覚ましたとき、森はすっかり明るさを取り
戻していた。
strings.translated: When Yumemi opened her eyes, the forest had fully reclaimed its light.

strings.text:
木々の隙間から蒼の光が射し込み、辺り一面を絵画の
ように浮かび上がらせている。
strings.translated: Blue light filtered in through the gaps between the trees, illuminating everything around her like a painting.

strings.text: 朝が早いためか、今は鳥の声すら聞こえない。
strings.translated: Perhaps because it was still so early, not even the sound of birds could be heard.

strings.text:
しっとりとした静寂が肌に染み込んでくるようで、
夢美は暫しその心地良さに身を預けた。
strings.translated: A moist stillness seemed to seep into her skin, and Yumemi surrendered herself to its pleasant embrace for a moment.

strings.text: ふと気付けば、優斗の姿がどこにもなかった。
strings.translated: She suddenly realized that Yuuto was nowhere to be seen.

strings.text:
二つの買い物袋は地面に置きっぱなしで、特に中身が
減った様子もない。
strings.translated: The two shopping bags had been left sitting on the ground, and their contents didn't appear to have diminished at all.

strings.text:
一瞬、優斗に何かあったのかと思ったが、それもどこ
か違うような気がして、暫くその場で待つことにした。
strings.translated: For a moment she wondered if something had happened to Yuuto, but something felt off about that thought, so she decided to wait there for a while.

strings.text: ぶるりと肩が震えて、くしゃみが一つ出た。
strings.translated: Her shoulders gave a shiver, and she let out a sneeze.

strings.text:
服装が服装だけに、肩や太ももが冷え切ってしまって
いる。
strings.translated: Given her sparse clothing, her shoulders and thighs had gone completely cold.

strings.text:
風邪を引かなかっただけマシだが、今夜も同じ状況で
寝るはめになったとしたら、さすがにどうなるか分か
らなかった。
strings.translated: She was lucky not to have caught a cold, but if she ended up sleeping in the same conditions again tonight, she honestly had no idea what would become of her.

strings.text:
夢美
「あんたも眠れたかな？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Did you manage to sleep too?"

strings.text:
脇に置いてあったリュックサックを開けて、中にいる
蟲を覗き込む。
strings.translated: She opened the rucksack set beside her and peered in at the Bug inside.

strings.text:
――と、真っ直ぐに目が合って、蟲が細い触手を伸ば
してきた。
strings.translated: Their eyes met directly, and the Bug extended a slender tendril toward her.

strings.text:
夢美は、それを指で遊んでやりながら、優しく蟲の
胴体を抱え揚げる。
strings.translated: Yumemi played with it using her finger, then gently scooped the Bug's body up in her arms.

strings.text:
快適な目覚めには程遠かったが、夢美は笑顔で蟲に
話しかけた。
strings.translated: It was far from a comfortable awakening, but Yumemi spoke to the Bug with a smile.

strings.text:
背中を撫でてみると、氷のように冷たい感触が指に
伝わってくる。
strings.translated: When she stroked its back, an ice-cold sensation traveled through her fingertips.

strings.text:
あまりに冷たかったため、本当に大丈夫なのかと心配
になってしまうほどだった。
strings.translated: It was so cold that she found herself genuinely worried whether it was really all right.

strings.text: 右腕を摩りながら、夢美は愛しそうにそう挨拶した。
strings.translated: Rubbing her right arm, Yumemi greeted it with an affectionate look.

strings.text:
たとえ姿は変わってしまっても、夢美を支えてくれる
存在は確かにそこにいる。
strings.translated: Even if her form had changed, the presence that supported Yumemi was undeniably there.

strings.text: それが、夢美を不安から掬い上げてくれていた。
strings.translated: And that was what lifted Yumemi out of her anxiety.

strings.text:
少し離れたところから声がして、夢美はハッと顔を
上げた。
strings.translated: A voice called out from a short distance away, and Yumemi snapped her head up.

strings.text:
傾斜が急な岩場を滑るようにしながら、優斗が平たい
地面へと着地する。
strings.translated: Yuuto slid down a steep rocky slope and landed on flat ground.

strings.text:
昨日より髪がボサついているが、それ以外は割りと
元気そうだった。
strings.translated: His hair was more disheveled than yesterday, but aside from that, he looked reasonably well.

strings.text:
優斗
「じゃ、食事にしようか？　お腹空いてるよね？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Well then, shall we eat? You must be hungry, right?"

strings.text: 腹の虫こそ鳴らなかったが、確かにお腹は空いていた。
strings.translated: Her stomach hadn't growled, but she was certainly hungry.

strings.text:
昨日からロクなものを食べていないせいもあり、食欲
は十分にある。
strings.translated: Having eaten almost nothing since yesterday, she had more than enough of an appetite.

strings.text:
優斗は買い物袋から菓子パンを取り出すと、それを
夢美に手渡した。
strings.translated: Yuuto reached into a shopping bag and pulled out some sweet bread rolls, then handed them to Yumemi.

strings.text:
優斗
「あっ、手を洗うならあっちに小さな川があるよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Oh, if you want to wash your hands, there's a small stream over that way."

strings.text:
優斗
「ついでに顔を洗うのもいいかもしれない」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"You might want to wash your face while you're at it."

strings.text:
何気ない優斗の言葉に、夢美はハッと気付いたことが
あった。
strings.translated: Yuuto's offhand remark made Yumemi suddenly realize something.

strings.text:
今更の話だが、自分が寝ていた間、優斗はずっと辺り
を見回っていたらしい。
strings.translated: It was obvious in hindsight, but it seemed that while she had been sleeping, Yuuto had been keeping watch over the area the whole time.

strings.text:
おそらく、ちょくちょく戻ってきては、夢美がまだ
寝ていることを確認し、再度見回りに行ったのだろう。
strings.translated: He had probably been coming back periodically to check that Yumemi was still asleep, then heading out again to patrol.

strings.text:
夢美
「へ、変な顔してませんでした？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"W-was my face doing anything weird?"

strings.text: そう言って、優斗が慌てて口を塞ぐ。
strings.translated: Saying that, Yuuto hurriedly clapped a hand over his mouth.

strings.text:
相手に気を遣うなら、ここは「見てないよ」と答える
べきところだった。
strings.translated: If he was trying to be considerate of Yumemi's feelings, the right answer here would have been "I wasn't looking."

strings.text:
優斗
「こ、このパンおいしいね？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"T-this bread is good, isn't it?"

strings.text:
夢美
「え……ええっ、そうですねっ！」

強引に話を変える優斗に、夢美もまた強引についてい
く。
strings.translated: Yuuto forced the subject to change, and Yumemi forced herself to follow along.

strings.text:
どちらも、これ以上この話題に触れてはいけないと、
警告のようなものを発していた。
strings.translated: Both of them were sending out a kind of warning that this topic must not be touched any further.

strings.text: パンの味は、思っていたよりも美味しかった……。
strings.translated: The bread tasted better than she had expected...

strings.text: 食事を終えたあとは、森の出口に向けて歩き始めた。
strings.translated: After finishing their meal, they set off walking toward the forest exit.

strings.text:
昨日は三時間歩いたのだから、今日も三時間歩けば
出られるはず……。
strings.translated: They had walked three hours yesterday, so if they walked three hours today, they should be able to get out...

strings.text:
そんなに簡単にいくとは思っていないが、それでも
三時間で出られるならそれに越したことはない。
strings.translated: They didn't think it would be that simple, but even so, if they could get out in three hours, that would be the best outcome.

strings.text:
昨日の記憶を必死にたぐり寄せて、夢美と優斗は
森の中を歩き続けていた。
strings.translated:
Desperately grasping at the memories of the day before, Yumemi and Yuuto
kept walking through the forest.

strings.text: ――既に四時間が経過していた。

優斗
「少し休憩にしよう。
　そろそろお腹も空いてきたし」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Let's take a short break.
 We're starting to get hungry again."

strings.text:
岩場になった場所を見つけて、二人はそこへ腰を下ろ
した。
strings.translated: They found a rocky area and sat down there.

strings.text:
ひんやりとした感触が、布地を通して肌に伝わってく
る。
strings.translated: A cool sensation seeped through the fabric and reached their skin.

strings.text:
昼間と言えど森の気温は低く、吐く息が微かに白かっ
た。
strings.translated: Even in the middle of the day, the temperature in the forest was low, and their breath came out faintly white.

strings.text:
優斗
「実は、ちょっとまずいことになってる」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Actually, we're in a bit of a bad situation."

strings.text:
昼食のパンを齧りながら、優斗が真剣な顔をして言っ
た。
strings.translated: Yuuto said this with a serious expression, nibbling on his lunch bread.

strings.text:
優斗
「どっちに行けばいいのか、本当に分からなくなっ
　た」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I genuinely have no idea which way we should go."

strings.text:
夢美
「帰り道が、分からないってことですか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"You mean... you don't know the way back?"

strings.text:
優斗はすぐに返事はしなかったが、「違う」と即答し
ない時点で答えは決まったも同然だ。
strings.translated: Yuuto didn't answer right away, but the fact that he didn't immediately say "no" made the answer as good as decided.

strings.text:
道も案内板もない場所で、二人は進むべき方向さえ
見失ったのだった。
strings.translated:
In a place with no paths and no signs, the two had lost even their sense
of which direction to go.

strings.text:
優斗
「このままここにいても仕方ないし、どこかに方向を
　決めて歩くしかないと思う」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"We can't just stay here forever. I think we need to pick a direction and start walking."

strings.text:
優斗
「待ってても救助が来るわけじゃないからね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"It's not like help is going to come to us if we wait."

strings.text:
いつもより低い声で言う優斗に、夢美の気分は暗く
落ち込んでいった。
strings.translated: Yuuto's voice was lower than usual, and Yumemi felt her spirits sink.

strings.text: 余裕のない口調から、事態の深刻さが窺える。
strings.translated: The tension in his tone made the gravity of their situation all too clear.

strings.text:
心のどこかで、今日のうちに森から出られると楽観的
に考えていた部分があったため、帰り道が分からない
という事態には少なからずショックを受けた。
strings.translated: Somewhere in the back of her mind, she had been optimistically assuming they would make it out of the forest by today -- so the reality that they had no idea how to get back came as quite a shock.

strings.text:
優斗
「今日は少し長く歩くかもしれないから、今のうちに
　水分は補給したほうがいいよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"We might be walking for a while today, so you should drink some water while you can."

strings.text:
二人が休んでいる場所のそばには、小さな川が流れて
いた。
strings.translated: A small stream ran near where the two had stopped to rest.

strings.text:
見た目は透明だが、飲んで大丈夫なのかどうかは分か
らない。
strings.translated: It looked clear enough, but whether it was safe to drink was another question entirely.

strings.text:
ただ、その水を飲まなければ、他に飲める物がないの
もまた事実だった。
strings.translated: Still, if they didn't drink from it, there was simply nothing else to drink -- and that was the plain truth.

strings.text:
優斗
「水、買っておけば良かったんだけどね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"We should have bought more water."

strings.text: 優斗が、割りと真剣な顔をしてつぶやく。
strings.translated: Yuuto murmured, his expression unusually serious.

strings.text:
レンには食料を一週間分と言われたため、飲料水は
あまり買い込まなかったのだ。
strings.translated: Ren had told them to bring a week's worth of food, so they hadn't stocked up much on drinking water.

strings.text:
いつ、森を出られるか分からない以上、水分補給は
重要な課題だった。
strings.translated: With no way of knowing when they would get out of the forest, staying hydrated was a critical concern.

strings.text:
夢美
「飲んでもいいと思います？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Do you think it's safe to drink?"

strings.text:
優斗
「見た目は綺麗だから、死ぬことはないと思うんだけ
　ど……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"It looks clean, so I don't think it'll kill us, but..."

strings.text:
暫く悩んでみたが、「飲まない」という選択肢は無い
に等しい。
strings.translated: They thought it over for a while, but the option of "not drinking" was essentially off the table.

strings.text:
結局、諦めて川の水を口にふくみ、二人は喉を潤した
のだった。
strings.translated: In the end, they gave in and brought the river water to their lips, quenching their thirst as best they could.

strings.text:
優斗
「いや、空……少し曇ってきたみたいだから……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"No, it's just -- the sky... looks like it's getting a bit cloudy..."

strings.text:
木々の隙間から見える空を見上げながら、優斗が不安
げな声を漏らす。
strings.translated: Gazing up at the sky through the gaps in the trees, Yuuto let out an uneasy murmur.

strings.text: 森に広がる蒼の光も、昨日より色褪せて見えた……。
strings.translated: Even the blue light filtering through the forest seemed more faded than it had yesterday...

strings.text:
先を歩いていた優斗が、空を見上げながらぽつりと
つぶやいた。
strings.translated: Yuuto, who had been walking ahead, glanced up at the sky and whispered quietly.

strings.text: 夢美が顔を上げると、冷たい雫がポツッと頬に落ちる。
strings.translated: Yumemi raised her face, and a cold drop landed on her cheek with a soft patter.

strings.text:
いつの間にか空は灰色の雲に覆われていて、今にも
大雨になりそうな気配だった。
strings.translated: Before she had even noticed, the sky had been swallowed by grey clouds, and the air carried the unmistakable threat of a heavy downpour.

strings.text:
優斗
「あっちの樹が多いところに行こう。
　少しは凌げるかもしれない」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Let's head over where the trees are thicker.
They might keep some of the rain off."

strings.text:
優斗が指差した先は、樹木が鬱蒼と茂り、自然の屋根
を作った陽の当たらない場所だった。
strings.translated: Where Yuuto pointed, the trees grew dense and tangled, their canopy forming a natural roof that blocked out the sun.

strings.text:
離れていてもじめじめとした雰囲気が伝わってくるが、
このまま直接雨に打たれるよりはマシだろう。
strings.translated: Even from a distance it had a damp, gloomy feel to it -- but it was better than standing out in the open rain.

strings.text:
夢美はうなずくと、優斗と手を取り合って森の深部へ
と歩いていった。
strings.translated: Yumemi nodded, took Yuuto's hand, and the two walked deeper into the forest.

strings.text:
優斗
「うん、思ったより乾いてる」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Yeah, it's drier than I expected."

strings.text:
一際大きな樹の根元に立って、優斗が足元の地面を
踏み締めながら言った。
strings.translated: Standing at the base of a particularly large tree, Yuuto tested the ground with his foot as he spoke.

strings.text:
予想していたより森の空気はずっと乾燥していて、
落ち葉の絨毯が広がっている。
strings.translated: The air in the forest was far drier than they had anticipated, and a carpet of fallen leaves spread out around them.

strings.text:
これならば腰を下ろしても、服が濡れる心配はなさそ
うだった。
strings.translated: It looked like they could sit down without worrying about their clothes getting wet.

strings.text:
優斗
「雨が止むまで、ここでじっとしてたほうがいいかも
　ね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"We're probably better off staying put here until the rain lets up."

strings.text:
荷物を地面に降ろしながら、優斗がホッとした様子で
言う。
strings.translated: Yuuto said, looking relieved as he set his bag down on the ground.

strings.text:
陽の射さない森は正直薄気味悪かったが、今は休める
場所が見つけられた偶然に感謝するべきだった。
strings.translated: The sunless forest was honestly unsettling, but for now she was grateful for the stroke of luck that had led them to a place where they could rest.

strings.text:
夢美も、樹に背中を預けるようにしながら座り込むと、
棒のように硬くなった両脚を前に投げ出した。
strings.translated: Yumemi leaned her back against the tree and slid down to sit, stretching her stiff, rod-like legs out in front of her.

strings.text: 疲れ果てたような溜息が、夢美の口から吐き出される。
strings.translated: A sigh of utter exhaustion escaped Yumemi's lips.

strings.text:
歩くのを止めると、全身がどっと重くなったような気
がした。
strings.translated: The moment she stopped walking, her whole body seemed to grow suddenly, crushingly heavy.

strings.text:
左右の足が熱を帯びていて、指を動かすと痺れたよう
に痛む。
strings.translated: Both feet were burning, and when she wiggled her toes they ached with a numb, tingling pain.

strings.text: 歩けないわけではないが、暫くは歩きたくなかった。
strings.translated: She could still walk -- but she had no desire to for a good while.

strings.text:
優斗
「これ以上強くなると、ここも降り込んで来そうだ
　なぁ……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"If it gets any heavier, it's going to start coming in here too..."

strings.text:
頭上を見つめながら、優斗が困ったように言葉を漏ら
す。
strings.translated: Staring up at the canopy above, Yuuto muttered with a troubled look.

strings.text:
雨の勢いは少しずつ増しており、時折肌に雫が落ちて
きた。
strings.translated: The rain was gradually picking up, and every so often a drop would fall and graze her skin.

strings.text:
このまま降り止まないような事になれば、夜の冷気と
も合わせて想像を絶するほどの寒さになるだろう。
strings.translated: If the rain didn't let up, combined with the cold of the night, the temperature would drop to a truly unbearable degree.

strings.text: そうなる前に、何か手を打たなければならなかった。
strings.translated: They had to do something before it came to that.

strings.text:
ぼんやりと森を眺めていると、ふと視界の端で何かが
動いたような気がした。
strings.translated: As she gazed absently into the forest, something at the edge of her vision seemed to move.

strings.text:
目を凝らしてみると、昆虫のようなものがゆっくりと
樹をよじ登っている。
strings.translated:
Squinting to get a better look, she could see something insect-like slowly
climbing up a tree.

strings.text:
最初は気にも留めずすぐに視線を外したが、何となく
引っかかるものがあり、もう一度眺めてみた。
strings.translated:
At first she paid it no mind and looked away, but something nagged at her,
and she looked again.

strings.text: 三段重ねのようになった異質な胸部。
strings.translated: A strange thorax that seemed stacked in three segments.

strings.text:
腹部は蜘蛛のように膨らんでいたが、よく見るとそこ
から長い脚が生えていた。
strings.translated:
The abdomen was swollen like a spider's, but on closer inspection,
long legs sprouted from it.

strings.text:
夢美
（昆虫って脚は胸からじゃなかったっけ？）
strings.translated:
Yumemi
(Wait... don't insects have their legs coming from the thorax?)

strings.text:
あまり詳しいわけではないが、幼い頃の学校の授業で、
昆虫の脚は胸部から三対生えているのが原則だと聞い
た覚えがある。
strings.translated:
She was no expert, but she recalled being taught in school as a child
that insects, as a rule, have three pairs of legs growing from the thorax.

strings.text:
それに照らし合わせると、遠くで樹を登っている生物
は、明らかに昆虫とは違っていた。
strings.translated:
Measured against that, the creature climbing the distant tree
was clearly something other than an insect.

strings.text:
夢美
（この森って……もしかして…………）

今、自分が見ているものは昆虫ではないのだと、夢美
は唐突に理解することができた。
strings.translated:
What she was looking at right now was not an insect -- Yumemi
suddenly understood that with startling clarity.

strings.text:
樹を登る生物の正体に気付いたとき、夢美はこの森の
一端が見えた気がした。
strings.translated:
The moment she recognized the true nature of the creature climbing the tree,
Yumemi felt as though she had glimpsed one corner of this forest's secret.

strings.text: つまり、この場所は『蟲が棲む森』なのだ。
strings.translated: In other words, this place was a "forest where Bugs dwell."

strings.text: 森に棲む自然の生き物として、蟲が暮らしているのだ。
strings.translated: Bugs lived here as natural creatures inhabiting the woods.

strings.text: 果たして、これが何を意味しているのか…………。
strings.translated: And what exactly did that mean...............?

strings.text:
それを考えようとしたところで、夢美はふと自分の体
に異変を覚え、蟲に対する思考を中断させた。
strings.translated:
Just as she began to ponder that question, Yumemi suddenly felt something
wrong with her own body, and her thoughts about the Bugs were cut short.

strings.text:
夢美
（なんか……お腹、痛くなってきた…………）
strings.translated:
Yumemi
(Something... my stomach, it's starting to hurt...............)

strings.text:
軽く腹を撫でながら、夢美は微かな緊張を感じ始めて
いた。
strings.translated: Gently rubbing her belly, Yumemi began to feel a faint tension creeping in.

strings.text: 下腹の辺りが、しくしくと痛みを訴えている。
strings.translated: The area around her lower abdomen was aching with a dull, persistent throb.

strings.text:
だが、それは怪我をしたわけではなく、ましてや病気
になったわけでもない。
strings.translated: But it was not from any injury, nor was she coming down with any illness.

strings.text:
まるで波紋のように広がってくる鈍痛の正体を、夢美
は既に理解していた。
strings.translated: Yumemi already understood the true nature of the dull pain spreading through her like ripples on water.

strings.text:
この森に足を踏み入れてからというもの、夢美には
ひとつだけずっと我慢してきたものがあった。
strings.translated: Ever since she had set foot in this forest, there was one thing Yumemi had been holding back.
It was something that, for any human being ----

strings.text:
――いや、生物であれば例外なく通過しなければなら
ない行為であり、もちろん夢美も同じだった。
strings.translated:
-- no, for any living creature without exception, was an act that could not be avoided,
and Yumemi was no different.

Yumemi
"Um... I need to... just for a moment...!"

strings.text:
夢美
「すぐに戻りますからっ！」

いきなり立ち上がって走り出した夢美を、優斗の声が
追いかける。
strings.translated: Yuuto's voice chased after Yumemi as she suddenly leapt to her feet and broke into a run.

strings.text:
何の前触れもなかったため、ワケが分からなくて当然
だ。
strings.translated: With no warning whatsoever, it was only natural that he had no idea what was going on.

strings.text:
だが、夢美には事実を話す余裕も、またその度胸もな
かった。
strings.translated: But Yumemi had neither the composure nor the nerve to tell him the truth.

strings.text:
夢美
（ああっ、もう……漏れちゃうぅっ！）
strings.translated:
Yumemi
(Oh no... I can't hold it anymore...!)

strings.text:
夢美は下腹を押さえながら、その『行為』に及べる
場所を求め、森を駆けて行った……。
strings.translated:
Pressing her hand against her lower abdomen, Yumemi ran through the forest
in search of a place where she could carry out that "act"...

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ！」

懸命に森を走って、夢美はどうにか『行為』に及べそ
うな場所を発見していた。
strings.translated:
Running desperately through the forest, Yumemi had somehow managed to find
a spot that seemed suitable for the "act."

strings.text:
辺りには背の高い草が生い茂っていて、近くに小川も
流れている。
strings.translated: Tall grass grew thick all around, and a small stream ran nearby.

strings.text:
辺りには面積の大きい葉の植物も生えており、行為後
の処理――――
strings.translated: Large-leafed plants also grew in the area, which could serve for cleanup after the act ----

strings.text:
――つまり、トイレットペーパー代わりとして使えそ
うだった。
strings.translated: -- in other words, as a substitute for toilet paper.

strings.text:
夢美
「このへんなら……大丈夫かな」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Around here should be... okay, I think."

strings.text:
しとしとと雨が降る中、夢美はかなり森の深い場所ま
でやって来ていた。
strings.translated: In the soft patter of the rain, Yumemi had made her way quite deep into the forest.

strings.text:
どのくらいの距離を歩いたのかは定かでないが、少な
くとも優斗に声が届くような場所ではない。
strings.translated: She wasn't sure exactly how far she had walked, but it was certainly not close enough for Yuuto to hear her voice.

strings.text:
適当な茂みを見つけてそこで中腰になり、夢美はよう
やくその行為に至ることができた。
strings.translated: Finding a suitable thicket and crouching down inside it, Yumemi was at last able to carry out the act.

strings.text: ショーツをずらして、肛門に力を込める。
strings.translated: She shifted her shorts aside and bore down.

strings.text:
この行為を外でするのは初めての経験で、力んでいる
だけで顔から火が出そうだった。
strings.translated: This was her first time doing this act outdoors, and just the straining alone was enough to make her face burn with heat.

strings.text:
森の草木が広がっているだけで、夢美の行為を外界か
ら隔てるものは何一つとして存在しないのだ。
strings.translated:
Only the trees and grass of the forest spread out in every direction, and there was nothing whatsoever
to shield Yumemi's act from the outside world.

strings.text:
今、もしも優斗が自分を探しに来ていて、この行為を
見られたとしたら……。
strings.translated: If Yuuto had come looking for her and happened to see her like this...

strings.text: 想像するだけで死にたくなるような気分に陥った。
strings.translated: Just imagining it made her feel like she wanted to die.

strings.text: 腹に溜まっている物は、かなり大きい。
strings.translated: Whatever had built up in her stomach was quite substantial.

strings.text:
ついでにガスも溜まっているようで、一発目に大きな
屁が出た。
strings.translated: On top of everything else, it seemed gas had built up as well -- the first thing to come out was a loud fart.

strings.text: 排泄物がゆっくりと腸を下り、出口へと近付いて来る。
strings.translated: The waste slowly made its way down through her intestines, inching toward the exit.

strings.text:
夢美は、しきりに辺りの様子を窺いながら、緊張した
面持ちで静かに『その瞬間』を待ち続ける……。
strings.translated: Yumemi kept glancing nervously at her surroundings, waiting in tense silence for "that moment" to arrive...

strings.text:
女として、と言うよりも人間としてどうかと言う行為
だが、出るものは出るのだから仕方がない。
strings.translated: It was an act questionable not just for a woman, but for any human being -- yet what needed to come out would come out, and there was nothing to be done about it.

strings.text:
地面にしゃがみ込んだ姿勢のまま、思いきり下腹部に
力を込め、暫くそのままの状態を維持した。
strings.translated: Remaining crouched low to the ground, she bore down hard on her lower abdomen and held that position for a while.

strings.text:
しとしとと雨が降る中、自分の心臓の音がやけに大き
く聞こえる。
strings.translated: In the soft patter of the rain, the sound of her own heartbeat seemed strangely loud.

strings.text:
体の芯は燃えるように熱くなっていて、頬がうっすら
と赤みを帯びていた。
strings.translated: The core of her body burned with heat, and a faint flush had crept into her cheeks.

strings.text:
仕方ないと分かっていても、やはり割り切れない部分
がある。
strings.translated: Even knowing it couldn't be helped, there was still a part of her that couldn't quite accept it.

strings.text:
たとえどんな言い訳をしたところで、夢美が今行って
いる行為は野外排泄、つまり――――
strings.translated: No matter what excuse she made, what Yumemi was doing right now was outdoor defecation -- in other words,----

strings.text:
夢美
（こういうの……野糞って言うんだよね…………）
strings.translated:
Yumemi
(This kind of thing... they call it "taking a dump in the woods," don't they...)

strings.text:
改めて自分の行為に目を向けて、夢美は茹で上がった
タコのように顔を赤くした。
strings.translated: Confronting the reality of what she was doing, Yumemi's face turned as red as a boiled octopus.

strings.text:
五年前の件で自分の人生が大きく変わってしまった事
は理解していたが、まさかこんな経験までする日が来
ようとは想像もしていなかった。
strings.translated: She had understood that the incident five years ago had drastically changed her life -- but she had never imagined a day would come when she'd have to go through something like this.

strings.text:
下腹に力を込めて、直腸内の排泄物を押し出そうとす
る。
strings.translated: She bore down on her lower abdomen, trying to push the waste out of her rectum.

strings.text:
雨に濡れて体は冷たいはずなのに、額からはじわりと
嫌な汗が出ていた。
strings.translated: Her body should have been cold from the rain soaking her, yet an unpleasant sweat was seeping from her brow.

strings.text:
野外排泄という行為はもちろんだが、この下半身丸出
しのポーズからも一刻も早く解放されたい。
strings.translated: It wasn't just the act of defecating outdoors -- she wanted to be free from this pose with her lower half completely exposed as soon as possible.

strings.text:
場所がこんな森であったとしても、誰かに見られたら
と考えるだけで気が気ではなかった。
strings.translated: Even in a forest like this, the mere thought of someone seeing her was enough to make her heart race.

strings.text:
そのためだろう、排泄はしたいはずなのに、緊張した
体が『物』を途中で止めてしまう。
strings.translated: Perhaps because of that, even though she desperately needed to go, her tensed body kept stopping things halfway.

strings.text: 早く出したいはずなのに、体がそれを拒もうとする。
strings.translated: She wanted it out quickly, yet her body was trying to refuse.

strings.text:
結果、夢美の心は焦り、連鎖的に肉体の緊張はさらに
高まっていった。
strings.translated: And so Yumemi's mind grew frantic, and in a chain reaction, the tension in her body wound even tighter.

strings.text:
神にも祈るような気持ちで、夢美はきゅっと目を閉じ
た。
strings.translated: As if in prayer to the heavens themselves, Yumemi squeezed her eyes shut.

strings.text:
頭の中で、直腸内の排泄物が移動するイメージを作り
出し、それを体に実行させようと試みる。
strings.translated: In her mind, she formed an image of the waste moving through her rectum, and tried to will her body into carrying it out.

strings.text:
膝に置いた手に力を込め、薄く口を開けているであろ
う肛門に意識を集中した。
strings.translated: She pressed her hands into her knees and focused her awareness on her anus, which must have been slightly open by now.

strings.text: 力んでいると、腹がゴロゴロと嫌な音を立てた。
strings.translated: As she strained, her stomach let out a horrible gurgling sound.

strings.text: 腹の中で、汚水が大きく波打つイメージが広がる。
strings.translated: In her mind, an image spread of foul water churning in great waves inside her gut.

strings.text:
突然変わってしまった環境に体が順応し切れなかった
のか、要するに『緩いもの』も詰まっているらしかっ
た。
strings.translated: Whether her body had simply failed to adapt to the sudden change in environment, the short of it was that something looser was also packed in there.

Yumemi
(Oh no... I can't take this anymore...)

strings.text:
軽い下腹の痛みを覚えながら、夢美はとにかく排泄を
済ませることに専念した。
strings.translated: Enduring the aching pain in her lower abdomen, Yumemi focused entirely on getting through the ordeal.

strings.text:
あまり時間をかけると優斗に心配をかけてしまうかも
しれないし、何よりずっと雨に打たれていると寒い。
strings.translated: Taking too long might worry Yuuto, and more than anything, being pelted by rain this whole time was making her cold.

strings.text:
吐く息も靄のように見えるため、辺りの気温は決して
高くはなさそうだった。
strings.translated: Her breath was visible like mist, which suggested the temperature around her was anything but warm.

strings.text:
夢美
「んんんんんんんんんんんっ！！」

下腹にさらに力を込めると、まず先に黄金水が勢いよ
く噴き出した。
strings.translated: When she bore down even harder on her lower abdomen, the golden stream came first, gushing out with force.

strings.text:
地面の一点を打ち付けるようにして、しばらくの間
ジョボジョボと放尿が続けられる。

strings.translated: But having openly cried out that she was "coming" -- no amount of damage control could make that look any better.

strings.text:
過去、これ以上の経験はないほどに、夢美は酷く落ち
込んでしまっていた。
strings.translated: In all her life, Yumemi had never felt so utterly mortified.

Yuuto
"Um... I do it too, so..."

strings.text:
不意に優斗の声が聞こえて、夢美はおそるおそる振り
返った。
strings.translated: Yuuto's voice reached her unexpectedly, and Yumemi turned around with cautious, hesitant steps.

strings.text:
優斗はまだ背中を向けたままだったが、微かに顔が
夢美のほうを向いているような気もする。
strings.translated: Yuuto still had his back to her, but she had the faint impression that his face was turned ever so slightly in her direction.

strings.text:
優斗
「俺だって……ああいうこと、するし…………」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I... do that kind of thing too, so..."

strings.text: もう一度、今度はもう少し聞き取りやすい声で言う。
strings.translated: He said it once more, this time in a voice that was just a little easier to hear.

strings.text:
だが、それ以上は言葉が出てこない様子で、また押し
黙ってしまった。
strings.translated: But it seemed he could not find any more words after that, and he fell silent again.

strings.text:
もしかすると、今度は自分が喋らなければならない番
なのだろうか。
strings.translated: Perhaps it was now her turn to say something.

strings.text:
ふとそんな事に思い至ったが、何を喋ればいいのか
分からない。
strings.translated: That thought occurred to her, but she had no idea what to say.

strings.text:
夢美
『気を遣ってもらって、ありがとうございます』
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Thank you for trying to make me feel better."

strings.text:
夢美
『あっ、優斗さんもするんですか？
　安心しちゃった』
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Oh, you do it too, Yuuto-san? That's such a relief."

strings.text:
夢美
『そうですよね。
　人間なんだから当然ですよね』
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I suppose so. It's only natural, being human and all."

strings.text: 幾つもの言葉が浮かび、そのたびに心の中で否定する。
