strings.text: だが、それを口にするのは躊躇われる。
strings.translated: But saying it out loud was hard to bring herself to do.

strings.text:
躊躇われるが、隠し事をするのも気まずい空気を招い
てしまう。
strings.translated: Hard as it was, keeping it secret would only make things awkward between them.

strings.text:
優斗は、当然の事ながら不思議そうな顔を浮かべてい
て、このまま黙っているわけにはいかなかった。
strings.translated: Yuuto, naturally, was wearing a puzzled look on his face, and she couldn't just stay silent.

strings.text: 勇気を振り絞るようにして、その言葉を口にする。
strings.translated: She forced the words out as though summoning every last bit of courage she had.

strings.text:
馬鹿正直に言う必要があったのか定かではないが、
嘘をつくほうが何となく嫌だったのだ。
strings.translated: Whether it had really been necessary to be so bluntly honest was unclear, but lying somehow felt worse.

strings.text:
言葉が通じなかったらしく、優斗が不思議そうに聞き
返してくる。
strings.translated: The words didn't seem to register, and Yuuto repeated them back to her with a puzzled look.

strings.text:
どうやら本気で知らないらしいのだが、夢美にとって
は一種の拷問だった。
strings.translated: He genuinely seemed not to know what she meant -- which, for Yumemi, was its own kind of torture.

strings.text: だが、ここまできて説明しないわけにもいかない。
strings.translated: But having come this far, she couldn't very well leave it unexplained.

strings.text:
夢美は、顔を真っ赤にして俯かせると、ボソボソと
こもった声で話し始めた。
strings.translated: So Yumemi, face burning red and head bowed, began to speak in a small, muffled voice.

strings.text:
夢美
「女の子の…………ッチな、体液………………」

夢美
「女の子が、エッチなことすると、出る、体液のこと
　です」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It's the fluid that comes out of a girl... when she does something... s-sexy."

strings.text:
ぽかんとした様子でつぶやいたあと、優斗がじっと
夢美を見つめる。
strings.translated: He murmured blankly for a moment, then Yuuto stared intently at Yumemi.

strings.text: そこにあるのは、純粋な疑問の表情だった。
strings.translated: What was written on his face was a look of pure, genuine curiosity.

strings.text:
優斗
「その、よく意味が分からなかったんだけど……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I just... didn't really understand what you meant..."

strings.text:
優斗
「えっと……お、女の人も、そういうもんなの？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"So... um... d-do girls... have something like that too?"

strings.text: 今度は夢美がぽかんとしてしまう。
strings.translated: This time it was Yumemi's turn to be left speechless.

strings.text: 優斗に尋ねられたことの意味がよく分からない。
strings.translated: She couldn't quite grasp what Yuuto was asking her.

strings.text:
夢美
「あの……どういう、意味でしょうか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Um... what do you... mean by that?"

strings.text:
優斗
「ん？　んっと……へ、変なこと訊いてたら、本当に、
　申し訳ないんだけど…………」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Hm? Um... if I'm asking something weird, I'm really,
 sorry... but..."

strings.text:
優斗
「女の人も、き、気持ち良くなったら、そういうの、
　出るの？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Do women... g-get that too, when they feel good?"

strings.text:
ようやく、互いの何がズレているのかが分かり始めて
きた。
strings.translated: They were finally starting to understand where the disconnect between them lay.

strings.text:
夢美もあまり詳しいわけではないが、優斗は明らかに
女の体のことを知らなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi didn't know all that much about it herself, but Yuuto clearly had no knowledge of the female body.

strings.text:
夢美
「優斗さんって、もしかして…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yuuto-san, could it be that you're...........?"

strings.text:
優斗
「もしかしなくても童貞ですけど」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I'm a virgin, no 'could it be' about it."

strings.text:
さすがに気に障ったのか、優斗がむっとした様子で
答える。
strings.translated: Perhaps it had actually gotten under his skin -- Yuuto answered with a sullen look on his face.

strings.text:
夢美は慌てた様子で手を振ると、しどろもどろになり
ながら説明を付け加えた。
strings.translated: Yumemi waved her hands in a flustered panic and added an explanation, stumbling over her words.

strings.text:
夢美
「だ、だって、優斗さん優しいし、顔だってカッコイ
　イ部類に入ると思うし……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I-it's just, Yuuto-san is kind, and I think you'd fall into the good-looking category too..."

strings.text:
優斗
「それなら、もっとモテてもいいと思うんだけどね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Then you'd think I'd be more popular."

strings.text:
夢美
「モテないんですか？」
地雷を踏んだと理解する。
strings.translated: She realized she had stepped on a landmine.
Two in a row, no less.

strings.text:
優斗の顔も一段と不機嫌になり、辺りに気まずい空気
が流れ始めた。
strings.translated: Yuuto's expression grew even more sour, and an awkward silence began to settle over them.

strings.text:
夢美
「あの……ごめんなさい」

優斗
「いや、別にいいんだけどね……」
結局、気まずい空気が流れてしまう。
strings.translated: The awkward atmosphere lingered after all.

strings.text: しかも、想像していた以上に重い。
strings.translated: And it was heavier than she had imagined.

strings.text:
二人とも顔を背けてしまい、その雰囲気を察したのか
蟲の触手の動きも止まっていた。
strings.translated: Both of them looked away, and as if sensing the mood, the Bug's tentacles had gone still.

strings.text:
優斗
「俺、すごい奥手だよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I'm really slow when it comes to this stuff."

strings.text: やがて、優斗が拗ねたような口調で言う。
strings.translated: After a pause, Yuuto said it in a sulky tone.

strings.text:
優斗
「だって俺、夢美ちゃんに声かけるのに二年もかかっ
　てるし」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I mean, it took me two whole years just to work up the nerve to talk to you, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text: 優斗の言葉に、夢美の目が大きく見開かれた。
strings.translated: Yuuto's words made Yumemi's eyes go wide.

strings.text:
優斗
「いつから俺がＡｎｚＵに通ってるか知ってる？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Do you know how long I've been coming to AnzU?"

strings.text: 記憶をたぐってみたが、全く思い出せなかった。
strings.translated: She tried to search her memory, but couldn't recall at all.

strings.text:
常連客の一人であることは知っていたが、それがいつ
からなのかと問われれば、曖昧にしか答えられない。
strings.translated: She knew he was one of the regulars, but if asked exactly when that had started, she could only give a vague answer.

strings.text:
優斗
「いいよ。謝られることじゃないし」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Don't be. It's nothing to apologize for."

strings.text: 優斗が、苦笑して首を横に振る。
strings.translated: Yuuto shook his head with a wry smile.

strings.text:
優斗
「初めてお店に入ったのは、大学に入ってすぐだった
　かな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"The first time I walked into the shop was right after I started university, I think."

strings.text:
優斗
「うん、着てるものがまだ長袖だったし、たぶん春頃
　だったと思う」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Yeah, I was still wearing long sleeves, so it was probably around spring."

strings.text:
優斗
「その時は、ただお腹が空いて、どこでもいいからっ
　て気持ちで店に入って……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"At the time, I just walked in because I was hungry and anywhere would do..."

strings.text:
優斗
「夢美ちゃんも働き始めてまだ間もなかったのかな？
　たどたどしい口調で接客してくれてた」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"You had only just started working there too, hadn't you?
 You were so awkward when you waited on me."

strings.text:
夢美
「それ、だいぶ前ですね……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That was quite a while ago..."

strings.text:
優斗
「その時は、ただ面白いって思うだけだったんだけど、
　何となく気になって、通う回数が増えていった」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Back then I just thought you were kind of funny, but somehow you stuck with me, and I started coming more and more often."

strings.text:
優斗
「だから、夢美ちゃんの仕事ぶりが少しずつ上手く
　なっていくの、俺、結構知ってるよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"So I actually know quite a bit about how your work has been getting better little by little, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text:
そんな時期から知られているとは思っていなかったた
め、かなり気恥ずかしいものがある。
strings.translated: She hadn't realized he had known her from that far back, and it made her feel quite embarrassed.

strings.text:
優斗
「そんな事を繰り返してるうちに、だんだん店に行く
　目的が夢美ちゃんに会いに行くことになって……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"As that kept going, the reason I went to the shop gradually became about going to see you, Yumemi-chan..."

strings.text:
優斗
「それで、いつか声を掛けようって思ってたんだけど、
　ずるずると二年も…………」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"And I kept telling myself I'd talk to you someday, but I just kept putting it off for two whole years........."

strings.text:
夢美
「それ、は…………長い、ですね………………」
優斗が恥ずかしそうに後頭部を掻く。

あちこち土色に汚れていて、中央には大きな黒いシミ
ができている。
strings.translated: It was stained all over with the color of dirt, and at its center was a large dark blotch.

strings.text:
それが何なのかを理解した瞬間、夢美の頭の中は真っ
白になった。
strings.translated: The instant she understood what it was, Yumemi's mind went completely blank.

strings.text:
夢美
「きゃあああああぁぁぁぁぁぁーーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーーっ！！！！」

森全体に響き渡るような悲鳴を上げて、夢美はその場
から飛びのいた。
strings.translated: Letting out a scream that seemed to echo through the entire forest, Yumemi leapt back from the spot.

strings.text:
――と、今度はかかとを何かにぶつけてしまい、その
ままの勢いで尻餅をつく。
strings.translated: -- But this time her heel struck something, and with the same momentum she fell flat on her backside.

strings.text:
小さく呻き声は出たが、それより頭の中は子供の死体
の事でいっぱいで、尻の痛みなどに構っていられるだ
けの余裕がない。
strings.translated: A small groan escaped her, but her mind was too consumed with the child's corpse to spare any attention for the pain in her rear.

strings.text:
離れた位置にいた優斗がすぐに戻って来てくれたが、
その足取りは徐々に重くなり、ついには途中で止まっ
てしまった。
strings.translated: Yuuto, who had been some distance away, came rushing back -- but his steps grew gradually heavier, and he stopped partway.

strings.text: 優斗の視線が、夢美のやや右側に向けられている……。
strings.translated: Yuuto's gaze was directed slightly to Yumemi's right...

strings.text: 見てはいけない、という警告はあった。
strings.translated: There had been a warning -- don't look.

strings.text:
顔を向ける必要はないと、もう一人の自分が叫んでい
た。
strings.translated: Another part of her was screaming that she didn't need to look.

strings.text: だが、夢美は気付いてしまったのだ。

自分の手に触れている感触が、草木、地面とは少し
違ったものであることを…………。
strings.translated: That the sensation touching her hand was slightly different from grass, from earth............

strings.text:
そこに、おそらくは、自分の想像したものが転がって
いるのだと、気付いてしまったのだ。
strings.translated: That what she had imagined was most likely lying there, right beside her.

strings.text:
まるで、何かに吸い寄せられるように、夢美はゆっく
りと顔を向けた。
strings.translated: As if drawn by some irresistible force, Yumemi slowly turned her face.

strings.text:
自分の右側にある『もの』に、ゆっくりと視線を向け
ていった。
strings.translated: She slowly turned her gaze toward the "thing" to her right.

strings.text:
まぶたを大きく開いた子供の目が、じっと夢美のほう
を見つめていた。
strings.translated: A child's eyes, wide open, stared fixedly back at Yumemi.

strings.text:
光を失った左右の眼が、夢美の姿をハッキリと映し出
していた。
strings.translated: Two eyes, left and right, that had lost their light, reflected Yumemi's image with perfect clarity.

strings.text:
夢美
「あ、あぁ…………あぁあぁぁぁ……………………」
子供は仰向けに倒れていた。

口から血を流し、胸元をスコップのようなもので抉り
出されたような傷を負って、草むらの中に死んでいた。
strings.translated: Blood poured from its mouth, and it lay dead in the undergrowth with a wound in its chest as though it had been gouged out with a shovel.

strings.text:
手のひらに伝わる感触からして死後硬直は始まってい
るが、地面に流れる血は完全には乾ききっていない。
strings.translated: From the sensation transmitted through her palm, rigor mortis had already begun -- but the blood pooling on the ground had not yet fully dried.

strings.text: 死んだのは、今日のうちと見て間違いなかった。
strings.translated: There was no doubt that the death had occurred sometime today.

strings.text:
人間の死体を見たのは初めてなのだろう、優斗の体が
ガタガタと震えていた。
strings.translated: It was probably his first time seeing a human corpse -- Yuuto's body was trembling violently.

strings.text: 顔色は真っ青で、今にも倒れてしまいそうだ。
strings.translated: His face had gone completely pale, and he looked as though he might collapse at any moment.

strings.text:
だが、それは夢美も同じことで、自分を見つめる子供
の死体から目を離すことができなかった。
strings.translated: But the same was true of Yumemi -- she could not tear her eyes away from the child's corpse staring up at her.

strings.text:
こんなところで見るはずのない『もの』に、動揺が
抑えきれない。
strings.translated: Faced with something she should never have seen in a place like this, she could not contain her distress.

strings.text:
森に迷った子供の死体かとも思ったが、それにしては
あまりにも不可解な点が多すぎた。
strings.translated: She briefly wondered if it might be a child who had gotten lost in the forest and died -- but there were far too many inexplicable details for that.

strings.text:
夢美
「な、なんっ……で……これっ……なん、でっ……
　こんな、と、とこっ、ろにっ…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"W-why... why... is this... here... in a place... like... this..............."

strings.text: 体が震えているため、上手く喋ることができない。
strings.translated: Her body was trembling so badly she could barely speak.

strings.text:
ガラス玉のような目と見つめ合っていると、本当に
意識を失いそうだった。
strings.translated: Staring into those glass-bead eyes, she felt as though she might truly lose consciousness.

strings.text:
恐怖は自然と吐き気を催してきて、夢美は反射的に
逆の方向へ体をねじると、その場に今朝食べたもの
を嘔吐した。
strings.translated: Fear naturally brought nausea rising up within her, and Yumemi reflexively twisted her body in the opposite direction and vomited everything she had eaten that morning onto the ground.

strings.text:
夢美
「うげえぇっ！　え、うえぇっ！　げほっ！」

夢美
「は、はひっ、ひぃっ……ひいぃぃぃぃっ！！」

夢美
「ぐ――おおぉげえぇええぇぇぇぇぇっ！！！」

グチャグチャと湿った音を立てながら、吐瀉物が地面
に撒き散らされていく。
strings.translated: With a wet, squelching sound, the vomit splattered across the ground.

strings.text:
あまりに苦しくて少し鼻水まで吹いたが、それを拭う
暇もなく胃の中の物が押し上がってくる。
strings.translated: The retching was so violent that snot came flying out of her nose, and before she could even wipe it away, more was surging up from her stomach.

strings.text:
涙で視界が滲んだが、その先に見えるのは脳裏に焼き
付いた子供の死体だった。
strings.translated: Her vision blurred with tears, but what she could still see through them was the child's corpse -- seared into her mind.

strings.text:
夢美
「は、はひっ……ひ、いっ……ひぃっ…………」

口から涎の糸を何本も引いて、夢美の嘔吐はようやく
終わりを迎えてくれた。
strings.translated: Trailing long strings of saliva from her lips, Yumemi's vomiting finally came to an end.

strings.text:
そして、動くようになった体を引きずるようにして、
少しでも死体から離れようと地面を這いずった。
strings.translated: She dragged her body, which had only just begun to move again, crawling along the ground in an effort to put even a little distance between herself and the corpse.

strings.text: 例えようもない恐怖が、夢美の体を蝕んでくる。
strings.translated: An indescribable terror was eating away at Yumemi's body.

strings.text:
子供の死体そのものも影響はしているが、それ以上に
『ある事実』に気付いて、それがたまらなく怖かった。
strings.translated: The child's corpse itself was part of it -- but more than that, she had noticed a certain fact, and that was what terrified her beyond bearing.

strings.text: 何故、こんなところに死体があったのかは分からない。
strings.translated: She had no idea why there was a corpse in a place like this.

strings.text:
だが、『どうしてこんなところで死体になったのか』
は分かった。
strings.translated: But she did understand how that child had come to be a corpse here.

strings.text: つまり、あの子供は、この場所で――――
strings.translated: In other words, that child, in this place ----

strings.text: 口にした瞬間、全身が怖気立った。
strings.translated: The moment the words left her mouth, every hair on her body stood on end.

strings.text:
子供を殺した『何か』がこの近くにいることに、卒倒
しそうなほどの恐怖を覚えた。
strings.translated: The thought that whatever had killed the child might be somewhere nearby filled her with a terror so overwhelming she nearly fainted.
This was no dream or illusion.

strings.text:
これは現実であり、確かにこの場所で殺人が行われた
のだ。
strings.translated: This was reality -- and a murder had truly been committed in this very place.

strings.text:
再び込み上げてきた嘔吐を堪えながら、夢美はよろめ
きながら立ち上がった。
strings.translated: Suppressing another wave of nausea rising within her, Yumemi staggered to her feet.

strings.text:
涙と鼻水と涎、そして吐瀉物でグチャグチャになった
顔を振り向かせて、もう一度そこに子供の死体がある
ことを確認した。
strings.translated: She turned her face -- a mess of tears, snot, saliva, and vomit -- and confirmed once more that the child's corpse was still there.

strings.text:
頭の中は、いつの間にか血のように真っ赤になってい
た……。
strings.translated: Without her noticing, the inside of her head had turned a deep, blood-red...

strings.text: 子供の死体を発見してから十分後。
strings.translated: Ten minutes after discovering the child's corpse.

strings.text:
夢美と優斗は、少し離れた場所に小川を見つけ、そこ
で気分を落ち着けることにしていた。
strings.translated: Yumemi and Yuuto had found a small stream a short distance away and decided to calm themselves there.

strings.text:
特に、夢美の顔は酷い有様だったため、顔を洗うこと
ができたのは幸運だ。
strings.translated: In particular, since Yumemi's face was in a terrible state, it was fortunate that she was able to wash it.

strings.text:
優斗にも恥ずかしいところを見せてしまったが、さす
がに今の状況では些細な問題だった。
strings.translated: She was embarrassed to have shown Yuuto such an ugly side of herself, but under the circumstances, that was the least of her concerns.

strings.text:
優斗
「もしかすると、熊でもいるのかもしれないね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Maybe there's a bear out here or something."

strings.text:
子供が殺されたと知ったあと、二人はその犯人を熊や
狼といったものに押し付けようとしていた。
strings.translated: After learning that the child had been killed, the two of them were trying to pin the blame on something like a bear or a wolf.

strings.text:
本当にそんな動物が生息しているのかどうかは分から
ないが、何かしら理由付けが欲しかったのだ。
strings.translated: Whether such animals actually lived in this area, they had no idea -- but they needed some kind of explanation.

strings.text:
だが、そんな結論を、夢美は心から信じているわけで
はない。
strings.translated: But Yumemi did not truly believe that conclusion in her heart.

strings.text:
そんな甘い結論を信じられるほど、あの殺害現場は
生易しいものではなかった。
strings.translated: The scene of the killing had been far too brutal to be explained away by something so convenient.

strings.text: のちに確認できた子供の死体の数は、ざっと十五人。
strings.translated: The number of children's corpses they had been able to confirm afterward was roughly fifteen.

strings.text:
傷口をしっかりと確認したわけではないが、肉や骨が
露出するほどの大怪我を負って死んでいた。
strings.translated: They had not examined the wounds closely, but the children had died from severe injuries -- flesh and bone laid bare.

strings.text:
中には首を刎ねられた死体もあり、素人目に見ても
熊や狼の仕業ではない。
strings.translated: Among them were corpses with severed heads, and even to an untrained eye, this was clearly not the work of a bear or wolf.

strings.text:
他にも、蟲と思しき生物が何匹も殺されていたりと、
あの場所は異常なことだらけだった。
strings.translated: On top of that, there were several creatures that appeared to be Bugs, also killed -- that place had been full of abnormalities.

strings.text:
夢美
「きっと、この事だったんです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm sure... this is what it was about."

strings.text:
夢美
「朝、森の何かが変わったような気がしたのは……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"This morning, when I felt like something in the forest had changed..."

strings.text:
もしかすると、あれは森からの警告だったのではない
か。
strings.translated: Perhaps it had been a warning from the forest.

strings.text:
この森に危険なものがいることを、誰かに伝えようと
していたのではないか。
strings.translated: Perhaps it had been trying to tell someone that something dangerous lurked within these woods.

strings.text:
多分に都合のいい考えである事は理解しているが、
夢美の中にはそう考えたい気持ちが湧き上がっていた。
strings.translated: She understood it was a convenient way of thinking, but the desire to believe it welled up inside Yumemi nonetheless.

strings.text:
優斗
「とにかく、早く森を出よう」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Anyway, let's get out of the forest. Fast."

strings.text:
優斗
「今の俺達にできることは、それしかない」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"There's nothing else we can do right now."

strings.text:
トーンの低い声で言ってくる優斗に、夢美はただ頷く
しかなかった……。
strings.translated: Yuuto spoke in a low, flat tone, and all Yumemi could do was nod...

strings.text:
そろそろ出発しようかという頃になって、夢美はふと
誰かの声を聞いたような気がした。
strings.translated: Just as they were about to set off, Yumemi thought she heard someone's voice.

strings.text:
顔を上げて辺りを見回してみると、微かな気配を感じ
る。
strings.translated: She raised her head and looked around -- and sensed a faint presence nearby.

strings.text:
夢美の様子が変わったことに気付いたのだろう、小川
で顔を洗っていた優斗が不思議そうに尋ねた。
strings.translated: Noticing that Yumemi's demeanor had changed, Yuuto -- who had been washing his face in the stream -- looked up and asked with a puzzled expression.

strings.text:
独り言のようにつぶやきながら、夢美はゆっくりと
気配のする方向に歩き始めた。
strings.translated: Murmuring as if to herself, Yumemi slowly began walking in the direction of the presence she sensed.

strings.text:
ひどく弱ってはいるが、呻き声のようなものが耳に
届いている。
strings.translated: It was terribly faint, but something like a moan was reaching her ears.

strings.text: やがて草むらの中に発見したのは――――
strings.translated: And then, what she finally discovered in the undergrowth was --

strings.text: ――うつ伏せに倒れた子供の姿だった。
strings.translated: -- a child, lying face-down on the ground.

strings.text:
生きている気配を感じ取っているにも関わらず、夢美
はついそんな事を呟いてしまった。
strings.translated: Even though she could sense that the child was alive, Yumemi found herself whispering those words anyway.

strings.text:
自分でもまぬけだとは思うが、どうしても先に見た
死体のことを思い出してしまうのだ。
strings.translated: She knew it was foolish of her, but she couldn't help thinking back to the corpse they had seen earlier.

strings.text:
だが、子供の指先がぴくっと動いたのを見たとき、
そんな恐怖は一瞬にして吹っ飛んでしまった。
strings.translated: But when she saw the child's fingertips twitch, that fear vanished in an instant.

strings.text:
夢美
「大丈夫！？　しっかりして！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Are you okay?! Stay with me!!"

strings.text:
優斗
「夢美ちゃん？　誰かいたの？」

夢美
「優斗さんっ！　子供っ、子供ですっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yuuto-san! A child -- there's a child here!!"

strings.text: 慌てて子供を抱きかかえながら、優斗に向かって叫ぶ。
strings.translated: She cried out to Yuuto as she hurriedly scooped the child up into her arms.

strings.text:
手のひらにじっとりとした血が付着したが、その程度
のことで騒ぎ立てている場合ではない。
strings.translated: Her palms came away sticky with blood, but this was no time to make a fuss over something like that.

strings.text:
ただ、これから子供をどうすればいいのかが分からず、
縋るような視線を優斗に向けた。
strings.translated: She just didn't know what to do for the child from here, and turned a desperate, pleading gaze toward Yuuto.

strings.text:
優斗
「水のあるところに運ぼう」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Let's carry them somewhere with water."

strings.text:
夢美の手から奪い取るようにして、優斗が腕の中に
子供を抱え上げる。
strings.translated: Almost snatching the child from Yumemi's arms, Yuuto lifted the child up against his chest.

strings.text:
そして、夢美と目を合わせて頷き合うと、ここまで
来る途中に見かけた小川へと向けて、全力で走り始
めた。
strings.translated: Then, he and Yumemi exchanged a nod, and they broke into a full sprint toward the stream they had passed on the way here.

strings.text:
優斗の腕の中の子供は、今にも息絶えそうなほど弱り
切っていた……。
strings.translated: The child in Yuuto's arms was so weak it seemed they might stop breathing at any moment...

strings.text: 小川のある場所まで戻ってから十分後。
strings.translated: Ten minutes after returning to where the stream was.

strings.text:
夢美と優斗が運んだ子供は、柔らかな芝生の上に横た
えられていた。
strings.translated: The child that Yumemi and Yuuto had carried was laid out on a soft patch of grass.

strings.text: 怪我はしているが、幸いにして大きなものはない。
strings.translated: They had some injuries, but fortunately nothing serious.

strings.text:
とりあえず、血と汚れを洗い落としてやり、喉を潤す
程度に小川の水を飲ませてやった。
strings.translated: For now, they washed away the blood and dirt, and gave the child enough stream water to wet their throat.

strings.text:
夢美
「今は落ち着いてるみたいです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"They seem to have calmed down for now."

strings.text:
心配げに見つめる優斗に、夢美はできるだけ笑顔を
作って返す。
strings.translated: Yumemi did her best to smile back at Yuuto, who was watching with a worried look.

strings.text:
まだまだ油断はできないが、治療不可能なほどの怪我
をしてなかったのは、助けた側としても気分が楽だっ
た。
strings.translated: They weren't out of the woods yet, but knowing the child's injuries weren't beyond treatment was a relief for those who had saved them.

strings.text:
優斗
「なんで、こんな森に子供がいるんだろう」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Why would there be a child alone in a forest like this?"

strings.text:
常識的に考えて、こんな森に子供だけでいるのは明ら
かにおかしい。
strings.translated: By any common sense, a child being alone in a forest like this was clearly wrong.

strings.text:
あの殺害現場の件も含めて、今、この森に何か異変が
起こっているはずだった。
strings.translated: Including the matter of that murder scene, something strange was definitely happening in this forest right now.

strings.text:
優斗
「あ、目を覚ましたかな？」

優斗の言葉を受けて子供を見てみると、フードの下の
目がうっすらと開いていた。
strings.translated: Following Yuuto's words, they looked at the child and saw that the eyes beneath the hood were slowly opening.

strings.text:
夢美
「大丈夫？　気が付いた？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Are you okay? Are you with us?"

strings.text:
覗き込む夢美と、少し離れた場所にいる優斗を交互に
見つめたあと、むくりと上半身を起き上がらせる。
strings.translated: After looking back and forth between Yumemi, who had leaned in close, and Yuuto, who stood a little further away, the child pushed themselves upright.

strings.text:
辺りをキョロキョロと見回したあと、ややふらつきな
がら立ち上がって、二、三歩後ずさりした。
strings.translated: After glancing around at the surroundings, they stood up on unsteady legs and took two or three steps back.

strings.text:
夢美
「怖がらなくていいよ。何もしないから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"You don't have to be scared. We won't do anything to you."

strings.text:
優しく微笑みかける夢美に、子供が疑うような眼差し
を向ける。
strings.translated: The child fixed a suspicious gaze on Yumemi, who smiled gently at them.

strings.text: 口は横一文字に結ばれて、何も喋ろうとはしなかった。
strings.translated: Their mouth was pressed into a firm line, and they showed no sign of speaking.

strings.text:
夢美
「あっ！　ねぇ、どこに行くの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ah! Hey, where are you going?"

strings.text:
――くるりと背中を向けた子供が、足早に森の奥へと
走り始める。
strings.translated: -- the child turned their back and began running deeper into the forest at a quick pace.

strings.text:
夢美は慌てて追いかけようとしたが、子供の足は思い
のほか速く、すぐに森の木々に隠れて見えなくなって
しまった。
strings.translated: Yumemi hurried to give chase, but the child's feet were faster than expected, and they quickly disappeared behind the trees of the forest.

strings.text:
無口なのか、それとも言葉を喋れなかったのか、どち
らにしても謎ばかりが残る。
strings.translated: Whether the child was simply quiet or unable to speak at all, either way, only mysteries remained.

strings.text:
夢美は優斗と顔を合わせたが、返って来る言葉はな
かった……。
strings.translated: Yumemi and Yuuto looked at each other, but there were no words to exchange...

strings.text:
蟲の気配がするほうに向けて歩いていると、夢美は
不意にあることに気付いた。
strings.translated: As she walked in the direction where she sensed the presence of Bugs, Yumemi suddenly noticed something.

strings.text:
辺りを見回しながら確認してみるが、やはり間違いな
い。
strings.translated: She looked around to confirm, but there was no mistaking it.

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲が一匹もいない……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"There isn't a single Bug around..."

strings.text:
異質な気配のする蟲ばかりに集中していたため気付か
なかったが、辺りには殆ど蟲の気配が感じられなかっ
た。
strings.translated: She had been so focused on the strange Bug presences that she hadn't noticed, but there was almost no sense of any Bugs in the area at all.

strings.text:
まるで、異質な蟲の気配から逃げるように、普通の蟲
がいなくなってしまったような感じだ。
strings.translated: It was as if the ordinary Bugs had fled -- driven away by the presence of those strange ones.

strings.text: 果たして、それが何を意味しているのか……。
strings.translated: What exactly that meant, she couldn't say...

strings.text:
考えても分かるような事ではなかったが、とても嫌な
予感が胸に渦巻いていた。
strings.translated: It wasn't the kind of thing one could figure out just by thinking, but a deeply unsettling premonition swirled in her chest.

strings.text:
？？？
「あれぇ？　何してんの、君達？」
strings.translated:
???
"Huh? What are you two doing out here?"

strings.text:
不意に声をかけられ、夢美と優斗はビクッと体を震え
させた。
strings.translated: Startled by the sudden voice, Yumemi and Yuuto flinched.

strings.text:
自分達以外に人がいるとは思っていなかったため、
完全に心の準備を怠っていたのだ。
strings.translated: They hadn't expected anyone else to be out here, so they had been completely off guard.

strings.text:
驚きながら振り返ると、そこにはさらに驚くべき人物
が立っていた。
strings.translated: They turned around in surprise -- only to find someone even more surprising standing there.

strings.text:
史郎
「ああ、やっぱり優斗か。
　まさかとは思ったけど…………」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Ah, it really is you, Yuuto.
I thought it might be, but..."

strings.text:
優斗
「お前こそ、こんなところで何してるんだよ？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"What are YOU doing out here?"

strings.text:
史郎
「ボク？　ボクは昆虫採集みたいなもんだよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Me? I'm out doing something like insect collecting."

strings.text:
自然なのか、それとも異常なのか、どちらとも判断し
づらい答えに二人は顔を見合わせた。
strings.translated: The two exchanged glances, unsure whether to call the answer perfectly natural or completely bizarre.

strings.text:
史郎
「あれ？　優斗は知ってるだろ？
　ボクの趣味の一つが昆虫採集だって」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Huh? You knew, didn't you, Yuuto?
That insect collecting is one of my hobbies."

strings.text: 戸惑いながらも、優斗が頷いて返す。
strings.translated: Bewildered as he was, Yuuto nodded anyway.

strings.text:
反応を見るかぎり、史郎の趣味の一つが昆虫採集とい
うのは嘘ではないようだった。
strings.translated: Judging by his reaction, it seemed Shirou wasn't lying about insect collecting being one of his hobbies.

strings.text:
だが、それにしても、夢美と優斗が何日も迷い続けて
いるこの森で、昆虫採集を楽しむことなど出来るのだ
ろうか。
strings.translated: But even so -- could anyone really enjoy insect collecting in this forest, the very same one where Yumemi and Yuuto had been lost for days?

strings.text:
あまりにも信じがたい話に、二人ともただ戸惑う事し
かできなかった。
strings.translated: The claim was so hard to believe that both of them could only stand there, bewildered.

strings.text:
史郎
「君達こそ、こんなところで何してるんだい？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"What about you two -- what are you doing out here?"

strings.text:
史郎
「デートするにしちゃ、ちょっと場所の選択を誤った
　んじゃないかなぁって思うんだけど」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"If this is a date, I'd say you picked a bit of a questionable location, don't you think?"

strings.text:
苦笑いしながら、史郎がちらちらと夢美の格好を見つ
める。
strings.translated: Shirou smiled wryly, his gaze drifting repeatedly over Yumemi's outfit.

strings.text:
優斗
「お前、出口分かるか？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Hey, do you know the way out?"

strings.text:
史郎
「出口？　出口なら、この道を真っ直ぐに行けばいず
　れ川にたどり着くはずだから、それに沿って下流に
　進めばすぐ高速に出るはずだよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"The way out? If you just follow this path straight ahead, you should eventually reach a river -- follow it downstream and you'll hit the highway in no time."

strings.text: あっさりと答えられ、優斗が閉口する。
strings.translated: The answer came so easily that Yuuto was left speechless.

strings.text:
ここまで断言されては、史郎を疑うこともできなかっ
た。
strings.translated: With such certainty in his words, there was no way to doubt Shirou.

strings.text: それとも、これは本当にただの偶然なのか。
strings.translated: Or was this all just a genuine coincidence?

strings.text:
いつの間にか森の出口のそばまでやって来ていて、
だからこそ史郎と出遭っただけなのか。
strings.translated: Had they already made their way close to the forest's exit without realizing it -- and that was simply why they had run into Shirou?

strings.text:
答えを出すためには、史郎の言った出口を目指してみ
るしかなかった。
strings.translated: The only way to find out was to head for the exit Shirou had described.

strings.text:
史郎
「なんか、さ……君達、すごいボロボロじゃない？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Hey, so... you two look pretty roughed up, don't you?"

strings.text:
夢美と優斗をじろじろと舐め回すように見て、史郎が
怪訝な表情を浮かべた。
strings.translated: Shirou looked them over with a scrutinizing gaze, a puzzled expression crossing his face.

strings.text:
ようやく、二人の様子が普通ではないことに気付いた
らしい。
strings.translated: It seemed he had finally noticed that the two of them were not in any ordinary state.

strings.text:
史郎
「まさかとは思うけど、遭難して丸一日さ迷ってまし
　た、とか言わないよね？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Don't tell me -- and I'd like to think this isn't the case -- that you've been wandering around lost for a whole day?"

strings.text:
さすがにそれはないだろう、といった苦笑いを浮かべ
ながら、史郎が念のためといった様子で尋ねてくる。
strings.translated: He asked with a wry smile, as if to say surely that couldn't be true, though he posed the question just to be safe.

strings.text:
だが、実際には丸一日どころか、今日で五日目に突入
しているのだ。
strings.translated: But in reality, it wasn't just a whole day -- today marked the fifth day.

strings.text:
史郎の想像など、二人が体験してきたことに比べれば、
まだまだ安全な範囲内の出来事だった。
strings.translated: Whatever Shirou was imagining, it was still well within the realm of safety compared to what the two of them had actually been through.

strings.text:
優斗
「ま、色々あったんだよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Well... it's been a whole thing."

strings.text:
優斗
「じゃあ、俺達森の外に出るから」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Anyway, we're heading out of the forest."

strings.text:
史郎
「ああっ！　ちょっと待って！！」

森の出口へ向かおうとしたところで、史郎が慌てた
様子で引き止めてきた。
strings.translated: Just as they moved to head for the exit, Shirou called out to stop them in a fluster.

strings.text:
まだ優斗に用でもあるのかと思いきや、視線は夢美の
ほうに向けられている。
strings.translated: Yuuto thought Shirou might still have something to say to him, but Shirou's gaze was directed toward Yumemi.

strings.text:
史郎
「さっきから気になってるんだけど……それ、何？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"I've been wondering about it for a while now... what's that?"

strings.text: 史郎が指差したのは、夢美が抱いている蟲だった。
strings.translated: What Shirou was pointing at was the Bug that Yumemi was holding.

strings.text:
史郎
「ぬいぐるみじゃないよね。
　さっきから脚が動いてるし、質感も生々しいし」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"That's not a stuffed animal, is it.
 Its legs have been moving this whole time, and the texture looks so... real."

strings.text:
史郎
「す、すごいっ！　こんな生き物初めて見たっ！」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"W-wow! I've never seen a creature like this before!"

strings.text:
史郎
「どこ！？　ここ！？
　もしかして、この森で見つけたの！！？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Where!? Here!?
 Did you find it in this forest!?"

strings.text:
夢美
「え、えっと……何て言うか、その…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"U-um... how do I put this... well..."

strings.text:
史郎
「も、もっとよく見せてよっ！
　動物！？　それともこのサイズで昆虫！？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"L-let me get a better look!
 Is it an animal!? Or is it an insect at that size!?"

strings.text: 興奮した様子の史郎が、じりじりとにじり寄って来る。
strings.translated: Shirou, visibly excited, crept closer and closer.

strings.text:
その異様な圧迫感に、夢美は思わず後ずさりしてし
まった。
strings.translated: Overwhelmed by that strange pressure, Yumemi instinctively backed away.

strings.text:
優斗
「おい、怖がらせるなよ」

優斗に首根っこを掴まれ、史郎が夢美から引き剥がさ
れる。
strings.translated: Yuuto grabbed Shirou by the scruff of his neck and pulled him away from Yumemi.

strings.text:
優斗
「蟲の話は、また今度にさせてくれ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"We can talk about the Bug another time."

strings.text:
優斗
「それより俺達は森から出たいんだけど、さっきの
　道順で本当に大丈夫なのか？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"More importantly, we want to get out of this forest -- are you sure the directions you gave us are right?"

strings.text:
史郎
「ああ、それは問題ないと思うよ。
　川に沿って下流に方向に歩いていくだけだし」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Yeah, that should be fine.
 All you have to do is walk downstream along the river."

strings.text:
史郎
「たぶん、十分もすれば高速道路が見えてくるから」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"You should be able to see the highway in about ten minutes or so."

strings.text:
まだ納得しかねている部分があるのか、優斗が沈んだ
声で返事をする。
strings.translated: As if there was still something he couldn't quite accept, Yuuto replied in a subdued voice.

strings.text:
だが、史郎はそんな優斗の様子には気付いておらず、
ぐるんぐるんと腕を回し、鼻息も荒く吼えた。
strings.translated: But Shirou hadn't noticed Yuuto's mood at all -- he swung his arms around in wide circles and let out a snort.

strings.text:
史郎
「よぉーし！
　ボクも新種の生物、見つけてやるぞぉーっ！！」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"All right!
 I'm gonna find a new species too!!"

strings.text:
史郎
「それじゃ、また今度ゆっくり話そうねっ！！」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Let's talk more next time, okay!!"

strings.text:
固く握り拳を作って、史郎が意気揚々と森の中に消え
ていく。
strings.translated: Shirou pumped his fist with gusto and disappeared back into the forest.

strings.text:
夢美は、ぽかんとした表情でそれを見送りながら、
思わずといった風に呟いてしまった。
strings.translated: Yumemi watched him go with a blank expression, and before she knew it, she had murmured aloud.

strings.text:
夢美
「ああいう人だったんですね……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"So that's the kind of person he is..."

strings.text:
そう答える優斗も、やはりぽかんと史郎の背中を見つ
めていた。
strings.translated: Yuuto, answering in kind, was also staring blankly at Shirou's retreating back.

strings.text:
自分の追って来た『異質な蟲の気配』が、史郎ととも
に遠ざかって行った事に気付いたのは、それから暫く
経ってからだった……。
strings.translated: It was only some time later that she realized the 'strange Bug presence' she had been tracking had grown distant along with Shirou...

strings.text:
史郎
「気をつけてね。
　油断すると、森なんてすぐ迷っちゃうから」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Take care now.
 It's easy to get lost in a forest if you let your guard down."

strings.text:
優斗
「ああ、骨身に沁みてるよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Yeah, I've learned that lesson the hard way."

strings.text:
夢美
「ありがとうございました」
史郎に軽く頭を下げて、教えられた出口を目指す。
strings.translated: Yumemi gave Shirou a small bow and set off toward the exit he had described.

strings.text:
まだまだ不安は大きかったが、それでも森から出られ
るかもしれないという期待感は膨らみつつあった。
strings.translated: There was still plenty of anxiety weighing on her, but even so, the hope that they might finally escape the forest was beginning to swell.

strings.text: 人目を気にせずに済むトイレ。
strings.translated: A bathroom where she wouldn't have to worry about being seen.

strings.text: 求めて止まなかったものが、頭の中をぐるぐる巡る。
strings.translated: All the things she had been desperately longing for swirled around and around in her head.

strings.text:
夢美は一度だけ振り返ってみたが、そのとき史郎の姿
はもう見えなくなっていた。
strings.translated:
Yumemi glanced back once, but by then, Shirou's figure
had already vanished from sight.

strings.text:
今まで追っていたはずの異質な蟲の気配もまた、夢美
達の背後に回っていることに気付いた。
strings.translated: She noticed that the strange Bug presence she had been tracking until now had also circled around behind them.

strings.text:
史郎と話している間に、蟲のほうが近くを通り過ぎて
いたのか、それとも――――――――
strings.translated: Had the Bug simply passed nearby while they were talking with Shirou, or was it --

strings.text:
胸に不安なものを抱えながら、夢美は優斗の後を付い
て行った。
strings.translated: Carrying that uneasy feeling in her chest, Yumemi followed after Yuuto.

strings.text:
その先に森の出口があることを、心から祈ってい
た……。
strings.translated: She prayed with all her heart that the forest's exit lay ahead of them...

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁっ……はぁっ……はぁっ……はぁっ……」

優斗
「はぁっ…………はぁっ…………はぁっ…………」

史郎と別れて小一時間ほど経った頃、夢美と優斗は
まだ森の中を歩いていた。
strings.translated:
About an hour had passed since parting ways with Shirou, and Yumemi and Yuuto
were still walking through the forest.

strings.text:
そろそろ足の裏が痛くなってきていて、太ももが
ぷるぷると痙攣し始めている。
strings.translated: The soles of her feet were starting to ache, and her thighs had begun to tremble and spasm.

strings.text:
優斗はまだ幾分余裕があるようだったが、夢美の様子
を見て足を止めた。
strings.translated: Yuuto still seemed to have some energy left, but he stopped when he saw Yumemi's condition.

strings.text:
なるべく平らな場所を見つけて、そこに二人並んで腰
を下ろす。
strings.translated: They found the flattest spot they could and sat down side by side.

strings.text:
どちらも疲労より落胆の色が濃く、すぐには話をする
事もできなかった。
strings.translated: Both of them wore expressions heavy with dejection more than exhaustion, and neither could find words to speak right away.

strings.text: 頭の中では、互いに同じ疑問を抱いているのが分かる。
strings.translated: In their heads, they both knew they were harboring the same doubt.

strings.text:
優斗
「道、間違えたのかな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Did we take a wrong turn somewhere?"

strings.text:
夢美
「でも、すぐに高速に出るって……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But he said we'd reach the highway quickly..."

strings.text: 史郎の言ったとおり、小川までは順調に見つかった。
strings.translated: Just as Shirou had said, they managed to find the stream without trouble.

strings.text:
あとはそれを下流に向かって歩くだけで、すぐに高速
道路が見えてくるはずだった。
strings.translated: After that, all they had to do was follow it downstream, and the highway should have come into view before long.

strings.text:
だが、実際には森の中を延々と歩くだけで、森の出口
に近付いている雰囲気すらない。
strings.translated: But in reality, they just kept walking endlessly through the forest, without even a hint that they were getting closer to the exit.

strings.text:
辺りには普通に蟲の気配を感じるし、このまま歩いて
も一生森から出られないような気がした。
strings.translated: They could still sense Bugs around them as usual, and it was starting to feel like they might never leave this forest alive.

strings.text:
優斗
「もう少しだけ、川沿いに行ってみて、それでダメな
　ら、次を考えよう」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Let's try following the river a little further -- and if that doesn't work, we'll think of something else."

strings.text:
疲れ果てた優斗の言葉に、夢美もまた疲れ果てた返事
をする事しかできなかった……。
strings.translated: To Yuuto's utterly exhausted words, all Yumemi could manage was an equally exhausted reply...

strings.text:
レン
「それでは、貴女はここで大人しくしていて下さい」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Now then, please stay here and behave yourself."

strings.text:
誘拐してきた美弥香を廃屋へと連れて来て、レンが
静かな口調で命令した。
strings.translated: Ren had brought the kidnapped Miyaka to an abandoned house and issued his command in a quiet tone.

strings.text:
部屋の中は荒れ放題で、天井や壁は崩れかかっている
し、一歩あるけば埃が宙を舞った。
strings.translated: The room inside was in complete disarray -- the ceiling and walls were on the verge of crumbling, and every step stirred up clouds of dust into the air.

strings.text:
ここ数年、全く使われていなかった家である事が、
辺りに漂う澱んだ空気からも伝わってくる。
strings.translated: From the stagnant air that hung throughout, it was clear the house had gone completely unused for several years.

strings.text:
美弥香
「酷い臭いですね」

レン
「申し訳ありませんが我慢して下さい。
　貴女のお父上との交渉が済むまでの辛抱です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I apologize for the inconvenience, but please bear with it.
 It will only be until negotiations with your father are concluded."

strings.text:
レンはそんなことを言いながら、蟲筒から一匹の蟲を
放った。
strings.translated: Saying that, Ren released a single Bug from his Bug tube.

strings.text:
それは巨大な女郎蜘蛛へと姿を変え、ガサガサと音を
立てながら、脚を伸ばして部屋の天井に張り付く。
strings.translated: It transformed into an enormous joro spider, and with a rustling sound, stretched out its legs and clung to the ceiling of the room.

strings.text: これには、さすがに美弥香も顔を青褪めさせた。
strings.translated: Even Miyaka went pale at the sight of that.

strings.text:
レン
「あれが監視役をしますので、無理にここから出よう
　などと考えないほうがいいですよ」
strings.translated:
Ren
"That one will serve as your guard, so I would advise against trying to force your way out of here."

strings.text:
美弥香
「……覚えておきます」

レン
「では、僕は他に用事がありますので」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Well then, I have other matters to attend to."

strings.text:
空になった蟲筒をコートの内側に収めて、レンが廃屋
を出て行こうとする。
strings.translated: Ren tucked the now-empty Bug tube inside his coat and moved to leave the abandoned house.

strings.text: ――と、その背中に向けて美弥香が声を掛けた。
strings.translated: Just then -- Miyaka called out to his retreating back.

strings.text:
美弥香
「少し、お話ができませんか？」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Could we... talk for a moment?"

strings.text:
引き戸に手を掛けかけたレンが、ピタリと動きを止め
る。
strings.translated: Ren, who had just reached for the sliding door, stopped dead in his tracks.

strings.text:
そして、美弥香のほうを振り返ると、感情のない声で
尋ねた。
strings.translated: Then, turning back toward Miyaka, he asked in a flat, emotionless voice.

strings.text:
美弥香
「父の会社と、蟲使いの関係……そういったものに
　ついてです」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"About the relationship between my father's company and the Bug Users... things like that."

strings.text:
レン
「そんな事を話してどうすると言うのですか」
strings.translated:
Ren
"And what do you hope to gain by discussing such things?"

strings.text:
美弥香
「私は、ずっと知りたいと思っていました。
　Ｊｉｎｍｕ・Ｃｏｒｐｏｒａｔｉｏｎの暗部を」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"I have always wanted to know. The dark side of Jinmu Corporation."

strings.text:
レン
「それを僕が貴女に話して、何か益になるような事が
　あるとでも？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"And what good would it do you
 if I told you any of that?"

strings.text:
美弥香
「私が知っていて、貴方がたが知らない情報がある
　可能性もあるのでは？」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Is it not possible that there is information I possess which you do not?"

strings.text:
レン
「……無いとは言い切れませんね」
レンの返事に、美弥香がホッとした表情を浮かべる。
strings.translated: At Ren's reply, Miyaka's expression softened with visible relief.

strings.text:
レン
「では、話していただきましょうか」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Very well. Let us hear what you have to say."

strings.text:
レン
「貴女が知っていることを、です」
唐突に言われ、美弥香は内心戸惑った。
strings.translated: Caught off guard by the abruptness, Miyaka was inwardly flustered.

strings.text:
知っている事を頭の中に並べ、レンにとって有益と
思われる情報を探し出す。
strings.translated: She sorted through what she knew in her mind, searching for information that might be of use to Ren.

strings.text:
そして、暫くの沈黙を通したあと、思い出したように
口を開いた。
strings.translated: Then, after a brief silence, she opened her mouth as if suddenly remembering something.

strings.text:
美弥香
「私が聞いた話では、神武は新しい生物兵器のような
　ものを作り出しているそうです」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"From what I have heard, Jinmu is apparently creating something akin to a new biological weapon."

strings.text:
レン
「ええ、おそらくは一族を抜けた蟲使いから蟲を入手
　し、それを研究、改良して新種の蟲を作り出してい
　るのでしょうね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Yes -- most likely they obtained Bugs from Bug Users who left the clan, then researched and refined them to produce new strains."

strings.text:
美弥香
「その研究の責任者が、確か――――」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"The person in charge of that research was, if I recall----"

strings.text:
レンが言葉を続けると、美弥香が驚いたように目を
丸くした。
strings.translated: When Ren continued speaking, Miyaka's eyes went wide with surprise.

strings.text:
レン
「そのくらいの情報であれば、我々も既に掴んでいま
　す」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Information at that level is something we have already obtained."

strings.text:
レン
「ただ、その正体までは突き止められずにいます。
　どこの誰なのか、せめて名前は分かりませんか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"However, we have yet to identify who is behind it. Do you happen to know who they are -- even just a name?"

strings.text:
美弥香
「ごめんなさい。私もそこまでは…………」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"I'm sorry. I don't know that much either..."

strings.text:
美弥香
「そういう人がいるらしいと、聞いたことがある程度
　なので……」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"I only heard that such a person exists, nothing more..."

strings.text:
ハッとしたような表情を浮かべて、美弥香が顔を上げ
る。
strings.translated: Miyaka looked up suddenly, her expression brightening as if something had just come to her.

strings.text:
美弥香
「私にその話を聞かせてくれた人なら、もしかすると
　何か知っているかもしれません」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"The person who told me about all this -- they might know something."

strings.text:
美弥香
「神武に所属する研究者の、お屋敷で働いている人で
　す」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Someone who works at the estate of a researcher affiliated with Jinmu."

strings.text: レンの問いかけに、美弥香はすぐには答えなかった。
strings.translated: Miyaka did not answer Ren's question right away.

strings.text:
黙ってレンを見上げている様子を見ると、知らないわ
けではないらしい。
strings.translated: The way she sat there silently looking up at Ren suggested it wasn't that she didn't know.

strings.text:
やがて、一度だけまぶたを閉じて考えるような仕草を
見せたあと、今度は口元に微かな笑みを浮かべて問い
返した。
strings.translated: After a moment, she closed her eyes once -- as if to gather her thoughts -- then turned back with a faint smile playing at the corners of her lips.

strings.text:
美弥香
「その人の名前を教える前に、私の質問に答えていた
　だくわけにはいきませんか？」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Before I tell you that person's name -- would you be willing to answer a question of mine first?"

strings.text:
レン
「……質問の内容によりますが」
strings.translated:
Ren
"...That depends on the nature of your question."

strings.text:
美弥香
「先ほどもお尋ねしたことです。
　神武と蟲、蟲使いの関係について、あなた方がどこ
　までご存知なのか……」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"It is the same question I asked before.
 How much do you know about the relationship between
 Jinmu, the Bugs, and the Bug Users...?"

strings.text:
レン
「それこそ、先ほどお答えした通りです。
　一族から抜けた蟲使いから蟲を得て、それを改良し
　ている……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"And my answer is the same as before.
 They obtain Bugs from Bug Users who have left the clan,
 and then refine them..."

strings.text:
レン
「生物兵器に利用する話は噂程度に聞いていましたが、
　我々にとって問題なのは、蟲が外部の手に渡ってい
　ることです」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I had heard rumors about their use as biological weapons,
 but what concerns us is that the Bugs have fallen
 into outside hands."

strings.text:
美弥香
「つまり、全ての蟲を回収するのが、あなた方の目的
　なのですか？」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"In other words, is your goal to recover all of the Bugs?"

strings.text:
レン
「現在、別の担当者が、蟲や蟲使いに関する全ての
　情報の破棄、並びに今後関わらないことを条件に、
　貴女の父親と交渉しています」
strings.translated:
Ren
"At this moment, another representative is negotiating
 with your father, on the condition that all information
 regarding Bugs and Bug Users be destroyed,
 and that he have no further involvement."

strings.text:
レン
「その結果によっては、蟲の回収だけで済むかもしれ
　ませんし、済まないかもしれません」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Depending on the outcome, it may be enough to simply recover the Bugs -- or it may not."

strings.text:
美弥香
「あなた方は、蟲とともに静かに暮らすことを望んで
　いるのですね……」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"You wish to live quietly, together with the Bugs......"

strings.text:
レン
「さて、どうでしょうね」
そう呟いて、初めてレンが視線を逸らした。
strings.translated: Muttering that softly, Ren looked away for the first time.

strings.text:
何かを見るためではなく、美弥香から逃げるように
顔を背けた。
strings.translated: Not to look at anything in particular -- he simply turned his face away, as if fleeing from Miyaka.

strings.text:
レン
「蟲とともに生き、蟲とともに死ぬ……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"To live with the Bugs, and to die with the Bugs......"

strings.text:
レン
「古の時代より森の一部となりて、我等の生き方は
　変わらない」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Since ancient times we have been part of the forest -- our way of life does not change."

strings.text:
レン
「それを乱す恐れのあるものは、何人たりとも許して
　おくわけにはいかない」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Anyone who threatens to disturb that cannot be permitted to go free."

strings.text:
レン
「少なくとも僕は……そう教わって育ちました……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"At least, that is what I was taught as I grew up......"

strings.text:
レン
「貴女の質問は終わりですか？」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Are you finished with your questions?"

strings.text:
美弥香
「えっ？　あ、はい……」

再びレンに見下ろされ、美弥香が戸惑ったように答え
た。
strings.translated: Ren's gaze fell upon her again, and Miyaka answered with a flustered look.

strings.text:
レン
「では、先ほどの話に出た人物の名前を教えていただ
　きましょうか」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Then, would you kindly tell me the name of the person mentioned earlier?"

strings.text:
美弥香
「その前に、彼女に酷いことをしないと。約束しても
　らえますか？」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Before that -- can you promise me you won't do anything terrible to her?"

strings.text:
レンがやや意外そうに言い、美弥香がぐっと言葉を
詰まらせた。
strings.translated: Ren said it with a hint of surprise, and Miyaka caught herself, choking on her words.

strings.text: 気が緩んでいたのか、今のは明らかな失言だ。
strings.translated: Perhaps her guard had slipped -- that was clearly a mistake.

strings.text:
美弥香
「そうです、女性です」

美弥香
「ですから、手荒な真似はしないと約束してもらいた
　いのです」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"That is precisely why I need you to promise you won't treat her roughly."

strings.text:
レン
「善処はしますが約束はできません。
　必要であれば、相応の手段をとります」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I will do my best, but I cannot make promises. If necessary, I will take whatever measures are required."

strings.text:
美弥香
「では、名前を言うわけにはいきません」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Then I'm afraid I cannot give you the name."

strings.text:
まるで、一本の矢を思わせるような視線で、美弥香が
ハッキリと拒否する。
strings.translated: With a gaze sharp as an arrow, Miyaka refused him plainly.

strings.text:
対してレンも動じた様子はなく、つり上がった目で
美弥香を睨み付けていた。
strings.translated: Ren, for his part, showed no sign of being shaken, and fixed her with a sharp, upturned glare.

strings.text:
レン
「命令が下れば、貴女を蟲で犯してでも名前を吐かせ
　るところなのですが……」
strings.translated:
Ren
"If I were given the order, I would violate you with Bugs until you gave up the name......"

strings.text:
美弥香
「では、そのようになされば良いのでは？」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Then perhaps you should do exactly that."

strings.text:
レン
「命令があれば、です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Only if I am given the order."

strings.text:
レン
「残念ですが、今は貴女にそこまで構っていられるだ
　けの余裕がない」
strings.translated:
Ren
"Unfortunately, I don't have the luxury of devoting that much attention to you right now."

strings.text:
レン
「話の続きは、また後日にしましょう」
strings.translated:
Ren
"We will continue this conversation another day."

strings.text: 一礼して、レンが廃屋を出て行く。
strings.translated: With a brief bow, Ren left the abandoned building.

strings.text:
美弥香はそれを見送ると、ホッと胸から吐息を漏らし
た。
strings.translated: Miyaka watched him go, then let out a quiet sigh of relief.

strings.text:
レンと話している間、強がっては見せていたが、実際
は心臓が止まるかと思うほど怖かった。
strings.translated: Throughout her exchange with Ren, she had put on a brave front -- but in truth, she had been so frightened she thought her heart might stop.

strings.text:
美弥香
「大変な事になってしまったわね」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"This has turned into quite a mess..."

strings.text: 美弥香の呟きは、虚空に吸い込まれて消えていった。
strings.translated: Miyaka's murmur was swallowed up by the empty air and vanished.

strings.text:
その様子を、天井に張り付いた蜘蛛が、じっと見下ろ
していた……。
strings.translated: A spider clinging to the ceiling stared down at the scene in silence...

strings.text:
肌にチクチクするような痛みを感じたのは、その日の
早朝からだった。
strings.translated: The stinging pain across her skin had begun in the early hours of that morning.

strings.text:
まるで、神経が過敏になっているような、触れるだけ
で痺れが走るような、そんな症状が全身に起こってい
た。
strings.translated: It was as though her nerves had become hypersensitive -- as if the mere touch of anything against her skin sent a numbing shock through her -- and that sensation was spreading across her entire body.

strings.text: 近くからも遠くからも感じる蟲の気配。
strings.translated: She could sense the presence of Bugs, both near and far.

strings.text:
昨日よりもさらに鮮明に、手で掴むような確実さで
感じ取ることができる。
strings.translated: Even more vividly than the day before -- with a certainty she could grasp in her very hands -- she could feel it.

strings.text:
頭の中に自分を中心とした森の地図が広がって、
その範囲内にいる蟲を上から見下ろしているよう
な感覚だった。
strings.translated: A map of the forest spread through her mind with herself at its center, and she had the sensation of looking down from above at every Bug within its range.

strings.text:
自分の体を抱き締めるようにして耐えながら、昨日
食べたものを思い返す。
strings.translated: She hugged her own body and endured it, trying to recall what she had eaten the day before.

strings.text:
だが、殆どが長期保存の利く食品ばかりで、神経過敏
になるようなものはなかったはずだ。
strings.translated: But almost everything had been long-shelf-life food -- nothing that should have made her nerves this sensitive.

strings.text:
強いて言えば、カップラーメンを買ってはいたものの
お湯がなかったためそのまま食べるという荒行に出た
が、それが関係あるとは思えなかった。
strings.translated: If she had to name something, she had bought a cup of instant ramen but, having no hot water, had resorted to the ordeal of eating it dry -- though she couldn't imagine that had anything to do with it.

strings.text:
まだ優斗が寝ていることを確認して、夢美はコソコソ
と服を脱ぎ始めた。
strings.translated: After confirming that Yuuto was still asleep, Yumemi began quietly slipping off her clothes.

strings.text:
とにかく何かが肌に触れるだけで痛みを感じるため、
一度裸になって自分の体を確認しようと思ったのだ。
strings.translated: Anything touching her skin caused pain, so she thought she would strip down and check her body over.

strings.text:
隣に優斗がいるためいつ起きるかという恐怖はあった
が、見られたら見られた時だという開き直りも、心の
どこかにあった。
strings.translated: With Yuuto sleeping right beside her, there was the fear of him waking up at any moment -- but somewhere in her heart was also a resignation that if he saw her, he saw her.

strings.text:
装束を脱いで自分の体を見回してみたが、これといっ
て異常は見当たらなかった。
strings.translated: She took off her outfit and looked herself over, but found nothing particularly wrong.

strings.text:
森の探索で細かい傷ができていたり、泥で汚れていた
りはしたが、それはまた別の問題のはずだ。
strings.translated: The exploration had left small scratches here and there, and she was dirty with mud -- but those were separate issues.

strings.text:
あちこちペタペタ触ってみたが、やはりおかしいとこ
ろは見当たらなかった。
strings.translated: She poked and prodded herself all over, but still found nothing out of the ordinary.

strings.text:
自分の体が痛まないことに気付いて、夢美は小さく
首を傾げた。
strings.translated: Noticing that her body no longer hurt, Yumemi tilted her head slightly.

strings.text:
起きたときは全身の神経がピリピリしていたのに、
服を脱いだ途端それが感じられなくなったのだ。
strings.translated: When she had woken up, her nerves had been prickling all over -- but the moment she took off her clothes, that sensation had vanished.

strings.text:
偶然だろうと思いつつ装束を着直してみると、再び
あのチクチクするような感覚が襲って来る。
strings.translated: Telling herself it was probably a coincidence, she put her outfit back on -- and once again, that prickling feeling came rushing back.

strings.text:
その時初めて、夢美はレンの言っていたことを思い出
したのだった。
strings.translated: It was only then that Yumemi remembered what Ren had told her.

strings.text:
レン
『強いて言うのなら、夢美さんが明確な理由を持って
　その服を脱ごうとしたとき、訓練の第一段階は通過
　したと考えて良いでしょう』
strings.translated:
Ren
"To put it simply -- when you find yourself with a clear reason to take off that outfit, you may consider the first stage of training complete."

strings.text:
それが何を意味するのかは分からなかったが、通過し
た可能性は十分に考えられた。
strings.translated: She didn't know what it meant, but there was every reason to think she had passed it.

strings.text:
明確な理由というものが、「着ていると肌が痛いか
ら」、というものでも良いのなら、おそらく間違い
ないだろう。
strings.translated: If "a clear reason" could include something like "because it hurts my skin to wear it," then she was almost certainly right.

strings.text:
夢美はもう一度服を脱いで、確かに肌の痛みが消えて
いくのを確認すると、着替え用として持って来ていた
私服に袖を通した。
strings.translated: Yumemi took her clothes off once more, confirmed that the pain in her skin was indeed fading, and then slipped into the casual clothes she had brought along as a change of outfit.

strings.text: 久しぶりの肌触りが、夢美の体に染み込んできた……。
strings.translated: The familiar feel of the fabric seeped into Yumemi's skin...

strings.text:
優斗
「へぇ、それじゃあ、もうあの服は要らないんだ？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Huh, so you don't need that outfit anymore?"

strings.text:
目を覚ますと夢美の姿が変わっていたことに、優斗は
暫くぽかんとした表情を浮かべた。
strings.translated: When he woke to find Yumemi looking different, Yuuto stared blankly for a moment.

strings.text:
最近、ようやく装束の格好が見慣れてきたところだっ
たようで、ある意味不意打ちを喰らった形になったら
しい。
strings.translated: He had apparently only just gotten used to seeing her in the outfit, so in a sense he had been caught completely off guard.

strings.text:
朝食を採っている間もちらちらと視線を送ってきて、
夢美は何となく照れてしまった。
strings.translated: Even while they ate breakfast, he kept glancing over at her, and Yumemi found herself feeling oddly self-conscious.

strings.text:
夢美
「もしかして、こっちの格好のほうが変ですか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Does this look strange to you, maybe?"

strings.text:
優斗
「えっ？　あ、いや、そうじゃないよ。
　なんだか懐かしい感じがしてたから、つい……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Huh? Oh, no, that's not it.
 It just... feels nostalgic somehow, so I couldn't help but stare..."

strings.text: 逆に照れたように言って、優斗が苦笑いを浮かべる。
strings.translated: He said it as if he were the embarrassed one, and gave a wry smile.

strings.text:
夢美はホッと胸を撫で下ろしたが、ふとある事が気に
なってその質問を投げてみた。
strings.translated: Yumemi breathed a sigh of relief, but something suddenly caught her attention, and she decided to ask.

strings.text:
夢美
「優斗さんは、どっちの格好が良かったですか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Which look did you prefer, Yuuto-san?"

Yuuto
"Compared to what you were wearing up until yesterday?"

strings.text: 夢美が頷くと、優斗が少し考えるような仕草を見せる。
strings.translated: When Yumemi nodded, Yuuto made a show of thinking it over for a moment.

strings.text: 言おうか言うまいか、悩んでいるような様子が窺えた。
strings.translated: It was clear he was wrestling with whether or not to say what was on his mind.

strings.text:
優斗
「ぶっちゃけていい？」

夢美
「……お手柔らかにお願いします」

優斗
「最初見たときは、どんなお店で働き始めたんだろ
　うって思った」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"When I first saw it, I thought -- I wonder what kind of shop she started working at."

strings.text:
夢美
「要するに変ってことですね」

優斗
「変ってわけじゃないけど、あんまり見ないデザイン
　の服だったからね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Not weird exactly -- it was just a design you don't see very often."

strings.text:
優斗
「最近見慣れてはきてたけど、やっぱり夢美ちゃんは
　その格好のほうが似合ってるかな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I've gotten used to it lately, but I still think this look suits you better, Yumemi-chan."

strings.text:
多少のお世辞が入っている可能性はあったが、やはり
似合っていると言われて悪い気はしない。
strings.translated: There was a chance some flattery was mixed in, but even so, being told she suited the outfit was not an unpleasant thing to hear.

strings.text:
夢美は軽く安堵の息を吐いたが、その直後優斗が付け
足すように言った。
strings.translated: Yumemi let out a small sigh of relief -- but immediately after, Yuuto added something more.

strings.text:
優斗
「でもまあ、あれはあれで不思議な色気があったけど
　ね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"But, well, that outfit had its own kind of strange allure, you know."

strings.text:
優斗の言葉がやや意外で、夢美はつい確認するように
聞き返してしまった。
strings.translated: Yuuto's words caught her slightly off guard, and Yumemi found herself asking back as if to confirm.

strings.text:
正直、妙な部分が露出している服だと思っていたので、
男と女の感覚の差が出たような気もする。
strings.translated: Honestly, she had thought of it as an outfit that exposed odd parts of the body, so she supposed this was a case of the difference between how men and women see things.

strings.text:
優斗
「まあ、ほら、あっちはスカートだったしね」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Well, I mean, that one had a skirt, after all."

strings.text: つぶやきながら、自分の体を見下ろしてみる。
strings.translated: She murmured and glanced down at herself.

strings.text:
スカートは履かないわけではないが、気軽に動ける事
などを考慮すると、夢美はズボンのほうが好みだった。
strings.translated: It wasn't that she never wore skirts, but when she considered things like ease of movement, Yumemi preferred pants.

strings.text:
夢美
「もしかして、私って色気ないですか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Could it be... that I'm not very alluring?"

strings.text:
優斗
「えっ？　そんな事ないと思うけど……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Huh? I don't think that's true at all..."

strings.text:
夢美
「優斗さんは、女の子の格好で好きなのってありま
　す？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yuuto-san, is there a style of clothing you like on girls?"

strings.text:
優斗
「格好で好きって言われてもなぁ……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"A style I like, huh... that's a tough one..."

strings.text:
優斗が考えるような仕草を見せたあと、ふと何かを
思い出したような表情を浮かべる。
strings.translated: Yuuto made a gesture as if thinking it over, then suddenly wore an expression like he'd recalled something.

strings.text:
そして、ついと夢美――の髪に視線を送ると、やや
苦笑いしながら言った。
strings.translated: Then he glanced over at Yumemi -- at her hair, specifically -- and spoke with a slightly wry smile.

strings.text:
優斗
「もうひとつだけぶっちゃけると…………」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"If I'm being completely honest about one more thing..."

strings.text: 返事をしながら、思わず身を乗り出してしまう。
strings.translated: She replied and found herself leaning forward without thinking.

strings.text:
優斗
「髪型はアップにしてるほうが好きかな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I think I prefer hair worn up."

strings.text: 思わず首の後ろに手が回ってしまう。
strings.translated: Her hand instinctively moved to the back of her neck.

strings.text:
ヘアクリップのひとつもあれば出来ない事はないが、
今、ここでというのは無理だ。
strings.translated: If she had even a single hair clip it wouldn't be impossible, but right here, right now -- that was out of the question.

strings.text:
優斗
「あ、別に気にしなくていいよ。ただの好みだし」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Ah, don't worry about it. It's just a personal preference."

strings.text:
優斗が苦笑いしながら補足するが、夢美の耳には届い
ていない。
strings.translated: Yuuto added with a wry smile, but the words didn't quite reach Yumemi's ears.

strings.text:
アップと言っても色々あるが、優斗の言うところの
髪型は何となくイメージできた。
strings.translated: "Up" could mean many things, but she had a vague image of the particular style Yuuto had in mind.

strings.text:
ただ、それをするには、夢美は髪の長さそのものが
足りない。
strings.translated: The problem was, Yumemi's hair simply wasn't long enough to pull it off.

strings.text:
ＡｎｚＵで働き始める際にバッサリ切ってしまった事
を、少しだけ後悔した。
strings.translated: She felt a small pang of regret for having cut it all off when she started working at AnzU.

strings.text:
夢美
「これから暫く、髪は切らないことにします」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"From now on, I've decided not to cut my hair for a while."

strings.text:
優斗
「気にすることないんだけどなぁ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"You really don't have to worry about it, though."

strings.text:
夢美
「いいんです。
　誰かのために変えてみるのも、もしかすると案外
　楽しいかもしれないし……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It's fine. Changing yourself for someone else might actually turn out to be surprisingly fun..."

strings.text:
優斗
「うん、じゃあ、期待してようかな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Well then... I'll look forward to it."

strings.text:
ニッコリと笑顔を浮かべる優斗に、夢美は元気良く
返事をした。
strings.translated: Yumemi replied cheerfully to Yuuto, who smiled warmly back at her.

strings.text:
こういうちょっとした約束が、優斗との絆を深めてく
れているような気がした……。
strings.translated: It felt as though these small little promises were deepening the bond between her and Yuuto...

strings.text:
優斗
「……っと、ちょっと用足し。待ってて」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"...Oh, I need to take a quick bathroom break. Wait here."

strings.text:
そろそろ出発しようかという頃になって、優斗が
用を足すために川のほうへと下りていった。
strings.translated: Just as they were about to set off, Yuuto headed down toward the river to relieve himself.

strings.text:
夢美は荷物の整理をしながら、足元に擦り寄ってきて
いる蟲の背中を撫でる。
strings.translated: Yumemi sorted through their belongings while stroking the back of the Bug that had sidled up to her feet.

strings.text:
優斗の存在はもちろんだが、蟲の存在もまた、夢美の
大きな支えの一つだ。
strings.translated: Yuuto's presence was of course important, but the Bug's presence was also one of Yumemi's great pillars of support.

strings.text:
森を出るのに、あと何日掛かるか分からないが、必ず
二人と一匹で脱出してやると強く心に誓った。
strings.translated: She didn't know how many more days it would take to get out of this forest, but she swore firmly in her heart that the three of them -- the two of them and the Bug -- would make it out together.

strings.text: 蟲を抱き上げて、笑顔で話しかける。
strings.translated: She lifted the Bug up and spoke to it with a smile.

strings.text: そして、そっとキスをしようとした瞬間――――
strings.translated: And just as she gently leaned in to give it a kiss --

strings.text:
猛烈な圧力が、夢美の背中から胸へとかけて突き抜け
た。
strings.translated: A violent force tore straight through Yumemi, from her back through to her chest.

strings.text:
全身に電気のような刺激が走り、抱えていた蟲を地面
に落とす。
strings.translated: An electric-like shock ran through her entire body, and she dropped the Bug she had been holding to the ground.

strings.text:
視線を動かしてみると、胸の中心から一本の赤黒い
触手が伸びていた。
strings.translated: When she moved her eyes to look, a single red-black tentacle was extending from the center of her chest.

strings.text: 二本目が、今度は背中から腹へと突き抜けた。
strings.translated: A second one tore through her, this time from her back out through her stomach.

strings.text: この時点になって初めて、背後に大きな気配を感じる。
strings.translated: Only at this point did she finally sense a massive presence behind her.

strings.text:
何十匹もの蟲が、自分に襲い掛かっている気配が、
痛いくらいに肌に――――――
strings.translated: The presence of dozens upon dozens of Bugs swarming over her body prickled against her skin -- painfully --

strings.text: さらに体が貫かれ、夢美の視界は赤一色に染まった。
strings.translated: Her body was pierced again, and Yumemi's vision flooded red.

strings.text:
体のあちこちに穴が空いて、激痛が指先にまで駆け抜
けてくる。
strings.translated: Holes opened all across her body, and searing pain shot through her to the very tips of her fingers.

strings.text:
だが、夢美にはもはや声を出す力さえなく、血の色の
世界で呆然と立ち尽くすしかなかった。
strings.translated:
But Yumemi no longer had the strength even to cry out, and could only stand there in a daze
within a world drenched the color of blood.

strings.text:
？？？
「うひっ、獣魔蟲はボクがいただいて行くよ」
strings.translated:
???
"Hehe, I'll be taking the Jumachuu for myself."

strings.text:
？？？
「優斗は友達のよしみで助けておいてあげるからさ、
　君は安心して眠りなよ」
strings.translated:
???
"I'll do you a favor and let Yuuto go, since he's a friend -- so you just relax and go to sleep."

strings.text:
最後にそんな声を聞いて、夢美の意識はぷつりと途絶
えた。
strings.translated: Those were the last words she heard before Yumemi's consciousness cut out entirely.

strings.text:
一体何が起こったのか、死の瞬間までよく分からな
かった……。
strings.translated: She never quite understood what had happened, right up until the moment of her death...

strings.text: 古びた廃屋の隅で、アゲハは目を覚ました。
strings.translated: Ageha awoke in the corner of a decrepit abandoned house.

strings.text:
砂と埃にまみれた板張りの床で、膝を抱えて丸くなっ
た状態で、小さく呻き声を漏らした。
strings.translated: On the dusty, grime-covered wooden floor, she let out a small groan, curled up with her knees drawn to her chest.

strings.text: 妙な体勢で寝てしまったため、体の節々が痛い。
strings.translated: She had fallen asleep in an awkward position, and every joint in her body ached.

strings.text:
上半身を起こして辺りを見回すと、自分に起こった
出来事を思い出した。
strings.translated: As she raised her upper body and looked around, the events that had befallen her came flooding back.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ああ……捕まっちゃったんだっけ…………」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Oh right... I got captured, didn't I.........."

strings.text:
涙で腫れぼったくなった顔を擦りながら、埃まみれに
なった膝を抱えなおす。
strings.translated: She rubbed her face, swollen from crying, and readjusted her arms around her dust-covered knees.

strings.text:
ミニスカートなので正面から見れば下着が丸見えだっ
たが、自分しかいない部屋では隠す必要もない。
strings.translated: Her miniskirt left her underwear fully visible from the front, but with no one else in the room, there was no need to hide it.

strings.text:
ここに連れて来られて、どれほど時間が経ったのかは
分からなかったが、アゲハの精神はかなり追い詰めら
れていた。
strings.translated: She had no idea how much time had passed since she was brought here, but Ageha's mind had been pushed to its limit.

strings.text: 何が起こったのかは、今でもよく分かっていない。
strings.translated: She still didn't fully understand what had happened.

strings.text:
自宅でくつろいでいるところを突然襲われ、気付けば
ここまで運ばれて来たのだ。
strings.translated: She had been attacked without warning while relaxing at home, and before she knew it, she had been brought here.

strings.text:
相手は自分とそう歳の変わらない少女で、しきりに
Ｄｒ．Ｗｅｓｔのことを喋るよう脅してきた。
strings.translated: Her captor was a girl not much different in age from herself, who kept threatening Ageha to talk about Dr. West.

strings.text:
アゲハは、とにかく恐ろしくて知っているだけのこと
を話して聞かせたが、居場所――――
strings.translated: Ageha had been so terrified that she told the girl everything she knew -- but the location --

strings.text:
――つまり、Ｄｒ．Ｗｅｓｔ宅の住所は覚えていな
かったため、駅からの行き方を身振り手振りで伝えた。
strings.translated: -- That is, she didn't know the address of Dr. West's home, so she had conveyed the directions from the station with gestures and hand movements.

strings.text:
だが、少女はそれを聞いても尚、まだアゲハが何か
隠しているのではないかと疑っていた。
strings.translated: Even so, the girl still suspected that Ageha was hiding something.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ホントにもう何も知らないのに」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I really don't know anything else."

strings.text: 膝を抱えていると、また涙が出てきた。
strings.translated: As she hugged her knees, the tears came again.

strings.text: 何故、自分がこんな目に遭わなければならないのか。
strings.translated: Why did she have to go through something like this?

strings.text:
Ｄｒ．Ｗｅｓｔのことを知っているとは言っても、
詳しい研究内容まで聞かされているわけではない。
strings.translated: Knowing Dr. West was one thing, but she had never been told the details of his research.

strings.text: 蟲をもらって数日観察するだけ。
strings.translated: All she did was receive a Bug from him and observe it for a few days.

strings.text: アゲハのやって来たことと言えば、その程度だ。
strings.translated: That was the extent of what Ageha had ever done.

strings.text:
それなのに、一体どういう経緯で自分のことが蟲使い
にばれてしまい、こうして捕まる羽目になったのか。
strings.translated: And yet, somehow, a Bug User had found out about her -- and now she had ended up captured like this.

strings.text: 考えれば考えた分だけ涙が頬を濡らした。
strings.translated: The more she thought about it, the more tears streaked down her cheeks.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「帰りたい……家に帰りたいよぉ…………」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I want to go home... I want to go home..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「お父さん……お母さん…………」

今は疎遠になってしまった両親のことを想い、アゲハ
は両肩を震わせた。
strings.translated: Ageha thought of the parents she had grown so distant from, and her shoulders shook.

strings.text:
蟲使いなどに関わらなければ、今の自分にももっと
違った未来があったのだろうか。
strings.translated: If she had never gotten involved with Bug Users, would her life have turned out so differently?

strings.text:
たとえば普通に学校に行って、友達とお喋りをして、
家族みんなで夕食をとるような未来もあったのだろう
か。
strings.translated: Like going to school like a normal person, chatting with friends, having dinner together as a whole family -- could a future like that have been hers?

strings.text:
もう、手の届かない幸せに手を伸ばして、アゲハは
ただ泣き続けた。
strings.translated: Reaching out toward a happiness forever beyond her grasp, Ageha simply kept on crying.

strings.text:
何気なく天井を見上げたとき、アゲハは思わずそんな
声を漏らした。
strings.translated: When she happened to glance up at the ceiling, Ageha let out that small sound without thinking.

strings.text:
天井には古びた梁が何本が伸びていたが、そもそも
それが見える事自体がおかしい。
strings.translated: Several old beams stretched across the ceiling -- but the fact that she could see them at all was strange.

strings.text:
何故なら蟲使いの少女が出て行くとき、天井に巨大な
女郎蜘蛛の蟲を放ったからだ。
strings.translated: Because when the Bug User girl had left, she had released a giant jorougumo Bug onto the ceiling.

strings.text:
少女の話によればそれが監視役で、逃げようとすれば
襲い掛かってくるとの事だったのだが……。
strings.translated: According to the girl, it was there to keep watch, and would attack if Ageha tried to escape -- or so she had been told...

strings.text:
起きたときは気付かなかったが、天井に近い位置の壁
に、その蜘蛛が通り抜けられるほどの大穴が空いてい
た。
strings.translated: She hadn't noticed when she first woke up, but high on the wall near the ceiling, there was a gaping hole large enough for the spider to pass through.

strings.text:
最初からあったのかどうかは分からないが、姿が見え
ないという事は、そこから外に出たと考えるのが普通
だ。
strings.translated: She couldn't tell if it had been there from the start, but with the spider nowhere in sight, it was only natural to assume it had gone outside through there.

strings.text:
だが、アゲハの監視をしていた蟲が、何故廃屋の外に
出たのか。
strings.translated: But why had the Bug that was supposed to be watching Ageha left the abandoned house?

strings.text:
不思議に想いながらも引き戸のほうに近付いてみたが、
蜘蛛が襲い掛かって来るような気配はなかった。
strings.translated: Puzzled, she edged toward the sliding door -- but there was no sign of the spider poised to attack.

strings.text:
ごくりと息を呑んで、戸に掛けた手をどうするか考え
る。
strings.translated: She swallowed hard, hand on the door, weighing what to do next.

strings.text:
もしかすると戸を引いた時点で初めて、蟲が襲い掛
かって来るかもしれないのだ。
strings.translated:
It was possible that the moment she slid the door open, the Bug would come
crashing down on her.

strings.text: それを考えると、指先がカタカタと小刻みに震えた。
strings.translated: The thought made her fingertips tremble in tiny, rapid shivers.

strings.text:
だが、もしも、何らかの理由があって蟲がいなくなっ
てしまったのだとしたら――――
strings.translated: But if, for some reason, the Bug had disappeared --

strings.text:
――アゲハを見張るどころではない事態が起こってし
まったのだとしたら、逃げ出すチャンスは今しかない
ように思えた。
strings.translated:
-- if something had happened that left no room to keep watch over Ageha, then
this might be her only chance to escape.

strings.text:
このまま廃屋の中で大人しく待つか、それとも意を
決して逃げてみるか。
strings.translated:
Should she stay put in the abandoned house and wait quietly, or steel herself
and make a run for it?

strings.text:
だいぶ長い間考えた末、アゲハは奥歯を噛み締めなが
ら引き戸を開けた……。
strings.translated:
After deliberating for quite a long time, Ageha bit down on her back teeth and
slid the door open...

strings.text:
不意に人の気配に気付き、夢美は自然とその方向に
声を掛けていた。
strings.translated:
She had sensed someone's presence without warning, and Yumemi had called out
in that direction without thinking.

strings.text:
夢美
「そこに誰かいるんでしょ？」

木の影にいる人物が、びくっと体を震わせたのが分か
る。
strings.translated:
She could tell that the figure lurking in the shadow of the trees gave a startled
flinch.

strings.text:
暫く迷っていたようだったが、やがて観念したのか
木陰から姿を現した。
strings.translated:
They seemed to hesitate for a moment -- but eventually, as if resigning themselves,
they stepped out from the shade of the trees.

strings.text: それを見たとき、夢美も優斗も我が目を疑った。
strings.translated: When she saw who it was, both Yumemi and Yuuto couldn't believe their eyes.

strings.text:
木陰から姿を現したのは、紛れもなく九条アゲハだっ
た。
strings.translated:
The one who had stepped out from the shade of the trees was unmistakably
Kujou Ageha.

strings.text:
ピンクのジャケットにヒラヒラのミニスカートという、
森を歩くには明らかに不自然な格好で、夢美達の前に
立っている。
strings.translated:
She stood before Yumemi and the others in a pink jacket and a frilly miniskirt --
an outfit clearly out of place for walking through a forest.

strings.text:
顔はひどく憔悴しきっていて、あちこち砂や泥で汚れ
ていた。
strings.translated: Her face was haggard and worn, smudged here and there with dirt and mud.

strings.text:
夢美
「何でこんなところに……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Why are you in a place like this..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「近付かないでっ！」
夢美が駆け寄ろうとすると、アゲハの鋭い声が飛んだ。
strings.translated: When Yumemi moved to rush over, Ageha's sharp voice cut through the air.

strings.text:
激しい苛立ちと微かな恐怖を含んだような、そんな
感情に任せた叫びだった。
strings.translated:
It was a cry driven by raw emotion -- laced with intense irritation and a faint
undertone of fear.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「何でこんなところに？
　アンタに関わったからに決まってるじゃないっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Why am I in a place like this?
 It's obviously because I got involved with you!"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「これだから蟲使いなんて嫌なのよ。
　蟲なんてのがいるから、アタシの人生メチャクチャ
　になっちゃったのよっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"This is exactly why I hate Bug Users.
 Because Bugs exist, my whole life has been
 turned completely upside down!!"

strings.text:
夢美
「ち、ちょっと待って！　私、蟲使いじゃ――――」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"H-hold on! I'm not a Bug User --"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「似たようなもんでしょっ！
　お金もらって生活してるんだからっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Same difference!
 You're living off their money!!"

strings.text:
ヒステリックなアゲハの叫びに、夢美はビクンッと体
を震わせた。
strings.translated: Ageha's hysterical outburst made Yumemi flinch with a jolt.

strings.text:
確かに誰かから――現状では蟲使いが可能性が高いの
だが、毎月高額の金が振り込まれていたのは事実だ。
strings.translated:
It was true that someone -- most likely a Bug User, given the circumstances --
had been wiring large sums of money into her account every month.

strings.text:
そして、それを生活費にあてていたのも事実だし、
時折高い買い物ができたのもまた事実だった。
strings.translated:
And it was equally true that she had been using that money for living expenses,
and that it had occasionally allowed her to splurge on expensive things.

strings.text: だが、何故それをアゲハが知っているのか。
strings.translated: But why did Ageha know about that?

strings.text:
見たところ蟲使いでもないアゲハが何故知っており、
何故その部分に怒りを撒き散らしているのか……。
strings.translated:
Why would Ageha, who wasn't even a Bug User, know about it -- and why was
she directing her anger at that particular point...?

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ほんっとに……こんな仕事請けるんじゃなかった
　わ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I really... should never have taken this job."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アタシはただ、アンタの身辺調査すれば良かっただ
　けよ！？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"All I was supposed to do was investigate your background!"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アンタが蟲持ってるかどうか、そのへんをちょっと
　調べれば良かっただけっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Just look into whether or not you had a Bug -- that's all I was supposed to do!!"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「蟲使いに誘拐とか監禁とか、そんなことされる覚え
　ないわっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I never signed up to be kidnapped or held captive by a Bug User!!"

strings.text:
アゲハの口から飛び出る言葉は不可解なものばかり
だったが、話しているうちに一つだけ分かってきた
ことがあった。
strings.translated:
The words spilling from Ageha's mouth were nothing but bewildering -- but as
she kept talking, one thing gradually became clear.

strings.text: それは、見た目以上にアゲハがまいっていること……。
strings.translated:
That was just how badly Ageha was falling apart -- even more than her appearance
suggested.

strings.text:
誘拐、そして監禁された影響なのか、全身から疲労が
滲み出ていた。
strings.translated:
Perhaps from being kidnapped and held captive, exhaustion was
seeping from every inch of her body.

strings.text:
こうして突然自らのことを暴露しているのも、精神が
追い詰められたが故の結果だろう。
strings.translated:
The fact that she was suddenly blurting out her own secrets like this was no doubt
the result of being pushed to her mental limit.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「もう嫌っ！　帰りたいっ！！
　アタシの家に帰してよぉっ！！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I can't take this anymore! I want to go home!
 Let me go back to my home!!"

strings.text:
頭を振ってその場に座り込むアゲハに、夢美はすぐに
手を差し伸べることができなかった。
strings.translated:
As Ageha shook her head and sank to the ground where she stood, Yumemi
couldn't bring herself to reach out to her right away.

strings.text:
自分にその資格があるのかどうか、判断することがで
きなかった……。
strings.translated: She couldn't decide whether she had the right to do so...

strings.text:
夢美
「アゲハちゃん……一緒にここから出よう」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ageha-chan... let's get out of here together."

strings.text:
夢美が手を差し伸べると、アゲハが驚いたように顔を
上げた。
strings.translated: When Yumemi reached out her hand, Ageha looked up with a startled expression.

strings.text:
瞳は涙で滲んでいて、精神的にどれだけ追い詰められ
ていたかが分かる。
strings.translated: Her eyes were blurred with tears, making it plain just how deeply she had been driven to the edge.

strings.text:
とてもではないが、こんな状態のアゲハを一人残して
先に進むことなどできるはずもなかった。
strings.translated: There was simply no way Yumemi could leave Ageha behind in this state and press on alone.

strings.text:
差し出された夢美の手を、アゲハは今にも泣き出しそ
うな顔で見つめていた。
strings.translated: Ageha stared at Yumemi's outstretched hand with a face on the verge of tears.

strings.text:
そこには、微かな安堵の色さえ浮かび、地面に着いて
いた右手がゆっくりと持ち上がってくる。
strings.translated: A faint trace of relief even flickered there, and her right hand, which had been resting on the ground, slowly began to lift.

strings.text:
刹那、夢美は小さく口元に笑みを浮かべたが、二人の
指先が触れるか否かというところで、突然アゲハが手
を引っ込めた。
strings.translated: For just a moment, a small smile touched Yumemi's lips -- but at the very instant their fingertips were about to meet, Ageha suddenly pulled her hand back.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「じ、冗談じゃないわよ……ッ！」

アゲハ
「なんでアタシが、蟲使い側の奴なんかに助けられな
　きゃなんないのよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Why the hell should I have to be saved by someone on the Bug Users' side?"

strings.text:
夢美
「別に……蟲使い側ってわけじゃ…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It's not like I'm... on the Bug Users' side or anything..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アタシはねぇ、蟲のせいで散々な目に遭ったのよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I've been through hell because of Bugs, you know."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「蟲なんて生き物がいたから、普通の生活ができなく
　なったのよっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"It's because things like Bugs exist that I can't live a normal life anymore!"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アンタには分かんないでしょうね。
　蟲に人生狂わされたアタシの気持ちなんて」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You wouldn't understand, would you.
What it feels like to have your life ruined by Bugs."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「蟲使いじゃなくても、アイツらに保護されて甘えた
　生活送ってただけで十分敵よっ！！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Even if you're not a Bug User yourself, just being sheltered by them and living off their charity is more than enough to make you my enemy!!!"

strings.text:
最後は悲鳴混じりの声で叫んで、アゲハが目から涙を
迸らせる。
strings.translated: Her final words came out as a scream, and tears burst from Ageha's eyes.

strings.text:
そこには、憎悪や殺意といった感情がありありと浮か
んでいた。
strings.translated: In them, emotions like hatred and murderous intent were written plain as day.

strings.text:
夢美
「それでも、ここに一人でいると危ないよ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Even so... it's dangerous to stay here alone."

strings.text: 自分からさらに手を伸ばして、アゲハの手を掴む。
strings.translated: Yumemi reached out further on her own and grabbed Ageha's hand.

strings.text:
暴れるか怒られるかすると思ったが、意外にもアゲハ
は無抵抗だった。
strings.translated: She had expected her to struggle or lash out, but Ageha offered no resistance whatsoever.

strings.text:
まるで、言いたい事を全て言って、全身から力が抜け
てしまったような雰囲気だった。
strings.translated: It was as though she had said everything she needed to say, and all the strength had drained from her body.

strings.text:
夢美が手を引くと、それに合わせてアゲハが立ち上が
る。
strings.translated: When Yumemi pulled her hand, Ageha rose to her feet in kind.

strings.text:
