strings.text:
既に夢美の決意が固いことを感じ取ったのか、優斗が
辛そうな表情を浮かべる。
strings.translated: Perhaps sensing that Yumemi's resolve was already set, Yuuto's expression turned pained.

strings.text: 言いたい事は、何となく伝わってきた。
strings.translated: What he wanted to say -- she could more or less feel it without being told.

strings.text:
夢美
「もう一度森に行って、私に何ができるのか……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Going back into that forest again... what could I even do..."

strings.text:
夢美
「何もできないどころか、無駄に死ぬだけなんじゃな
　いかって、そんな風にも考えました」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I even thought that maybe I wouldn't just be useless -- I'd end up dying for nothing."

strings.text:
夢美
「でも、今のままじゃ誰もあのコを助けてくれない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But the way things are now, no one is going to save that child."

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲使いも、ここの人達も、あのコのことを珍しい蟲
　くらいにしか考えてない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"The Bug Users, the people here -- they all see that child as nothing more than some rare Bug."

strings.text:
夢美
「その事がよく分かったら、だから……せめて私が
　行ってあげないと…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Once I understood that clearly... that's why... at the very least, I have to be the one to go..."

strings.text:
夢美
「優斗さんはダメです」
優斗の言葉を遮るように言って、夢美が首を横に振る。
strings.translated: Yumemi shook her head, cutting off Yuuto's words.

strings.text:
夢美
「気持ちは嬉しいけど、あの森は今、本当に危険な
　場所になってるから……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm glad you feel that way, but that forest has become a truly dangerous place right now..."

strings.text:
優斗
「だったら、君だって……」

夢美
「だから、あのコを見つけたら、すぐに逃げ帰って来
　るつもりです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That's why, once I find that child, I intend to turn right around and run back."

strings.text:
夢美
「私だって、できる事ってそのくらいしかないから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That's about all I'm capable of doing anyway."

strings.text:
優斗
「……俺は、それ以上に何もできないってことか」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"...So I can do even less than that, huh."

strings.text: 優斗の悔しさが、肌に染み込むようにして感じられた。
strings.translated: Yuuto's frustration seeped into her skin like something she could feel.

strings.text:
夢美
「大丈夫です。ちゃんと帰ってきますから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"It'll be fine. I'll come back safely."

strings.text:
夢美
「帰って来られたら、またお店に寄って下さいね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"When I do, stop by the shop again, okay?"

strings.text:
夢美
「まあ、無断欠勤続いてるから、とっくにクビになっ
　てるかもしれないけど」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Though, I've been absent without notice for so long, I might already be fired."

strings.text:
優斗
「その時は、俺が事情を説明するよ。
　夢美ちゃんがどんなに大変な目に遭ってたかって」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"In that case, I'll explain everything for you.
Just how much you've been through."

strings.text:
夢美
「はい、お願いします」

優斗
「いや、大したことじゃないんだけど……今みたいな
　ところで、俺は役に立てばいいのかなって」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"No, it's nothing major... I was just thinking, maybe this is where I can be useful."

strings.text:
優斗
「蟲とか、蟲使いとか、そういうのに対しては無力で
　も、全然夢美ちゃんの役に立てる場所がないってわ
　けじゃないのかなって……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Even if I'm powerless against Bugs and Bug Users and all of that -- it doesn't mean there's nowhere I can be of help to you, Yumemi-chan..."

strings.text: そして、夢美はパッと笑顔を浮かべた。
strings.translated: Then, Yumemi's face broke into a bright smile.

strings.text:
夢美
「それはそうですよ。
　私なんて、ずっと誰かに頼りっぱなしでしたから」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Of course it is.
 I've always been relying on someone, after all."

strings.text:
夢美
「帰って来たら、優斗さんに頼りたいこと……いっぱ
　いあります」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"When I get back, there are so many things...
 I want to rely on you for."

strings.text: しっかりと頷いて、優斗もまた笑顔を浮かべる。
strings.translated: He nodded firmly, and Yuuto's face broke into a smile as well.

strings.text:
そして、そっと夢美の唇にキスをしたあと、そのまま
華奢な体を抱き締めてきた。
strings.translated: After gently pressing a kiss to Yumemi's lips, he pulled her slender body into his arms.

strings.text:
優斗
「待ってるから……無事で……………………」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I'll be waiting... so come back safe..."

strings.text:
こういう時に、何もできない事の悔しさからか、優斗
の声が微かに震えていた。
strings.translated: Perhaps from the frustration of being powerless at a time like this, Yuuto's voice trembled faintly.

strings.text:
夢美の体を強く抱き締めながら、もう一度祈るように
呟いた。
strings.translated: Holding Yumemi's body tightly, he murmured once more, as if in prayer.

strings.text:
夢美
「必ず……帰ってきます…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I will... I promise I'll come back..."

strings.text: 不安に満ちた優斗とは対照的に、夢美は力強く答えた。
strings.translated: In contrast to Yuuto, who was filled with anxiety, Yumemi answered with strength in her voice.

strings.text:
そうする事で、少しでも優斗が安心できるようにと、
同じように抱き締め返した。
strings.translated: By doing so, hoping it might put Yuuto's heart at ease even a little, she held him back just as tightly.

strings.text: それが、今の夢美にできる精一杯のことだった……。
strings.translated: That was the most Yumemi could do for him right now...

strings.text:
真鈴ヶ崎までは、西が用意した自動車で送ってもらっ
た。
strings.translated: Nishi had arranged a car to take them back to Masuzugasaki.

strings.text:
高速道路を利用して三時間ほどの距離で、初めてあの
森がどこの場所にあったのかを知った。
strings.translated: It was about a three-hour drive via the highway -- and it was the first time she had learned just where that forest had actually been.

strings.text: だが、それもどうでもいい話。

自動車の中で、夢美は終始無言で、ただ後ろに流れる
景色を眺めていた。
strings.translated: Inside the car, Yumemi sat in silence the entire time, watching the scenery flow past behind them.

strings.text:
そうする事でしか、今の自分を保つことはできなかっ
た……。
strings.translated: It was the only way she could hold herself together right now...

strings.text:
夢美
「ありがとうございました」
優斗とともに自動車を降りて、運転手に頭を下げる。
strings.translated: She stepped out of the car alongside Yuuto and bowed her head to the driver.

strings.text:
初老の優しい人物で、どうやら夢美達の事情はあまり
知らないらしく、終始自分の身の上話で盛り上がって
いた。
strings.translated: He was a kind older man who seemed to know little of their circumstances, and had spent the entire ride cheerfully sharing stories about his own life.

strings.text:
走り去って行く自動車を見送ったあと、ふと優斗と
視線を合わせる。
strings.translated: After seeing the car drive away, she happened to meet Yuuto's gaze.

strings.text:
自分達の住む町に帰ってきたはずなのに、互いにどこ
か表情は晴れなかった。
strings.translated: Even though they had returned to the town they called home, neither of them could quite manage a clear expression.

strings.text:
優斗
「とりあえず、家に帰ろうか」
言葉数も少なく、自宅のある方向へ歩き始める。
strings.translated: With few words between them, they began walking in the direction of their homes.

strings.text:
頭上はすがすがしいくらいの青空で、このまま散歩で
もしたいくらいだった。
strings.translated: The sky overhead was a refreshingly clear blue -- the kind of day that made you want to take a leisurely stroll.

strings.text:
だが、そんな気分になれないのは、きっと今まで傍に
いた存在がいないからだろう。
strings.translated: But the reason she couldn't feel that way was surely because someone who had always been by her side was no longer there.

strings.text:
大切なものを失ったと、今、ひしひしと感じているか
らだろう。
strings.translated: Because she could feel it now, keenly -- that she had lost something precious.

strings.text:
夢美
「私、ひどい母親ですよね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm a terrible mother, aren't I."

strings.text:
夢美
「あのコのこと……見捨てちゃった……」
仕方ないよ、と言外に聞こえた。
strings.translated: There was nothing you could have done -- she could hear it, unspoken.
And it was true: there was nothing she could have done.

strings.text:
あの森に戻ったところで、夢美に何ができるというの
か。
strings.translated: Even if she went back to that forest, what could Yumemi possibly do?

strings.text:
西達の邪魔になって、最悪は自分の命を落としてしま
うかもしれない。
strings.translated: She would only get in Nishi and the others' way, and at worst, she might lose her own life.

strings.text: そう考えると、身が竦んだ。
strings.translated: When she thought of it that way, she shuddered.

strings.text:
優斗
「あ、俺、こっちだから」

ロクに会話もないままに、いつの間にか優斗との分か
れ道に差し掛かっていた。
strings.translated: Without having exchanged much of anything, they had somehow already reached the fork where their paths diverged.

strings.text: 夢美の住んでいたマンションも、もう目と鼻の先だ。
strings.translated: The apartment building where Yumemi lived was already right before her eyes.

strings.text:
もっとも、今後も住めるとは思えないため、とりあえ
ず必要な荷物をまとめに戻るだけなのだが……。
strings.translated: Though she couldn't imagine she would be able to go on living there -- for now, she was only going back to gather the things she needed...

strings.text:
夢美
「それじゃあ……えっと……お疲れ様でした」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well then... um... thank you for everything."

strings.text:
優斗
「うん、夢美ちゃんも……」

優斗にぺこりと頭を下げて、マンションへの道のりを
歩き出す。
strings.translated: She gave Yuuto a small bow and started down the path toward the apartment.

strings.text:
帰るのは合蟲人間の襲撃を受けて以来のため、果たし
て何日ぶりになるのか……。
strings.translated: It had been since the attack by the Bug-fused humans that she had last returned -- she couldn't even say how many days it had been...

strings.text:
――と、記憶の中で蟲とともに過ごした日々が思い起
こされて、自然と目に涙が溜まってきた。
strings.translated: Memories of the days she had spent with the Bug came flooding back to her, and tears welled up in her eyes unbidden.
She would never see it again.

strings.text:
西は「連絡する」と言っていたが、何となくその連絡
は来ないような気がした。
strings.translated: Nishi had said he would "be in touch," but somehow she had a feeling that call would never come.

strings.text:
たとえ蟲が見つかっても、夢美がその事実を知ること
はないように思えてならなかった。
strings.translated: Even if the Bug were found, she couldn't shake the feeling that Yumemi would never be told of it.

strings.text: 口元を押さえて、嗚咽を堪える。
strings.translated: She pressed her hand over her mouth, stifling a sob.

strings.text:
マンションに近付くにつれ足が重くなり、視界が涙で
滲んだ。
strings.translated: With every step closer to the apartment, her legs grew heavier, and her vision blurred with tears.

strings.text: 角を曲がったところで、膝を着いて泣き崩れる。
strings.translated: She turned the corner and collapsed to her knees, breaking down in tears.

strings.text:
後悔が胸を突き刺し、頭の中はこの五年間の蟲との
思い出で満たされた。
strings.translated: Regret pierced her chest, and her mind filled with memories of the five years she had spent with the Bug.

strings.text:
たぶん、きっと、これから自分の人生は穏やかなもの
になるだろう。
strings.translated: Probably, surely -- from here on, her life would become a peaceful one.

strings.text:
蟲がいなければ、蟲使いが恐れていた蟲姫ではなくな
るし、西が夢美を帰したのも、これ以上の利用価値は
ないと判断したからだ。
strings.translated: Without the Bug, she would no longer be the Bug Princess that the Bug Users feared, and Nishi had sent Yumemi home because he had determined she had no further use to him.

strings.text:
自分の『子』を失って、初めて夢美は、渇望していた
人間の生活を取り戻せたような気がした。
strings.translated: Having lost her own "child," Yumemi felt, for the first time, as though she had finally reclaimed the ordinary human life she had so desperately longed for.

strings.text: 空は青く、流れる雲は高い。
strings.translated: The sky was blue, and the drifting clouds hung high above.

strings.text:
夢美は、涙に濡れた顔を上げながら、ただ蟲が無事で
あることを祈った。
strings.translated: Lifting her tear-streaked face, Yumemi simply prayed that the Bug was safe somewhere.

strings.text: あの蟲が幸せに暮らせる処を、与えてほしいと思った。
strings.translated: She just wanted her Bug to be given a place where it could live happily.

strings.text:
我が子へと向けた儚い想いは、風に乗って空へと流れ
ていった……。
strings.translated: That fleeting wish, directed toward her own child, drifted up into the sky on the wind......

strings.text:
再び足を踏み入れた森は、確固たる意思を持って夢美
達を拒絶しているように感じられた。
strings.translated: The forest they had stepped into seemed to reject Yumemi and the others with a firm and unyielding will.

strings.text:
森に漂う空気も、殺意を向けてくる蟲達も、今まで
歩いて来た森のそれとは大きく違う。
strings.translated: The air drifting through the forest, and the Bugs bearing killing intent toward them -- both were vastly different from anything they had encountered in the forest up until now.

strings.text:
そんな中、森の入り口に立った夢美は、先遣隊として
散っていく合蟲人間達の背中を見つめていた。
strings.translated: Amid all of this, Yumemi stood at the forest's entrance, watching the backs of the Bug-fused humans as they scattered ahead as a vanguard.

strings.text: 与えられた任務は森に隠れている蟲使い達の排除。
strings.translated: The mission assigned to them: eliminate the Bug Users hiding in the forest.

strings.text:
まさか自分が、合蟲人間と行動する時が来るとは夢に
も思わなかったが、今は贅沢を言っていられる時では
ない。
strings.translated: She never could have dreamed that the day would come when she would be acting alongside Bug-fused humans -- but this was no time to be making complaints.

strings.text:
逸る気持ちを抑えていると、隣に立ったユーリアが
静かな声で尋ねてきた。
strings.translated: As she held back her restless, impatient feelings, Yulia, standing beside her, asked in a quiet voice.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「貴女の蟲の気配は感じますか？」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Can you sense your Bug's presence?"

strings.text: 意識を集中させて、周囲の蟲の気配を感じ取る。
strings.translated: She focused her consciousness and tried to sense the presence of the Bugs around her.

strings.text:
だが、既に戦闘が始まっているところもあるのか、
様々な気配が入り乱れており、とても一匹の蟲だけ
を探せるような状況ではなかった。
strings.translated: But fighting seemed to have broken out in places already; countless presences were tangled together, and it was far from a situation where she could pick out a single Bug.

strings.text:
夢美
「色々なものの気配が多すぎて、分かりません」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"There are too many presences of too many things -- I can't tell."

strings.text:
多少は何かを期待していたのか、ユーリアがやや落胆
した様子でつぶやく。
strings.translated: As if she had been hoping for something, Yulia murmured with a look of faint disappointment.

strings.text:
だが、すぐに元の雰囲気に戻ると、今度はもう一人の
少女――――
strings.translated: But she quickly returned to her usual composure, and this time turned toward the other girl --

strings.text:
――美弥香の友人であり護衛者でもある唯のほうを
向いて言った。
strings.translated: -- Yui, who was both a friend and a bodyguard to Miyaka, and spoke.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「佐々原さんは、櫻井さんとともに行動して下さい。
　合蟲人間が放たれているとは言え、蟲使いに襲われ
　る危険性は十分にあります」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Sasahara-san, please stay with Sakurai-san.
 Even with the Bug-fused humans deployed, there is still ample risk
 of being attacked by Bug Users."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「ただし、蟲使いの次期長・レンと遭遇した場合は、
　何を差し置いてでも逃げて下さい」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"However, should you encounter Ren -- the next head of the Bug Users -- please flee, above all else."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「この森にいる蟲使いの中で、もっとも強いのは
　彼でしょうから」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"He is likely the strongest among the Bug Users in this forest."

strings.text:
夢美
「そんなに強いんだ……」

ユーリア
「現存する蟲使いの中でも、彼の能力は秀でていると
　言われています」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Even among the Bug Users currently alive, his abilities are said to be exceptional."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「十匹以上の蟲を同時に扱えるとの情報もありますし、
　おそらく普通の人間では太刀打ちできないでしょ
　う」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"There are also reports that he can control more than ten Bugs simultaneously -- an ordinary human would likely stand no chance against him."

strings.text:
夢美
「それじゃあ、合蟲人間で……？」

ユーリア
「いえ、彼の相手は私がします」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"No -- I will handle him myself."

strings.text:
さらりと言うユーリアの発言に、夢美は目を丸くして
驚いた。
strings.translated: Yumemi's eyes went wide with surprise at Yulia's offhand remark.

strings.text:
果たしてそんな事が可能なのかと問おうとした時、
突如森に変化が生じる。
strings.translated: Just as she was about to ask whether such a thing was even possible, a sudden change swept through the forest.

strings.text:
張り詰めていた空気がパンッと音を立てたように弾け、
森全体を覆っていた不思議な力が消え去った。
strings.translated: The taut air seemed to burst with a sharp crack, and the strange power that had blanketed the entire forest vanished.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「結界が消えたようです」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"It appears the barrier has dissolved."

strings.text:
唯
「この森って人の感覚を狂わせる結界があるらしくて、
　それを壊すために、先に合蟲人間……でしたっけ？
　あの人達を送り込んだらしいんです」
strings.translated:
Yui
"Apparently there's a barrier in this forest that messes with people's senses,
 and to break it, they sent in those Bug-fused humans... was that what they were called?
 That's what it sounds like."

strings.text:
夢美
「結界って壊せるものなんだ」

ユーリア
「蟲使いの結界の張り方は、森の樹に呪式印を刻み込
　む方法です」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"The way Bug Users set up barriers is by carving curse-seal markings into the trees of the forest."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「森の大きさと結界の内容さえ分かっていれば、どこ
　に呪式印が刻まれているのかは、だいたい想像する
　ことができます」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"As long as you know the size of the forest and the nature of the barrier, you can more or less
 figure out where the curse-seal markings have been carved."

strings.text:
ユーリアの言葉に、夢美は蟲使いが神武に対して強硬
な姿勢を取っていた理由が分かった気がした。
strings.translated: Hearing Yulia's words, Yumemi felt she finally understood why the Bug Users had taken such a hard stance against Jinmu.

strings.text:
今、簡単に説明された結界の張り方など、おそらくは
蟲使いの者でなければ知っていてはいけない事なのだ
ろう。
strings.translated: What had just been so casually explained -- the method of setting up a barrier -- was likely something only a Bug User was supposed to know.

strings.text:
そうでなければ、こうも簡単に森の結界が消されるな
どあり得ないはずだ。
strings.translated: Otherwise, there was no way the forest's barrier could have been dispelled so easily.

strings.text:
ユーリアの説明が終わった直後に、森の結界が復活し
た気配が感じられた。
strings.translated: The moment Yulia finished her explanation, they sensed the forest's barrier spring back to life.

strings.text:
そういったものを感じ取る力のない唯だけが、二人の
変化を見てぽかんとした表情を浮かべている。
strings.translated: Only Yui, who lacked the ability to perceive such things, stood there with a blank look on her face, watching the other two react.

strings.text:
ユーリアは黙って森を見つめていたが、やがて溜息混
じりに呟いた。
strings.translated: Yulia stared silently into the forest, then eventually murmured with a sigh.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「どうやら、結界は一つだけではなかったようです
　ね」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"It seems there was more than one barrier."

strings.text:
夢美
「もう一つ……別のがあった…………？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"There was another one... a different one...?"

strings.text: その時、遠くのほうから激しい爆音が響き渡った。
strings.translated: Just then, a tremendous explosion echoed from somewhere in the distance.

strings.text:
三人の視線がその方向へ向けられ、立ち昇る爆煙を
確認する。
strings.translated: All three turned their gazes in that direction and confirmed the rising column of smoke.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「あちらから来たようですね」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"It appears he came from over there."

strings.text: 爆発のあった先からレンが歩いてくる。
strings.translated: Ren came walking from the direction of the explosion.

strings.text:
一体何匹の合蟲人間を倒したのか、全身はどす黒い血
や肉片で汚れきっていた。
strings.translated: However many Bug-fused humans he had cut down, his entire body was caked in dark, blackened blood and scraps of flesh.

strings.text: 夢美の脳裏に、不吉な予感がよぎる。
strings.translated: A dark premonition flashed through Yumemi's mind.

strings.text: レンが今、ここにいるという事は、あの蟲は――――
strings.translated: The fact that Ren was here now meant that the Bug was --

strings.text:
ユーリア
「二人とも先に行って下さい。
　彼は私が相手をします」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"Both of you, go on ahead.
 I will deal with him."

strings.text: そう言って、ユーリアがレンのほうへ歩いていく。
strings.translated: Saying that, Yulia walked toward Ren.

strings.text:
だが、二人の戦いが始まる前に、夢美は蟲のことを
確認しておかなければならなかった。
strings.translated: But before their battle could begin, Yumemi had to confirm what had become of the Bug.

strings.text:
夢美
「レンッ！　あの蟲は……あのコはどうしたの！？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ren! The Bug... what did you do with her!?"

strings.text:
レン
「始末しました。……次は貴女です」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I disposed of it. ...You are next."

strings.text: レンが姿を現した瞬間から、心の片隅で覚悟したこと。
strings.translated: It was something she had braced herself for in a corner of her heart the moment Ren appeared.

strings.text:
だが、そう言われたからといって、蟲の生存を諦める
ことはできなかった。
strings.translated: But even hearing those words, she could not bring herself to give up hope that the Bug was still alive.

strings.text:
あの蟲は、この森のどこかで必ず生きていると、今は
信じたかった。
strings.translated: She wanted to believe, right now, that the Bug was alive somewhere in this forest.

strings.text:
唯
「夢美さん、行きましょう」
力強く答えて、夢美と唯は森へと走り出した。
strings.translated: Answering with resolve, Yumemi and Yui broke into a run toward the forest.

strings.text:
じっと見つめてくるレンの視線を背中に受けながら、
森の深部へと走って行ったのだった……。
strings.translated: With Ren's unwavering gaze boring into their backs, they ran deeper and deeper into the forest...

strings.text:
蟲使い装束に着替え、ホテルの外に出たところで、
夢美は背後から声を掛けられた。
strings.translated: Having changed into her Bug User garb and stepped outside the hotel, Yumemi was called out to from behind.

strings.text:
振り返った先にいたのは、美弥香と一緒にＡｎｚＵに
来てくれた唯だった。
strings.translated: The one standing there when she turned around was Yui -- the same Yui who had come to AnzU together with Miyaka.

strings.text:
以前と同じ可愛らしい笑顔で、ぺこりと頭を下げてく
る。
strings.translated: With the same sweet smile as before, she gave a small bow.

strings.text:
唯
「お久しぶりです。
　こんな形で再会できるなんて、全然思ってもみませ
　んでした」
strings.translated:
Yui
"It's been a while.
 I never imagined we'd meet again like this."

strings.text:
夢美
「私のほうこそ……また会えて嬉しいです」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Same here... I'm so glad to see you again."

strings.text:
唯
「今回は……その、さっきユーリアさんから聞いたん
　ですけど、本当に大変でしたね」
strings.translated:
Yui
"This time around... well, I just heard from Yulia-san a little while ago, but you've really been through a lot, haven't you."

strings.text:
どういう表情にすれば良いのか分からなかったのだろ
う、唯が苦笑いを浮かべながら言う。
strings.translated: Not quite sure what expression to make, Yui said it with a wry smile.

strings.text:
おおまかな夢美の過去、そして今の夢美の目的につい
ては知っているようで話はスムーズだった。
strings.translated: She seemed to already know the broad strokes of Yumemi's past and her current goal, so the conversation flowed smoothly.

strings.text:
唯
「それが、蟲使いの服なんですか？」
strings.translated:
Yui
"Is that... the outfit of a Bug User?"

strings.text:
夢美
「そう、らしいです。……外を歩くにはちょっとアレ
　なデザインですけど」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yeah, apparently so. ...The design is a little, um,
 something, for walking around outside."

strings.text:
唯
「スカート、短いですね。
　……ちょっと見えてません？」
strings.translated:
Yui
"That skirt is short.
 ...Isn't it a little exposed?"

strings.text:
夢美
「森までは車で送ってもらえるらしいから、もう我慢
　することにしました」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm getting a ride to the forest, so I've decided
 to just put up with it."

Yui
"Ah, so you're putting up with it."

strings.text:
夢美
「だってここスリット入ってるし……歩くと見えます
　よね？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Well, it has a slit in it... you can see things
 when I walk, right?"

Yui
"Just a little... a little peek..."

strings.text:
ユーリア
「何がチラッとなのですか？」

軽くスカートの裾をめくったりしながら話していると、
いつの間にか真正面に立っていたユーリアに話しかけ
られた。
strings.translated:
They were talking while Yumemi idly lifted the hem of her skirt a little,
when Yulia, who had somehow come to stand right in front of them,
spoke up.

strings.text:
別にやましい事をしていたわけではないのだが、夢美
も唯も悲鳴を上げて後ずさりしてしまう。
strings.translated:
It wasn't as though they had been doing anything shameful, but both Yumemi
and Yui let out a shriek and stumbled backward.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「……声を掛けてはいけないお話でしたか？」
strings.translated:
Yulia
"...Was that a conversation I should not have interrupted?"

strings.text:
唯
「全然そんな事ないですよっ！？」

二人で首を横に振りながら、ごまかすように苦笑いを
浮かべる。
strings.translated: The two of them shook their heads in unison, forcing awkward smiles to cover their embarrassment.

strings.text:
唯
「と、とにかくっ！　美弥香ちゃんも、夢美さんの
　蟲さんも、必ず見つけ出しましょうねっ！」
strings.translated:
Yui
"A-anyway! We'll definitely find Miyaka-chan and Yumemi-san's
 Bug, no matter what!"

strings.text:
夢美
「はい、ありがとうございますっ！」

やけに気合いの入った二人に、ユーリアが不思議そう
に首を傾げる。
strings.translated: Yulia tilted her head curiously at the two of them and their oddly fierce determination.

strings.text:
ここまでしてごまかす必要のある話だったのかと、
夢美は内心自問したが、言葉そのものに嘘はない。
strings.translated: Yumemi wondered inwardly whether the situation had really warranted that much covering up -- but there was no lie in the words themselves.

strings.text:
励ますような笑顔を向けてくる唯の存在が、今はとて
も心強かった。
strings.translated: The presence of Yui, smiling at her with an encouraging look, felt like a tremendous source of strength right now.

strings.text:
互いに話したい事はまだ多くあったが、今はそれだけ
で十分だった。
strings.translated: There was still much they each wanted to say to the other, but for now, that was enough.

strings.text:
ユーリア
「それでは、行きましょうか」

夢美
「よろしくお願いします」

ユーリアに案内されて、二人は森へと運んでくれる
自動車へと乗り込んだ。
strings.translated: Led by Yulia, the two of them climbed into the car that would carry them to the forest.

strings.text:
頭の中には、助け出すべき美弥香と、夢美の蟲のこと
だけが浮かんでいた……。
strings.translated: In her mind, only two things floated to the surface -- Miyaka, who had to be rescued, and Yumemi's Bug...

strings.text: 森の中は、無数の合蟲人間の死体に溢れていた。
strings.translated: Inside the forest, the ground was overflowing with the corpses of countless Bug-fused humans.

strings.text:
レン以外にも、戦いに慣れた蟲使いが何人かいるよう
で、一人で何体も倒すという善戦ぶりだ。
strings.translated: It seemed there were several Bug Users besides Ren who were accustomed to combat, each holding their own against multiple enemies at once.

strings.text:
だが、その一方で敗北した蟲使いの姿もよく見ること
ができた。
strings.translated: But at the same time, there were also plenty of Bug Users who had been defeated, and their fates were plain to see.

strings.text:
死んでいるのならまだマシなほうで、たまに合蟲人間
に犯されている女の蟲使いがいた。
strings.translated: Being dead would have been the better outcome -- here and there, female Bug Users were being violated by Bug-fused humans.

strings.text: それも三体、四体といった複数による輪姦だ。
strings.translated: And not by one, but by three, four at a time -- gang-raped by a crowd of them.

strings.text:
彼女達が死ぬまで犯されるのは、誰にも止められない
決定事項だった。
strings.translated: That these women would be violated until they died was a foregone conclusion that no one could stop.

strings.text:
唯
「神武が、こんなものを、作っていたなんて……」
strings.translated:
Yui
"To think that Jinmu... created something like this..."

strings.text:
森の中を駆けながら、唯はショックを受けたように
呟いていた。
strings.translated: Running through the forest, Yui murmured as though in shock.

strings.text:
敵とはいえ、同じ女である人間が犯されているのを、
ただ黙って見ている事しかできない自分に苛立つ。
strings.translated: Even if they were enemies, she was furious at herself for being able to do nothing but watch in silence as fellow women were violated.

strings.text:
それは夢美も全く同じ感覚で、力さえあれば犯されて
いる女を助けてやりたかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi felt exactly the same way -- if only she had the power, she would have wanted to save those women.

strings.text:
夢美
「あの人は……Ｄｒ．Ｗｅｓｔって人は、こうなるっ
　て分かってて、やったんですか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"That person... did Dr. West do this knowing
 it would turn out like this?"

strings.text:
唯
「私も、詳しいことは、分かりません」
strings.translated:
Yui
"I don't know the details either."

strings.text:
唯
「美弥香ちゃんから、噂程度に、聞いてはいましたけ
　ど……」
strings.translated:
Yui
"I had heard something about it from Miyaka-chan,
 but only as a rumor..."

strings.text:
走っていると、突然正面から羽虫のような蟲が襲い掛
かって来た。
strings.translated: As they ran, a Bug resembling a winged insect suddenly lunged at them from straight ahead.

strings.text:
間一髪の差で唯がそれを叩き落してくれたが、夢美だ
けなら確実にやられていただろう。
strings.translated: Yui knocked it away at the last possible moment, but had Yumemi been alone, she would certainly have been done for.

strings.text:
蟲の居場所は感知できるはずなのに、走っているうち
に、走ることに意識が向きすぎていた証拠だ。
strings.translated: She should have been able to sense the location of Bugs -- proof that while running, too much of her focus had shifted to the act of running itself.

strings.text:
夢美
「周りに蟲がいます。
　二匹……ううん、三匹…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"There are Bugs nearby.
 Two... no, three..."

strings.text:
茂みの中から襲い掛かって来た蟲を、夢美と唯が素早
くかわす。
strings.translated: Yumemi and Yui swiftly dodged the Bug that lunged at them from the bushes.

strings.text: 唯はまだ余裕があるが、夢美はこの時点で必死だった。
strings.translated: Yui still had composure to spare, but Yumemi was already fighting desperately just to keep up.

strings.text:
レンの扱う蟲ほどではないものの、襲って来る蟲の
攻撃は十分速い。
strings.translated: Not quite on the level of the Bugs Ren wielded, but the attacking Bugs were still plenty fast.

strings.text: かわすのが精一杯で、反撃の余裕など皆無だった。
strings.translated: Dodging was all she could manage -- there was no room to even think about fighting back.

strings.text:
唯
「どこかに隠れていて下さいっ！」

襲って来る蟲を叩き落としながら、唯が周囲を窺いな
がら叫ぶ。
strings.translated: Yui shouted, swatting down the Bugs that lunged at her while keeping watch on her surroundings.

strings.text:
動きは無駄がなく軽やかで、まるで踊るように次々と
蟲を撃退していた。
strings.translated: Her movements were fluid and effortless, dispatching one Bug after another as if performing a dance.

strings.text:
ここまで自分と唯の差をあまり意識していなかった
夢美だが、戦いというものに関しては大きな違いが
あった。
strings.translated: Yumemi hadn't been particularly conscious of the gap between herself and Yui until now, but when it came to combat, the difference was vast.
Yui was no stranger to combat.

strings.text: 夢美は戦い慣れていない。
それが、この場においての二人の決定的な差だ。
strings.translated: That was the decisive difference between them here and now.

strings.text:
どこかに隠れている蟲使いも唯のほうが強敵だと判断
したのか、徐々に攻撃を集中させ始めていた。
strings.translated: Perhaps the Bug User hiding somewhere had judged Yui to be the greater threat -- the attacks were gradually concentrating on her.

strings.text:
ハッキリとした殺意をその身に受けて、唯が突然走り
始めた。
strings.translated: Receiving a clear and unmistakable killing intent directed at her, Yui suddenly broke into a run.

strings.text: 目指すはある巨木の根元。
strings.translated: Her target: the base of a large tree.

strings.text:
それを阻止するかのように、無数の蟲が一気に襲い掛
かっていく。
strings.translated: As if to stop her, a swarm of countless Bugs surged forward all at once.

strings.text:
振り向きざまの唯の一撃は、今まで放ったどの攻撃よ
りも強力だった。
strings.translated: The blow Yui unleashed as she spun around was more powerful than any attack she had thrown before.

strings.text:
右腕を矢のように突き出した瞬間、固まって飛んでい
た羽虫型の蟲が、一気に撃ち落される。
strings.translated: The instant she thrust her right arm forward like an arrow, the cluster of winged Bugs flying in formation was knocked down all at once.

strings.text:
直接唯の手が触れていなくとも、右腕から伝わってく
る衝撃波で吹っ飛ばされたらしい。
strings.translated: Even without her hand making direct contact, the shockwave transmitted through her right arm had apparently blown them away.

strings.text: だが、夢美が確認できたのはそこまでだった。
strings.translated: But that was as much as Yumemi was able to confirm.

strings.text:
夢美
「えっ！？　こっちにも！！？」

戦闘の気配を察したのか、別の蟲使いが近付いている
気配がした。
strings.translated: Perhaps sensing the signs of battle, she felt the presence of another Bug User drawing near.

strings.text: 殺意は明らかに夢美に向けられている。
strings.translated: The killing intent was unmistakably directed at Yumemi.

strings.text:
唯のほうに逃げようかとも思ったが、それでは無駄に
敵を増やすだけにしかならない。
strings.translated: She considered fleeing toward Yui, but that would only serve to bring more enemies upon her needlessly.

strings.text:
夢美にできる事と言えば、自分の力でこの蟲使いを
振り切ることだった。
strings.translated: What Yumemi could do was shake off this Bug User on her own.

strings.text:
突然、真上から液状の蟲が落ちてきて、夢美は慌てて
その場から退いた。
strings.translated: Suddenly, a liquid-form Bug dropped from directly above, and Yumemi scrambled out of the way.

strings.text:
幸いにしてかする事もなく難を逃れたが、当たってい
れば確実に捕獲されていた。
strings.translated: Fortunately she escaped without so much as a graze, but had it hit her, she would certainly have been captured.

strings.text:
夢美
「唯さんっ！　もう一人来ましたっ！
　こっちのほうは私が何とかしてみますっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yui-san! Another one came!
 I'll try to handle this one myself!!"

strings.text:
果たして、唯に届いたかどうか分からないが、夢美は
そう叫んで森を走り始めた。
strings.translated: Whether or not it reached Yui she couldn't tell, but Yumemi shouted those words and began running through the forest.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ！！」

夢美が逃亡を開始すると、蟲使いは上手く誘いに乗っ
てきてくれた。
strings.translated: Once Yumemi began her flight, the Bug User took the bait nicely.

strings.text:
森の木々の間隙を飛び交いながら、胴体の長いトンボ
のような蟲を撃ち出して来る。
strings.translated: Weaving between the trees, they launched long-bodied dragonfly-like Bugs at her.

strings.text:
これといって特徴のある攻撃はして来ないが、人間の
足で振り切れるような相手ではなかった。
strings.translated: The attacks weren't particularly distinctive, but this was not an opponent she could shake off on foot.

strings.text:
背後から襲ってきた蟲が、夢美の背後から突っ込んで
来る。
strings.translated: A Bug came diving at Yumemi from behind.

strings.text:
かろうじて身を屈めて避けたものの、すぐさま旋回し
て攻撃し直して来た。
strings.translated: She barely managed to duck and avoid it, but it immediately circled back and attacked again.

strings.text: 右側に跳んで、頭から藪の中に突っ込む。
strings.translated: She leaped to the right and plunged headfirst into a thicket.

strings.text:
感覚で蟲の動きを感じ取れるからこそ、何とか夢美の
足でも逃げることができていた。
strings.translated: It was only because she could sense the Bugs' movements by instinct that she was somehow able to keep fleeing on her own two feet.

strings.text:
ただ、反撃する手段がないため、やがて直撃を受けて
しまうのは目に見えている。
strings.translated: However, with no means of fighting back, it was plain to see that she would eventually take a direct hit.

strings.text:
夢美は、坂道を全力で駆け上がりながら、何か方法は
ないかと考えた。
strings.translated: Yumemi sprinted up the slope with all her might, racking her brain for any possible solution.

strings.text:
夢美
「ああ、もうっ！　しつこいっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ugh, enough already! You just don't quit!!"

strings.text:
唯の負担にならないよう一人引き受けたつもりだが、
なかなか振り切ることができない。
strings.translated: She had taken this one on alone so as not to burden Yui, but she couldn't seem to shake it off.

strings.text:
木々の隙間を縫うように走れば何とかなるかと思った
が、相手は執拗に追って来ていた。
strings.translated: She had thought weaving through the gaps between the trees might do the trick, but her pursuer followed with relentless persistence.

strings.text:
夢美
「せめてアレがいてくれたら……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"If only that thing were here..."

strings.text: 頭の中に、合蟲人間の姿が浮かぶ。
strings.translated: The image of the Bug-fused humans surfaced in her mind.

strings.text:
夢美にとって、決して好ましい生物ではなかったが、
今は味方と言えば味方のはずだった。
strings.translated: It was by no means a creature she found agreeable, but right now it was supposed to be on her side.

strings.text:
地面から飛び出ていた木の根に足を取られ、前のめり
に倒れ込む。
strings.translated: Her foot caught on a tree root jutting from the ground, and she pitched forward and fell.

strings.text:
すぐに立ち上がろうとしたが、頭上では既に蟲が旋回
していた。
strings.translated: She tried to get up immediately, but the Bug was already circling overhead.

strings.text: そう思った夢美は、頭を庇うように背中を丸め込んだ。
strings.translated: Thinking that, Yumemi curled her back inward to shield her head.

strings.text:
考えての行動というよりも、反射によるところが大き
い。
strings.translated: It was less a calculated move and more a matter of pure reflex.

strings.text:
せめて、あまり痛くありませんようにと祈ったが、
何故だか蟲の攻撃はなかなかやって来なかった。
strings.translated: She prayed it wouldn't hurt too much at least -- but for some reason, the Bug's attack never came.

strings.text:
夢美
「うっ……ごほっ、ごほっ…………」

おそるおそる顔を上げようとした時、急に胸の奥が
締め付けられるように痛み始めた。
strings.translated: Just as she cautiously tried to lift her face, a sudden pain gripped her deep in her chest.

strings.text:
むせ返るようにして咳が出て、内臓がピリピリと痙攣
したような感覚がする。
strings.translated: A choking cough welled up, and she felt her insides twitch and spasm.

strings.text:
――と、ボトッと蟲が地面に落ち、夢美と同じように
体を痺れさせていた。
strings.translated: -- Then, with a thud, the Bug dropped to the ground, its body convulsing just like hers.

strings.text:
？？？
「こっち！　早く来なさいよっ！！」
誰かが腕を引いて、夢美を強引に立ち上がらせる。
strings.translated: Someone grabbed her arm and yanked Yumemi forcibly to her feet.

strings.text:
顔を上げると何故だかアゲハがいて、口元をハンカチ
で覆っていた。
strings.translated: When she looked up, Ageha was there for some reason, her mouth covered with a handkerchief.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「急いでっ！　暫くは動けないはずだからっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Hurry! It shouldn't be able to move for a while!"

strings.text:
ふと背後を見ると、夢美を追って来ていた蟲使いも、
地面の上で苦しんでいた。
strings.translated: Glancing back, she saw that the Bug User who had been chasing her was also writhing on the ground.

strings.text:
かなり年老いた老人で、齢は七十を超えているように
見える。
strings.translated: He was a very old man -- he looked to be well past seventy.

strings.text:
夢美は、何が何やら分からないまま、アゲハに腕を
引かれて坂道を上がっていった……。
strings.translated: Still not understanding what was happening, Yumemi was pulled by the arm and led up the slope by Ageha......

strings.text:
アゲハ
「やっぱりこんな事だろうと思ったわ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I knew it would come to this."

strings.text:
ひとまず安全な場所まで来て、アゲハが腰に手を当て
ながら言った。
strings.translated: Once they reached somewhere safe, Ageha spoke with her hands on her hips.

strings.text:
夢美は地面から突出した岩場に腰掛け、喉の調子を
整えている。
strings.translated: Yumemi perched on a rocky outcropping jutting up from the ground, steadying her breathing.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「荒っぽい方法だったけど、助けてやったんだから
　感謝しなさいよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"That was a rough way to do it, but I did save you -- so you'd better be grateful."

strings.text:
夢美
「あれ、は……けほっ……アゲハちゃん、が……？」

アゲハ
「先生……あの西って人から、蟲を幾つかもらって来
　たのよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Sensei... I got some Bugs from that Nishi person."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アタシみたいな一般人でも、使えるように改良した
　蟲があるの」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"There are Bugs that have been modified so that even a regular person like me can use them."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「色々あってね、アタシ、そういう蟲のモニター役
　だったから」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"It's a long story -- I was a monitor tester for that kind of Bug."

strings.text:
漠然とではあるものの、アゲハと西の関係が見えた気
がした。
strings.translated: Vaguely, but she felt like she could see the connection between Ageha and Nishi.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ま、アタシ、要領悪いから、ちゃんと使える蟲なん
　てごく一部だったけどね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Well, I'm not very good at it, so there were only a handful I could actually use."

strings.text:
肩から提げた鞄を摩りながら、アゲハが溜息混じりに
つぶやく。
strings.translated: Ageha murmured with a sigh, rubbing the bag hanging from her shoulder.

strings.text:
そこに蟲が入っているらしいことは、何となく感じ取
れた。
strings.translated: Yumemi could somehow sense that the Bugs were inside it.

strings.text:
夢美
「アゲハちゃん……助けに来てくれたの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ageha-chan... you came to help me?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「勘違いするんじゃないわよっ！
　アンタに借りを作りっぱなしなのが嫌だっただけな
　んだからねっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Don't get the wrong idea! I just didn't like having a debt to you hanging over me!!"

strings.text:
いきなり顔を真っ赤に染めて、アゲハが目をつり上げ
ながら叫ぶ。
strings.translated: Her face suddenly flushing red, Ageha shouted with her eyes narrowed in a glare.

strings.text:
別にそこまで全力で否定するような事ではない気がし
たのだが、とりあえず夢美は納得したようにコクコク
と頷いておいた。
strings.translated: Yumemi didn't quite feel it warranted such a vehement denial, but she nodded along as if she understood.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アタシにも用事があるのよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I have my own business here too."

strings.text:
夢美
「用事って、美弥香さんを助けること？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Your business -- is it saving Miyaka-san?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それとは全く別件」

アゲハ
「まあ、偶然でも見つけられれば、助けてやってもい
　いけど…………」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Well, if I happen to find her, I wouldn't mind helping... but............"

strings.text:
そこまで言いかけて、アゲハはふと考え込むような
仕草を見せた。
strings.translated: She trailed off mid-sentence, and Ageha fell into a thoughtful pose.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ねぇ、アンタ……蟲の気配が分かるんだっけ？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Hey, you... you can sense the presence of Bugs, right?"

strings.text:
夢美
「ん、まあ、何となく……この森にいる間に、そうい
　う力がついちゃったみたいで……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yeah, sort of... it seems like I picked up that ability while I've been in this forest..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「蟲が少ないほうはどっち？」

夢美
「えっと……ちょっと待って……。
　今、森が荒れててすぐには分からないの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Um... hold on a moment...
 The forest is in such an uproar right now, I can't tell right away."

strings.text:
夢美
「でも、安全な場所に行きたいなら、森を出たほうが
　いいかも――――」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But if you want to go somewhere safe, it might be better to leave the forest----"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「誰が安全な場所を探せって言ったのよ！
　アタシは蟲の少ない場所を探せって言ったのよ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Who said anything about finding somewhere safe!
 I said find somewhere with fewer Bugs!"

strings.text: アゲハの剣幕に押されて、夢美は森の中を探り始めた。
strings.translated: Cowed by Ageha's ferocity, Yumemi began probing through the forest.

strings.text:
蟲の少ない場所と言われても幾つかあるが、候補地と
なりそうなポイントは二、三個感じ取れる。
strings.translated: There were several areas with fewer Bugs, but she could sense two or three spots that seemed like candidates.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「神武美弥香の居場所、もしかすると蟲の少ない場所
　かもしれないわよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Jinmu Miyaka's location -- it might just be somewhere with fewer Bugs."

strings.text:
周囲の気配を探りながら、夢美は思わず聞き返してい
た。
strings.translated: While probing the surroundings for signs of life, Yumemi found herself asking without thinking.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アタシが蟲使いに捕まったとき、ものすごく汚い家
　に閉じ込められたの」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"When I was captured by that Bug User, I was locked up in this incredibly filthy house."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「……で、最初は大きな蟲が監視してたんだけど、
　どういうわけか、いきなりいなくなったのよね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"...And at first, a large Bug was keeping watch over me, but for some reason, it suddenly disappeared."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「まあ、それでめでたく脱出できたんだけど、その時
　蟲がいなくなった理由をずっと考えてたの」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Well, that's how I managed to escape, but I kept wondering the whole time why the Bug had vanished."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それで思ったのは、アタシを監視するどころじゃな
　い何かが起きたんじゃないかってこと」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"What I figured was, something must have happened that was more pressing than keeping watch over me."

strings.text:
夢美
「監視するどころじゃ、ないこと……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Something more pressing... than keeping watch..."

strings.text: 夢美の頭の中に、惨殺された子供達の姿が浮かんだ。
strings.translated: The image of the slaughtered children surfaced in Yumemi's mind.

strings.text: アゲハと出遭ったのは、その翌日の話だ。
strings.translated: It was the following day that she had encountered Ageha.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「今だってそう。神武美弥香に一匹も蟲を付けないっ
　て事はないだろうけど、そんなにいっぱい付けるよ
　うな余裕もないと思うのよね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"It's the same right now. I doubt Jinmu Miyaka has zero Bugs on her, but I don't think they have enough leeway to assign her that many either."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「神武美弥香を捕らえておくためなら、監視役に一匹
　か二匹で十分」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"To keep Jinmu Miyaka contained, one or two Bugs for surveillance would be enough."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あとは、その監禁場所に近づけないように、蟲使い
　達が戦うほうが効率的でしょ？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"After that, wouldn't it be more efficient for the Bug Users to fight in a way that keeps others from getting close to the confinement site?"

strings.text: アゲハの理論には納得できる部分が多々ある。
strings.translated: There were many parts of Ageha's reasoning that made sense.

strings.text:
蟲使いの中でもっとも強いとされているレンが、森の
入り口付近までやって来ているのだ。
strings.translated: Ren, said to be the strongest among the Bug Users, had come all the way to the forest entrance.

strings.text:
監禁場所に近づけない方法で戦っている可能性は、
十分に考えられるような気がした。
strings.translated: It seemed entirely plausible that they were fighting in a way designed to keep others away from the confinement site.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「単なる勘でしかないけど、アテもなくぶらぶらする
　よりマシだと思わない？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"It's nothing more than a hunch, but don't you think it's better than wandering around with no leads?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「と、ゆーわけでさっさと探すっ！
　この森で蟲の少ない場所ってどこよっ！？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"So -- that's why we need to find it fast!
Where in this forest has the fewest Bugs!?"

strings.text:
ビシッとアゲハに指を差されて、夢美は直立不動に
なった。
strings.translated: With Ageha pointing a finger sharply at her, Yumemi snapped to attention and stood bolt upright.

strings.text: 学校で先生に叱られた生徒のような気分だ。
strings.translated: She felt just like a student being scolded by a teacher at school.

strings.text:
意識を集中させてさらにポイントを絞り込み、夢美は
やがてある方向に顔を向けた。
strings.translated: Focusing her mind and narrowing down the possibilities further, Yumemi eventually turned her face in a certain direction.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「オッケー。それじゃ、さっさと行きましょ」

夢美
「アゲハちゃん、やっぱり美弥香さんを助けに来たん
　じゃないの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ageha-chan, you really did come to save Miyaka-san, didn't you?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ついでよ、ついで……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"It's just a side thing, a side thing..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「どうせアタシが用のある奴は、この森のどこにいる
　かも分からないんだし」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"The person I actually need to find could be anywhere in this forest, for all I know."

strings.text: そう呟いて、アゲハが溜息をつく。
strings.translated: Muttering that, Ageha let out a sigh.

strings.text:
誰に会おうとしているのかは分からないが、よほど
大切な用があるらしい。
strings.translated: It was unclear who she was trying to meet, but whatever the matter was, it seemed terribly important to her.

strings.text:
夢美は多少気になりつつも、蟲の少ない方向へと
歩き始めた。
strings.translated: Yumemi was a little curious, but she started walking in the direction with fewer Bugs.

strings.text: 森の各所では、いまだ激しい戦いが続いていた……。
strings.translated: Throughout the forest, fierce battles continued to rage...

strings.text:
蟲使いを倒してから、夢美は暫くの間、放心したまま
だった……。
strings.translated: After defeating the Bug User, Yumemi remained in a daze for some time...

strings.text:
あれから場所は移動したが、蟲使いの死体と、腹を
抉ったときの感触は、生々しく記憶に残っている。
strings.translated: They had moved locations since then, but the Bug User's corpse and the sensation of gouging open his stomach remained vivid in her memory.

strings.text:
突出した岩に座って森を眺めていても、目に見えるの
は絶命する瞬間の男の顔だった。
strings.translated: Even as she sat on a jutting rock gazing out at the forest, all she could see was the man's face in the moment of his death.

strings.text: 自分が人を殺してしまったという事実。
strings.translated: The fact that she had killed a person.

strings.text: 初めてではないが、だからといって平気ではなかった。
strings.translated: It was not the first time, but that did not make it any easier.

strings.text:
それどころか五年前、夢美が殺した蟲使いの死に顔が、
鮮明な記憶として甦ってくる。
strings.translated: Far from it -- the face of the Bug User Yumemi had killed five years ago resurfaced as a sharp, clear memory.

strings.text:
自分が二人も人を殺したという事実が、重く肩に圧し
掛かっていた……。
strings.translated: The fact that she had now killed two people weighed heavily on her shoulders...

strings.text:
優斗
「夢美ちゃん……そろそろ行こうか？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Yumemi-chan... should we get going soon?"

strings.text: 躊躇いがちに、優斗が話しかけて来る。
strings.translated: Yuuto spoke to her with some hesitation.

strings.text:
夢美の気持ちが分からないわけではないが、この場所
は決して安全ではない。
strings.translated: It wasn't that he couldn't understand how Yumemi felt, but this place was far from safe.

strings.text:
何の力を持たない人間でも、唯一その事だけは理解で
きたからこそ、優斗はやや力ずくで夢美を立ち上がら
せた。
strings.translated: Even as someone with no special power of his own, that much he could understand -- and it was precisely because of that understanding that Yuuto, with a bit of force, got Yumemi back on her feet.

strings.text:
優斗
「とにかく、この森を出てから考えよう」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Anyway, let's think about it once we're out of this forest."

strings.text:
優斗にしっかりと手を握られて、夢美はトボトボと
足を動かし始めた。
strings.translated: With Yuuto holding her hand firmly, Yumemi began to trudge forward, one foot at a time.

strings.text:
思考は停止したままだが、優斗の言葉が正しいと感じ
ることはできる。
strings.translated: Her thoughts had ground to a halt, but she could still feel that Yuuto was right.

strings.text:
アゲハも無言でその後をついて来て、三人は森の出口
を目指して坂道を下って行った。
strings.translated: Ageha followed behind them in silence, and the three made their way down the slope toward the forest exit.

strings.text:
森に響き渡った重苦しい音に、三人は思わず足を止め
た。
strings.translated: A heavy sound that reverberated through the forest brought all three of them to an involuntary stop.

strings.text:
辺りを見回しながら、アゲハが不安げな様子でつぶや
く。
strings.translated: Ageha murmured uneasily, scanning the area around her.

strings.text:
夢美もさすがに我に返って、キョロキョロと周囲の
様子を窺っていた。
strings.translated: Even Yumemi snapped back to her senses, glancing around nervously to take in her surroundings.

strings.text: 二発、そして三発と銃声が続く。
strings.translated: A second shot rang out, then a third.

strings.text:
距離はそれほど離れていないようで、音はかなり大き
かった。
strings.translated: The distance didn't seem all that great -- the sound was quite loud.

strings.text: 行くべきか逃げるべきか。
strings.translated: Should they press forward, or run?

strings.text: 考えるより先に夢美は駆け出していた。
strings.translated: Before she could even think it through, Yumemi had already broken into a sprint.

strings.text:
優斗とアゲハが驚いたように声を上げたが、構ってい
る余裕はなかった。
strings.translated: Yuuto and Ageha cried out in surprise, but she had no time to worry about them.

strings.text:
やがて、夢美の視界に、森の中で戦う二つの人影が
見えてくる。
strings.translated: Before long, two figures locked in combat came into view through the trees.

strings.text:
そのうちの一つの姿を確認したとき、夢美は思わずと
いった風に呟いていた。
strings.translated: The moment she made out one of those figures, Yumemi found herself murmuring without thinking.

strings.text:
人影のうちの一つは、紛れもなく蟲筒を構えたレン
だった。
strings.translated: One of the figures was unmistakably Ren, his Bug tube raised and ready.

strings.text:
敵対しているらしい相手との距離を取りながら、蟲を
放つタイミングを計っている。
strings.translated: He was keeping his distance from his apparent opponent, waiting for the right moment to release his Bug.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ユーリア？　何でこんなところに……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Yulia? What is she doing here..."

strings.text:
ようやく追い付いてきたアゲハが、驚いたように声を
上げた。
strings.translated: Ageha, having finally caught up, let out a startled cry.

strings.text: レンと戦う二人の少女を見て、目を大きく開いている。
strings.translated: She stared wide-eyed at the two girls fighting Ren.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「白い髪のほうは、ユーリア……ナンタラとかって
　長い名前の女」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"The one with white hair is Yulia... something-or-other, some woman with a long name."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「もう一人は佐々原　唯って言う、神武美弥香の
　お友達」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"The other one is Sasahara Yui -- a friend of Jinmu Miyaka's."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「でも、どっちもその美弥香って女の護衛者よ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"But they're both bodyguards for that Miyaka woman."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「その二人が来て、しかもアレがいるってこと
　は……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"If those two are here, and that thing is here too, then that means..."

strings.text:
アゲハの視線の先――帽子とコートをまとった人物が、
地面を蹴ってレンに襲い掛かった。
strings.translated: Following Ageha's gaze -- a figure in a hat and coat kicked off the ground and lunged at Ren.

strings.text:
そのスピードは、体格からは想像もできないほど速く、
夢美は目で追うこともできなかった。
strings.translated: The speed was beyond anything their build would suggest, and Yumemi couldn't even track it with her eyes.

strings.text:
レンが蟲筒を振るった瞬間、そこから飛び出した蟲が
コートの人物の体をバラバラに砕く。
strings.translated: The instant Ren swung his Bug tube, the Bug that burst from it shattered the coated figure's body to pieces.

strings.text:
どす黒い血と濁った灰色の骨、そして人間にはない
触手のようなものが、地面に飛び散っていった。
strings.translated: Dark, blackened blood, murky gray bone, and something like tentacles -- nothing that belonged to a human body -- scattered across the ground.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「合蟲人間が来てるってことは、先生もいるってこ
　と？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"If a Bug-fused human is here, does that mean Sensei is here too?"

strings.text:
優斗
「とにかく、逃げたほうがいいんじゃないかな。
　ここにいると、いつ巻き添えを食らうか分からない
　し……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Either way, shouldn't we run? If we stay here, there's no telling when we might get caught in the crossfire..."

strings.text: 青褪めた顔をして、優斗は既に数歩後ずさりしていた。
strings.translated: His face drained of color, Yuuto had already backed away several steps.

strings.text:
たった今、目の前で人間に近い生物が砕かれたのだか
ら怯えて当然だ。
strings.translated: He had just watched something nearly human get torn apart right before his eyes -- of course he was frightened.

strings.text:
実際、夢美も初めて目の当たりにするレンの力に、
恐れがないわけではなかった。
strings.translated: In truth, Yumemi herself felt no small amount of fear at witnessing Ren's power for the first time.

strings.text: だが、本当に逃げていいのか。
strings.translated: But was it really all right to run?

strings.text: もっと他に、成すべきことがあるのではないか。
strings.translated: Was there not something else she ought to be doing?

strings.text:
心に何か引っかかるものがあって、夢美はなかなか
その場から動くことができなかった。
strings.translated: Something nagged at her heart, and Yumemi found herself unable to move from the spot.

strings.text:
右腕を握り締めながら、夢美はレンとユーリアの戦い
を見つめた……。
strings.translated: Clutching her right arm, Yumemi watched the battle between Ren and Yulia...

strings.text:
レンとユーリア、唯の戦いを見つめているうちに、
夢美はふとある事を思い出した。
strings.translated: As she watched the fight between Ren, Yulia, and Yui, something suddenly came back to Yumemi.

strings.text:
以前、まだ倉庫で蟲をかわす訓練をしていた頃、レン
は美弥香の誘拐を計画していたはずだ。
strings.translated: Before, back when she was still training to dodge Bugs in the warehouse, Ren had been planning to kidnap Miyaka.

strings.text:
護衛者の二人がここにいると言うことは、誘拐犯の
レンを追って来たか、或いは――――
strings.translated: If the two bodyguards were here, they had either come in pursuit of the kidnapper Ren, or else ----

strings.text:
アゲハ
「なに？　何か心当たりでもあるの？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"What? Did something come to mind?"

strings.text:
夢美の様子に気付いたアゲハが、やや苛立った様子で
尋ねてくる。
strings.translated: Ageha, having noticed Yumemi's expression, pressed her with a slightly irritated look.

strings.text:
その迫力に圧されかけはしたものの、夢美は自分の
考えを述べた。
strings.translated: Though nearly overwhelmed by the force of it, Yumemi laid out her thoughts.

strings.text:
最初は訝しげだったアゲハの顔が、徐々に驚愕の表情
に変わっていく……。
strings.translated: Ageha's face, at first skeptical, gradually shifted into an expression of astonishment...

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あり得ない話じゃないわね。
　アタシだって、連中に捕まってここに連れて来られ
　たわけだし……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"It's not an impossible theory.
I was captured by those people and dragged here myself, after all..."

strings.text:
夢美
「この場所って、もしかして……」

アゲハ
「よく分かんないけど、簡単に森から出られないよう
　な仕掛けがあるわけでしょ？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I'm not sure exactly, but there's some kind of mechanism that keeps you from easily leaving the forest, right?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それなら、森全体が牢屋みたいな役目をしてる可能
　性も、結構アリかもしれない」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"In that case, there's a pretty good chance the whole forest is serving as a kind of prison."

strings.text:
優斗
「あれ？　でも、そうすると美弥香って人が捕まって
　る場所って……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Huh? But then... the place where Miyaka-san is being held..."

strings.text:
優斗のつぶやきを聞いて、アゲハがハッとした表情を
浮かべた。
strings.translated: Hearing Yuuto's murmur, Ageha's expression shifted with a sudden realization.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アタシが捕まってた場所、汚い家だったんだけど、
　周りにも同じような家があった」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"The place where I was being held was a filthy house -- and there were other houses just like it around it."

strings.text:
夢美
「それじゃあ、美弥香さんもそこに？」

アゲハ
「かもしれない……けど、正確な場所なんて覚えてな
　いわよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Maybe... but I don't remember exactly where it was."

strings.text: アゲハが、まるで自信無さそうな様子で言う。
strings.translated: Ageha spoke, as if she had little confidence in herself.

strings.text:
だが、返って来たのは落胆した夢美と優斗の視線で、
必要以上に罪悪感を刺激された。
strings.translated:
But what greeted her in return were the dejected gazes of Yumemi and Yuuto,
which stirred in her a guilt far greater than necessary.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「わ、分かったわよ。
　なんとか思い出してみるわよぉ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"F-fine, I get it.
 I'll try my best to remember, okay..."

strings.text: 渋々そう答えて、アゲハは森のほうを見つめた。
strings.translated: Grumbling, Ageha turned her gaze toward the forest.

strings.text:
昨日の事とはいえ、本当に思い出せるかどうかは分か
らない。
strings.translated: Even if it was only yesterday, there was no telling whether she could truly remember any of it.

strings.text:
ただ、もしも美弥香がこの森に捕らわれているのなら、
確かに放っておくわけにはいかなかった。
strings.translated:
But if Miyaka truly was being held captive somewhere in this forest,
there was no question they couldn't simply leave her there.

strings.text:
夢美
「アゲハちゃん、行こう」

アゲハ
「せっかく出てきたのに……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"And here I finally managed to get out..."

strings.text:
微笑を浮かべる夢美に、アゲハは大きな溜息をつい
た……。
strings.translated: Ageha let out a long, heavy sigh at Yumemi's smiling face...

strings.text:
藪の中から飛び出して来た触手が、夢美の体を薙ぎ倒
した。
strings.translated: A tentacle burst out from the underbrush and swept Yumemi off her feet.

strings.text:
赤黒いヘビのような異物が大きくうねり、空中で弧を
描くように動く。
strings.translated: The dark reddish-black, snake-like mass writhed violently, arcing through the air as it moved.

strings.text: それは、一瞬の出来事だった。

空中で大きくうねった触手が、真っ直ぐに優斗の胸を
貫いていた。
strings.translated: The tentacle, which had twisted wildly through the air, had driven straight through Yuuto's chest.

strings.text:
触手が突き刺さった自分の胸を見て、優斗が小さく声
を漏らす。
strings.translated: Yuuto let out a small sound as he looked down at his own chest, skewered by the tentacle.

strings.text:
傷口からはじわりと血が滲み、それが少しずつ円形に
広がっていた。
strings.translated: Blood seeped slowly from the wound, spreading outward in a widening circle.

strings.text: 夢美の頭の中に『死』と言う文字が浮かび上がる。
strings.translated: The word "death" surfaced in Yumemi's mind.

strings.text:
夢美
「いやああああああああああああああっ！！！！」

裏返った悲鳴を上げながら、夢美は優斗のもとへ走り
寄った。
strings.translated: Screaming at the top of her lungs, Yumemi ran to Yuuto's side.

strings.text:
近くに蟲使いがいる事も、周囲を蟲に囲まれているこ
とも関係ない。
strings.translated: It didn't matter that a Bug User was nearby, or that they were surrounded by Bugs.

strings.text:
早く手当てしなければ優斗が死んでしまうと、ただそ
れだけが頭の中にあった。
strings.translated: All that filled her mind was the single thought that she had to treat his wound, or Yuuto would die.

strings.text:
大声で叫びながら、優斗の胸に刺さった触手を引き抜
こうとする。
strings.translated: Crying out at the top of her voice, she tried to pull the tentacle free from Yuuto's chest.

strings.text: 背後のほうで物音がして、夢美は慌てて振り返った。
strings.translated: A sound came from behind her, and Yumemi spun around in a panic.

strings.text:
見れば夢美の蟲が藪に飛び込んで、その向こう側にい
る敵に襲い掛かっている。
strings.translated: She saw that her Bug had plunged into the underbrush and was attacking the enemy on the other side.

strings.text:
周囲の蟲達は主を助けるためか、次々と藪の中に飛び
込み、そして激しい物音だけが延々と続いていった。
strings.translated: Perhaps to protect their master, the Bugs all around dove into the thicket one after another, and the fierce sounds of struggle went on and on.

strings.text: 蟲のことは気になるが、今は優斗のほうが先決だ。
strings.translated: She was worried about the Bug, but Yuuto had to come first right now.

strings.text:
触手を引き抜こうかとも思ったが、それをすると大量
の出血を招いてしまう恐れもある。
strings.translated: She considered pulling the tentacle out, but doing so risked causing massive blood loss.

strings.text:
結局、夢美にできる事といえば、優斗の体を地面に
横たえてやる程度だった。
strings.translated: In the end, all Yumemi could do was lay Yuuto's body down gently on the ground.

strings.text:
夢美
「いやぁっ、そんなこと……そんなこと言わないで下
　さいっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"No -- don't say that... please don't say things like that!!"

strings.text:
まるで遺言のような科白に、夢美は泣きながら首を
横に振った。
strings.translated: At words that sounded all too much like a final farewell, Yumemi shook her head, weeping.

strings.text: こんな事があるわけがない。

ようやく森を抜ける事ができたのに、こんな結末があ
るわけがない。
strings.translated: They had finally managed to escape the forest -- there was no way it could end like this.

strings.text:
きっと何か助ける方法があるはずだと、夢美は可能な
限り思考を巡らせた。
strings.translated: Surely there had to be some way to save him -- Yumemi racked her mind for every possibility she could think of.

strings.text:
優斗
「うっ……げぼっ！　う、べほっ！！！」
優斗の口から、大量の血が噴き出す。
strings.translated: A torrent of blood poured from Yuuto's mouth.

strings.text:
それが――そんなむせ返った咳のようなものが、優斗
の最期の声だった。
strings.translated: That -- that strangled, choking cough -- was the last sound Yuuto ever made.

strings.text:
血を吐いたあと、人形のように動かなくなってしまっ
た優斗に、夢美は呆然とした様子で声をかけた。
strings.translated: After he coughed up that blood and went still as a doll, Yumemi called out to Yuuto in a daze.

strings.text:
だが、それに優斗が応えてくれる事はなく、指一本動
かない体が、既に命尽きた事を伝えていた。
strings.translated: But Yuuto did not answer. His body, not even a finger twitching, told her that his life had already come to an end.
There was nothing he could do.

strings.text:
助けたいという気持ちだけが、ただ虚しく胸に残って
いた。
strings.translated: Only the desperate wish to save him remained, hollow and aching in her chest.

strings.text:
そんな思いがもう叶わないのだと頭では理解しつつも、
夢美はまだ優斗を助ける方法がないか考えていた。
strings.translated: Even as her mind understood that wish could never be fulfilled, Yumemi was still searching for some way to save Yuuto.

strings.text: 思考とは裏腹に、感情のほうが先に込み上げてくる。
strings.translated: Her emotions surged up ahead of her thoughts.

strings.text:
自分にとって最愛の人が、たった今死んだことを、
心のほうが強く感じ取っていた。
strings.translated: Her heart felt it deeply -- that the person most precious to her had just died.

strings.text:
手足はブルブルと震えているが、夢美が意識してのこ
とではなかった。
strings.translated: Her limbs trembled uncontrollably, though it was not something Yumemi was doing consciously.

strings.text:
やがて、戦いを終えたのか夢美の蟲が戻ってきたが、
結果などもはやどうでもいい。
strings.translated: Eventually, Yumemi's Bug returned, having finished the battle -- but the outcome no longer mattered at all.

strings.text:
息絶えた優斗の躯から目を離すことができず、夢美は
ただその場で呆然とし続けていた……。
strings.translated: Unable to tear her eyes away from Yuuto's lifeless body, Yumemi simply stood there, dazed, unmoving...

strings.text:
吹っ飛ばされた夢美を追うようにして、優斗が振り
返る。
strings.translated: As if chasing after Yumemi who had been blown back, Yuuto turned around.

strings.text:
だが、間一髪の差で、右腕を蟲化させて難を逃れてい
た。
strings.translated: But by a hair's breadth, she had escaped harm by transforming her right arm into a Bug.

strings.text:
刃物のような五本爪が、襲い掛かって来た蟲の触手を
切断している。
strings.translated: Five blade-like claws sliced through the tentacles of the attacking Bug.

strings.text:
だが、蟲の触手は次から次へと襲ってきて、夢美は
大きく右側に跳躍した。
strings.translated:
But the Bug's tentacles came one after another, and Yumemi
leaped far to the right.

strings.text: それは、一瞬の出来事だった。

空中で大きくうねった触手が、真っ直ぐに優斗の胸を
貫いていた。
strings.translated: The tentacle, which had twisted wildly through the air, had driven straight through Yuuto's chest.

strings.text:
触手が突き刺さった自分の胸を見て、優斗が小さく声
を漏らす。
strings.translated: Yuuto let out a small sound as he looked down at his own chest, skewered by the tentacle.

strings.text:
傷口からはじわりと血が滲み、それが少しずつ円形に
広がっていた。
strings.translated: Blood seeped slowly from the wound, spreading outward in a widening circle.

strings.text: 夢美の頭の中に『死』と言う文字が浮かび上がる。
strings.translated: The word "death" surfaced in Yumemi's mind.

strings.text:
夢美
「いやああああああああああああああっ！！！！」

裏返った悲鳴を上げながら、夢美は優斗のもとへ走り
寄った。
strings.translated: Screaming at the top of her lungs, Yumemi ran to Yuuto's side.

strings.text:
近くに蟲使いがいる事も、周囲を蟲に囲まれているこ
とも関係ない。
strings.translated: It didn't matter that a Bug User was nearby, or that they were surrounded by Bugs.

strings.text:
早く手当てしなければ優斗が死んでしまうと、ただそ
れだけが頭の中にあった。
strings.translated: All that filled her mind was the single thought that she had to treat his wound, or Yuuto would die.

strings.text:
大声で叫びながら、優斗の胸に刺さった触手を引き抜
こうとする。
strings.translated: Crying out at the top of her voice, she tried to pull the tentacle free from Yuuto's chest.

strings.text:
グチャリ、と潰れる音が鳴って、夢美の視界に赤い花
が咲いた……。
strings.translated: A wet, crushing sound rang out, and a red flower bloomed in Yumemi's vision...

strings.text: 二度目、そして三度目と、立て続けに音が聞こえる。
strings.translated: A second time, then a third -- the sounds came in rapid succession.

strings.text:
全身がバラバラになったかのような痛みが、繰り返し
感じられる。
strings.translated: A pain as though her entire body had been torn apart washed over her again and again.

strings.text:
自分の体に、何かが突き刺さっているような気がした
が、もはやどうする事もできなかった。
strings.translated: She felt as though something was being driven into her body, but there was nothing she could do anymore.

strings.text: 何度も何度も、自分が潰れる音が聞こえる。
strings.translated: Again and again, she could hear the sound of herself being crushed.

strings.text: まるでうすの中に入れられた餅になった気分だ。
strings.translated: It felt as though she had been stuffed into a mortar and was being pounded like rice cake.

strings.text:
こうも何度も潰されては、蟲の復元も追いつかないだ
ろう。
strings.translated: Being crushed this many times, even a Bug's regeneration could not keep up.

strings.text:
やがて、痛みも感じなくなり、目の前が暗くなってき
たところで――――
strings.translated: Eventually, even the pain faded away, and as darkness crept over her vision ----

strings.text:
――遠くのほうで優斗の声を聞いた気がして、夢美の
意識は潰えた。
strings.translated: She thought she heard Yuuto's voice from somewhere far away -- and then Yumemi's consciousness went dark.

strings.text: 櫻井夢美がどうなったのか――――。

森に戻ったレンですら、その詳細を知ることはできな
かった。
strings.translated: Even Ren, who had returned to the forest, could not learn the details.

strings.text:
すぐに調査を行うべきだったのだが、同時期に誘拐さ
れた神武美弥香を救出するための部隊が森に侵入。
strings.translated: He should have investigated immediately, but around the same time, a unit had entered the forest to rescue Jinmu Miyaka, who had been kidnapped.

strings.text:
激しい攻防戦となり、夢美の消息を追うだけの余裕が
なかったのだ。
strings.translated: The fighting had been fierce, and there had been no room to spare to track down Yumemi's whereabouts.

strings.text:
レンが再び森に足を踏み入れたのは、神武側との交渉
が落ち着いた数週間後。
strings.translated: Ren set foot in the forest again several weeks later, after negotiations with the Jinmu side had settled down.

strings.text:
平穏を取り戻した森の中を歩きながら、夢美、そして
獣魔蟲の姿を探した。
strings.translated: Walking through the forest, now restored to calm, he searched for any sign of Yumemi -- and of the Jumachuu.

strings.text: だが、それは口で言うほど容易いことではない。
strings.translated: But it was not as easy as it sounded.

strings.text:
見知った森ではあるが、アテもなく一人の人間を探す
のは、レンであっても至難の業だった。
strings.translated: Though he knew the forest well, searching for a single person with no leads was an ordeal even for Ren.

strings.text:
唯一、獣魔蟲の気配を感じ取ることができれば、そこ
に夢美もいるかもしれないのだが、確実に見つけられ
る方法ではない。
strings.translated: The one hope was that if he could sense the Jumachuu's presence, Yumemi might be nearby -- but it was no reliable method of finding her.

strings.text:
レン
「ここが、南優斗の死亡した場所でしたね」
strings.translated:
Ren
"This is where Minami Yuuto died."

strings.text:
ある場所でぴたりと立ち止まって、レンがぽつりと
つぶやく。
strings.translated: Stopping abruptly at a certain spot, Ren murmured quietly.

strings.text:
そこに、特別な感情を窺うことはできないが、夢美の
行動を予測する、一つの情報であるのは間違いなかっ
た。
strings.translated: No particular emotion could be read into his words, but there was no doubt it was one piece of information for predicting Yumemi's movements.

strings.text: 優斗は蟲使いに殺された。
strings.translated: Yuuto had been killed by a Bug User.

strings.text: そして、その蟲使いは獣魔蟲に殺された。
strings.translated: And that Bug User had been killed by the Jumachuu.

strings.text:
遠くから監視していた別の蟲使いから、そこまでの
報告は受けている。
strings.translated: He had received reports up to that point from another Bug User who had been watching from a distance.

strings.text:
問題はそれ以降のことで、獣魔蟲に恐怖した蟲使いが
途中で逃げ出してしまったため、夢美の消息が分から
なくなってしまったのだ。
strings.translated: The problem was what came after -- the Bug User, terrified by the Jumachuu, had fled midway, leaving Yumemi's whereabouts unknown.

strings.text:
ただ、常識的に考えれば、わざわざ森の中に戻る必要
はないはずで、レン自身何かを期待して来たわけでは
ない。
strings.translated: Rationally speaking, there was no reason to return to the forest, and Ren himself had not come here expecting anything in particular.

strings.text:
ただ、自宅のマンションにも戻らず、市内のホテルに
泊まるでもなく、捜索が行き詰ったからここに来ただ
けの話だった。
strings.translated: It was simply that she had neither returned to her apartment nor stayed at any hotel in the city; with the search at a dead end, he had come here.

strings.text: 結界を越えて、蟲使いの森の中へ――――。
strings.translated: Crossing the barrier, into the forest of Bug Users.

strings.text:
辺りには特に変わった様子はなく、今までと同じく、
野生の蟲がのんびりと暮らしているようだった。
strings.translated: The surroundings showed no particular change; as always, wild Bugs seemed to be living their unhurried lives.

strings.text: 獣魔蟲の気配は、今のところ感じられない……。
strings.translated: No sign of the Jumachuu could be felt, at least for now...

strings.text: 森は至って静かで、穏やかな雰囲気に満ちていた。
strings.translated: The forest was utterly quiet, filled with a calm and gentle atmosphere.

strings.text: 妙に弱々しい気配があった。

森の奥、ずっと深いところから、弱々しいのにハッキ
リと感じられる気配があった。
strings.translated: From deep within the forest, from somewhere far deeper, there was a presence -- faint, yet unmistakably clear.

strings.text: 気配を追って、森の奥へ。
strings.translated: Following the presence, deeper into the forest.

strings.text:
気配が気になったのは、普通の蟲とはどこか違うもの
があったからだ。
strings.translated: What caught his attention was that it felt somehow different from an ordinary Bug.

strings.text: 蟲のようで、しかし蟲ではないもののような気配。
strings.translated: A presence like a Bug, and yet like something that was not a Bug.

strings.text:
レンだからこそ気付いた微妙な差が、森の奥へ進むご
とに明確になっていった。
strings.translated: The subtle difference that only Ren could have noticed grew clearer with every step he took deeper into the forest.

strings.text:
二十分ほど歩いたところで、ようやく確信を持つこと
ができた。
strings.translated: After walking for about twenty minutes, he was finally able to feel certain.

strings.text:
以前ほど圧迫感はないが、肌に感じる気配は獣魔蟲の
それと同じだ。
strings.translated: The oppressive weight was not as strong as before, but the presence he felt against his skin was unmistakably that of the Jumachuu.

strings.text:
どうやら、ずっとこの森にいたようで、今はどこかへ
向かって移動している最中のようだった。
strings.translated: It seemed to have been in this forest all along, and now appeared to be moving somewhere.

strings.text: 幾つもの小川を越えて、さらに深いところへ。
strings.translated: Crossing several streams, pressing even deeper.

strings.text:
漂う空気がいっそう冷たくなったが、レンは気にした
様子もなく歩を進めた。
strings.translated: The air drifting around him grew colder still, but Ren walked on without any sign of concern.

strings.text: 近付くごとに、強く感じられる気配。
strings.translated: With every step closer, the presence grew stronger.

strings.text:
最初に弱々しいと思ったのは間違いだったと、レンは
この時になって考えを改めていた。
strings.translated: By now, Ren had revised his initial impression that it was faint.

strings.text: 獣魔蟲の気配は、決して弱かったわけではない。
strings.translated: The Jumachuu's presence had never truly been weak.

strings.text:
ただ、気配の『質』そのものが変わってしまっていた
だけだった。
strings.translated: It was simply that the very "quality" of the presence had changed.

strings.text:
まるで、何かを悲しんでいるかのような、そんな物寂
しげな気配。
strings.translated: A lonely, mournful presence -- as though grieving over something.

strings.text:
とても蟲の発する気配ではなかったが、そう感じるの
だから仕方なかった。
strings.translated: It was hardly the kind of presence a Bug would emit, yet that was how it felt, and there was nothing to be done about it.

Ren
"Up ahead, if I recall correctly..."

strings.text: 目の前にそびえる絶壁。
strings.translated: A sheer cliff face loomed before him.

strings.text:
そこを、獣魔蟲が触手を伸ばして登っているのが、
一瞬だけ見えた。
strings.translated: For just a moment, he caught a glimpse of the Jumachuu scaling it, extending its tentacles upward.

strings.text:
美しいメタリックブルーの輝きは、以前と何ら変わる
ところがない。
strings.translated: The beautiful metallic blue gleam was no different from what he remembered.

strings.text:
崖は、レンでも登るのは困難な高さだったが、ぐるり
と反対側に迂回すれば、上まで登るルートがあるはず
だった。
strings.translated: The cliff was too high for even Ren to climb directly, but if he circled around to the opposite side, there should be a route to the top.

strings.text: 果たして、獣魔蟲はこんな所で何をしているのか。
strings.translated: What on earth was the Jumachuu doing in a place like this?

strings.text: ただの偶然か、それとも――――

レン
「行ってみれば分かりますか」
strings.translated:
Ren
"I suppose I'll find out if I go and see."

strings.text:
胸に様々な思いを秘めながら、レンは崖の反対側へと
回り込んで行った。
strings.translated: With a multitude of thoughts stirring in his chest, Ren made his way around to the other side of the cliff.

strings.text: 崖の上に広がっていたのは、この森唯一の湖だった。
strings.translated: What spread out atop the cliff was the forest's only lake.

strings.text:
森の中でもっとも明るい場所で、湖面は陽光を受けて
キラキラと輝いている。
strings.translated: It was the brightest spot in the entire forest, and the surface of the lake sparkled and shimmered in the sunlight.

strings.text:
そして、気配を追ってきた獣魔蟲は、まるで湖を見つ
めるかのように、枯れた花の上でじっとしていた。
strings.translated: And the Jumachuu, which he had followed by its presence, sat perfectly still atop a withered flower -- as though gazing at the lake.

strings.text:
レン
「ここに、夢美さんが……？」
蟲のいる場所の花は、そこで生えたものではなかった。
strings.translated: The flowers where the Bug rested had not grown there naturally.

strings.text:
まるで、誰かがどこからか摘んできたように、地面を
覆うようにして添えられている。
strings.translated: They were laid across the ground as if someone had gathered them from elsewhere and placed them there as an offering.

strings.text:
レン
「いや、ここにいるのは…………」
strings.translated:
Ren
"No, the one who was here is..."

strings.text:
いくら獣魔蟲が普通の蟲ではないといっても、まさか
死者に花を手向けるような事はしないだろう。
strings.translated: However extraordinary the Jumachuu might be, it surely would not lay flowers for the dead.

strings.text:
それならば、この森にいてこんなことをする人物は
一人しかいない。
strings.translated: Then there was only one person in this forest who could have done something like this.

strings.text:
レン
「夢美さんは生きているのですか？」

答えなど返ってくるはずがないのに、ついそんな事を
獣魔蟲に尋ねてしまう。
strings.translated: There was no reason to expect an answer, yet he found himself asking the Jumachuu just that.

strings.text:
それは、レンらしくない行動ではあり、レン自身も
またそう感じていた。
strings.translated: It was unlike Ren to act that way, and Ren himself felt the same.

strings.text: 獣魔蟲は何をするでもなく、湖のほうを見つめている。
strings.translated: The Bug sat motionless, staring out toward the lake.

strings.text: まるで、何かを待つように、じっとそこに佇んでいる。
strings.translated: It stood there motionless, as though waiting for something.

strings.text:
それが何を意味するのか、レンはあえて考えることは
しなかった。
strings.translated: As for what that meant, Ren chose not to dwell on it.

strings.text: 全てを包み込むように、柔らかく水面を揺らす。
strings.translated: It rippled the surface softly, as if embracing everything within it.

strings.text:
それを見つめながら、レンはふと夢美と優斗の声を
聞いた気がした。
strings.translated: Gazing at it, Ren thought for a moment that he heard the voices of Yumemi and Yuuto.

strings.text:
まるで、楽しげに笑い合っているような、そんな声を
聞いた気がしたのだった……。
strings.translated: As if they were laughing together cheerfully -- that was the kind of voice he thought he heard......

strings.text: あれから、何日が経ったのか……。
strings.translated: How many days had passed since then......

strings.text:
ふと気が付いたとき、夢美は薄暗い森の中で膝を抱え
ていた。
strings.translated: When she came to her senses, Yumemi found herself hugging her knees in the dim forest.

strings.text: 何をするでもなく、ただその場にじっとしている。
strings.translated: She did nothing in particular, simply sitting still in that spot.

strings.text:
時折、意識が戻ったように立ち上がると、フラフラと
森の中を徘徊してはまた座り込んで過ごした。
strings.translated: Now and then, as if her consciousness had returned, she would stand up and wander aimlessly through the forest, only to sit back down again.

strings.text: ここ数日の記憶は曖昧。
strings.translated: Her memories of the past few days were hazy.

strings.text:
優斗が死んだ瞬間から、今に至るまでの記憶が殆どな
かった。
strings.translated: From the moment Yuuto died up until now, she had almost no memory at all.

strings.text: 気が付けば、ただ森の中を歩いている。
strings.translated: Before she knew it, she was simply walking through the forest.

strings.text: まるで、誰かを探すように――――。
まるで、優斗を探すように――――。
食事は一日一回程度になっていた。
strings.translated: She had been eating only about once a day.

strings.text: 自分で決めたわけではなく、自然とそうなっていた。
strings.translated: It was not a conscious decision -- it had simply become that way on its own.

strings.text:
ギリギリまで腹が空かないと、食べたいという気さえ
起こらないのだ。
strings.translated: Unless she was starving to the very limit, she could not even muster the desire to eat.

strings.text:
一日一回、この森に来るまでに買い込んでおいた食糧
で飢えを凌いだ。
strings.translated: Once a day, she staved off hunger with the food she had stocked up before coming to this forest.

strings.text: だが、それも今日までの話だ。
strings.translated: But that, too, was only up until today.

strings.text:
鞄に詰めておいた一週間分の食料はついに無くなり、
夢美は無造作に鞄を捨てた。
strings.translated: The week's worth of food she had packed into her bag had finally run out, and Yumemi tossed the bag aside without a second thought.

strings.text: 身軽になって、また森の奥へと進んだ。
strings.translated: Unburdened, she pressed on deeper into the forest.

strings.text: 自分が何をやっているのか、そんなものは分からない。
strings.translated: What she was doing -- she had no idea.
Nor did she try to understand.

strings.text:
どこかへ向かっている気がするのだが、それも曖昧な
感覚でしかなかった。
strings.translated: She felt as though she was heading somewhere, but even that was nothing more than a vague sensation.
And then -- she sat down again -- -- -- --.

strings.text: 森の深部で、夢美は地べたに座り膝を抱えた。
strings.translated: Deep in the forest, Yumemi sat on the bare ground and hugged her knees.

strings.text:
辺りはじめじめして尻が冷たかったが、だからどうと
言うわけでもない。
strings.translated: The area was damp and the ground was cold against her, but that hardly mattered.

strings.text: 動く気がなくなったから、こうして座っているだけ。
strings.translated: She had lost the will to move, so she simply sat there.

strings.text: 今の夢美の行動に、それ以上の理由はなかった。
strings.translated: There was no greater reason than that behind Yumemi's actions now.

strings.text: 疲れたように溜息が漏れる。
strings.translated: A weary sigh escaped her lips.

strings.text:
優斗が死んで以来、出てくる声はそんなものばかり
だった。
strings.translated: Since Yuuto's death, that was all that ever came out of her.

strings.text: 果たして、自分はこんなところで何をしているのか。
strings.translated: Just what was she doing in a place like this.

strings.text:
今日か明日、もしくは明後日には死んでしまうのだろ
うか。
strings.translated: Would she die today, tomorrow, or the day after.

strings.text:
それならそれで構わなかったし、事実食料がないのだ
からそうなってもおかしくはないはずだった。
strings.translated: If that was how it would be, she did not mind -- and in truth, with no food left, it would not be strange if it came to that.

strings.text: いつからいたのか、目の前に一人の子供が立っていた。
strings.translated: A child stood before her -- she had no idea how long they had been there.

strings.text: 左右の手に一匹ずつ、芋虫のような蟲を持っている。
strings.translated: In each of their hands, they held a single caterpillar-like Bug.

strings.text: ただ、左右の蟲には一つだけ違う点があった。
strings.translated: There was, however, one difference between the Bug in the left hand and the one in the right.

strings.text:
それは、右手の蟲は食べかけて、左手の蟲はまだ生き
ていることだ。
strings.translated: The Bug in the right hand had been half-eaten, while the one in the left was still alive.

strings.text:
子供はゆっくりと近付いてくると、左手の蟲を夢美の
膝の上に置いた。
strings.translated: The child slowly drew closer, then placed the Bug from their left hand onto Yumemi's knee.

strings.text: 要するに、食べろと言っているらしい。
strings.translated: In short, they seemed to be telling her to eat it.

strings.text:
子供は暫く夢美を見つめていたが、やがて飽きたのか
森の奥へと消えていった。
strings.translated: The child stared at Yumemi for a while, but eventually seemed to lose interest and disappeared into the depths of the forest.

strings.text: 後に残されたのは、夢美と、膝の上で蠢く蟲だけ。
strings.translated: Left behind were only Yumemi and the Bug squirming on her knee.

strings.text:
当たり前の話だが、この蟲を食べるということは、
この蟲を殺すということで、この蟲が死ぬという
ことだ。
strings.translated: It went without saying, but eating this Bug meant killing this Bug -- meant that this Bug would die.

strings.text: そこまでして生き延びたいのか――――
strings.translated: Did she want to survive badly enough to go that far -- -- -- --

strings.text:
――もしくは、生き延びなければならない理由がある
のか。
strings.translated: -- Or rather, did she have a reason she had to survive.

strings.text:
夢美は、久しぶりにそんな事を思考したが、やがて
そっと蟲を掴み上げた。
strings.translated: Yumemi turned that thought over in her mind for the first time in a long while, then quietly reached out and picked up the Bug.

strings.text:
足場を無くした蟲は、どこか慌てたようにぴくぴくと
蠢いている。
strings.translated: Deprived of its footing, the Bug squirmed and twitched as if in a panic.

strings.text: そんな蟲の背に歯を当てて、夢美は一気に齧り付いた。
strings.translated: Pressing her teeth against the Bug's back, Yumemi bit down all at once.

strings.text: そんな鳴き声が聞こえた気がする。
strings.translated: She thought she heard a cry like that.

strings.text:
蟲の胴体がびくっと震え、痛みに耐えかねたように
暴れ始めた。
strings.translated: The Bug's body shuddered violently, and it began to thrash as though it could no longer bear the pain.

strings.text:
自分が食われる――命を失う――殺されるのだから、
必死に抵抗して当たり前なのだ。
strings.translated: It was being eaten -- losing its life -- being killed, so of course it would resist with everything it had.

strings.text: だが、それは夢美も同じこと。

今、ここで何かを食べなければ、いつかは冷たい森の
中で野垂れ死ぬだろう。
strings.translated: If she didn't eat something here and now, she would eventually die a miserable death in the cold forest.

strings.text: 優斗と同じように、冷たい躯と変わるだろう。
strings.translated: She would become a cold corpse, just like Yuuto.

strings.text:
それを、少しでも嫌だと思うのなら、目の前の蟲を
喰らってでも生き延びるしかなかった。
strings.translated: If she found that even slightly unbearable, then she had no choice but to eat the Bug before her and survive.

strings.text: 蟲の腹に、下顎を食い込ませる。
strings.translated: She drove her lower jaw into the Bug's belly.

strings.text:
もう一度、鳴き声が聞こえたような気がしたが、構わ
ず歯を押し込んでいった。
strings.translated: She thought she heard the cry once more, but she paid it no mind and kept pressing her teeth deeper.

strings.text:
舌先に触れた蟲の体液が、夢美の口内に痺れのような
感覚を広げていく。
strings.translated: The Bug's bodily fluid that touched the tip of her tongue spread a numbing sensation throughout her mouth.

strings.text:
ピリッとした痛みと、えぐい味に涙が出たが、それで
も蟲を食うのを止めようとは思わなかった。
strings.translated: The sharp pain and the foul taste brought tears to her eyes, but even so, she had no intention of stopping.

strings.text: 果たして、それは断末魔だったのか。
strings.translated: Was that, perhaps, a death cry?

strings.text:
蟲にしては大きな声で鳴いて、暴れていた胴体がぴた
りと大人しくなった。
strings.translated: It let out a surprisingly loud shriek, and then the thrashing body went completely still.

strings.text:
傷口から緑色の体液を漏らしながら、死んだように
動かなくなる。
strings.translated: Green fluid seeped from the wound as it stopped moving, as if dead.

strings.text: いや、死んだようにではない。

夢美の歯に胴体の半分を貫かれ、蟲は確かに死んでい
た。
strings.translated: Half its body pierced through by Yumemi's teeth, the Bug was unmistakably dead.

strings.text:
ほんの数秒前まで生きていた蟲は、夢美の歯に貫かれ、
命を断たれ、奪われ、殺され、息絶えていた。
strings.translated: The Bug that had been alive mere seconds ago had been pierced by Yumemi's teeth, its life severed, stolen, killed -- it had breathed its last.

strings.text:
夢美は、暫く蟲に噛み付いたままじっとしていた
が――――
strings.translated: Yumemi stayed still for a while, teeth still clamped into the Bug -- and then --

strings.text: 再び顎に力を込めて、蟲の肉を抉り抜いていった。
strings.translated: She clenched her jaw again and tore through the Bug's flesh.

strings.text:
夢美
「んぐっ……む、うぅっ…………もぐっ…………」

肉を噛み千切ると、口の中いっぱいに蟲の体液が
広がった。
strings.translated: As she bit off a chunk of flesh, the Bug's bodily fluid spread throughout her entire mouth.

strings.text:
それは、溶解したゼリーのような感触で、苦味と酸味
を混ぜ合わせた、おおよそ人間の食べる物ではないよ
うに感じられた。
