strings.translated: It had the texture of dissolved gelatin, a mixture of bitterness and sourness -- something that felt entirely unfit for human consumption.

strings.text: だが、それが一体何の意味を持つというのか……。
strings.translated: But what did any of that matter...

strings.text:
今、ここで食べなければ、人間として生きていく未来
さえないのだ。
strings.translated: If she didn't eat here and now, she wouldn't even have a future to live as a human being.

strings.text:
命を繋ぐ食べ物は食べるし、必要であれば泥水でも
飲んで生き延びる。
strings.translated: She would eat whatever food sustained her life, and if necessary, she would drink muddy water to survive.

strings.text:
次第に夢美の頭の中を占めるのは、『生』への執着心
のみとなっていった。
strings.translated: Gradually, the only thing filling Yumemi's mind was a singular obsession -- the will to live.

strings.text:
夢美
「しゃぐっ……む、もぐっ、もぐっ……。
　ご、くんっ……ぴちゃっ……ごくんっ…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Shag... mm, munch, munch...
   Sw... swallow... smack... gulp..."

strings.text:
夢美
「う……げほっ、う、えほっ……ごほごほっ！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ugh... cough, ugh, hack... cough, cough, cough!"

strings.text: 急いで食べ過ぎたため、蟲の肉が喉につかえた。
strings.translated: She had eaten too hastily, and the Bug's flesh caught in her throat.

strings.text: むせ返って唾液を吐き出し、暫くその場にうずくまる。
strings.translated: She choked and spat out saliva, crouching there for a while.

strings.text: 胸がズキリと痛み、まぶたの奥から涙が零れた。
strings.translated: A sharp pain stabbed through her chest, and tears spilled from behind her eyelids.

strings.text:
夢美
「ぐ……むっ……にちゃっ……にちゃっ…………」
ゆっくりと口を動かして、蟲の肉を噛み締める。
strings.translated: She moved her mouth slowly, chewing the Bug's flesh.

strings.text:
えぐい味に何度も嗚咽を漏らしながら、染み出した
肉汁を嚥下していった。
strings.translated: Stifling repeated retches at the foul taste, she swallowed the juices that seeped out.

strings.text:
夢美
「ごくっ……ん…………ごくんっ………………」

五分以上も時間をかけて、ようやく肉のカケラを一つ
飲み込む。
strings.translated: It took over five minutes before she finally managed to swallow a single piece of flesh.

strings.text:
喉が焼けるように熱くなったが、吐き戻そうとは思わ
なかった。
strings.translated: Her throat burned with heat, but she had no intention of bringing it back up.

strings.text:
今、夢美の口の中にあるのは、自分が生きるために
奪った命――――
strings.translated: After all, what was in her mouth now was a life she had taken in order to survive --

strings.text: ――自分が生きるために、噛み殺した蟲の命なのだ。
strings.translated: -- The life of the Bug she had bitten to death so that she could live.

strings.text: それを吐き出すような真似は、絶対にできなかった。
strings.translated: There was absolutely no way she could spit that out.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぐっ……む、ぐ……もぐっ…………」
涙で頬を濡らしながら、もう一度蟲に齧り付く。
strings.translated: Tears streaming down her cheeks, she bit into the Bug once more.

strings.text:
口内に広がる痺れはさらに強まっていったが、夢美は
構わず緑色の肉を食べ続けた……。
strings.translated: The numbness spreading through her mouth grew ever stronger, but Yumemi kept eating the green flesh without pause...

strings.text: 初めて蟲を食べてから、五回太陽が昇るのを数えた。
strings.translated: Five sunrises had passed since she first ate a Bug.

strings.text:
五日が過ぎたということではなく、それ以上は数える
のが面倒になってやめていた。
strings.translated: Not that only five days had passed -- after five, she had simply stopped bothering to count.

strings.text:
この森にいる以上、日付や時間を気にしていても仕方
が無い。
strings.translated: As long as she remained in this forest, fretting over dates and times was pointless.

strings.text: 生きるために必要なのは、もっと別のものだった。
strings.translated: What she needed to survive was something else entirely.

strings.text:
湿気を帯びた土の上に座りながら、木々の隙間から
見える空を眺める。
strings.translated: She sat on the damp earth and gazed up at the sky visible through the gaps in the trees.

strings.text:
暇を持て余しているわけでなく、無駄に体力を消費し
ないよう動かずにいるだけだ。
strings.translated: It was not that she had time to spare -- she simply kept still to avoid wasting energy needlessly.

strings.text: 体を動かすのは餌となる蟲を狩る時と――――
strings.translated: The only time she moved her body was when hunting Bugs for food -- and...

strings.text: 微かに顔を上げて、夢美がその場から立ち上がる。
strings.translated: She raised her face slightly, and Yumemi rose to her feet.

strings.text:
虚ろな瞳で辺りを見回すと、ぴくぴくと耳を細かく
動かした。
strings.translated: With hollow eyes she scanned her surroundings, her ears twitching in small, rapid movements.

strings.text:
見るのではなく、聞くのでもなく、何かを直接感じ取
ろうとするかのような雰囲気が、夢美の周囲に広がっ
ていく。
strings.translated: An aura spread around Yumemi -- as though she were trying not to see, not to hear, but to directly sense something.

strings.text:
泥にまみれた顔には、死人のように表情といったもの
が浮かんでいなかった。
strings.translated: Her mud-caked face bore no expression whatsoever, like the face of a corpse.

strings.text: 一切のものが変わっていた……。
服は所々が破れ、左側の胸は完全に露出している。
strings.translated: Her clothes were torn in places, and her left breast was fully exposed.

strings.text:
肌には細かい傷が幾つも刻まれ、真新しい血が滲んで
いる箇所も決して少なくはなかった。
strings.translated: Numerous small cuts were etched into her skin, and there was no shortage of spots where fresh blood seeped through.

strings.text:
さらに驚くべきは下半身の格好で、ズボンも下着も
何もつけていなかった。
strings.translated: Even more striking was the state of her lower body -- she wore neither pants nor underwear nor anything at all.

strings.text: もちろん、露出狂に目覚めたわけではない。
strings.translated: Not that she had awakened to exhibitionism, of course.

strings.text:
ズボンは湿気でぐっしょりと濡れたため気持ち悪くて
捨てたのだが、下着は昨日蟲を狩る際に木の枝に引っ
掛けて失くしてしまったのだ。
strings.translated: Her pants had grown so soaked with moisture that she had thrown them away in disgust, and her underwear had caught on a tree branch while she was hunting Bugs yesterday and been lost.

strings.text: 探そうとは思わなかった。
strings.translated: She had not thought to look for it.

strings.text:
それよりも逃げる獲物を狩るほうが先決で、その日は
見事に大物を捕らえる事ができた。
strings.translated: Hunting down her fleeing prey had taken priority, and that day she had managed to catch quite a large one.

strings.text: 得体の知れない『生』への執着心。
strings.translated: A clinging attachment to life -- one she could not even name.

strings.text:
理由もよく分からないまま、夢美は生き続けることを
選んでいた。
strings.translated: Without fully understanding why, Yumemi had chosen to keep living.

strings.text:
記憶も曖昧で、時々自分が誰なのかさえ分からなくな
る。
strings.translated: Her memories were hazy, and at times she could no longer even tell who she was.

strings.text:
だが、この森で生きるにおいて、自分の存在など大し
た問題ではなかった。
strings.translated: But in terms of surviving in this forest, her own identity was hardly a pressing concern.

strings.text: 足場の悪い坂道を降りて、沢のほうへと向かう。
strings.translated: She descended the treacherous slope and made her way toward the stream.

strings.text:
勾配のついた坂を下りると、雑草の生い茂った場所へ
と足を踏み入れ、そこに素手で小さな穴を掘った。
strings.translated: Coming down the steep incline, she stepped into a patch of overgrown weeds and dug a small hole there with her bare hands.

strings.text:
一見すると小動物が餌を探しているような仕草だが、
夢美の目的はまさにそれだ。
strings.translated: At a glance it looked like a small animal foraging for food -- and that was precisely what Yumemi was doing.

strings.text:
土の中に隠れていた小さな蟲を掴み出すと、適当に
泥を払って口の中に放り込んだ。
strings.translated: She pulled out a small Bug hiding in the soil, brushed off the dirt without much care, and tossed it into her mouth.

strings.text:
蟲は、声を出すこともなく、歯と歯に磨り潰されて
死んだ。
strings.translated: The Bug made no sound as it was ground to death between her teeth.

strings.text: 味は、お世辞にも美味しいとは言えない。
strings.translated: The taste was, to put it charitably, not good.

strings.text: 苦味どころか、舌が痺れるような感覚さえある。
strings.translated: It was more than just bitter -- there was even a numbing sensation on her tongue.

strings.text:
どうやら多少毒を持っていた蟲のようで、こういった
事はしょっちゅうだった。
strings.translated: It seemed this particular Bug carried a mild poison; such things happened all the time.

strings.text: それでも、夢美は生きることを諦めなかった。
strings.translated: Even so, Yumemi did not give up on living.

strings.text:
この森の中で、自分が生き続けなければならない理由
があるような気がして、動くときは常に餌を探した。
strings.translated: She felt as though somewhere in this forest there was a reason she had to keep surviving, and whenever she moved, she was always searching for food.

strings.text: 愛しい男の名を呼んで、夢美は次の蟲を探した……。
strings.translated: Calling the name of the man she loved, Yumemi searched for her next Bug...

strings.text:
昇った太陽の数も、沈んだ月の数も、おそらく百を
超えた頃、夢美は一日の大半を森の深部で過ごすよう
になっていた。
strings.translated: By the time the number of sunrises and moonsets had likely surpassed a hundred, Yumemi had taken to spending the greater part of each day deep within the forest.

strings.text:
風雨が凌ぎやすい木の陰で、膝を抱き締めるようにし
て眠りにつく。
strings.translated: She slept curled up with her knees drawn to her chest in the shelter of a tree that kept off the wind and rain.

strings.text:
何の手入れもしていない髪の毛と、マネキンのような
質感になった蒼白い肌。
strings.translated: Her hair, completely untended, and her pallid skin, which had taken on the texture of a mannequin.

strings.text:
爪は獣のように鋭く伸び、時折何かを思い出したかの
ように、ピクッピクッと痙攣している。
strings.translated: Her nails had grown sharp as a beast's claws, and every so often she would twitch -- once, twice -- as if something had suddenly come back to her.

strings.text: ぼやけた記憶の中に浮かぶ男の姿。
strings.translated: The shape of a man surfacing within her blurred memories.

strings.text:
何度も何度も夢を見るが、そのたびに男の姿は遠く
なっていく。
strings.translated: She dreamed of him again and again, but each time his figure grew more distant.

strings.text:
手を伸ばしても、走り寄っても、男に触れるどころか
近付くことさえできない。
strings.translated: She reached out, she ran toward him, yet she could not even draw near him, let alone touch him.

strings.text: それが堪らなく哀しくて、それでよく目が覚めた。
strings.translated: The grief of it was unbearable, and it was what woke her, time and again.

strings.text: 膝を抱えていた夢美が、ハッと顔を上げた。
strings.translated: Yumemi, who had been hugging her knees, snapped her head up.

strings.text: 肌に触れるのは、確かな蟲の気配。
strings.translated: What brushed against her skin was the unmistakable presence of a Bug.

strings.text:
頭の中に蟲の形が立体的に浮かび上がり、その位置を
感じ取る。
strings.translated: The Bug's form rose in three dimensions inside her mind, and she sensed its exact location.

strings.text:
腰を上げるや否や走り始め、目の前の草むらに腕を
突っ込み、その奥に隠れていた蟲を鷲掴みにした。
strings.translated: The moment she rose to her feet she broke into a run, plunged her arm into the undergrowth ahead, and seized the Bug lurking within.

strings.text:
蟲は触手を伸ばして暴れようとしたが、それより先に
夢美の歯が突き立てられる。
strings.translated: The Bug extended its tentacles and tried to thrash about, but Yumemi's teeth sank into it first.

strings.text:
コウモリにも似た声を上げ、蟲の胴体がびくんっと
跳ねた。
strings.translated: It let out a cry not unlike a bat's shriek, and the Bug's body lurched and spasmed.

strings.text:
夢美
「むぢゅっ……ん、もぐっ…………」

蟲の体液を零さないよう啜りながら、齧った肉を口の
中で噛み締める。
strings.translated: She sucked carefully so as not to spill the Bug's fluids, chewing the torn flesh in her mouth.

strings.text: やや苦味が強かったが、食べられないわけではない。
strings.translated: It was somewhat bitter, but not inedible.

strings.text:
それに、森で生きていく上で味覚の役目は、その食べ
物が安全か危険かの判断だ。
strings.translated: Besides, when it came to surviving in the forest, the purpose of taste was to judge whether something was safe or dangerous.

strings.text:
味わうのではなく、その味が何の意味を持っていたか
を思い出す。
strings.translated: Not to savor the flavor, but to recall what that flavor signified.

strings.text:
そうすれば、たとえ初めて口にするものであっても、
それが自分にとって有害な蟲か無害な蟲かの区別が付
いた。
strings.translated: And so, even when tasting something for the first time, she could tell whether a Bug was harmful to her or harmless.

strings.text:
夢美
「はぐっ……もぐっ……もぐもぐっ…………」

地面に尻を着いて蟲を食うその姿は、さながら猿人の
ようだ。
strings.translated: Sitting on the ground, devouring the Bug -- she looked for all the world like some primitive ape-man.

strings.text:
左右の瞳も妖しげな光を湛え、一心不乱に蟲を喰らっ
ている。
strings.translated: Both eyes gleamed with an eerie light as she ate, utterly consumed by the act of feeding.

strings.text:
夢美は、既に自分が『櫻井夢美』である事をあまり
思い出せなくなっていたが、それでも生き続けたい
という気持ちだけは失くしていなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi could barely remember anymore that she was "Sakurai Yumemi" -- yet even so, the desire to keep living had never left her.

strings.text:
生き続ける先に、あの夢で見る男の姿を求めてい
た……。
strings.translated: And in that continued living, she sought the figure of the man she saw in her dreams...

strings.text: 痛いほどに肌を叩く大雨が、森の中に降り注いでいた。
strings.translated: A heavy rain that struck the skin like blows was pouring down through the forest.

strings.text: こんな日を、もう何度体験したのか……。
strings.translated: How many times had she lived through a day like this now...

strings.text:
最近では雨が来る前に森の深部に移動するのだが、
今日は失敗してしまった。
strings.translated: Lately she had been moving deeper into the forest before the rain came, but today she had failed.

strings.text: 雨が近付く臭いに気付くことができなかった。
strings.translated: She had not been able to catch the scent of the approaching rain.

strings.text: 溜息をついて、森の奥へと進む。
strings.translated: She let out a sigh and pressed on deeper into the forest.

strings.text:
今日の雨は長く続きそうで、しかもどんどん強くなっ
ている。
strings.translated: And today's rain showed no sign of letting up -- in fact, it was growing stronger by the moment.

strings.text: ――夜は嵐になるかもしれない。
strings.translated: -- It might turn into a storm by nightfall.

strings.text:
夢美は、漠然とそんな事を感じ取りながら、今夜の
寝る場所を探し歩いた。
strings.translated: With that vague sense drifting through her mind, Yumemi walked on, searching for a place to sleep that night.

strings.text:
森の奥深くにやって来た頃には、雨の勢いはさらに
増していた。
strings.translated: By the time she had made her way deep into the forest, the rain had grown even more intense.

strings.text:
今からこの調子では、明日は風邪を引いてしまうかも
しれない。
strings.translated: At this rate, she might catch a cold by tomorrow.

strings.text:
冷え切った体に鞭を打つようにして、とにかく前へ歩
く。
strings.translated: She whipped her exhausted body onward and kept walking, one step at a time.

strings.text:
ぬかるんだ地面に足を取られそうになったが、それで
も夢美は前へ進むのをやめなかった。
strings.translated: The muddy ground nearly caught her feet and dragged her down, but even so, Yumemi did not stop moving forward.

strings.text: こういう時、魔法の言葉がある。
strings.translated: At times like these, there was a magic word.

strings.text: 不安を和らげてくれる、不思議な言葉がある。
strings.translated: A strange word that eased her anxiety.

strings.text:
その言葉が、何の意味を持つものだったのか、夢美は
既に思い出せなくなっていた。
strings.translated: What meaning that word had once held, Yumemi could no longer remember.

strings.text:
大切な言葉だったような気がするが、昔の事はよく
思い出せない。
strings.translated: It felt like it had been a precious word, but she could not recall the old days clearly.

strings.text:
そもそも、自分がこの森で何をしているのかさえ、
夢美――だったはずの少女はよく分からなくなって
いた。
strings.translated: In the first place, even what she was doing in this forest -- the girl who had once been Yumemi no longer knew.

strings.text: もう一度、言葉を口にする。
strings.translated: She spoke the word once more.

strings.text: 口にすると、胸に熱いものが込み上げてくる。
strings.translated: Each time she spoke it, something warm welled up inside her chest.

strings.text:
理由は分からないが、とても幸せで、少しだけ寂しい
気持ちになった。
strings.translated: She did not know why, but it made her feel deeply happy, and just a little lonely.
She wanted to see someone -- from the bottom of her heart.

strings.text: 不意に、そんなふうに思う。
strings.translated: The thought came to her suddenly, without warning.

strings.text: 一瞬だけ頭の中に浮かんだ誰かに、逢いたい。
strings.translated: Someone who had flickered through her mind for just an instant -- she wanted to see them.

strings.text:
それが誰なのか分からないが、それでも逢いたくて
堪らない。
strings.translated: She did not know who it was, but the longing was unbearable.

strings.text: 記憶はなくとも、心が覚えている。
strings.translated: Even without the memories, her heart remembered.

strings.text: その心に突き動かされるようにして、森の中を進む。
strings.translated: Driven by that feeling, she pressed on through the forest.

strings.text: いつか見た誰かが、少女の前に立っていた。
strings.translated: Someone she had seen before, somewhere -- was standing before the girl.

strings.text:
右手には白い蟲を持っていて、雨に濡れながらじっと
少女を見つめていた。
strings.translated: In their hands they held a white Bug, and they stood there in the rain, silently watching the girl.

strings.text:
二人の中間には、一本の巨木が立っていて、そこまで
は雨は降り込んでいなかった。
strings.translated: Between the two of them stood a great old tree, and beneath it, the rain did not reach.

strings.text: たまたま、それが重なっただけ。
strings.translated: It just happened that the two of them coincided.

strings.text:
少女と子供は巨木の下に移動すると、その根元に腰を
落ち着けた。
strings.translated: Before long, the girl and the child moved beneath the great tree and settled down at its roots.

strings.text: 特に会話があるわけではない。
strings.translated: There was nothing in particular to talk about.

strings.text:
二人とも、黙ったまま雨の音を聞き続け、白んだ森を
見つめていた。
strings.translated: Both of them remained silent, listening to the sound of the rain, gazing out at the pale forest.

strings.text:
子供が、手に持っていた蟲を半分に割り、その片方を
少女に差し出していた。
strings.translated: The child had split the Bug they were holding in half, and held one piece out to the girl.

strings.text:
少女は暫くそれを見つめていたが、やがて大人しく
受け取り、口に運ぶ。
strings.translated: The girl stared at it for a moment, then quietly accepted it and brought it to her mouth.

strings.text: 雨の味が混じっていたが、食べるのに問題はなかった。
strings.translated: There was the taste of rain mixed in, but it posed no problem to eat.

strings.text:
今日は朝に一匹捕まえたきりだったため、食べ物に
ありつけるのは有難かった。
strings.translated: She had only caught one Bug that morning, so having something to eat was a welcome relief.

strings.text: 夜になっても、雨は一向に止む気配がなかった。
strings.translated: Even as night fell, the rain showed no sign of letting up.

strings.text:
辺りの気温はぐんぐん下がり、少女も子供もカタカタ
と震えている。
strings.translated: The temperature around them dropped steadily, and both the girl and the child were trembling.

strings.text:
凍死するほどではないが、眠れるほど余裕があるわけ
でもない。
strings.translated: It was not cold enough to kill, but not comfortable enough to sleep, either.

strings.text:
雨に濡れた体を抱き締めながら、少女は必死に寒さに
耐えた。
strings.translated: Hugging her rain-soaked body close, the girl desperately endured the cold.

strings.text: ――と、隣で子供が小さく呻いた。
strings.translated: Then -- the child beside her let out a small groan.

strings.text:
正確にはくしゃみをしたようなのだが、それでさらに
全身を縮こまらせた。
strings.translated: More precisely, it seemed they had sneezed, and it made them curl their whole body inward even further.

strings.text: 少女は、そんな子供の肩を抱いてやった……。
strings.translated: The girl put her arm around the child's shoulders...
A body that flinched with a start.

strings.text:
見上げられた瞳には驚きが混じり、口はぽかんと開け
られていた。
strings.translated: The eyes that looked up at her held a flicker of surprise, and their mouth hung open.

strings.text:
どう声を掛けていいのか分からず、少女はただ口元に
笑みを浮かべる。
strings.translated: Not knowing what to say, the girl simply let a smile rest on her lips.

strings.text: 目を細めて、柔らかな笑顔で子供を見つめる。
strings.translated: She narrowed her eyes and gazed at the child with a soft, gentle smile.

strings.text: それを――どう受け止めたのか――――。

やがて、子供は視線を外すと、少女のほうに体を傾け
た。
strings.translated: After a moment, the child looked away, then leaned their body toward the girl.

strings.text:
触れ合った肌と肌の部分が、互いの鼓動を伝えてくれ
る……。
strings.translated: Where their skin touched, they could feel each other's heartbeat...

strings.text:
その時、ふと、少女は以前にもこんな事があったよう
な気がした。
strings.translated: In that moment, the girl suddenly felt as though something like this had happened before.

strings.text:
もっと大きな誰かと、こうして体を寄せ合いながら
過ごしたような気がする。
strings.translated: She felt as though she had spent time like this, pressed close to someone much larger.
She wanted to see someone -- from the bottom of her heart.

strings.text: また、そんな気持ちが膨らんだ……。
strings.translated: That feeling swelled within her once more...

strings.text: ある日、自分の後ろに蟲がいることに気付いた。
strings.translated: One day, she noticed there was a Bug behind her.

strings.text: 今まで見たこともないような――――
strings.translated: One she had never seen before --------

strings.text: ――しかし、何故だか懐かしさを覚える蟲がいた。
strings.translated: -- and yet, for some reason, it stirred a feeling of nostalgia within her.

strings.text: 少女が歩くと、蟲はその後ろをついて来た。
strings.translated: When the girl walked, the Bug followed behind her.

strings.text: いったい、いつからついて来ていたのか……。
strings.translated: Just how long had it been following her...

strings.text:
捕まえて食べようかとも思ったが、何故だかそんな気
にはなれなかった。
strings.translated: She considered catching it and eating it, but for some reason she could not bring herself to do so.

strings.text:
綺麗なメタリックブルーの色に魅せられたのかもしれ
ない。
strings.translated: Perhaps she had been captivated by its beautiful metallic blue color.

strings.text:
蟲は、まるで少女が自分に気付いてくれたことを喜ん
でいるかのように、ピンク色の触手を揺らしていた。
strings.translated: The Bug swayed its pink tentacles, as if rejoicing that the girl had finally noticed it.

strings.text: その程度のことを思って、少女は再び歩き始めた。
strings.translated: With that passing thought, the girl began walking again.

strings.text: 子供とは、時々森の中で出会った。
strings.translated: She would occasionally encounter the child in the forest.

strings.text:
何のために森にいるのかは知らないが、それを尋ねよ
うとは思わない。
strings.translated: She did not know why the child was in the forest, and she had no intention of asking.

strings.text: そんな思考さえ、もはや少女には浮かばなかった。
strings.translated: Such thoughts no longer even surfaced in the girl's mind.

strings.text: 時々会って、時々食べ物を交換して、時々一緒に寝る。
strings.translated: They would meet occasionally, exchange food sometimes, and sleep together sometimes.

strings.text:
繰り返される邂逅は、少しずつ少女に何かを思い出さ
せた。
strings.translated: These repeated encounters slowly brought something back to the girl's memory.

strings.text: 不意に視界に入る、長く伸びた髪。
strings.translated: Long, flowing hair that drifted into her field of vision without warning.

strings.text: 気付けば腰ほどの長さがあり、少し頭が重く感じた。
strings.translated: She realized it had grown to about waist length, and her head felt a little heavy.

strings.text: 少女は、尖った爪でそれを切ろうとしたが――――
strings.translated: The girl tried to cut it with her sharpened nails, but --------

strings.text:
？？？
『これから暫く、髪は切らないことにします』
strings.translated:
???
'From now on, I will not cut my hair for a while.'

strings.text: あれは――誰が誰に向けた言葉だったか――――。
strings.translated: That was -- whose words were those, and to whom were they spoken --------.

strings.text: 暫く髪を掴んでいた少女は、やがてそれを放した。
strings.translated: The girl, who had been gripping her hair for a moment, finally let it go.

strings.text:
切ってしまうと、何か別のものまで切れてしまいそう
で怖かった。
strings.translated: She was afraid that if she cut it, something else might get cut along with it.

strings.text: 最近では、発音さえ曖昧になってしまった言葉を呟く。
strings.translated: She murmured words whose very pronunciation had grown hazy of late.

strings.text: 頭の片隅を、誰かの笑顔が掠めた気がした……。
strings.translated: She felt as though someone's smiling face had grazed the corner of her mind...
When had it started, she wondered.

strings.text:
森の中を、少女は子供と、そして一匹の蟲とともに
歩くようになっていた。
strings.translated:
Through the forest, the girl had come to walk
 alongside the child and a single Bug.

strings.text:
――いや、何かの目的があったまま、同じような場所
を何度も何度も歩き続ける。
strings.translated: -- No, with some purpose intact, she kept walking the same kinds of places, over and over again.

strings.text: 夜になると、全員で固まって寝るようになった。
strings.translated: When night fell, they all huddled together to sleep.

strings.text:
子供と抱き合うようにして、繭のようになった蟲に
包まれて、幾つもの夜を明かした。
strings.translated: Holding the child close, wrapped in the cocoon-like Bug, she passed night after night.

strings.text:
子供と抱き合うたびに、いつか自分がそうして抱かれ
ていたような気がした。
strings.translated: Each time she held the child, she had the feeling that she herself had once been held that way.

strings.text:
とても大切な、誰かの腕に、優しく抱かれていたよう
な気がした。
strings.translated: She felt as though she had been gently held in the arms of someone very dear to her.

strings.text: 食事は相変わらず蟲だった。
strings.translated: But the food remained Bugs, as always.

strings.text: 毎日二人と一匹で探しては、その日の獲物を分け合う。
strings.translated: Every day, the two of them and the one Bug would search together and share whatever they caught.

strings.text: 蟲を獲るのが一番上手かったのは、蟲だった。
strings.translated: The one best at catching Bugs was the Bug itself.

strings.text:
森の木々の隙間から見える空が、少しずつ色を変えて
いく……。
strings.translated: The sky visible through the gaps in the forest trees slowly changed color...
The blue of summer grew thin --------

strings.text: ――そして、乾いた冬の空がやって来る。
strings.translated: And then -- the dry winter sky arrived.

strings.text:
気温以外、森にあまり変化は感じられなかったが、
時折降る雨は骨に沁みるほど痛かった。
strings.translated: Other than the temperature, the forest felt little different, but the occasional rain was cold enough to ache in her bones.

strings.text: そうして、変わらぬ毎日が過ぎていく……。
strings.translated: And so the unchanging days passed on...

strings.text:
ある日、森を歩いているところで、少女は小川が
流れる音に気付いた。
strings.translated: One day, while walking through the forest, the girl noticed the sound of a stream flowing nearby.

strings.text: 別段、珍しいことではない。

森を歩いていれば、一日のうちに二度、三度は水を
飲む。
strings.translated: Walking through the forest, she would drink water two or three times in a single day.

strings.text:
この時も、ただ喉が渇いていたから、その小川のほう
へ向かっただけだった。
strings.translated: This time too, she simply headed toward the stream because she was thirsty, nothing more.

strings.text: 小川に直接口をつけて、流れる水を飲む。
strings.translated: She pressed her lips directly to the stream and drank the flowing water.

strings.text:
子供も同じようにして飲み、それが終わればまた歩き
出す。
strings.translated: The child drank the same way, and when they were done, they set off walking again.

strings.text: ――と、不意に少女は、誰かの声を聞いた気がした。
strings.translated: -- Then, suddenly, the girl thought she heard someone's voice.

strings.text: 辺りを見回すが、自分達以外に生き物の姿はない。
strings.translated: She looked around, but there were no living creatures other than themselves.

strings.text:
子供が不思議そうに見上げてきて、ただの空耳だと
思った。
strings.translated: The child looked up at her with a puzzled expression, and she thought it must have been her imagination.

strings.text:
？？？
「う、うえっ、あ、ぁ……うぁああぁぁぁ…………」
誰かが、泣きながら、誰かを、抱いて、歩いていた。
strings.translated: Someone was walking, crying, holding someone in their arms.

strings.text:
？？？
「うあっ、あ、あぁぁ……ううぅああぁっ…………」

少女は、まるで何かに導かれるように、その誰かを
追いかけ始めた。
strings.translated: As if drawn by something, the girl began to follow after that someone.

strings.text:
？？？
「ああぁうっ……う、ひぐっ……う、うああっ……
　ひっぐ……ううぅっ、う、うあぁあぁぁ…………」
strings.translated:
???
"Aaah, ugh... u, hic... u, uaah...
 hic... uuugh, u, uaaahh............"

strings.text: 誰かが進み、少女がそれを追いかける。
strings.translated: The someone moved forward, and the girl followed after them.

strings.text:
そして少女を子供が追いかけ、その隣で蟲もまた追い
かけていた。
strings.translated: And the child followed after the girl, while the Bug followed alongside them.

strings.text: 誰かを追いかけていると、喉から嗚咽が漏れた。
strings.translated: As she chased after that someone, a sob escaped from her throat.

strings.text: 目の奥が熱くなり、徐々に視界がぼやけ始める。
strings.translated: The backs of her eyes grew hot, and her vision slowly began to blur.

strings.text: それが、いきなり零れ落ちた。
strings.translated: Then the tears spilled over, all at once.

strings.text:
少女
「あ、うっ……あぁ……っく……う、あぁ…………」
strings.translated:
Girl
"A, ugh... ah... hic... u, aah..."

strings.text:
今が哀しいのではなく、もっとずっと以前、哀しい
想いを抱えてここを通ったことがあるような気がした。
strings.translated: It was not a sadness of the present moment -- it felt as though, long, long ago, she had passed through this place carrying a grief just like this.
Why had she been so sad?

strings.text: それは、とても、大切な、何かを――――――――
strings.translated: Because something very, very precious had been --

strings.text:
？？？
「うあぁっ、ゆ、と……さん……っく、あぁ…………
　ゆ、とぉ……ゆぅと、さぁん…………ッ！！」

もう、どうしようもないくらい、涙が溢れて止まらな
い。
strings.translated: The tears spilled over and would not stop, beyond all hope of holding them back.

strings.text: とても哀しいことがあって――――
締め付けられるくらい胸が痛くて――――
strings.translated: Her chest ached as though it were being wrung tight --
She kept calling out a name --

strings.text: 誰かが、泣きながら土を掘っていた。
strings.translated: Someone was digging at the earth, weeping as they dug.

strings.text:
何の道具も使わず、自分の指先だけで、泣きながら
地面を掘り返していた。
strings.translated: Using no tools at all -- only their own fingertips -- they tore at the ground, sobbing all the while.

strings.text:
傍らには、違う誰かが横たえられ、胸元を真っ赤に
染めている。
strings.translated: Beside them lay someone else, their chest stained a deep, vivid red.

strings.text:
？？？
「うっ……うっ……うっ……うっ……うっ……
　うっ……うっ……うっ……うっ……うぅっ……」
strings.translated:
???
"Ugh... ugh... ugh... ugh... ugh...
 ugh... ugh... ugh... ugh... uugh..."

strings.text: ただ、一心に、地面を掘る。
strings.translated: They simply dug, with single-minded devotion.

strings.text:
歩き続けた果てにたどり着いた、せめてこの綺麗な
場所に、傍らの誰かを埋めるため……。
strings.translated: At the end of all that walking, they had arrived here -- and now they dug, so that the one lying beside them might be laid to rest in this beautiful place...

strings.text: 大切なその人に、せめてもの安らぎを与えるため……。
strings.translated: So that this precious person might be given at least some measure of peace...

strings.text: それが――少女にできた精一杯の事だった――――。
strings.translated: That was all the girl had been able to do.

strings.text: 気が付けば、もう誰かはいない。
strings.translated: When she came to her senses, the someone was gone.

strings.text:
泣きながら地面を掘っていた誰かの姿は、もうどこに
もなかった。
strings.translated: The figure that had been weeping and digging at the earth was nowhere to be found.

strings.text: ただ、その代わりに、哀しいことを思い出した。
strings.translated: But in their place, she remembered something sorrowful.
They had been precious to her.

strings.text:
いなくなってしまっても、その死が受け入れられない
くらいに、心から愛し始めていた。
strings.translated: She had come to love him so deeply that even after he was gone, she could not accept his death.

strings.text: 少女が求めた人は、この場所にいた。
strings.translated: The one the girl had sought had been in this place.

strings.text: 地面にうずくまり、その場所を手のひらで撫でる。
strings.translated: She crumpled to the ground and stroked that spot with the palm of her hand.

strings.text:
冷たい土の感触が伝わってきて、それでまた少女は
泣いた。
strings.translated: The cold touch of the soil reached her, and at that, the girl wept again.

strings.text: ずっと歩き続けていた。
strings.translated: She had been walking all this time.

strings.text: ずっと探し続けていた。
strings.translated: She had been searching all this time.

strings.text:
自分でその人を弔ったことを忘れてしまうくらい、
長い間、森の中をさ迷い続けていた。
strings.translated: She had wandered through the forest for so long that she had even forgotten she was the one who had buried him here.

strings.text:
少女
「ユウトオォォォォ………………………………ッ！」
深く、哀しい声が、森の中に響いた。
strings.translated: A deep, mournful cry echoed through the forest.

strings.text:
いつまでも、いつまでも、森の中に響き続けてい
た……。
strings.translated: It echoed on and on, without end...

strings.text:
そんな報告を受けたのは、既に一年以上が経過した
ある日のことだった。
strings.translated: That report reached them on a certain day, more than a year after the fact.

strings.text:
内容は俄かには信じがたく、常識的に考えてありえな
い。
strings.translated: The contents were difficult to believe at first, and by any rational measure, impossible.

strings.text:
蟲使いにとって既に破棄された森の中で、大した訓練
も受けていない人間が、それほど長く生きられるはず
がないからだ。
strings.translated: No human with so little training should have been able to survive that long in a forest that Bug Users had already abandoned.

strings.text:
かつて、神武美弥香を救出するために送り込まれた
合蟲人間と戦い、そして散った同胞十六名と――――
strings.translated: Sixteen comrades, who had fought and fallen against the Bug-fused humans once sent in to rescue Jinmu Miyaka --

strings.text: 試験中だった蟲使いの子供、合計二十四名と――――
strings.translated: -- and the Bug User children who had been in the middle of their trials, twenty-four in all --

strings.text:
――獣魔蟲を持った少女と、それに同行していた青年
の死体が、今もその森のどこかにあるはずだった。
strings.translated: -- And somewhere in that forest, the bodies of the girl who had carried the Jumachuu, and the young man who had accompanied her, should still have been lying.

strings.text: 季節は夏が過ぎようとしている頃だった。
strings.translated: It was a time when summer was drawing to a close.

strings.text: だが、この森はそんな時期であっても肌寒い。
strings.translated: Even so, this forest was cold enough to raise goosebumps, no matter the season.

strings.text:
纏わり付いてくる空気が、嫌がらせのように体温を
奪い去ろうとする。
strings.translated: The air clung to the skin, as if spitefully trying to steal away every last trace of body heat.

strings.text: 原因の一つは、幾重にも張り巡らされた結界だ。
strings.translated: One reason for that was the barrier -- layers upon layers of it, woven throughout the forest.

strings.text: 森の外側と内側を、完全に別世界にしてしまっている。
strings.translated: It divided the outside and the inside into two completely separate worlds.

strings.text:
だから、この森には基本的には蟲使いしか入れないし、
蟲使いしか出ることもできない。
strings.translated: Because of that, only Bug Users could enter this forest -- and only Bug Users could leave it.

strings.text:
そして、森から出られなければ、その先にあるのは
死以外のなにものでもない。
strings.translated: And if one could not leave the forest, what lay ahead was nothing -- nothing but death.

strings.text: なにものでも、ないはずなのだ――――。
strings.translated: Nothing but death -- that was how it should have been.

strings.text: 森はひっそりと静まり返っていた。
strings.translated: The forest was utterly still and silent.

strings.text:
野生に棲む蟲の気配を、あちこちに感じることができ
るだけで、それ以外には特に何もない。
strings.translated: The only thing one could sense was the presence of wild Bugs here and there -- nothing else of note.

strings.text:
念のため、獣魔蟲の気配を探ってみたが、それらしい
ものは感じられなかった。
strings.translated: Just to be safe, he searched for any trace of the Jumachuu, but felt nothing of the sort.
-- There was no way she could still be alive.

strings.text:
あの程度の準備で、今まで普通に生活して来た人間が、
この森で一年以上も生き延びられるはずがない。
strings.translated: There was no way a person with so little preparation -- someone who had lived an ordinary life until now -- could survive in this forest for over a year.

strings.text:
そんなふうに考えながら、その一方で生存を信じて
探し続けているような自分がいる。
strings.translated: Even as he thought that, some part of him kept searching, kept believing she was still alive.

strings.text: 森がさらに深くなると、冷気がいっそう強くなった。
strings.translated: As the forest grew deeper, the cold intensified.

strings.text:
遠くからは小川のせせらぎが聞こえて、何気なくその
方向へと歩き出す。
strings.translated: From somewhere in the distance came the sound of a babbling brook, and without thinking, he started walking toward it.
-- There was no way she could still be alive.

strings.text: もう一度、そんなことを考える。
strings.translated: Once more, that thought crossed his mind.

strings.text:

strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Then why couldn't you answer immediately?
 Is it not because you have no such intention?"

strings.text:
史郎
「違います。助けに来たんですよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"You're wrong. I came to rescue you."

strings.text:
美弥香
「では、Ｄｒ．Ｗｅｓｔの兵隊が、未だ森の入り口で
　戦っているというのに、貴方がここに来ることがで
　きたのは何故ですか？」
strings.translated:
Miyaka
"Then why is it that you were able to come here,
 when Dr. West's soldiers are still fighting
 at the forest entrance?"

strings.text:
史郎
「それはもちろん、連中が囮で………………」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"That's because, naturally, they're acting as a decoy... ..."

strings.text:
しどろもどろになりながら説明する男の顔が、徐々に
険しくなってくる。
strings.translated:
The man fumbled through his explanation, his face gradually
growing darker.

strings.text:
明らかに美弥香が自分を疑っていることに、腹を立て
始めていた。
strings.translated:
He was clearly beginning to lose his temper at the fact that
Miyaka was doubting him.

strings.text:
史郎
「だあああああああああああっ！！」

急に男が叫んだかと思うと、いきなり首がにゅっと
伸びた。
strings.translated: The man suddenly let out a cry, and without warning his neck stretched grotesquely outward.

strings.text:
しかも、そればかりか腹から触手を生やし、それを
美弥香に絡めて来る。
strings.translated: On top of that, tentacles sprouted from his abdomen and coiled themselves around Miyaka.

strings.text:
美弥香
「ひぃっ！？　あ、貴方は、一体…………ッ！！？」

史郎
「ああ、もう、面倒臭いなぁ。
　担ぐのが嫌だったから、わざわざこんな真似までし
　たのに」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Ugh, this is such a pain.
 I went through all this trouble just so I wouldn't have to carry you."

strings.text:
史郎
「もういいよ。
　君はボクが連れて行ってあげるから」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Whatever, forget it.
 I'll take you with me myself."

strings.text:
史郎
「とりあえず、暫く眠ってて」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"For now, just sleep for a while."

strings.text:
史郎
「おやすみ、美弥香ちゃん」
首筋にちくりと痛みを感じて、美弥香は小さく呻いた。
strings.translated: Miyaka felt a sharp prick at her neck and let out a small groan.

strings.text: 何かに刺された、と気付いたときにはもう遅い。
strings.translated: By the time she realized she had been stung by something, it was already too late.

strings.text:
首を伸ばしながらニヤニヤと笑う男の前で、ゆっくり
とその場に崩れ落ちていく。
strings.translated: Before the man, who grinned and leered at her, she slowly crumpled to the ground.

strings.text:
史郎
「あとでいっぱい楽しいことしようね、美弥香ちゃ
　ん」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"We'll have lots of fun together later, Miyaka-chan."

strings.text:
男のそんな言葉を聞いて、美弥香は意識を深い闇の淵
へと落としていった……。
strings.translated:
Hearing those words from the man, Miyaka let her consciousness
slip down into the depths of a dark abyss......

strings.text: 歩き始めてから二十分後――――。
strings.translated: Twenty minutes after they had started walking -- -- -- --

strings.text:
蟲の少ない方向に歩いていくと、やがて夢美達の前に
一件の家が現れた。
strings.translated:
As they walked on toward where the Bugs were fewer, a single house
eventually came into view before Yumemi and the others.

strings.text:
近付いていくと、その周囲にさらに幾つかの家が見え
る。
strings.translated: As they drew closer, several more houses became visible nearby.

strings.text:
この森で誰かを監禁するとなれば、確かにこの場所は
有力そうだった。
strings.translated: If someone were to confine a person somewhere in this forest, this location did indeed seem like a likely candidate.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ストップ！　蟲がいるかもしれないっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Stop! There might be Bugs around!"

strings.text:
廃屋に近付こうとした夢美を、アゲハの鋭い声が制し
た。
strings.translated: Ageha's sharp voice stopped Yumemi as she tried to approach the abandoned house.

strings.text:
夢美
「あ、見張りの蟲がいるかもしれないんだっけ？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Oh right -- there might be guard Bugs, huh?"

strings.text:
ごくりと息を呑むようにして、アゲハが廃屋に視線を
向ける。
strings.translated: Ageha swallowed hard and fixed her gaze on the abandoned house.

strings.text:
夢美もつられるように家を見たが、屋内から蟲らしい
気配は感じられなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi followed her lead and looked at the house as well, but she could sense no sign of Bugs from inside.

strings.text:
念のため、慎重に扉を開けながら、そっと中の様子を
窺ってみる……。
strings.translated: Just to be safe, they carefully opened the door and quietly peered inside......

strings.text:
室内は、むっとしたカビの臭気に満ちていて、とても
簡単に足を踏み入れられるような場所ではなかった。
strings.translated: The interior was thick with the stifling stench of mold -- not the kind of place one could easily step into.

strings.text:
夢美が顔をしかめて顔を引くと、アゲハもまた眉間に
シワを寄せて咳き込む。
strings.translated: Yumemi wrinkled her face and pulled back, and Ageha too furrowed her brow and coughed.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「う～っ、これこれ。この臭いがキツイのよねぇ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Ugh -- there it is. This smell is just brutal."

Yumemi
"My nose is about to fall off."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「見たところ神武美弥香はいないみたいだし、わざわ
　ざ中に入る必要はなさそうね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Jinmu Miyaka doesn't appear to be here, so there's no need to
 bother going inside."

strings.text: 顔を引っ込めて、扉を閉める。
strings.translated: She pulled her face back and closed the door.

strings.text:
森の新鮮な空気を吸い込むと、二、三度深呼吸を繰り
返した。
strings.translated: Breathing in the fresh forest air, she took two or three deep breaths.

strings.text:
夢美
「次、どの家にしようか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Which house should we try next?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あっちのほうが順々でいいんじゃない？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Wouldn't it make sense to go in order over that way?"

strings.text:
アゲハの指差した先に、同じような家がポツポツと
見えた。
strings.translated: In the direction Ageha pointed, more houses of the same kind were scattered about.

strings.text:
どうやらこの辺り一体はかつて村だったらしく、少数
ながら人間が暮らしていた事を窺わせた。
strings.translated: It seemed this whole area had once been a village, hinting that a small number of people had lived here.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「先生から聞いたことあるけど、蟲使いは森に住んで
　たって……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I heard from Sensei once that Bug Users used to live in forests..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「たぶん、昔はこの森で生活してたのね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"They probably used to make their lives in this forest, back in the old days."

strings.text:
夢美
「ずっと昔の家なのかな？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Are these houses from way back then?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「さあ？　案外今でも、どっかの森にこういう家建て
　て暮らしてるんじゃない？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Who knows? Wouldn't surprise me if some of them still build houses like this in forests somewhere and live there even now."

strings.text: 森に住み、蟲とともに暮らす一族――――。
strings.translated: A clan that dwells in the forest, living alongside Bugs -- -- -- --

strings.text:
それが今、どういう生活を営んでいるのか知る由もな
いが、どんな生活であれ夢美が馴染めるものではない
ような気がした。
strings.translated: There was no way of knowing what kind of life they led now, but whatever it was, Yumemi had a feeling it wasn't one she could ever fit into.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「さっ、次の家を確認するわよ。
　神武美弥香がいたら、保護してさっさと森を脱出」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Come on, let's check the next house.
 If Jinmu Miyaka is there, we grab her and get out of this forest fast."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それをネタにして、神武と蟲使いのくだらない喧嘩
　を終わらせてもらう。ＯＫ？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Then we use that as leverage to put an end to the stupid feud between Jinmu and the Bug Users. OK?"

strings.text:
夢美
「終わらせてもらうって……そんな事できるの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Put an end to it... can you really do something like that?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「社長令嬢なんだから、そのくらい働いてもらわない
　と……蟲使いと神武の関係がこのまま泥沼化すると、
　関わってるアタシ達までヤバイのよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"She's the company president's daughter -- she'd better pull her weight...
If things between the Bug Users and Jinmu keep getting messier, it's going to be bad for us too, since we're caught up in it."

strings.text: アゲハの言わんとしている事は分かる。
strings.translated: She understood what Ageha was getting at.

strings.text:
既に夢美もアゲハも、そして優斗も、普通に暮らす上
では余計なことを知り過ぎてしまっている。
strings.translated: By now, both Yumemi and Ageha -- and Yuuto too -- knew far more than was good for anyone just trying to live a normal life.

strings.text:
今後、それがどんな影響を及ぼしてくるのか、考える
だけで陰鬱な気分になった。
strings.translated: Just thinking about what kind of trouble that might cause down the road was enough to put her in a gloomy mood.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「蟲使いってのは閉鎖的な一族みたいだからね、自分
　達のことも蟲のことも、あんまり他人には知られた
　くないみたいだし」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Bug Users seem to be a pretty closed-off clan -- looks like they don't want outsiders knowing too much about themselves or their Bugs."

strings.text:
次の廃屋へ向けて歩きながら、アゲハが愚痴をこぼす
ように言う。
strings.translated: Ageha spoke as if venting, her words trailing behind her as they walked toward the next abandoned house.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「そうなんだって……アンタ、蟲使いについてどこま
　で知ってるの？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"'Really?' Seriously... how much do you actually know about Bug Users?"

strings.text: 慎重に扉を開けて、部屋の中を確認する。
strings.translated: She carefully opened the door and checked inside the room.

strings.text:
夢美
「どこまでって言うか、なんかもう頭の中でまとめ切
　れてない感じで……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"How much... it's more like I can't even sort it all out in my head..."

strings.text: 美弥香がいない事を確認して、次の廃屋に移る。
strings.translated: Confirming that Miyaka wasn't there, they moved on to the next abandoned house.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「そもそもこのイザコザはね、先生……って呼ぶのも
　今更かしらね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"This whole mess started with... Sensei... though I guess calling him that is a bit much at this point."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「西って男が、アンタの蟲を見つけたところから始ま
　るのよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"It started when a man named Nishi found your Bug."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「獣魔蟲、だっけ？　それを手に入れようとして、
　アンタのマンションを襲撃……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"The Jumachuu, was it? He tried to get his hands on it, so he attacked your apartment..."

strings.text:
夢美
「だけどレンに邪魔されて失敗した？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But Ren got in the way and he failed?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「まっ、そういう事ね」
三つ目の廃屋の扉を開ける。
strings.translated: She opened the door to the third abandoned house.

strings.text:
部屋の天井から、巨大な蜘蛛のような蟲が吊り下がっ
ていた。
strings.translated: A massive spider-like Bug hung from the ceiling of the room.

strings.text:
胴体をバッサリと縦に切られ、遠目にも死んでいると
分かる。
strings.translated: Its body had been sliced clean in two lengthwise -- even from a distance, it was clearly dead.

strings.text:
だが、それがあるからといって、美弥香がいないかど
うか調べないわけにもいかない。
strings.translated: But that alone wasn't reason enough to skip checking whether Miyaka was inside or not.

strings.text:
室内を見回しながら、二人は気を紛らわすように会話
を続けた。
strings.translated: The two of them continued talking as they looked around the room, using the conversation to keep their nerves in check.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「蟲使いは、ずっとアンタと獣魔蟲のことを監視して
　た」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"The Bug Users had been watching you and the Jumachuu the whole time."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「でも、それを狙ってる奴がいることを知って、方法
　を変えざるを得なくなった」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"But when they found out someone else was after it, they had to change their approach."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「そっから先は、アンタのほうが分かるでしょ？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You probably know the rest better than I do."

strings.text: 美弥香がいない事を確認して、扉を閉める。
strings.translated: She confirmed Miyaka wasn't there and closed the door.

strings.text: 次の家は、すぐ隣だった。
strings.translated: The next house was right next door.

strings.text:
夢美
「レンに、蟲使いになれって言われたの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ren told me to become a Bug User."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「なるほどね。もしもの時のために、少しでも制御で
　きる力を付けさせようとしたってわけだ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Makes sense. He wanted to give you at least some ability to control it, just in case things went south."

strings.text:
夢美
「でも、優斗さんにそのあたりの事を話しちゃって、
　それでこの森に…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But I told Yuuto-san about all of that, and that's how I ended up in this forest..."

strings.text:
夢美
「一週間、生き延びろって……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"He said to survive for one week..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「要するに、一週間で生かすか殺すか判断するつもり
　だったのね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"So basically, they were planning to decide whether to let you live or kill you within that one week."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「この森でなら、何人殺しても外に漏れる心配はない
　し……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"And out here in this forest, they wouldn't have to worry about word getting out no matter how many people they killed..."

strings.text: 丹念に室内を見回すが、美弥香の姿は見当たらない。
strings.translated: She looked carefully around the room, but there was no sign of Miyaka.

strings.text: 扉を閉めて深呼吸をして、次の廃屋に移動した。
strings.translated: She took a deep breath to calm herself, then moved on to the next abandoned house.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「……っていうか、それを考えるとアタシも殺される
　可能性大だったわけじゃない」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"...Actually, thinking about it that way, I was pretty likely to get killed too, wasn't I."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ホント、危ないところだったわ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"That was a really close call."

strings.text:
夢美
「そういえば、アゲハちゃんは蟲のモニター役だった
　から捕まったの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Come to think of it, were you caught because you were a Bug monitor?"

strings.text:
夢美
「酷いことされなかった？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Did they do anything awful to you?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「誘拐されるとき、抵抗したら無理やり引きずられた
　りしたけどね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"When they kidnapped me, I resisted and they dragged me off by force..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「監禁されてからは、あとで話を聞くって言われて
　それきりだったし……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"But after they locked me up, they just said they'd talk to me later, and that was it..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「きっと西のことよ。
　彼等、殆ど情報を掴んでなかったみたいだしね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"About Nishi, most likely. It seems they barely had any information on him."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「逃げ出さなかったら、きっと蟲で拷問だったんだろ
　うなぁ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"If I hadn't escaped, they probably would've tortured me with Bugs."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ううっ、考えただけで寒気がしてきたわ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Ugh, just thinking about it gives me the chills."

strings.text:
アゲハが自分の体を抱き締めるようにして、ぶるっと
肩を震わせる。
strings.translated: Ageha hugged herself tightly and shuddered, her shoulders trembling.

strings.text:
夢美も、不意に自分の過去を思い出してしまい、同じ
ように体を震わせた。
strings.translated: Yumemi, too, suddenly found herself recalling her own past, and shivered in the same way.

strings.text:
話しながら廃屋を調べているのだが、美弥香の姿は
どこにも見当たらなかった。
strings.translated: They had been searching the abandoned houses while talking, but Miyaka was nowhere to be found.

strings.text: 残された家の数は三軒。

そのどれかに美弥香がいるのか、それともここ以外の
場所なのか、或いは――――
strings.translated: Was Miyaka in one of them, or somewhere else entirely -- or perhaps...

strings.text:
？？？
「そんなところ、探しても無駄だよ」

不意に人の声が聞こえて、夢美とアゲハは勢いよく
振り返った。
strings.translated: A sudden voice made Yumemi and Ageha spin around sharply.

strings.text:
蟲使いがやって来たのかと思い、心臓が口から飛び出
しそうになる。
strings.translated: Thinking a Bug User had come for them, their hearts nearly leapt out of their chests.

strings.text:
だが、そこに立っていたのは夢美の知った顔で、アゲ
ハと出会った時と同じくらい意外な人物だった。
strings.translated: But the figure standing there was a face Yumemi recognized -- someone just as unexpected as when she had first met Ageha.

strings.text: 何故だか、アゲハが憎々しげな視線を向ける。
strings.translated: For some reason, Ageha fixed him with a look of deep contempt.

strings.text:
夢美にとってはＡｎｚＵの客、及び優斗の友人なのだ
が、アゲハにはそれ以外の関係があるらしい。
strings.translated: To Yumemi, he was a regular at AnzU and a friend of Yuuto's -- but it seemed Ageha had a different kind of history with him.

strings.text:
史郎
「君達、神武美弥香を探してるんだろう？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"You two are looking for Jinmu Miyaka, aren't you?"

strings.text:
史郎
「彼女の居場所なら、ボクが知ってるよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"If it's her whereabouts you want, I know where she is."

strings.text:
にっこりと笑顔を浮かべる史郎に、夢美はどう反応し
ていいか分からなかった。
strings.translated: Shirou smiled pleasantly, and Yumemi had no idea how to react.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あった！　ここよっ！！」

アゲハの微かな記憶と勘を頼りに進んで行くと、やが
て夢美達の目の前に一件の家が現れた。
strings.translated: Following Ageha's faint memories and instincts, they pressed on until a single house appeared before Yumemi and the others.

strings.text:
近付いていくと、その周囲にさらに幾つかの家が見え
る。
strings.translated: As they drew closer, several more houses became visible nearby.

strings.text:
この森で誰かを監禁するとなれば、確かにこの場所は
有力そうだった。
strings.translated: If someone were to confine a person somewhere in this forest, this location did indeed seem like a likely candidate.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ストップ！　蟲がいるかもしれないっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Stop! There might be Bugs around!"

strings.text:
廃屋に近付こうとした夢美を、アゲハの鋭い声が制し
た。
strings.translated: Ageha's sharp voice stopped Yumemi as she tried to approach the abandoned house.

strings.text:
優斗
「あ、蟲が見張ってるかもしれないんだっけ？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Oh right, there might be Bugs standing guard?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「見張りっていうか、逃げ出したときに捕まえるため
　の蟲よ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Less like guards, more like Bugs set to catch anyone who tries to escape."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アタシの時は、部屋の天井に大きな蜘蛛みたいなの
　が張り付いてて……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"When I was held, there was something like a giant spider clinging to the ceiling of the room..."

strings.text:
その時のことを思い出したのか、アゲハが自分の体を
抱き締めてブルブルと震える。
strings.translated: As if reliving that moment, Ageha hugged herself and trembled violently.

strings.text:
夢美
「それ、よく逃げられたね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"How did you even manage to escape from that?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「まさか、蟲のほうから勝手にいなくなっただけよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Believe it or not, the Bug just disappeared on its own."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ただ運が良かったのかと思ってたけど……もしかす
　ると、あの時から何か起こってたのかもね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I thought it was just good luck at the time, but... maybe something had already started happening back then."

strings.text:
廃屋をじっと見つめながら、アゲハが真面目な顔をし
て言う。
strings.translated: Ageha said it with a serious expression, staring intently at the abandoned house.

strings.text:
夢美もつられるように家を見たが、屋内から蟲らしい
気配は感じられなかった。
strings.translated: Yumemi followed her lead and looked at the house as well, but she could sense no sign of Bugs from inside.

strings.text:
念のため、慎重に扉を開けながら、そっと中の様子を
窺ってみる……。
strings.translated: Just to be safe, they carefully opened the door and quietly peered inside......

strings.text:
室内は、むっとしたカビの臭気に満ちていて、とても
簡単に足を踏み入れられるような場所ではなかった。
strings.translated: The interior was thick with the stifling stench of mold -- not the kind of place one could easily step into.

strings.text:
夢美が顔をしかめて顔を引くと、アゲハもまた眉間に
シワを寄せて咳き込む。
strings.translated: Yumemi wrinkled her face and pulled back, and Ageha too furrowed her brow and coughed.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「う～っ、これこれ。この臭いがキツイのよねぇ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Ugh -- there it is. This smell is just brutal."

Yumemi
"My nose is about to fall off."

strings.text:
優斗
「こんなところに閉じ込めるなんて……」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"To lock someone up in a place like this..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「見たところ神武美弥香はいないみたいだし、わざわ
　ざ中に入る必要はなさそうね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Jinmu Miyaka doesn't appear to be here, so there's no need to
 bother going inside."

strings.text: 顔を引っ込めて、扉を閉める。
strings.translated: She pulled her face back and closed the door.

strings.text:
森の新鮮な空気を吸い込むと、二、三度深呼吸を繰り
返した。
strings.translated: Breathing in the fresh forest air, she took two or three deep breaths.

strings.text:
夢美
「次、どの家にしようか？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Which house should we try next?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「あっちのほうが順々でいいんじゃない？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Wouldn't it make sense to go in order over that way?"

strings.text:
アゲハの指差した先に、同じような家がポツポツと
見えた。
strings.translated: In the direction Ageha pointed, more houses of the same kind were scattered about.

strings.text:
どうやらこの辺り一体はかつて村だったらしく、少数
ながら人間が暮らしていた事を窺わせた。
strings.translated: It seemed this whole area had once been a village, hinting that a small number of people had lived here.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「先生から聞いたことあるけど、蟲使いは森に住んで
　たって……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"I heard from Sensei once that Bug Users used to live in forests..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「たぶん、昔はこの森で生活してたのね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"They probably used to make their lives in this forest, back in the old days."

strings.text:
優斗
「ずっと昔に使われてた家なのかな？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"So these are houses that were used way back in the old days?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「さあ？　案外今でも、どっかの森にこういう家建て
　て暮らしてるんじゃない？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Who knows? Wouldn't surprise me if some of them still build houses like this in forests somewhere and live there even now."

strings.text: 森に住み、蟲とともに暮らす一族――――。
strings.translated: A clan that dwells in the forest, living alongside Bugs -- -- -- --

strings.text:
それが今、どういう生活を営んでいるのか知る由もな
いが、どんな生活であれ夢美が馴染めるものではない
ような気がした。
strings.translated: There was no way of knowing what kind of life they led now, but whatever it was, Yumemi had a feeling it wasn't one she could ever fit into.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「さっ、次の家を確認するわよ。
　神武美弥香がいたら、保護してさっさと森を脱出」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Come on, let's check the next house.
 If Jinmu Miyaka is there, we grab her and get out of this forest fast."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それをネタにして、神武と蟲使いのくだらない喧嘩
　を終わらせてもらう。ＯＫ？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Then we use that as leverage to put an end to the stupid feud between Jinmu and the Bug Users. OK?"

strings.text:
夢美
「終わらせてもらうって……そんな事できるの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Put an end to it... can you really do something like that?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「社長令嬢なんだから、そのくらい働いてもらわない
　と……蟲使いと神武の関係がこのまま泥沼化すると、
　関わってるアタシ達までヤバイのよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"She's the company president's daughter -- she'd better pull her weight...
If things between the Bug Users and Jinmu keep getting messier, it's going to be bad for us too, since we're caught up in it."

strings.text:
優斗
「そんな感じはするよなぁ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Yeah, that's kind of the feeling I get."

strings.text: アゲハの言わんとしている事は分かる。
strings.translated: She understood what Ageha was getting at.

strings.text:
既に夢美もアゲハも、そして優斗も、普通に暮らす上
では余計なことを知り過ぎてしまっている。
strings.translated: By now, both Yumemi and Ageha -- and Yuuto too -- knew far more than was good for anyone just trying to live a normal life.

strings.text:
今後、それがどんな影響を及ぼしてくるのか、考える
だけで陰鬱な気分になった。
strings.translated: Just thinking about what kind of trouble that might cause down the road was enough to put her in a gloomy mood.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「蟲使いってのは閉鎖的な一族みたいだからね、自分
　達のことも蟲のことも、あんまり他人には知られた
　くないみたいだし」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Bug Users seem to be a pretty closed-off clan -- looks like they don't want outsiders knowing too much about themselves or their Bugs."

strings.text:
次の廃屋へ向けて歩きながら、アゲハが愚痴をこぼす
ように言う。
strings.translated: Ageha spoke as if venting, her words trailing behind her as they walked toward the next abandoned house.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「そうなんだって……アンタ、蟲使いについてどこま
　で知ってるの？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"'Really?' Seriously... how much do you actually know about Bug Users?"

strings.text: 慎重に扉を開けて、部屋の中を確認する。
strings.translated: She carefully opened the door and checked inside the room.

strings.text:
夢美
「どこまでって言うか、なんかもう頭の中でまとめ切
　れてない感じで……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"How much... it's more like I can't even sort it all out in my head..."

strings.text: 美弥香がいない事を確認して、次の廃屋に移る。
strings.translated: Confirming that Miyaka wasn't there, they moved on to the next abandoned house.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「そもそもこのイザコザはね、先生……って呼ぶのも
　今更かしらね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"This whole mess started with... Sensei... though I guess calling him that is a bit much at this point."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「西って男が、アンタの蟲を見つけたところから始ま
　るのよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"It started when a man named Nishi found your Bug."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「獣魔蟲、だっけ？　それを手に入れようとして、
　アンタのマンションを襲撃……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"The Jumachuu, was it? He tried to get his hands on it, so he attacked your apartment..."

strings.text:
夢美
「だけどレンに邪魔されて失敗した？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But Ren got in the way and he failed?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「まっ、そういう事ね」
三つ目の廃屋の扉を開ける。
strings.translated: She opened the door to the third abandoned house.

strings.text:
部屋の天井から、巨大な蜘蛛のような蟲が吊り下がっ
ていた。
strings.translated: A massive spider-like Bug hung from the ceiling of the room.

strings.text:
胴体をバッサリと縦に切られ、遠目にも死んでいると
分かる。
strings.translated: Its body had been sliced clean in two lengthwise -- even from a distance, it was clearly dead.

strings.text:
だが、それがあるからといって、美弥香がいないかど
うか調べないわけにもいかない。
strings.translated: But that alone wasn't reason enough to skip checking whether Miyaka was inside or not.

strings.text:
室内を見回しながら、二人は気を紛らわすように会話
を続けた。
strings.translated: The two of them continued talking as they looked around the room, using the conversation to keep their nerves in check.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「蟲使いは、ずっとアンタと獣魔蟲のことを監視して
　た」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"The Bug Users had been watching you and the Jumachuu the whole time."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「でも、それを狙ってる奴がいることを知って、方法
　を変えざるを得なくなった」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"But when they found out someone else was after it, they had to change their approach."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「そっから先は、アンタのほうが分かるでしょ？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You probably know the rest better than I do."

strings.text: 美弥香がいない事を確認して、扉を閉める。
strings.translated: She confirmed Miyaka wasn't there and closed the door.

strings.text: 次の家は、すぐ隣だった。
strings.translated: The next house was right next door.

strings.text:
夢美
「レンに、蟲使いになれって言われたの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Ren told me to become a Bug User."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「なるほどね。もしもの時のために、少しでも制御で
　きる力を付けさせようとしたってわけだ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Makes sense. He wanted to give you at least some ability to control it, just in case things went south."

strings.text:
夢美
「でも、優斗さんにそのあたりの事を話しちゃって、
　それでこの森に…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But I told Yuuto-san about all of that, and that's how I ended up in this forest..."

strings.text:
夢美
「一週間、生き延びろって……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"He said to survive for one week..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「要するに、一週間で生かすか殺すか判断するつもり
　だったのね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"So basically, they were planning to decide whether to let you live or kill you within that one week."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「この森でなら、何人殺しても外に漏れる心配はない
　し……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"And out here in this forest, they wouldn't have to worry about word getting out no matter how many people they killed..."

strings.text: 丹念に室内を見回すが、美弥香の姿は見当たらない。
strings.translated: She looked carefully around the room, but there was no sign of Miyaka.

strings.text: 扉を閉めて深呼吸をして、次の廃屋に移動した。
strings.translated: She took a deep breath to calm herself, then moved on to the next abandoned house.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「……っていうか、それを考えるとアタシも殺される
　可能性大だったわけじゃない」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"...Actually, thinking about it that way, I was pretty likely to get killed too, wasn't I."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ホント、危ないところだったわ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"That was a really close call."

strings.text:
夢美
「そういえば、アゲハちゃんは何で捕まったの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Come to think of it, why were you captured, Ageha-chan?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「おおかた、西って男のモニターだって事がバレたん
　でしょ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Most likely they found out I was testing Bugs for that man Nishi."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「蟲を使う仕事になるから、蟲使いとしてはほったら
　かしにはできなかったのね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Since that's work that uses Bugs, the Bug Users couldn't just leave it alone."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「……どっから情報が漏れたのかは分からないけど」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"...I don't know how the information leaked, but..."

strings.text:
夢美
「酷いことされなかった？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Did they do anything awful to you?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「誘拐されるとき、抵抗したら無理やり引きずられた
　りしたけどね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"When they kidnapped me, I resisted and they dragged me off by force..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「監禁されてからは、あとで話を聞くって言われて
　それきりだったし……」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"But after they locked me up, they just said they'd talk to me later, and that was it..."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「きっと西のことよ。
　彼等、殆ど情報を掴んでなかったみたいだしね」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"About Nishi, most likely. It seems they barely had any information on him."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「逃げ出さなかったら、きっと蟲で拷問だったんだろ
　うなぁ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"If I hadn't escaped, they probably would've tortured me with Bugs."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ううっ、考えただけで寒気がしてきたわ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Ugh, just thinking about it gives me the chills."

strings.text:
アゲハが自分の体を抱き締めるようにして、ぶるっと
肩を震わせる。
strings.translated: Ageha hugged herself tightly and shuddered, her shoulders trembling.

strings.text:
夢美も、不意に自分の過去を思い出してしまい、同じ
ように体を震わせた。
strings.translated: Yumemi, too, suddenly found herself recalling her own past, and shivered in the same way.

strings.text:
優斗
「ここじゃなかったのかな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Maybe she's not here after all."

strings.text:
話しながら廃屋を調べているのだが、美弥香の姿は
どこにも見当たらなかった。
strings.translated: They had been searching the abandoned houses while talking, but Miyaka was nowhere to be found.

strings.text: 残された家の数は三軒。

そのどれかに美弥香がいるのか、それともここ以外の
場所なのか、或いは――――
strings.translated: Was Miyaka in one of them, or somewhere else entirely -- or perhaps...

strings.text:
？？？
「そんなところ、探しても無駄だよ」

不意に人の声が聞こえて、夢美とアゲハは勢いよく
振り返った。
strings.translated: A sudden voice made Yumemi and Ageha spin around sharply.

strings.text:
蟲使いがやって来たのかと思い、心臓が口から飛び出
しそうになる。
strings.translated: Thinking a Bug User had come for them, their hearts nearly leapt out of their chests.

strings.text:
だが、そこに立っていたのは夢美の知った顔で、アゲ
ハと出会った時と同じくらい意外な人物だった。
strings.translated: But the figure standing there was a face Yumemi recognized -- someone just as unexpected as when she had first met Ageha.

strings.text: 何故だか、アゲハが憎々しげな視線を向ける。
strings.translated: For some reason, Ageha fixed him with a look of deep contempt.

strings.text:
夢美にとってはＡｎｚＵの客、及び優斗の友人なのだ
が、アゲハにはそれ以外の関係があるらしい。
strings.translated: To Yumemi, he was a regular at AnzU and a friend of Yuuto's -- but it seemed Ageha had a different kind of history with him.

strings.text:
優斗
「お前……なんで、ここに…………？」

史郎
「君達、神武美弥香を探してるんだろう？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"You two are looking for Jinmu Miyaka, aren't you?"

strings.text:
史郎
「彼女の居場所なら、ボクが知ってるよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"If it's her whereabouts you want, I know where she is."

strings.text:
にっこりと笑顔を浮かべる史郎に、夢美はどう反応し
ていいか分からなかった。
strings.translated: Shirou smiled pleasantly, and Yumemi had no idea how to react.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「神武美弥香の居場所、なんでアンタが知ってるの
　よ？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Why would you know where Jinmu Miyaka is?"

strings.text:
敵意を剥き出しにした視線を送りつけて、アゲハが
もっともな疑問を口にした。
strings.translated: Ageha shot him a look of undisguised hostility and voiced the perfectly reasonable question.

strings.text:
対して史郎は笑顔を崩さないまま、くつくつと肩を
揺らしながら答える。
strings.translated: In response, Shirou kept his smile intact and answered with a quiet chuckle, his shoulders shaking.

strings.text:
史郎
「もちろん、ボクが助けたからだよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Because I rescued her, of course."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「助けた？　アンタが？」

史郎
「森の外側に近いところで、ユーリア達が戦ってるん
　だろう？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Yulia and the others are fighting near the outer edge of the forest, aren't they?"

strings.text:
史郎
「その間、ボクは森の中から連中を叩いておいたん
　だ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"While that was going on, I was striking at those people from inside the forest."

strings.text:
夢美
「叩いたって、まさか蟲使いを……？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Striking -- you mean you took on Bug Users...?"

strings.text:
史郎
「君達さぁ、仮にここに神武のお嬢様がいたとして、
　蟲使いが誰もいないなんてこと、あると思ってた
　の？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Did you all really think that even if Jinmu's young lady was here, there'd be no Bug Users guarding her?"

strings.text:
史郎
「ボクが先にやっつけたからに決まってるじゃない
　か」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Because I took them out first, obviously."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アンタにそんな力があるっていうの？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You're saying you have that kind of power?"

strings.text:
史郎
「これでも蟲の使い方は、君よりも上手いつもりだ
　よ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"I'd like to think my way with Bugs is better than yours."

strings.text: 史郎の顔が、初めて侮蔑を含んだ表情に変わる。
strings.translated: For the first time, Shirou's expression shifted to one tinged with contempt.

strings.text:
それは、アゲハのみに向けられた感情ではあったが、
夢美はぞくりとしたものを感じ取って息を呑んだ。
strings.translated: It was a feeling directed at Ageha alone, but Yumemi felt a chill run through her and held her breath.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「どこにいるのよ、神武美弥香は……？」

史郎
「あっちのほうだよ。
　小さな洞窟みたいな場所があって、そこに捕らわれ
　てたんだ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Over that way. There's a place like a small cave, and that's where she was being held."

strings.text:
史郎の指差すほうに視線を向けると、小高い丘があっ
た。
strings.translated: Following the direction Shirou pointed, they saw a small hill.

strings.text: どうやら、その先にいると言っているらしい。
strings.translated: Apparently, he was saying she was somewhere beyond it.

strings.text:
夢美とアゲハは互いに顔を見合わせると、果たして
史郎の言葉を信じていいものかどうか、困惑気味の
表情を浮かべた……。
strings.translated: Yumemi and Ageha looked at each other, their expressions uncertain, unsure whether to trust Shirou's words...

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ちょうどいいわ。
　アンタに聞きたいことがあったのよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Perfect timing. There's something I wanted to ask you."

strings.text:
何かを思い出したように、アゲハが史郎のほうを向い
て言った。
strings.translated: As if remembering something, Ageha turned toward Shirou and spoke.

strings.text:
表情にはどことなく怒気が混じっていて、声のトーン
もいつもより低く感じられる。
strings.translated: Her expression carried a trace of anger, and her voice sounded lower than usual.

strings.text:
史郎
「何かな？　手短にお願いしたいけど」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"What is it? Please make it quick."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「彼女の……櫻井夢美の過去、嘘ついたのはなん
　で？」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Her... why did you lie about Sakurai Yumemi's past?"

strings.text:
史郎
「嘘？　別に嘘をついたつもりはないけどなぁ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Lie? I don't think I lied about anything."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「ふざけるんじゃないわよっ！
　櫻井夢美は、蟲の世話をする代わりにお金をもらっ
　てるって言ったのアンタでしょっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"Don't play dumb with me!
You're the one who said Sakurai Yumemi was getting paid in exchange for taking care of the Bug!!"

strings.text:
史郎
「確かに言ったけど、ボク、その話の前に未確認の
　情報だけどって伝えたはずだよ？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"I did say that, but I'm pretty sure I told you beforehand that it was unconfirmed information, didn't I?"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それは……確かに言ってたけど、ものすごく本当の
　事っぽく話したじゃないっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You did say that, but... you talked about it like it was completely true!!"

strings.text:
史郎
「それは君がそう解釈しただけだよ。
　ボクだって、本当のことを知ったのは最近なんだか
　ら……」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"That's just how you interpreted it.
I only found out the truth myself recently, so..."

strings.text: ニヤニヤと笑いながら、史郎が弁明する。
strings.translated: Shirou defended himself with a smirk on his face.

strings.text:
だが、そこに間違った情報を伝えてしまった罪悪感の
ようなものは一切感じられない。
strings.translated: But there wasn't even a trace of guilt about having passed along false information.

strings.text:
嘘を伝えたのではないかと疑いたくなるのも、無理の
ない話だった。
strings.translated: It was only natural to suspect that he had done so intentionally.

strings.text:
史郎
「まあ、積もる話はあると思うけど、今は神武美弥香
　を助けたほうがいいんじゃない？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Well, I'm sure there's a lot to talk about, but shouldn't we focus on rescuing Jinmu Miyaka right now?"

strings.text:
史郎
「また、蟲使いが来ると厄介だしね」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"It'd be a real pain if more Bug Users showed up."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アンタ……あとで絶対ホントのことを聞かせてもら
　うわよ」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You... I'm definitely getting the truth out of you later."

strings.text:
悔しげに言うアゲハに、史郎がふんっと鼻を鳴らし
た。
strings.translated: Shirou gave a dismissive snort at Ageha, who spoke with barely concealed frustration.

strings.text:
優斗
「史郎……お前……これって…………」

史郎
「はははっ、そんな顔するなよ。
　蟲が使えるってだけで、ボクはボクだ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Hahaha, don't make that face.
I can use Bugs, but I'm still me."

strings.text:
史郎
「今まで通りに付き合ってくれたらいいんだよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Just treat me the same as always."

strings.text:
どう反応していいか分からない様子で、優斗がうなず
く。
strings.translated: Yuuto nodded, looking like he didn't know how to react.

strings.text:
その表情には、大学の友人がこういった世界に関わっ
ていたと言う事に対する、戸惑いの色が浮かんでいた。
strings.translated: On his face was a look of bewilderment -- the kind that comes from learning a college friend had been involved in a world like this.

strings.text: 史郎の言葉に、笑顔を浮かべたものはいなかった。
strings.translated: Not one of them smiled at Shirou's words.

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲の死骸があったの」

史郎が歩き出そうとしたとき、夢美はある確信を胸に
抱きながら呟いていた。
strings.translated: When Shirou was about to start walking, Yumemi murmured, holding a certain conviction in her chest.

strings.text:
史郎とアゲハが、ほぼ同時にきょとんとした表情を
浮かべる。
strings.translated: Shirou and Ageha both wore puzzled expressions at almost the same time.

strings.text:
突然、蟲の死骸の話などされても、意味が分からなく
て当然だ。
strings.translated: Suddenly being told about a Bug's corpse out of nowhere -- it was only natural they wouldn't understand.

strings.text:
夢美
「私達が調べた家の中に、一軒だけ大きな蜘蛛みたい
　な蟲が死んでたの」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"In one of the houses we searched, there was a dead Bug that looked like a big spider."

strings.text:
夢美
「アゲハちゃんに聞いたんだけど、蟲使いに監禁され
　たとき、大きな蟲に見張られてたって」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I asked Ageha-chan, and she said that when she was held captive by a Bug User, she was watched over by a large Bug."

strings.text:
夢美
「だからあの蟲も、誰かを見張るために家の中にいた
　のかもしれない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"So maybe that Bug was also inside the house to keep watch over someone."

strings.text:
夢美の話を聞いているうちに、史郎の表情から笑みが
消えていく。
strings.translated: As he listened to Yumemi, the smile faded from Shirou's face.

strings.text:
夢美が確信を持っていることを、史郎もまた確信を
持って理解していた。
strings.translated: Shirou, too, could tell with certainty that Yumemi was sure of it.

strings.text:
夢美
「あの蟲は、まだ死んであんまり時間が経ってなかっ
　た気がする」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I don't think much time had passed since that Bug died."

strings.text:
夢美
「最近……ううん、もしかすると、たった数時間前に
　殺されたのかもしれない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Recently... no, maybe it was killed just a few hours ago."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それって、つまり…………」

ようやく夢美の言わんとしている事が分かったのか、
アゲハが驚いたように目を丸くする。
strings.translated: As if finally grasping what Yumemi was trying to say, Ageha's eyes went wide with surprise.

strings.text:
夢美
「誰かを見張ってた蟲が、誰かに殺された」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"A Bug that was keeping watch over someone was killed -- by someone."

strings.text:
夢美
「今の状況を考えれば、見張ってた相手は美弥香さん
　に間違いない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Given the current situation, the one being watched over was definitely Miyaka-san."

strings.text:
夢美
「じゃあ、誰が蟲を殺して、そこにいたはずの美弥香
　さんはどうなったの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"So then, who killed the Bug -- and what happened to Miyaka-san, who should have been there?"

strings.text: 一つ一つ情報を整理しながら言葉を紡ぐ。
strings.translated: She chose her words carefully, sorting through the information one piece at a time.

strings.text:
話し始めた部分は半信半疑だった部分もあったのだが、
筋道を立てて考えると、答えは自ずと導き出されるよ
うな気がした。
strings.translated: When she first started talking, part of her had still been uncertain, but as she laid it out logically, the answer seemed to present itself naturally.

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲使いがそんな事するはずがない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"There's no way a Bug User would do something like that."

strings.text:
夢美
「でも、ユーリアさんか唯さんが助けたのなら、すぐ
　に美弥香さんを連れて森から出ようとするはず」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But if Yulia-san or Yui-san had rescued her, they would have tried to get Miyaka-san out of the forest right away."

strings.text:
夢美
「でも、救出しに来てる人達が助けたのなら、すぐ
　に美弥香さんを連れて森から出ようとするはず」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But if the people who came to rescue her had helped her, they would have tried to get Miyaka-san out of the forest right away."

strings.text:
夢美
「それなのに、あなたが美弥香さんの居場所を知って
　るってことは…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"And yet, the fact that you know where Miyaka-san is means......"

strings.text:
見張りの蟲を殺し、もともと監禁されていたはずの
廃屋から美弥香を連れ出した人物は、もはや一人し
かあり得ない。
strings.translated: The person who killed the watchful Bug and led Miyaka out of the abandoned house where she had been held captive -- there could only be one.

strings.text:
夢美
「神武美弥香は……あなたが隠したんでしょう？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Jinmu Miyaka...... you're the one who hid her, aren't you?"

strings.text:
夢美が真っ直ぐな視線を向けて言うと、微かに史郎の
体が震えたように見えた。
strings.translated: When Yumemi fixed him with a direct stare and spoke, Shirou's body seemed to tremble ever so slightly.

strings.text:
肯定も否定もしないが、表情だけはどんどん醜悪な
笑みにゆがんでいく。
strings.translated: He neither confirmed nor denied it, but his expression kept twisting into an uglier and uglier grin.

strings.text: 言葉にしなくとも、回答は得られたようなものだった。
strings.translated: Even without words, it was as good as an answer.

strings.text:
史郎
「あんまり頭は良くなさそうに見えたんだけどなぁ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"You didn't look like you were all that smart, though."

strings.text:
困ったように頭を掻きながら、史郎がくつくつと喉を
鳴らす。
strings.translated: Scratching his head as if troubled, Shirou let out a low chuckle in his throat.

strings.text:
史郎
「その通りだよ。
　神武のお嬢様はボクが確保した」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"That's right.
 I'm the one who secured the Jinmu young lady."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「確保ですってぇ……」

史郎
「監禁場所を見つけたのはたまたまでね、せっかくな
　んでボクがもらっちゃう事にしたんだ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Finding the place where she was being held was pure coincidence -- and since the opportunity was right there, I decided to take her for myself."

strings.text:
史郎
「どうせ先生だってお嬢様が助かるかどうかなんて
　二の次だし、何よりこの森には獣魔蟲がいるはず
　だからね」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"After all, the doctor couldn't care less whether the young lady lives or dies, and more importantly, the Jumachuu should be somewhere in this forest."

strings.text:
史郎
「ああ、そうそう。君が捕まってくれたおかげで、
　この森を見つけることができたよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Oh, right, right. Thanks to you getting captured, I was able to find this forest."

strings.text:
史郎
「その点については、本当に感謝してる」

アゲハ
「何よ、それ……まさか………………ッ！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"What do you mean...... don't tell me..............................!!"

strings.text:
史郎
「表向き、ただの一般人のはずの君を、蟲使いがどう
　して捕まえたと思う？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Why do you think a Bug User would bother capturing you -- someone who's supposed to be just an ordinary civilian?"

strings.text:
史郎
「ボクが連中にリークしたからに決まってるじゃない
　か」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Obviously because I leaked your information to them."

strings.text: 言いながら、史郎がさも楽しそうに腹を抱える。
strings.translated: As he said it, Shirou clutched his sides as if thoroughly amused.

strings.text:
アゲハが死ぬかもしれない目にあった事など、まるで
気にしていないようだった。
strings.translated: He seemed utterly unconcerned that Ageha had nearly lost her life.

strings.text:
アゲハ
「アンタ……アタシを囮に使ったわねっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You...... you used me as bait!!"

strings.text:
史郎
「まあね。ここを調べる方法は幾つかあったけど、
　一番手っ取り早い方法を使わせてもらったんだよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Well, yes. There were several ways to investigate this place, but I went with the quickest method available."

strings.text:
史郎
「だって仕方ないだろう。
　元はと言えば、夢美ちゃんを横取りしようとした
　君の責任なんだから」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Well, what was I supposed to do?
 When you get right down to it, it's your own fault for trying to steal Yumemi-chan away."

strings.text:
せせら笑う史郎の言葉に、アゲハの体がびくんっと
震えた。
strings.translated: At Shirou's mocking words, Ageha's body gave a sharp shudder.

strings.text:
夢美には何のことか分からないが、どうやらアゲハに
は理解できたらしい。
strings.translated: Yumemi had no idea what he was referring to, but it seemed Ageha understood perfectly well.

strings.text:
史郎
「先生が君の勝手な行動を見抜けなかったとでも思う
　のかい？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Did you really think the doctor hadn't seen through your little scheme?"

strings.text:
史郎
「本当は櫻井夢美を横取りして、恨みでも晴らそうと
　したんだろうけど、お粗末にもそっちも失敗してく
　れるんだもんなぁ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"You were trying to steal Sakurai Yumemi away and settle some grudge -- but you went and botched that too, didn't you."

strings.text:
史郎
「ああ、気にしなくていいよ。
　彼女の場合、ただの逆恨みだし」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Ah, don't worry about it.
 In her case, it's just a petty grudge."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「それはアンタが、嘘を教えたからでしょうっ！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"That's because you fed me lies!!"

strings.text:
史郎
「でも、逆恨みで夢美ちゃんを酷い目に遭わせようと
　していたのは事実だろう？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"But the fact that you were trying to put Yumemi-chan through something terrible out of that petty grudge -- that's still true, isn't it?"

strings.text: アゲハが、悔しげに奥歯を噛む。
strings.translated: Ageha bit down on her back teeth in frustration.

strings.text: 少なくとも史郎の言っていることは、全て事実らしい。
strings.translated: At the very least, everything Shirou was saying appeared to be the truth.

strings.text:
史郎はふふんっと鼻で笑うと、得意げな顔で説明を始
めた。
strings.translated: Shirou gave a smug little snort, then began his explanation with a self-satisfied look on his face.

strings.text:
史郎
「ちょっと前に、夢美ちゃんのマンションが合蟲人間
　に襲われたことがあっただろう？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"A little while back, Yumemi-chan's apartment was attacked by a Bug-fused human -- you remember that, right?"

strings.text:
史郎
「本当はね、君がマンションから逃げたらボクが君を
　捕まえる予定だったんだ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"The plan was actually for me to catch you after you fled the apartment."

strings.text:
史郎
「そしてその通り、君は一人でマンションから逃げ出
　したわけなんだけど…………」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"And sure enough, you did escape from the apartment on your own...... but............"

strings.text: そこまで言って、史郎が短く溜息をつく。
strings.translated: At that, Shirou let out a short sigh.

strings.text:
ちらりとアゲハを見ると、微かに怒ったような雰囲気
を見せ、再び夢美のほうに向き直る。
strings.translated: He glanced briefly at Ageha with a faintly irritated air, then turned back toward Yumemi.

strings.text:
史郎
「ボクはそのとき車の中で待機していてね、うっかり
　寝過ごしちゃったんだ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"I was waiting in the car at the time, and I accidentally slept right through it."

strings.text:
史郎
「君がすぐ間近を通ったはずなのに、マヌケにも車の
　中でグーグー寝ちゃってたわけさ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"You must have passed right by me, and there I was, the fool, fast asleep in the car."

strings.text:
史郎
「起きたときは本当に焦ったよ。
　夢美ちゃんも獣魔蟲もどこ行ったか分かんないし、
　完全にボクのミスだし…………」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"I was really panicked when I woke up.
 I had no idea where Yumemi-chan or the Jumachuu had gone, and it was entirely my mistake............"

strings.text:
史郎
「だけど何かおかしいって思って調べてみたら、車の
　シートに蝶の粉がくっ付いてたんだよね」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"But something felt off, so I looked into it -- and found butterfly scales stuck to the car seat."

strings.text:
史郎
「それで、まさかって思って調べてみたら、案の定
　アゲハちゃんの仕業だったってわけさ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"So I thought, no way, and looked into it further -- and sure enough, it turned out to be Ageha-chan's doing."

strings.text: そこまで言って、史郎が肩を竦めて見せる。
strings.translated: At that, Shirou gave an exaggerated shrug.

strings.text:
アゲハは何も言わなかったが、どこか辛そうに顔を
伏せていた。
strings.translated: Ageha said nothing, but she hung her head as if in pain.

strings.text:
史郎
「ま、気持ちは分からないでもないけどね。
　アゲハちゃんは、蟲使いに優遇されてる夢美ちゃん
　のことをすごく恨んでたから」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Well, I can't say I don't understand her feelings.
 Ageha-chan deeply resented Yumemi-chan for being so favored by the Bug Users."

strings.text:
アゲハ
「だからそれは、アンタが嘘を教えたからじゃな
　いっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"That's because YOU fed me lies!!"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「櫻井夢美は特別な蟲を持ってて、それを育てる代わ
　りに蟲使いから大金をもらってるって！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"You told me that Sakurai Yumemi had a special Bug, and that she was being paid a fortune by Bug Users in exchange for raising it!"

strings.text:
アゲハ
「蟲使いからすごく優遇されてるって！！」
strings.translated:
Ageha
"That the Bug Users were giving her the royal treatment!!"

strings.text:
史郎
「まあ、少しは脚色したけどね、嘘を言ったつもりは
　ないよ」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Well, I may have embellished a little, but I didn't intend to lie."

strings.text:
史郎
「第一、ちゃんと未確認情報だって言ってただろ
　う？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"Besides, I did tell you it was unconfirmed information, didn't I?"

strings.text:
史郎
「彼女の過去はある程度知ってはいたけど、完全に
　把握することはできなかったからね」
strings.translated:
Shirou
"I knew something of her past, but I was never able to get the full picture."

strings.text:
史郎
「それに、彼女の過去が嘘でも本当でも、逆恨みして
　酷いことをしようとしたのは君の意思だろう？」
strings.translated:
Shirou
