"From this day forward, I'll be living a life with nothing to do with Bug Users."

strings.text:
もう一度肩を竦めて、空になった蟲筒をポイッと投げ
捨てる。
strings.translated: She shrugged once more and tossed aside the now-empty Bug tube.

strings.text:
綾佳
「あっ、ムーは別だからな。あれは家族も同然だ」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Oh, but Muu is a different story. That one's practically family."

strings.text:
綾佳
「夢美、まさかとは思うが、あたしが父の事を許して
　いないとでも思っていたのではあるまいな？」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Yumemi, surely you didn't think I still held what happened to my father against you, did you?"

strings.text:
綾佳
「確かにあの時のことを忘れた日はないが、それを
　十年も引きずるほど愚かではないぞ」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"True, there hasn't been a day I've forgotten what happened back then -- but I'm not foolish enough to let it drag me down for ten years."

strings.text:
綾佳
「あたしが気にしていたのは、これからの夢美と優斗
　の生活に、あたしが邪魔になるのではないかという
　ことだ」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"What I was worried about was whether I'd be getting in the way of your life together -- yours and Yuuto's -- going forward."

strings.text:
綾佳
「何しろ新婚だ。夜は盛る日も多かろう？」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"You're newlyweds, after all. I'd imagine there are plenty of nights you get frisky, yes?"

strings.text:
夢美
「ば、馬鹿なこと言ってるんじゃないのっ！」
涙を堪えるように夢美が叫ぶ。
strings.translated: Yumemi cried out as if fighting back tears.

strings.text:
唐突に――綾佳からもっとも聞きたかった言葉を聞け
て、胸に熱いものが込み上げた。
strings.translated: Suddenly -- hearing the words she had most wanted to hear from Ayaka, something warm welled up in her chest.

strings.text:
夢美
「あなたが……私にとってどれだけ必要か……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"How much... you mean to me..."

strings.text:
夢美
「十年も一緒にいて……この先、あなた無しの生活な
　んて、考えられない」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"We've been together for ten years... I can't imagine a life without you from here on out."

strings.text:
夢美
「あなたがどう思おうと……あなたは、私の娘なんだ
　から…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"No matter what you think... you are my daughter.............."

strings.text:
綾佳
「どうやらあたしは……意外と愚かだったらしいな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Seems I was... more foolish than I thought."

strings.text: 煉獄のほうを向いたまま、綾佳の声が微かに震える。
strings.translated: Ayaka kept her eyes on Rengoku, but her voice trembled faintly.

strings.text:
果たして、そこにどんな思いがあったのか、それは
綾佳本人にもよく分かっていなかった。
strings.translated: What feelings lay behind it -- even Ayaka herself wasn't quite sure.

strings.text:
綾佳
「うむ、悪くない気分だ」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Mm, not a bad feeling at all."

strings.text:
一度だけ目元を手で拭って、綾佳が眼前の敵を見つめ
る。
strings.translated: Wiping her eyes just once with her hand, Ayaka turned her gaze to the enemy before her.

strings.text:
既に煉獄も痺れを切らしかけているようで、眼の下が
ピクピクと痙攣していた。
strings.translated: Rengoku already seemed to be losing his patience, the area beneath his eyes twitching with a tic.

strings.text:
右肩の傷は、傷口から伸びた触手が繋ぎ合わさるよう
にして再生されていく……。
strings.translated: The wound on his right shoulder was regenerating, the tentacles extending from the gash knitting themselves back together...

Ayaka
"Yeah, sorry to keep you waiting."

strings.text:
煉獄
「だったらさっさと死にに来い。
　……言っておくがもう不意打ちは通用せんぞ？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Then hurry up and come die.
...I'll warn you -- a sucker punch won't work on me anymore."

strings.text:
綾佳
「ふん、三流の悪党は常に同じ科白を吐くな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Hmph. Third-rate villains always spout the same lines."

strings.text:
綾佳
「十五年ぶりに目を醒ましたらしいが、それでやる事
　が夢美の結婚式の邪魔とは、つくづく暇な男よ」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"You wake up after fifteen years and the first thing you do is crash Yumemi's wedding -- you really are a man with nothing better to do."

strings.text:
綾佳
「あたしが引導を渡してやるから、とっとと三途の川
　を渡るか溺れるかして来い」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"I'll be the one to send you off, so go ahead and cross the Sanzu River -- or drown in it, I don't care which."

strings.text:
煉獄
「小娘がぁーーーーーーーーっ！！！」

床を強く蹴り出すようにして、煉獄が綾佳に殴り掛か
る。
strings.translated: Rengoku launches himself off the floor and lunges at Ayaka with a punch.

strings.text:
対して綾佳はまだ蟲筒さえ構えておらず、その後方に
いた夢美は悲鳴を上げた。
strings.translated: Ayaka, for her part, hadn't even raised her Bug tube yet, and Yumemi, standing behind her, let out a scream.

strings.text:
綾佳の間近まで接近した煉獄が、その豪腕を振り下ろ
そうとする。
strings.translated: Rengoku closed in on Ayaka and swung his massive arm down at her.

strings.text:
まともに殴られれば、綾佳のような少女など全身の骨
をバラバラに砕かれるだろう。
strings.translated: A direct hit would shatter every bone in a girl like Ayaka's body.

strings.text:
だが、その瞬間が目の前に迫っていて尚、綾佳の口元
には笑みが浮かんでいた。
strings.translated: Yet even as that moment bore down on her, a smile played at the corner of Ayaka's lips.

strings.text:
綾佳を殴り付けようとした煉獄の腕が、その途中で
ピタリと止まる。
strings.translated: Rengoku's arm, mid-swing toward Ayaka, stopped dead in its tracks.

strings.text:
自分の右腕に視線を送ると、そこにピンク色の触手が
絡み付き、逆方向に引っ張っていた。
strings.translated: When he looked at his right arm, a pink tentacle had coiled around it and was pulling it in the opposite direction.

strings.text:
綾佳
「さっさと散れぃ、この化け物めっ！！」
とんっ、と床を蹴って綾佳の体が浮き上がる。
strings.translated: With a light kick off the floor, Ayaka's body launched upward.

strings.text:
右手には蟲筒を持っており、それを煉獄の顔の前に
向けると――――
strings.translated: In her right hand she held her Bug tube, and she leveled it directly at Rengoku's face----

strings.text:
先ほどよりさらに強い爆発が、しかも今度は連続して
煉獄の顔を中心に起こる。
strings.translated: An explosion even greater than before erupted -- and this time in rapid succession, centered on Rengoku's face.

strings.text:
巨体が大きく仰け反って、空中で薄い弧を描きながら
床に落下した。
strings.translated: The massive body lurched backward, tracing a shallow arc through the air before crashing to the floor.

strings.text:
綾佳
「ちっ……これだけ撃ち込んでも仕留め切れんか」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Tch... and he still won't go down after all that."

strings.text:
硝煙の向こう側で倒れ込む煉獄を見て、綾佳が小さく
舌打ちした。
strings.translated: Watching Rengoku collapse beyond the gunsmoke, Ayaka clicked her tongue softly.

strings.text: 手ごたえはあったが致命傷には至っていない。
strings.translated: There was impact, but it hadn't been a killing blow.

strings.text:
それを証明するかのように煉獄がむくりと起き上がり、
憎々しげな眼で綾佳を睨み付けた。
strings.translated: As if to prove it, Rengoku hauled himself back up and fixed Ayaka with a hateful glare.

strings.text:
煉獄
「小娘があぁぁぁーーーーーーーーーーーっ！！！」

綾佳
「そう騒ぐな愚か者。
　次はもっとデカイのをお見舞いしてやる」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Stop your howling, you fool.
Next time I'll give you something even bigger."

strings.text: 綾佳が、教会の天井に向けて叫んだ瞬間だった。
strings.translated: It was the moment Ayaka screamed toward the ceiling of the church.

strings.text:
サッカーボール程度の大きさの、メタリックブルーの
塊が、くるくると回転しながら落ちてくる。
strings.translated: A metallic-blue mass, roughly the size of a soccer ball, came spinning and tumbling down from above.

strings.text:
そして、べちゃっと綾佳の隣に着地すると、ピンク色
の触手をグネグネと動かして煉獄を威嚇した。
strings.translated: It landed with a wet splat beside Ayaka, then wriggled its pink tentacles menacingly at Rengoku.

strings.text:
綾佳
「ま、あたしのキョーダイみたいなものだな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Well, it's something like a sibling of mine."

strings.text:
綾佳
「本当は夢美と優斗の結婚式をこっそり見させてやる
　だけのつもりだったが……まあ、こうなっては仕方
　ない」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"I had only meant to let it secretly watch Yumemi and Yuuto's wedding... but, well, it can't be helped now."

strings.text:
綾佳
「あたし達二人で、お前をあの世に送り返してくれ
　る」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"The two of us will send you straight to the afterlife."

strings.text:
そばに駆け寄ろうとした夢美を、前を向いたまま綾佳
が一喝する。
strings.translated: Yumemi had tried to rush to her side, but Ayaka barked at her without turning around.

strings.text:
綾佳
「ここから先は、蟲使いの領域ぞ。
　夢美の出る幕はないわ」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"From here on, this is the domain of Bug Users.
This is no place for you, Yumemi."

strings.text:
綾佳
「優斗もそうだ。何をボサッとしておる」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"You too, Yuuto. What are you standing around for?"

strings.text:
綾佳
「集まってくれた客人を、早く安全なところに避難さ
　せんか」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Hurry up and get the guests who gathered here to somewhere safe."

strings.text:
まだ躊躇っている様子の夢美の肩に、優斗が優しく手
を置く。
strings.translated: Yuuto gently placed his hand on Yumemi's shoulder -- she still looked hesitant.

strings.text:
夢美は言葉が詰まったような仕草を見せたが、やがて
静かに頷いてみせた。
strings.translated: Yumemi looked as though the words had caught in her throat, but at last she gave a quiet nod.

strings.text:
夢美
「分かったわ。……気をつけてね」

綾佳と煉獄が睨み合う中、夢美と優斗、そして参列し
ていたアゲハや唯、ユーリアが率先して客達を出口へ
と誘導する。
strings.translated: While Ayaka and Rengoku glared at each other, Yumemi and Yuuto, along with Ageha, Yui, and Yulia -- who had been among the guests -- took the lead in guiding everyone toward the exit.

strings.text:
幸いにして大きな騒ぎにはならず、十分もしないうち
に全員が教会から外に出ることができた。
strings.translated: Fortunately, it did not turn into a major commotion, and within ten minutes everyone had made it out of the church.

strings.text:
後に残された綾佳と煉獄は、互いに一言も喋らず睨み
合っている。
strings.translated: Left behind, Ayaka and Rengoku stared each other down without exchanging a single word.

strings.text:
やがて、口を開いたのは煉獄のほうで、その表情には
幾分冷静さを取り戻していた。
strings.translated: It was Rengoku who finally broke the silence, and his expression had regained some measure of composure.

strings.text:
煉獄
「そろそろ、始めても良さそうだな」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Looks like it's about time we got started."

strings.text:
綾佳
「なんだ、わざわざ待っていてくれたのか？
　案外気の長い奴なのだな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"What, you actually waited for me?
You're more patient than I would have thought."

strings.text:
煉獄
「どのみち、お前がここにいる以上、あの女は逃げら
　れん」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Either way, as long as you're here, that woman can't escape."

strings.text:
煉獄
「これからじわじわと狩って行くのも面白そうだ」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Hunting her down nice and slow from here on -- now that sounds like fun."

strings.text: 煉獄の口が、にぃっとゆがむ。
strings.translated: Rengoku's mouth twisted into a grin.

strings.text:
その醜悪な笑みに、綾佳はふんっと呆れたように鼻を
鳴らした。
strings.translated: At that hideous smile, Ayaka gave a contemptuous snort.

strings.text:
綾佳
「くだらん事にだけは頭が働くようだな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"It seems your mind only works when it comes to worthless things."

strings.text:
綾佳
「もっとも、その程度のことにしか使えん頭なら仕方
　ないがな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Though I suppose there's nothing to be done if that's the only use you have for it."

strings.text:
ニヤニヤと笑う綾佳の挑発に、煉獄の表情に怒気が
混じる。
strings.translated: Ayaka's taunting smirk provoked a flash of anger across Rengoku's face.

strings.text:
口の悪さに関しては、やはり綾佳のほうが一枚も二枚
も上手のようだった。
strings.translated: When it came to sharp tongues, Ayaka was clearly a cut -- or two -- above.

strings.text:
煉獄
「その言葉、後悔させてやる」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"I'll make you regret those words."

strings.text:
綾佳
「やってみるが良い。
　蟲を寄せ集めただけの合蟲人間に、あたしが倒せる
　かどうかな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Go ahead and try.
Let's see whether a Bug amalgam like you can actually bring me down."

strings.text:
煉獄
「ふん、それはオレの科白だ」

煉獄
「たかが小娘と蟲一匹、それでオレが倒せるとでも
　思っているのか？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"You think a little girl and a single Bug are enough to beat me?"

strings.text:
煉獄
「本当はさっきの攻撃で倒すつもりが、できなかった
　んだろう？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Truth is, you were trying to finish me off with that last attack, weren't you? And you couldn't."

strings.text:
互いの戦力差を説明しながら、煉獄が肩を揺らして
笑う。
strings.translated: Rengoku laughed, his shoulders shaking, as he laid out the difference in their strength.

strings.text:
だが、綾佳のほうも笑みは崩さないまま、静かに頷い
て返した。
strings.translated: But Ayaka's smile never faltered -- she simply gave a quiet nod in return.

strings.text:
綾佳
「確かにその通りだ。
　あれで仕留め切れなかったのは、あたしもまだまだ
　甘いということだな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"You're absolutely right.
The fact that I couldn't finish you off with that means I still have a long way to go."

strings.text:
煉獄
「ほう、それでどうする？
　何か次の手でもあるのか？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Oh? So what will you do?
Do you have some other trick up your sleeve?"

strings.text:
綾佳
「なければ――こんな所には立っておらぬ――――」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"If I didn't -- I wouldn't be standing here----"

strings.text: ゆらり、と空気が揺らいだ。
strings.translated: The air swayed, slowly, like a mirage.

strings.text: どこからともなく、肌寒い風が流れ込んでくる。
strings.translated: From nowhere in particular, a cold wind began to drift in.

strings.text:
綾佳
「この筋肉達磨を倒して、さっさと結婚式の続きをせ
　ねばならん」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"We have to take down this muscle-bound fool and get back to the wedding."

strings.text:
綾佳
「お前の本当の力を……見せてやれっ！！」
教会内の空気が、一気に凍り付いた。
strings.translated: The air inside the church froze solid in an instant.

strings.text:
綾佳の傍らにいる蟲を中心に、星屑のような輝きを
放つダイヤモンドダストが広がっていく。
strings.translated: Centered on the Bug standing at Ayaka's side, a diamond dust of starlike brilliance began to spread outward.

strings.text: 煉獄の見ている前で、蟲の体が変化し始める。
strings.translated: Before Rengoku's very eyes, the Bug's body began to change.

strings.text: いや、それは変化などという生易しい現象ではない。
strings.translated: No -- change was far too gentle a word for what was happening.

strings.text:
蟲の内側から触手が飛び出し、噴き出した血肉が新た
な骨と変わる。
strings.translated: Tentacles burst from within the Bug's body, and the blood and flesh that sprayed forth transformed into new bone.

strings.text:
その骨に触手が絡み付き、新たな肉となり血の色の肉
塊を作り出した。
strings.translated: Tentacles coiled around that bone, becoming new flesh, forming a mass of meat the color of blood.

strings.text:
煉獄の見ている前で、綾佳のほんの数十センチ後ろで、
蟲はその肉体を全くの別物へと変えいてた。
strings.translated: Before Rengoku's very eyes, just a few dozen centimeters behind Ayaka, the Bug was reshaping its body into something else entirely.

strings.text: まるで、何か新しい生き物が誕生するかのように。
strings.translated: As though some new creature were being born.

strings.text:
蟲の内側に抑え込まれていたものが、卵の殻を破って
産まれるかのように。
strings.translated: As though something long suppressed within the Bug were hatching, breaking free from its shell.

strings.text:
驚愕する煉獄の前で、蟲が肉体の破壊と復元を繰り返
す。
strings.translated: Before the stunned Rengoku, the Bug continued its cycle of destruction and restoration.

strings.text:
繰り返すたびに肉塊はその大きさを増し、やがて綾佳
の背丈を遥かに越えた生物へと変わっていった。
strings.translated: With each repetition the mass of flesh grew larger, until at last it had transformed into a creature that towered far above Ayaka.

strings.text: その光景を――果たして何と表すべきなのか――――。
strings.translated: How was one to describe that sight?

strings.text:
そこに在るものを、果たして『蟲』と表現して良いも
のなのか。
strings.translated: Could what stood there even be called a "Bug"?

strings.text:
存在の答えさえ出ない相手に、煉獄は目を剥いて唇を
戦慄かせるしかなかった。
strings.translated: Faced with something that defied even the question of what it was, Rengoku could only stare wide-eyed, his lips trembling.

strings.text:
煉獄
「な、なんだ、それは………………ッ！！？」

綾佳
「さて……待たせたな、筋肉達磨」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Well then... sorry to keep you waiting, muscle-head."

strings.text:
煉獄
「蟲、なのか……その巨大なものが…………」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"A Bug... is that what that massive thing is............"

strings.text:
綾佳
「ふん、夢美に聞いた話では、期待外れとかぬかして
　捨てたらしいが……よほどの愚か者よの」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Hmph. From what Yumemi told me, you apparently called it a disappointment and threw it away... what a tremendous fool you are."

strings.text:
煉獄
「――獣魔蟲だと言うのかっ！！！！」
床を蹴って、煉獄が獣魔蟲に飛び掛かる。
strings.translated: Rengoku kicks off the floor and lunges at the Jumachuu.

strings.text: 獣魔蟲から出た太い触手が、煉獄の胴体を殴り付ける。
strings.translated: A thick tentacle shot from the Jumachuu and slammed into Rengoku's torso.

strings.text: その衝撃は、綾佳が先に放った爆蟲の比ではない。
strings.translated: The impact was incomparable to the Explosive Bug Ayaka had unleashed before.

strings.text:
骨が砕け、内臓が潰れるかと思うほどの破壊力に、
煉獄は成すすべもなく壁に叩き付けられた。
strings.translated: With a destructive force enough to shatter bone and crush organs, Rengoku was hurled helplessly into the wall.

strings.text:
綾佳
「無駄に時間を掛けるつもりはない。
　その蟲を寄せ集めた忌まわしき肉体……粉々に砕い
　てやろうぞっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"I have no intention of wasting time. That wretched body of yours, cobbled together out of Bugs... I'll grind it to dust!!"

strings.text:
獣魔蟲に飛び掛かった瞬間、煉獄の口から呻くような
声が漏れた。
strings.translated: The moment he lunged at the Jumachuu, a groan tore itself from Rengoku's throat.

strings.text:
どす黒い緑の肉体に突き刺さっているのは、数十本に
も及ぶ触手。
strings.translated: Piercing that dark, murky green body were dozens upon dozens of tentacles.

strings.text:
まるで氷のように冷たく硬い触手が、煉獄の背中まで
一気に突き抜けていた。
strings.translated: Tentacles as cold and hard as ice had driven clean through Rengoku's body, bursting out through his back.

strings.text:
煉獄
「ぐ、うおおおおおおおおおおおおおっ！！！！」

煉獄が叫んだ瞬間、その肉体からボコボコと音を立て
て蟲が飛び出した。
strings.translated:
The moment Rengoku cried out, his body erupted with a wet, gurgling sound
as Bugs burst forth from within him.

strings.text: 肉に埋めていた蟲を解放し、獣魔蟲へと牙を剥く。
strings.translated: He released the Bugs embedded in his flesh and bared their fangs at the Jumachuu.

strings.text:
その数は、ざっと数えただけでも十匹以上で、普通の
蟲使いが同時に扱える限界を遥かに超えていた。
strings.translated: Their number, by even a rough count, exceeded ten -- far beyond the limit any ordinary Bug User could control at once.

strings.text:
獣魔蟲に牙を突き立てた瞬間、煉獄の蟲が一斉に弾け
飛んだ。
strings.translated: The instant they sank their fangs into the Jumachuu, Rengoku's Bugs were blasted apart all at once.

strings.text:
いや、弾け飛んだというよりも、砕け散ったと言った
ほうが正しいだろう。
strings.translated: No -- blasted apart was not quite right. Shattered would be the more accurate word.

strings.text: 床面には凍った蟲の肉が落ち、パラパラと音を立てた。
strings.translated: Frozen fragments of Bug flesh fell to the floor, scattering with a faint, dry sound.

strings.text:
煉獄
「ふ、ふざけた真似を――――――――――ッ！！」
煉獄の体から、再度蟲が射出される。
strings.translated: From Rengoku's body, Bugs were launched a second time.

strings.text:
その数は一度目よりさらに多く、また種類も様々だっ
た。
strings.translated: Their number was even greater than the first wave, and their variety far wider.

strings.text:
何ら結果は変わる事はなく、蟲は氷のカケラとなって
床に舞い散る。
strings.translated: The result was no different. The Bugs became shards of ice and drifted down across the floor.

strings.text:
空気中にはキラキラと光るものが漂い、その中で綾佳
は冷めた視線を送っていた。
strings.translated: Glittering particles drifted through the air, and within them, Ayaka watched with cold, indifferent eyes.

strings.text: 突如、走り抜けたのは、脳髄が痺れるような激痛。
strings.translated: Without warning, a searing pain tore through him -- enough to numb his very brain.

strings.text:
視線を落とせば触手が突き刺さった部分から、薄い氷
の膜が張り始めていた。
strings.translated: Dropping his gaze, he saw that from the point where the tentacles had pierced him, a thin film of ice was beginning to spread.

strings.text:
煉獄
「な、なんだ、これは……………………ッ！」

煉獄
「うおおおおおおおおおおおっ！！！？」
急激な勢いで、煉獄の体が凍り付いていく。
strings.translated: At a terrifying rate, Rengoku's body was freezing over.

strings.text: 傷口から波紋状に、びっしりと氷が張っていく。
strings.translated: From the wound, ice spread outward in rippling waves, covering everything in its path.

strings.text: その苦痛は、言葉にできるほど軽くはない。
strings.translated: The pain was far too great to be put into words.

strings.text:
その身に何十匹もの蟲を宿した煉獄であっても、体内
から凍らされて平気な顔をしていられるほど、頑強で
はなかった。
strings.translated: Even Rengoku, who harbored dozens of Bugs within his body, was not hardy enough to be frozen from the inside out and keep a straight face.

strings.text:
煉獄
「ぐ、がっ……この、まま……このままぁ…………」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Gh, gah... like this... like this I..."

strings.text:
煉獄
「このまま殺られるかあぁーーーーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーーっ！！！！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Like hell I'm dying here -- AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!"

strings.text: 蟲を飛ばし、自分に刺さっていた触手を切り裂く。
strings.translated: He launched Bugs, slicing apart the tentacles that had pierced him.

strings.text:
皮膚に張り付いた氷を、手で払いながら距離を取ると、
獣魔蟲を睨み付けながら膝を着いた。
strings.translated: Brushing the ice clinging to his skin away with his hands, he put distance between himself and the Jumachuu, then dropped to one knee, glaring at it.

strings.text:
煉獄
「ぜぃっ、ぜぃっ、ぜぃっ、ぜぃっ、ぜぃっ！」

煉獄
「ぐ、ぶっ……ば、馬鹿な…………。
　このオレが……手も足も……げぶっ、出んだと？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Gh, bgh... i-impossible...........
 Even I... can't even... gbugh, land a hit?"

strings.text:
緑色の血を吐きながら、煉獄が驚愕の眼差しで獣魔蟲
を見る。
strings.translated: Spitting green blood, Rengoku stared at the Jumachuu with eyes wide in disbelief.

strings.text:
その圧倒的な力は、蟲が何匹いれば勝てるなどといっ
た領域を遥かに超えていた。
strings.translated: Its overwhelming power was far beyond any realm where throwing more Bugs at it could make a difference.

strings.text:
自分が、次元の違う強さの相手に挑んでいることに、
煉獄はようやく気付き始めていた。
strings.translated: Rengoku was finally beginning to realize that he was challenging an opponent of an entirely different dimension of strength.

strings.text:
煉獄
「まだだっ！　こんな……こんなくだらねぇ伝説なん
　ざに殺られてたまるかっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Not yet! I refuse... I refuse to be killed by some worthless legend like this!!"

strings.text:
凍り付く体を奮い立たせるようにして、煉獄が立ち上
がる。
strings.translated: As if willing his frozen body to move, Rengoku forces himself to stand.

strings.text:
まだ氷の張っていない部分から蟲を分離させると、
それを一気に獣魔蟲へと飛ばした。
strings.translated: Separating Bugs from the parts of his body not yet frozen, he launched them all at the Jumachuu in one burst.

strings.text:
煉獄
「がああああああああああああっ！！！！！」

蟲を放った瞬間、獣魔蟲から伸びた触手がその全てを
突き貫いた。
strings.translated: The instant he released the Bugs, tentacles extending from the Jumachuu pierced every single one of them.

strings.text:
しかも、その勢いは衰えることなく、後方に位置して
いた煉獄の体まで貫いていく。
strings.translated: And their momentum did not slow -- they drove straight through, impaling Rengoku's body where he stood behind them.

strings.text:
腕や脇腹、脚といった部分が突き抜かれ、煉獄は獣の
ように吼えた。
strings.translated: His arms, his sides, his legs -- all were run through, and Rengoku howled like a beast.

strings.text: 強引に触手を引き抜いて、煉獄が数歩後ずさりする。
strings.translated: Wrenching the tentacles free by force, Rengoku staggered back several steps.

strings.text:
傷口からは早くも氷が張り始め、再生能力を奪って
いった。
strings.translated: Ice had already begun to spread from the wounds, robbing him of his regenerative ability.

strings.text: もはや、誰が見ても戦えるような状態ではない。
strings.translated: Anyone watching could see he was in no condition to fight.

strings.text:
凍り付いた部分は次々と砕け散り、肉体を維持するの
でさえ困難な様子だった。
strings.translated: The frozen sections were crumbling apart one after another, and even maintaining his physical form seemed to be growing difficult.

strings.text:
綾佳
「やめておけ。これ以上の悪あがきは無意味ぞ？」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Stand down. Any further struggle is pointless, is it not?"

strings.text:
煉獄
「ふざけるなっ！　オレは……オレは絶対にこんなと
　ころでは死なんぞっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Don't make me laugh! I... I will absolutely not die in a place like this!!"

strings.text:
綾佳
「残念だがそれはない。
　ムーが本当の力を出した以上、お前ごときでは相手
　にもならん」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Regrettably, that is not an option.
 Now that Muu has unleashed its true power, the likes of you are not even worth its time."

strings.text:
煉獄
「黙れぇーーーーーーーーーーーーーっ！！！！」

煉獄の飛ばした蟲は、今度は攻撃することさえ適わな
かった。
strings.translated: The Bugs Rengoku launched this time could not even reach their target to attack.

strings.text:
何故なら、飛ばした蟲以上の数の獣魔蟲の触手が、
一匹残らず突き殺していたからだ。
strings.translated: Because tentacles from the Jumachuu -- in numbers exceeding the Bugs he had sent -- had skewered every last one of them.

strings.text: 蟲の数を増やしたところで、勝つことはできない。
strings.translated: Even if he were to increase the number of Bugs, victory would still be beyond his reach.

strings.text: だが、他に戦うだけの方法がない。
strings.translated: But he had no other way to fight.

strings.text:
煉獄は、怒りに満ちた表情を浮かべながらも、手足が
小刻みに震えるのを抑えることができなかった。
strings.translated: Though his face was twisted with rage, he could not stop his arms and legs from trembling in small, uncontrollable spasms.

strings.text:
煉獄
「うおぉぉああああぁぁぁぁぁーーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーーーーっ！！！！！」
咆哮と言うよりは悲鳴。
strings.translated: Less a war cry -- more a scream.

strings.text: 煉獄は大声を上げながら、体中から蟲を飛ばした。
strings.translated: Rengoku bellowed at the top of his lungs and launched Bugs from every part of his body.

strings.text:
数では勝てないと分かっている相手に、ただひたすら
に数で勝負を挑んだ。
strings.translated: Against an enemy he knew he could not beat in numbers, he threw numbers at it anyway, desperately, senselessly.

strings.text:
だが、その攻撃は悉く触手によって防がれ、それどこ
ろか煉獄自身への攻撃を開始する。
strings.translated: But every attack was blocked by the tentacles -- and worse, the beast began launching its own assault on Rengoku himself.

strings.text:
初撃は辛うじてかわす事ができたが、この時点で煉獄
の肉体は限界に達していた。
strings.translated: He barely managed to dodge the first strike, but by this point, Rengoku's body had reached its limit.

strings.text: 煉獄の肉体は、ただ蟲を宿しているわけではない。
strings.translated: His body did not merely harbor Bugs.

strings.text: 蟲を宿すことによって、あらゆる機能――――
strings.translated: By harboring Bugs, every function of his body --

strings.text:
――いや、生命そのものを維持している合蟲人間だっ
た。
strings.translated: -- no, his very life itself was being sustained. He was a Bug-fused human.

strings.text:
つまり、蟲を放つという事は、それだけ煉獄の肉体が
弱まることを意味しており、生命を削りながら攻撃し
ていると言っても過言ではなかった。
strings.translated: In other words, launching Bugs meant weakening his own body by that much -- it was no exaggeration to say he was whittling away his own life with every attack.

strings.text:
煉獄
「死ね……死ねぇ……死ねぇぇ…………」

煉獄
「死ねっ、死ねっ、死ねっ、死ねっ――――」

煉獄
「死ねえぇぇぇーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーっ！！！！！」
生命を削りながらの攻撃が続く。
strings.translated: The assault continued -- each attack carving away at his own life.

strings.text:
獣魔蟲への恐怖に突き動かされるようにして、煉獄の
攻撃が続いていく。
strings.translated:
Driven as if by fear of the Jumachuu, Rengoku's
assaults continued.

strings.text: だが、既に胸の裡にあるのは後悔だけだった。
strings.translated: But by now, all that remained within his chest was regret.

strings.text: あの時、油断さえしなければ――――
strings.translated: If only he hadn't let his guard down back then --

strings.text: あの時、興味本位であんな事をしなければ――――
strings.translated: If only he hadn't done that out of mere curiosity back then --

strings.text: あの時、あんな小娘を『苗床』にしなければ――――
strings.translated: If only he hadn't made that girl a "Seedbed" back then --

strings.text: ――もっと違った未来もあったかもしれないのに。
strings.translated: -- perhaps a very different future might have awaited him.

strings.text: ついに蟲を撃ち尽くして、煉獄はその場でよろめいた。
strings.translated: Finally, having spent every last Bug, Rengoku staggered where he stood.

strings.text:
平衡感覚さえ失ってしまったのか、満足に立っている
こともできない。
strings.translated:
As if he had even lost his sense of balance, he could no longer
manage to stand properly.

strings.text:
全身には大小様々な穴が空き、どす黒い血が床へと
流れていた。
strings.translated:
Holes of all sizes riddled his body, and dark blood
flowed down onto the floor.

strings.text:
煉獄
「オレ、は……オレはぁぁ…………………………」
煉獄が、首を伸ばすようにして目を剥く。
strings.translated: Rengoku craned his neck and glared with wide, bloodshot eyes.

strings.text:
だが、既に歩く力さえ失っているようで、半壊した
肉体からは蟲一匹さえ飛ぶことはなかった。
strings.translated:
But he seemed to have already lost even the strength to walk, and from his half-destroyed
body, not a single Bug took flight.

strings.text:
綾佳は、静かにそれを見つめ続けたあと、最後にぽつ
りと零すように告げた。
strings.translated:
After quietly watching it all, Ayaka finally murmured
a single word, as if letting it fall from her lips.

strings.text:
綾佳
「ムー、もう眠らせてやれ」

全身を触手で貫かれ、壁に貼り付けにされて煉獄が
呻いた。
strings.translated:
Pierced through his entire body by tentacles and pinned to the wall, Rengoku
groaned.

strings.text:
眼は憎々しげに綾佳を睨み付けているが、そこには
もう戦うだけの力は残されていない。
strings.translated:
His eyes glared at Ayaka with seething hatred, but
there was no longer enough strength left in him to fight.

strings.text:
肉体は貫かれた部分から凍りつき始め、一部にはヒビ
が入り早くも砕け散っていた。
strings.translated:
His flesh began to freeze from the points where it had been pierced, and parts of it
had already cracked and shattered.

strings.text:
綾佳
「なぁ、煉獄とやら……。
　お前は何故、蟲使いを捨てながら蟲に頼った？」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Hey, you -- Rengoku, was it....
 Why did you abandon the Bug Users, yet still rely on Bugs?"

strings.text:
正面でじっと自分を見つめてくる綾佳に、煉獄はさら
に眉をつり上げる。
strings.translated:
Rengoku's brow furrowed even further as Ayaka stood before him,
staring at him in silence.

strings.text:
だが、綾佳の表情にはどこか憐憫さえ浮かび、小さく
肩を落としていた。
strings.translated:
But Ayaka's expression held something almost like pity, and her shoulders
dropped slightly.

strings.text:
綾佳
「滅ぶと分かっている一族の技能に、何故縋ろうとし
　た？」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Why did you try to cling to the skills of a clan
 you knew was doomed to perish?"

strings.text:
煉獄
「ハッ……それが……一番…………手っ取り早い、
　だろが…………」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Hah... that's... the quickest...
 way to settle it... isn't it..."

strings.text:
綾佳
「その時点でお前は間違っていたのだ。
　本気で蟲使いから逃れたくば、まず蟲を捨てるべき
　だった……」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"You were wrong from that very moment.
 If you truly wished to escape the Bug Users, you should have
 first cast aside the Bugs..."

strings.text:
綾佳
「それさえも出来んのなら、お前は一族を抜けるべき
　ではなかった」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"If even that was beyond you, then you should never
 have left the clan at all."

strings.text:
煉獄
「ケッ……知った風な、口……ゲホッ…………
　叩くんじゃ……ねぇよ…………」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Tch... don't talk like you... know everything... *cough*...
 ...about me..."

strings.text:
煉獄
「いずれ……テメーも……思い知る、ぜ…………」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Sooner or later... you'll... understand too..."

strings.text:
煉獄
「蟲使い、が……蟲を、使わず……に…………
　生き、て……いく、なんざ……不可能、だって……
　ことを、な…………」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"A Bug User... who tries to live... without using Bugs...
 that's... impossible... and that's...
 the truth of it..."

strings.text: 全てを言い終わる前に、煉獄の全身が凍り付いた。
strings.translated: Before he could finish saying it all, Rengoku's entire body froze solid.

strings.text:
バラバラに砕け散った氷の破片を、綾佳は静かな眼差
しで見つめていた。
strings.translated:
Ayaka watched the shattered fragments of ice scatter in all directions
with a quiet, steady gaze.

strings.text:
幾つもの思いが交錯したが、最後に行き着く結論は
決まっている。
strings.translated:
Many thoughts crossed her mind, but the conclusion she always arrived at
was the same.

strings.text:
綾佳
「蟲を使うのではなく、蟲とともに生きる」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Not using Bugs -- but living alongside them."

strings.text:
綾佳
「この十年、夢美がそうやって生きてきたのを……
　あたしはこの目でしっかりと見てきた」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"For these past ten years, Yumemi has lived exactly that way...
 and I have watched it with my own eyes."

strings.text:
小さく呟いた綾佳の足に、いつの間にか今までの姿に
戻ったムーが擦り寄ってきた。
strings.translated: As Ayaka murmured softly, Muu -- who had somehow returned to her usual form -- rubbed up against Ayaka's feet.

strings.text:
綾佳はクスッと笑むと、その体を抱き上げて頭の上に
乗せる。
strings.translated: Ayaka let out a small chuckle, scooped her up, and placed her on top of her head.

strings.text:
綾佳
「さて、ムーよ。ご苦労だったな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Well then, Muu -- you've done well."

strings.text:
綾佳
「我等が父と母を護ったこと、褒めて遣わすとともに
　感謝しておるぞ」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"For protecting our father and mother, I commend you,
 and offer you my gratitude."

strings.text:
綾佳の言葉を喜ぶように、ムーが触手を伸ばしてゆら
ゆらと揺らす。
strings.translated: As if overjoyed by Ayaka's words, Muu extended her tentacles and swayed them gently back and forth.

strings.text:
腹の下にある顔を撫でると、綾佳がくすぐったそうに
笑った。
strings.translated: When Muu stroked the face beneath her belly, Ayaka laughed as if it tickled.

strings.text:
綾佳
「さて、行こうか。
　……夢美と優斗が待っておる」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Well then, shall we go.
 ...Yumemi and Yuuto are waiting for us."

strings.text:
ムーの体をぽんっと叩いて、綾佳が教会の出口へと
向かう。
strings.translated: Giving Muu's body a light pat, Ayaka headed toward the church exit.

strings.text:
夢美の十五年前の因縁を断ち切って、これから始まる
新しい生活へと歩き出して行ったのだった……。
strings.translated:
Having severed the ties of Yumemi's fifteen-year-old fate, she walked forward
into the new life that was about to begin......

strings.text:
夢美
「綾佳ぁっ、もう準備はできたの？」

綾佳
「おーっ、もう少しだ。暫し待て」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Yeah, just a little longer. Wait a moment."

strings.text:
夢美
「もう。一時間も前から声掛けてるのに」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Goodness. I've been calling you for over an hour now."

strings.text:
綾佳
「女は身嗜みに時間が掛かるのだ」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"A woman needs time to make herself presentable."

strings.text:
夢美
「私も女だけど、三十分前には済んでるわよ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm a woman too, and I was ready thirty minutes ago."

strings.text:
綾佳
「めかし込んでも無駄だからな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"There's no point in dolling yourself up anyway."

strings.text: 目をつり上げる夢美に、綾佳が白い歯を見せて笑う。
strings.translated: Yumemi's eyes narrow sharply, and Ayaka flashes a white-toothed grin.

strings.text:
今日は家族揃ってドライブに行くのだが、既に出発予
定時刻を十分も過ぎていた。
strings.translated: Today the whole family was going out for a drive, but they were already ten minutes past their planned departure time.

strings.text: もちろん、遅れた原因は全て綾佳だ。
strings.translated: Of course, the blame for the delay rested entirely on Ayaka.

strings.text:
綾佳
「おっ？　ムーはどこだ？」

夢美
「もう車に乗ってるわよ」

夢美
「ほら、早く準備する。それとももう終わったの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Come on, hurry up and get ready. Or are you done already?"

strings.text:
綾佳
「おっとっと……携帯携帯…………」

テーブルの上に置いてあった携帯電話を手に取って、
綾佳が玄関へと向かう。
strings.translated: Ayaka picks up the cell phone she had left on the table and heads toward the front door.

strings.text:
綾佳
「そういえば、今日はどこに行くのだ？
　ドライブとしか聞いておらんが……」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Come to think of it, where are we going today?
All I heard was that it was a drive..."

strings.text:
夢美
「適当に海のほうまで行くみたいよ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Sounds like we're just heading out toward the sea."

strings.text:
綾佳
「……今更だが、本当に優斗の運転は大丈夫なのだろ
　うな？」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"...I know it's a bit late to ask, but Yuuto's driving really is going to be fine, right?"

strings.text:
靴を履きながら綾佳に尋ねられ、夢美が苦笑いしなが
ら曖昧な答えを返す。
strings.translated: Ayaka asks while putting on her shoes, and Yumemi answers with an awkward smile and a vague reply.

strings.text:
本人は大丈夫だと豪語しているのだが、何しろ昔は
あまり上手くなかった――――
strings.translated: He himself boasted that he was perfectly fine, but the fact was that he used to be not very good at it --

strings.text:
――正確には下手だったはずなので、不安がないと
言えば少しだけ嘘になる。
strings.translated: -- to be precise, he had been downright bad at it, so it would be a slight lie to say there was no cause for concern.

strings.text:
綾佳
「アクセルとブレーキを間違えて海にダイブなぞごめ
　んだからな」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"I'd rather not end up diving into the sea because he mixed up the gas and the brake."

strings.text:
夢美
「さすがにそれはないと思うけど……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I don't think it'll come to that, but..."

strings.text:
綾佳と話しているうちに、だんだん不安が大きくなっ
てくる。
strings.translated: As she talks with Ayaka, her unease slowly grows.

strings.text:
願わくば何事も起こりませんようにと、夢美は心の中
で祈った。
strings.translated: Yumemi prayed silently in her heart that nothing would go wrong.

strings.text:
綾佳
「さて、それでは行くか」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Well then, shall we be off."

strings.text:
夢美
「ええ、急ぎましょう」

綾佳
「……っと、そうだ。大事なことを忘れておった」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"...Oh, that's right. I almost forgot something important."

strings.text:
夢美
「えっ？　あ、ちょっと――――」

夢美が玄関のドアを開けようとすると、何かを思い出
したらしい綾佳が部屋へと戻っていく。
strings.translated: Just as Yumemi reaches for the front door, Ayaka seems to remember something and turns back into the room.

strings.text:
何事かとぽかんとしていると、すぐに戻って来て夢美
に小さな紙袋を差し出してきた。
strings.translated: Yumemi stands there puzzled, wondering what's going on, when Ayaka returns almost immediately and holds out a small paper bag.

strings.text:
表には薄い花柄が描かれていて、どこかのデパートあ
たりで買ってきた物らしい。
strings.translated: The outside is decorated with a delicate floral pattern -- it looks like something bought at a department store.

strings.text:
綾佳
「た、大した事ではないのだが、日ごろの、その……
　かん、しゃ……とか……込めてみたりな……」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"I-it's nothing much, but... it's got a bit of my everyday... g-gra... titude... or something... in it..."

strings.text:
綾佳が何かをプレゼントしてくれるなど、初めてのこ
とだ。
strings.translated: Ayaka giving her a gift -- that was a first.

strings.text:
夢美
「開けてみてもいい？」

どうやら照れているらしく、綾佳が頬を赤らめながら
そっぽを向く。
strings.translated: She seems to be embarrassed; Ayaka turns her face away, cheeks flushed red.

strings.text:
紙袋の中身は仄かなピンク色をしたハンカチで、桜の
ような模様が施されていた。
strings.translated: Inside the paper bag was a handkerchief in a soft shade of pink, adorned with a pattern resembling cherry blossoms.

strings.text:
綾佳
「な、なかなか良いのがなくてな……結構迷ったのだ
　が……」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"I-I couldn't find a very good one... I spent quite a while deciding..."

strings.text:
夢美
「綺麗な色じゃない。ありがとう、綾佳」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"What a lovely color. Thank you, Ayaka."

strings.text:
夢美
「でも、突然どうしたの？　誕生日でもないのに」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"But what brought this on all of a sudden? It's not my birthday."

strings.text:
綾佳
「ああ……いや、ほれ……今日は……アレだ……」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Ah... no, well, you see... today is... that thing..."

strings.text:
綾佳
「き、今日は……は、はは……はは…………」

綾佳
「ち、違うわっ、うつけ者っ！
　今日が母の日だという事くらい気付かんかっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"I-I'm not babbling, you fool!
Can't you even tell that today is Mother's Day?!"

strings.text: 綾佳の思わぬ言葉に、思わず思考が停止する。
strings.translated: Ayaka's unexpected words brought Yumemi's thoughts to a sudden halt.

strings.text:
頭の中でカレンダーを開いてみて、確かにその通り
だったことを思い出した。
strings.translated: She mentally flipped through a calendar and realized that yes, it was exactly as Ayaka said.

strings.text: だが、これは物凄い角度からの不意打ちだ。
strings.translated: But this was an ambush from a completely unexpected angle.

strings.text:
綾佳
「その……まあ……そういうことでな…………」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Well... I mean... that's just how it is..."

strings.text:
綾佳
「たまには……お、おか………………に…………
　プレゼント…………」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Every once in a while... I thought I'd get... m-mo............... a present..............."

strings.text: もごもごと口を動かしながら、綾佳が俯いてしまう。
strings.translated: Mumbling something under her breath, Ayaka looks down at the floor.

strings.text:
だが、夢美は胸の鼓動を高鳴らせながら、綾佳の言葉
を待った。
strings.translated: But Yumemi waited for Ayaka's words, her heart pounding in her chest.

strings.text: 互いに沈黙すること一分。
strings.translated: A full minute of silence passed between them.

strings.text:
やがて、綾佳は思い出したように靴を履き直すと、
下を向いたまま口を開いた。
strings.translated: At last, as if suddenly remembering herself, Ayaka straightened her shoes and opened her mouth, still looking down.

strings.text:
綾佳
「ゆ、優斗達が待っておる。そろそろ行こう」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Y-Yuuto and the others are waiting. We should get going."

strings.text:
夢美
「えっ？　あ……そ、そうね…………」
少し苦笑いしながら、夢美がうなずく。
strings.translated: Yumemi nods with a slight, wry smile.

strings.text:
もう少し粘りたい気持ちはあったが、確かに優斗達を
待たせすぎている。
strings.translated: She wanted to press a little longer, but they really had kept Yuuto and the others waiting too long.

strings.text:
綾佳が靴を履いたのを確認してドアを開けると、不意
に左手が柔らかく握られた。
strings.translated: She confirmed that Ayaka had put her shoes on and opened the door -- when her left hand was suddenly clasped in something soft.

strings.text: 視線を落とすと、綾佳が赤面しながら手を繋いでいる。
strings.translated: Glancing down, she saw Ayaka holding her hand, face flushed red.

strings.text: 夢美はクスッと笑むと、優しくその手を握り返した。
strings.translated: Yumemi let out a small laugh and gently squeezed her hand in return.
There is no need to rush.

strings.text:
まだまだ先は長いのだから、ゆっくりと家族揃って
歩いて行けばいい。
strings.translated: They still had a long road ahead of them -- plenty of time to walk it together, as a family.

strings.text:
夢美
「行きましょうか、綾佳」
スカートの中から蟲筒を取り出して、綾佳が構える。
strings.translated: Ayaka drew her Bug tube from beneath her skirt and took her stance.

strings.text:
口元に笑みを浮かべると、真正面から煉獄を睨み付け
た。
strings.translated: A smile played at the corner of her lips as she fixed her gaze straight ahead at Rengoku.

strings.text:
綾佳
「ありったけの蟲を叩き込んでくれるわ」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"I'll drive every last Bug I have into you."

strings.text:
煉獄
「ふん、犯しながら殺してやる」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Heh. I'll rape you while I kill you."

strings.text: 煉獄が、ゆっくりと左右の拳を固める。
strings.translated: Rengoku slowly clenched his fists, left and right.

strings.text:
蟲よりも、強化された己の肉体で仕留めるつもりの
ようだった。
strings.translated: It seemed he intended to finish this with his own enhanced body rather than with Bugs.

strings.text:
綾佳
「夢美っ！　優斗っ！
　お前達は客人を避難させろっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Yumemi! Yuuto!
Get the guests out of here!!"

strings.text:
綾佳
「コイツは何としてもアタシが――――――」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"This one is mine no matter what -- "

strings.text:
静かに、綾佳の言葉を断ち切るように、夢美の声が
教会内に響いた。
strings.translated: Quietly, as if cutting through Ayaka's words, Yumemi's voice echoed through the church.

strings.text:
そして、ゆっくりと足を進めると、綾佳よりもさらに
前へと出る。
strings.translated: Then, stepping forward slowly, she moved out ahead of Ayaka.

strings.text:
綾佳
「お、おいっ！　何をしとるかっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"H-hey! What do you think you're doing?!"

strings.text:
夢美
「この男との決着をつけるのは、私の役目よ」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Settling things with this man is my role."

strings.text:
綾佳
「馬鹿を言うなっ！　これは蟲使いの――――――」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Don't be absurd! This is a Bug User's -- "

strings.text:
夢美
「優斗、ここにいる人達を安全なところに避難させ
　て……」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yuuto, get everyone here to somewhere safe..."

strings.text:
綾佳
「こらっ！　聞かんかっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"Hey! Are you even listening to me?!"

strings.text: 夢美は後ろを振り向かなかった。
正面の煉獄を見据えたまま、静かな声で言っていた。
strings.translated: She kept her eyes fixed on Rengoku ahead of her, speaking in a quiet voice.

strings.text:
だが、それでも優斗には、夢美が一瞬だけ優しい笑顔
で振り向いてくれたように感じられたのだった。
strings.translated: And yet, to Yuuto, it felt as though Yumemi had turned to him for just a moment with a gentle smile.

strings.text:
優斗
「分かった。……みんなのことは俺に任せて」

夢美の背中に力強く頷いて、列席者達の避難を開始さ
せる。
strings.translated: He gave a firm nod toward Yumemi's back and began evacuating the congregation.

strings.text:
途中、アゲハや唯、ユーリアも協力してくれて、全員
の避難が済むのに十分と掛からなかった。
strings.translated: In the meantime, Ageha, Yui, and Yulia lent their help as well, and it took less than ten minutes to get everyone out.

strings.text:
後に残ったのは、夢美、煉獄、綾佳、そして優斗の
四人。
strings.translated:
Those who remained were Yumemi, Rengoku, Ayaka, and Yuuto --
four in all.

strings.text:
優斗は、夢美の背中を見つめると、精一杯の笑顔を
浮かべて言った。
strings.translated:
Yuuto looked at Yumemi's back, put on the biggest smile he could manage,
and spoke.

strings.text:
優斗
「約束してくれ。……必ず帰って来るって」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Promise me. ...That you'll come back. No matter what."

Yumemi
"Yes, I'll come back. I promise."

strings.text:
夢美
「――あなたのところへ」

ほんの一瞬だけ、今度は本当に夢美が振り向いて笑っ
た。
strings.translated: -- For just a brief moment, Yumemi truly turned around this time and smiled.

strings.text: 優斗が綾佳の肩に手を載せ、無言で頷いて見せる。
strings.translated: Then Yuuto placed a hand on Ayaka's shoulder and gave a silent nod.

strings.text:
優斗
「俺には難しいことは分からないけど、綾佳じゃあい
　つには勝てない」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I don't understand the complicated stuff, but you can't beat him, Ayaka."

strings.text:
優斗
「俺は俺にできること……綾佳は綾佳にできることを
　すればいいんだ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I'll do what I can do... and Ayaka should do what Ayaka can do."

strings.text:
綾佳
「あたしに……できること…………」
綾佳は俯いて、しばらく教会の床を見つめた。
strings.translated: Ayaka hung her head and stared at the church floor for a long moment.

strings.text:
本当のことを言えば、煉獄に勝てる見込みがあったわ
けではない。
strings.translated: To tell the truth, there was no real prospect of winning against Rengoku.

strings.text:
一度戦って勝てないと踏み、とにかく片っ端から使え
そうな蟲を掻き集めてきただけだ。
strings.translated: She had fought him once before, judged she couldn't win, and had simply gathered every Bug she could find that might be of use.

strings.text:
破壊力のある蟲は何匹かいるが、それもどこまで効果
があるのかは分からない。
strings.translated: She had a few Bugs with considerable destructive power, but how effective they would actually be -- she had no idea.

strings.text: だからこそ――本当は綾佳にも分かっていた。
strings.translated: And that was precisely why -- deep down, Ayaka already knew.

strings.text:
あの怪物に勝てる唯一の見込みがあるとすれば、それ
は――――
strings.translated: If there was any chance at all of defeating that monster, it would have to be ----

strings.text:
綾佳
「だが、夢美っ！
　あたしとも一つだけ約束しろっ！！」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"But, Yumemi! Promise me one thing too!!"

strings.text:
綾佳
「必ず……必ず、あたしを夢美の娘にしろ」
strings.translated:
Ayaka
"You have to... you absolutely have to make me Yumemi's daughter."

strings.text:
夢美
「私の話、聞いてなかったの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Were you not listening to what I said?"

strings.text:
夢美
「あなたは――私の娘だって言ったでしょう？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I already told you -- that you are my daughter."

strings.text:
振り向きこそしなかったものの、夢美はとても優しい
声で言った。
strings.translated: Though she still did not turn around, Yumemi spoke in a very gentle voice.

strings.text:
綾佳は、ぐっと胸が詰まるような呻き声を漏らし、
そしてボロボロと大粒の涙を零し始めた。
strings.translated: Ayaka let out a choked, strangled groan, and then great fat tears began spilling down her cheeks one after another.

strings.text:
そんな綾佳の肩に手を当てたまま、優斗が教会から出
るよう促す。
strings.translated: Keeping his hand on Ayaka's shoulder, Yuuto gently urged her toward the church exit.

strings.text:
綾佳は黙ってそれに従うと、最後にぐっと胸を張って
教会の出口へと向かって行った。
strings.translated: Ayaka silently complied, and at the last moment squared her shoulders with resolve before heading for the church doors.

strings.text: そして、優斗もまた夢美に背を向け――――
strings.translated: And then Yuuto, too, turned his back on Yumemi ----

strings.text: ――夢美にはもう言葉を掛けず、教会を後にした。
strings.translated: -- Without another word to Yumemi, he left the church.

strings.text:
煉獄
「今度こそ話は済んだか？」

夢美
「ええ、待たせたわね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Yes. Sorry to keep you waiting."

strings.text:
煉獄
「構わん。どうせすぐに着く勝負だ」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"No matter. It'll be over soon enough anyway."

strings.text:
煉獄
「テメーが何を考えてるのか知らねぇが、今のオレを
　殺せるとでも思ってんのか？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"I don't know what the hell you're thinking, but do you really believe you can kill me the way I am now?"

strings.text:
煉獄
「オレはなぁ、もう人間が殺せるような体じゃねーん
　だよ」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"You see, this body of mine isn't something a human can kill anymore."

strings.text: 自分の胸を親指で差して、煉獄がニヤリと笑う。
strings.translated: Rengoku jabbed a thumb at his own chest and flashed a grin.

strings.text:
その体はよく見ると大量の触手がうねっており、無数
の蟲が寄り集まったものである事が見て取れた。
strings.translated: Looking closely, one could see countless tentacles writhing across his body -- it was clear he was an amalgamation of innumerable Bugs.
-- There was no way he could lose.

strings.text: 煉獄の頭には、勝利への確信があった。
strings.translated: Rengoku's mind was filled with absolute certainty of victory.

strings.text: 相手はただの女が一人。
strings.translated: His opponent was nothing but a single woman.

strings.text:
どんな転び方をしても、そもそも相手には自分を殺す
方法がないのだ。
strings.translated: No matter how things played out, she simply had no way to kill him.

strings.text: その時点で、この戦いの決着はついたも同然だった。
strings.translated: At that point, the outcome of this battle was as good as decided.
As good as decided -- or so it should have been ----.

strings.text:
煉獄
「さあ、どうやって殺してやろーか？
　なんなら、テメーの犯され方を決めさせてやっても
　いいぜ？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Now then, how shall I kill you?
 If you like, I'll even let you choose how you want to be violated?"

strings.text:
煉獄
「そうだ。犯されながら、この教会を出て行くなんて
　のはどうだ？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"I know -- how about getting violated while walking out of this church?
 How does that sound?"

strings.text:
煉獄
「クヒヒヒャヒャヒャヒャヒャヒャヒャッ！！！！」
煉獄が、腹を抱えるようにして高笑いする。
strings.translated: Rengoku doubled over as if clutching his stomach, roaring with laughter.

strings.text:
既に決まっている自分の勝利に、早くも酔っている
感じだった。
strings.translated: He was already drunk on the certainty of his own victory.

strings.text:
そして、夢美は、そんな煉獄を静かに見つめなが
ら――――
strings.translated: And Yumemi, quietly watching Rengoku like that --

strings.text:
煉獄
「クヒヒヒャヒャヒャ……ヒャ……ヒ…………？」
己の持つ『力』を――解放させ始めた――――ッ！
strings.translated: -- began to unleash the 'power' she possessed ----!!

strings.text: 肌に感じた冷気とともに、煉獄の高笑いが消える。
strings.translated: Along with a chill felt against the skin, Rengoku's laughter died away.

strings.text:
耳の傍でパリパリと薄いものが割れる音が聞こえ、
教会内の空気が一変した。
strings.translated:
Near his ear came the sound of something thin cracking and splintering,
and the air inside the church changed completely.

strings.text: 異様な気配を感じ取り、思わず辺りを見回す。
strings.translated: Sensing something deeply wrong, he instinctively looked around.

strings.text:
だが、その場にいるのは確かに自分と夢美だけであり、
体に突き刺さってくるような異様な気配は―――――
strings.translated: Yet the only ones present were himself and Yumemi -- and the unsettling presence that seemed to pierce right through him was --

strings.text:
煉獄
「なんだ、貴様…………この気配は何だっ！！？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"What are you...... what is this presence!!?"

strings.text: 右腕を出そうとした瞬間、パキンと何かが砕けた。
strings.translated: The instant he tried to extend his right arm, something snapped and shattered.

strings.text: 緑色の肌から、薄い氷のカケラのようなものが散った。
strings.translated: From his green skin, fragments like thin shards of ice scattered outward.

strings.text:
それが、いったい何を意味するのか、煉獄にはまだ
分からない。
strings.translated: What that meant, exactly, Rengoku still could not comprehend.

strings.text:
ただ、その肉体に取り込んだ蟲達が、何かに怯えるよ
うに一斉に騒ぎ始めていた。
strings.translated: Only -- the Bugs he had absorbed into his body had all begun to stir at once, as if cowering from something.

strings.text: 目の前にいる櫻井夢美の、その――――――
strings.translated: It was coming from Sakurai Yumemi, standing right before him -- from her------

strings.text:
煉獄
「右腕かぁーーーーーーーーーーーーーっ！！！！」
堪りかねたように、煉獄が床を蹴って飛び出す。
strings.translated: As if he could bear it no longer, Rengoku kicked off the floor and lunged forward.

strings.text:
全身に纏わり付いていた氷が音を立てて散ったが、
もはやそんなものに構っている余裕はない。
strings.translated: The ice that had clung to his entire body shattered with a sound, but he had no time to worry about that now.

strings.text:
夢美の右腕にある『何か』に向かって、硬く拳を固め
た豪腕を振り下ろす。
strings.translated: He brought his iron fist crashing down toward whatever 'something' was on Yumemi's right arm.

strings.text: だが、その瞬間、夢美の右腕が大きく真横に薙いだ。
strings.translated: But in that instant, Yumemi's right arm swept wide to the side.

strings.text: 青白い閃光が、煉獄の胸を裂いた。
strings.translated: A pale blue flash tore through Rengoku's chest.

strings.text:
肉眼で視認できるか否かの疾さで、夢美の右腕が空を
切り裂いていた。
strings.translated: Moving at a speed barely perceptible to the naked eye, Yumemi's right arm had sliced through the air.

strings.text: 夢美の右腕に生えているもの。
strings.translated: What was growing from Yumemi's right arm.

strings.text: それは、紛れもなく蟲そのものだった。
strings.translated: It was unmistakably a Bug itself.

strings.text:
煉獄
「貴様も……貴様もそんなものを持っていたのか」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"You too...... you had something like that as well."

strings.text: 動揺する煉獄を前に、夢美は静かに言葉を紡いでいた。
strings.translated: Before the visibly shaken Rengoku, Yumemi quietly began to speak.

strings.text: しょせん、自分自身の肉体はただの人間でしかない。
strings.translated: In the end, her own body was nothing more than a mere human's.

strings.text:
煉獄のような怪物を葬り去るためには、この方法しか
なかった。
strings.translated: To bring down a monster like Rengoku, there had been no other way.

strings.text:
夢美
「お願い――私達を護って――――――ッ！」
夢美の願いが、右腕をさらに変化させる。
strings.translated: Yumemi's wish drove the right arm to transform further.

strings.text:
どこまでも硬く、どこまでも冷たく、そしてどこまで
も鋭く――――。
strings.translated: Harder and harder, colder and colder, and sharper and sharper ----.

strings.text:
やがて、右腕全体がメタリックブルーの輝きを放ち始
め、場の空気を一気に下げていく。
strings.translated: Before long, the entire right arm began to radiate a metallic blue glow, rapidly dropping the temperature of the air around them.

strings.text:
煉獄はおろか、夢美までその冷気によって肌を蝕まれ
始めていた。
strings.translated: Not only Rengoku -- even Yumemi herself had begun to have her skin eaten away by the cold.

strings.text:
夢美
「大丈夫……そのまま続けて………………」
胸に秘めた願いを、蟲へと託す。
strings.translated: She entrusted the wish held within her heart to the Bug.

strings.text:
腕と肩の結合面がピリッと痛んだが、夢美はそれを
口には出さなかった。
strings.translated: A sharp pain shot through the joint where her arm met her shoulder, but Yumemi said nothing of it.

strings.text:
煉獄
「く……おおおおおおおおおおおおおっ！！！！」
煉獄が猛り、全身から蟲を飛ばす。
strings.translated: Rengoku roared and launched Bugs from across his entire body.

strings.text: その数は十匹を超え、種類も全てバラバラだ。
strings.translated: Their number exceeded ten, and every one was a different kind.

strings.text:
どの蟲がどんな能力、特性を持っているかなど、対峙
する夢美が知るはずもない。
strings.translated: What abilities or traits each Bug possessed -- there was no way Yumemi, facing them, could know.

strings.text:
煉獄
「死ねっ！　何をするつもりか知らんが死ねぇっ！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Die! I don't know what you're trying to do, but DIE!"

strings.text: 煉獄が命令を下し、十匹の蟲を一斉に飛ばす。
strings.translated: Rengoku issued his command and unleashed all ten Bugs at once.

strings.text:
今尚、右腕を変化させ続ける夢美へ向けて、彼が持つ
攻撃用の全種の蟲を撃った。
strings.translated: He fired every offensive Bug in his arsenal at Yumemi, who was still continuing to transform her right arm.

strings.text:
夢美の右手の指から伸びた五本爪が、放たれた蟲の
全てを切り裂いていた。
strings.translated: The five claws extending from the fingers of Yumemi's right hand had sliced through every single one of the launched Bugs.

strings.text:
切り裂かれた蟲達は、その傷口を凍らされていき、
床に落ちて動かなくなる。
strings.translated: The sliced Bugs had their wounds frozen over, and fell to the floor, no longer moving.

strings.text: その圧倒的な強さに、煉獄は初めて恐怖で息を呑んだ。
strings.translated: Faced with that overwhelming power, Rengoku felt fear for the first time, his breath catching in his throat.

strings.text:
煉獄
「なん、だと……こんな、馬鹿な………………ッ！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Wh-what...... this can't be, this is impossible............!!"

strings.text:
煉獄
「き、貴様っ、それはなんだっ！？
　いったい何の蟲を宿してやがるっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Y-you...! What is that?!
Just what kind of Bug are you harboring?!"

strings.text:
夢美
「あなたが言っていたことよ」

夢美
「伝説の――獣魔蟲だって――――――」

夢美の口から放たれた言葉に、煉獄は驚愕し目を剥い
た。
strings.translated: The words that left Yumemi's mouth struck Rengoku with shock, his eyes going wide.

strings.text:
それはかつて、彼自身が『期待外れ』だと言って捨て
た蟲。
strings.translated: It was a Bug that he himself had once called "a disappointment" and discarded.

strings.text:
踏み潰し、自分の蟲で切り刻み、鼻でせせら笑ってい
た蟲。
strings.translated: A Bug he had trampled underfoot, shredded with his own Bugs, and sneered at with contempt.

strings.text:
煉獄
「それが獣魔蟲だと言うのかっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"You're telling me that thing is the Jumachuu?!"

strings.text: 煉獄の肉体から、今度は無数の触手が撃ち出される。
strings.translated: From Rengoku's body, countless tentacles now shot outward.

strings.text:
正面に立つ夢美へと向けて、大小様々な触手で串刺し
にしようと試みた。
strings.translated: He attempted to skewer Yumemi, who stood directly before him, with tentacles of every shape and size.

strings.text: だが、それさえも防がれる。

夢美の右腕から旋風のように回転した五本爪が、煉獄
の触手を粉々に打ち砕いていった。
strings.translated: The five claws spinning like a whirlwind from Yumemi's right arm shattered Rengoku's tentacles to pieces.

strings.text:
氷の破片が辺りに舞い散り、バラバラと音を立てて
床へと落ちる。
strings.translated: Shards of ice scattered through the air, clattering as they fell to the floor.

strings.text:
そこでようやく、煉獄は自分が決定的なミスを犯して
いたことに気付いた。
strings.translated: It was then, finally, that Rengoku realized he had made a fatal mistake.

strings.text:
まだ、夢美が戦う意思を固めていないとき、蝶型の蟲
で体を麻痺させたあの時に、すぐさま殺しておくべき
だったのだ。
strings.translated: When Yumemi had not yet steeled herself to fight -- back when he had paralyzed her body with the butterfly-type Bug -- he should have killed her then and there.

strings.text:
この十五年間、蟲使いのことを知りながらも生き抜い
てきた女の危険性を、もっと早くに感じ取るべきだっ
たのだ。
strings.translated: He should have recognized far sooner the danger posed by a woman who had survived fifteen years with full knowledge of Bug Users.

strings.text: そこで、夢美の体がよろめく。
strings.translated: At that moment, Yumemi's body swayed.

strings.text:
一瞬だけ意識が遠くなり、足元から力が抜けそうに
なった。
strings.translated: For just an instant, her consciousness began to fade, and the strength drained from her legs.

strings.text: だが、そんなことはできない。
strings.translated: But she could not allow that.

strings.text:
何しろ夢美には、果たさなければならない約束が二つ
もあるのだ。
strings.translated: After all, Yumemi had not one but two promises she had yet to fulfill.

strings.text:
その想いを裏切るような真似だけは、絶対に赦されな
いのだ。
strings.translated: Betraying those feelings -- that alone was something she could never, ever be forgiven for.

strings.text:
夢美
「く――ああああああああああああああっ！！！！」

鋭利な刃物のように光る五本爪を、大きく真上に振り
あげる。
strings.translated: She swings the five claws, gleaming like razor-sharp blades, high up above her.

strings.text:
煉獄
「ぐっ、おっ、があっ、の、伸びただとっ！！？」
突如、触手のように伸びた五本爪。
strings.translated: Suddenly, the five claws stretched out like tentacles.

strings.text:
それが、頭上から槍のように降り注ぐのを、煉獄は
肩や両腕、脇腹の肉を削ぎ落とされながらかわした。
strings.translated: They rained down from above like spears, and Rengoku barely dodged as flesh was carved from his shoulders, both arms, and sides.

strings.text: 頑強な肉体など、まるで役に立たない。
strings.translated: His formidable body was utterly useless now.

strings.text:
頭や心臓を貫かれれば、それで終わりなのは間違いな
かった。
strings.translated: If his head or heart were pierced, there was no doubt it would all be over.

strings.text:
煉獄
「チッ、忌々しいものを持ち歩きやがって……」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Tch, carrying around something that damned annoying..."

strings.text:
自分の持つ蟲で勝負にならないことは、先ほどの攻防
で既に理解している。
strings.translated: He already understood from the exchange moments ago that his own Bugs were no match in a direct fight.

strings.text:
夢美に勝つ手段があるとすれば、それは本体の差だっ
た。
strings.translated: If there was any way to defeat Yumemi, it lay in the difference between their base bodies.

strings.text:
触手を繋ぎ合わせるようにして、肉体をすぐさま再生
させる。
strings.translated: He knits the tentacles back together, regenerating his flesh in an instant.

strings.text:
夢美
「そう……あなたもそういう体なのね…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I see... you have that kind of body too............"

strings.text:
みるみるうちに煉獄の傷口が塞がっていくのを見て、
夢美はすっと目を細めた。
strings.translated: Watching Rengoku's wounds seal themselves shut before her eyes, Yumemi narrowed her gaze.

strings.text:
いくら獣魔蟲の力を使っていても、相手の傷が癒えて
しまうのでは意味がない。
strings.translated: No matter how much she drew on the power of the Jumachuu, it meant nothing if her opponent's wounds kept healing.

strings.text:
戦いが長引けば長引くほど、本体が人間である自分達
のほうが不利だった。
strings.translated: The longer the battle dragged on, the more disadvantaged she and her fully human body would become.

strings.text: そして、それは既に煉獄も理解に至っている……。
strings.translated: And Rengoku had already come to understand that as well...

strings.text:
どんなに強力な攻撃を放ったとしても、相手を仕留め
切れなければ意味はない。
strings.translated: No matter how powerful an attack one unleashed, it was meaningless if the enemy could not be finished off.

strings.text:
今は一時的に劣勢だが、必ず勝機は巡ってくると、
煉獄は確信を持っていた。
strings.translated: Though he was temporarily at a disadvantage, Rengoku was certain that an opening would come.

strings.text:
煉獄
「クヒッ、どうした？
　立ってるのも辛そうじゃねぇか」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Khih, what's wrong?
You look like you can barely stay on your feet."

strings.text:
煉獄
「空気を冷やす力があるようだが、テメーのほうが
　先にまいりそうだぜ？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Seems like you've got the power to chill the air, but looks like you'll be the one
going down first, yeah?"

strings.text:
挑発とも聞こえる煉獄の言葉に、夢美は微かに目を
細めた。
strings.translated: At Rengoku's words, which might as well have been provocation, Yumemi narrowed her eyes slightly.

strings.text: 指摘された部分は、決して間違いではない。
strings.translated: What he pointed out was not wrong.

strings.text:
生身の体で蟲の作り出した冷気の空間に長くいるのは、
自殺行為にも等しいことなのだ。
strings.translated: For an unprotected human body to remain long in a space chilled by a Bug's cold -- it was tantamount to suicide.

strings.text:
実際、右腕から突き上がってくる冷気が、少しずつ
夢美の体を蝕み始めている。
strings.translated: In fact, the cold air surging up from her right arm had already begun to slowly eat away at Yumemi's body.

strings.text: 煉獄に向けて、右腕の五本爪を振るう。
strings.translated: She swings the five claws of her right arm at Rengoku.

strings.text:
右肩の接続部から伝わってくる痛みに耐えながら、
夢美は戦い続けることを選んだ。
strings.translated:
Enduring the pain radiating from the connection point at her right shoulder,
Yumemi chose to keep fighting.

strings.text:
たとえどんなに肉体が悲鳴を上げても、煉獄だけは今
ここで倒さなければならない。
strings.translated:
No matter how loudly her body screamed, she had to bring Rengoku down
here and now.

strings.text: そのために、かつて十年前――――
strings.translated: And for that purpose, going back to that time ten years ago ----

strings.text:
――レンと戦ったとき以上の力が必要なのであれば、
躊躇うつもりもなかった。
strings.translated:
-- If she needed even greater power than when she fought Ren,
she had no intention of holding back.

strings.text: 煉獄が全身から蟲を放ちながら、夢美との距離を取る。
strings.translated: Rengoku releases Bugs from all over his body as he creates distance between himself and Yumemi.

strings.text:
接近戦の技術で負けるつもりはなかったが、獣魔蟲が
武器として振るわれているとなれば話は別だ。
strings.translated:
He had no intention of losing in close-quarters combat, but if the Jumachuu was being wielded
as a weapon, that was another matter entirely.

strings.text:
伝説を信じているわけではなかったが、現にこうして
存在している以上、迂闊に手を出すことはできない。
strings.translated:
He didn't believe in legends, but given that the thing plainly existed before him,
he couldn't afford to act carelessly.

strings.text:
それよりも戦いを長引かせ、本体である夢美の体力が
減るのを待つほうが得策だった。
strings.translated:
It was wiser to drag out the fight and wait
for Yumemi's stamina -- the main body -- to wear down.

strings.text:
煉獄が放った蟲は、夢美にたどり着く前にことごとく
切り裂かれて死んだ。
strings.translated:
Every Bug Rengoku unleashed was sliced apart and killed
before it could reach Yumemi.

strings.text: 並の人間の反射速度ではない。
strings.translated: That was no ordinary human's reflexes.

strings.text:
まるで、視認するより早く蟲の位置を察知して動いて
いるような、そんな攻撃の仕方だった。
strings.translated:
It was as if she was sensing the Bugs' positions and moving
before she could even see them -- that was the nature of her attacks.

strings.text:
夢美
「蟲の数が減ってる……。
　何匹もいるのは確かでも、限界はあるみたいね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"The number of Bugs is going down...
 I'm sure there are plenty of them, but it seems there's a limit."

strings.text:
煉獄
「なに？　貴様……感知できるのか……ッ！？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"What? You... you can sense them...!?"

strings.text:
十年前の出来事を知らない煉獄にとって、それは予想
もしていなかった言葉だった。
strings.translated:
For Rengoku, who knew nothing of what had happened ten years ago,
those were words he had never anticipated.

strings.text:
蟲が感知されるということは、自分の持ち弾が全て
知られているのと変わりない。
strings.translated:
If his Bugs were being detected, it was no different from
having all his ammunition laid bare.

strings.text:
しかも、煉獄は気付いていなかったが、この戦いの中
で夢美の感覚はピーク時だった十年前にまで戻りつつ
あった。
strings.translated:
Moreover -- though Rengoku hadn't noticed -- in the midst of this battle,
Yumemi's senses were returning to what they had been at their peak,
ten years ago.

strings.text: もっとも、それは諸刃の剣。
strings.translated: Though that, too, was a double-edged sword.

strings.text:
獣魔蟲の力が強まれば強まるほど、夢美の肉体に掛か
る負荷は大きくなる。
strings.translated:
The stronger the Jumachuu's power grew, the greater
the burden placed on Yumemi's body.

strings.text:
その限界ギリギリのところで、十年前はレンに勝利す
ることができたのだ。
strings.translated:
It was right at that very limit where, ten years ago,
she had managed to defeat Ren.

strings.text:
夢美が五本爪を振るった瞬間、煉獄が己の左腕でそれ
を受け止めた。
strings.translated:
The instant Yumemi swung her five claws, Rengoku caught them
with his own left arm.

strings.text:
もちろん無傷ではなく、腕の半分は切られ、爪が骨ま
で食い込んだ。
strings.translated: Of course he wasn't unscathed -- half his arm was cut open, the claws biting down to the bone.

strings.text:
しかし、それこそが煉獄の狙いであり、目の前には
動きの止まった夢美の姿があった。
strings.translated:
But that was precisely what Rengoku had been aiming for,
and before him stood Yumemi, her movement stopped.

strings.text:
そのチャンスを逃すほど、煉獄はのんびりした性格は
していない。
strings.translated: Rengoku was not the type to let an opportunity like that slip by.

strings.text: 煉獄の巨大な脚が、夢美を襲った。
strings.translated: Rengoku's massive leg came crashing down on Yumemi.

strings.text: 腹を蹴られ、そのまま後方へと吹っ飛ばされる。
strings.translated: Kicked in the stomach, she was sent flying backward.

strings.text:
耳の奥でミシミシと音が聞こえ、一瞬にして世界が
反転した。
strings.translated: A creaking sound rang deep in her ears, and in an instant the world flipped upside down.

strings.text:
気付いたときにはテーブルに肩をぶつけながら、赤い
絨毯の上を滑っていた。
strings.translated:
By the time she came to, she was sliding across the red carpet,
shoulder slamming into a table.

strings.text: 頭の奥がグラグラと揺れる。
strings.translated: The back of her head swam and swayed.

strings.text:
たとえ獣魔蟲という力を得ていても、夢美自身の肉体
まで強化されているわけではない。
strings.translated:
Even with the power of the Jumachuu, Yumemi's own body
had not been physically strengthened.

strings.text:
体格からして違う煉獄の一撃をまともに受ければ、
それで死んでもおかしくはなかった。
strings.translated:
Taking a direct hit from Rengoku, whose very build was on a different level --
it wouldn't have been strange if that alone had killed her.

strings.text: 夢美に襲い掛かって来た蟲を、間一髪の差でかわす。
strings.translated: Yumemi dodged the Bug lunging at her by a hair's breadth.

strings.text: 煉獄の豪腕が、夢美の体に衝撃を伝える。
strings.translated: Rengoku's powerful arm drove a shockwave through Yumemi's body.

strings.text:
辛うじて右腕で防ぎはしたものの、頭の奥がさらに
揺れた気がした。
strings.translated:
She barely managed to block with her right arm, but it felt as though
the back of her head swayed even further.

strings.text: 五本爪を振るうが、今度は余裕でかわされる。
strings.translated: She swung the five claws, but this time they were dodged with ease.

strings.text:
正面に立つ煉獄を見ると、左腕の傷はすっかり完治し
ていた。
strings.translated:
Looking at Rengoku standing before her, the wound on his left arm
had already healed completely.

strings.text:
ただ切ったり突いたりするだけでは、煉獄を倒すこと
はできない。
strings.translated:
Simply slashing and stabbing would not be enough
to bring Rengoku down.

strings.text:
首を切るか、心臓を貫くか、そのくらいの攻撃でなけ
れば、致命傷にはならないようだった。
strings.translated:
It seemed that nothing short of severing his neck or piercing his heart
would deal a fatal blow.

strings.text:
煉獄の首を撥ねようと五本爪を振るったが、真っ向か
ら殴り返される。
strings.translated: She swung her five claws to sever Rengoku's neck, but was met with a direct counter-punch.

strings.text: 夢美の右腕が弾かれ、胴体ががら空きになった。
strings.translated: Yumemi's right arm was knocked aside, leaving her torso wide open.

strings.text: 反射的に床を蹴って、背後へと跳ぶ。
strings.translated: On reflex, she kicked off the floor and leaped backward.

strings.text:
夢美が跳ぶのと、煉獄が蹴りを打ち出すのは同時だっ
た。
strings.translated: Yumemi's leap and Rengoku's kick were simultaneous.

strings.text: 胸が潰れるかと思うほどの圧迫感。
strings.translated: A crushing pressure, as though her chest were about to cave in.

strings.text:
声さえ出せないまま、夢美の体は壁まで吹っ飛ばされ
た。
strings.translated: Unable to even cry out, Yumemi's body was sent flying into the wall.

strings.text:
夢美
「げほっ……げほげほっ、げほぉ…………ッ！」
激しくむせ返りながら、それでも急いで立ち上がる。
strings.translated: Coughing violently, she still forced herself to her feet as fast as she could.

strings.text:
視界には入らなかったが、蟲が襲い掛かってきている
気配を察知していた。
strings.translated: She hadn't seen it coming, but she sensed the presence of a Bug lunging at her.

strings.text: 爪を振るい、直撃する寸前だった蟲を切り裂く。
strings.translated: She swung her claws and sliced through the Bug just before it could land a direct hit.

strings.text:
煉獄を睨み付けると、余裕が出たためかニヤニヤと
笑っていた。
strings.translated: She glared at Rengoku, who was now grinning smugly, as if he'd found his footing.

strings.text: たった二発の蹴りによって、戦況は大きく変わる。
strings.translated: In just two kicks, the tide of battle had shifted dramatically.

strings.text:
獣魔蟲という存在の強さより、夢美という存在の弱さ
が、戦いに影響を及ぼし始めていた。
strings.translated: It was no longer the strength of the Jumachuu that was shaping the fight -- it was Yumemi's own weakness.

strings.text:
煉獄
「クヒッ、オレらしくもなく最初はビビっちまったが、
　しょせんはただの人間だな」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Kheh, not like me to get spooked at first, but you're just a plain old human after all."

strings.text:
煉獄
「テメーに獣魔蟲なんざ、宝の持ち腐れってやつだ」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Giving a Jumachuu to someone like you -- that's what they call a waste of a good thing."

strings.text: そう言いながら、煉獄の体がボコボコと波打ち始める。
strings.translated: As he said this, Rengoku's body began to ripple and bulge.

strings.text:
肉体に宿した無数の蟲が、そこから分離しようとして
いた。
strings.translated: The countless Bugs dwelling within his flesh were trying to separate from it.

strings.text:
煉獄
「決めたぜ。テメーは跡形もなく吹き飛ばしてやる」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"I've decided. I'm going to blow you apart without a trace."

strings.text:
煉獄
「そんで、その獣魔蟲はオレがもらってやらぁ」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"And then I'll be taking that Jumachuu for myself."

strings.text:
煉獄
「元々はオレが持ってた卵なんだからな。
　文句はねーよなァ？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"It was my egg to begin with, after all.
 No complaints, yeah?"

strings.text: 煉獄の周りに、様々な種類の蟲が現れてくる。
strings.translated: All manner of Bug species began to emerge around Rengoku.

strings.text:
それらが全て攻撃用の蟲であり、まともに喰らえば
死は免れないことを、夢美は直感的に悟った。
strings.translated: Yumemi instinctively understood that every last one of them was an attack-type Bug, and that taking a direct hit from any of them meant certain death.

strings.text:
煉獄
「そのフラフラの状態で、これだけの蟲を捌ききれる
　か？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"In that barely-standing state of yours, can you really handle this many Bugs?"

strings.text:
あらゆる方向から襲い掛かって来る蟲を、夢美の五本
爪が切り裂いていく。
strings.translated: Yumemi's five claws sliced through the Bugs swarming at her from every direction.

strings.text:
夢美
「く、あっ！　ああっ、くううぅぅっ！！！」

次から次へと撃ち出される蟲を、夢美が必死に爪を
振るって撃破する。
strings.translated: Yumemi desperately swung her claws, striking down the Bugs launched at her one after another.

strings.text:
一度に三、四匹は片付けているのだが、それでも尚、
煉獄の蟲は撃ち込まれて来た。
strings.translated: She was taking out three or four at a time, and yet Rengoku's Bugs kept coming.

strings.text:
無尽蔵ではないにしろ、その身に宿している蟲の数が
違う。
strings.translated: Not inexhaustible, perhaps, but the sheer number of Bugs he harbored within him was on a different level.

strings.text:
伝わってくる感覚だけで判断しても、まだ三分の一も
消費してないはずだった。
strings.translated: Judging by the sensations alone, he couldn't have used even a third of them yet.

strings.text: 一匹の蟲が、夢美の肩を掠める。

これ以上捌き続けるのは、夢美の体力では不可能だっ
た。
strings.translated: Continuing to hold them off any further was beyond Yumemi's physical limits.

strings.text:
煉獄
「クヒヒッ、どうしたァ！　もう後がないぞっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Khihihi, what's wrong?! You've got nowhere left to run!!"

strings.text:
じりじりと後退を余儀なくされていた夢美が、ついに
教会の端まで追い詰められる。
strings.translated: Forced to retreat step by step, Yumemi was finally cornered at the far end of the church.

strings.text: 息が上がり、目の前が霞む。
strings.translated: Her breathing grew ragged, and her vision blurred.

strings.text: 感覚だけで腕を振るうのも、もう限界だった。
strings.translated: Even swinging her arms on instinct alone was reaching its limit.

strings.text:
夢美を掠めるようにして背後の壁に当たった蟲が、
大きな爆発を起こす。
strings.translated: A Bug that had just barely grazed Yumemi struck the wall behind her and exploded with tremendous force.

strings.text:
その衝撃で夢美は前へと吹っ飛ばされ、うつ伏せに床
に倒れ込んだ。
strings.translated: The shockwave sent Yumemi flying forward, and she collapsed face-down onto the floor.

strings.text:
急いで立ち上がろうとするが、痛みに呻く体が言うこ
とを聞いてくれない。
strings.translated: She tried to scramble to her feet, but her pain-wracked body refused to obey.

strings.text: それでも前へ這おうとして――――
strings.translated: Still, she tried to crawl forward -- and then --

strings.text: 夢美は、真正面から突っ込んで来る蟲の姿を見た。
strings.translated: Yumemi saw a Bug hurtling straight toward her.

strings.text:
煉獄
「死ねえぇぇぇぇぇぇぇっ！！！！」
自らの死を覚悟した瞬間、夢美は思わず目をつぶった。
strings.translated: The moment she braced herself for death, Yumemi squeezed her eyes shut without thinking.

strings.text:
肉が潰れるような音が耳に届き、それで自分は死んだ
と感じた。
strings.translated: The sound of flesh being crushed reached her ears, and she felt certain she had died.

strings.text:
やはり、獣魔蟲の力を使っても、あんな怪物に勝つす
べなどなかったのか。
strings.translated: So even with the power of the Jumachuu, there had been no way to defeat a monster like that.

strings.text: 初めから、結果の見えた戦いを挑んでしまったのか。
strings.translated: Had she picked a fight whose outcome had been decided from the start?

strings.text:
もしかすると、優斗と一緒にどこか遠くへ逃げたほう
が良かったのか。
strings.translated: Perhaps it would have been better to flee somewhere far away with Yuuto.

strings.text:
そんな思考を繰り返した果てに、夢美は右肩が焼ける
ように痛むことに気付いた。
strings.translated: After turning such thoughts over and over in her mind, Yumemi noticed that her right shoulder was burning with pain.

strings.text: 先ほどから妙に考え事をしている時間がある。
strings.translated: There had been a strange stretch of time just now where her mind had been wandering.

strings.text:
それは、実はほんの数秒程度の思考だったのだが、
夢美には途方もなく長い時間に感じられていた。
strings.translated: In reality it had only been a matter of seconds -- but to Yumemi, it had felt like an eternity.

strings.text: やがて――ゆっくりとまぶたを開く――――。
strings.translated: And then -- slowly -- her eyelids opened.

strings.text:
再び視界が開かれると、正面に目をつり上げた煉獄の
姿があった。
strings.translated: As her vision cleared again, she found Rengoku standing before her, eyes blazing with fury.

strings.text: 何をそんなに怒っているのか分からない。
strings.translated: She had no idea what he was so angry about.

strings.text:
だが、それ以前に、自分がどうなったのかもよく分か
らない。
strings.translated: But before that, she didn't even understand what had happened to herself.

strings.text:
夢美は、ふと痛む右肩に目をやり、そこで奇妙なもの
を見つけた。
strings.translated: Yumemi glanced at her aching right shoulder -- and found something strange there.
Claws extending from her right arm.

strings.text: だが、その爪の数が、五本から十本近くに増えていた。
strings.translated: But the number of those claws had grown from five to nearly ten.

strings.text:
長さも今までの倍近くあり、先端には串刺しになり、
凍り付いた蟲がいる。
strings.translated: They were nearly twice as long as before, and skewered on their tips were Bugs, frozen solid.

strings.text:
それに気付いた瞬間、蟲が今までになく冷たくなって
いることに気付いた。
strings.translated: The moment she noticed that, she realized the Bugs had grown colder than ever before.

strings.text:
それと同時に、自分が大きな間違いを犯していた事に
も気付く。
strings.translated: And at the same time, she realized she had made a grave mistake.

strings.text:
かつて、蟲使いになると決め、レンに連れられた倉庫
でトレーニングを積んでいたとき、蟲が夢美を護って
くれたことがあった。
strings.translated: Long ago, when she had resolved to become a Bug User and was training in the warehouse Ren had taken her to, there had been a time when the Bug protected her.

strings.text: 蟲の意思で、夢美を護ってくれたことがあった。
strings.translated: Of its own will, the Bug had protected her.

strings.text: レンとの戦いの時にしてもそうだ。
strings.translated: The same had been true in that battle with Ren.

strings.text: 本当の危機に陥ったとき、いつも蟲が助けてくれた。
strings.translated: Whenever she fell into true danger, the Bug had always come to her aid.

strings.text:
自分が蟲の力を借りているだけだと言うことは、理解
しているつもりだった。
strings.translated: She had thought she understood -- that she was merely borrowing the Bug's power.

strings.text:
だが、長い年月が過ぎ去るうちに、夢美はそんなこと
も忘れてしまっていた。
strings.translated: But as the long years passed, Yumemi had forgotten even that.

strings.text:
右腕を硬質化させ、爪を振るうことを、獣魔蟲の力を
使うことだと勘違いしていた。
strings.translated: She had mistaken hardening her right arm and wielding her claws for using the power of the Jumachuu.
She had not yet used it.

strings.text: 夢美はまだ、獣魔蟲の力など使っていない。
strings.translated: Yumemi had not yet used the power of the Jumachuu at all.

strings.text: 獣魔蟲は、その力を使うことが出来ないでいる。
strings.translated: The Jumachuu had been unable to use its power.

strings.text: 力を使うことが、夢美にどれだけ負担を与えるか。
strings.translated: How heavily using that power would weigh on Yumemi's body --

strings.text: それを、獣魔蟲が理解していないはずがない。
strings.translated: There was no way the Jumachuu did not understand that.

strings.text:
だからこそ、今までは危機に陥ったときになって助け
てくれた。
strings.translated: Precisely because it did, it had only come to her aid when she fell into true danger.

strings.text:
夢美の体に負荷を負わせてでも、その命を守ることを
優先した。
strings.translated: It had prioritized protecting her life, even at the cost of burdening her body.

strings.text: そのことに、ようやく気付くことができた。
strings.translated: Only now had she finally been able to realize that.

strings.text: 立ち上がり、煉獄を見る。
strings.translated: She rose to her feet and looked at Rengoku.

strings.text:
蟲を飛ばして来ないのは、獣魔蟲の力の底が見えず、
攻めあぐねているからだ。
strings.translated: The reason he wasn't launching any Bugs was that he couldn't gauge the limits of the Jumachuu's power and was hesitating to press his attack.

strings.text: 果たして、獣魔蟲がどれほどの力を持っているのか。
strings.translated: Just how much power did the Jumachuu truly possess?

strings.text: それを観察するような視線を、じっと向けて来る。
strings.translated: He fixed her with a watchful, probing stare.

strings.text:
煉獄
「それが奥の手か？
　まさか、爪の数を増やせるとはな」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"So that's your trump card?
I didn't expect you could increase the number of claws."

strings.text:
煉獄
「さっきのでトドメにするつもりだったが、これで
　まだ互角に逆戻り、か」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"I was planning to finish you off with that last one, but now
we're back to even, are we."

strings.text:
夢美
「いいえ、そうじゃないわ」
そんな戦いになるはずがない。
strings.translated: Such a battle could never have been.

strings.text: 伝説の獣魔蟲と、ただ蟲を寄せ集めただけの合蟲人間。
strings.translated: The legendary Jumachuu, against a mere amalgam of gathered Bugs fused into human form.

strings.text:
その力が互角などと言う、馬鹿馬鹿しい結果になるは
ずはない。
strings.translated: There was no way their power could be evenly matched -- what a laughable notion.

strings.text:
レン
『獣魔蟲と言えど、人間の一部を補ったままでは力を
　出し切れないようですね』
strings.translated:
Ren
"Even the Jumachuu cannot draw out its full power while compensating for a part of a human body, it seems."

strings.text: かつて、レンもそう言っていた。
strings.translated: Ren had said as much, once before.

strings.text: ――人間の一部を補ったままでは力を出し切れない。
strings.translated: -- While compensating for a part of a human body, it cannot draw out its full power.

strings.text: その言葉が、嘘であるはずがない。
strings.translated: Those words could not have been a lie.

strings.text:
寡黙で、冷淡で、笑顔など一度として見せなかった
レンだが、彼は嘘は絶対につかなかった。
strings.translated: Ren had been silent, cold, and never once shown a smile -- but he had never, ever told a lie.
If that was the case -- then --

strings.text: 夢美の右腕が蒼く、そして冷たく輝き始める。
strings.translated: Yumemi's right arm begins to glow blue -- and cold.

strings.text:
十本に増えていた爪がたわみ、そして触手のように
変化していく。
strings.translated: The ten claws that had grown bend and flex, then begin to transform, like tentacles.

strings.text:
その刹那、腕の内側から力が溢れ出し、夢美を中心に
風が吹き抜けた。
strings.translated: In that instant, power surges from within the arm, and a wind sweeps outward with Yumemi at its center.

strings.text:
今までとは比べ物にならないほどの圧力が、煉獄の肌
を突き抜ける。
strings.translated: A pressure incomparably greater than anything before pierces through Rengoku's skin.

strings.text:
内包した蟲達が一斉に騒ぎ始め、中には命令もなく
分離しようとするものさえ現れた。
strings.translated: The Bugs contained within him all begin to stir at once, and some even start to separate without any command.

strings.text:
煉獄
「貴様らっ、落ち着けっ！！」

強引に蟲達を抑え付け、正面に対峙する夢美と睨み合
う。
strings.translated: He forcibly suppresses the Bugs and locks eyes with Yumemi, who stands directly before him.

strings.text: 何が起こっているのかなど、分かるはずがない。
strings.translated: There was no way to understand what was happening.

strings.text: だが、このまま放っておくわけにもいかない。
strings.translated: But he could not simply leave it alone.

strings.text:
煉獄は全身から蟲を分離させると、先ほどよりさらに
多い数を夢美へと飛ばした。
strings.translated: Rengoku separated the Bugs from his entire body and launched an even greater number than before at Yumemi.

strings.text: それを――蟲の爪が切り裂く――――ッ！
strings.translated: And those -- the Bug's claws tear through them -- !!

strings.text:
夢美が腕を振るっただけで、あとは爪が追いかけるよ
うにして全ての蟲を切り裂いた。
strings.translated: With nothing more than a swing of her arm, the claws pursued and shredded every last Bug on their own.

strings.text: たった一振りに対して数十にも及ぶ数の刃。
strings.translated: Dozens of blades against a single swing.

strings.text: それで、煉獄の蟲は床の上で氷のカケラと変わった。
strings.translated: And with that, Rengoku's Bugs were reduced to shards of ice scattered across the floor.

strings.text:
煉獄
「お、おのれ……まだこんな力を残していたのか」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Y-you wretch... you still had this much power left?"

strings.text: 煉獄が、怒りにその拳を固める。
strings.translated: Rengoku clenches his fist in fury.

strings.text: 残された手は、本体である夢美を直接叩くしかない。
strings.translated: The only option left was to strike Yumemi -- the host herself -- directly.

strings.text:
だが、そんな煉獄を見つめながら、夢美は心の中で
否定していた。
strings.translated: But as she watched Rengoku, Yumemi was denying it in her heart.

strings.text: 力など、残していたわけではない。
strings.translated: She had not been holding power in reserve.

strings.text:
『残す』どころか、『使う』にすら至っていなかった
のだ。
strings.translated: Far from "holding it in reserve" -- she had not even begun to "use" it yet.

strings.text:
変化する右腕を感じながら、夢美はその最後の姿を
見つめていた。
strings.translated: Feeling her right arm transform, Yumemi stared at its final form.

strings.text: 本来、獣魔蟲は、こんな姿をしているわけではない。
strings.translated: In its true nature, the Jumachuu was never meant to look like this.

strings.text:
夢美の右腕を補うために、十年もの間、その力を凝縮
し続けてきたのだ。
strings.translated: It had spent ten long years condensing its power in order to compensate for Yumemi's right arm.

strings.text:
それが全て解放されたとしたら、『右腕』などという
形に留まっているはずがない。
strings.translated: If all of that were released at once, there was no way it would remain confined to the shape of an "arm."

strings.text:
そのためには、この十年に及ぶくびきを、夢美自身が
外してやらなければならなかった。
strings.translated: To make that happen, Yumemi herself would have to remove the yoke that had bound it for those ten years.

strings.text: 右肩と蟲の結合部が、さらに痛みを増す。
strings.translated: The pain at the junction between her right shoulder and the Bug intensifies further.

strings.text:
まるで皮膚が直接焼けるような、そんな激痛が走り抜
ける。
strings.translated: A searing agony tears through her, as though her very skin is being burned alive.

strings.text:
感覚が麻痺するような刺激が、少しずつ夢美の肉体を
蝕んでいく。
strings.translated: A sensation that numbs all feeling slowly eats away at Yumemi's body, bit by bit.

strings.text:
そこで、一瞬だけ蟲が躊躇うような気配が伝わってき
たが――――
strings.translated: In that moment, a faint hesitation seemed to pass through the Bug -- but --
