strings.text: 強い口調で、蟲に命令を下す。
strings.translated: She issues the command to the Bug in a firm, unwavering tone.
Not yet -- it's still not enough!!

strings.text:
十年もの間、固定され続けた姿を解放するためには、
更なる時間が必要だった。
strings.translated: To release a form that had been fixed in place for ten long years, more time was needed.

strings.text:
対して煉獄も、夢美が何をしようとしているのかに
気付き始める。
strings.translated: Facing her, Rengoku too begins to realize what Yumemi is trying to do.

strings.text: 無駄に強烈な力を溢れさせているわけではない。
strings.translated: She is not simply overflowing with reckless, overwhelming power.

strings.text:
むしろ、力の解放は今からなのだと、遅すぎる理解に
至っていた。
strings.translated: Rather, he had arrived -- too late -- at the understanding that the true release of her power was only just beginning.

strings.text:
煉獄
「『右腕』から解放させる気かっ！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"You're trying to free it from the 'Right Arm'!"

strings.text: 意を決したように拳を固め、夢美へと飛びかかる。
strings.translated: As though steeling himself, he clenches his fist and lunges at Yumemi.

strings.text:
煉獄
「ぬっ、が、ああっ、あああああああっ！！！」

夢美の右腕が大きく膨らんだかと思った瞬間、煉獄の
体が無数の刃によって切り裂かれた。
strings.translated: The moment Yumemi's right arm swelled enormously, Rengoku's body was torn apart by countless blades.

strings.text:
思わず後ろに飛びのいたが、その間にも傷口が凍り始
める。
strings.translated: He leaped backward on reflex, but even in that brief interval, the wounds began to freeze over.

strings.text:
今まで、自分の体には起こらなかった現象に、煉獄は
動揺を抑え切れなかった。
strings.translated: Faced with a phenomenon that had never once occurred to his own body before, Rengoku could not suppress his shock.

strings.text: 傷口に付着した氷を払い落とす。
strings.translated: He brushes the ice clinging to his wounds away with his hand.

strings.text:
肉体の全てを凍らせるほどではないが、明らかに先ほ
どよりも獣魔蟲の力が上がっていた。
strings.translated: It was not enough to freeze his entire body solid, but the power of the Jumachuu had clearly risen beyond what it had been moments ago.

strings.text: 歯軋りをしながら、正面の夢美を見る。
strings.translated: Grinding his teeth, he looks at Yumemi before him.

strings.text: 夢美の右肩から生えているもの。
strings.translated: What was growing from Yumemi's right shoulder.

strings.text: それは、もはや『腕』でも『爪』でもなかった。
strings.translated: It was no longer an "arm" -- nor was it "claws."

strings.text: 『爪』だったものから、何か別のものに変化していた。
strings.translated: What had once been "claws" had transformed into something else entirely.

strings.text:
人間で言えば手の甲にあたる部分から、細長い触手の
ようなものが伸び、それが夢美を護るように取り巻い
ている。
strings.translated: From the part that would correspond to the back of a human hand, slender, tentacle-like appendages extended outward, wrapping around Yumemi as though to protect her.

strings.text:
煉獄
「それが、獣魔蟲の本性というわけか……」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"So that is the true nature of the Jumachuu..."

strings.text:
夢美
「そんなはずないでしょう」

夢美
「全てを喰らうとまで伝えられている獣魔蟲の真の姿
　が、こんなものだと本気で思うの？」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Do you honestly believe that this is the true form of the Jumachuu -- the one said to devour all things?"

strings.text: 夢美の言葉に、煉獄が息を呑む。
strings.translated: At Yumemi's words, Rengoku draws a sharp breath.

strings.text:
自分が何か大きな勘違いをしていた事に、ようやく
気付き始めていた。
strings.translated:
He was only now beginning to realize
that he had been gravely mistaken about something.

strings.text:
だが、その答えに至るより先に、恐怖が体を突き動か
す。
strings.translated: But before he can arrive at an answer, fear drives his body into motion.

strings.text:
全身に掛かってくる圧力に耐え切れず、煉獄は獣のよ
うに吼えた。
strings.translated: Unable to withstand the pressure bearing down on him from all sides, Rengoku howled like a beast.

strings.text:
煉獄
「死ねええぇぇぇぇぇぇーーーーーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーっ！！！！」

肉体に宿らせた蟲を、操れるだけ操り夢美へと撃ち出
す。
strings.translated: He drives every Bug harbored within his body, commanding as many as he can, and hurls them at Yumemi.

strings.text:
容易に近づけない以上、煉獄に残された手段はそれし
かなかった。
strings.translated: With no easy way to close the distance, it was the only option left to Rengoku.

strings.text: それを、夢美は一歩も動くことなく突き落とす。
strings.translated: And Yumemi strikes them all down without taking a single step.

strings.text:
襲って来た蟲の数以上の爪や触手が、煉獄の放った蟲
をことごとく打ち砕いた。
strings.translated: Claws and tentacles, outnumbering the Bugs that came swarming in, shattered every last one of Rengoku's Bugs.

strings.text:
煉獄
「ぐおおおおぉぉぉぉぉぉぉっ！！！！？」

蟲を突き落とした細長い触手が、そのまま煉獄を襲っ
た。
strings.translated: The slender tentacles that had struck down the Bugs turned and attacked Rengoku directly.

strings.text: 肩や腕、脇腹や脚に鋭い痛みが走る。
strings.translated: Sharp pain lances through his shoulders, arms, sides, and legs.

strings.text:
煉獄はすぐに触手を引きちぎり後退したが、傷口から
はパキパキと音を立てて氷が広がり始めていた。
strings.translated: Rengoku immediately tore the tentacles free and fell back, but from the wounds, ice was already spreading with a crackling sound.

strings.text:
煉獄
「き、傷が……回復が遅い…………ッ！？」

煉獄の肉体には、治癒能力のある蟲が何十匹と内包さ
れていた。
strings.translated: Within Rengoku's body, dozens of Bugs with healing abilities were housed.

strings.text:
たとえどんなに小さな傷であっても、蟲が自然とそれ
を治癒するようになっていた。
strings.translated: No matter how small the wound, the Bugs would naturally mend it on their own.

strings.text:
だが今は、傷口に張り付いた氷が邪魔をして、肉体の
治癒を鈍らせている。
strings.translated: But now, the ice clinging to the wounds was interfering, slowing the body's recovery.

strings.text:
手で払えば氷は落ちるが、まともに肉を抉られるよう
な攻撃を受ければどうなるか……。
strings.translated: He could brush the ice away by hand -- but what would happen if he took a hit that gouged deeply into flesh...?

strings.text:
想像もしていなかった事態に、そして何より風のよう
に吹き抜けてくる獣魔蟲の圧倒的な力に、煉獄は恐怖
した。
strings.translated: Faced with a situation he had never once imagined, and above all by the overwhelming power of the Jumachuu that swept through him like a gale, Rengoku felt fear.

strings.text:
煉獄
「し、死ねっ！　死ねっ！！　死ねぇぇっ！！！」
煉獄の肉体から、ありったけの数の蟲が解き放たれる。
strings.translated: From Rengoku's body, every last Bug he possessed is unleashed.

strings.text:
その数は今までより遥かに多く、同時に操作できる
限界を超えていた。
strings.translated: Their number far exceeded anything before, surpassing the limit of what he could control simultaneously.

strings.text:
夢美に襲い掛かる蟲がいる一方で、ただ自由を得ただ
けの蟲が教会内に散っていく。
strings.translated: While some Bugs hurled themselves at Yumemi, others -- having simply gained their freedom -- scattered throughout the church.

strings.text: 夢美に牙を剥いた蟲は、全て氷のカケラと散った。
strings.translated: Every Bug that bared its fangs at Yumemi was scattered into shards of ice.

strings.text:
だが、煉獄の影響下を逃れた蟲達は、半ば暴走とも
呼べる行動に出始める。
strings.translated: But the Bugs that had slipped free of Rengoku's influence began to act in ways that could only be called half-berserk.

strings.text:
ある蟲はステンドグラスを突き破り、ある蟲は意味も
なく天井や壁に傷を付ける。
strings.translated: Some Bugs burst through the stained glass; others gouged meaningless wounds into the ceiling and walls.

strings.text:
またある蟲は空中で旋回し、ある蟲は爆発を起こして
辺りに火を放った。
strings.translated: Still others spiraled through the air, and some triggered explosions that set the surroundings ablaze.

strings.text:
夢美
「あなたもここまでみたいね」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Looks like you've reached your limit too."

strings.text:
煉獄
「黙れっ！　貴様こそもう限界のはずだっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Silence! You're the one who should be at your limit by now!!"

strings.text: 憎悪を込めた眼で睨み付けて、煉獄が叫ぶ。
strings.translated: Glaring at her with eyes filled with hatred, Rengoku screams.

strings.text:
煉獄
「獣魔蟲の力は認めてやらぁっ！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"I'll grant you that the Jumachuu's power is real!"

strings.text:
煉獄
「だが、それを使い続けているテメーはなんだ？
　ただの人間だろーがっ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"But what the hell are you, still using that thing?!
You're just a damn human!!"

strings.text:
煉獄
「そんな力をそんな近くで受け続けて、平気なわきゃ
　ねーだろォォッ！！」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"There's no way you'd be fine after taking that kind of power at such close range...!"

strings.text: ただひたすらに、煉獄が蟲を放ち続ける。
strings.translated: Rengoku simply keeps unleashing his Bugs, relentlessly.

strings.text:
獣魔蟲の爪に切り裂かれると分かっていながら、それ
でも尚、全身から蟲を解放し続ける。
strings.translated: Even knowing the Jumachuu's claws will tear him apart, he continues to release Bugs from every inch of his body.

strings.text:
それは、やがて煉獄の姿を歪め、人の形が崩れ始めて
も続けられた。
strings.translated: Eventually, it continued even as Rengoku's form began to warp, his human shape starting to collapse.

strings.text: 暴走する蟲の数が増え、さらに火の手が上がっていく。
strings.translated: The number of rampaging Bugs grows, and the flames rise ever higher.

strings.text:
だが、そんな中にあって、夢美は心静かに獣魔蟲の力
を解き放ち続けていた。
strings.translated: And yet, amid all of this, Yumemi kept her heart calm as she continued to unleash the Jumachuu's power.

strings.text:
右肩と蟲の結合部は既に感覚を失くし、痛みさえ今は
どこか遠い。
strings.translated: The junction between her right shoulder and the Bug had long since gone numb, and even the pain felt distant now.

strings.text:
頭の奥はぼんやりと霧が掛かり、こうして立っている
のもやっとの状態だった。
strings.translated: A hazy fog had settled deep in her mind, and simply remaining upright was all she could manage.

strings.text:
気を抜けば床に膝を着き、そのまま意識を失ってしま
うだろう。
strings.translated: If she let her focus slip for even a moment, she would drop to her knees and lose consciousness entirely.

strings.text: それほどに、獣魔蟲は『重い』のだ。
strings.translated: That was how "heavy" the Jumachuu truly was.

strings.text:
夢美
「大丈夫……私は一人じゃないから…………ッ！」

右肩から先に『在』る獣魔蟲に、まるで微笑むように
語り掛ける。
strings.translated: She speaks to the Jumachuu -- the presence extending beyond her right shoulder -- as if offering it a smile.

strings.text: それは、決して嘘ではない。

夢美がたった一人であれば、とうに力に圧され潰され
ている。
strings.translated: If Yumemi had been truly alone, she would have long since been crushed beneath the weight of that power.

strings.text:
床に倒れて意識を失い、勝利は煉獄が手にしていただ
ろう。
strings.translated: She would have collapsed to the floor, lost consciousness, and victory would have gone to Rengoku.

strings.text: だが、胸に抱く想いが、夢美の体を奮い立たせる。
strings.translated: But the feelings she holds in her heart drive Yumemi's body forward.

strings.text:
大切な存在と、守らなければならない約束が、夢美を
強くその場に在らせていた。
strings.translated: The precious existence she cherishes, and the promise she must keep -- they were what kept Yumemi standing firm in that place.

strings.text:
煉獄
「ぐ、おぉっ……おおぉおおぉぉ………………ッ！」
夢美と対峙する煉獄が、苦しげに呻き声を漏らす。
strings.translated: Rengoku, facing Yumemi, lets out a pained groan.

strings.text:
既に放った蟲の数は半分を越え、肉体のあちこちから
触手が飛び出している。
strings.translated: The number of Bugs he had already unleashed exceeded half, and tentacles were bursting out from all over his body.

strings.text:
肉体に埋め込まれた蟲が、煉獄の制御下から逃れよう
としており、人の姿さえ維持できなくなりつつあった。
strings.translated: The Bugs embedded in his flesh were struggling to break free of his control, and he was losing even the ability to maintain a human form.

strings.text:
煉獄
「こんな……こんなはずは……………………ッ！」

夢美
「煉獄……いいえ、蟲使い・煉悟…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Rengoku... no -- Rengo, the Bug User..."

strings.text:
夢美
「あなたとの因縁は、ここで断ち切る――――ッ！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"The bond between us ends here!"

strings.text: 夢美が、右肩から先の存在を構える。
strings.translated: Yumemi raises the presence extending from her right shoulder into a ready stance.

strings.text:
本来の姿を取り戻そうとしている獣魔蟲を、蒼く冷た
い刃へと変える。
strings.translated: She transforms the Jumachuu -- which is trying to reclaim its true form -- into a cold, blue blade.

strings.text:
頭の奥で金属が砕ける音が鳴り、十年に及ぶくびきが
失われる。
strings.translated: Deep in her mind, the sound of shattering metal rings out, and a yoke that has lasted ten years is broken.

strings.text:
夢美
「く、ううぅううぅぅぅぅーーーーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーーっ！！！！」
右肩から肉体に掛けて、強烈な圧力が伝わってくる。
strings.translated: A fierce pressure travels from her right shoulder through her entire body.

strings.text: 吹き荒ぶ風が冷気の渦を巻き、獣魔蟲を取り巻いた。
strings.translated: A raging wind whips up a vortex of freezing air, enveloping the Jumachuu.

strings.text:
煉獄
「死ねぇ……死ねぇぇ……死ねぇぇぇ…………ッ！」

煉獄
「死ねええぇぇぇぇぇぇーーーーーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーーーっ！！！！！」

煉獄の体が弾けるようにして、無数の蟲や触手が夢美
に襲い掛かる。
strings.translated: Rengoku's body seems to burst apart as countless Bugs and tentacles lunge at Yumemi.

strings.text: その数は、果たして五十か百か、それ以上か……。
strings.translated: Fifty? A hundred? More than that...?

strings.text: 対して夢美は、構えていた獣魔蟲を――――――
strings.translated: Against them, Yumemi swings the Jumachuu she had readied -- and --

strings.text: 夢美の右肩から解き放たされた、百を超える蟲の槍。
strings.translated: More than a hundred spears of Bugs, unleashed from Yumemi's right shoulder.

strings.text:
それが、煉獄を含め、夢美に襲い掛かっていた全ての
蟲を貫いていた。
strings.translated:
They pierced through every last Bug that had been swarming Yumemi --
including Rengoku himself.

strings.text: 砕け散った氷が床に落下し、粉雪が辺りに舞い散る。
strings.translated: The shattered ice crashes to the floor, and powdery snow drifts through the air.

strings.text:
煉獄は全身を槍で串刺しにされ、その傷口から氷で
包み込まれようとしていた。
strings.translated: Rengoku's entire body was skewered by the spears, and the wounds were being encased in ice.

strings.text:
口から吐き出したどす黒い血の塊が、氷の上を滑り落
ちていく。
strings.translated: A dark, clotted mass of blood he spat from his mouth slides down across the ice.

strings.text:
夢美
「もう二度と、私の前に現れないで…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Don't ever appear before me again............"

strings.text: 煉獄が、唇の端をつり上げる。
strings.translated: Rengoku curls the corner of his lips upward.

strings.text:
血に濡れた歯を見せると、引き攣った笑い声を漏らし
ながら言った。
strings.translated: Baring his blood-soaked teeth, he let out a strained laugh and spoke.

strings.text:
煉獄
「安心、しろよ……。
　これで……終わりだ…………」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Don't worry......
 This is...... the end.........."

strings.text:
煉獄
「オレも……テメーも、な…………」

肌を焼くような熱の中で、夢美は小さな呻き声を漏ら
した。
strings.translated: Amid a heat that seemed to scorch her skin, Yumemi let out a small groan.

strings.text:
うっすらとまぶたを開けて、暫くぼんやりと虚空を
見つめる。
strings.translated: She slowly opened her eyelids and stared blankly into the void for a moment.

strings.text:
自分が床に倒れているのは分かったが、何故そうなっ
ているのかは、すぐには思い出せなかった。
strings.translated: She could tell she had collapsed on the floor, but she couldn't immediately remember why.

strings.text: 体中に走る痛みが、少しずつ思考を働かせ始める。
strings.translated: The pain running through her body gradually set her mind to working again.

strings.text:
獣魔蟲を無数の槍のように変化させ、それで煉獄の体
を貫いたところまでは覚えている。
strings.translated: She remembered transforming the Jumachuu into countless spear-like shapes and driving them through Rengoku's body.

strings.text: だが、その直後から、記憶はすっぽり抜け落ちていた。
strings.translated: But from that moment on, her memory was completely blank.

strings.text:
顔を上げて、辺りを見回し、何がどうなったのかを
把握しようとする。
strings.translated: She lifted her head, looked around, and tried to grasp what had happened.

strings.text:
体を起こそうと右手を床に着こうとして、夢美は思い
きり真横に倒れ込んだ。
strings.translated: As she tried to push herself up with her right hand, Yumemi toppled hard onto her side.

strings.text: 肩を打ちつけ、頭をぶつける。
strings.translated: She slammed her shoulder and knocked her head.

strings.text:
仰向けになって頭を押さえようとしたが、何故だか
手が動かない。
strings.translated: She tried to roll onto her back and cover her head, but for some reason her hand wouldn't move.

strings.text:
夢美は虚ろな目で右腕を見て、そこで初めて自分の
状態を理解した。
strings.translated: Yumemi looked at her right arm with hollow eyes, and only then did she understand her own condition.

strings.text:
夢美の右肩から先には、既に右腕も、獣魔蟲の存在も
なかった。
strings.translated: Beyond Yumemi's right shoulder, there was no longer any right arm -- nor any trace of the Jumachuu.

strings.text: そして、ようやく漠然とだが記憶が甦ってくる。
strings.translated: And at last, her memories began to return, however vaguely.

strings.text:
獣魔蟲の槍に貫かれた煉獄が、突如風船のように膨ら
んだかと思うと、轟音と共に爆発したのだ。
strings.translated: Rengoku, pierced through by the Jumachuu's spears, had suddenly swelled up like a balloon -- and then exploded with a thunderous roar.

strings.text:
内包していた蟲の暴走か、それとも煉獄の意思でそれ
を招いたのか……。
strings.translated: Whether it was a rampage of the Bugs he had harbored within him, or whether Rengoku had willed it himself......

strings.text:
どちらにしても、その爆発で夢美は吹き飛ばされ、
獣魔蟲と完全に分離してしまったらしい。
strings.translated: Either way, the explosion had apparently sent Yumemi flying and completely separated her from the Jumachuu.

strings.text:
周囲を見回して獣魔蟲を探しては見たが、どこにも姿
は見当たらない。
strings.translated: She looked around searching for the Jumachuu, but it was nowhere to be found.

strings.text:
あの爆発で微塵に砕け散ったか、それとも既に脱出し
たのか。
strings.translated: Whether it was shattered to pieces by that explosion, or whether it had already escaped --

strings.text:
できれば後者であることを願いながら、夢美は体を
うつ伏せにした。
strings.translated: Hoping it was the latter, Yumemi turned herself face-down.

strings.text:
夢美
「ごほっ……ごほごほっ………………」
煙を吸い込み、その場でむせ返る。
strings.translated: She had inhaled smoke and choked right where she lay.

strings.text:
教会の入り口のほうを見たが、そこは既に火の手が
上がっていて、とても通り抜けられるような状態で
はない。
strings.translated: She looked toward the entrance of the church, but flames had already risen there, and it was in no state to pass through.

strings.text: 要するに、逃げ道が塞がれてしまったという事だ。
strings.translated: In short, her escape route had been cut off.

strings.text:
夢美は、他に出口がないかを探したが、うつ伏せの
体勢でも辺りが火の海なのは分かった。
strings.translated: Yumemi searched for another way out, but even face-down she could tell that the surroundings were a sea of fire.

strings.text:
正直、逃げ道を探すどころか、あともう何分生きてい
られるのかさえ怪しい。
strings.translated: Honestly, rather than searching for an escape route, it was questionable how many more minutes she could even stay alive.

strings.text:
少しだけ床を這うように移動してみたが、行き先など
ないままでは、すぐに止まってしまった。
strings.translated: She tried crawling along the floor a little, but with nowhere to go, she stopped almost immediately.

strings.text:
夢美
「ごめんなさい……。
　約束……守れそうにないわ…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"I'm sorry......
 It doesn't look like I'll be able to keep my promise......"

strings.text: 胸が苦しくなって、体勢を仰向けに変える。
strings.translated: Her chest tightened, and she shifted onto her back.

strings.text:
――と、天井の梁が今にも落ちてきそうなのが見えて、
思わず息を呑んだ。
strings.translated: -- And then she saw that the ceiling beams looked ready to come crashing down at any moment, and she caught her breath.

strings.text:
夢美はもう一度逃げようとしてみたが、落下しそうな
梁が広範囲にわたっているため、どこへ逃げても同じ
ことだと悟る。
strings.translated: Yumemi tried once more to flee, but the falling beams had spread across such a wide area that she realized it made no difference where she ran.

strings.text:
それに、そろそろ教会内の温度が人間の耐えられる
域を超えようとしていた。
strings.translated: On top of that, the temperature inside the church was approaching the limits of what a human could endure.

strings.text:
梁の落下で死ぬのが早いか、熱に焼かれて死ぬのが早
いか……。
strings.translated: Whether the falling beams would kill her first, or the heat would burn her to death first......

strings.text: 夢美は、もう一度床を這おうと試みたが――――
strings.translated: Yumemi tried once more to crawl along the floor -- but ----

strings.text: 天井の梁が崩れ落ちるのを見て、硬くまぶたを閉じた。
strings.translated: She saw the ceiling beams collapsing and squeezed her eyes shut.

strings.text:
肌に冷たい風が触れたのを感じて、夢美は小さく呻い
た。
strings.translated: Feeling a cold wind touch her skin, Yumemi let out a small groan.

strings.text:
梁が崩れ落ちる音を聞いてから、かなり時間が経った
ような気がする。
strings.translated: It felt as though quite a lot of time had passed since she heard the sound of the beams crashing down.

strings.text: 少なくとも、梁が落下するのには十分だろう。
strings.translated: At the very least, it would have been enough time for the beams to fall.

strings.text: また、冷たい風が肌を撫でた。
strings.translated: Again, a cold wind brushed against her skin.

strings.text:
それが死後の世界なのかと考えながら、夢美はおそる
おそる目を開ける。
strings.translated: Wondering if this might be the afterlife, Yumemi cautiously opened her eyes.

strings.text:
自分の周囲に広がっている光景を見て、夢美は大きく
息を呑んだ。
strings.translated: Seeing the scene that spread out around her, Yumemi drew in a sharp breath.

strings.text:
美しいメタリックブルーのカーテンのような膜が、
夢美の体を包み込んでいる。
strings.translated: A beautiful curtain-like membrane of metallic blue was enveloping Yumemi's body.

strings.text:
背景が透けて見えるため、膜が外側から燃えているの
が見えた。
strings.translated: The membrane was translucent enough that she could see it burning from the outside.

strings.text:
夢美の言葉に応えるかのように、膜の透過率がどんど
ん下がっていく。
strings.translated: As if in response to Yumemi's words, the membrane's transparency rapidly decreased.

strings.text:
周囲の景色が見えなくなっていって、膜の外側が硬く
固まっていくのが分かった。
strings.translated: The surrounding scenery disappeared from view, and she could tell that the outer surface of the membrane was hardening.

strings.text:
膜の中は涼しい風が流れていて、さらに空気も澄んで
いる。
strings.translated: A cool breeze flowed inside the membrane, and the air within was clear and fresh.

strings.text:
こんな事ができるものなど、ひとつしか思い浮かばな
かった。
strings.translated: There was only one thing she could think of that was capable of something like this.

strings.text:
夢美
「ダメよっ！
　いくらあなただって死んじゃうわっ！！」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Stop it!
 No matter how strong you are, you'll die!!"

strings.text:
夢美の言葉通り、膜の一部が弾けそこから真っ赤な炎
が入り込んでくる。
strings.translated: Just as Yumemi said, part of the membrane burst open, and bright red flames began pouring in.

strings.text:
だが、それも一瞬のことで、すぐに新しい膜が繋ぎ合
わされ炎の侵入を遮断する。
strings.translated: But it lasted only a moment -- new membrane immediately sealed the breach, cutting off the flames' intrusion.

strings.text:
しかし、その一瞬の侵入だけでも、膜の中の空気は
肌が燃えるような熱を帯びてしまっていた。
strings.translated: Yet even that brief intrusion was enough to fill the air inside the membrane with a scorching heat that seared the skin.

strings.text:
夢美
「逃げて……私のことはいいから逃げて…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"Run away... don't worry about me, just run away..."

strings.text:
膜の中の温度が下がっていくのを感じながら、夢美は
頬から涙を零した。
strings.translated: Feeling the temperature inside the membrane drop, Yumemi let tears fall from her cheeks.

strings.text:
膜に手で触れてみると、ひんやりとした冷気が伝わっ
てくる。
strings.translated: When she pressed her hand against the membrane, a cool chill was transmitted through it.

strings.text:
この空間を作り出すために、果たして蟲が何を犠牲に
しているのか。
strings.translated: What the Bug was sacrificing to create this space -- she already knew.

strings.text: そんなものは、もはや考えるまでもない。
strings.translated: There was no need to even think about it anymore.

strings.text:
やがて、外の景色は完全に見えなくなり、蟲は己の身
を一つの繭と化した。
strings.translated: Eventually, the outside scenery became completely invisible, and the Bug had transformed its own body into a single cocoon.

strings.text:
夢美
「逃げなさいっ！　これは……命令よっ！！」
涙で震える声で、夢美が命令を下す。
strings.translated: In a voice trembling with tears, Yumemi issued her command.

strings.text:
いつもなら、それですぐに蟲は実行してくれるはず
だった。
strings.translated: Normally, the Bug would have acted on it immediately.

strings.text:
だが、夢美を包み込む繭は、いつまで経っても解かれ
ない……。
strings.translated: But the cocoon enveloping Yumemi showed no sign of releasing her, no matter how long she waited...

strings.text:
外界の炎から夢美を護るため、自らの硬い外甲をもっ
て、優しく夢美を包み込み続けていた。
strings.translated: To protect Yumemi from the flames of the outside world, it continued to wrap her gently within its hard outer shell.

strings.text:
夢美
「逃げ、なさい…………逃げてぇ………………」

夢美
「あなたなら……ここからだって…………逃げられる
　はずじゃない…………」
strings.translated:
Yumemi
"You could... even from here... you could escape... couldn't you..."

strings.text: 唇をわななかせながら、夢美が何度も命令を下す。
strings.translated: Her lips trembling, Yumemi issued the command again and again.

strings.text:
もう、蟲がそれを聞く気がないと分かっていても、
夢美はそうすることしかできなかった。
strings.translated: Even knowing that the Bug had no intention of listening, it was all Yumemi could do.

strings.text:
繭から一本の触手が伸びてきて、夢美の頬をそっと
撫でる。
strings.translated: A single tendril extended from the cocoon and gently stroked Yumemi's cheek.

strings.text: まるで、涙を拭うように……夢美を慰めるように……。
strings.translated: As if to wipe away her tears... as if to comfort her...

strings.text:
夢美
「あ、うっ……あぁ…………ぁぁぁ………………」
蟲の触手を握り締めて、夢美がさらに涙を溢れさせる。
strings.translated: Gripping the Bug's tendril tightly, Yumemi let her tears overflow even more.

strings.text: その冷たい温もりが愛しかった。
strings.translated: That cold warmth was so dear to her.

strings.text:
十五年間、常に夢美のそばにあり続けた我が子が、
どこまでも愛しかった。
strings.translated: This child who had always been at Yumemi's side for fifteen years -- she loved it so deeply, beyond all measure.

strings.text:
氷が割れるような音を立てて、触手が粉雪のように
砕け散る。
strings.translated: With a sound like cracking ice, the tendril shattered into powder like fine snow.

strings.text:
蟲は、全体を蒼白く輝かせ始めると、繭の中に深々と
氷の粒を降らせ始めた。
strings.translated: The Bug began to glow with a pale blue-white light, and started raining tiny particles of ice deep within the cocoon.

strings.text:
夢美の体を優しく抱き締めるように、まばゆいばかり
の光で包み込んでいった……。

夜遊びはダメだと言っているにも関わらず、なかなか

strings.translated: She was furious at Ayaka, who kept going out at night no matter how many times she was told not to.

strings.text:
偶然、夢美が杏子と電話しているときに、遥と再会し
たのを電話して来たことは感謝するが、しっかりとし
た教育はやはり必要だ。
strings.translated: She was grateful that Ayaka had called to tell her about running into Haruka by chance, right while Yumemi happened to be on the phone with Anzu -- but proper discipline was still necessary.

strings.text:
優斗
「まあ、あまり泣かせ過ぎないように――――」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Well, try not to make her cry too much --"

strings.text: 優斗がそう言いかけて、不意に足を止めた。
strings.translated: Yuuto started to say that, then suddenly stopped in his tracks.

strings.text:
夢美は不思議そうにクビを傾げたが、すぐに道の先に
誰かが立っているのを確認する。
strings.translated: Yumemi tilted her head in puzzlement, but quickly confirmed that someone was standing further down the road.

strings.text:
それは、巨大な男のシルエットで、ゆっくりと夢美達
のほうに近付いて来ていた。
strings.translated: It was the silhouette of an enormous man, slowly drawing closer toward Yumemi and the others.

strings.text:
煉獄
「クヒッ、久しぶりだなァ」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Khee hee, long time no see."

strings.text: 男の姿を見た瞬間、夢美の背中に戦慄が走った。
strings.translated: The moment she saw the man's face, a shudder ran down Yumemi's spine.

strings.text:
忘れるはずもない顔、声、そして笑い方が、十五年前
の記憶を呼び覚ます。
strings.translated: A face, a voice, and a laugh she could never forget -- they stirred memories from fifteen years ago.

strings.text:
夢美の様子が変わったことに、優斗が怪訝な表情を
浮かべる。
strings.translated: Yuuto's expression turned suspicious as he noticed the change that had come over Yumemi.

strings.text:
ただ道を歩いていて、体の大きな相手に驚いた。とい
うわけではないのは明白だ。
strings.translated: It was obvious this was not simply a matter of being startled by a large man while walking down the street.

strings.text:
優斗は夢美の前に出ると、男を睨み付けながら口を
開いた。
strings.translated: Yuuto stepped in front of Yumemi and, glaring at the man, opened his mouth.

strings.text:
優斗
「あなたは誰ですか？　夢美に何の用なんです？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Who are you? What business do you have with Yumemi?"

strings.text:
煉獄
「オイオイ、あんまりでしゃばると後悔することにな
　るぜぇ？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Hey now, if you stick your nose in too far, you're gonna regret it."

strings.text:
煉獄
「まあもっとも、その女の関係者ってだけで後悔する
　ことになるんだがな」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Though honestly, just being associated with that woman is enough to make you regret it."

strings.text:
優斗
「お前は……何者だ？
　夢美とはどんな関係なんだ？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"You... who are you?
 What's your relationship with Yumemi?"

strings.text:
煉獄
「親密な関係さァ。……十五年前からのな」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"An intimate one. ...Going back fifteen years."

strings.text:
十五年という言葉を聞いて、優斗はおおよその事を
察した。
strings.translated: Hearing the words "fifteen years," Yuuto grasped the general shape of things.

strings.text:
夢美にとって、男が忌まわしい存在である事を理解し
た。
strings.translated: He understood that this man was something abhorrent to Yumemi.

strings.text:
煉獄
「さあ、どいてもらおうか。
　オレはそっちの女に用があるんでな」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Now then, step aside.
 I've got business with the woman over there."

strings.text:
優斗
「夢美はお前なんかに用はない」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Yumemi has no business with the likes of you."

strings.text:
煉獄
「クヒッ、いいねぇ。
　そういう態度が一番理想的だぜぇ」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Khee hee, I like that.
 That kind of attitude is exactly what I'm hoping for."

strings.text: 男が引き攣ったように笑う。
strings.translated: The man lets out a twitching laugh.

strings.text:
優斗は短く嘆息すると、夢美のほうを振り返って、
狭い路地のほうを指差した。
strings.translated: Yuuto exhaled briefly, then turned back toward Yumemi and pointed toward the narrow alley.

strings.text:
優斗
「あっちの道から行くんだ」

優斗
「……俺は、あの男と話がある」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"...I have something to say to that man."

strings.text:
優斗
「大丈夫。すぐに行くよ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"It's fine. I'll be right there."

strings.text:
不安げな表情を浮かべる夢美に、優斗がそっとキスを
する。
strings.translated: Yuuto gently kisses Yumemi, whose face is clouded with unease.

strings.text:
夢美は、やや躊躇った様子を見せていたが、やがて
優斗が指差した路地のほうへ姿を消して行った。
strings.translated: Yumemi hesitated for a moment, but eventually disappeared down the alley Yuuto had pointed to.

strings.text:
優斗
「さて、と……少し話をさせてもらうぞ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Now then... let's have a little talk."

strings.text:
煉獄
「クヒッ、時間稼ぎのつもりか？」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Khee hee, trying to buy time, are you?"

strings.text:
煉獄
「まあ、オレも狩りは嫌いじゃねーからな。
　構わねぇぜ」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"Well, I don't mind a good hunt myself.
 Go right ahead."

strings.text:
煉獄
「テメーの首を、あの女に届けてやる」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"I'll deliver your head to that woman."

strings.text: 男が、ゆっくりと優斗に近付いて来る。
strings.translated: The man slowly closes in on Yuuto.

strings.text:
その圧倒的な威圧感は、とても普通の人間が持つそれ
とは違っていた。
strings.translated: The overwhelming pressure he exuded was nothing like what any ordinary human could possess.

strings.text:
優斗はごくりと息を呑むと、逃げることなく真正面か
ら男を睨み続けていた……。
strings.translated: Yuuto swallowed hard, and without fleeing, kept his gaze fixed straight on the man...

strings.text: それは、鉄のように重く、鋼のように硬い一撃だった。
strings.translated: It was a blow as heavy as iron and as hard as steel.

strings.text: 触れた瞬間に肉が潰れ、骨が粉々に砕け散った。
strings.translated: The moment it connected, flesh was crushed and bone shattered to pieces.

strings.text:
突き抜ける衝撃は脳を揺さ振り、意識を遠くへと吹き
飛ばす。
strings.translated: The piercing impact rattled his brain and sent his consciousness flying far away.

strings.text: 電柱の脇に積み上げられていた粗大ゴミ。
strings.translated: Bulky trash had been piled up beside a utility pole.

strings.text:
それをバラバラに破壊しながら、巨体の背中が壁に
叩き付けられた。
strings.translated: Smashing through it all, the massive body was slammed into the wall.
The one who groaned was Rengoku.

strings.text:
自分の体で押し潰したゴミの上で、大の字になって
寝ている。
strings.translated: He lay spread-eagle atop the pile of garbage his own body had crushed.

strings.text:
薬剤で強化され、無数の蟲を移植された肉体を持つ
煉獄が、ゴミだらけの地面に倒れ込んでいた。
strings.translated: Rengoku -- whose body had been chemically enhanced and implanted with countless Bugs -- had collapsed onto the trash-strewn ground.

strings.text:
優斗
「ほう、思ったより丈夫だな」

煉獄
「こんな……オ、オレが、こんな奴に…………」
strings.translated:
Rengoku
"This... m, me, brought down by someone like this..."

strings.text:
優斗
「傷が回復している……」

優斗
「ああ、そうか。
　初めから体の中に、そういう蟲がいるってことか」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Ah, I see.
 So he's had Bugs like that inside him from the start."

strings.text:
右拳を固めた優斗が、純粋に驚いたような表情を浮か
べる。
strings.translated: Yuuto, his right fist clenched, wore an expression of genuine surprise.

strings.text:
煉獄に対する恐れの色は、カケラほども窺うことは
できなかった。
strings.translated: Not a single trace of fear toward Rengoku could be seen in him.

strings.text:
優斗
「まずは蟲からどうにかしないといけないって事か。
　……少し厄介だな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"So I need to deal with the Bugs first.
 ...This is a bit of a hassle."

strings.text:
優斗
「まあ、長くぶん殴れるって考えればいいか」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Well, I guess I can think of it as getting to beat him for longer."

strings.text:
優斗
「何しろ夢美を犯した奴なんだしな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"After all, this is the guy who violated Yumemi."

strings.text:
攻撃されたと言うことを理解するのに、果たしてどれ
だけの時間が必要なのか。
strings.translated: How much time would it take to even comprehend that he had been attacked?

strings.text:
気付いた時には地面に膝を着いていた煉獄は、それが
現実のものだとすぐには信じられなかった。
strings.translated: By the time he realized it, Rengoku was down on one knee -- and he could not immediately believe it was real.

strings.text:
優斗
「臓器を取られたらどうなる？
　夢美のように新しく蟲が作ってくれるのか？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"What happens when an organ is taken from you?
 Will the Bugs make a new one, like they do for Yumemi?"

strings.text:
優斗の視線の先――煉獄の腹から伸びた胃袋が握り潰
される。
strings.translated: At the end of Yuuto's gaze -- the stomach protruding from Rengoku's abdomen was crushed in his grip.

strings.text:
その光景を、当の煉獄は信じられないものを見るよう
な眼で見つめていた。
strings.translated: Rengoku stared at the sight with eyes that could not believe what they were seeing.

strings.text:
優斗
「どうした？
　再生はできても復元はできないのか？」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"What's wrong?
 You can regenerate, but you can't restore?"

strings.text:
優斗
「なんだ。本当にできないのか」
腹に空いた傷口を狙って、優斗が煉獄を蹴り上げる。
strings.translated: Yuuto kicks Rengoku, aiming for the open wound in his gut.

strings.text: 辺りにどす黒い血が飛び散り、巨体が仰向けに倒れた。
strings.translated: Dark blood sprayed in all directions, and the massive body toppled over onto its back.

strings.text:
伝わってくる刺激は、痛いだとか苦しいだとかいう
次元のものではない。
strings.translated:
The sensation that came through was not something that could be described
as mere pain or suffering.

strings.text: 何しろ体に空いた穴を狙って蹴られたのだ。
strings.translated: After all, he had been kicked directly into the open wound in his body.

strings.text:
衝撃は体内を直接責め立て、肉体に埋め込んだ蟲が
怯えたように暴れ始めた。
strings.translated:
The impact assaulted his insides directly, and the Bugs embedded within his flesh
began to thrash about as if in a panic.

strings.text:
煉獄
「が、ぐっ……おおおおおおおおおおおっ！！！」
腹に空いた穴を縫合しながら、煉獄が立ち上がる。
strings.translated: Rengoku forces himself upright, suturing the hole in his gut as he rises.

strings.text:
胃袋を失うと言うダメージは大きかったが、それで
死ぬほど脆弱な肉体をしているわけでもなかった。
strings.translated:
Losing his stomach was a significant blow, but his body was not so fragile
that it would kill him.

strings.text: 煉獄の顔面に、優斗の拳が矢のように突き刺さる。
strings.translated: Yuuto's fist drives into Rengoku's face like an arrow.

strings.text:
二メートルを超える背丈の肉体が、ボールのように
宙を舞った。
strings.translated:
The massive frame standing over two meters tall went sailing through the air
like a ball.

strings.text: 苦悶の声さえ上がらない。
strings.translated: Not even a cry of agony escaped him.

strings.text:
顎が潰れ、喉が破れた煉獄には、声を出すだけの機能
さえ失われていた。
strings.translated:
With his jaw crushed and his throat torn open, Rengoku had lost even the ability
to produce a voice.

strings.text: 体内の蟲を用いて傷口を縫合する。
strings.translated: He uses the Bugs within his body to suture the wounds.

strings.text:
緑色の肉が絡み合い、顎が再生されていったが、煉獄
の口元に笑みは浮かんでいなかった。
strings.translated:
Green flesh intertwined as his jaw regenerated, but no smile came
to Rengoku's lips.

strings.text:
優斗
「口が変な形になってるぞ。
　肉を繋ぎ合わせただけって感じだ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Your mouth ended up in a weird shape.
 It looks like you just stitched the flesh back together."

strings.text: 煉獄が、自らの肉体に宿している蟲を飛ばす。
strings.translated: Rengoku launches the Bugs dwelling within his own body.

strings.text:
鋭い牙を持つ羽虫が二十匹ほど、優斗に向かって飛ん
で行った。
strings.translated:
Around twenty winged insects with razor-sharp fangs flew
straight toward Yuuto.

strings.text: 左右が狭い路地裏では、逃げ道などどこにもない。
strings.translated: In the narrow alley, there was nowhere to run.

strings.text:
優斗はあっと言う間に全身に喰い付かれ、その瞬間、
煉獄は己の勝利を確信した。
strings.translated:
Yuuto was swarmed all over his body in an instant, and in that moment,
Rengoku was certain of his victory.

strings.text:
如何に相手を殴り付ける力が強くとも、二十匹もの
蟲に同時に襲われては、成すすべもないはずだ。
strings.translated:
No matter how powerful the enemy's striking force, being attacked simultaneously
by twenty Bugs should leave him utterly helpless.

strings.text:
優斗が血肉の塊となって地面に転がる様を、煉獄は
頭の中で想像した。
strings.translated:
Rengoku pictured it in his mind -- Yuuto reduced to a lump of blood and flesh,
rolling across the ground.

strings.text:
優斗
「これがお前の奥の手か？」

優斗の声が聞こえた瞬間、二十匹もの蟲が一斉に地面
に落ちた。
strings.translated:
The moment Yuuto's voice reached him, all twenty Bugs dropped to the ground
at once.

strings.text:
そして、ガラスが割れるような音を立てながら、氷の
ように砕け散った。
strings.translated:
And then, with a sound like shattering glass, they shattered
like ice.

strings.text:
空気中に粉雪のようなものが舞い、月明かりを受けて
キラキラと輝いている。
strings.translated:
Something like powdery snow drifted through the air, glittering and sparkling
in the moonlight.

strings.text:
優斗
「なんだ。
　夢美の蟲のほうが、ずっと強いじゃないか」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Hm.
 Yumemi's Bugs are far stronger than yours."

strings.text:
優斗
「結局、雑魚を寄せ集めただけか」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"So in the end, you just scraped together a bunch of weaklings."

strings.text: 煉獄の体を、無数の何かが貫いた。
strings.translated: Countless somethings pierced through Rengoku's body.

strings.text:
視線を落とすと、メタリックブルーの触手が全身に
突き刺さっている。
strings.translated:
Looking down, he saw metallic blue tentacles skewering him
all over.

strings.text:
それは、まるで鉄のような重さと、鋼のような硬さを
もって煉獄の体内を掻き回していた。
strings.translated:
They churned through Rengoku's insides with a weight like iron
and a hardness like steel.

strings.text:
煉獄
「ぎ、あっ……ぎゃあああああああっ！！！」

パキンパキンと音を立てながら、煉獄の体内に氷の膜
が広がっていく。
strings.translated:
With a series of cracking sounds, a membrane of ice
spreads through Rengoku's body.

strings.text:
触手によって貫かれた部分を中心として、血、肉、骨、
そして臓器が、凍り付かされていく。
strings.translated:
Centered on the points pierced by the tentacles, his blood, flesh, bone,
and organs are being frozen solid.

strings.text:
煉獄は力任せに触手を引き剥がそうとしたが、触手は
ぴくりとも動いてはくれなかった。
strings.translated:
Rengoku tried to tear the tentacles free by brute force, but they would not
budge so much as an inch.

strings.text:
優斗
「そんなものは、もう何年も前に蟲に喰わせてやった
　よ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"That's something I fed to the Bugs
 many years ago."

strings.text: 煉獄を貫いている触手。
その発生源は、目の前にいる優斗の両腕だった。
strings.translated: Their source was the two arms of Yuuto standing before him.

strings.text:
基本的にはグネグネと蠢いて柔らかいが、煉獄に突き
刺さる直前から凍ったように硬くなっている。
strings.translated:
They were fundamentally soft and writhing, but had frozen rigid
just before plunging into Rengoku.

strings.text:
優斗は一歩足を踏み出すと、初めて嘲笑とも取れる
笑みを煉獄へと向けた。
strings.translated:
Yuuto took a step forward and, for the first time, turned a smile
toward Rengoku -- one that could only be called a sneer.

strings.text:
優斗
「お前が悠々と寝てる間、夢美は自分の蟲のことを
　徹底的に調べたんだ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"While you were lounging around sleeping, Yumemi was
 thoroughly studying her own Bugs."

strings.text:
優斗
「俺と夢美自身の体を実験体にして、あらゆる可能性
　を探ったんだ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Using me and Yumemi herself as test subjects, she explored
 every possibility."

strings.text:
優斗
「時にはＹ＆Ｙの料理に混ぜて、その効果を試したこ
　ともある」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"There were even times she mixed them into Y&Y's cooking
 to test the effects."

strings.text:
優斗
「自分に何ができるのか……」

優斗
「自分がどこまでできるのか……」

優斗
「目的の達成のために、夢美は蟲姫になる方法を探し
　続けた」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"In order to achieve her goal, Yumemi kept searching
 for a way to become the Bug Princess."

strings.text:
優斗
「俺達は蟲使いを滅ぼす。
　その障害になるものは全て潰す」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"We will destroy all Bug Users.
Anyone who stands in our way gets crushed."

strings.text:
優斗
「お前は蟲使いだったわけだし、何より夢美を犯した
　男だ」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"You were a Bug User, and more than that -- you're the man who violated Yumemi."

strings.text:
優斗
「粉々にぶっ潰してやる」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"I'm going to smash you to pieces."

strings.text:
煉獄が視認できたのは、優斗が接近して来るところま
でだった。
strings.translated: All Rengoku could make out was Yuuto closing in on him.

strings.text:
あとは、どこを殴られたのか、殴られた箇所がどう
なったのか、それを知ることはできなかった。
strings.translated: After that, he had no way of knowing where the blows landed, or what became of the places they struck.

strings.text: 耳に届くのは、ガラスが砕けるような音。
strings.translated: What reached his ears was a sound like shattering glass.

strings.text:
自分がこんなところで死ぬことを信じられないまま、
煉獄は呆気なく死んでいった……。
strings.translated: Still unable to believe he could die in a place like this, Rengoku died all too easily......

strings.text:
体内から凍らせた煉獄を粉々にして、優斗は小さく
溜息をついた。
strings.translated: Having shattered Rengoku -- frozen from the inside out -- into pieces, Yuuto let out a small sigh.

strings.text:
地面に広がるのは氷のカケラで、その元が煉獄の肉体
だと思えないほど、宝石のような輝きを放っている。
strings.translated: Spread across the ground were shards of ice, glittering like jewels in a way that made it impossible to believe they had once been Rengoku's body.

strings.text: 結果だけを見れば圧勝。
strings.translated: By the outcome alone, it was a complete victory.

strings.text:
だが、実のところ、優斗の胸の内はそれほど余裕のあ
るものではなかった。
strings.translated: But in truth, Yuuto's heart was not nearly as composed as that suggested.
His fingers trembled with small, rapid shivers.

strings.text:
人間と呼べるものの命を奪うのは、実のところ、これ
が初めてだった。
strings.translated: Taking the life of something that could still be called human -- in truth, this was the first time.

strings.text:
この十年間、自らの体を少しずつ強化はして来たもの
の、『戦い』というもっとも重要な経験を得ることは
できなかったのだ。
strings.translated: Over these past ten years, he had gradually strengthened his own body, yet he had been unable to gain the most crucial experience of all -- actual 'combat.'

strings.text:
人としての心を残した優斗にとって、煉獄との戦いが
恐ろしくないわけがなかった。
strings.translated: For Yuuto, who still retained a human heart, there was no way the fight with Rengoku had not been terrifying.

strings.text:
優斗
「うん……でも、大丈夫みたいだな」
strings.translated:
Yuuto
"Yeah... but it looks like I'm okay."

strings.text: 蟲使いと戦うための力。
strings.translated: The power to fight Bug Users.

strings.text:
自分が、それを確かに得られていることを、優斗は
煉獄との戦いの中で実感していた。

strings.translated: For the first time in ages I have a little breathing room -- though I'm still at the office and testing is still going on, so really all that's happened is that I've finally, barely finished the whole scenario. I'm Izumi Manya.

strings.text: 皆様、初めましてｏｒお久しぶりでゴザイマス。
